o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i ring lugs bsang gsol gyi rim pa phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa yid bzhin 'dod pa 'jo ba'i gter bum zhes bya ba bzhugs so/

tei:div.tei:p: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i ring lugs bsang gsol gyi rim pa phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa yid bzhin 'dod pa 'jo ba'i gter bum zhes bya ba bzhugs so// // o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i ring lugs bsang gsol phyogs bsdus kyi them byang bzhugs so// // o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa yi/ /ring lugs bsang gsol rgyas pa dang*/ /g.yang khrus rab gnas nyer mkho 'ga'/ /phyogs bsdus 'dod 'jo'i gter bum rmad/ /de'i dkar chags gter chen po'i/ /bum pa'i kha 'byed lde'u mig /blo ldan gang 'dod 'tshol bde'i slad/ /spel gyis grogs dag gus pas longs/ /o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i ring lugs bsang gsol gyi rim pa phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa yid bzhin 'dod pa 'jo ba'i gter bum la dpe tshan 'tshol bde'i sa bcad mdor bstan dang*/ nang gses rgyas par 'god pa gnyis las/ dang po sa bcad mdor bstan pa la bzhi'i thog mar glegs bam nyid kyi them byang sogs sngon gyi rim pa dang*/ gnyis pa/ rang lugs gtso bor gyur pa'i lha bsang phyogs bsdus skor

(22-268) gsum pa/ g.yang khrus rab gnas sogs nyer mkho 'ga' (270-498 bzhi pa gsol kha rgyas pa phrin las srid zhi kun khyab (499-970) bar ro/ de dag gi nang gses dkar chag rgyas par 'god pa la/ ༈ dang po glegs bam nyid kyi them byang dang*/ spros bcas bsang gsol gyi gtor ma'i bca' thabs mes po'i phyag bzhes so/ ༈ gnyis pa o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i ring lugs gtsor gyur lha bsang phyogs bsdus gyi skor la/ bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las/ brngan bsang 'dod rgu char 'bebs/ rang lugs gtso bor gyur pa'i bsang mchod sna tshogs phyogs bsdus kyi skor la/ ri bo bsang mchod/ chos skyong sde lnga'i bsang*/ dpal ldan lha mo'i bsang*/ yang phur btsan bsang*/ chos rgyal chen po'i bsang*/ ban thung bsang*/ wer ma'i lha bsang ring mo mi pham gsung*/ ge sar bsang bsdus khag gsum/ mnol bsang lha chab sngon mo/ grib bsang*/ rlung rta yar skyed bsang*/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo bsdus pa/ phyogs bcu'i mun sel bsdus pa/ bkra shis brtsegs pa bsdus pa/ klu bsang bla sel chen mo/ sa bdag bshags 'bum/ bsang bsdus khag /dzam lha dkar po'i bsang*/ rta bsang*/ nor lha'i bsang*/ lug bsang*/ zhi ba dkar bsang*/ gze rgyal bsang khag 'ga'/ mtsho dkar dmar bsang*/ srung 'dzugs thabs/ phye mar g.yang skyabs/ yul ris bye brag pa'i bsang mchod/ ༈ gsum pa g.yang khrus rab gnas sogs nyer mkho kha skong sna tshogs kyi skor la/ 1) thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las/ bstan skyong yul gyi cho ga 2) ri bstod dang ri khrus zur bkol byas pa/ 3) thugs sgrub khrus gsol zur rgyan dang bcas pa phyogs bsgrigs/ 4) nor sgrub bsod nams stobs bskyed/ 5) g.yang 'bod dngos grub char 'bebs/ 6) rab gnas bsdus pa/ 7) bka' brgyad gsang ba zil gnon las/ gnam sa snang brgyad kyi cho ga 8) cha gsum bcas so/ ༈ bzhi pa o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i ring lugs rgyun gsol phyogs bsdus cung zad rgyas pa'i lugs su bkod pa phrin las srid zhi kun khyab la rgyun gsol dang gtor 'bul yongs rdzogs phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa drag bskul gyi rim pa phyogs bsdebs mtha' bsdus tshogs mchod bcas bzhi las/

dang po rgyun gsol gyi rim pa la/ thog mar gong gnon la brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs dang rdo rje phur pa'i bla brgyud gsol 'debs/ bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las/ las byang phrin las rgyun khyer/ gnyis pa rgyun gsol dngos la/ thog mar rtsa gsum chos skyong dang bcas pa'i gtor bsngos rig 'dzin srog sgrub/ phur srung nyer bzhi'i gtor 'bul/ bka' brgyad las mgon po phyag bzhi'i gsol ka /chos skyong kun 'dus kyi gtor 'bul/ ma hā kā la'i ka bstod/ ye shes mgon po phyag drug pa'i gsol mchod/ mgon po bya rog gdong gi gsol mchod/ thugs sgrub kyi bka' srung chos skyong sde lnga/ lha mo bsod nams dbang rgyal ma/ a phyi'i ka bstod/ dpal ldan lha mo dud sol ma'i gsol mchod/ lha mo'i bskang gsol/ 'khrugs skong chags med gsung*/ lha mo'i mnga' gsol/ sngags srung rang byung rgyal mo'i phrin bcol/ dbang gi lha mo'i bstod bskul/ dbyings phyug zhi mo/ dbyings phyug drag mo/ zhing skyong gi gsol ka /dgongs pa zang thal gyi sngags srung ma/ kī la ya'i bka' srung e ka dzā ṭi/ 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi gza' yi sgrub thabs/ kī la ya'i bka' srung gza' mchog gtor 'bul/ dam can/ btsan rgod rol pa bco brgyad kyi gsol ka /btsan gsol blo gros rab 'phel gyis mdzad pa/ rgyal po pe ha ra'i gsol ka /gze rgyal gsol ka /gze rgyal gsol bsdus/ de'i mnga' gsol dang bskang ba/ pad+ma rgyal po'i gter srung klu mo/ gnas bdag dge bsnyen/ gshin rje'i gter srung dge bsnyen/ yang dge bsnyen gtor 'bul/ ge sar gsol mchod/ rgyal chen rnam sras/ thang lha/ ban thung*/ skrag dbyi/ sde brgyad gser skyems/ yul lha spyi yi mchod thabs sogs gsol mchod skor/ ༈ gnyis pa gtor 'bul phyogs bsgrigs skor/ ༈ gsum pa drag bskul phyogs bsdebs/ ༈ bzhi pa mtha' bsdus phur pa'i tshogs mchod/ bcas de dag gis gsol ka'i skor rnams grub bo/

༈ o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i ring lugs spros bcas bsang gsol gyi gtor ma bca' thabs mes po'i phyag bzhes zhes bya ba bzhugs so// // bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon gyi lha bsang rgyal brngan bca' thabs ni/ brngan gtor rgyas pa la/ gdan gru bzhi lnga brtsegs steng*/ pad 'dab bzhi mthil sprod/ de steng rtsa gsum spyi gtor bzhag /bang rim gnyis pa'i khar/ dmar gtor brgyad 'dab chags sogs gnam la 'phur dgu/ bang rim gsum pa la dmar gtor sum cu so gsum ri dwags dang sder chags/ bang rim bzhi par dkar gtor brgyad dang g.yung dwags/ bang rim lnga par bkra shis rdzas rtags dang chu gnas/ mdun du g.yag lug ra gsum gzugs 'gros bcas pa bzhag /zur bzhi la 'brang rgyas bzhi/ phyogs bzhi la changs bu bzhi dang ja phud chang phud shel tshig 'bru sna zan bcad spyan gzigs dar mtshon sogs dang*/ rgyan lnga rgyan nyi zla nor bus brgyan par bya'o/ ༈ 'bring po'i lugs la ni/ gdan gru bzhi sum brtsegs steng*/ zhi gtor pad 'dab bzhi pa rgyan spros can/ bang rim rnams su dmar gtor brgyad dang de 'og dmar gtor sum cu so gsum dang*/ de 'og dkar gtor brgyad/ mdun du g.yag lug ra gsum/ spyan gzigs dang dar tshon/ shel tshig sogs 'du bya'o/ ༈ bsdu na zhi gtor pad 'dab bzhi can gcig gis 'thus so/ spyan gzigs dar tshon dang shel tshig sogs gong bzhin du byas pas 'thus so/ ༈ mdun du chos skyong spyi gtor ni/ chos 'byung bsnol ma'i steng*/ dmar gtor leb zhal can/ 'khor sum cu dang*/ bsdus na dgu'am bcu bya/ snying dang sha dum/ dar mtshon gyis brgyan/ ༈ g.yas su dgra lha'i gtor ma ni/ gdan gru bzhi sum brtsegs khar/ mkhar thab tog gis mtshan pa/ bang rim gnyis par bshos bu rtse gsum dgu/ gsum par dkar gtor bzhi dang mdun rgyab gang bder go mtshon sogs dgra lha'i rten rnams bkram par bya'o/ ༈ g.yon du brtan ma ni/

bum pa'i khar/ sman ting zhal dkar pad 'dab bzhi pa'i mthar dmar gtor bcu gnyis la sman leb kyis brgyan par bya'o/ mthar nyer spyod sna tshogs dang 'bru sna sman sna ja phud chang phud bsang phye bcas dang*/ g.yang rten phye mar nyi zla nor bus brgyan pa/ g.yang chang mda' dar sogs 'os pa'i chas rnams ma tshang pa med par bya'o/ gnyis pa gsol kha'i bca' bsham ni/ gtso bo yi dam bka' phur gu drag sogs rtsa gsum gang du bgyis pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyas spros sam/ bsdus pa'i dbang du byas na/ gong gnon yang phur gy-i gtor ma spyi ltar dang*/ bsdu na rtsa gsum spyi gtor la/ gdan gru bzhi'i khar dpal gtor rtse thon dpung gshog sna rdze can/ pad 'dab bzhi dang*/ mtshams su mtheb skyu nyis brtsegs gong du ril bu res mtshan pa bzhag la rgyan legs bya/ g.yas g.yon sman raka bskul gtor la dmar gtor gdong zhal 'khor brgyad/ ༈ chad mdo la dmar gtor tha tshig lnga/ brtan ma la stod zur smad zlum g.yon logs su mtheb skyus brgyan par bu pang ma zhes grags la 'khor dkar gtor bcu gcig gis bskor ba dang*/ ༈ gtor bsngos rig 'dzin srog sgrub kyi skong gtor ni/ gdan gru bzhi dpangs mtho ba zhig gi khar gtor ma zhi gtor gyi dbyibs la zur gsum dpung gshog zla gam rak+ta'i rgyun lam dang pad 'dab bzhis brgyan pa mtshams bzhi o kyu bzhi ze'u 'bru dang bcas pa/ lnga rgyan pa tra nyi zla nor bus mtshan pa/ ༈ mdun du cung zad dma' ba'i bang rim gyi khar bka' srung yongs rdzogs kyi gtor ma gsol kha'i 'grigs rim ltar sbreng tshar du bkod par bya ba la/ ༈ thog mar phur srung rgyas pa ltar na dbang phyug nyer brgyad la/ gtor ma che ba gcig la 'khor drug khrag kyu nyer gcig zor mde'u ltar la sha khrag gis brgyan par bshams/ ༈ phur srung bcu drug la/ gtor snod gang rung gsum mam bzhi bhan+dha lcags zangs sogs kyi snod du:

thog mar bswe mo bzhi la dpal gtor nag po g.yon gcus: ljang gu bya rog mgo: dmar po g.yas gcus: sngon po sbrul dkris: ming po bzhi la dmar gtor rtse zur bzhi yod pa dmar nag dkar ser yin: ging bzhi la dpal gtor nag po: dmar gtor sho ris: nag po khram ris: dkar po gru lag: sngon po chos 'byung bcas gri ris bya: re ti bzhi la sog kha'i steng du dpal gtor chu ris sngon po: me ri bu spang : sa ris ri rab: shing ris gru bzhi bcas kha dog rang mdog bya: mar rgyan mtheb skyu ci rigs sha dum bcas la dpal 'bar yang btsugs/ bsdu na dmar gtor gcig la rang 'dra bco lngas bskor ba/ ༈ mgon po phyag bzhi pa la/ gdan 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad/ de steng rtsibs bzhi/ de steng chos 'byung kha khyer la thod skam brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ de steng snying bshos zur brgyad la pad 'dab bzhi/ bsdu na/ dmar gtor gtso 'khor lnga/ mtshams su mtheb skyu bzhi bya/ ༈ phyag drug pa'i gtor bsngos la/ dmar gtor zhig gi mdun khrag kyu gcig bzhag ༈ mgon po bya rog gdong la/ 'bru nag gi ngar phye la dpal gtor zlum po khram ris can g.yas gcus: gdan chos 'byung gi kha ru bzhag: mdun du khrag kong lhan du 'brang rgyas tshe nyungs kyis mtshan pa bzhag: 'khor dpal gtor bzhi dang kyu gu bzhi mtheb skyu brgyad gzhan yang sha sna snying sna ke tshe shang tshes brgyan: nyungs dkar nag gi sgang bu kyang gzug: ༈ chos skyong sde lnga la/ gdan ri rab bang rim gsum pa: de'i steng du 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa dang bzhi pa: de'i steng du thod pa'i sgyed pu gsum: de'i steng du chos 'byung rngams 'thug gcig la thod tshal gyi kha bad yod pa: bang rim gsum dang ldan pa: de'i steng du rin chen zur brgyad pa: de'i steng du mgon po'i gtor ma tsit+ta'i dpal bshos thod tshal bzhis brgyan pa bya: rtsibs bzhi pa'i steng shar du zhing skyong mgon po'i gtor ma dbal zur gsum dang ldan pa dpung gshog gnyis brgyangs pa thog mde'u lta bur khrag kong gsum gyis bskor ba:

zor ris rak+ta'i rgyun lam bya: lho ru gza' mchog gtor ma dpal gtor g.yas gcus gru gsum gyi steng du sbrul mgo gsum brgyan pa: logs gsum du bzhag: nub tu gnod sbyin gtor ma chos 'byung steng du bra gzugs dbal thon la tsit+ta gsum chos 'byung zur gsum du bzhag: gri ris kyang 'then: byang du rgyal po dpe ha ra'i gtor ma gdan gru bzhi'i steng du mkhar thab rtse mo spre'u mgos mtshan pa mkhar gyi logs gsum du phyi ba gyen du langs pa bya: rtsibs bcu par shar du lha bshos: shar mtshams dkar gtor: shar lho kong bu gru bzhi'i kha ru phyi ba: lho ru gtor ma nag po zur bzhi pa khram ris can: lho nub tu dpal gtor g.yas gcus: nub tu sog kha'i steng du snying bshos: nub mtshams su mkhar thab steng du ra mgo bzhag: nub byang rus sbal steng du 'brang rgyas: byang du gtor ma zur gsum sbrul mgos brgyan par sbrul dkris can: byang shar du zur gsum g.yas gcus: mtshams rnams su khrag kong bcu: bang rim rnams su gtor zur drug cu rtsa bzhi: ling tshe drug cu rtsa gnyis mtha' ru khrag kong dang mtheb skyu: mtshams bzhir dbang po rnam lnga bcas rtse mor mdzes pa'i rgyan khra: gzhan yang liṅga'i rgyal mtshan dang dmar rgyan tshe nyungs kyi rkang bu bcas: rtse mor dar nag po'i rgyal mtshan: shar du seng lpags rgyal mtshan: lho ru stag lpags rgyal mtshan: nub tu dom lpags rgyal mtshan: byang du zhing lpags rgyal mtshan: mtshams su ru mtshon dkar ser dmar ljang : gru bzhir dar mtshon sna lnga: byung na snal ma'i gdugs bcas phub: ༈ lha mo bsod nams dbang rgyal ma la/ stod zur smad zlum 'khor rang 'dra bzhi/ ༈ dud sol ma la/ dmar gtor gtso 'khor gsum/ ༈ rang byung rgyal mo la/ dmar gtor bshos zlum mtheb skyus bskor ba/ ༈ dbyings phyug zhi mo gtso bo zlum gtor 'khor rang 'dra bzhi bya/ ༈ dbyings phyug drag mo la/

gtor zur smad zlum 'khor dmar gtor che bzhi phyogs bzhir bzhag /mdun du dmar gtor chung ba gsum/ ༈ zhing skyong la/ dmar gtor seng zhal lam rtse bcad 'khor dregs pa sde brgyad kyis bskor ba zhig ༈ byang gter sngags srung ma la/ gtor ma snying gi gzugs rtse sum zur du yod pa'am/ zur gsum 'gying can mtheb skyus bskor ba/ ༈ sngags srung e dzā ṭi la/ tsit+ta zur brgyad kyi gzugs yod pa la dmar gyis brgyan/ ༈ 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi gza' la/ 'bru nag dpal gtor smad zlum la: bya rog mgo dang me ri yis: mtshan pa'i rgyan bkra legs par btab: 'khor du gtor chung brgyad kyis bskor: ༈ kī la ya'i gza' la/ gza' dmar gtor bya mgo can g.yas gcus/ gza' brgyad dmar gtor yin/ 'khor gdong mo bzhi la mtheb skyu/ ༈ dam can la/ dmar gtor ra mgos mtshan pa 'khor dmar gtor gsum/ ༈ btsan rgod rol pa bco brgyad bca' rim ni/ bang rim sum brtsegs kyi kha ru btsan mkhar gru bzhi bzhag /de'i steng la dmar gtor ra dgu pa tsit+ta gsum gyis brgyan pa bzhag: de nas rim bzhin btsan rol pa bcu bdun g.yas skor rnam pas: ber ma ri rab thog mde'u: dmar po kong zor snying brgyan: beng smug chos 'byung bra gzugs: rol pa khrag kong liṅga: lha btsan dkar gtor rtse gsum: mig dmar zangs sho zangs khrab: mtshal stag bam ro zlum po: lho btsan dpal gtor thod brgyan: sog ra g.yas gcus g.yon gcus: zangs ri zla skyong g.yas gcus: sham po rmog gzugs 'phru can: 'bar ba khrag 'thung glo ba'i rgyal mtshan: rdo rje 'bar ba bshos bu rtse gsum: zangs btsan mkhar thab shwa rus brgyan: rong btsan sprel dmar bya dmar: rdor legs ra mgo 'dab can: shel ging phyi ba lag sbrel: de rnams spros pa'i skabs yin la bsdus pa'i skabs dmar gtor bcu bdun gyis bskor ba'i chog ༈ rgyal po la/ ri rab bang rim gsum gyi kha ru mkhar thab rgya phibs dang bcas pa'i steng dril gzugs rin chen zur brgyad/

bum pa'i steng tog bzhag /de'i phyogs bzhir mar me'i rgyal mtshan bzhi/ zur bzhi la phyi ba gyen du phyogs pa bzhi/ mtshams bzhir spre'u rgyal mtshan bzhi/ de'i phyi rim bar ma la dpal bshos rtse zur bcu/ bang rim 'og ma la g.yas su gtor ma rtse gsum lnga/ rgyab tu rkang gzugs lnga/ g.yon tu 'brang rgyas lnga/ mdun du zhal zas lnga/ mtshams su sman bshos lnga/ phyi rol du sgal phreng bcas/ rtse mor rgyan mdzes dang*/ dar tshon sna tshogs bklubs/ ༈ tsi'u dmar la/ dmar gtor zur gsum g.yon gcus/ 'khor rang 'dra drug /bya dmar bdun klad na lding ba/ mthar khyi dmar bdun/ khrag kong khar dgra ling sha dum gyis brgyan pa dar dmar ru mtshon/ mthar gzugs 'gros kyi rgyan bskor/ ༈ gze rgyal drag po la/ dbus su dpal gtor zlum po dmar gyis brgyan zhing mtheb skyus bskor ba mdun du yum khrag kyu bzhag /mdun rgyab gnyis la dkar gtor re re bya/ ༈ zhi ba 'dzam gling byang skyong la/ bshos bu rtse gsum la pad 'dab brgyad bya/ ༈ pad+ma rgyal po'i nor skyong klu mo la/ bshos bu sngon po sbrul dkris can: mtheb skyu bzhi yis bskor bar bya: ༈ dzam lha dbang sdud dmar po'i gter srung dge bsnyen la/ dge bsnyen bshos zlum sbrul dkris can la/ g.yas su bshos zlum/ g.yon du dmar gtor khram ris/ rgyab du dmar gtor/ mdun du mtheb skyu sogs kyis brgyan/ ༈ gshin rje'i gter srung dge bsnyen la/ bshos bu nag po zur gsum pa rtse la sbrul gdengs dang ldan pa: sbrul gnyis bsnol gyis dkris pa: g.yas g.yon du dmar gtor la dgra bo liṅga dang sdig pas brgyan pa: 'khor mtheb skyu bcu gnyis/ ༈ ge sar la/ dmar gtor khrab ris can 'khor sum cu/ ༈ rnam sras la/ gdan ri rab bang rim gsum brtsegs khar rin chen zur brgyad/ de steng gter bum khar gtor ma zlum po pad 'dab bzhi yis mtshan pa/ zur brgyad la bshos bu brgyad/

mtshams rnams su ril bu bzhag /rgyan khra nor bu gang mdzes bya/ ༈ thang lha la/ mchod gtor gru gsum gsham dkris can lug mgos mtshan pa/ ༈ ban thung la/ dmar gtor rtse mo bshos bu dpung gshog gor mo rtsa ba zlum por rgyun lam can/ ༈ skrag dbyi gnyis la/ dkar gtor pad 'dab can gnyis bya/ sde brgyad cha snyoms dang sa yul spyi la/ dkar gtor pad 'dab can bya/ gzhan yang rgyun 'bul dkar dmar gang mang dang gser skyems g.yu skyems 'bru sna rin chen brdar phye sogs dgos pa'i yo byad mtha' dag tshags su tshud par bya'o/ gong gsal bca' bsham rnams rang yul du dar ba'i phyag srol cung mi 'dra bar mchis pa las/ gtso bo sgo chen bdud 'dul sngags gling gi gnam lcags yongs rdzogs kyi gtor ma'i zin bris dang gnam lcags ri khrod dang ngang zo dgon pa'i phyag srol ltar ri pa smad dgon gyi bca' bsham yig rigs dang gtor ma'i dpe'u ris cha tshang bzhugs pa dang rtsa ba'i gter gzhung gnyis zhib bsdur thog /gwa gra bla ma karma 'brug grags kyi phyag rgyun ldan pa'i grwa don grub tshe 'phel/ 'gam phu ri khrod kyi phyag rgyun ldan pa sgrub bla mi nub rgyal mtshan/ ri smad dgon gyi phyag rgyun ldan pa 'brong bla karma longs spyod sgo chen dgon gyi phyag rgyun ldan pa gangs leb dgon gyi bla ma o rgyan gsang sngags dang*/ gnam lcags gdan srol ltar lag len mkhyen pa'i mkhan po ngag dbang dge legs sogs kyi lag len dngos la blta bsdur dang*/ zhib dpyad kyis phal cher mthun che ba rnams gtso bor byas shing spyi la phan pa'i lhag bsam gyis kun nas bslangs te sprul ming gnam lcags gsang sngags bstan 'dzin gyis gtan la phab pa bzhin gtor ma'i dpe'u ris 'god po ri dgon sgrub bla gsang sngags ye shes rgya mtshos bgyis shing yi ge pa ni o rgyan gsang sngags 'gro 'dul gyis bgyis pa dge bar gyur cig/

// ༈ bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: bsang brngan 'dod rgu char 'bebs bzhugs so: kyai ye shes dbyings kyi lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: e maḥ bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: phyi rabs skal ldan don slad du: rten 'brel dge legs 'byung ba'i ched: bsang brngan 'dod rgu char 'bebs bstan: 'di yi yon tan bsam mi khyab: tshe rabs las kyi sgrib pa byang : sbyin smin bsod nams tshogs chen rdzogs: yi dam lha yi bka' chad zhi: dkyil 'khor gnyan gyi dam tshig gso: chos skyong rnams kyi 'khu ldog sel: lha srin sde brgyad gdug rtsub zhi: sngon las 'phral rkyen sha 'khon byang : dus min 'chi ba'i bdud las grol: phyi yul skag rkyen dgra la bzlog: nang gi mnga' thang srid kyang bskyed: che btsan gzi byin mthu dang ldan: bka' gter srung mas bu bzhin skyong : gzhi lam byes su kha 'dzin myur: lo nyes sad ser nad yams zhi: yul bzung sa bcud rnams kyang dge: bkra shis phun sum tshogs pa'i rten: lha bsang 'di la rag las pas: rten 'brel mchog la 'di nyid bzung : mtsho rgyal brda yi yi ger thob: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: dpal bkra shis dge ba'i dus tshes mgor: thabs rten 'brel bsang mchod brtsam pa ni: rgyu bsod nams phun tshogs mchod rdzas bsags: don bden gnyis ngang la gzhung bsrang ngo : sa ma ya: dang po bkra shis dge ba'i yar tshes bzang po la: gzhi gtsang dkar ba yid du 'ong bar bzo: de yi steng du 'bru yi tshom bu rab lha grangs: 'bring pad+ma 'dab brgyad: tha ma gang 'byor bsham: de yang bkra shis dge legs 'byung ba'i gnad rdzas la: tshang zhing 'byor ldan cher dgos so: gnyis pa gtor ma'i rnam dbye ni: pad gzhong lcags min pa'i snod gtsang ma'i nang : gzhi ri rab gru bzhi sum brtsegs sam: yang na lnga brtsaigs bya: de yang srid pa gsum 'byung ba lnga mtshon pa yin:

de yi steng du pad+ma mthil sprod bya: de yi steng du bla ma rtsa gsum gtor ma: de la 'khor gtor zur brgyad kyis bskor: pad 'dab la sogs spyi dang mthun: 'bring po zhi gtor zlum po bzhag: bsdu na dkar gtor gcig kyang bya: ri rab bang rim dag la ni: dang po dpal gtor sum cus bskor: mdun du g.yag lug ra gsum bzhag: phyogs bzhir mtshams brgyad dkar gtor brgyad: de yi phyi rol spyan gzigs dang : mchod rdzas bskang rdzas rnams kyis bskor: de yi phyi rol gzugs 'gros tshogs: de yi phyi rol 'dab chags tshogs: de yi phyi rol changs bu bya: rtse mor nyi zla nor bu bya: dkar dmar rgyan tshogs phra bar bcos: rin chen sna tshogs dar zab rigs: rgyan dang phye ma gcal du bkram: 'bring po gzugs 'gros mi bya na: dpal gtor sum cu g.yag lug ra: dkar gtor brgyad dang changs bus bskor: shel tshig khri dkar stong nag spung : des kyang 'bring po'i lugs shig tshang : gzhan yang phyi nang mchod rdzas 'bul: phye mar 'o skol zhal zas dang : 'bru sman sna tshogs rnams kyang bkram: spyan gzigs go khrab lha rten gzugs: phyi nang mchod rdzas tshang bar bya: de nas dgra lha'i gtor ma ni: g.yas su snod gtsang dag gi nang : ri rab gru bzhi sum brtsegs steng : mkhar thab tog bcas tshang ba la: bshos bu rtse gsum dgu yis bskor: de yi phyi rol dkar gtor bzhi: de dag dkar dmar rgyan gyis spras: g.yon du pad gzhong yangs pa'i nang : bum pa'i steng du sman bshos bzhag: de la brtan ma bcu gnyis bskor: sman leb bcu gnyis sha sogs brgyan: gzhan yang gzhi zur 'tshams pa ru: lcags zangs bhan+dha'i snod dag tu: chos 'byung bsnol ma de yi steng : dmar gtor dbal bcas tshang ba la: dpal gtor sum cus bskor bar bya: bsdu na dgu'am bcu gsum bya: sha khrag dmar gyis rab tu brgyan: phye mar mar gyis brgyan pa bsham: de nas bsang shug rim pa ni:

rab ltar tsan+dan a ga ru: lha shug ba lu mkhan pa dkar: 'bring ni stab shing mdung shing dang : lo ma phyug pa'i shing lo'o: tha mar dug shing chu shing dang : shel shing ag shing bse shing dang : lcang ma glang ma ma lags pa'i: shing sna gang la byas kyang rung : sna tshogs bsdu na gang yang gnas: rab ni bsang khang gsum tsam phub: dbus su zhi ba'i lha bsang la: g.yas su dgra lha'i lha bsang ste: g.yon du drag po'i lha bsang ngo : zhi ba'i sbyin sreg ltar bya na: dbus su pad+ma 'dab brgyad bri: phyi rim zla phyed rdo rje dang : rigs bzhi'i phyag mtshan me ris bskor: nad gcod la sogs khag che na: bsang gzhi'i 'og tu g.yang gzhi bkod: de steng sa stegs bzhag par bya: gnad 'gag med na mi bya'o: de nas dkyil 'khor cha tshang nas: bsang brngan cho gar 'jug pa ni: bde ba'i gdan la skyil krung bzhugs: phyi nang bskyed rdzogs ldan pa'i ngang : dang po skyabs yul rgyas pa gzhung ltar bya: hūm̐: chos dbyings lhun grub bde chen ngang nyid las: mdun gyi nam mkhar seng khri pad zla'i gdan: pad+ma 'byung gnas snang srid zil gnon sku: dkar dmar mdangs ldan pad zhwa mthong grol gsol: rdo rje bhan+dha tshe bum kha ṭ+wāṃ bsnams: chos gos dmar po za ber smug nag gsol: g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum rgyal po rol stabs bzhugs: bag dro lhun chags gzi brjid ldan par bsgom: g.yas su seng khri dar 'bol gdan steng du: sangs rgyas kun 'dus sprul sku shākya thub: btso ma'i gzi 'bar sa gnon mnyam bzhag bzhugs: g.yon du pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan steng du: dge 'dun kun 'dus gsang bdag rdo rje gtum: mthing nag rdo rje sdigs mdzub mkha' la gtad: rgyab tu mdangs ldan pad nyi'i gdan steng du: dam chos 'byung gnas dbyings phyug yum chen mo: mthing ka phyag gnyis ral gri pu ti 'dzin: mdun du pad+ma nyi zla bam ro'i gdan: che mchog smug nag rdo rje bhan+dha bsnams:

skyabs yul phyi nang dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: ma bcos stong pa'i dbyings su 'ja' ltar bsgom: na mo: dkyil 'khor gtso bo bla ma thod pa rtsal: gsol 'debs skyabs mchi phyi nang bar chad sol: mnyam med bcom ldan sangs rgyas kun 'dus la: gsol 'debs skyabs mchi phyi nang bar chad sol: gsang bdag thugs mchog dge 'dun kun 'dus la: gsol 'debs skyabs mchi phyi nang bar chad sol: dam chos gsang mdzod dbyings phyug mkha' 'gro la: gsol 'debs skyabs mchi phyi nang bar chad sol: yi dam rtsa gsum che mchog he ru kar: gsol 'debs skyabs mchi phyi nang bar chad sol: skyabs yul mchog gsum thugs rje kun 'dus la: bdag dang mkha' mnyam sems can bskyab tu gsol: mi 'bral rtag tu spyi gtsug dbyings la bzhugs: lus ngag yid gsum dwang bas phyag 'tshal bstod: rtse gcig 'dun pa'i mchod sprin bla med mchod: dbang po gling bzhi ri rab maṇ+ḍal 'bul: tshe rabs sgo gsum sgrib gnyis mthol lo bshags: 'gro mgon thugs rje'i mnga' bdag che la bstod: mya ngan mi 'da' 'gro ba'i dpal gyur bzhugs: theg chen bla med chos 'khor bskor du gsol: mtha' yas 'gro kun byang chub lam 'god bsngo: las ngan gdung ba'i tshad las rab sgrol shog: de nas mchod pa byin rlabs ni: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces skabs 'dir spro na sngags drug gis byin gyis brlab pa ni: lag pa thal mo khang stong sbyar ba mtheb sor rnams rtse sprad pa chos nyid rnam dag gi phyag rgya dang sngags ni: oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ gtor ma dang mchod rdzas rnams kyi 'bag pa dang mi gtsang ba sogs ma dag pa'i snang ba thams cad stong par gyur/ lag pa gnyis mnyam pa'i thal mo dbus ma gsum gyi tshigs bar ma rnam bcags nas nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang sngags ni: na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu ṣe bh+yaḥ

sarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā: gtor ma dang mchod rdzas rnams rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che bar zag pa med pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po rgyun mi 'chad par gyur cig: lag gnyis thal mo sbyar ba las mdzub mo gnyis gung mo'i rgyab tu kha phye la sbyar: mthe bong gnyis bsnol ba bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i phyag rgya dang sngags ni: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭ/ gtor ma dang mchod rdzas rnams 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga'i rang bzhin du gyur pa thams cad mgron so so'i thob pa la bgegs dang nyer 'tshe med par gyur cig /lag pa g.yas pa pus mo g.yas kyi steng du mchod sbyin dang mnyam bzhag byas pa rgya che shugs ldan gyi phyag rgya dang sngags ni: oṃ ā kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma naṃ a d+ya nut+pan+na twata oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ gtor mgron so sos gang la gang 'dod kyi dngos po rnams yid bzhin du 'byung bar gyur cig /lag g.yon khu tshur bcangs la pang du bzhag pas rdo rje khu tshur gyi mdzub mo bsgrengs nas sdigs mdzub bstan pa ye shes skar mda'i phyag rgya sngags ni/ oṃ dzñā na ā wa lo ki te na maḥs man+ta s+pha ra ṇa rasmi bha wa ma hā ma ṇi du ru du ru hri da ya dz+wa la ni swā hā/ gtor mgron rnams drag zhan che chung med par so so'i yid bzhin du tshim zhing rang dbang du longs spyod par gyur cig /drug pa lag pa gnyis rdo rje nang du bsdams pa spyi bo'i thad kar bskor ba dbang sgyur 'khor lo'i phyag rgya dang sngags ni/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dha naṃ gra he shwa ri pra bhañdza na ma hā sa ma ye hūm̐ phaṭ/ gtor ma dang mchod rdzas rnams bskal pa ji srid gnas kyi bar du zag pa med cing mgron rnams mnyes pa'i mthu dang ldan par gyur cig /brjod kyang chog /ma 'byor na gsang sngags rdo rje theg chen lugs la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ la tshang :

oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃḥ stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i snod gling bzhi ri rab bkod pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dam can chos skyong nor lha gter bdag rgyud srung : gzhan yang lha srin sde brgyad dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu: yang 'khor sprul pa'i ru 'dren: sangs rgyas bstan pa'i bya ra ba 'bum: khyad par gzhi bdag drag rtsal dang ldan pa: yul ri sa brtan gnyan po srung ba: stong gsum stong gi bdag po: 'dzam bu gling gi zo dor: rdzu 'phrul dgra lha'i dmag dpung : bod skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis: sbas gnas gangs can srung ma: lo zla zhag dus mtshams 'dzin: rten 'brel chen po la dbang ba rnams la mnyes pa'i rdzas mchog: spyan gzigs dar mtshon rgyan gyis nam mkha' sa gzhi khyab pa: sra brtan go khrab mtshon cha rno la gzeng ba: sku 'bag bla 'khor srog rten ri ltar brjid pa: rkang bzhi gzugs 'gros sna tshogs gar rtsed bsgyur ba: 'dab chags skad snyan sna tshogs 'phur 'jums lding ba: gser dngul rin chen sna tshogs gcal du bkram pa: bkra shis rdzas rtags sna tshogs phun sum tshogs pa: 'bru bcud 'bras bu sna tshogs ri ltar spungs pa: dkar mngar bdud rtsi'i phud mchod mtsho ltar 'khyil ba: phye mar sman dang dri zhim gangs ltar rgyas pa: bha ling rten gtor sgrub rdzas dbyings dang mnyam pa: dri zhim bsang gi dud pa phyogs bcur khyab pa: sna tshogs sgra snyan rol mo 'brug ltar ldir ba: gzhan yang phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod rdzas nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ oṃ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ oṃ ma hā bha ling+ta te dz+wa bha ling+ta bha la bha te gu h+ya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ āḥham̐'u:

oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥham̐'u: oṃ badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra shab+da āḥham̐'u: oṃ badz+ra rū pa āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra rā sa āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra spar+she ā hūm̐: oṃ badz+ra sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: zhes rol mo sna tshogs drag tu brdungs shing dri zhim gyi dud pa bdug: de nas rang nyid bdag bskyed ni: hūm̐: rang nyid dran rdzogs pad+ma 'byung gnas gsal: dkar dmar mdangs ldan gzi brjid dpal du 'bar: zhal 'dzum mdangs mnga' spyan rtsa phyogs bcur 'khyil: pad zhwa mthong grol dar dpyangs cod pan 'phur: snyan cha mgul rgyan rin chen se mo do: phod kha chos gos lhab lhub ber chen gsol: phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga thugs kar gdengs: g.yon pas bhan+dha 'chi med tshe bum bsnams: nyon mongs rtsad gcod kha ṭ+wāṃ rgya rtags 'chang : g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum snang srid zil gnon tshul: g.yas su lha lcam mda' dar tshe bum 'dzin: g.yon du mtsho rgyal bhan+dha bdud rtsi mchod: gnyis ka zhi 'dzum mnyen lcug 'khril ldem la: yab yum bde chen ye shes ngang nyid las: ma bcos lhun grub rang byung de ltar gsal: gnas lngar 'od 'phros rnga yab dpal ri nas: rig 'dzin rgyal ba sras bcas spyan drangs gyur: oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya phaiṃ phaiṃ dza dzaḥ spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po la: o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams: pad+ma ge sar sdong po la: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes: pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag bsgrub kyi: byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob la: sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bzhi bskur: bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol:

oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥsid+dhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ bzhugs gsol mchod pa ni: hūm̐: ma chags skyon bral pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan: dran rig 'du 'bral med pa'i pad 'byung lha: sku gsum ye shes ngang la dgyes par bzhugs: zung 'jug bde stong dbyings su phyag 'tshal nas: sna tshogs dbang po rtsol bral mnyes mchod 'bul: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: bstod pa ni: hūm̐: ngo mtshar rmad byung pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: mtshan dpe yon tan kun rdzogs dpal 'bar ba: 'o ma'i mtsho las skyes pa rdo rje'i sku: za hor rgyal sras rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung : skye 'chi 'jigs bral mdo sngags sgron me sbar: gangs can bod du sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs: lho nub gdong dmar srin po thabs kyis 'dul: bstan pa'i mnga' bdag mtshungs med u rgyan rje: ya mtshan mngon gyur sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: khyed la gdung shugs gsol btab bstod pa'i mthus: thugs rje'i klong nas byin rlabs char chen phob: tshe rabs gtan gyi skyabs su mnga' gsol zhing : sku lnga ting 'dzin mchog gsum deng 'dir stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: oṃ ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa sarba sid+dhi dzaḥ zhes rtsa sngags bzlas shing rang nyid pad 'byung du gsal gdab: de nas mdun bskyed me lha spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: mdun du bh+rūm̐ gyur 'byung lnga yangs pa'i dpal: me thab dkar po gru gsum raṃ gyis mtshan: zla phyed rdo rje kha khyer mu ran bcas: ye shes me dpung sna lnga 'bar ba'i dbus: ting 'dzin snod kyi me lha ag+ne rgyal: zhi rgyas mdangs ldan sku mdog dmar ser bcas: g.yas g.yon phyag na ril ba spyi blugs 'dzin: rdzu 'phrul shugs ldan ra skyes khams pa chibs: nyon mongs bdud bzhi sreg byed tsha zer 'phro: 'khor du ye shes me lha 'bum gyis bskor: rang bzhin gnas nas skad cig spyan drangs gyur:

oṃ ag+ne ye badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥ de nas spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: chos dbyings rang byung ngang las sprul pa'i lha: nyon mongs bud shing sreg mdzad me lha'i tshogs: snod kyi 'jig rten gso mdzad gshegs su gsol: a raṃ me 'phrul tshwa tshwa'i khri la bzhugs: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ tiṣ+ṭha lhan: de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: 'jigs byed me lha 'khor dang bcas pa la: phyi nang mnyes mchod dgyes pa'i bsreg rdzas 'bul: rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyis: ji ltar bcol ba'i phrin las sgrub tu gsol: oṃ badz+ra ag+ne ye ram̐ sa pa ri wā ra: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: zhes mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: de yang khag che na mgron rnams me lha'i lto bar bskyed: do gal chung na phyi rol tu bskyed: 'byung po phra mo rnams me la bsngangs nas mi tshugs pas phyi rol tu bskyed kyang rung : de nas mgron bskyed pa ni: oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ: stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las: dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi ri rab dang bcas pa: de yi steng du bh+rūm̐ ser po yongs su gyur pa las: pho brang gru bzhi sgo bzhi mtshan nyid rdzogs pa: stong gsum 'khor lo'i khyon dang mnyam pa ye shes 'khor lo'i rang bzhin 'ja' 'od zer thag 'khrigs pa'i gzhal yas su gyur: de yi dbus su stod kyi cha la: seṅge gyad dang pad+ma nyi zla brtsegs pa'i steng du: chos sku kun tu bzang po yab yum la gsang ba rigs lnga ye shes mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor ba: g.yas su seng khri pad zla'i steng du: bcom ldan 'das thub pa'i dbang po la: dgongs brgyud sangs rgyas byang sems 'bum gyis bskor ba: rgyab tu pad+ma nyi zla'i steng du: dbyings phyug yum chen mo pha rol tu phyin ma la: gsang mdzod brda brgyud bka' yi rgyud sdes bskaur ba:

g.yon du pad+ma nyi zla'i steng du: byang sems phyag na rdo rje la: snyan brgyud dge 'dun tshogs kyis bskor ba: mdun du pad+ma nyi zla'i steng du: gu ru rin po che dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas la: gter brgyud bka' bab rig 'dzin tshogs kyis bskor ba: bar gyi cha la pad+ma nyi zla baṃ ro'i steng du: dpal chen che mchog he ru ka la: rgyud sde bzhi yi yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyis bskor ba: g.yas su pad+ma nyi zla ro yi steng du: khrag 'thung legs ldan nag po la chos skyong pho rgyud kyis bskor ba: g.yon du pad+ma nyi zla ro yi steng du: sngags srung e ka dzā ṭi la: chos skyong mo rgyud kyis bskor ba: rgyab tu rin chen pad+ma nyi zla'i steng du: rgyal chen dzam lha dmar po la: nor lha dbang sdud 'bum gyis bskor ba: mdun du pad+ma nyi zla ro yi steng du: zhing skyong dpal 'bar stobs ldan la: gter bdag gter srung pho nyas bskor ba: 'og gi cha la lha srin sde brgyad sde dpon dgu la: snang zhing srid pa'i lha 'dre'i tshogs kyis bskor ba: de yi phyi rol du rigs drug snying rje'i mgron gyis bskor ba: de yi phyi rol du lan chags bgegs rigs mgron gyis bskor ba: de yi phyi rol du khas zhan dbang chung ming nas ma smos pa rnams kyis bskor bar gyur: de ltar gsal ba'i rang rang gi gnas lnga nas 'od zer 'phros pas: bsang mgron rnams spyan drangs badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ rol mo bya zhing dbyangs snyan po dang bcas pas: hūm̐: 'og min lhun grub bde chen pho brang nas: kun bzang chos sku'i lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: sna tshogs sgyu ma'i cho rol pho brang nas: sangs rgyas byang sems tshogs bcas gshegs su gsol: ma 'gags dbyings rig zang thal pho brang nas: yum chen phar phyin tshogs bcas gshegs su gsol: mos blos dga' tshal der ston pho brang nas: dge 'dun 'phags mchog 'dus sde gshegs su gsol:

mkha' dbyings pad+ma brtsegs pa'i pho brang nas: sku gsum rig 'dzin lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: drag po mthing nag e yi pho brang nas: yi dam rgyud sde'i lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: che btsan stobs bcu ldan pa'i pho brang nas: pho rgyud chos skyong lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: snang srid las la 'gyed pa'i pho brang nas: mo rgyud mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: longs spyod yid 'ong gter gyi pho brang nas: nor bdag dzam lha 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol: khrag zhag rgya mtsho 'khrugs pa'i pho brang nas: dam can gter bdag pho nya gshegs su gsol: gling bzhi stong gsum yangs pa'i pho brang nas: dregs sde yul lha gzhi bdag gshegs su gsol: 'khor 'das ro gcig snying rje'i pho brang nas: rigs drug bgegs rigs lan chags gshegs su gsol: snod bcud phyi nang bral ba'i pho brang nas: gdul bya srid par grub rnams gshegs su gsol: badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ zhes rol mo bya: de nas bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐: seng khri pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan steng du: mchog gsum sku gsum lha tshogs bzhugs su gsol: pad+ma nyi zla baṃ ro'i gdan steng du: rtsa gsum bka' srung lha tshogs bzhugs su gsol: sna tshogs rang rang yid 'ong mdzes pa'i gdan: srid pa chags pa'i mgron rnams bzhugs su gsol: oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni: phyi nang gi rdzas mchod bsang nang du mchod cing : hūm̐: mchog gsum dkon mchog rin chen la: 'dod yon bsang mchod sna tshogs 'bul: sku gsum dam tshig nyams pa bshags: rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: 'dod yon bsang mchod sna tshogs 'bul: sgo gsum bag med dam 'gal bshags: srid gsum stong gi dregs sde la: 'dod yon bsang mchod sna tshogs 'bul: phyi nang bar chad bzlog tu gsol: 'byung 'jug snod kyi gzhi bdag la: 'dod yon bsang mchod sna tshogs 'bul: phog thug 'gram 'khrug zhi bar mdzod:

pha ma rigs drug bgegs rigs la: 'dod yon bsang mchod sna tshogs 'bul: tshe rabs lan chags 'khor gyur cig: dbang chung khas zhan mgron rigs la: 'dod yon bsang mchod sna tshogs 'bul: longs spyod nam mkha'i mdzod ldan shog: oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra dhū pe pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke pū dza me gha sa mu dra sa s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra nai wi d+ye pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: om̐ badz+ra shab+da pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: om̐ badz+ra rū pa pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: om̐ badz+ra shab+da pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: om̐ badz+ra gan+dhai pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra rā sa pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: om̐ badz+ra spar+she pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: zhes rol mo dang bcas mchod: de nas bstod pa bya ba ni: hūm̐: chos dbyings sgyu ma'i ngang tshul can: kun bzang zhi khro'i lha la bstod: ma 'gags thugs rje'i lcags kyu can: mchog gsum brgyud pa'i tshogs la bstod: phrin las gzi byin rdzu 'phrul can: rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor tshogs la bstod: snod bcud stong 'dzin dbang bsgyur ba: dregs sde skyong ba'i tshogs la bstod: 'khor 'das snying rjes skyong phyir du: pha ma rigs drug kun la bstod: ces bstod cing thams cad dgyes par bsam:

de nas sreg mchod bsang sbyang gi 'byung khungs bstan pa ni: kyaiḥ bsang gi rgyu byung gang nas byung : bsang byung stong nyid mkha' nas byung : ma rig nyon mongs sems can la: dug lnga'i 'dzin pas bcings pa'i tshe: thog ma'i chos sku kun bzang gis: stong nyid e yi me hom du: ro gcig lta ba'i bsang shing brtsegs: ye shes lnga yi rang me sbar: thabs shes bdai stong mchod pa bsregs: tshogs drug rang shar mgron la sbyin: bzang ngan 'dzin pa'i dri za tshims: stong nyid bcu drug bsang dud kyis: gnyis 'dzin nyon mongs ka nas dag: zang thal chos dbyings ngang la grol: de bzhin de ring bsang gis mchod: kyaiḥ de nas bsang byung gang nas byung : bsang byung khrag 'thung dbyings nas byung : lha dang lha min 'thab pa'i tshe: 'khon grib dme ba'i bag chags 'phros: ye shes 'jig rten nyams pa'i tshe: che mchog khrag 'thung he ru kas: rang gsal chos 'byung me hom du: khregs chod gshis lugs bsang shing brtsegs: shes rab rang gsal sgron me sbar: zung 'jug bden gnyis rdzas bsregs nas: sna tshogs sgyu ma'i mgron la sbyin: 'khor 'das phye ba'i stong gzugs tshims: dbyings rig rdzu 'phrul bsang dud kyis: phyi nang bag sgrib ye nas grol: mchod yul sbyin mkhan ye nas stong : de bzhin de ring bsang gis mchod: kyaiḥ de nas bsang byung gang nas byung : bsang byung rten 'brel rgyu las byung : srid pa dang po ming sring gnyis: rim gyis bag chags brtsegs pa las: lus nyams ma rmos lo tog rnying : bzang ngan las kyi lha 'dre 'khrugs: mun gling gyur cing sdug bsngal tshe: mang bkur chos kyi rgyal po yis: rten 'brel thabs kyi dkyil 'khor bris: dpag bsam shing gi lo ma brtsegs: rdzas sbyor srid pa'i me sbar nas: 'dod yon sna tshogs mchod pa bsregs: bzang ngan lha 'dre'i mgron la sbyin: srid par bsdus pa'i dregs pa tshims: dpag bsam byang chub bsang dud kyis:

ming sring 'khrig pa'i mnol grib bsangs: 'bru bcud rgyas shing nyi zla gsal: de bzhin de ring bsang gis mchod: kyaiḥ de nas bsang byung gang nas byung : bsang byung rgya gar yul nas byung : rgya gar chos nub mu stegs chags: mtha' 'khob bye ma'i gling du gyur: dbyings bzhugs sangs rgyas thugs yang skyo: mi rnams phal cher srin por gyur: bdud dbang rkyen stobs che ba'i tshe: bstan gnyis gtso bo shāka thub kyis: sa sna dgu yi dkyil 'khor bris: tsan+dan dkar dmar lo ma brtsegs: rten 'brel thabs shes me sbar te: sman spos dri zhim dkar gsum bsregs: smon lam las grub lha 'drer sbyin: las stobs bsgyur ba'i 'byung po tshims: tsan+dan dri zhim bsang dud kyis: ma rungs bdud kyi las stobs zhi: mdo sngags chos kyi sgron me sbar: de bzhin de ring bsang gis mchod: kyaiḥ de nas bsang byung gang nas byung : bsang byung bod kyi yul nas byung : btsan po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis: bsam yas lha khang bzhengs pa'i tshe: bdud blon rnams kyis bsam ngan 'chang : lha 'dre 'byung pos cho 'phrul btang : rtsig pa nyin brtsegs mtshan mor bshig: gtsug lag bshol du thug pa'i tshe: rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: rin chen phye mas dkyil 'khor gdab: shing sna dgu yi lo ma brtsegs: mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul rang me sbar: ro mchog 'dod yon sna tshogs bsregs: ye shes 'jig rten mgron la sbyin: 'byung po lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul rnams: brngan dang dri zhim bsang dud kyis: mgron rnams dgyes shing bdud blon zhi: bsam yas lhun grub chos 'khor bskor: de bzhin de ring bsang gis mchod: brngan no ye shes 'jig rten brngan: sngon tshe rten 'brel phun tshogs bzhin: de ring rnal 'byor bdag cag gis: bkra shis dge legs sgrub pa la: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: de nas bsang gzhung gtong ba ni: rol mo gdangs dbyangs snyan po dang bcas nas:

hūm̐ hrīḥ 'chi med bdud rtsi yid 'ong lha yi bsang : dri zhim ngad pa mdangs ldan kyi li li: 'dod yon ro mchog gsur dud thu lu lu: g.yu dud sngon po sprin ltar thibs se thib: nyon mongs bsregs pa'i me zhags 'u ru ru: me dud mdangs ldan 'od zer re re la: mchod sprin lha mo grangs med zlos gar rtse: mchod byed sgeg mo lang ling bar snang gang : steng na phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas spungs se spung : bar snang bla ma rig 'dzin thibs se thib: yi dam rgyud sde'i lha tshogs ya la la: ma sring mkha' 'gros gar byed shigs se shig: chos skyong dam can pho nya sha ra ra: nor lha gter bdag longs spyod kyi li li: yul lha gzhi bdag bzhad gad lhangs se lhang : rigs drug bgegs rigs dga' bro ya la la: phyi nang mgron kun mnyes tshim dgyes pa'i rdzas: 'dod rgu phun tshogs sprin phung bsang mchod kyis: ye shes 'jig rten mgron rnams bsang bar bgyi: dge legs bkra shis phun tshogs stsal du gsol: hūm̐: chos sku kun tu bzang po bsangs: snang mtha' 'od mi 'gyur ba bsangs: thog ma'i sangs rgyas rigs lnga bsangs: drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen bsangs: ston pa rdo rje sems dpa' bsangs: bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong rtsa bsangs: ston pa phyag na rdo rje bsangs: byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bsangs: dgongs brgyud rig 'dzin rnam gsum bsangs: brda brgyud theg pa rim dgu bsangs: yum chen shes rab phar phyin bsangs: bya spyod rnal 'byor bla med bsangs: rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung gnas bsangs: bka' brgyad rig 'dzin brgyad rnams bsangs: rje 'bangs nyi shu rtsa lnga bsangs: tshig brgyud shog ser gter brgyud bsangs: rtsa brgyud bla ma thams cad bsangs: hūm̐: che mchog he ru ka pa bsangs: zhi ba bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis bsangs: 'bar ba khrag 'thung lnga bcu bsangs: badz+ra he ru ka pa bsangs: yang dag thugs kyi lha tshogs bsangs: bcom ldan khro rgyal gshin rje bsangs:

'jam dpal sku yi lha tshogs bsangs: dbang chen khro rgyal rta mgrin bsangs: pad+ma gsung gi lha tshogs bsangs: sras mchog rdo rje gzhon nu bsangs: phrin las phur pa'i lha tshogs bsangs: bla med he ru ka pa bsangs: ma mo rbod gtong lha tshogs bsangs: yi dam gu ru drag po bsangs: go cha khro bcu'i lha tshogs bsangs: bcom ldan dregs pa kun 'dul bsangs: 'jig rten mchod bstod lha tshogs bsangs: khrag 'thung stobs ldan nag po bsangs: dmod pa drag sngags lha tshogs bsangs: legs ldan ma hā kā la bsangs: chos skyong pho rgyud thams cad bsangs: mkha' 'gro seṅge'i gdong can bsangs: ma sring bye ba 'bum phrag bsangs: sngags srung e ka dzā ṭi bsangs: chos skyong mo rgyud thams cad bsangs: dbang sdud dzam lha dmar po bsangs: longs spyod nor lha thams cad bsangs: zhing skyong dpal 'bar stobs ldan bsangs: las mgon bya rog gdong can bsangs: khyab mjug gza' mchog mgo dgu bsangs: btsan rgod rdo rje legs pa bsangs: snying srung mkha' 'gro sde lnga bsangs: gter srung myur mgyogs thams cad bsangs: sde brgyad dam la gnas pa bsangs: sngags bdag dregs chen bco brgyad bsangs: dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu bsangs: bka' gter srung ma yongs rdzogs bsangs: hūm̐: chos dbyings klong gis khyab pa bsangs: longs sku rtsal las 'gyu ba bsangs: sprul sku sna tshogs cho 'phrul bsangs: zhing skyes dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bsangs: sngags skyes dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bsangs: mngal skyes dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bsangs: lhan skyes dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bsangs: nye zhing dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bsangs: gnas chen dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bsangs: nye gnas dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bsangs: yul chen dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bsangs: nye yul dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bsangs: 'thung spyod dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bsangs: 'du ba'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bsangs: tshan+dho'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bsangs: nye tshan dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bsangs:

ra la'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bsangs: nye ba'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bsangs: gnas yul zhing skyong mkha' 'gro bsangs: ma gcig rdo rje phag mo bsangs: khrag 'thung mkha' 'gro sde lnga bsangs: sha za ḍāk+ki 'bum phrag bsangs: las byed sman mo 'bum phrag bsangs: hūm̐: lha chen brgyad po 'khor bcas bsangs: klu chen brgyad po 'khor bcas bsangs: gza' chen brgyad po 'khor bcas bsangs: rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad bsangs: gdong mo brgyad po 'khor bcas bsangs: 'gyu ba bcu gnyis 'khor bcas bsangs: phyogs skyong bcu po 'khor bcas bsangs: rgyal chen sde bzhi 'khor bcas bsangs: sde dpon brgyad po 'khor bcas bsangs: sa bdag rtsa gnyis 'khor bcas bsangs: lo zla zhag dus 'khor bcas bsangs: phyi nang lha srin sde brgyad bsangs: rtag chags yul skyong sde brgyad bsangs: yang gsang drag sngags sde brgyad bsangs: bod khams brtan ma bcu gnyis bsangs: skyong ma ya ma bcu gnyis bsangs: srid pa chags pa'i lha dgu bsangs: rje yi mgul lha bcu gsum bsangs: 'bangs kyi srog lha bcu gsum bsangs: skyes lha che btsan bcu gsum bsangs: yul lha zo dor thams cad bsangs: gangs gnyan nyi shu rtsa gcig bsangs: sbas pa'i g.yu mtsho rtsa bdun bsangs: sgrub gnas chen po brgya rtsa bsangs: dben ri sbas gnas gzhi bdag bsangs: gter gnas sgrub gnas gzhi bdag bsangs: gzhi lam byes gsum gzhi bdag bsangs: g.ya' gangs tshal gyi gzhi bdag bsangs: chu brag shing spang gzhi bdag bsangs: yul 'di'i gzhi bdag zo dor bsangs: mdun rgyab g.yas g.yon gzhi bdag bsangs: stong gsum snod kyi gzhi bdag bsangs: 'dzam bu gling gi zo dor bsangs: kyaiḥ rgya gar gling bzhi'i gzhi bdag bsangs: li bal kha che'i gzhi bdag bsangs: tho gar zhang zhung gzhi bdag bsangs: dur khrod brgyad kyi gzhi bdag bsangs: dbus gtsang ru bzhi'i gzhi bdag bsangs: mdo khams sgang drug gzhi bdag bsangs: rgya nag yul bcu'i gzhi bdag bsangs:

lho rgyal bod kyi gzhi bdag bsangs: chung ngu ming nas ma smos pa'i: khas zhan dbang chung gzhi bdag bsangs: rigs drug lan chags bgegs rigs bsangs: srid rtse mnar med yan chad rnams: thams cad chos nyid ngang du bsangs: rnam rtog chos sku'i ngang du bsangs: 'khor ba mya ngan 'das par bsangs: sems can sangs rgyas ngang du bsangs: dug lnga ye shes lnga ru bsangs: gang shar 'dzin med klong du bsangs: lha 'dre sems kyi cho 'phrul bsangs: re dogs snang ba'i bag chags bsangs: rgyu 'bras blo yi bye brag bsangs: hūm̐: rang rig sangs rgyas stong rtsa bsangs: grags stong chos kyi rang mdangs bsangs: ma yengs dran pa'i dge 'dun bsangs: lta ba gtad med ye grol bsangs: sgom pa rang shar bzo med bsangs: spyod pa rgya yan lhug bzhag bsangs: kun gzhi 'khor 'das ro gcig bsangs: lam mchog ma 'gags zang thal bsangs: 'bras bu khregs chod ka dag bsangs: dbu ma rtsa yi sgron me bsangs: sgra gcan rlung gi 'khor lo bsangs: srog 'dzin sems kyi thig le bsangs: kun gzhi ma bcos lhun grub bsangs: stong pa ye nas sangs rgyas bsangs: rgyu 'bras bden med shes pa bsangs: ngo bo stong la 'dzin med bsangs: rang bzhin gsal la ma 'gags bsangs: thugs rje 'dzin med sprul sku bsangs: gang 'dul der ston ngang la bsangs: bla med bsang mchod 'di bgyis pas: thams cad chos nyid klong du grol: kun kyang ye shes reg gyur cig: skabs 'dir 'dzam gling spyi bsang 'dzud kyang rung : rang lugs chos skyong gzhan rnams kyi gsol ka rgyas bsdus gang rung 'dir 'dzud kyang chog /de nas brngan bya ba ni: gser skyems mchod cing shel tshig khri dkar yang gtor: hūm̐: nga ni rig 'dzin thod phreng rtsal: ye shes 'jig rten mgron gyi tshogs: dga' mgu legs pa'i yid kyis nyon: bkra shis dge legs stsol ba'i phyir: rten 'brel longs spyod rgyan gyis brngan: so so'i yid 'thad sna tshogs 'bul:

hūm̐: chos sku kun tu bzang po la: phyag 'tshal ting 'dzin lta bas brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas stong phrag la: rang byung ye shes lnga yis brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: yum chen rgyud sde'i mnga' bdag la: lta ba klong yangs shugs kyis brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: dga' rab rig 'dzin rnam gsum la: ma 'gags sna tshogs zer gyis brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: shāka thub byang sems gnas bcu la: stong nyid bcu drug ldan pas brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: pad 'byung rig 'dzin rnam dgu la: rang rig mngon gyur shes pas brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: che mchog zhi khro rab 'byams la: sna tshogs sgyu ma'i rtsal gyis brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: 'jam dpal sku yi lha tshogs la: bskyed rim snang stong gzugs kyis brngan: 'dod yon bsang mchod sna tshogs 'bul: pad+ma gsung gi lha tshogs la: grags stong sngags kyi bzlas pas brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: yang dag thugs kyi lha tshogs la: ting 'dzin ma 'gags rtsal gyis brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: phur pa phrin las lha tshogs la: las bzhi lhun grub rdzas kyis brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: ma mo rbod gtong lha tshogs la: dkyil 'khor rang byung rdzas kyis brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: 'jig rten mchod bstod lha tshogs la: rang byung bsod nams tshogs kyis brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: dmod pa drag sngags lha tshogs la: dug lnga bsgral ba'i mchod pas brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: yi dam dmar nag me phreng la: rtse gcig sgrub pa'i dam bcas brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: khrag 'thung legs ldan nag po la: bya nag g.yag nag lug gis brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: chos skyong pho rgyud thams cad la:

dgra bgegs klad khrag sha yis brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: sngags bdag ma mo ral gcig la: dgra bo'i don snying dbang pos brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: chos skyong mo rgyud thams cad la: sha khrag ba liṃ brgyan gyis brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: gnod sbyin dzam lha dmar po la: rgyal srid rin chen bdun gyis brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: dpal 'bar zhing skyong mgon po la: gri rgod snying dang gtor mas brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: srog bdag bya rog ming can la: 'bru nag bshos bu sha yis brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: gter srung dam can yongs rdzogs la: dgra sha khrag mchod phud kyis brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: bla med dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: spyan gzigs rdzas dang rol mos brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: bskang rdzas mchod rdzas sgrub rdzas kyi: brngan mchod 'bul zhing thugs dam bskang : dam tshig nyams pa bsal du gsol: hūm̐: tshangs pa gser gyi 'khor los brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: lha min go khrab gri yis brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: gza' rnams snying dang gtor mas brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: gshin rje shwa khram rgyan gyis brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: ma mo me long dar snas brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: bdud rnams rta nag khyi yis brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: btsan rnams glo snying khrag gis brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: rgyal po za 'og gos kyis brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: gnod sbyin g.yag nag stag gis brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: klu bdud sbal sbrul sman gyis brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: dri za dri dang gsur gyis brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul:

grul bum nam mkha' rgyang bus brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: me lha 'bru mar til gyis brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: srin po sha khrag gtor mas brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: rlung lha ba dan mdung gis brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: dbang ldan chu glang ma hes brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: bgegs rgyal changs bu glud kyis brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: 'byung po sna tshogs dud pas brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: sa bdag gser dngul phye mas brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: brtan ma bum pa gtor mas brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: dmu rnams gcan gzan tshogs kyis brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: ma sang go khrab rgyan gyis brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: sman mo shwa ba ri dwags brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: mgul lha sna tshogs mchod pas brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: zo dor yid mthun gtor mas brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: yul lha dkar gtor phud kyis brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: mkhar lha rgyal mtshan tog gis brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: khyim lha 'bru bcud gtor mas brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: me lha mda' dar phud kyis brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: yul skyong gser mkhar bsang gis brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: hūm̐: stong gsum gzhi bdag thams cad kun: rang rang 'dod pa'i rdzas kyis brngan: rigs drug lan chags bgegs rigs rnams: sbyin sreg 'dod yon rdzas kyis brngan: rgyal brngan mchod pas dgyes gyur nas: phyi nang 'gal rkyen bar chad sol: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: de nas dgra lha'i dpang bstod bya ba ni go mtshon sna tshogs bsgrengs shing : hūm̐:

dang po dgra lha gang nas byung : sngon tshe bskal pa'i dang po la: srid pa ye thog chags pa'i tshe: thabs shes sgong bu dkar dmar srid: rgyas pa ri rab rtse ru bzhag: dbang chen khro rgyal rta mgrin gyis: drag po'i ngang la bcag pa'i tshe: dgra lha ma sang mched dgu byung : rtsal ldan go khrab lus la rdzogs: rno ba'i mtshon cha lag na thogs: mgyogs pa'i rlung gshog 'og na chibs: ma thogs gnas 'dir spyan 'dren no: hūm̐: dkar po dung khrab gyon pa 'bum: zhi ba lha yi dgra lha yin: de ring dgra lha rten la byon: sang nas dgra la dmag 'dren no: nyes can dgra bo cham la phob: gsol lo gsol lo lha gsol lo: hūm̐: ser po gser khrab gyon pa 'bum: rgyas pa gnyan gyi dgra lha yin: de ring dgra lha rten la byon: sang nas dgra la dmag 'dren no: nyes can dgra bo cham la phob: gsol lo gsol lo lha gsol lo: hūm̐: dmar po bswe khrab gyon pa 'bum: drag po btsan gyi dgra lha yin: de ring dgra lha rten la byon: sang nas dgra la dmag 'dren no: nyes can dgra bo cham la phob: gsol lo gsol gsol lha gsol lo: hūm̐: ljang khu g.yu khrab gyon pa 'bum: ki kang bza' bdud dgra lha yin: de ring dgra lha rten la byon: sang nas dgra la dmag 'dren no: nyes can dgra bo cham la phob: gsol lo gsol lo lha gsol lo: hūm̐: sngon po mthing khrab gyon pa 'bum: glen pa klu yi dgra lha yin: de ring dgra lha rten la byon: sang nas dgra la dmag 'dren no: nyes can dgra bo cham la phob: gsol lo gsol lo lha gsol lo: hūm̐: smug po mchong khrab gyon pa 'bum: dmu bdud srid pa'i dgra lha yin: de ring dgra lha rten la byon: sang nas dgra la dmag 'dren no: nyes can dgra bo cham la phob: gsol lo gsol lo lha gsol lo: hūm̐: 'od ldan zangs khrab gyon pa 'bum: bshan pa pho nya'i dgra lha yin: de ring dgra lha rten la byon: sang nas dgra la dmag 'dren no:

nyes can dgra bo cham la phob: gsol lo gsol lo lha gsol lo: hūm̐: nag po lcags khrab gyon pa 'bum: rngam pa bdud kyi dgra lha yin: de ring dgra lha rten la byon: sang nas dgra la dmag 'dren no: nyes can dgra bo cham la phob: gsol lo gsol lo lha gsol lo: hūm̐: gnam lcags go khrab gyon pa 'bum: lus la 'khor ba'i dgra lha yin: de ring dgra lha rten la byon: sang nas dgra la dmag 'dren no: nyes can dgra bo cham la phob: gsol lo gsol lo lha gsol lo: hūm̐: rdo rje'i go khrab gyon pa 'bum: srog skyob brtan pa'i dgra lha yin: de ring dgra lha rten la byon: sang nas dgra la dmag 'dren no: nyes can dgra bo cham la phob: gsol lo gsol lo lha gsol lo: hūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang : chos skyong dam can gter gyi bdag: sde brgyad dgra lha'i tshogs bcas pa: bsang mchod gser skyems 'di 'bul lo: de ring go cha'i rten btsugs bzhin: dgra lha mi dang ma 'bral cig: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: de nas dgra lha bstod cing bsngags pa ni: hūm̐: dgra lha'i rten mkhar gang nas byung : dgra lha'i rten mkhar dbyings nas byung : ma sang rdo rje legs pa dang : ki kang khyab 'jug nag po yis: nam mkha'i dbyings nas mgar bzo brgyab: rang byung rdo rje'i go khrab brdungs: sngags bdag ma mo'i byin gyis brlabs: slob dpon phyag tu phul ba las: srid pa rdo rje'i go khrab gyur: chos skyong pho nya'i rten du bkod: dgra lha bkod cing rdzu 'phrul 'gyed: pha rol dgra bo cham la phob: sngon tshe go khrab de bzhin du: de ring dgra lha 'di ltar bkod: hūm̐: rmog la dgra lha bkod pa ni: rmog mo shar gyi byang bu la: zhi ba chos sku'i dgra lha bkod: rmog mo lho yi byang bu la: rgyas pa longs sku'i dgra lha bkod: rmog mo nub kyi byang bu la: sprul sku dbang gi dgra lha bkod: rmog mo byang gi byang bu la:

sku gsum drag po'i dgra lha bkod: ru dar phrin las lnga ldan la: bla ma yi dam dgra lha bkod: bya sgro khyung ru rngam chen la: mkha' 'gro dam can dgra lha bkod: rmog dkris 'od zer sna lnga la: rgyal ba rigs lnga'i dgra lha bkod: rmog zhol dkar mo leb chen la: chos skyong gter srung dgra lha bkod: rmog rgyan rdo rje'i kheb chen la: pha rol rgol 'joms dgra lha bkod: de ltar dgra lha rten btsugs bzhin: de ring rmog gi kha la bzhugs: dgra lha gnyan po dpa' mkhar bstod: srog skyob rdzong btsan mnga' gsol lo: bsang mchod gser skyems 'di bzhes la: dgra lha bdag dang ma 'bral cig: sang nas dgra la dmag 'dren no: nyes can dgra bo cham la phob: gsol lo gsol lo lha gsol lo: hūm̐: khrab la dgra lha bkod pa ni: stod kheb dkar mo 'khyil chen la: pho lha gnyan gyi dgra lha bkod: lag mdung mu tig 'dzum yag la: skyes lha gnyan gyi dgra lha bkod: sen kheb sngon mo lag ring la: yul lha gnyan gyi dgra lha bkod: mdun sham rdo rje 'od ldan la: dpa' rtsal gyad kyi dgra lha bkod: rgyab sham dkar mo byang ring la: zhang lha gnyan gyi dgra lha bkod: sham bu sna tshogs mdzes rgyan la: myur mgyogs rtsal gyi dgra lha bkod: dkar sham sra mkhregs pha lam la: lam lha gnyan gyi dgra lha bkod: de ltar dgra lha rten btsugs bzhin: de ring khrab kyi mkha' la bzhugs: dgra lha gnyan po dpa' mkhar bstod: srog skyob rdzong chen mnga' gsol lo: bsang mchod gser skyems 'di bzhes la: dgra lha bdag dang ma 'bral cig: sang nas dgra la dmag 'dren no: nyes can dgra bo cham la phob: gsol lo gsol lo lha gsol lo: hūm̐: mtshon la dgra lha bkod pa ni: g.yas shag gsal ba 'od ldan la: myur mgyogs btsan gyi dgra lha bkod: ral gri dgra srog gcod byed la: drag rtsal bdud kyi dgra lha bkod: mdung ring thog rgod 'khyugs yag la: khram thogs gshin rje'i dgra lha bkod:

rtse mo phur bu 'dril 'debs la: shan pa dmar nag dgra lha bkod: mda' mo sgra gcan 'gyu byed la: ki kang gza' bdud dgra lha bkod: gzhu mo rdo rje'i 'chang ldan la: dam can legs rtsal dgra lha bkod: gzhu breng 'khyug mau dril chen la: sngags srung ma mo'i dgra lha bkod: de ltar dgra lha'i rten btsugs bzhin: de ring mtshon cha'i mkha' la bzhugs: dgra lha gnyan po dpa' mkhar bstod: dgra srog gcod par mnga' gsol lo: bsang mchod gser skyems 'di bzhes la: dgra lha bdag dang ma 'bral cig: sang nas dgra la dmag 'dren no: nyes can dgra bo cham la phob: gsol lo gsol lo lha gsol lo: hūm̐: phub la dgra lha bkod pa ni: phub mo shar gyi gling khams la: dkar po lha yi dgra lha bkod: phub mo lho yi gling khams la: shel ging dkar po'i dgra lha bkod: phub mo nub kyi gling khams la: yak+sha gnod sbyin dgra lha bkod: phub mo byang gi gling khams la: sngon po klu yi dgra lha bkod: phub mo dbus kyi gling khams la: drag rtsal skyob pa'i dgra lha bkod: drag po'i rnga zhol dmar nag la: srog skyob srung ba'i dgra lha bkod: de ltar dgra lha rten btsugs bzhin: de ring phub kyi mkha' la bzhugs: dgra lha gnyan po dpa' mkhar bstod: srog skyob rdzong chen mnga' gsol lo: bsang mchod gser skyems 'di bzhes la: dgra lha bdag dang ma 'bral cig: sang nas dgra la dmag 'dren no: nyes can dgra bo cham la phob: gsol lo gsol lo lha gsol lo: hūm̐: mi la dgra lha bkod pa ni: spyi bo bde chen pho brang na: 'jam dpal sku yi dgra lha bkod: mgrin pa longs spyod pho brang na: pad+ma gsung gi dgra lha bkod: snying kha chos kyi pho brang na: phyag rdor thugs kyi dgra lha bkod: lte ba sprul pa'i pho brang na: yon tan khro mo'i dgra lha bkod: gsang gnas bde skyong pho brang na: phrin las phur pa'i dgra lha bkod: g.yas pa thabs kyi lag pa la:

za byed pha bcu'i dgra lha bkod: g.yon pa shes rab lag pa la: gsod byed ma bcu'i dgra lha bkod: rkang g.yas rdzu 'phrul gyad chen la: las mkhan pho rgyud dgra lha bkod: rkang g.yon myur mgyogs shugs ldan la: pho nya mo rgyud dgra lha bkod: phyi nang gzugs kyi cha gnas su: zhi khro'i lha tshogs bye ba bkod: de ltar dgra lha rten btsugs bzhin: de ring rnal 'byor lus la bzhugs: dgra lha gnyan po dpa' mkhar bstod: srog lha bdag skyob mnga' gsol lo: bsang mchod gser skyems 'di bzhes la: dgra lha bdag dang ma 'bral cig: sang nas dgra la dmag 'dren no: nyes can dgra bo cham la phob: gsol lo gsol lo lha gsol lo: hūm̐: rta la dgra lha bkod pa ni: mgo bo g.yu 'brug rngam yag la: dbu 'phang mtho ba'i dgra lha bkod: rngog gzhol le brgan 'bar ba la: seng stag 'brug gi dgra lha bkod: sgal rgyud rin chen phreng ba la: sra mkhregs rdo rje'i dgra lha bkod: mjug ma dug sbrul 'khyug chen la: sgab 'dre tshar gcod dgra lha bkod: rkang bzhi rngam pa ling chen la: rtsal ldan myur mgyogs dgra lha bkod: sga stan nyi zla 'ja' ris la: rten 'brel rdzas kyi dgra lha bkod: rta mgo rdo rje'i go khrab la: srog skyob mi shigs dgra lha bkod: de ltar dgra lha rten btsugs bzhin: de ring rta yi srung la bzhugs: dgra lha gnyan po'i dpa' mkhar bstod: myur mgyogs shugs ldan mnga' gsol lo: bsang mchod gser skyems 'di bzhes la: dgra lha bdag dang ma 'bral cig: sang nas dgra la dmag 'dren no: nyes can dgra bo cham la phob: gsol lo gsol lo lha gsol lo: ༈ me sgyogs dgra lha'i dpang bstod ni/ hūm̐/ sbor la dgra lha bkod pa ni/ /g.yas pa thabs kyi rwa rtse la/ /mgon po pho rgyud dgra lha bkod/ /g.yon pa shes rab rwa rtse la/ /lha mo mo rgyud dgra lha bkod/ /ngar ldan lcags kyi sbu gu la/ /bya rog gdong can dgra lha bkod/

/so pha dgra snying dmar 'byin la/ /zhing skyong yab yum dgra lha bkod/ /so mig mthong ba dbugs sdud la/ /sprel gdong pho mo'i dgra lha bkod/ /me skam tshod 'dzin pho nya la/ /mgar ba dmar nag dgra lha bkod/ /ras mda' dug sbrul 'khyug yag la/ /klu bdud nag po'i dgra lha bkod/ /rna phor tshwa tshwa 'khrugs pa la/ /har len bco brgyad dgra lha bkod/ /su me mdel rdzas 'byor byed la/ /rol pa bco brgyad dgra lha bkod/ khro mdel gnam lcags thog dmar la/ /srog bdag shel ging dgra lha bkod/ /sgra skad g.yu 'brug nga ro la/ /ki kang gza' bdud dgra lha bkod/ kho tho dug gi bang mdzod la/ /gza' chen brgyad kyi dgra lha bkod/ /sha khag chu srin gre 'tham la/ /gdong mo bzhi yi dgra lha bkod/ /'jal phor srog zan sdig rgod la/ /sha za srin po'i dgra lha bkod/ /mgyogs rdzas hur thum srog bdag la/ /rgyu skar nyer brgyad dgra lha bkod/ drag po'i shing gi dgu mtha' la/ /pho nya las byed dgra lha bkod/ /kyus mdzer gnam lcags ngar ma la/ /rang srung lha yi dgra lha bkod/ /sbor shubs dug gi phag rgod la/ /nag po bdud kyi dgra lha bkod/ /rdzas khug gdug pa spir gzugs la/ /sa bdag gnyan gyi dgra lha bkod/ /mdel kheb rus sbal lto sbyor la/ /spar sme lo zla'i dgra lha bkod/ /mdel khug nya mo 'khyug yag la/ /klu bdud gdol pa'i dgra lha bkod/ 'byung ba lnga 'dus me sgyogs 'di/ /dug lnga'i dgra la btab pa'i tshe/ /phung po lnga po thal bar brlag /ye shes lnga yi klong du bstim/ /de ltar dgra lha rten btsugs bzhin/ /dam nyams dgra la dmag 'dren na/ /zhing bcu'i dgra bo cham la phob/ /gsol lo gsol lo lha gsol lo/ bka' brgyad lha bsang dgra lha'i cha rkyen du gnubs lo'i skyes sprul au ḍī sha dha yis nyams mtshar du bris pa la nongs pa mchis na dam can chos skyong srung mar bshags/ dge bas dgra lha mi dang mi 'bral zhing pha rol dam nyams srog gi gshed mar shog

/sarba maṅga laṃ// // hūm̐: 'bru rigs srid pa'i dgra lha bsangs: gdong rigs srid pa'i dgra lha bsangs: sga rigs srid pa'i dgra lha bsangs: dbra rigs srid pa'i dgra lha bsangs: pha lha gnyen gyi dgra lha bsangs: ma lha gnyen gyi dgra lha bsangs: 'phrag lha gnyen gyi dgra lha bsangs: yul lha gnyen gyi dgra lha bsangs: skyes lha gnyen gyi dgra lha bsangs: srog lha gnyen gyi dgra lha bsangs: byes lam gzhi yi dgra lha bsangs: bsang ngo gsol lo phrin las mdzod: bsang gsol sogs rgyas spros skabs bstan skyong yul gyi cho ga'ang 'dir 'dzud dgos/

mchan/ de nas brtan ma'i gtor ma bsang nang du 'bul: gzhi mtshams su 'bul na lha bswo bya: hūm̐: yul ni gangs can bod kyi yul: gzho stod ti sgro'i gnas mchog nas: gtso mo bkra shis tshe ring ma: 'khor ni ye shes mkha' 'gro bzhi: gser skyems phud dang gtor mas brngan: sangs rgyas bstan pa'i bya ra mdzod: hūm̐: yul ni kong yul mthing brag nas: sring gcig rdo rje bod khams skyong : gser skyems phud dang gtor mas brngan: dus 'khrug zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: yul ni ma pham g.yu mtsho'i gnas: sring gcig rdo rje g.ya' ma skyong : gser skyems phud dang gtor mas brngan: nad yams zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: yul ni bal bod mtshams kyi gnas: sring gcig gangs dkar sha med ma: gser skyems phud dang gtor ma brngan: sad ser zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: yul ni gnam mtsho phyug mo ru: sring gcig 'brog chen 'khor 'dus ma: gser skyems phud dang gtor mas brngan: nor gyi g.yang nyams zhi bar mdzod: hūm̐: yul ni brag dmar mchims phu ru: sring gcig rdo rje g.yu bun ma: gser skyems phud dang gtor mas brngan: bod khams bde ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: yul ni sbas lung yar 'brog mtsho: sring gcig kha rag khyung btsun ma: gser skyems phud dang gtor mas brngan: zab chos rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: yul ni tsha shod rong bzhi ru: sring gcig rdo rje klu mo rgyal: gser skyems phud dang gtor mas brngan: gangs can srung ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: yul ni bal yul shel phug tu: sring gcig rdo rje drag mo rgyal: gser skyems phud dang gtor mas brngan: rin chen gter gyi srung ma mdzod: hūm̐: yul ni ri bo ma la'i shar: sring gcig btsan gyi sman gcig ma: gser skyems phud dang gtor mas brngan: phyi nang bar chad zhi bar mdzod: hūm̐: yul ni na len shing gcig drung : sring gcig ug chos g.yar mo sil:

gser skyems phud dang gtor mas brngan: dgra bgegs tshar gcod phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: yul ni rdo rje brag dmar na: sring gcig dril bu si le ma: gser skyems phud dang gtor mas brngan: khams sum dbang sdud phrin las mdzod: de nas chos skyong spyi yi gtor ma ni: byin gyis brlabs la kha bsngo bya: gtor 'gugs na mo dkon mchog? de nas 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i klong : gru gsum e yi klong dkyil nas: legs ldan nag po phyag bzhi pa: rdzu 'phrul dbyings nas skur bzhengs shig: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung du gsol: rnal 'byor bdag gi dpung gnyen mdzod: bstan dgra dam nyams cham la phob: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ka ra tsa tur ya kā li dhe wi sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: hūm̐: 'jigs su rung ba'i gnas mchog nas: srog bdag las mgon bya rog gdong : rdzu 'phrul nam mkha'i dbyings nas bzhengs: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: zab gter gnyan gyi mel tshe mdzod: sngon gyi tha tshig dran par gyis: brnag pa'i dam nyams dgra bo yi: mgo snying srog rtsa phrol la shog: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ ma hā kā la he ru ka khā kha mu kha kro ti tsaṇ+ḍi ya bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: hūm̐: rngam chen gangs dkar sbas yul nas: stobs ldan zhing skyong seṅge'i gdong : drag rtsal me rlung dbus nas bzhengs: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: ka cha dkor nor gnyer du bskos: dus drug srung ba'i mel tshe gyis: pha rol gdug pas sdang gyur na: snying khrag drong zhing don snying bzhes: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ ma hā kā la singha mu kha si ṇa ra ma kro ti singha mu kha ya i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: hūm̐: khrag zhag 'khrugs pa'i rba klong nas: ma gza' rdor legs shan pa 'bum: mngon spyod phrin las mdzad phyir bzhengs:

sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bdag la dgra byung na: gnyen 'dun yin yang myur du sgrol: brnag pa'i dgra bo shor ra re: byad ma'i yul zhing rten dang phrol: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ ma tri e ka dzā ṭi ki kang rā hu la badz+ra sa dhu ya bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: hūm̐: zangs ri khrag mtsho'i dur khrod nas: btsan rgod rol pa skya bdun rnams: myur mgyogs las la bskul phyir bzhengs: dgra sha khrag mchod 'di bzhes la: btsan dmar dmag-dpung dgra la drongs: ka cha dkor nor 'phrog byed pa'i: dam nyams dgra yi yul du chos: gri thogs shan pa'i dmag dpung skyed: dgra bo mi nor phyags mas thob: reg phung dug mda'i gzer bu rgyob: sngon tshe pad 'byung bka' ma bcag: da lta rig 'dzin dam ma bkral: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ tsa tri shu la tsaṇ+ḍa swa bhā wa ya bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: hūm̐: bka' gter dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi: srung ma dam can gter bdag rnams: rang rang mngon rtogs bstan phyir du: dgra sha khrag mchod 'di bzhes la: bos pa'i tshe na snyan ma sra: g.yab pa'i tshe na spyan ma rtul: rbad pa'i tshe na mthu ma chung : mngag pa'i tshe na bang ma bul: rig 'dzin bdag gis bskul ba'i tshe: bstan dgra sgos dgra rtsad nas chod: dmigs pa'i dgra bo shor ra re: gdug pa'i ru tra myur du sgrol: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ sarba dharma pā la ya sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: gtsang sbyar ma sogs gtor 'bul rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i bar song*/ de nas dgra lha'i gtor ma bsang nang du 'bul lam gtsang sar bskyal la: hūm̐: dgra lha chen po mthu stobs dbang : gzi byin stobs kyi bdag po rnams: mchod bstod gser skyems 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la: lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs: kha 'dzin sdongs grogs rgyab rten mdzod: dpung gnyen bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod:

ces gtor ma 'bul zhing phrin las bcol: brtan ma'i gtor 'bul ni/ hūm̐: skye mched bcu gnyis gnas 'dzin ma: lo skor bcu gnyis skyong mdzad ma: dus tshod bcu gnyis mnga' sgyur ma: don la rnal 'byor bcu gnyis te: dam tshig can gyi tshogs khang nyul: dus drug nyul le bcu gnyis ma: gser skyems phud dang gtor mas brngan: phyi yi snang ba dbang du sdud: nang gi rtsa rlung ljon shing skyed: bkra shis bde legs phun tshogs spel: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: ces gser skyems 'bul zhing phrin las bcol: de nas brngan 'bul ba ni: gser skyems dang bcas gtsang ma'i ri zhig tu bskyal lo: hūm̐: nga ni rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung : nga ni dkyil 'khor kun gyi gtso: nga ni mkha' 'gro kun gyi yab: nga ni dpa' bo kun gyi rje: mchog gsum rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i gtso: ye shes 'jig rten mgron rnams kun: bden gnyis dkon mchog bka' la nyon: de ring sna tshogs brngan gyis mchod: kun tshang ya mtshan 'di ltar ro: hūm̐: dar tshon 'ja' gur kyi li li: mchog gsum lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul: dkar rgyan gzi 'bar ta la la: rtsa gsum lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul: ba liṃ brjid chags ye re re: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul: dpal gtor bshos bu hrangs se hrang : 'jig rten dregs sde mnyes phyir 'bul: dkar mngar sman sna chi li li: phyi rgyud dkar phyogs mnyes phyir 'bul: sha khrag rgya mtsho me re re: nag phyogs dregs pa mnyes phyir 'bul: go mtshon ru dar lhabs se lhab: chos skyong dgra lha mnyes phyir 'bul: bkra shis rdzas rtags spungs se spung : nor lha gter bdag mnyes phyir 'bul: 'dab chags gshog 'gyur lings se ling : phyi rgyud gzhi bdag mnyes phyir 'bul: g.yag nag ngar sgra khra la la: pho rgyud chos skyong dgyes phyir 'bul: lug dkar 'ba' sgra di ri ri: yul lha sa srung tshogs la 'bul:

ra skyes sbrid pa sha ra ra: the'u rang dam can tshogs la 'bul: gyi ling rta skad tse re re: ma sang g.ya' spang tshogs la 'bul: ri dwags gar rtsed khyugs se khyug: zo dor gnyan po'i tshogs la 'bul: gcan spyang ngar skad 'u ru ru: 'jig rten dregs pa'i tshogs la 'bul: changs bu gtor ma nyi li li: rigs drug lan chags bgegs la 'bul: hūm̐: phyi nang mchod pa sna tshogs dang : spyan gzigs brngan mchod dpag med 'dis: ye shes 'jig rten la sogs pa: srid pa'i rtse mo man chod dang : na rag dmyal khams yan chod kyi: srid pa chags pa'i lha 'drer 'bul: so sor mnyes pa'i 'dod yon tshogs: zad med nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam: yid mthun mchod pa sna tshogs kyis: stong gsum 'dzam gling sa bdag brngan: mthun rdzas 'dod rgu 'di 'bul gyis: rten 'brel legs pa'i yon tan spel: shi ba yod na bslang du gsol: na ba yod na gso bar mdzod: gas pa yod na srub tu sbyor: chad pa yod na mthud du gsol: bla med dkyil 'khor dam tshig bskang : yi dam rgyud sde'i bka' chad bshags: chos skyong rnams kyi 'khu ldog khrol: yul lha gzhi bdag phog thug zhi: rigs drug lan chags bu lon 'khor: tshe rabs mi dge'i sha 'khon byang : dus 'khrug mtshon cha'i bskal pa nyams: nad rims dal yams ngan pa chod: yul 'dir bkra shis phun sum tshogs: 'jig rten lo phyug rtag tu legs: char chu dus 'bebs bskal pa bzang : hūm̐: lha dang phyi rgyud srung ma kun: dgyes pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: phyi nang bar chad zhi ba dang : rnal 'byor bdag gi kha 'dzin mdzod: nyin gsum nyin gyi bya ra dang : mtshan gsum mtshan gyi mel tshe gyis: lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs: sngon tshe kun bzang che mchog bka': bar du khro rgyal 'dus pa'i lung : rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung gnas la: bsam yas mchims phu'i ke'u tshang du: khyed rnams srog snying phul ba bzhin: tha tshig gnyan po dran par gyis:

khas blangs dam bca' ma 'da' bar: sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyan po srung : rig 'dzin bdag gi grogs dan sgrubs: zab chos snying gi thig le 'di: phyogs bcur spel ba'i sdong grogs mdzod: rnal 'byor bdag gi bcol ba'i las: deng 'dir 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ sarba dharmā swa bhā he kha kha khā hi: oṃ sarba nā tha swa bhā he kha kha khā hi: oṃ sarba lo ka swa bhā he kha kha khā hi: oṃ sarba dharma pā la ya kha kha khā hi: oṃ sarba k+ṣe ṭa pā la ya kha kha khā hi: oṃ sarba lo ka pā la ta ya kha kha khā hi: oṃ bhū mi pa ti ya kha kha khā hi: oṃ sarba lau ka pā la ya kha kha khā hi: oṃ āḥhūm̐ pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye kha kha khā hi: zhes phul: rig 'dzin brgyud pa sogs mtha' dbyung*/ de nas mda' dar dang phye mar thogs la g.yang 'gugs pa ni: hūm̐: chos dbyings bde chen pho brang nas: kun bzang che mchog yab yum gyi: thugs rje rang rgyud smin mdzad pa: de ring 'od gsal g.yang 'gug go: bde chen lhun grub zhing khams nas: yi dam rtsa gsum 'dus pa yi: byin rlabs dngos grub ster mdzad pa: bskyed rdzogs rten 'brel g.yang 'gug go: klong lnga zer phreng pho brang nas: pad 'byung rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i tshogs: zab chos gter gyi mdzod gling rnams: myur du 'gyed pa'i g.yang 'gug go: mtha' yas gang 'dul pho brang nas: grub thob rjes 'brang 'tshogs pa'i mchog: bka' bab gter la spyod mdzad pa'i: kun 'byung nor bu'i g.yang 'gug go: gzi ldan me yi pho brang nas: chos skyong dam can gter gyi bdag: mthu stobs che btsan myur mgyogs pa: drag rtsal mthu stobs g.yang 'gug go: yid 'ong 'dod rgu'i pho brang nas: dzam lha dbang sdud nor bdag 'bum: snyan grags tshe chos bkrag dang mdangs: longs spyod srid kyi g.yang 'gug go: phyi rgyud rang rang gnas mchog nas: srid pa'i lha 'dre mgron gyi tshogs: lo legs bkra shis 'bru spel ba:

'dod rgu thun mong g.yang 'gug go: rgyun bsang skabs 'di nas 'og gi hūm̐ ye shes 'jig rten la sogs pa'i sogs kho nar mdzad srol 'dug mchan/ hūm̐: brtan pa mtho ba nam mkha'i g.yang : de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: rgyud 'dzin gsal ba nyi zla'i g.yang : de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: srid 'phel grangs mang gza' skar g.yang : de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: snyan grags kun khyab g.yu 'brug skad: de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: dgra lha myur mgyogs glog zhags g.yang : de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: mthu rtsal stobs ldan thog rgod g.yang : de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: mdzes rgyan bkrag mdangs 'ja' tshon g.yang : de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: sna tshogs 'dzin med chu 'dzin g.yang : de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: zab chos mtha' rgyas bar snang g.yang : de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: stobs bskyed 'ja' lus rlung gi g.yang : de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: longs spyod rgya chen sa yi g.yang : de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: mi zad kun 'byung chu yi g.yang : de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: rtsal chen 'bar ba me yi g.yang : de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: mi rgyud grangs mang rtsi shing g.yang : de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: sra mkhregs rdzong btsan lcags kyi g.yang : de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: rta drel nor lug phyugs kyi g.yang : de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: bang ba bcud rgyas 'bru yi g.yang : de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: yul bzung sa 'dzin rten 'brel g.yang : de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: hūm̐: bla ma'i chos g.yang 'dir 'gug go: sde dpon khrims g.yang 'dir 'gug go: phyug po'i phyugs g.yang 'dir 'gug go: 'phan po'i 'phan g.yang 'dir 'gug go: zhing bzang sa g.yang 'dir 'gug go: dpa' bo'i rtsal g.yang 'dir 'gug go: bu 'phel srid g.yang 'dir 'gug go: pha spun gnyen gyi g.yang 'gug go:

tsha bo mag pa'i g.yang 'gug go: mna' ma tshur 'ong g.yang 'gug go: bu mo phar 'gro'i g.yang 'gug go: dkor bdag chas kyi g.yang 'gug go: du ba rtse sprod g.yang 'gug go: gaṅgā chu 'dus g.yang 'gug go: 'gyu ba rlung khyab g.yang 'gug go: khyim mtshes grong gi g.yang 'gug go: sa yul lung pa'i g.yang 'gug go: snang srid kun gyi g.yang 'gug go: hūm̐: ye shes 'jig rten la sogs pa'i: srid pa chags pa'i lha 'dre kun: gser skyems phud mchod 'di bzhes la: phywa g.yang 'gugs pa'i pho nyar rbad: 'dzam gling srid pa'i g.yang sdud la: rig 'dzin sgrub pa'i lus la stims: sngon gyi tha tshig ma nor bar: phywa g.yang 'gugs pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: g.yang skor de ni kyi li li: phywa skor de ni me re re: srid skor de ni spungs se spung : phywa g.yang char chen tshubs se tshub: gnas 'dir g.yang rten 'dzugs su gsol: brtan par bzhugs shig tiṣ+ṭha lhan: de nas phye mar gyi srung 'dzugs shing gtor ma dang g.yang rdzas rnams lag tu thog la mi rtas bsang skor dang ki bswo dang lha rgyal 'then zhing bkra shis pa'i tshig kyang brjod/ ces nas me lha'i dal du bsang rdzas mchod: hūm̐: ye shes dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dang : 'dzin byed me lha 'khor bcas la: sna tshogs mchod pa 'bul gyis bzhes: phyi nang rten 'brel spel la bstod: lhun grub ngang du dgyes par stsol: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: oṃ ag+ne raṃ dz+wa la pū dza hūm̐: zhes rol mo dang bcas te bstod: mchod bstod ni/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ hūm̐: chos dbyings sgyu ma'i ngang tshul can: kun bzang zhi khro'i lha la bstod: ma 'gags thugs rje'i lcags kyu can: mchog gsum brgyud pa'i tshogs la bstod: phrin las gzi byin rdzu 'phrul can: rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor tshogs la bstod:

snod bcud stong 'dzin dbang bsgyur ba: dregs sde skyong ba'i tshogs la bstod: 'khor 'das snying rjes skyong phyir du: pha ma rigs drug kun la bstod: bzod par gsol ba ni: hūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dam can dang : chos skyong gter bdag gzhi bdag mgron rigs rnams: snying rje brtse ba'i thugs kyis dgongs su gsol: bkra shis bsang mchod cho ga'i rim pa la: chad lhag nor 'khrul 'gal ba ci mchis pa: rgyu chung phud nyams lhag ma phri ba sogs: dam tshig nyams dang phog thug 'gram pa bshags: bzod par gsol la tshangs par stsal du gsol: oṃ badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya sogs yi ge brgya pas lhag chad bkang : nang gi dkyil 'khor ye shes pa dang me lha bsdu ba ni: hoḥ rang byung me yi dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams: dmigs med chos dbyings stong pa'i ngang la bsdu: sna tshogs spro bsdu rang byung ye shes rtsal: skye med ka dag ngang du āḥl ldang : a a āḥ zhes bsdu'o: de nas dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni: oṃ: khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad: āḥ rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang : trām̐: sems can rnams kyi don slad du: hrīḥ slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol: oṃ badz+ra muḥ bsang mgron 'jig rten pa rnams rang rang so so'i gnas su gshegs: bsngo ba smon lam bya ba ni: hoḥ bdag gi bla med bsang mchod bgyis pa yi: sbyin tshogs dpag dka'i zag med dge ba bsngo: mtha' yas 'gro kun byang chub mchog reg nas: skye dang tshe rabs pad 'byung 'grub gyur cig: ces bsngo ba smon lam rgyas pa ci rigs bya'o: de nas bkra shis bya ba ni: hūm̐: chos sku'i bkra shis kun bzang thog ma'i mgon: rang rig mngon du 'gyur ba'i bkra shis shog: longs sku'i bkra shis rdor sems rigs lnga'i gtso: sprul pas 'gro ba 'dren pa'i bkra shis shog: sprul sku'i bkra shis rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung :
