gsang sngags bstan pa rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog: yi dam bkra shis che mchog he ru kaḥ mi 'bral dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa'i bkra shis shog: mkha' 'gro'i bkra shis sngags bdag dpal 'bar ma: brgyud 'dzin gter la spyod pa'i bkra shis shog: chos skyong bkra shis las mgon seṅge'i gdong : bstan dgra bgegs srin tshar gcod bkra shis shog: dam can bkra shis sngags srung rdo rje legs: dam nyams bdud dgra bcom pa'i bkra shis shog: gter srung bkra shis las mgon bya rog gdong : zab chos mkha' ltar rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog: gter gnas bkra shis mtsho sman khyung btsun ma: ma yengs bya ra byed pa'i bkra shis shog: gnas mchog bkra shis yar 'brog gangs kyi ri: rten 'brel legs tshogs 'phel ba'i bkra shis shog: yul lha'i bkra shis sbas yul gzhi bdag gnyan: sa steng g.yul 'khrug zhi ba'i bkra shis shog: sbyin bdag bkra shis bde skyid phun sum tshogs: gang bsam thogs med 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog: ces bkra shis rgyas bsdus gang rung brjod: bkra shis legs tshogs gong 'phel sgrub: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: e maḥ bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: bkra shis dge legs lha bsang bzhag: bka' brgyad gsang ba zil gnon gyi: bsang mchod bgyis pa'i skal ldan rnams: rang byung ye shes chos skur 'char: phyi nang 'gal rkyen bar chad zhi: bsod nams ye shes tshogs chen rdzogs: yul gru bkra shis nad yams zhi: lo 'bras phun tshogs mtshon bskal nyams: tshe ring nad med bde skyid ldan: yi dam chos skyong dngos grub 'byung : yul lha gzhi bdag 'gram 'khrugs gso: dge legs 'bras bu sna tshogs 'grub: ye shes mtsho rgyas bskul phyir bzhag: ma 'ongs dus kyi tha ma la: lo tsā sangs rgyas ye shes kyi: skye ba o rgyan gter bdag gling : thugs sras de dang 'phrad par shog: legs ldan mgon po bya rog gdong : zab chos 'di yi mel tshe gyis:

gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo pad+ma gter bdag gling pas lcags byi lor pad+ma sbas tshal yar 'brog lha yi mtsho chen nas gdan drangs te pad+ma chos 'khor gling du shog ser nas bod yig tu zhal bsgyur ba'o// // de ltar bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon gyi brngan bsang 'dod rgu char 'bebs 'di nyid bal yul yang le shod gsang sngags phur pa gling gnam lcags sgrub sde'i nyams bzhes bya sla ba'i ched du 'di ltar dgos zhes bka' yis yang yang bskul ba la brten gter gzhung kho na la gzhir bzung go rim rnams snga srol bzhin gab 'khrugs bsal te nag 'gros kyi tshul du bkod pa dang tshig don yang rtsa ba'i ma phyi dag dang dpyad bsdur gyis zhu dag legs par bgyis nas ring lugs 'di nyid mi nyams sor chud dang slad kyi rgyud 'dzin pa bdag 'dra'i shes rmongs rnams la phan pa'i kun slong gis mtshams sbyar te gnam lcags zab gter yongs rdzogs 'phrul gyi par la drangs pa'i skabs sgo chen sprul ming du 'bod pa gnam lcags gsang sngags bstan 'dzin gyis bsgrigs chog tu spel ba yi ge'i mthun gyur pa ni o rgyan gsang sngags kyis bgyis pa nor 'khrul mchis na chos kyi spyan ldan rnams kyi spyan sngar 'chags shing dge bas snying po'i bstan 'di dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ // ༈ rang lugs gtso bor gyur pa'i bsang mchod sna tshogs phyogs dus bzhugs so// // de'ang bsang gzhung las bsang mchod rgyas spros kyi skabs 'dzam gling spyi bsang yang 'dir 'dzud par bya'o gsungs pa bzhin bsang mchod kyi rim pa zhib rgyas sna tshogs shig 'dir bya bar spro na/ thog mar lha btsun nam mkha' 'jigs med kyis mdzad pa'i ri bo bsang mchod ni/ 'bru gsum dang nam mkha' mdzod sngags lan gsum sogs kyis byin brlabs la/ bh+rūm̐: rin chen sna tshogs dwangs ma'i snod yangs su:

'jig rten srid pa'i 'dod rgu dam tshig rdzas: 'bru gsum ye shes bdud rtsir byin brlabs pas: snang srid mchod pa'i 'dod rgur 'khrugs pa 'di: bla ma yi dam ḍāk+ki chos srung dang : phyogs bcu rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ji snyed dang : 'dzam gling gzhi bdag rigs drug lan chags mgron: khyad par bdag gi tshe 'phrog srog rku zhing : nad gtong bar chad rtsom pa'i 'byung po dang : rmi lam rtags mtshan ngan dang ltas ngan rigs: sde brgyad ma rungs cho 'phrul bdag po dang : zas dang gnas dang nor gyi lan chags can: grib dang smyo 'dre pho gshin mo gshin dang : gri bo the'u rang grong srin 'dre mo bcas: lan chags dmar po'i me la bsregs te 'jal: rang rang yid la gang 'dod 'dod rgu'i char: ji srid nam mkha' gnas kyi bar nyid du: 'dod pa'i yon tan zad pa med par bsngo: bdag gis dus gsum bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dang : dkon mchog dad gshin dkor la spyad pa rnams: sbyin sreg me mchod 'di yis dag gyur cig: me lce snang srid gang ba'i rdul phran res: kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin phung mi zad pa: rgyal ba'i zhing khams yongs la khyab gyur cig: me lce ye shes 'od lnga'i mchod sbyin zer: rigs drug mnar med gnas su khyab gyur pas: khams gsum 'khor ba 'ja' lus 'od skur grol: 'gro kun byang chub snying por sangs rgya shog: om̐ āḥhūm̐: zhes 'bru gsum brgya stong sogs gang 'grub mthar/ sku gsum dag pa snod kyi gzhal yas su: chos longs sprul gsum snang srid gzugs phung rnams: bdud rtsir zhu bas 'ja' 'od bar snang gang : 'khor ba myang 'das zag med bdud rtsi'i bcud: thog med dus nas da lta yan chad du: snang srid mgron du gyur pa yongs la bsngo: sa lam 'bras bu'i yon tan mthar phyin zhing : lta sgom spyod pa'i bar chad kun bsal nas: rmad byung kun bzang thugs kyi mkha' dbyings su: gzhon nu bum skur gtan srid zin par shog:

'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po stongs pa'i mthar: 'og min pad+ma drwa bar sangs rgyas shog: phung khams bsreg rdzas bkrag mdangs gzi brjid 'bar: dkar dmar byang sems bsreg rdzas bde stong 'bar: stong nyid snying rje'i bsreg rdzas chos dbyings gang : snang srid 'khor 'das rdo rje'i 'od lnga'i gzhir: lhun grub rdzogs sangs rgyas pa'i bsreg rdzas 'bul: sngon gyi lan chags thams cad byang gyur cig: da lta rgyud la mi gnas mthol lo bshags: ma 'ongs sgrib pa'i 'khor lor ma gyur cig: so thar byang sems rig pa 'dzin pa yi: sdom bcas bslab pa gsang sngags dam tshig rigs: tshor dang ma tshor nyams pa mthol lo bshags: nad gdon grib dang mi gtsang dag gyur cig: nad mug mtshon gyi bskal pa zhi gyur cig: mtha' mi dbus su 'ong ba'i sun ma zlog: chos mdzad bla ma gdan 'dren bar chad zlog: bod yul bkra mi shis pa'i ltas ngan zlog: gza' klu rgyal pos srog dbugs sdud pa zlog: 'jigs pa chen po brgyad dang bcu drug zlog: bdag cag 'khor bcas bkra mi shis pa zlog: dam sri 'gong po'i mthu stobs nus pa zlog: sa ma ya: ༈ rgyal ba kun 'dus khyab bdag rol pa las/ chos skyong sde lnga'i bsang mchod sngon med gsar skrun phrin las myur mgyogs gnam lcags 'bar ba'i thog rgod ces bya ba bzhugs so// // na mo e haṃ lo ha badz+ra ye/ snang srid zil gnon pad+ma thod phreng rtsal/ /thugs kyi sras mchog bud+dha dzñā na'i 'phrul/ /sprul pa'i gter chen gar dbang rtsa gsum gling*/ /chos kyi rgya mtsho'i zhabs pad spyi bor khur/ /gang de'i ring lugs gsang sngags rdo rje theg /mchog gi bstan pa skyong ba'i tha tshig gnyer/ /bstan srung kun gyi rno mde'u thog rgod rtsal/ /drag po sde lnga'i bsang mchod brtsam pa la/ /thog mar bsang gzhung bdag bskyed sngon du song*/ /de la sa ma dhi yis kha gso shing*/ /mdun bskyed skad cig dran rdzogs ngang du gsal/

/mchod rdzas dngos 'byor bkod legs yid sprul bya/ /bzang shing phye mar dri bzang phud rgod bsham/ /yid sprul snang srid khyab pa'i dmigs 'dun gsal/ /rnga rol zi ldir snyan brjid dbyangs dang bcas/ /gsal ba gsum ldan ngang nas 'di skad do/ hūm̐: dur khrod ming ni nges su gang zhig bca': 'dzam gling 'di ru stobs bcus mnga' bsgyur ba: sa mtshams 'gog pa'i dmigs su ma mchis pa: tshangs pa'i yul nas sdong po'i gling 'jug pa: dpal chen nag po phyag bzhi gshegs su gsol: thabs shes mkha' la rol pa'i tshul 'chang ma: yum mchog tsaṇ+ḍi ma mo gshegs su gsol: phyogs bzhi mtshams dang las su sprul pa'i lha: ye shes mgon po'i lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: shar phyogs 'dzam gling 'jig rten tsā ri'i gnas: g.ya' gangs lhun snyogs nags tshal sprin ltar 'khrigs: ma mo mngon rgyu sha za lang long rgyug: de 'dra'i pho brang dbang sgyur nag po che: bdud mgon zhing skyong lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: dug mtsho nag po rba rlabs phyur mar 'khyil: stong gsum 'di ru 'gyu ba'i drag rtsal can: myur mgyogs shugs 'chang gnam lcags 'od po che: thog ser rngam klong 'gyu ba'i las byed pa: drang srong gza' mchog lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: khrag mtsho 'khrugs pa'i gnas chen zangs ri'i gling : mchong dmar 'gyings pa'i pho brang khang bzang nas: gnod sbyin chen po mi bsrun mthu bo che: mngon spyod mdzad tshe shan pa'i tshul bzung ba: btsan rgod 'bar ba'i lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: tshangs pa'i pho brang 'dod rgu 'byung ba'i gnas: dbang phyug lha yi gzhal med lta bu'i khyim: 'dzam gling dkor mdzod spungs pa'i pho brang nas: skye 'gro mnga' sgyur las byed dkar smug zhal: sprul pa'i chos rgyal 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: gzhan yang dam can srung ma drag rtsal can: gter la dbang zhing sngags kyi bstan pa srung :

bka' yi las byed mthu ldan ma lus pa: sprul pa yang sprul nyid sprul la sogs pa: chos skyong yongs rdzogs 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol: pad+ma nyi zla ti ra brtsegs pa'i khrir/ /gtso 'khor 'tshams pa'i gdan khri so so la/ /bsang mchod bzhes slad dgyes pa'i gar gyis bzhugs/ hūm̐/ dpal mgon dam can rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs la/ /mnyes pa'i bsang dang gsol mchod 'bul ba ni/ mi bzad bsang gi dud sprin 'dod yon gter/

tshigs rkang 'di gu h+yas bsab/ /dbang po'i me tog sha chen bsregs pa'i spos/ /rkang tshil zhun mar dmar chen dri chab gtams/ /sha khrag gtor chen rkang gling thod rnga'i sgra/ /'dis kyang dam can rgya mtsho bsangs gsol lo/ /dum gcig bhan+dha a mṛ 'od dkar 'phro/ /lcags zangs snod mchog ba liṃ lhun po brjid/ /bum ril zhal bur khrag chang rba rlabs 'khrugs/ /bstan la sdang ba'i zhing bcu dgra bo yi/ /sha yi ri bo gser ri bdun ltar brtsegs/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i sgos dgra bdud rigs gi /snying khrag dron mo rol pa'i mtsho ltar 'khyil/ khyad par bdag la 'tshe ba'i sger dgra yi/ /dbang lnga rus pa bcas pa'i gram khrod brdal/ /'dis kyang dam can rgya mtsho bsangs gsol lo/ /mar gad ne'u le shel dang baiḍūr+ya/ /pad rāg gser dngul rin chen snod mchog tu/ /'bras phye dkar po gangs can ri ltar spungs/ /'bri zal zho mar brag dkar ri ltar brjid/ /dpag bsam ljon pa shang dkar mdangs bzang phud/ /myos byed gar chang 'o zho dal 'gro'i rgyun/ /nad sel rnal rgyal ga pur si la sman/ khre 'bras so til gro sran phung po spungs/ /'dis kyang dam can rgya mtsho bsangs gsol lo/ /sbrul snying go shi sa mchog 'ba' zhig nag /a gar go snyog bal sha zhi ba'i shing*/ /stag pa rgyas shing mdzo se dbang gi shing*/ /g.yu shug drag dang 'om bu bdud rtsi can/ /gser gyi khu bar 'phrad tshe me lce ni/ /chu 'dzin drwa ba dbang gzhu'i lang tsho can/ /de las byung ba'i rgyal srid rdzas rtags brgyad/ /go dang mtshon spyad lhab lhub dar ling gos/ /zi sbub rnga dung pi waṃ rkang gi gling*/ /rgod sgro lha rdzas mdung rgya ldan pa'i mda'/ /gcod byed shang lang rngam byed mdung ring rno/ /stag dong nyag phran gzig shubs rnam ru mdung*/ /'dis kyang dam can rgya mtsho bsangs gsol lo/ khyung 'brug mkha' lding 'dab chags bya yi rigs/ /seng glang stag gzig dom dred sder chags rigs/

/byang g.yag sha rkyang gtsod sogs ri dwags rigs/ /sbal sbrul nya dang chu srin chu gnas rigs/ /spu sdug gyi ling 'khyol ldan drel gyi khyu/ /rwa rgyas zhol ldan g.yag lug ra skyes khyu/ /zho rgyas 'bri zal mdzo mo ma he'i khyu/ /mdor na snang srid dkor nor mthun rdzas sogs/ /'dis kyang dam can rgya mtsho bsangs gsol lo/ /de ltar dngos 'byor yid sprul bsang mchod 'dis/ /'khor bcas dgyes bskangs dgra lha'i dpa' mkhar bstod/ /bdag cag rnams la srung skyob sdongs grogs mdzod/ hūm̐/ dpal chen nag po phyag bzhi yab yum bsangs/ /dpal mgon sde bzhi yab yum 'khor bcas bsangs/ /bya rog gdong dang las byed sgo skyong bsangs/ hūm̐/ bdud mgon zhi skyong seng gdong yab yum bsangs/ las mkhan sprel gdong baṃ ro pho mo bsangs/ /bka' 'khor dregs pa lha srin sde brgyad bsangs/ /las byed sprul pa yang sprul 'khor bcas bsangs/ hūm̐/ drang srong chen po gza' mchog yab yum bsangs/ /myur mgyogs gza' chen yab yum rnam brgyad bsangs/ /gdong mo bzhi dang rgyu skar nyer brgyad bsangs/ /sprul pa yang sprul gza' bdud 'khor bcas bsangs/ hūm̐/ gnod sbyin btsan rgod me 'od gdong can bsangs/ /las mkhan myur mgyogs sde brgyad ma lus bsangs/ /sprul pa byi la mtshal bya'i tshogs bcas bsangs/ hūm̐/ dkor bdag chen po dpe har rgyal po bsangs/ /yum mchog sman btsun gnam sman rgyal mo bsangs/ /shel ging dregs pa dbang sdud sku lnga bsangs/ /sprul pa yang sprul nyid sprul dpung bcas bsangs/ hūm̐: gzhan yang dam can myur mgyogs thams cad bsangs/ /gter gyi bdag dang gter gnas srung ma bsangs/ /yul lha gzhi bdag mgul lha dge bsnyen bsangs/ /mchod 'os bstod par 'os pa thams cad bsangs/ khyed rnams bsang mchod phul ba'i dpal yon gyis/ /rgyal bstan spyi dang khyad par rdzogs chen bstan/ /bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel ba'i grwa slob 'khor/

/'khor 'bangs dad pa'i mi nor 'byor ldan kun/ /kun rtog nyer 'tshe'i bar chad zhi bar mdzod/ /mnga' thang longs spyod dbyar mtsho ltar rgyas shing*/ khab len lcags bzhin snang srid dbang du sdud/ /rtsa sbur me ltar sdang dgra drag tu sgrol/ /pha rol dmag 'phan phyug nor 'dren pa na/ /mi phyugs 'phan dar 'dzam gling dpal g.yang khug /mi snying stong la rang snying khengs par gyis/ /brgya yi ga pha stong gi zhur po mdzod/ /pha rol mi dang lce bde shag 'gyed na/ /smra dbang don gsal rgyal kha khyod kyis stsol/ /mtshon byed tshig gis rno ngar shugs drag pos/ /thad langs dmigs bya'i glo snying tshal par thongs/ /pha rol dgra la mthu rtsal dmag 'dren na/ /dpung dang rno mtshon gza' rgod thog mda' yis/ /rdo rje'i brag ri yin kyang phye mar thongs/ /dpa' rtsal dar 'phru rang gi thob par gyis/ /mdor na yid la gang dang gang brtsams pa/ /phrin las sna tshogs ci dang ci bcol ba/ /ma thogs myur ba nyid dang nyid rnams kyis/ /pad 'byung bka' ltar myur zhing myur bar sgrubs/ khyad par snga 'gyur zab gsang rdo rje theg /mkha' 'gro'i gter rgya brgyud pa byin rlabs can/ /mkha' la rdo rje rwa ba bar snang la/ /sman raka mtsho rgyas sa gzhi'i dkyil 'khor gyi/ /bkrag mdangs ma nyams gnubs ston dzñā na'i 'phrul/ /pad+ma gter bdag gling pa'i zab gter chos/ /'dzin 'chang spel ba'i grwa slob sbyin bdag bcas/ /'dir snang rdzogs ldan dpal 'byor dbyar mtsho rgyas/ /mthar thug bla med a ti snying po'i mchog /smin grol 'bras bu skad cig rtsal rdzogs ste/ /rigs kyi khyab bdag pad 'byung nyid 'grub pa'i/ /grogs dan mel tshe gegs med mdzad du gsol/ ces pa rig 'dzin chen po pad+ma thod phreng rtsal gyi yang sprul gar dbang lo hā badz+ra'am sprul pa'i gter chen rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos bsam yas mchims phu ke'u tshang nas gdan drangs pa'i thugs sgrub bsam pa lhun grub kyi chos skor las byung ba'i bstan srung drag po sde lnga'i bsang mchod gsar du bskrun pa phrin las myur mgyogs gnam lcags 'bar ba'i thog rgod ces bya ba 'di bzhin dgos zhes bla ma dam pa lung dang rigs pa'i dpal yon rgya mtsho mngon du rgyas shing*/

khyad par gter chen nyid kyi zab chos la thugs bzhed spro ba gu ru ār+ya dh+wa dza zhes pas gsung lha rigs dkar po'i rgya rtags nyams med gtsug tu son pa dang mtshungs bral dad ldan gcig gis dar lcog dkar po khur byung ba dang lhan cig byung bas/ bstan pa dar ba'i rten 'brel du ngos 'dzin zhing lha dang bla mar 'dun pa rtse gcig du dril te/ yi ge'i ris su bris pas zab chos bsre bslad kyi nongs pa mchis na sgo gsum gus pa kho nas bshags shing*/ dge bas bstan dang bstan 'dzin gyi zhabs pad bstan cing ci srid thos bsam sgom pa'i 'khor lo rgyun chad med par dri gzhon shugs kyis spyod par shog /ces smon lam dang bcas sngags btsun ming phrin las thogs med rtsal lam o rgyan bstan 'dzin zhes pas smin drug nya ba'i dmar phyogs res gza' spen pa dang zla ba 'khyud pa snar ma lhan cig 'grub sbyor nyin bris pa dge legs 'phel lo// // ༈ /dpal ldan lha mo'i bsang mchod 'dod don lhun grub dgos 'dod kun 'byung bzhugs so// // ma gcig las kyi dbang mor 'dud/ rgyun du bsang mchod byed pa'i rim par mchod pa gzhung bzhin ltar dang rol mo dbyangs snyan pos bskyed rdzogs dang bcas/ hūm̐/ nam mkha' mdangs ldan 'ja' tshon 'khrigs pa'i dbus/ /pad+ma nyi zla me zer 'khyil ba'i klong*/ khrag mtsho keng rus baṃ gyi gdan steng du/ /srid pa'i bdag mo ma gcig re ma ti/ /'dod khams dbang phyug gtso mo'i cha lugs ni/ /sku mdog dmar nag zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ khro mo zhal rgyas dbu skra thod skam brgyan/ /spyi bor rma bya'i sgro phor mdangs ldan gsal/ /be con thod khrag ral gri snying dmar g.yon/ /re lde nag po'i smad g.yogs sbrul sham 'phyang*/ /mi lpags g.yang gzhi gyon cing rngam pa mo/ /chibs su lcags kyi drel rta rkang gsum la/ /srin po'i thod sga pags pas rab g.yogs bstad/

/'khor du srin mo rigs bzhi'i tshogs kyis bskor/ /dkar ser dmar ljang gar sgyur gri thod 'dzin/ /yang sprul ma mo bdud sman sring lcam rnams/ /sha khrag phud dang gtor ma'i mchod pa bzhes/ /gsol lo mchod do bsangs so gzi brjid bskyed/ /dam rdzas mchod gtor rgya mtsho 'di bzhes la/ /sangs rgyas bstan srungs sngags kyi mel tshe grogs/ /dbyar mtsho yar zla lta bur rgyas par mdzod/ /bstan dang bdag la sdang ba'i dgra bgegs rnams/ /nam mkha'i lha dang bsdongs shing gzugs phung rol/ /sa gzhi klu la bsdongs shing mdze nad phob/ /bar snang btsan la bsdongs shing snying khrag rol/ /dgra yul bstan gnas yul mkhar rdul du shigs/ /ma rungs log 'dren gdug can cham la phob/ /zab gsang bstan pa rgyas pa'i rogs dan du/ /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ bh+yo ma mo rak+mo rak+sha kro ti kā li dhe wi sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi/ zhes gtor ma 'bul zhing phrin las bcol/ sa ma ya/ zhes sngags 'chang pad+ma badz+ra gyis bskul ngor pad+ma gter bdag gling pas bris pa'o/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag gi gter srung btsan rgod bsang mchod bstan dgra tshar gcod bzhugs so// // dpal chen yang dag ku ma rā la 'dud/ de yang gter srung bsang mchod bya ba dngos 'byor mchod rdzas gang rung bsags la lha yi ting 'dzin bcas 'di skad do/ kyai/ phyogs phyogs dag kyang pha ki na/ /nyi ma nub phyogs pha ki na/ /zangs ri gnam du zengs se zeng*/ /zangs thang de ni phya ma phyo/ /rlung dmar 'tshub ma chi li li/ /btsan gyis bswo sgra di ri ri/ /zangs 'phar zangs khyi nyi li li/ /glog dmar 'brug sgra 'u ru ru/ /rak+ta rgya mtsho phyur ba'i dbus/ /zangs brag rtse dgu gzhal yas nas/ /btsan gyi rgyal po mthu bo che/ /rdo rje gzhon nu'i bka' nyan cing*/ /pad+ma thod phreng dam gnas pa/ /btsan rgod har len chen po la/

/btsan rgod 'bar ba bcu bdun dang*/ /btsan dmag 'bum gyi 'khor gyis bskor/ /bsang mchod slad du spyan 'dren no/ /ma thogs myur du gnas 'dir gshegs/ /rang rang dgyes pa'i gdan la bzhugs/ /dam tshig gnyan la ma 'da' zhig kyai/ dbang chen pad+ma'i bka' nyan pho nya ste/ /rgya gar bid+yot+ta ma'i gnas kyi bdag /btsan rgod har len chen po 'khor bcas bsangs/ /bal yul yang le shod kyi gnas mchog nas/ /btsan rgod ber ma chen po 'khor bcas bsangs/ /chu mig byang chub ring mo'i gnas mchog nas/ /btsan rgod dmar po dpon g.yog 'khor bcas bsangs/ /mon yul sha 'ug brag gi gnas mchog nas/ /btsan rgod beng smug bswe khrab 'khor bcas bsangs/ /byang phyogs sham bha la yi gnas mchog nas/ /btsan rgod rol pa mi gzan 'khor bcas bsangs/ /'dzam gling lte ba ti se'i gnas mchog nas/ /lha btsan rdo rje thog 'bebs 'khor bcas bsangs/ /bsam yas mchims phu brag gi gnas mchog nas/ /btsan rgod shan pa mig dmar 'khor bcas bsangs/ /yang rdzong shel brag 'bar ba'i gnas mchog nas/ /btsan rgod gnyan stag dmar po 'khor bcas bsangs/ /mkha' spyod tsā ri ṭa yi gnas mchog nas/ /lho btsan ghā ya dha ra 'khor bcas bsangs/ /gzho stod ti sgro gsang ba'i gnas mchog nas/ /btsan rgod sog ra chen po 'khor bcas bsangs/ /dbu ru stod kyi zangs ri'i gnas mchog nas/ /btsan rgod drag po zla skyong 'khor bcas bsangs/ /sham po gangs kyi rwa ba'i gnas mchog nas/ /btsan rgod myur len har ting 'khor bcas bsangs/ /sbas yul pad+ma spungs pa'i gnas mchog nas/ /btsan rgod 'bar ba khrag 'thung 'khor bcas bsangs/ /gze rgyal gangs dkar rtse gsum gnas mchog nas/ /btsan rgod rdo rje 'bar ba 'khor bcas bsangs/ /mdo khams sku rgyal zangs ri'i gnas mchog nas/ /gnod sbyin beg rtse 'bar ba 'khor bcas bsangs/ /rong btsan gangs dkar gter gyi gnas mchog nas/ /btsan rgod shan pa rlung dmar 'khor bcas bsangs/

/gtsug lag khang chen du ma'i gnas mchog nas/ /btsan rgod rdo rje legs pa 'khor bcas bsangs/ /rten gsum dkor nor spungs pa'i gnas mchog nas/ /btsan rgod shel ging smug po 'khor bcas bsangs/ /dri zhim rtsi shing sna tshogs dud pas bsangs/ /gser dngul rin chen sna tshogs dud pas bsangs/ /dar zab bal tshon sna tshogs gtibs pas bsangs/ /rnga dung rol mo sna tshogs sgra yis bsangs/ /bzang drug sman spos du ma dri yis bsangs/ /zhim mngar zas mchog sna tshogs ro yis bsangs/ /'jam legs gos dang yid 'ong reg byas bsangs/ /mdzes sdug rgyan phreng du ma'i gzugs kyis bsangs/ /dgos 'dod lhun grub thogs med chos kyis bsangs/ /sngags dang phyag rgya ting 'dzin mthu yis bsangs/ /dkon mchog byin rlabs bka' yi bden pas bsangs/ /mi gtsang nyams grib gyur pa thams cad bsangs/ /dam tshig nyams chag phog thug 'gram 'khrugs bsangs/ /'thibs shing rmug par gyur pa thams cad bsangs/ khyod la bsang mchod phul ba'i yon tan gyis/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba'i phrin las mdzod/ /nad gdon bar chad zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod/ /snang srid dbang du 'du ba'i phrin las mdzod/ /tshe bsod dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /dgra bgegs log 'dren sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod/ /rgyal khams bde skyid ldan pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /lo legs phyugs nad med pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /bsam don yid bzhin 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod/ ces sngags 'chang don yod rdo rjes smar gyi dge gong du sbyar// // ༈ chos rgyal chen po'i bsang mchod bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bzhugs so// // khyab bdag pad+ma thod phreng rtsal la 'dud/ de yang bsang gzhung sngon du song nas/ mchod rdzas phun sum tshogs par bshams la rang nyid pad+ma thod phreng rtsal gsal zhing*/ rol mo'i dbyangs dang bcas nas 'di skad do/ hūm̐/ 'di nas nyi ma steng gi phyogs/ /dgung sngon mtho ba'i yang steng na/

/shel gyi gur phub gzhal yas khang*/ /nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan steng du/ /tshangs pa shel ging dkar po la/ /rgyal chen sku lnga yum 'khor bcas/ /blon po chen po tsi'u dmar dang*/ /phyi nang sprul pa yang sprul bcas/ /bsang mchod slad du spyan 'dren na/ /ma thogs myur gshegs gdan la bzhugs/ /dam las ma 'da' bstan pa srungs/ /sa brgyad sems dpa' khyod phyag 'tshal/ kyai/ bzang shing sna tshogs dud sprin 'khrigs/ /phye mar gtor mchod phun sum tshogs/ /ja chang 'o zho gser skyems phud/ /shel tshig 'bru sna dar tshon rigs/ /spyan gzigs dkor cha bsam mi khyab/ /ma tshang med pa'i mchod rdzas 'dis/ /tshangs pa shel ging dkar po bsangs/ /dge slong li byin chen po bsangs/ /bha ta'i dkor bdag dpe har bsangs/ /dpe dkar sku yi rgyal po bsangs/ /dpe dmar gsung gi rgyal po bsangs/ /dpe nag thugs kyi rgyal po bsangs/ /shing bya yon tan rgyal po bsangs/ /gnam lha phrin las rgyal po bsangs/ /gnod sbyin chen po tsi'u dmar bsangs/ /sprul pa ru 'dren brgyad cu bsangs/ /'khor dang yang 'khor bcas pa bsangs/ /de ltar bsang mchod phul ba'i mthus/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba dang*/ /gsang sngags chos srid rgyal mtshan phyor/ /bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i sku tshe srings/ /gtsug lag dge 'dun dar zhing rgyas/ /o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas dang*/ /gar dbang gnam lcags rdo rje yi/ /bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar/ /bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas la/ /gnod 'tshe 'khu ldog ma mdzad par/ /zhi ba byang chub sems ldan nas/ /chos brgyud chu bo'i gzhung ltar ring*/ /nad gdon bar chad god kha zhi/ /tshe dpal mnga' thang gdul bya rgyas/ /ka cha dkor nor dbang du sdud/ /phyi dgra nang dgra rtsad nas chod/ /yid la re ba'i 'dod don kun/ /myur ba nyid du 'grub par mdzod/ ces rig 'dzin chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi dam la gnas pa'i dkor bdag thun mong ma yin pa gcig pu ru phrin las rtsal grags pa'o/

gar dbang gnam lcags rdo rjes sbyar ba'o// // hūm̐/ ma hā kā la stag zhon bsgrubs pa yi/ /rig 'dzin chen po 'brong pa ban thung ni/ /dngos ni mkha' spyod rig 'dzin gnas na bzhugs/ /bla ni rigs su 'brong pa'i dgra lha mdzad/ /btsun gzugs chas bzang spu gri rgya ma 'dzin/ /dgra srog gcod cing g.yang dang dngos grub bsdus/ /zhabs ya lham gnas ri brag thogs pa med/ /zhabs ya rjen pas chu la thogs pa med/ /'dir gshegs brgyan pa'i bsang dang mchod gtor bzhes/ /rang gi rigs rgyud 'phan phyug rta hrag dang*/ /dar zhing rgyas pa'i kha 'dzin sdong grogs mdzod/ /pha rol gnod byed dgra rkun byung tsa na/ /dgra lha gnyan po mi dang ma 'bral cig /legs kha rgyal kha rang gis 'thob pa sogs/ /dgra pham g.yul rgyal dngos grub stsal du gsol/ khyed ni pha mtshun dgra lha drag rtsal can/ /bdag cag rigs rgyud bu dang tsha bo la/ /gdung sems ma chung lus dang grib bzhin 'grogs/ /bu sring shag rogs dgra yi yul rnams su/ /pha mtshun dgra lha ma bros ma 'khyams par/ /bdag gi gnas 'dir bzhugs la kha 'dzin mdzod/ /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ ces pa 'brong pa dbang drag gis bskul ngor/ a rā gas bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ/ ban thun bsang mchod ni/ hūm̐: stag zhon bsgrubs pa'i rig 'dzin ni/ /ma hā kā la'i sprul pa ste/ /dgra lha ban thung 'khor bcas bsangs/ /bdag la kha 'dzin sdong grogs mdzod/ /ma nyes kha yog dgra la phob/ /mi mthun rkyen dang bar chad sol/ /mthun rkyen bsam pa yid bzhin sgrubs/ /bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ hūm̐ kā las sbyar ba'o// // wer ma'i lha bsang ring mo dgra lha'i dpa' glu bzhugs so// // kyai/ lha ki ki ki la bswo bswo bswo/ /pho ge sar rgyal po dmag gi lha/ /dgra rgyal khams gang ba'i dus byung tshe/ /thugs ma g.yel ma g.yel dgra 'dul rje/ /mgon su la mi re khyed la re/

/a tsi tsi dmag gi dpung re rngam/ /a li li gzhon pa'i chas re bzang*/ /a ya ya mi pho rtsal re che/ /pho dpa' rtsal can tsho g.yas na bzhugs/ /sman mdzes ma dri zhim zhal bzang ma/ /zhal gang nas bltas kyang 'dzum pa 'dra/ /sems ci la btang yang khyod la 'gro/ /mo mdzes sdug can tsho g.yon na bzhugs/ /steng lha yul gyi sprin dkar 'od re che/ /bar mi yul gyi rdo khang smug re chags/ /'og klu yul gyi na bun thol re ldang*/ /dmu thag la 'jus te 'di ru phebs/ /gung skyid pa'i gdan la rgyal po bzhugs/ /yul dkar po lha lung 'di nyid du/ /gnas nor rdzas 'dzoms pa'i bdag po de/ /gling ge sar rgyal po khyed kyis mdzod/ /bsang bdud rtsi'i sprin phung thibs se thib/ /rnga rol mo'i dbyangs snyan 'brug sgra 'ur/ /skyems dkar mngar mtsho mo chi li li/ /spos dri bzang ngad pa spungs se spung*/ /dar ba dan glog ltar shigs se shig /sems dad pa'i brtse gdung dungs se dung*/ /bu pha la mi re su la re/ /sman bu mo ma la lus kyang re/ /dus 'di ru rtags dang mtshan ma ston/ /dgra phyogs mtshams brgyad kyi skye bo thul/ /gnyen phu dung can gyi skye bo skyongs/ /zhal 'chi med bdud rtsi'i 'dzum mdangs ngom/ /dgung gses rum gyi a dkar 'od po che/ /che srid gsum gyi spyi bo'i gtsug na lding*/ /chung 'jag gdan gyi steng na dgyes tshul rtse/ /thugs 'od gsal gyi ngang nas bu la gzigs/ /yid mos gus kyi mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ /dus 'di nas byang chub snying po'i bar/ /mgon mi 'gyur bdag gi dgra lha mdzod/ /dpal thugs yid dbyer med 'dres par mdzod/ /a la li la li la mo li/ kyai/ dgung stong chen gyi mkha' dbyings dwangs pa la/ /byams snying rje'i rang bzhin rtsa gsum lha/ /pha seng chen dpa' bo'i dmag dpung du/ /byin thibs se byon la mgon skyabs mdzod/ /lha shing bsang gi mchod pa 'dis/

/yar mchod skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum/ /rje bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro bsangs/ /sku rje 'dzam gling ge sar khong*/ /dus da lta dgra 'dul dmag dpon tshul/ /dbu dar 'phru dgung du lams se lam/ /chos skyong srung ma'i zi ra khol/ /dar 'phru snyan sgra thags se thag /ma mkha' 'gro gar stabs khrigs se khrig /dbu rmog dkar 'od zer lams se lam/ /dgra lha'i kha pho thams se tham/ khrab 'bum ye'i rgyun thag spungs se spung*/ /wer ma'i dmag dpung khrigs se khrig /sked mdo drug 'khor gsum sha ra ra/ khrag 'thung bshugs sgra nyi li li/ /rta 'do ba'i rgyug 'dur sha ra ra/ /bka' sdod gyi bro gar shigs se shig /dpa' dgra lha byas kyang ge sar yin/ /wer ma byas kyang ge sar yin/ /phyi ma'i bla ma ge sar yin/ /'di gang dpon po ge sar yin/ /phyi dmag dpon nor bu dgra 'dul rtsal/ /nang yi dam thugs rje chen po yin/ /thugs mi 'gyur pad+ma 'byung gnas rje/ /lha mchod do bstod do thugs dam bskang*/ /bu dam tshig 'gyur med bdag cag la/ /de ring skyabs mgon gdong grogs mdzod/ /nga'i bsam pa chos bzhin 'grub par mdzod/ /de ring nyi ma'i mdung gang la/ /smon pa'i 'bras bu 'byin par mdzod/ /sdang dgra bo'i glo snying lon pa dang*/ /rgyal kha bzang dgu thob par mdzod/ /thugs ma g.yel ma g.yel 'dzam gling dpon/ /a la la cha cha he he ho/ /'do ba rkyang rgod pher po de/ /phyi ni byol song rta yi tshul/ /nang na sangs rgyas dgongs pa 'char/ /rta mgrin dbang gi sprul pa red/ /mdzes 'dod 'ja' tshon kyi li li/ /zer ma rlung gi bang gi mdzod/ /'dab chags bya yi gshog rtsal tshang*/ /seṅge dkar mo'i dpa' rtsal ldan/ /rdo rje'i ze rngog g.yas g.yon na/ dgra lha dung khyung dkar po 'khor/ /rna rtse rgod kyi thig phran la/ /gsal byed sgron me'i so pa 'khor/ /dpung pa rlung gi 'khor lo la/ /tshe la dbang ba'i dgra lha 'khor/

/'do ba rta yi rmig bzhi la/ /mgyogs pa rlung gi dgra lha 'khor/ /spu rtse re la lha re bzhugs/ /bu nga la mi mgon su la mgon/ /bsang dpa' skyems bzhes la mgyogs rtsal spur/ /gnas gar 'dod rdzu 'phrul kha lo sgyur/ /mi bdag gi 'dod don khyod kyis sgrubs/ /phrin las rlung rta dar bar mdzod/ /rta phu phu bswo bswo cha cha spur/ /seng chen gyi phrin las kha sgyur blon/ /nyag phran kha lo sgyur ba'i mi/ /dgung la g.yu 'brug grags pa'i mi/ /phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i lha/ /rdo rje'i thog rgod lan med rtsal/ /dmag dpon 'dan ma spyang khra ni/ /'do ba rngul phrug ldem pa zhon/ /g.yas na mda' gsor si li li/ /g.yon na gzhu skor gyi li li/ /rdo rje'i gar stabs khrigs se khrig /wer ma'i dpung dmag thibs se thib/ /sdang dgra bo'i srog la gting nas rngam/ /bu dam tshig can la zhi nas btsa'/ /gzhis la tshe ring 'dan ma mchod/ /byes la lam yag 'dan ma mchod/ /tshong la don 'grub 'dan ma mchod/ /rtsod la jag yag 'dan ma mchod/ /kun la bkra shis 'dan ma mchod/ /ci bsam 'grub pa'i 'dan ma mchod/ /bu gdung shugs can la sha tsha mdzod/ /sdang dgra bo'i glo snying lcags mdas phug /snying khrag wer ma'i skyems skal mchod/ /gsol lo mchod do seng chen rgyal/ /gsol lo mchod do 'dan ma blon/ /rgyal blon ru dar mnyam du sgrigs/ /sdang ba'i dgra la mthu ma chung*/ /gnod pa'i bgegs la rtsal ma zhan/ /gsol lo mchod do dpa' thul sde/ /gsol lo mchod do wer ma'i dpung*/ /gsol lo mchod do dregs pa'i tshogs/ ma g.yel ma g.yel phrin las mdzod/ /dgra nag po sa 'og mgo mjug sgyur/ /gnyen dkar po'i ngo 'phang dgung la bstod/ /klung snyan grags rgyal khams 'brug bzhin sgrogs/ /phyogs kun las rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan phyor/ /dgra lha'i ba dan phyar re ran/ /wer ma'i dung sgra sgrogs re ran/ /ma g.yel ma g.yel dpa' bo gling*/

/dus da lta nyid du rtags mtshan ston/ /ji bsam pa yid bzhin grub pa dang*/ /mchog thun mong gnyis kyi dngos grub stsol/ /e a ti mi bu lha rgyal lo/ snying la zab rgyas blo mchog nor bu'i gter/ /mang mchis mgrin pa 'o ma'i rgya mtsho na/ /snyan ngag ku mud mdzes pa'i tshal bkra yang*/ /'grig 'grig snyan snyan blo bzo du ma yis/ /ma spros wer ma'i dpa' glu rin po che/ /byin rlabs gzi byin stong dang rab ldan pa/ /ji bzhin 'di na bkod pa rdo rje'i tshig /dgra lha wer ma dgyes pa'i 'brug sgra yin/ /zhes me glang zla ba gsum pa'i tshes nyer bzhi la snang gsal gyi 'od la brten te bris pa maṅga laṃ// // ༈ hrīḥ dge mtshan klung rta snyan ba dan che/ /'dod rgu kun 'byung mchod pa'i sprin phung 'di/ /ge sar skyes bu 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /bsam 'dod kun 'grub phyogs las rnam rgyal mdzod/ ces pa 'di'ang shing sbrul zla ba lnga pa'i tshes lnga la mi pham pas bkod pa sarba maṅga laṃ/ ༈ hūm̐/ bkra shis rlung rta snyan pa'i ba dan che/ kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin chen 'phro ba 'di/ /rtsa gsum srung ma dgra lha zo dor dang*/ /'go zhing skyobs pa mchod pa'i mgron gyur sogs/ khyad par ge sar nor bu dgra 'dul rtsal/ /rdzu 'phrul rdo rje rkyang rgod pher po dang*/ /dpa' thul dwangs sman bka' sdod pho nyar bcas/ /gsol lo mchod do bsam don lhun grub mdzod/ rlung rta'i gsol bsdus 'di yang dbyu gu zla ba'i yar tshes bcu dus bzang por ru dam yang khrod du mi pham pas bkod pa maṅga laṃ/ dge'o// // kyai/ sangs rgyas mi gzugs byon pa'i rdzu 'phrul can/ /mthu rtsal stobs ldan hor bdud cham la phab/ /'dre srin dam btags bod khams bde la bkod/ /dbu nag dgra lha skyes bu don 'grub la/ /bsang mchod 'di bzhes pho lhar mnga' gsol lo/ /gzhi la tshe ring bde skyid phun sum tshogs/ /byes su gang bsam sgrub la bar chad sol/

/bstan pa mnga' thang phyogs bcur khyab par shog /rgyal dbang bde chen rdo rje'i mdzad pa'o// // ༈ slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa'i mnol bsang lha chab sngon mo bzhugs so// // pad+ma saṃ bha wa la na mo/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis bsam yas mchims phu'i brag phug tu sgrub pa mdzad pa'i tshe/ rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyi khams yun ring ma bde zhing*/ yul du btsa' sad ser gsum nad yams mu ge la sogs mi bde ba'i mtshan ma mang du byung bas/ blon po rnams kyis gros byas nas sman pa mo ma rtsis pa gang la gang dgos pas phyag rtsa brtags pas/ sman pa'i zhal nas nad 'du ba bzhi'i rtsa ni mi 'dug /bying 'thib kyi rtsa zhig 'dug pas mi gtsang ba'i snyun nad gcig yin pa 'dra zer/ der mo mas mo btab/ rtsis bas rtsis byas pa thams cad zhal 'chams par mi gtsang ba'i mnol grib kyis rgyal po dang yul lha thams cad 'khrugs 'dug zer ba las/ de sman pa mo rtsis sogs kyis rgyu rkyen gang lta bus mnol ba ma shes/ rgyal po'i btsun mo mang bza' khri lcam bya ba la btsog mnol gyi bu gcig byung ba btsun mos gsang nas khol mo gcig la gtad de khyod kyis sus kyang mi mthong bar sbas pa gal che zer ba bzhin khol mos sa phag zhig tu sbas pas sa bdag gi lto bar 'phrad pas sa bdag yul lha thams cad la mi gtsang ba'i grib phog nas 'khrugs pas rgyal po dang yul khams thams cad du mi bde ba byung*/ der khol mo yang mi gtsang ba'i grib phog nas na ste mgo dang yan lag thams cad zha grum du song*/ sman pa bos nas bstan pas 'du ba rnam bzhi'i nad mi 'dug /mi gtsang ba'i mnol grib phog 'dug pas gang gis mnol mi shes pas khyod kyi nad 'di la phan pa'i thabs gzhan med zer ba na/ der khol mos khri lcam gyi bu sbas tshul rnams zhib tu bshad pas gcig smras gnyis smras rgyal po'i snyan du gsan/

rgyal pos khri lcam bos nas dris pas/ khri lcam gyis khol mo la srog nyen yong dgongs nas drang por ma zhus pas/ rgyal po thugs dgongs 'khrugs nas khri lcam la chad pa gcod dgongs pa la/ khri lcam o rgyan rin po che'i drung du skyabs 'tshol du song*/ der o rgyan rin po ches rgyal po la phyag mdud yi ge dang bcas pa bskur nas/ da btsun mo khri lcam 'di la chad pa gcod par dgongs pa 'dra yang*/ nga snang srid bden med du rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa yin/ sna tshogs kyi snang ba rten 'brel du bsgyur shes pa yin pas/ mi gtsang ba'i mnol grib 'di bas nyon mongs dug lnga'i grib kyang sel bar byed nus/ bya sla ba tshig nyung la don che ba'i sel thabs yod/ rdzas dang yo byad 'di ltar dgos pas thams cad tshogs par gyis la/ rgyal po thugs khrel mi gnang bar sang rgyal blon 'khor bcas bsam yas has po ri'i rtse mor byon cig /ces gsungs 'dug pas/ rgyal po shin tu dga' ste rdzas dang yo byad rnams bsags nas/ sang has po ri'i rtse mor byon pa la/ der slob dpon chen po bzhugs te rgyal po'i phyag nas byung ba'i rdzas rnams thab snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du bsregs te cho ga ni 'di ltar gsungs so/ kyai/ sems can kun kyang ma rig 'thibs pas mnol/ /nyon mongs dug lngas ye shes lha lnga mnol/ /sgo gsum mi dges lus ngag yid gsum mnol/ /'dul khrims nyams pas lus kyi mkha' 'gro mnol/ /dam tshig nyams pas rdo rje slob dpon mnol/ /tshogs gtor chung bas ma dang mkha' 'gro mnol/ /phud nyams lhag mas chos skyong srung ma mnol/ /ser sna bsags pas bka' srung dam can mnol/ /ting 'dzin 'khrugs pas srid pa'i ma mo mnol/ /brtse gdung 'khrugs pas mched dang lcam dral mnol/ /zhe sdang 'khrugs pas zhi ba'i lha rnams mnol/ /nga rgyal 'khrugs pas rgyas pa'i lha rnams mnol/ /'dod chags 'khrugs pas dbang gi lha rnams mnol/

/phrag dog 'khrugs pas drag po'i lha rnams mnol/ /gti mug 'khrugs pas gsal byed lha rnams mnol/ /dkar dmar thab gzhob yul lha gnyan po mnol/ /'thab 'khon 'khrugs pas byes lha gnyan po mnol/ /mi gtsang thab kyis khyim lha gnyan po mnol/ /mi gtsang dri mas mgon skyabs lha rnams mnol/ khyad par mi gtsang bud med bang sme yis/ /steng 'og bar gsum lha klu gnyan rnams mnol/ /phug lha sgo nor khyim lha khyim bdag mnol/ /lus ngag yid dang dgra lha phrag lha mnol/ kyai/ lus mnol lus kyi mdangs nyams lus stobs shor/ /mgo mjing ro stod na zhing mig mi gsal/ /ngag mnol skad 'gag lkug cing smra mi bde/ /mchil snabs mang zhing sna mtshul lce 'og skrang*/ /yid mnol yid mi bde zhing tshig pa za/ /brjed nges gnyid 'thibs bying zhing mtshan mo g.yer/ /mgo mnol mgo 'khor mig 'grib rna ba 'on/ /yan lag mnol bas zha grum sbrid cing na/ /pho mtshan mnol bas mi 'greng rtsa dkar mang*/ /mo mtshan mnol bas srid kyi skye 'phro chad/ /rgyab rten mnol bas gzhi yi las mi 'grub/ /dgra lha mnol bas dgra sri thad kar ldang*/ /byes lha mnol bas mgo 'thom grogs dang 'bral/ /mgron lha mnol bas mgron rnams don mi 'grub/ /gzhis lha mnol bas gzhi la sdod mi tshugs/ /yul lha mnol bas nang 'khrugs mu ge 'byung*/ khang lha mnol bas 'tshag cing tsag sgra 'byin/ /sbra lha mnol na hrul zhing ldog 'gyur mang*/ /nor lha mnol bas stong zhing 'phel mi 'gyur/ /phyugs lha mnol bas spu byi ltas ngan 'byung*/ /zhing lha mnol na zhing sa khol bur stong*/ /thab lha mnol na bcud med stong zhing 'gong*/ /grogs lha mnol na za khar 'gong po 'jug /go mtshon mnol na go ral rno mtshon rtul/ /rta pho mnol na sgal rngog mgo lag nyams/ /sgo khyi mnol na skad 'gag mtshan rdzi zhan/ kha rje mnol na ma rabs lad mo shoms/ /dbang thang mnol na brjed nges dbang po zhum/

/rlung rta'i lha mnol sems stor don mi 'grub/ /srog gi lha mnol gnyid 'thibs dran pa nyams/ /lus kyi lha mnol sha 'gul sha ro ldang*/ /phrag lha mnol na bkrag mdangs gzi brjid nyams/ /rgyab rten lha srung mnol na sems mi bde/ /lus kyi sha mnol sha 'tsher nyams stobs chung*/ /rus mnol rus kun zug cing srin 'bu ldang*/ khrag mnol thig le pad+ma rnag khrag 'dzag /lpags mnol chu bur brdol zhing za phrug byed/ /chu rgyus rtsa mnol zha grum sbrid cing skrang*/ /spu mnol spu rnams byi zhing glog skyi 'thul/ /gzhan yang rme mnol rtsog mnol rmugs kyis mnol/ /yugs sa'i mnol dang rabs chad pho mo'i mnol/ /nal bu mo mtshan zla mtshan 'dzag pa'i mnol/ /zas mnol gos mnol thab gzhob 'khon gyi mnol/ /shi ba'i dur sri gson po'i nang dme'i mnol/ /sdig can bshan pa mna' zan gri bo'i mnol/ /phud nyams mi gtsang yas dang glud kyis mnol/ /de la sogs pa'i mnol grib thams cad kun/ /'byung ba'i dwangs ma lnga las grub pa yi/ /sa la brten cing chu yis rab tu brlan/ /me yis drod bskyed rlung gis rab bskyod pas/ /rtsa ba klu yi gnas nas skyes pa'i shing*/ /rtse mo lha yi gnas su smin pa'i shing*/ /lo 'dab mi yi gnas su khyab pa'i shing*/ /dri yis phyogs rnams ma lus khyab pa'i shing*/ kha dog dri ro nus bcud ldan pa'i shing*/ /shing mchog tsan+dan dkar dmar a ga ru/ /gser shing mkhan pa g.yu shing shug pa dang*/ /dung shing ba lu stag pa spen dkar dang*/ /'om bu rba smyug nya sbrid gser mgo dang*/ /pho shing mo shing bu shing shing sna'i tshogs/ /'bras bu gsum dang bzang drug sman sna'i tshogs/ /dri ldan ro nus kha dang ska ba'i rigs/ /nas 'bras gro dang so ba yungs ma dang*/ /'bru sna dkar nag 'bru yi rigs byed dang*/ /dar zab rin chen rtsi bcud phye mar dang*/ /gser skyems chang dang shing tog khu ba'i bcud/

/dkar gsum phud dang mngar gsum dwangs ma dang*/ /sha khrag la sogs dbang po rnam lnga'i gsur/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i dam rdzas dkar dmar dang*/ /gu gul dkar nag dri spos sna tshogs sogs/ /phyi nang gsang gsum mnol grib bsal ba'i rdzas/ /mes bsregs chus bkrus rlung gis rab gtor ba'i/ /nam mkha' bzhin du stong par gyur pa'i ngang*/ /raṃ las skyes pa'i me la bsregs pa yi/ /dri mchog dri gsur rnam pa sna tshogs kyis/ /ye shes dri med ngang du sangs gyur cig kyai/ ma rig dbang gis mnol na rang byung ye shes bsangs/ /dug lnga'i dbang gis mnol na rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas bsangs/ /sgo gsum mi dges mnol na sku gsum lha rnams bsangs/ /'dul khrims zhig pas mnol na lus kyi mkha' 'gro bsangs/ /phud nyams lhag mas mnol na chos skyong srung ma bsangs/ /tshogs gtor chung bas mnol na ma dang mkha' 'gro bsangs/ /dam tshig nyams pas mnol na rdo rje slob dpon bsangs/ /brtse gdung 'khrugs pas mnol na mched dang lcam dral bsangs/ /dam rdzas nang 'gras mnol na gtsang ris mgon po bsangs/ /ser sna bsags pas mnol na nor lha g.yang lha bsangs/ /'khon grib mi gtsang mnol na bka' srung dam can bsangs/ /ting 'dzin 'khrugs pas mnol na srid pa'i ma mo bsangs/ /brtse gdung chung bas mnol na snying rje'i mgron rnams bsangs/ /zhe sdang 'khrugs pas mnol na zhi ba'i lha rnams bsangs/ /nga rgyal 'khrugs pas mnol na rgyas pa'i lha rnams bsangs/ /'dod chags 'khrugs pas mnol na dbang gi lha rnams bsangs/ /phrag dog 'khrugs pas mnol na drag po'i lha rnams bsangs/ /gti mug 'khrugs pas mnol na gsal byed lha rnams bsangs/ /gnod grib 'khrugs pas mnol na yul lha gnyan po bsangs/ /'thab 'khon 'khrugs pas mnol na khyim lha gnyan po bsangs/ /nyams chag grib mas mnol na lhag pa'i lha rnams bsangs/ /mi gtsang dri yis mnol na mgon skyabs lha rnams bsangs/

/rabs chad dur sris mnol na srid kyi lha rnams bsangs/ /mna' zan gri bos mnol na pho lha dgra lha bsangs/ /sdig can bshan pas mnol na lhag pa'i lha rnams bsangs/ /dme yugs mi gtsang mnol na sangs rgyas byed rnams bsangs/ /gshin po'i ro grib mnol na phrag lha gnyan po bsangs/ /gson po'i nang dmes mnol na 'go ba'i lha lnga bsangs/ /thab kyis mnol na khang lha sbra lha bsangs/ /gzhob kyis mnol na pha lha ma lha bsangs/ /yugs sas mnol na ma lha bu rdzi bsangs/ /lus spyi mnol na lhan skyes lha rnams bsangs/ /ngag mnol gsung snyan grags stong lha rnams bsangs/ /yid mnol dran byed gsal stong lha rnams bsangs/ /yan lag mnol na byes lha mgron lha bsangs/ kyai/ rmug pa dwangs par byed pa'i lha rnams bsangs/ /'thib pa sangs par byed pa'i lha rnams bsangs/ /gtsang btsog dbye bar byed pa'i lha rnams bsangs/ /mnol ba sangs par byed pa'i lha rnams bsangs/ khyad par mi gtsang bud med bang sme yis/ /steng 'og bar gsum lha klu gnyan la sogs/ /phug lha sgo nor khyim lha khyim bdag dang*/ /lus ngag yid dang dgra lha phrag lha dang*/ /nor lha g.yang lha gos nor longs spyod la/ /mnol grib mi gtsang dri mas gos pa rnams/ /rtsi shing sman mchog dri gsur sna tshogs dang*/ /phyi nang gsang gsum 'dod yon dpag med kyis/ /mi gtsang mnol grib dri ma sangs gyur cig /de nas bye brag tu bsang ba 'di skad do/ kyai/ shing rtsi dri bzang sman gyi dud pa 'dis/ /bla ma yi dam mnol ba sangs gyur cig /ye shes lha rnams btsog gis mnol gyur na/ /sman sna tsan+dan dri yis sangs gyur cig /'jig rten lha rnams btsog gis mnol gyur na/ /spos dkar shing sna'i dri yis sangs gyur cig /ma sring mkha' 'gro btsog gis mnol gyur na/ /bha la dhā ra dri yis sangs gyur cig /chos skyong srung ma btsog gis mnol gyur na/ /sha khrag sna tshogs dri yis sangs gyur cig

/gtsang ris mgon po btsog gis mnol gyur na/ /dkar gsum mngar gsum dri yis sangs gyur cig /lha srin sde brgyad btsog gis mnol gyur na/ /shing rtsi sman mchog dri yis sangs gyur cig /bka' srung dam can btsog gis mnol gyur na/ /phye mar 'o skol dri yis sangs gyur cig /lha rnams mi gtsang btsog gis mnol gyur na/ /spos dkar g.yu shug dri yis sangs gyur cig /sa bdag mi gtsang btsog gis mnol gyur na/ /klu sman sna tshogs dri yis sangs gyur cig /gnyan rnams mi gtsang btsog gis mnol gyur na/ /dar tshon stag gzig dri yis sangs gyur cig /sa bdag mi gtsang btsog gis mnol gyur na/ /nya sbrid gser mgo dri yis sangs gyur cig /gnas bdag mi gtsang btsog gis mnol gyur na/ /stag pa sur dkar dri yis sangs gyur cig /gzhi bdag mi gtsang btsog gis mnol gyur na/ /mkhan pa gser mgo dri yis sangs gyur cig /yul lha mi gtsang btsog gis mnol gyur na/ /rba smyug dkar gsum dri yis sangs gyur cig /nor lha mi gtsang btsog gis mnol gyur na/ /phye mar zas phud dri yis sangs gyur cig /g.yang lha mi gtsang btsog gis mnol gyur na/ /rin chen sna tshogs dri yis sangs gyur cig khang lha mi gtsang btsog gis mnol gyur na/ /dar zab sna tshogs dri yis sangs gyur cig /thab lha mi gtsang btsog gis mnol gyur na/ /sha phud chang phud dri yis sangs gyur cig /zhing lha mi gtsang btsog gis mnol gyur na/ /'bru zan sna tshogs dri yis sangs gyur cig /pho lha mi gtsang btsog gis mnol gyur na/ /dar tshon sna tshogs dri yis sangs gyur cig /dgra lha mi gtsang btsog gis mnol gyur na/ /phye mar dpa' skyems dri yis sangs gyur cig /byes lha mi gtsang btsog gis mnol gyur na/ /'bras dkar rtsi bcud dri yis sangs gyur cig /mgron lha mi gtsang btsog gis mnol gyur na/ /sha chang gser skyems dri yis sangs gyur cig

/skyes lha mi gtsang btsog gis mnol gyur na/ /lha shing sur dkar dri yis sangs gyur cig /lus lha mi gtsang btsog gis mnol gyur na/ /gu gul dkar nag dri yis sangs gyur cig /srung skyob lha rnams btsog gis mnol gyur na/ /shing 'bras me tog dri yis sangs gyur cig /rig byed lha rnams btsog gis mnol gyur na/ /g.yu shug ba lu'i dri yis sangs gyur cig /rgyab rten lha rnams btsog gis mnol gyur na/ /spos sna shing sna'i dri yis sangs gyur cig /lus kyi go mtshon btsog gis mnol gyur na/ /lha chab sman sna'i dri yis sangs gyur cig /zas nor longs spyod btsog gis mnol gyur na/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis sangs gyur cig /shel sgong bzhin du phyi nang gsal gyur cig /de nas bsang dud rnams sku gsung thugs rten la bdug cing 'di skad do/ kyai/ bla ma yi dam mnol ba yod na yang*/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis sangs gyur cig /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro mnol ba yod na yang*/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis sangs gyur cig /chos skyong srung ma mnol ba yod na yang*/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis sangs gyur cig /pho nya las mkhan mnol ba yod na yang*/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis sangs gyur cig /gtsang ris lha rnams mnol ba yod na yang*/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis sangs gyur cig /lha srin sde brgyad mnol ba yod na yang*/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis sangs gyur cig /'jig rten skyong ba mnol ba yod na yang*/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis sangs gyur cig /steng gi lha rnams mnol ba yod na yang*/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis sangs gyur cig /bar gyi gnyan rnams mnol ba yod na yang*/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis sangs gyur cig /'og gi klu rnams mnol ba yod na yang*/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis sangs gyur cig /gzhi bdag gnas bdag mnol ba yod na yang*/

/shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis sangs gyur cig /mched dang lcam dral mnol ba yod na yang*/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis sangs gyur cig /'jig rten lha srung mnol ba yod na yang*/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis sangs gyur cig /sa gzhi'i gnas sa mnol ba yod na yang*/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis sangs gyur cig /rgyud kyi lha srung mnol ba yod na yang*/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis sangs gyur cig /'go ba'i lha lnga mnol ba yod na yang*/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis sangs gyur cig /ma lha bu rdzi mnol ba yod na yang*/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis sangs gyur cig /rta lha 'phan po mnol ba yod na yang*/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis sangs gyur cig /nor lha phyug po mnol ba yod na yang*/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis? /lug lha men po mnol ba yod na yang*/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis? /ra lha tsher mo mnol ba yod na yang*/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis? /zhing lha tshangs pa mnol ba yod na yang*/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis? /phug lha ge thung mnol ba yod na yang*/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis? /sgo lha stag g.yag mnol ba yod na yang*/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis? /thab lha yol mo mnol ba yod na yang*/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis? /pho lha dgra lha mnol ba yod na yang*/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis? /nor lha g.yang lha mnol ba yod na yang*/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis? /phyugs lha mdzod lha mnol ba yod na yang*/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis? /zas lha grogs lha mnol ba yod na yang*/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis? /byes lha mgron lha mnol ba yod na yang*/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis sangs gyur cig /phyi nang gi rten rdzas sogs la bdug cing 'di skad do/ kyai/ rnal 'byor dpon slob mi nor 'khor bcas kyi/ /lha dang srung ma mnol ba yod na yang*/

/shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis sangs gyur cig /lha khang dri med mnol ba yod na yang*/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis? /lha gos bar khrab mnol ba yod na yang*/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis? /lha rgyan lhab lhub mnol ba yod na yang*/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis? /lha mtshon rno ngar mnol ba yod na yang*/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis sangs gyur cig /lha zas ro brgya mnol ba yod na yang*/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis? /lha btung gser skyems mnol ba yod na yang*/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis? /lha rta btsan po mnol ba yod na yang*/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis? /lha g.yag zhol mo mnol ba yod na yang*/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis? /lha lug don po mnol ba yod na yang*/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis sangs gyur cig /lha ra khra bo mnol ba yod na yang*/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis sangs gyur cig /srung ma'i dam rdzas mnol ba yod na yang*/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis sangs gyur cig /srung ma'i spyan gzigs mnol ba yod na yang*/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis sangs gyur cig /mchod rdzas sgrub rdzas mnol ba yod na yang*/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis sangs gyur cig /rten rdzas sna tshogs mnol ba yod na yang*/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis sangs gyur cig /lha srung thugs dang 'gal ba yod na yang*/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis sangs rgyas gyur cig /de nas mi nor sogs la bdug cing 'di skad do/ kyai/ bdag cag dpon slob mi nor 'khor bcas kyi/ /srid kyi dbang thang mnol ba yod na yang*/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis sangs gyur cig /mkhas pa'i btsun g.yang mnol ba yod na yang*/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis? /gtso bo'i blo g.yang mnol ba yod na yang*/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis? /gzhon nu'i dpa' g.yang mnol ba yod na yang*/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis sangs gyur cig

/skyen po'i mtheb g.yang mnol ba yod na yang*/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis sangs gyur cig /mang po'i tshogs g.yang mnol ba yod na yang*/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis sangs gyur cig /rta pho'i mgyogs g.yang mnol ba yod na yang*/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis? /phyugs kyi 'phel g.yang mnol ba yod na yang*/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis? /zas kyi bcud g.yang mnol ba yod na yang*/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis? /btsan po'i stobs g.yang mnol ba yod na yang*/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis? /phyug po'i nor g.yang mnol ba yod na yang*/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis? /'phan po'i dar yang mnol ba yod na yang*/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis sangs gyur cig /btsan phyug 'phan gsum mnol ba yod na yang*/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis? /gzhan yang rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi/ /gyon pa'i ber gos mnol ba yod na yang*/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis? /btags pa'i rno mtshon mnol ba yod na yang*/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis sangs gyur cig /btung ba'i zas skom mnol ba yod na yang*/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis? /gzhi mal gnas sa mnol ba yod na yang*/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis sangs gyur cig /'dug pa'i mal stan mnol ba yod na yang*/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis sangs gyur cig /mi nor rigs brgyud mnol ba yod na yang*/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis? /bran dang sgo khyi mnol ba yod na yang*/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis? /zas nor longs spyod mnol ba yod na yang*/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis? /stobs dang mnga' thang mnol ba yod na yang*/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis? /bkrag dang gzi mdangs mnol ba yod na yang*/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis? /tshe dang bsod nams mnol ba yod na yang*/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis? kha rje dbang thang mnol ba yod na yang*/

/shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis sangs gyur cig /dmigs bsal gyi nad pa 'dra yod na 'di ltar/ kyai/ shing mchog dri bzang sman gyi dud pa 'dis/ /bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po yi/ /nyon mongs dug lnga'i gdung ba sangs gyur cig /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyi dud pa 'dis/ /bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po yi/ /'dod chags las gyur rlung nad sangs gyur cig /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyi dud pa 'dis/ /bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po yi/ /zhe sdang las byung mkhris nad? /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyi dud pa 'dis/ /bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po yi/ /gti mug las byung bad kan? /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyi dud pa 'dis/ /bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po yi/ /'du ba rnam bzhi'i nad rnams? /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyi dud pa 'dis/ /bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po yi/ /snying rlung rgyal po'i nad rnams? /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyi dud pa 'dis/ /bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po yi/ /glo gzer klu btsan nad rnams sangs gyur cig /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyi dud pa 'dis/ /bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po yi/ /mchin rgyu sa bdag nad rnams? /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyi dud pa 'dis/ /bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po yi/ /mtsher glo gri bo'i nad rnams sangs? /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyi dud pa 'dis/ /bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po yi/ /mkhal grum klu bsen nad rnams sangs gyur cig /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyi dud pa 'dis/ /bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po yi/ /pho gcong yid 'gong nad rnams? /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyi dud pa 'dis/ /bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po yi/ /mgo dang yan lag nad rnams? /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyi dud pa 'dis/ /bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po yi/

/sha dang lpags pa'i nad rnams sangs gyur cig /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyi dud pa 'dis/ /bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po yi/ khrag dang chu ser nad rnams sangs gyur cig /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyi dud pa 'dis/ /bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po yi/ /rus dang srin bu'i nad rnams sangs gyur cig /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyi dud pa 'dis/ /bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po yi/ /rtsa dang chu rgyus nad rnams sangs gyur cig /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyi dud pa 'dis/ /bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po yi/ /mdangs dang dbang po nyams pa sangs gyur cig /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyi dud pa 'dis/ /bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po yi/ /dbugs dang rnam shes nyams pa sangs gyur cig /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyi dud pa 'dis/ /bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po yi/ /dpal dang mthu stobs nyams p /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyi dud pa 'dis/ /bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po yi/ /tshe dang bsod nams nyams p /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyi dud pa 'dis/ /bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po yi/ kha rje dbang thang nyams pa sangs gyur cig /de ltar gyi dmigs bsal med na gong gi 'phro nas 'di bzhin bya/ gzhan yang bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas la/ /dme mnol btsog gis mnol dang grib kyis mnol/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis sangs gyur cig /thab dang gzhob kyis mnol dang yugs sas mnol/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis? /byi byas rabs chad zla mtshan nal bus mnol/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis? /mdze can gcong po dam nyams grib kyis mnol/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis? /dri can dri ngan can dang rmug dris mnol/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis sangs gyur cig /shi ba'i dur sri gson po'i nang dmes mnol/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis?

/sdig can bshan pa mna' gzan gri bos mnol/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis? /phud nyams mi gtsang yas dang glud kyis mnol/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis? /gzhan yang mi gtsang mnol grib ma lus kun/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis? /nam mkha' sprin dwangs bzhin du sangs gyur cig /nyi zla'i 'od mdangs bzhin du rgyas gyur cig /zla ba yar ngo bzhin du 'phel gyur cig /me tog 'dab stong bzhin du rgyas gyur cig /ston ka'i 'bru drug bzhin du smin gyur cig /chab srid lhun po bzhin du brtan gyur cig /dgos 'dod nor bu bzhin du 'byung gyur cig /chos brgyud nyi zla bzhin du gsal gyur cig /'khor 'bangs skar tshogs bzhin du 'khor gyur cig /nor phyugs rtsi shing bzhin du rgyas gyur cig /snyan grags 'brug sgra bzhin du khyab gyur cig /tshe ring nad med bde dang ldan gyur cig /lo brgya 'tsho zhing ston brgya mthong gyur cig /bkra shis bde legs phun sum tshogs bar shog /ces gsungs nas/ rgyal blon 'khor dang bcas pa rnams the tshom ma byed/ 'di lta bu nyams len byas na don dang ldan pa yin no gsungs so/ /de nas rgyal blon 'khor bcas dga' zhing mgu nas yi rang ste/ gser gyi maṇ+ḍal phul te phyag dang bskor ba byas nas 'di skad do/ kyai/ slob dpon chen po lags/ rgyun du nyams len ji ltar bya/ don ji ltar lags/ zhus pas/ slob dpon chen po'i zhal nas/ kyai rgyal po chen po lags/ spyir dal 'byor mi lus thob pa don ldan du byed dgos/ de'i thabs su byang chub kyi rgyu sgrub pa la 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha dang srung ma la gsol ba btab pas/ byang chub sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad sel zhing mchog thun mong gi dngos grub mthun rkyen sgrub pa yin pas de'i ched du lha dang srung ma bsten dgos pa yin/ bsang bya ba ni nyon mongs dug lnga'i grib mnol sbyong zhing*/

lha dang srung ma mi 'bral bar 'khor ba'i thabs yin pas/ rgyun du bsang bya ba don dang ldan pa yin/ lhag par mnol grib mi gtsang ba myur du sel ba'i thabs su snga dro lha bsang bya/ phyi dro mnol bsang dang mnol khrus byas na grib dang mi gtsang ba thams cad sbyangs/ lha dang srung ma 'khor/ zas nor longs spyod la byin chags/ lus kyi 'du ba cha snyoms/ bkrag dang gzi mdangs bskyed/ khams dang dbang po gsal/ kun gyi yid du 'ong*/ snang srid lha 'dres bka' la nyan/ 'gal rkyen bar chad kyi dri mas mi gos pa sogs yon tan mang po dang ldan pa yin gsungs so/ /der rgyal po'i zhal nas/ legs so slob dpon chen po lags/ mnol khrus bya ba ji ltar yin lags zhus pas/ slob dpon chen po'i zhal nas/ mnol khrus bya ba ni spyir mdo sngags so so'i lugs dang 'dra/ rdzas sbyor sogs dbye ba mang du yod kyang 'di'i skabs su gong gi sman rdzas dang dri sna tshogs chu gtsang dang sbyar nas rin po che'i bum pa'i nang du blugs la yul phyogs su chab gtor bran na yul khrus dang*/ yang sku gsung thugs kyi rten rnams la khrus gsol bya ba ni rten khrus dang*/ /mi nad phyugs nad sogs la rdo rje rnam 'joms khro bo sme brtsegs bdud rtsi 'khyil pa sogs rgyal dang ldan pas grib khrus dang nor rdzas sogs la grib phog na khrus chab bran pas chog pa yin gsungs so/ /der rgyal po chen po dgyes shing gus pas thal mo sbyar te phyag dang bskor ba mang du byas nas slar pho brang du gshegs so/ /de nas yun ring ma lon par rgyal po'i snyun nad dwangs te/ yul khams bod du bkra shis pa'i dge ltas mang po byung ngo*/ /slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa'i mnol bsang lha chab sngon mo zhes bya ba rdzogs so/ mnol bsang 'di dang bsang brngan bde legs kun 'byung bcas gter la ma sbas par pe har dkor mdzod gling gi phyi khyams ldeb ris su btab par mdzad pas bsam yas logs bris mar grags/

de las dpe rgyun 'phel te dbus gtsang phyogs su rgya cher 'phel zhing*/ lhag par slob dpon bai ro tsa nas dpe bsnams te rgyal mo tsha ba rong du phebs pa'i lam zhor mdo smad du ldi ra'-i chos kyi grags pa la gnang ba nas rim par brgyud de mdo khams smad phyogs su da lta'i bar dar rgyas shin tu che'o/ sarba maṅga laṃ/ 'di la grong sngags mkhas blun mang po'i kha ton lag bris kyi dpe rgyun tshig ris cung zad 'dra min mang du snang ba las dpe dag pa 'ga' zhig la gzhi bcol te zhus dag dpyad bzod pa'i khul du 'jigs bral ye shes rdo rjes gtsang bshus su spel ba dge/ // ༈ dag snang ye shes drwa ba las/ grib bsang bdud rtsi'i sprin phung bzhugs so: na mo gu ru pang+maka ra ye: grib bsang bdud rtsi'i sprin phung 'di: bzang shing phye mar gsur dud la: brten nas grangs mang brjod gyur na: grib mnol kun sel gtsang mar 'gyur: skyabs mchog gsum rtsa gsum byin rlabs dang : chos bden pa gnyis kyi bden stobs kyis: phyi snang ba snod kyi 'jig rten bsang : zhing dag pa mkha' spyod lta bur gyur: nang g.yo ba bcud kyi sems can bsang : lha dpa' bo mkha' 'gro kho nar gyur: gnas sbra khang zas nor 'dod yon bsang : rten gzhal yas 'dod rgu phun tshogs gyur: skyabs phan byed lha dang srung ma bsang : mthu nus stobs rtsal rgyas bde ldan gyur: mi 'dir 'dus yon mchod 'khor bcas bsang : rkyen mi mthun bar chad kun zhi nas: dpal bde skyid mnga' thang longs spyod rgyas: don 'di phyi'i dge legs kun 'grub shog: rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung gnas ngas: byin gyis brlabs shing dgongs rgyas btab: rdo rje glu yi tshig 'di dag: brjod pas bsam pa'i don kun 'grub: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: brda thim: zhes pa 'di o rgyas mtsho skyes rdo rjes khrag 'thung bdud 'joms rdo rje la 'od gsal nyams kyi snang ngor gdams pa'o//

yi ge pa ni phun tshogs bkra shis so// // ༈ rlung rta yar bskyed kyi bsang mchod ni/ sman shing dri bzang po'i dud sprin phye mar 'o skol gyis bran te/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ bsang mchod zag pa med pa 'dod yon bdud rtsi'i sprin chen por gyur bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis rgya cher spel la/ kyai/ bsang mchod phun sum tshogs pa 'di/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang*/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang*/ /chos skyong nor lha gter bdag sogs/ /bdag la bsrung zhing skyob rnams bsang*/ /rlung rta dar ba'i sdong grogs mdzod/ /kyai/ shar gyi phyogs na gnas pa'i lha/ /rlung rta dar ba'i dgra lha ni/ /dung seng g.yu yi ral pa can/ /dpa' rtsal che ba'i dgra lha bsang*/ /bdag gi rlung rta dar bar mdzod/ /rgud pa'i rlung rta bskyed du gsol/ /kyai/ lho yi phyogs na gnas pa'i lha/ /rlung rta dar ba'i dgra lha ni/ /g.yu 'brug zangs kyi mche ba can/ /ngar skad che ba'i dgra lha bsang*/ /bdag gi rlung rta dar bar mdzod/ /rgud pa'i rlung rta bskyed du gsol/ kyai/ nub kyi phyogs na gnas pa'i lha/ /rlung rta dar ba'i dgra lha ni/ /rgya stag mtshal gyi thig le can/ /dpa' rngams che ba'i dgra lha bsang*/ /bdag gi rlung rta dar bar mdzod/ /rgud pa'i rlung rta bskyed du gsol/ kyai/ byang gi phyogs na gnas pa'i lha/ /rlung rta dar ba'i dgra lha ni/ khyung chen nor bu'i thor tshugs can/ /stobs shugs che ba'i dgra lha bsang*/ /bdag gi rlung rta dar bar mdzod/ /rgud pa'i rlung rta bskyed du gsol/ kyai/ phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad gnas pa'i lha/ /'byung ba lnga yi lha rnams bsang*/ /'byung ba'i rlung rta dar bar mdzod/ /rgud pa'i rlung rta bskyed du gsol/ spar kha brgyad kyi lha rnams bsang*/ /spar kha'i rlung rta dar bar mdzod/ /rgud pa'i rlung rta bskyed du gsol/ /sme ba dgu yi lha rnams bsang*/ /sme ba'i rlung rta dar bar mdzod/

/rgud pa'i rlung rta bskyed du gsol/ /lo zla zhag dus lha rnams bsang*/ /lo zla'i rlung rta dar bar mdzod/ /rgud pa'i rlung rta bskyed du gsol/ /'go ba'i lha dang skyob pa'i lha/ /pha lha ma lha zhang lha dang*/ /'phrag lha lus lha thams cad bsang*/ /bdag gi rlung rta dar bar mdzod/ /rgud pa'i rlung rta bskyed du gsol/ /bskyed cig rlung rta yar la skyed/ /lus la dpa' rtsal gzi brjid skyed/ /ngag la bden pa'i nus mthu skyed/ /sems la bde ba'i ting 'dzin skyed/ /nad gdon bar chad zhi bar mdzod/ /tshe bsod stobs 'byor 'phel zhing rgyas/ /snang srid dbang sdus dgra bgegs sgrol/ /phyogs las rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan 'phyor/ /'dod pa'i don kun 'grub par mdzod/ /rgyal lo rgyal lo lha rgyal lo/ /bdag cag lha ngo rgyal gyur cig /nag phyogs bdud rigs cham la phob/ /bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ sarba bi dza ya sa ma ya/ khyung la gser dang dar ser/ seṅge la dngul dang dar dkar/ 'brug la g.yu dang dar ljang*/ stag la pad+ma rā ga dang mu men le brgan mthing ka dar dmar/ snying po ni/ gha rje seng ha me dri be'u sarba ar+tha sa dha sarba 'du 'du hūm̐ hoḥ sman sna lnga byugs/ zab bo/ rin chen sna lnga dang dar mtshon lnga rlung rta bzhi'i sngags rnams lus la 'chang*/ des lus ngag yid gsum gyi rlung rta dpal bskyed pa ser mo ba yin na yon tan phrin las rgyas/ skye bo yin na don kun 'grub cing tshong dang dgra las rgyal 'gyur zab bo/ bdag 'dra kun 'chang gling pas bris pa tshe bsod 'phel/ ༈ rlung rta spel thabs skor/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan bsdus pa ni/ oṃ/ gu ru yi dam rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i tog /dpung rgyan lha tshogs rnams la skyabs su mchi/ bdag cag snying nas gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ rgud pa kun las myur du bskyab tu gsol/ oṃ hūm̐ swā hā: dpung rgyan lha tshogs khyod kyi rdzu 'phrul mthus/

bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'khor bcas la/ rmi lam ngan dang bsam ngan sbyor rtsub zlog /byad kha phur kha 'thab rtsod 'khrugs slong zlog /srog lus dbang thang rlung rta rgud pa zlog /mi la na tsha phyugs la god kha zlog /tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang grags pa sogs/ nyin mtshan kun tu bde legs mdzad du gsol/ zhes mañdzu gho ṣas so// // ༈ rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan bsdus pa ni/ oṃ: thub pa'i dbang pos sum cu rtsa gsum na/ lha dbang lha min g.yul rgyal gzungs gsungs pa/ lha mo rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan la: bdag cag gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi/ rgyal bas gang gsungs bden tshig bslu med bzhin: pha rol g.yul sogs nyes pa kun zad cing*/ bdag gi tshe dpal rlung rta gong du bskyed: bkra shis bde legs rtag tu rgyas par mdzod: ces pa'ang gter chen dpa' bo chos dbyings rdo rje'i gsung byin rlabs can no// // 'phags pa phyogs bcu'i mun sel bsdus pa ni/ phyogs mtshams steng 'og bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas la/ phyag 'tshal skyabs mchis bdag cag gar 'gro yang*/ dgra jag chom rkun me chu gcan gzan sogs/ 'jigs pa kun skyobs bsam don lhun 'grub mdzod/ ces rdo grub gsungs su grags pa'i phyogs bcu'i mun sel bsdus pa'o// // bkra shis brtsegs pa ni/ oṃ: ngo mtshar bkra shis zhing gi lha rnams la: gus pas phyag 'tshal brtse bas rjes bzung ste/ don gnyis lhun grub bkra shis rmad byung zhing*/ bde legs phan bde dpal gyi phun sum tshogs: rtag tu mi 'gyur byang chub ljon shing rgyas: chos mthun bsam pa ma lus 'grub pa ru/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gros byin rlobs la/ dkar phyogs skyong bas rtag tu bsrung bar mdzod/ bkra shis brtsegs pa bsdus pa 'di sprul sku mi 'gyur rdo rje'am gter sras rdor dgra'i dgongs gter las so// // ༈ oṃ: bkra shis phyogs bcu dag na legs bzhugs pa'i:

bkra shis dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa ba gsum/ bkra shis lha tshogs rnams la skyabs su mchi/ bkra shis don kun 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ sku dgongs las so// // ༈ klu bsang bla sel chen mo bzhugs so// slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas la phyag 'tshal lo/ klu bsang gtong bar 'dod pas/ dang por rin chen sna lnga ni/ gser dngul mu tig byu ru mu men lnga/ 'bru lnga la nas 'bras gro sran ma til bcas lnga/ bdud rtsi lnga la sbrang dkar 'o ma zho mar bcas lnga/ sman lnga sle tres kaṇ+ḍa ka ri dbang lag rgya mtsho'i lbu ba shu dag bcas lnga/ dri lnga la tsan+dan dkar dmar dza ti ga bur gur gum bcas lnga/ bzang po drug la cu gang gur gum li shi dza ti sug smel ka ko la dang drug dug med pa'i shing sna bsregs/ bdag bskyed gang mos gsol btab la 'di skad do/ kyaiḥ dang po bsang byung gang nas byung : bsang byung 'dzam gling dbus nas byung : nam mkha'i smig dang smag la chags: sa la rtsi shing sna tshogs 'khrungs: de la 'o ma'i rgya mtsho byung : de la me tog mang po skyes: gso bskyed bdud rtsi'i sman char 'bebs: bde chen rigs lnga'i gzhal yas nas: klu yi rgyal po dzam lha bsangs: gnas mchog klu yi pho brang nas: klu rgyal gtsug na rin chen bsangs: de la 'khor ba'i klu rigs bsangs: dkar po klu yi sde tshogs bsangs: sngon po klu yi sde tshogs bsangs: smug po klu yi sde tshogs bsangs: ser po klu yi sde tshogs bsangs: ljang khu klu yi sde tshogs bsangs: khra bo klu yi sde tshogs bsangs: dmar po klu yi sde tshogs bsangs: nag po klu yi sde tshogs bsangs: rgyal rigs dkar po klu yi sde tshogs bsangs: rje rigs ser po klu yi sde tshogs bsangs: bram ze nag po klu yi sde tshogs bsangs: dmangs rigs ljang khu klu yi sde tshogs bsangs: gdol pa nag po klu yi sde tshogs bsangs: rgyal chen bzhi po 'khor bcas bsangs: klu chen brgyad po 'khor bcas bsangs:

gza' dang rgyu skar tshogs rnams bsangs: klu mo rta bzhin nor bzhin bsangs: klu mo lug bzhin g.yang bzhin bsangs: klu mo zas bzhin gter bzhin bsangs: pha ri g.yas la gnas pa'i lha klu bsangs: tshur ri'i g.yon la gnas pa'i lha klu bsangs: 'bab pa chu la gnas pa'i lha klu bsangs: sra ba brag la gnas pa'i lha klu? g.yo ba rlung la gnas pa'i lha klu? bstan pa mkhar la gnas pa'i lha klu? ri bo kun la gnas pa'i lha klu? rgya mtsho kun la gnas pa'i lha klu? yul mchog kun la gnas pa'i lha klu? chu mig kun la gnas pa'i lha klu? khyed klu rnams bsangs pa'i yon tan gyis: mi yi nad yams chod gyur cig: nor gyi god yams chod gyur cig: rta yi rta sri chod gyur cig: lug gi nad yams chod gyur cig: gso byed bdud rtsi sman gyis bsangs: na ba yod na de ring bsangs: rme ba yod na de ring bsangs: g.yo ba yod na de ring bsangs: mnol ba yod na de ring bsangs: 'thor ba yod na de ring bsangs: rdo skam bsangs na gser du gyur: shing skam bsangs na yal ga 'khrungs: klu rnams sum brgya drug cu bsangs: klu phran nyi khri chig stong bsangs: 'dod yon gter kha'i klu rnams bsangs: phyugs rnams spel ba'i klu rnams bsangs: rta rnams spel ba'i klu rnams bsangs: bstan pa gnyan po rgyun du bsrung : tshe ring srog skyong klu yis mdzod: kha rje dbang thang klu yi srung : klu yi gter kha sum brgya drug bcu bsangs: klu yi lcam mo brtan ma bcu gnyis bsangs: bdag gi mi nor spel zhing srung skyob mdzod: na ga sid+dhi thim 'du: mu lber rat+na swā hā: le lngar rat+na swā hā: g.yang wer rat+na swā hā: klu bsang bla sel chen mo ni slob dpon pad+mas mdzad pa'o/ shud+dhe bsangs shud+dhe shud+dhe swā hā: kyai/ dga' bo nyer dga' 'jog po dang*/ /dung skyong 'dzin pa lag mang tshogs/ /klu chen brgyad dang rigs bzhi'i klu/ /'khor bcas thogs med 'dir gshegs la/

/dug sna ma 'dres sman sna'i tshogs/ /rab sbyar bdud rtsi'i ril bu dang*/ /bsang mchod rgya chen 'di 'bul lo/ /dgyes pa chen pos bzhes nas kyang*/ /'khon rtsub dug tshub ngan pa kun/ /zhi nas byang chub sems bskyed do/ /btsa' sad thun pa ma gtong bar/ /mi phyugs nad rims zhi ba dang*/ /char chu dus su 'bebs pa dang*/ /lo phyugs rtag tu legs pa sogs/ /chos 'byor bde skyid 'phel bar mdzod/ /sems can nad pa ji snyed pa/ /myur du nad las thar gyur cig /'gro ba'i nad rnams ma lus pa/ /rtag tu 'byung ba med par shog /klu rgyal dga' bo nyer dga' dang*/ /bstan la dad pa'i lha rnams dang*/ /rgyal po sbyin bdag gnyis dang ni/ /sems can 'phongs pa ji snyed pa/ /tshe ring nad med phun sum tshogs/ /gtan du bde ba thob par shog /ces pa 'di ni paṇa chen ye shes chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'o/ zhes rkong rtse dbang gi rgyal pos gsungs so/ bla ma mgon po spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ klu sman sogs sta gon sngon du 'gro bas stong*/ sangs rgyas chos sogs skyabs sems dang*/ tshad med bzhi lan gsum bya/ rang nyid skad cig gis spyan ras gzigs su gsal ba'i/ /mdun du pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma gsum khebs pa'i dbus su mtsho dang rdzing bu dang ljon shing ne'u sing chu mig sogs klu'i pho brang nyams dga'i lte bar nyi zla dang hrīḥyig las/ jo bo kha sar pā ni sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon thugs kar pad+ma bsnams pa/ rin po che'i rgyan du mas mdzes pa g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum gyi tshul du bzhugs pa'i gnas gsum la oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum gyis mtshan pa/ thugs ka'i cha smad du yi ge hrīḥyig dang bcas par gyur/ 'phags pa'i mtha' bskor du nor rgyas/ dung skyong*/ dga' bo/ nye dga'o/ pad+ma/ chu lha/ dpal gyi'o/ 'od po che/ rigs bzang*/ stobs ldan te klu chen po brgyad stod skyes bu'i cha byed la sbrul mgo bdun gyi gdengs ka can/

smad sbrul mjug tu 'khyil ba 'khor klu dang sa bdag du mas yongs su gang bar gyur/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer gyis klu'i rigs su gyur pa thams cad spyan drangs/ oṃ nā ga sa pa ri wā ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ zhes sngags lan bdun gyis spyan drangs/ mdun bskyed la thim par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsir byin gyis brlab/ 'phags pa'i phyag mthil gyi hrīḥyig las gang 'dod kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs klu dang sa bdag thams cad kyis 'thung zhing khrus byas pas lus ngag yid gsum gyi nyer 'tshe thams cad dag nas dga' ba dang gus pa khyad par can skye bar gyur par bsams la/ oṃ bā su ke maṃ swā hā/ zhes chu bgrang ba dang bstun nas brgya rtsa gcig brjod/ klu bsang 'don na 'dir btang nas/ na mo/ chos rnams thams cad rgyu sogs/ chos sbyin dang*/ ngan song sbyong ba'i gzungs kyang bzla/ gtor ma spyi ltar bdud rtsis byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ a kā ro sogs brjod/ skyon gyis ma gos sogs nas phyag 'tshal lo/ zhes brjod/ klu chen brgyad dang klu rigs bzhi/ /klu phran bsam gyis mi khyab rnams/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /mnyes shing tshim par mdzad gyur cig /mthong ba'i dug dang reg pa'i dug kha rlangs dug dang 'tshe ba'i dug /bsam ngan dug la sogs pa yi/ /klu yi dug rnams zhi bar mdzod/ /bdag cag lhag bsam bden pa dang*/ /mchod sbyin 'di ltar bsngos pa'i mthus/ /klu yi nyer 'tshe zhi gyur cig /klu sman dzā ti pha la yis/ /klu yi mgo nad gsos gyur cig /gzi dang rgya mtsho'i lbu ba yis/ /mig dang klad nyams gsos gyur cig /ut+pal la dang nya lcibs kyis/ /sna dang 'gram pa nyams pa gsos/ li khri mtshal gyi sha khrag dang*/ /dar dang mgron bur ljags dang so/ /dung dang gur gum rus nyams dang*/ /dri bsung nyams pa gsos gyur cig /tsan+dan dkar pos tshad nad dang*/ /rma bya'i mdongs kyi mdangs nyams gsos/

/za 'og dar zab snying zho shas/ /pags dang snying nyams gsos gyur cig /mkhal ma zho shas mkhal ma dang*/ /gla gor zho shas glo ba gsos/ /chu srin sder mo dbang lag gis/ /sder mo yan lag nyams pa gsos/ /chag tshang ku bas grod pa dang*/ /spang spos tshul khrims nyams pa gsos/ /spu shel rtse dang rdo rgyus kyis/ /rtsa rgyud chu rgyus nyams pa gsos/ /sle tres byi thang ka ra yis/ /rgyu ma reg bya nyams pa gsos/ /a ru ra yi nang khrol dang*/ /'dam bu ka ra'i sman mchog gis/ /gnas khang nyams pa gsos gyur cig /rin chen sna lngas bang mdzod dang*/ /dkar gsum mngar gsum kha zas kyis/ /bza' bca' nyams pa gsos gyur cig /'jig rten khams ni thams cad du/ /char chu dus su 'bebs pa dang*/ /lo phyugs rtag tu legs par mdzod/ khyad par gnas 'dir sdod mi dang*/ /rnal 'byor bdag dang sbyin bdag la/ /rlung mkhris bad kan 'dus pa sogs/ /klu yi nad rigs zhi bar mdzod/ /mu ge 'khrugs rtsod zhi ba dang*/ /zhi rgyas la sogs dngos grub stsol/ /rgyan gyi brgyan par byas nas chos spyod de/ /dul zhing yang dag sdom la tshangs par spyod/ /dge slong dge sbyong de yin bram ze'am de/ /mtshon chas mi 'jigs gang yang med*/ /'chi ba'i srog la kun kyang 'dzem/ /rang gi lus la dpe longs la/ /gzhan la gnod pa ma byed cig /ces brjod/ grangs gsog tshe mdun bskyed nas 'di bar gsog /dmigs pa brtan po yod na bdud rtsi'i byin rlabs nas bsags kyang 'thus/ de nas gshegs gsol ni/ oṃ nā ga sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ya hūm̐ dza dzaḥ nā ga shig shig khyer cig /dengs shig /nā ga shig /nā ga khrol/ nā ga dengs/ /klu rgyal rigs/ bram ze'i rigs/ /rje rigs/ dmangs rigs/ gdol pa la sogs pa thams cad phyogs mtshams rang rang gi gnas su skad cig gis gshegs par gyur/ badz+ra muḥ mchod sbyin gnas 'dir sogs nas/ 'gro bar bgyis/ rang gi lus la dpe longs la/

sogs/ zhes thams cad rang rang gnas su song bar bsam la/ 'dir 'bad lhag bsam dge ba'i mthus/ klu rigs byang chub 'khod par shog /dpal chen lha mo la klu rgyal bā su kis phul ba'o/ dge'o// // sa bdag bshags 'bum bsdus pa ni/ kyai/ bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag gis/ /gar 'gro gar 'dug gnas pa'i tshogs/ /yul phyogs 'di la brten gnas pa'i/ /lha klu gnyan gsum khyed rnams la/ /pha ma snga rabs 'das pa dang*/ /bu tsha phyi rabs yan chad kyi/ /sa gnyan brkos dang rdo gnyan bslangs/ /chu gnyan dkrugs dang shing gnyan bcad/ /ro bag thab gzhob zor lam sogs

ka ma ra dzās so mchan/ ma rig ma shes ci 'gal ba/ /mthol lo bshags so dag gyur cig oṃ a ka ni ni ka ni a bhi la man dha la maṇ+ḍa le ma ye swā hā/ sa bdag bshags 'bum bsdus pa rā ga a s+yas mdzad pa'o// // ༈ skabs 'gar bsang mchod bsdus pa bya bar 'dod na/ hūm̐/ rig 'dzin o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas dang*/ /mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo lha lcam man+da ra/ /ye shes mtsho rgyal gnubs ban lo tsā ba/ /rtsa gsum gling dang rig 'dzin mi 'jigs rdor/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs bcas thams cad la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i bsang mchod 'di phul bas/ /bdag sogs byang chub thob pa'i phrin las mdzod/ rtsa gsum gling pas so// // ༈ dud sol ma'i bsang bsdus ni/ bh+yo/ byang shar thod pa 'phrul gyi gzhal yas nas/ /sangs rgyas stong gi bstan srung mthu mo che/ /zab mo rgyud kyi bstan 'dzin dud sol ma/ /las rnams kun 'grub khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma bsang mchod zhes kha bsgyur 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ rlangs smyon nas so// // ༈ zhing skyong ni/ hūm̐/ nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i yul rnams kun gyi bdag /nye ba'i 'thung spyod dpal gyi tsā ri ṭa/ /rab 'jigs dur khrod chen po'i gnas mchog nas/ /gā ya dha ra'i zhabs la bsang mchod 'bul/ rtsa gsum gling pas so// // ༈ btsan gyi bsang bsdus ni/ kyai/ dbang chen h+ya ghṛ wa'i rol rtsal gyis/ /gtum chen shugs drag rdo rje'i me char can/ /mngon spyod dam tshig gnyan gyi las byed pa/ /rol pa bco brgyad 'khor tshogs dpung bcas bsangs/ /las bzhi'i phrin las thogs med 'grub par mdzod// // ༈ gze rgyal bsang mchod ni/ kyai/ tsā ri ṭa dang gze rgyal pho brang nas/ /zhing skyong ma yo sku 'khor da tshur byon/ /gnam sar khyab pa'i 'dod yon bsang gsol bzhes/ /bcol ba'i phrin las myur du 'grub par mdzod/ ces pa'ang rtsa gsum gling pas so//

// bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: dzam lha dkar phyogs kyi bsang mchod bzhugs so: hūm̐: byang phyogs lhun grub gter gyi pho brang nas: nor gyi dbang phyug dpal ldan dzam bha lha: pad+ma rgyal po ār+ya re man+ta: rnam sras skya brgyad dzam lha nag po dang : rta bdag brgyad dang lug bdag ku bā+ai ra: nor bu bzang po gang ba bzang po dang : nor rgyun ma dang phyugs kyi ma lha brgyad: lha bu tshe 'dzin rgyal mo bu rdzi ma: thab lha yu mo zhing lha tshangs pa dang : sgo rdzi stag g.yag la sogs phyugs kyi bdag: srid pa'i lha rgan phyug po mgon dkar dang : longs spyod nor gyi bdag po thams cad la: 'dod yon sna tshogs dkar dmar bsres pa yis: mnyes pa'i dri gsur mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'bul: mnyes shing tshims nas sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin la: bsod nams nor dang longs spyod char bzhin phob: don gnyis mthar phyin gter la spyod par shog: dge'o// // ༈ rta bsang yid bzhin nor bu bzhugs so/ kyai/ sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po la/ /bsang gi rgyu ni ci ltar srid/ /kun bzang kun khyab mkha' klong nas/ /yum chen lnga yi cho 'phrul las/ /dbang chen 'byung ba rim par chags/ /'byung ba lnga yi dwangs ma las/ /dri bzang rtsi shing sna dgu 'khrungs/ /sur dkar dung lo lha yi shing*/ /nya rid span ne ma mo gnyan gyi shing*/ /'om bu bdud rtsi klu yi shing*/ /mkhan pa dkar po zhi ba'i shing*/ /stag pa gser lo rgyas pa'i shing*/ /sman shing se ba dbang gi shing*/ /shug pa g.yu lo drag po'i shing*/ /thang lo klu gnyan dga' ba'i shing*/ /shing sna dgu yi dud pa dang*/ /phye mar 'o zho ja chang phud/ /bsregs pa'i dud pa sprin ltar gtibs/ /dhi las lha mo bdug spos ma/ /dud pa'i lha mo sku mdog sngo/ /phyag g.yas bdud rtsi'i bum pa yis/ /lha srung grib kyis phog pa bkru/ /phyag g.yon sman gyi gzhong pa nas/ /dri zhim spos dud dpag med 'phro/

/dud pa spos kyi 'khri shing gis/ /stong gsum 'jig rten thams cad khyab/ /dud pa'i cha shas re re la/ /'dod yon lnga dang rin chen bdun/ /bkra shis rdzas rtags bza' btung sogs/ /'dzad med nam mkha'i char bzhin 'bebs/ /de 'dra'i dpag med bsang mchod 'dis/ /lha dang srung ma thams cad bsangs/ kyai/ /'gro ba kun la bu ltar brtse/ /ston pa shākya thub pa bsangs/ /sa gnas sems dpa' thugs rje can/ /cang shes nyi ma'i snying po bsangs/ /rta bdud 'dul mdzad khro bo'i rgyal/ /bcom ldan rta mgrin rgyal po bsangs/ /rdo rje khro bo re man+ta/ /rngog chags yongs kyi srung ma bsangs/ /lha yi so pha spyan rnon po/ /dpal rab 'chang ba'i mgon po bsangs/ /ār+ya kro ta re man+ta/ /sa gnas sems dpa' chen po bsangs/ /gzhon nu ār+ya re man+ta/ /nyi ma'i sras po chen po bsangs/ khro bo chen po re man+ta/ /rta 'dre rte'u sri 'dul mdzad bsangs/ /lha dmag 'bum gyi lam mkhan te/ /lam lha chen po 'khor bcas bsangs/ /nyi ma khyer nas gling bzhi bskor/ /rlung rta bdun gyi bdag po bsangs/ /lha min g.yul las rab tu rgyal/ /dgra lha yongs kyi rje bo bsangs/ /dpal dang grags pa gzi brjid ldan/ /'phags pa rta yi rgyal po bsangs/ /mthu dang rdzu 'phrul nus pa ldan/ /bstan srung gnod sbyin chen po bsangs/ /dngul rmog bswe khrab rta sngon can/ /mtshon cha sna tshogs bsnams pa bsangs/ /steng na sprul pa'i pho nya ni/ /lcags kyi khyung chen 'bar ba bsangs/ /'phrag gong gnyis nas sprul pa ni/ /lcags kyi bya khra 'bar ba bsangs/ /rgyab na sprul pa'i seṅge gnyis/ /'gying zhing g.yu ral sprug pa bsangs/ /mdun nas sprul pa stag mo gnyis/ /'grol zhing rgyug 'dur byed pa bsangs/ /'khor ni rang 'dra lnga brgya'i tshogs/ /zhub chen rta sngon bzhon pa bsangs/ /dpal 'byor bdag po rta yi lha/ /gnod sbyin gang ba bzang po bsangs/ /rta nor dngos grub kun gyi bdag
