/rdo rje rnam thos sras po bsangs/ /rta 'dre rti'u sri 'dul mdzad pa/ /rta lha mgon po nag po bsangs/ /zla ba'i sras po rta yi lha/ /gnod sbyin ku bā+ai ra g.yang bsangs/ /sprul pa'i gnod sbyin ku bā+ai ra/ /nor lha bye ba'i tshogs bcas bsangs/ /de ltar bsang ba'i yon tan gyis/ /rta drel rngog chags thams cad la/ /gnod pa'i nad gdon zhi bar mdzod/ /rta g.yang dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /tshe srog brtan pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /rta drel rngog chags 'phel ba yi/ /rta g.yang dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /gnod byed god 'dre rti'u sri rnams/ /thams cad thal ba rdul du rlog /glo bur dgra rkun gnod pa zlog /bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ kyai/ yang gcig bsang zhing mchod pa ni/ /sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po la/ /srid pa ye smon rgyal po yis/ /phyag sen rdzi ma so zho la/ /zhal mchil blugs nas smon lam btab/ /rin chen shel sgong dkar po byung*/ /sgo nga'i phyi shun las byung ba/ /bong bu rta yi rta bla bsangs/ /sgo nga'i bar shun las byung ba/ /'do ba rta yi bla brag bsangs/ /sgong nga'i sgong chu las byung ba/ /'do ba rta yi bla mtsho bsangs/ /mtsho la shing sdong dkar po skyes/ /rngog chags rta yi bla shing bsangs/ /shing rtse mu tig shel byi dang*/ /sprul pa'i bya khyung bcu gsum bsangs/ /rta drel rngog chags thams cad kyis/ /lus la gnas pa'i lha rnams bsangs/ /phrum phrum steng na khra gnyis gnas/ /phywa rje kun khyab dgra lha bsangs/ /snying mtsher gnyis la khra gnyis gnas/ /snying dpa' mthong ba'i dgra lha bsangs/ /spyan mig gnyis la khra gnyis gnas/ /snang gsal 'od kyi dgra lha bsangs/ /dpung pa gnyis la khra gnyis gnas/ /rta dgra 'dul ba'i dgra lha bsangs/ /lag pa gnyis la khra gnyis gnas/ /sa dgra 'dul ba'i dgra lha bsangs/ /sgal mig gnyis la khra gnyis gnas/ /rlung bas mgyogs pa'i dgra lha bsangs/ /rtsibs logs gnyis la khra gnyis gnas/

/bya bas mgyogs pa'i dgra lha bsangs/ /mgyogs pa bya zhon dgra lha bsangs/ /dgra lha dung khra dkar po bsangs/ /mgyogs pa bya bzhin dgra lha bsangs/ /mgyogs pa rlung zhon dgra lha bsangs/ /srid pa'i rngog chags srung ma bsangs/ /srid pa'i rta lha thams cad bsangs/ /rta lha nyams pa thams cad gso/ /rta lha rmug pa thams cad gso/ /rta lha rgud pa thams cad gso/ /rta lha bying ba thams cad gso/ /rta lha'i ngo so gyen du bstod/ /rta lha mnol ba thams cad gso/ /rta lha'i dbu 'phang gyen du bstod/ /rta lha mnyes zhing tshims gyur nas/ /bkrag mdangs gzi brjid ldan gyur cig kyai/ rta lha gnyan po khyed rnams la/ /bsang mchod dam pa 'di 'bul bas/ /thams cad mnyes zhing tshims gyur cig /thams cad mnyes zhing tshims nas kyang*/ /rta drel rngog chags 'di rnams la/ /rtag tu srung zhing skyob par mdzod/ /nyin gyi dus su bya ra mdzod/ /mtshan gyi dus su mel tshe mdzod/ /rta 'dre rti'u sri'i kha khog la/ /rta nad mtsher bcu'i ngo longs shig /dgra rkun gcan gzan kha khog la/ /'gong po lam dgra'i ngo longs shig /lhad dang ldom gyi kha khog la/ /zer dang gnod byed ngo longs shig /rta nad kun gyi kha khog la/ /gdon rigs kun gyi ngo longs shig kyai/ ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan nas/ /rngog chags rnams la bskyab tu gsol/ /cang shes nyi ma'i snying po yi/ /rta rnams kun la thugs rjes skyobs/ khro bo rta mgrin rgyal po yis/ /rngog chags rnams la bsrung du gsol/ /'phags pa rdo rje re man+tas/ /rngog chags srung zhing bskyab tu gsol/ /dpal rab 'chang ba'i mgon po yis/ /rta yi nad gdon zhi bar mdzod/ /'phags pa ār+ya re man+tas/ /rta drel 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzod/ /gzhon nu nyi ma'i sras po yis/ rta g.yang dngos grub dbang du sdud/ khro bo chen po re man+tas/ /rta la gnod byed rdul du rlog /dpal 'byor gang ba bzang po yis/ /rta g.yang dpal dang 'byor pa spel/

/rdo rje gnod sbyin rnam thos sras/ /rta drel longs spyod rgyas par mdzod/ /mgon po nag po rta yi lha/ /rta la gnod pa'i dgra bgegs thul/ /ku bā+ai ra ni rta yi bdag /rta yi bdag po'i 'tsho skyong mdzod/ /'jig rten srid pa'i rta lha rnams/ /rta la srung skyob mel tshe mdzod/ /rta yi lus lha gnyan po rnams/ /rta la brten chos srung skyob mdzod/ /rta lha rta dang ma 'bral cig /drel lha drel dang ma 'bral cig /nor lha nor dang ma 'bral cig /dgra lha mi dang ma 'bral cig /bkra shis bde legs rgyas par mdzod/ lha rgyal lo/ ces rā ga a s+yas sbyar ba'o// // ༈ nor lha'i bsang mchod bzhugs so/ kyai/ ri rab chen po'i byang phyogs su/ /lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog tu/ /spos ngad ldan pa'i ri bo'i steng*/ /rin chen gser gyi khang bzang ni/ /bkra shis bum bzang gter mdzod dbus/ /ljon shing chen po'i nags tshal nas/ /pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad kyi dbus/ /seṅge dkar mo'i khri steng nas/ /rgyal chen mgon po rnam thos sras/ /nor srung brgyad po'i 'khor gyis bskor/ /gnod sbyin 'bum phrag pho nya 'gyed/ khams gsum sems can thams can la/ /snying rje nor gyi char pa 'bebs/ /rgyal chen rnam sras 'khor bcas bsangs/ /gser gyi mdog can nor bu'i sras/ /rin chen dbyug tho ne'u le/ /ber dang bswe khrab sku la gsol/ /nor bu rin chen prog zhu bsnams/ /mgon po rnam sras 'khor bcas bsangs/ /shar phyogs nor srung dzaṃ bha la/ /phyag na rin chen ne'u le bsnams/ /ār+ya dzaṃ lha la sogs pa/ /shar phyogs nor srung 'khor bcas bsangs/ /lho phyogs nor srung gang ba bzang*/ /phyag na rin chen bum pa bsnams/ /gang ba bzang po la sogs pa'i/ /lho phyogs nor srung 'khor bcas bsangs/ /nub phyogs nor srung nor bu bzang*/ /phyag na ne'u le snye ma 'dzin/ /nor bu bzang po la sogs pa'i/ /nub phyogs nor srung 'khor bcas bsangs/

/byang phyogs nor srung ku bā+ai ra/ /phyag na rin chen ne'u le bsnams/ /ku bā+ai ra la sogs pa yi/ /byang phyogs nor srung 'khor bcas bsangs/ /shar lho nor srung yang dag shes/ /phyag na dngul dkar ral gri bsnams/ /yang dag shes la sogs pa yi/ /shar lho nor srung 'khor bcas bsangs/ /lho nub nor srung 'brog gnas ni/ /phyag na mdung dar dkar po bsnams/ /'brog gnas nag po la sogs pa'i/ /lho nub nor srung 'khor bcas bsangs/ /nub byang nor srung lngas rtsen ni/ /phyag na rat+na'i khang bu bsnams/ /lngas rtsen ser skya la sogs pa'i/ /nub byang nor srung 'khor bcas bsangs/ /byang shar nor srung dzaṃ bhi ni/ /phyag na gnam lcags ral gri bsnams/ /dzaṃ bha kuṇ+ḍa lī la sogs pa'i/ /byang shar nor srung 'khor bcas bsangs/ /dbus phyogs nor srung lha ku ni/ /phyag na rin chen gzhong pa bsnams/ /sku la rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan/ /dbus phyogs nor srung 'khor bcas bsangs/ /nor rgyun ma la sogs pa yi/ /nor lha mo rigs thams cad bsangs/ /phyag na rin chen phreng ba bsnams/ /nor bu pad+mas sku la brgyan/ /nor lha mo rigs brgyad po bsangs/ kyai/ ci 'dod dngos grub char 'bebs pa/ /tshong pa rnams kyi tshong lha mdzod/ /tshong dpon rnam sras 'khor bcas bsangs/ /dam pa'i chos kyi srung ma mdzod/ /chos skyong rnam sras 'khor bcas bsangs/ /jag pa rnams kyi dgra lha mdzod/ /dgra lha rnam sras 'khor bcas bsangs/ /'brog pa rnams kyi nor lha mdzod/ /nor lha rnam sras 'khor bcas bsangs/ /yus pa rnams kyi zhing lha mdzod/ /zhing lha rnam sras 'khor bcas bsangs/ /ci 'dod dngos grub phun sum tshogs/ /nor bu rnam sras 'khor bcas bsangs/ /dgra bgegs cham la 'bebs mdzad pa'i/ /rgyal chen rnam sras 'khor bcas bsangs/ kyai/ lha chen nor lha 'khor bcas bsangs/ /klu chen nor lha 'khor bcas bsangs/ /gnod sbyin nor lha 'khor bcas bsangs/

/srin po'i nor lha 'khor bcas bsangs/ /nyi ma zla ba'i nor lha bsangs/ /gza' dang rgyu skar nor lha bsangs/ /lha srin sde brgyad nor lha bsangs/ kyai/ slob dpon brgyud dang pha mes rgyud/ /tshe rabs sngon nas da lta'i bar/ kha 'dzin sdong grogs byed pa yi/ /rgyal chen rnam sras 'khor bcas la/ /bsang dang mchod pa dam pa 'bul/ /mi 'jigs seṅge'i khri steng na/ /bai las byung ba'i mgon po ni/ /sa brgyad sems dpa' stobs po che/ /nor gyi dbang phyug khyod la bstod/ /mi g.yang nor g.yang zas g.yang rnams/ /yon bdag 'di la 'dzoms par mdzod/ bkra shis bde legs mdzad du gsol/ dge'o// // ༈ lug lha'i bsang mchod bzhugs so/ kyai/ byang phyogs lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog nas/ /lug lha gnod sbyin chen po gang ba bzang*/ /a parā tsi ta tshogs kyi bdag po dang*/ /dkar mo lug la 'khor ba'i lha rnams kun/ /'dir gshegs bsang mchod dkar gsum mchod pa 'bul/ /g.yu shugs phye mar gsur gyi dud pas bsangs/ /g.yang dkar lug gi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /god kha snying stong mi kha bzlog pa dang*/ /brgya stong khri 'bum 'phel ba'i phrin las mdzod/ /dgos 'dod char ltar 'bebs pa'i bkra shis shog /ces pa bla ma tshe mtshams pa pad+ma smon lam dar rgyas kyis mdzad pa'o// // ༈ sprul sku mi 'gyur rdo rje'i zab gter zhi ba'i bsang gzhung ni: kamam: gu ru rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis: bla ma yi dam spyan 'dren no: g.yu shug phye mar gsur gyis mchod: nad gdon bar chad zhi bar mdzod: yams nad rims nad zhi bar mdzod: glo gor hon gsum zhi bar mdzod: rlung mkhris bad kan zhi bar mdzod: pho gdon mo gdon zhi bar mdzod: zhi ba'i las kun sgrub tu gsol: hūm̐: dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis: mkha' 'gro chos skyong spyan 'dren no: g.yu shug phye mar gsur gyis mchod: nad gdon bar chad zhi bar mdzod:

yams nad rims nad zhi bar mdzod: glo gor hon gsum zhi bar mdzod: rlung mkhris bad kan zhi bar mdzod: pho gdon mo gdon zhi bar mdzod: zhi ba'i las kun sgrub tu gsol: hūm̐: dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis: nor lha gter bdag spyan 'dren no: g.yu shug phye mar gsur gyis mchod: nad gdon bar chad zhi bar mdzod: yams nad rims nad zhi bar mdzod: glo gor hon gsum zhi bar mdzod: rlung mkhris bad kan zhi bar mdzod: pho gdon mo gdon zhi bar mdzod: zhi ba'i las kun sgrub tu gsol: hūm̐: dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis: dbang phyug chen po spyan 'dren no: g.yu shug phye mar gsur gyis mchod: nad gdon bar chad zhi bar mdzod: yams nad rims nad zhi bar mdzod: glo gor hon gsum zhi bar mdzod: rlung mkhris bad kan zhi bar mdzod: pho gdon mo gdon zhi bar mdzod: zhi ba'i las kun sgrub tu gsol: hūm̐: dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis: dpal mgon bdun cu spyan 'dren no: g.yu shug phye mar gsur gyis mchod: nad gdon bar chad zhi bar mdzod: yams nad rims nad zhi bar mdzod: glo gor hon gsum zhi bar mdzod: rlung mkhris bad kan zhi bar mdzod: pho gdon mo gdon zhi bar mdzod: zhi ba'i las kun sgrub tu gsol: hūm̐: dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis: brtan ma bcu gnyis spyan 'dren no: g.yu shug phye mar gsur gyis mchod: nad gdon bar chad zhi bar mdzod: yams nad rims nad zhi bar mdzod: glo gor hon gsum zhi bar mdzod: rlung mkhris bad kan zhi bar mdzod: pho gdon mo gdon zhi bar mdzod: zhi ba'i las kun sgrub tu gsol: hūm̐: dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis: mgur lha bcu gsum spyan 'dren no: g.yu shug phye mar gsur gyis mchod: nad gdon bar chad zhi bar mdzod: yams nad rims nad zhi bar mdzod: glo gor hon gsum zhi bar mdzod: rlung mkhris bad kan zhi bar mdzod: pho gdon mo gdon zhi bar mdzod: zhi ba'i las kun sgrub tu gsol:

hūm̐: dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis: dge bsnyen nyer gcig spyan 'dren no: g.yu shug phye mar gsur gyis mchod: nad gdon bar chad zhi bar mdzod: yams nad rims nad zhi bar mdzod: glo gor hon gsum zhi bar mdzod: rlung mkhris bad kan zhi bar mdzod: pho gdon mo gdon zhi bar mdzod: zhi ba'i las kun sgrub tu gsol: kyaiḥ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis: thang lha yar zhur spyan 'dren no: g.yu shug phye mar gsur gyis mchod: nad gdon bar chad zhi bar mdzod: yams nad rims nad zhi bar mdzod: glo gor hon gsum zhi bar mdzod: rlung mkhris bad kan zhi bar mdzod: pho gdon mo gdon zhi bar mdzod: zhi ba'i las kun sgrub tu gsol: kyaiḥ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis: mkhar ri lcam dral spyan 'dren no: g.yu shug phye mar gsur gyis mchod: nad gdon bar chad zhi bar mdzod: yams nad rims nad zhi bar mdzod: glo gor hon gsum zhi bar mdzod: rlung mkhris bad kan zhi bar mdzod: pho gdon mo gdon zhi bar mdzod: zhi ba'i las kun sgrub tu gsol: kyaiḥ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis: yar lha sham po spyan 'dren no: g.yu shug phye mar gsur gyis mchod: nad gdon bar chad zhi bar mdzod: yams nad rims nad zhi bar mdzod: glo gor hon gsum zhi bar mdzod: rlung mkhris bad kan zhi bar mdzod: pho gdon mo gdon zhi bar mdzod: zhi ba'i las kun sgrub tu gsol: kyaiḥ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis: yag la se bo spyan 'dren no: g.yu shug phye mar gsur gyis mchod: nad gdon bar chad zhi bar mdzod: yams nad rims nad zhi bar mdzod: glo gor hon gsum zhi bar mdzod: rlung mkhris bad kan zhi bar mdzod: pho gdon mo gdon zhi bar mdzod: zhi ba'i las kun sgrub tu gsol: kyaiḥ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis: rma rgyal spom ra spyan 'dren no: g.yu shug phye mar gsur gyis mchod: nad gdon bar chad zhi bar mdzod: yams nad rims nad zhi bar mdzod: glo gor hon gsum zhi bar mdzod:

rlung mkhris bad kan zhi bar mdzod: pho gdon mo gdon zhi bar mdzod: zhi ba'i las kun sgrub tu gsol: kyaiḥ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis: a wa ge mdzo spyan 'dren no: g.yu shug phye mar gsur gyis mchod: nad gdon bar chad zhi bar mdzod: yams nad rims nad zhi bar mdzod: glo gor hon gsum zhi bar mdzod: rlung mkhris bad kan zhi bar mdzod: pho gdon mo gdon zhi bar mdzod: zhi ba'i las kun sgrub tu gsol: kyaiḥ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis: me mgon dkar po spyan 'dren no: g.yu shug phye mar gsur gyis mchod: nad gdon bar chad zhi bar mdzod: yams nad rims nad zhi bar mdzod: glo gor hon gsum zhi bar mdzod: rlung mkhris bad kan zhi bar mdzod: pho gdon mo gdon zhi bar mdzod: zhi ba'i las kun sgrub tu gsol: kyaiḥ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis: sgyogs chen gdong ra spyan 'dren no: g.yu shug phye mar gsur gyis mchod: nad gdon bar chad zhi bar mdzod: yams nad rims nad zhi bar mdzod: glo gor hon gsum zhi bar mdzod: rlung mkhris bad kan zhi bar mdzod: pho gdon mo gdon zhi bar mdzod: zhi ba'i las kun sgrub tu gsol: kyaiḥ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis: rdo thi gangs dkar spyan 'dren no: g.yu shug phye mar gsur gyis mchod: nad gdon bar chad zhi bar mdzod: yams nad rims nad zhi bar mdzod: glo gor hon gsum zhi bar mdzod: rlung mkhris bad kan zhi bar mdzod: pho gdon mo gdon zhi bar mdzod: zhi ba'i las kun sgrub tu gsol: kyaiḥ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis: sku rgyal she ne spyan 'dren no: g.yu shug phye mar gsur gyis mchod: nad gdon bar chad zhi bar mdzod: yams nad rims nad zhi bar mdzod: glo gor hon gsum zhi bar mdzod: rlung mkhris bad kan zhi bar mdzod: pho gdon mo gdon zhi bar mdzod: zhi ba'i las kun sgrub tu gsol: kyaiḥ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis: stam rgyal ngang pa spyan 'dren no: g.yu shug phye mar gsur gyis mchod:

nad gdon bar chad zhi bar mdzod: yams nad rims nad zhi bar mdzod: glo gor hon gsum zhi bar mdzod: rlung mkhris bad kan zhi bar mdzod: pho gdon mo gdon zhi bar mdzod: zhi ba'i las kun sgrub tu gsol: kyaiḥ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis: jo bo gze rgyal spyan 'dren no: g.yu shug phye mar gsur gyis mchod: nad gdon bar chad zhi bar mdzod: yams nad rims nad zhi bar mdzod: glo gor hon gsum zhi bar mdzod: rlung mkhris bad kan zhi bar mdzod: pho gdon mo gdon zhi bar mdzod: zhi ba'i las kun sgrub tu gsol: kyaiḥ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis: dmag dpon dbyi rgyal spyan 'dren no: g.yu shug phye mar gsur gyis mchod: nad gdon bar chad zhi bar mdzod: yams nad rims nad zhi bar mdzod: glo gor hon gsum zhi bar mdzod: rlung mkhris bad kan zhi bar mdzod: pho gdon mo gdon zhi bar mdzod: zhi ba'i las kun sgrub tu gsol: kyaiḥ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis: rdo rje khyung grags spyan 'dren no: g.yu shug phye mar gsur gyis mchod: nad gdon bar chad zhi bar mdzod: yams nad rims nad zhi bar mdzod: glo gor hon gsum zhi bar mdzod: rlung mkhris bad kan zhi bar mdzod: pho gdon mo gdon zhi bar mdzod: zhi ba'i las kun sgrub tu gsol: kyaiḥ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis: dzo rgyal re ti spyan 'dren no: g.yu shug phye mar gsur gyis mchod: nad gdon bar chad zhi bar mdzod: yams nad rims nad zhi bar mdzod: glo gor hon gsum zhi bar mdzod: rlung mkhris bad kan zhi bar mdzod: pho gdon mo gdon zhi bar mdzod: zhi ba'i las kun sgrub tu gsol: kyaiḥ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis: go rgyal lcam dral spyan 'dren no: g.yu shug phye mar gsur gyis mchod: nad gdon bar chad zhi bar mdzod: yams nad rims nad zhi bar mdzod: glo gor hon gsum zhi bar mdzod: rlung mkhris bad kan zhi bar mdzod: pho gdon mo gdon zhi bar mdzod: zhi ba'i las kun sgrub tu gsol:

kyaiḥ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis: dge bsnyen 'ob rang spyan 'dren no: g.yu shug phye mar gsur gyis mchod: nad gdon bar chad zhi bar mdzod: yams nad rims nad zhi bar mdzod: glo gor hon gsum zhi bar mdzod: rlung mkhris bad kan zhi bar mdzod: pho gdon mo gdon zhi bar mdzod: zhi ba'i las kun sgrub tu gsol: kyaiḥ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis: ngom rgyal mtsho bkra spyan 'dren no: g.yu shug phye mar gsur gyis mchod: nad gdon bar chad zhi bar mdzod: yams nad rims nad zhi bar mdzod: glo gor hon gsum zhi bar mdzod: rlung mkhris bad kan zhi bar mdzod: pho gdon mo gdon zhi bar mdzod: zhi ba'i las kun sgrub tu gsol: kyaiḥ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis: grul rgyal byang grags spyan 'dren no: g.yu shug phye mar gsur gyis mchod: nad gdon bar chad zhi bar mdzod: yams nad rims nad zhi bar mdzod: glo gor hon gsum zhi bar mdzod: rlung mkhris bad kan zhi bar mdzod: pho gdon mo gdon zhi bar mdzod: zhi ba'i las kun sgrub tu gsol: kyaiḥ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis: yul 'dis gzhi bdag spyan 'dren no: g.yu shug phye mar gsur gyis mchod: nad gdon bar chad zhi bar mdzod: yams nad rims nad zhi bar mdzod: glo gor hon gsum zhi bar mdzod: rlung mkhris bad kan zhi bar mdzod: pho gdon mo gdon zhi bar mdzod: zhi ba'i las kun sgrub tu gsol: kyaiḥ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis: pha lha ma lha zhang lha dang : dgra lha rnams kyang spyan 'dren no: g.yu shug phye mar gsur gyis mchod: nad gdon bar chad zhi bar mdzod: yams nad rims nad zhi bar mdzod: glo gor hon gsum zhi bar mdzod: rlung mkhris bad kan zhi bar mdzod: pho gdon mo gdon zhi bar mdzod: zhi ba'i las kun sgrub tu gsol: nad thams cad zhi ba shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: gdon thams cad zhi ba shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: bar chad thams cad zhi ba shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā:

yams nad zhi ba shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: rims nad zhi ba shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: 'go nad thams cad zhi ba shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: glo thams cad zhi ba shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: gor thams cad zhi ba shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: hon thams cad zhi ba shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: rlung thams cad zhi ba shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: mkhris pa thams cad zhi ba shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: bad kan thams cad zhi ba shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: 'dus pa thams cad zhi ba shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: pho gdon rgyal po thams cad zhi ba shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: mo gdon bswe mo thams cad zhi ba shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: klu gdon the'u rang thams cad zhi ba shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: oṃ a hi swā hā: bir+ṭa ni swā hā: go gha ni swā hā: sa ma ye swā hā: sa ma ya swā hā: ha ka la swā hā: shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: zhes pa 'di mtshams su gzhan gang rung byar rung : sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: kha thaṃ gu h+yaḥ ces sprul sku mi 'gyur rdo rje dgung lo bcu gsum gser 'phyang gi lo rgyal zla ba'i tshes gnam gang nyin o rgyan rin po che sprul sku'i cha lugs spyi mthun gcig gis dngos su gsungs so// // sprul sku mi 'gyur rdo rje'i zhi ba'i bsang mchod nyung ngur bsdus pa bzhugs so// // kyaiḥ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /bla ma yi dam dkon mchog gsum/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong nor lha'i tshogs/ /gzhi bdag yul bdag gnas bdag rigs/ /sde brgyad lan chags bgegs rigs mgron/ /ma lus 'khor bcas spyan 'dren no/ /rang rang dgyes pa'i ldan la bzhugs/ /dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod rdzas dang*/ /bzang shing phye mar gsur gyis mchod/ thugs dang 'gal ba'i nongs pa bshags/ /nad gdon bar chad zhi bar mdzod/ /glo gor hon gsum zhi bar mdzod/ /rlung mkhris bad kan zhi bar mdzod/ /pho gdon mo gdon zhi bar mdzod/

/klu nad gnyan nad zhi bar mdzod/ /gza' nad btsan nad zhi bar mdzod/ /rgyal nad gshed nad zhi bar mdzod/ /sa bdag nad rnams zhi bar mdzod/ /'chi bdag nad rnams zhi bar mdzod/ /mi nad rta nad zhi bar mdzod/ /nor nad lug nad zhi bar mdzod/ khyi nad ra nad zhi bar mdzod/ /zhi ba'i las kun 'grub par mdzod: oṃ a ka ni ni ka ni a byi la maṇ+ḍa la maṇ+ḍa le swā hā/ zhes go 'jo'i yul la bsang mchod gcig gi skabs bla mas zhi bsang ci mang dgos gsungs pas zhi bsang rgyas pa kha grangs mang po mi thon pa'i rkyen gyis sngags nag rā ga a s+yas thun skabs gcig la sman lha'i thugs dgongs bskyed nas de la khag tshig nyung bsdus kyi glu dbyangs 'di gsungs so/ maṅga laṃ/ dge'o// // jo bo gze rgyal gyi bsang mchod phrin las kun 'grub bzhugs so// // gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal la 'dud/ de yang jo bo gze rgyal mgul bzang dbu ma stag rtse mtsho sman gur gcig ma bcas yab yum sras gsum gsol mchod rnams la brten de'i mchod bstod brtsam pa ni/ snod gtsang zhig gi nang du ri rab bang rim gsum pa'i kha ru lha'i bshos bu rtse gsum g.yas su dpal gtor sbrul mgos mtshan pa g.yon du klu mo dpang can 'khor gnyis sbrul dkris can/ yang 'khor du gtor chung bcu gnyis dang mtheb skyu bcas gzugs 'gros sogs dang gser skyems phye ma rnga shang bcas rdung zhing gdung dbyangs len no/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rang nyid skad cig pad 'byung gsal ba yi/ /gnas gsum yig 'bru gsum gyi 'phro 'du las/ dzaḥhūm̐ zhes pas thugs dam rgyud bskul nas/ /gter srung yab yum sras bcas spyan drangs gyur/ oṃ dhe wa pa ti nā ga ku murtā ya dza dzaḥ hūm̐/ shel ri rab dkar gzi 'od 'ja' tshon dbus/ /tshangs pa'i zlos gar skyes bzang lha yi sras/ /srid pa'i dmu rje ma yo gwa pa zhes/ /phywa rabs kun gyi nang nas mi bo che/ /rag dkar la chibs dmag chas go mtshon can/

/dar mdung zhags dkar rba lcag phyag na thogs/ /rol du dung seng pho mo 'bum 'bum khrid/ /lha rgyal de yi yid 'dzin mdza' mo lcam/ /dbang mo gzhon nu dar dkar lhub ldan gsol/ /rat+na yid gar mchis pa du mas brgyan/ /phyag na nor bu rin chen gter sgrom 'dzin/ /sbrul gdengs dbus su nor bu mdza' na mo/ /chibs su spang ljong gser shwa gar 'gros chibs/ /mthing bzang mdog ldan bu mo du mas bskor/ /lcam mo de yi sras chen gnod sbyin bu/ /sku mdog smug mthing dar ber dgu brtsegs gsol/ /dar dmar la thod dpa' bo mtshon thogs dbyibs/ /phyag na sbrul zhags mdung sngon rgyal mtshan phyar/ /gro sngon chu ris rlung gshog bang mgyogs chibs/ /nyid sprul lcags kyi bya khra dgra la 'gyed/ /mgul bzang rgyan spyod mdzes pa dbu ma che/ /yab yum sras gsum 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /gser skyems phud dang bsang mchod gtor ma 'bul/ /gzhan yang dkor cha gzugs 'gros spyan gzigs tshogs/ /nam mkha' sa gzhi bar snang kun khengs nas/ /blos blangs dge bsnyen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /bzhes nas rnal 'byor sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin la/ /gzhi lam byes gsum kha 'dzin rogs dan dang*/ /tshe bsod snyan grags kha rje dbang thang rnams/ /bkra shis dge legs zla rgyas gong 'phel bzhin/ /rgyal srid chab 'bangs yongs la 'dzoms par shog khyad par mi mthun bdud bgegs 'byung po dang*/ /nad mthun mu ge'i bskal pa ngan pa sol/ /nye bar zhi ba'i phrin las mdzad pa dang*/ /sgrub la ma gdung bu bzhin rab brtson nas/ /bdag la mthun rkyen go 'phang sgrub pa dang*/ /bar chad bdud dang mi min gdug sems zhi/ /che zhes dge bsnyen khyod kyis sgrol bar mdzod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi/ zhes pa bsang mchod rgyas pa btang ba 'di yang dpon mgon pos nye bar bskul ba'i ngor bkra shis tshang gi khyim du g.yung drung rdo rje ser skya mang zhig la o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas zhi khro'i thun mtshams su mchod pa'i skabs su bgyis pa'o//

// dgongs gsol yid bzhin nor bu bzhugs so// // pad+ma thod phreng drag po rtsal la 'dud/ gdul bya'i re skong gan+dho dharma'i tog /dbyings rig mkha' la phrin las 'od stong 'gyed/ /zer thag mchog dman kun blo'i dga' ston du/ /rnam 'dren rdo rje'i zlos gar legs bkod la/ /phrin las phra zhib yongs tshang lha bsang bstan/ /rnam dkar gzhi la 'byor tshogs gang gnas bsham/ /snyan 'gyur a ma bu 'bod gdung dbyangs gyer/ /ring lugs phyag bzhes 'khrul med rnams bzhin las/ /bsang mchod bdud rtsi'i sprin phung 'di skad do/ kyai/ 'dzam gling mchog gyur lta na sdug dbus tshal/ /ngo mtshar rab bkod 'ja' 'od mtha' rgyas klong*/ /kun las ya mtshan khyad 'phags ri rgyal ni/ /gze rgyal jo bo gangs ri'i gnas mchog nas/ /skyes gcig lha btsan rdo rje 'bar ba che/ /dkar dmar mdangs ldan dpa' bo seng zhal can/ /brjid chags ya mtshan shel khrab rmog zhu gsol/ /dkar chas ru mtshon thog zer thog mda' bsnams/ /cang shes ngang zhur lam lam 'gros chen chibs/ /spyan 'dren 'dir gshegs bsang mchod 'di bzhes la/ /smon lam dge bcu sgrub pa'i sdong grogs mdzod/ /yul du nad mug mtshon gyi bskal pa zhi/ /lo legs nor phyugs 'phel bar lha gsol lo/ /mi nor mnga' thang 'phel bar lha gsol lo/ /chos bzhin sgrub la chos min bstan dgra sgrol/ /yar tshes bzhin du skyid pa'i lha bsangs so/ /zo dor mi 'bral grib bzhin 'grogs par shog kyai/ ḍāk+ki dpal 'bar yid 'ong mdzes ma 'phro/ /ha ha seng gdong rngam pa'i cha byed can/ /dar dkar na bza' rat+na'i rgyan gyis brgyan/ kha ṭ+wāṃ tsit+ta phyag mtshan cha lugs 'chang*/ /dmar thag cang shes zer 'od 'khyug la chibs/ /spyan 'dren 'dir gshegs bsang mchod 'di bzhes la/ /smon lam dge bcu sgrub pa'i sdong grogs mdzod/ /yul du nad mug mtshon gyi bskal pa zhi/ /lo legs nor phyugs 'phel bar lha gsol lo/

/mi nor mnga' thang 'phel bar lha gsol lo/ /chos bzhin sgrub la chos min bstan dgra sgrol/ /yar tshes bzhin du skyid pa'i lha bsangs so/ /zo dor mi 'bral grib bzhin 'grogs par shog kyai/ yab yum sprul pa'i bam ro dmar nag ni/ /gcer bu ro langs spyi gtsug sa la 'gro/ /bya sder 'khrab cing rkang pas zor mda' 'phen/ /spyan 'dren 'dir gshegs bsang mchod 'di bzhes la/ /smon lam dge bcu sgrub pa'i sdong grogs mdzod/ /yul du nad mug mtshon gyi bskal pa zhi/ /lo legs nor phyugs 'phel bar lha gsol lo/ /mi nor mnga' thang 'phel bar lha gsol lo/ /chos bzhin sgrub la chos min bstan dgra sgrol/ /yar tshes bzhin du skyid pa'i lha bsangs so/ /zo dor mi 'bral grib bzhin 'grogs par shog kyai/ sprul pa yang 'khor sde brgyad dmag chen bcas/ /drag rtsal mtshon cha sna dgus lus la brgyan/ /rang mdog phyag mtshan rdzu 'phrul rlung rta chibs/ /spyan 'dren 'dir gshegs bsang mchod 'di bzhes la/ /smon lam dge bcu sgrub pa'i sdong grogs mdzod/ /yul du nad mug mtshon gyi bskal pa zhi/ /lo legs nor phyugs 'phel bar lha gsol lo/ /mi nor mnga' thang 'phel bar lha gsol lo/ /chos bzhin sgrub la chos min bstan dgra sgrol/ /yar tshes bzhin du skyid pa'i lha bsangs so/ /zo dor mi 'bral grib bzhin 'grogs par shog kyai/ gru 'dzin ri bo shar gyi phyogs rol nas/ /yul gyi lha chen rma gnyan spom ra ni/ /drag po'i gsang mtshan dge bsnyen thogs med rtsal/ /kun+da'i mdog can dar dkar lhab lhub gsol/ /dar mdung lcags kyu gdengs shing mnga' dbang bsgyur/ /zhol g.yag ngar 'gro mdzes rgyan dkar po chibs/ /spyan 'dren 'dir gshegs bsang mchod 'di bzhes la/ /smon lam dge bcu sgrub pa'i sdong grogs mdzod/ /yul du nad mug mtshon gyi bskal pa zhi/ /lo legs nor phyugs 'phel bar lha gsol lo/

/mi nor mnga' thang 'phel bar lha gsol lo/ /chos bzhin sgrub la chos min bstan dgra sgrol/ /yar tshes bzhin du skyid pa'i lha bsangs so/ /zo dor mi 'bral grib bzhin 'grogs par shog kyai/ zangs ri dmar nag rba klong e yi gru/ /mdangs ldan rak+ta lbu ba 'khrigs pa'i dbus/ /sku rgyal she ne drag rtsal sde dpon zhes/ /dbang gi mdog can dar dmar ber chen gsol/ /lhab lhub zangs gri ru dar dgra snying rol/ /mtshal stag mgo dgu 'dzam gling myur bgrod chibs/ /spyan 'dren 'dir gshegs bsang mchod 'di bzhes la/ /smon lam dge bcu sgrub pa'i sdong grogs mdzod/ /yul du nad mug mtshon gyi bskal pa zhi/ /lo legs nor phyugs 'phel bar lha gsol lo/ /mi nor mnga' thang 'phel bar lha gsol lo/ /chos bzhin sgrub la chos min bstan dgra sgrol/ /yar tshes bzhin du skyid pa'i lha bsangs so/ /zo dor mi 'bral grib bzhin 'grogs par shog kyai/ yid 'ong rab rgyas rba klong 'phyo ba'i klong*/ /sku lha zhes bya dge bsnyen mkhar nag che/ /gsang mtshan smyo kha rab 'jigs mun pa'i gzugs/ /ber nag gsol zhing dur khrod chas kyis brgyan/ /spu gri'i 'khor lo rno dbal mtshon cha thogs/ /chibs su chu rta rlung gi gshog can chibs/ /spyan 'dren 'dir gshegs bsang mchod 'di bzhes la/ /smon lam dge bcu sgrub pa'i sdong grogs mdzod/ /yul du nad mug mtshon gyi bskal pa zhi/ /lo legs nor phyugs 'phel bar lha gsol lo/ /mi nor mnga' thang 'phel bar lha gsol lo/ /chos bzhin sgrub la chos min bstan dgra sgrol/ /yar tshes bzhin du skyid pa'i lha bsangs so/ /zo dor mi 'bral grib bzhin 'grogs par shog kyai/ rdo rje gdan gyi byang shar 'dzam gling gangs/ /srid pa'i yul 'dzin thang lha 'od rgyal zhes/ /gsang mtshan badz+ra dhe wa shu la zhes/ /ku mud mdog can zhi 'dzum ber dkar gsol/ /dar mdung nor bu bsgrengs shing mkha' la bskyod/

/ngang dkar shugs ldan bya lam 'gros chen chibs/ /spyan 'dren 'dir gshegs bsang mchod 'di bzhes la/ /smon lam dge bcu sgrub pa'i sdong grogs mdzod/ /yul du nad mug mtshon gyi bskal pa zhi/ /lo legs nor phyugs 'phel bar lha gsol lo/ /mi nor mnga' thang 'phel bar lha gsol lo/ /chos bzhin sgrub la chos min bstan dgra sgrol/ /yar tshes bzhin du skyid pa'i lha bsangs so/ /zo dor mi 'bral grib bzhin 'grogs par shog kyai/ 'dzam gling dbyi shod 'bru nor dbyig gter dbus/ /rnam lnga'i tshon ldan legs bkra rgyas pa'i ljongs/ /dmag dpon chen po gnas po 'dzi rgyal zhes/ /gsang mtshan dbang sdud dpa' bo rdo rje ni/ /char sprin mdog can dar nag 'jo ber gsol/ /dgra satwa dang ni zhags pa spring spring 'khyug /rdzu 'phrul gyi ling rlung gi shugs can chibs/ /spyan 'dren 'dir gshegs bsang mchod 'di bzhes la/ /smon lam dge bcu sgrub pa'i sdong grogs mdzod/ /yul du nad mug mtshon gyi bskal pa zhi/ /lo legs nor phyugs 'phel bar lha gsol lo/ /mi nor mnga' thang 'phel bar lha gsol lo/ /chos bzhin sgrub la chos min bstan dgra sgrol/ /yar tshes bzhin du skyid pa'i lha bsangs so/ /zo dor mi 'bral grib bzhin 'grogs par shog kyai/ gangs can yul gyi gaṅgā rgyas pa'i dal/ /rba rlabs sngo nag yam yom 'phyo dbus su/ /rgyal ba'i bstan srung klu yi dge bsnyen zhes/ /sku mdog dud kha ha la rgyas pa'i gzugs/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis srin po rol pa'i stabs/ /spyan gsum dmar zlum zhal gdang mche ba gtsigs/ /ljags 'dril zhal dbus drag po'i mig gis brgyan/ /ma he'i gdong can sbrul zhags nad rkyal thogs/ /dur khrod chas ldan sbrul nag mjug ma 'khyug /spyan 'dren 'dir gshegs bsang mchod 'di bzhes la/ /smon lam dge bcu sgrub pa'i sdong grogs mdzod/ /yul du nad mug mtshon gyi bskal pa zhi/

/lo legs nor phyugs 'phel bar lha gsol lo/ /mi nor mnga' thang 'phel bar lha gsol lo/ /chos bzhin sgrub la chos min bstan dgra sgrol/ /yar tshes bzhin du skyid pa'i lha bsangs so/ /zo dor mi 'bral grib bzhin 'grogs par shog /ces pa 'di yang ngag dbang kun bzang rang grol kyis bskul ngor rig 'dzin hūm̐ nag drag rtsal gyis sbyar ba bkra shis par gyur cig/ // jo bo smon skyes gangs zhur gyi bsang mchod bzhugs so// // kyai/ phyogs phyogs de ni pha ki na/ /nyi ma byang phyogs pha ki na/ /nam mkha'i de ni dpangs re mtho/ /sa gzhi de ni rgya re che/ /nyi zla de ni 'od re gsal/ /sprin dang na bun yol 'khrigs dbus/ /gangs dkar smon skyes lhang lhang ni/ /rgyal ba yongs kyi pho brang che/ /rig 'dzin yongs kyi sgrub pa'i gnas/ /ma dang mkha' 'gro 'du ba yi/ /chos skyong drag po'i pho brang na/ /jo bo shel gur ti se gangs/ /steng na g.yu 'brug khra la la/ /bar na glog dmar skems se skem/ /phyogs su khu 'phang ya la la/ /dpal 'bar ri chen rtse gsum 'di/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag pho brang tshang*/ /shar phyogs rgyal po gdan bzhugs 'dra/ /lho phyogs seṅge gnam mchong 'dra/ /nub phyogs mchod rten bum pa 'dra/ /byang phyogs rin chen 'bar ba 'dra/ /lha yi khrus chu phyogs mtshams 'bab/ /mtsho rnams maṇ+ḍal bshams pa 'dra/ /ri rnams rgyal blon 'dus pa 'dra/ /brag ri mtshon thogs khrab chen 'dra/ /spang ri g.yu gur phub pa 'dra/ /ri brag rin chen spungs pa 'dra/ /de 'dra'i pho brang chen po ru/ /rin po che yi khri steng na/ /bzhugs pa de ni lha yi bu/ /yab ni gnam rje rgyal po la/ /yum ni klu gza' 'od sman gnyis/ /sras ni ming sring mched bzhi byon/ /che ba klu rje 'od 'bar ni/ /rdo rje 'bar ba dbang grags rtsal/ /sku mdog gangs la nyi shar 'dra/ /dbu la prog zhu smug po gsol/ /mdzes pa'i me long zur phud can/

/sku la dung khrab dung ber gsol/ /g.yas na nyi zla 'bar ba 'dzin/ /g.yon na mdung dar dkar po phyar/ /dung rta g.yu rngog chibs su chib/ /steng na khyung dang g.yas su seng*/ /g.yon na thang dkar skya khra 'jums/ /lha dmag 'bum bcas bswo sgra sgrogs/ /'dir byon bsang mchod 'dod yon bzhes/ /bdag gi rgyab rten sdong grogs mdzod/ /'bring ba gnam lha byang chub ni/ /rdo rje 'bar ba dbang phyug rtsal/ /sku mdog shel 'od dkar po la/ /dar dkar la thod g.yu zur can/ /mdung dar dkar po phyag na 'dzin/ /gro smug gdong se chibs su chib/ /dung gi thang dkar klad na lding*/ /g.yu 'brug sngon mo g.yas na sgrog /dung khra dkar po g.yon na 'dzum/ /drag po gnyan dmag 'bum dang bcas/ /'dir byon bsang mchod 'di bzhes la/ /bdag gi rgyab rten sdong grogs mdzod/ /chung ba rdo rje dpal brtsegs ni/ /rdo rje 'bar ba dpal 'bar rtsal/ /sku mdog ser po gser gyi mdog /man+t+ri thod la gser khrab brjid/ /ral gri phyar zhing mdung dar bsgrengs/ /stag ral gzig shubs go mtshon thogs/ /rkyang bu kha dkar chibs su chib/ /dung gi khrung khrung klad na lding*/ /dung khyi g.yas la bya khra g.yon/ /sngon po klu dmag 'bum dang bcas/ /'dir byon bsang mchod 'dod yon bzhes/ /bdag gi rgyab rten sdong grogs mdzod/ /sring mo lha lcam glog ma 'phrul/ /sku mdog dkar mo bzhin mdzes ma/ /'od glog tshwa tshwa skar ltar 'khrugs/ /gser g.yu mu tig dbu la brgyan/ /'od zer dang ni 'ja' tshon 'khyug /mda' dar tshe bum phyag na bsnams/ /gnam rta gyi ling chibs su chib/ khu byug co ga ne tso mdzes/ /pho nya sman phran 'bum gyis bskor/ /gling bu gsung snyan me long gsal/ /'dir byon bsang mchod 'dod yon bzhes/ /bdag gi rgyab rten sdong grogs mdzod/ /g.yu mtsho bkra shis 'khyil pa nas/ /thabs kyi yum chen mtsho sman gnyis/ /dkar mo 'dzum mdangs lang tsho rgyas/

/shel ri rin chen gser g.yus brgyan/ /dar dkar na bza' 'ja' tshon 'phro/ /shel dang nor bu'i bum pa 'dzin/ /chu rta chibs nas sman phran 'bum/ /ngar ngur khrung khrung skad snyan sgrogs/ /rin chen char 'bebs rma g.yang stsol/ /'dir byon bsang mchod 'dod yon bzhes/ /bdag gi rgyab rten sdong grogs mdzod/ /g.yas kyi de ni mda' ra ba/ /dpa' bo mgur bzang stag rtse ni/ /stag gi la thod g.yu khrab rngam/ /stag ral gzig shubs go mtshon brgyan/ /mdung dar lce brgyad g.yas na phyar/ /gnam lcags thogs mda' g.yon nas 'phen/ /chibs su khra bo stag chas chibs/ /drag shul klu dmag 'bum dang bcas/ /'dir byon bsang mchod 'dod yon bzhes/ /bdag gi rgyab rten sdong grogs mdzod/ /g.yon gyi de ni mdung ra ba/ /dbyin dmar pa ta spo lo dmar/ /dbang gi la thod dbu la bcings/ /bswe khrab rgya stag slog pa gsol/ /dgra lha'i go mtshon sna dgus brgyan/ /ral gri phyar zhing mdung zhags 'khyug /rag pa stag lag chibs su chib/ /lcags kyi go shub 'khyil pa 'gyed/ /'dir byon bsang mchod 'dod yon bzhes/ /bdag gi rgyab rten sdong grogs mdzod/ /gshin rje de ni dmar ze ni/ /zangs glang rta dmar chibs su chib/ khram bam 'debs shing mi ro shad/ /'dir byon bsang mchod 'dod yon bzhes/ /bdag gi rgyab rten sdong grogs mdzod/ /brag nag so phyar mi rta nag /dug gi sog le bdud zhags mdung*/ /rta nag chibs nas dmag khrom sdud/ /'dir byon bsang mchod 'dod yon bzhes/ /bdag gi rgyab rten sdong grogs mdzod/ /rgya sras gu rna rta la chibs/ /shel gyi ba dan 'gying dkar 'dzin/ /'dir byon bsang mchod 'dod yon bzhes/ /bdag gi rgyab rten sdong grogs mdzod/ /drag po ye phywa btsan rgod bsangs/ /las mkhan ha sha pho rog nag /dgyes pa'i ngang pa mtsho mgo sogs/ /jo chen jo chung sman phran rnams/ /'dir byon bsang mchod 'dod yon bzhes/

/bdag gi rgyab rten sdong grogs mdzod/ /las mkhan mun pa nag po ni/ /shan pa 'bum gyi 'khor dang bcas/ /'dir byon bsang mchod 'dod yon bzhes/ /bdag gi rgyab rten sdong grogs mdzod/ /btsan rgod srog bdag shwa ri ni/ /srog bdag lag dmar 'bum dang bcas/ /'dir byon bsang mchod 'di bzhes la/ /bdag gi rgyab rten sdong grogs mdzod/ /pho nya bre gu dkar sgron bsangs/ /gnyan po chu mig mgo dgu bsangs/ /gnas mchog phag mo'i klu mkhar bsangs/ /lha chen dbang phyug chen po bsangs/ /so pha skya rengs des khri bsangs/ /rgyal sras ri rgyal dbang phyug bsangs/ /sgo srung stag g.yag rngam pa bsangs/ /sgo khyi 'phar dred gzig gsum bsangs/ /sras mchog mo nom mched brgyad bsangs/ /btsun mo ri 'phar che chung bsangs/ /lcags kyi go pha mched dgu bsangs/ /dgra bo'i gnas brtan bla mtsho bsangs/ /lha rje g.yang mkhan sa mkhan bsangs/ /gser dngul gser mdzod go mdzod bsangs/ /chos khri gser gdong 'od 'bar bsangs/ /chos srid pad+ma 'byung gnas bsangs/ /rang byon rta phag byams pa bsangs/ /brag la gnas brtan rang byon bsangs/ /srib ri mgon po rang byon bsangs/ /rje btsun sgrol ma dkar sngon bsangs/ /sgrol ma nyi shu rtsa gcig bsangs/ /mi la ras pa brgyad cu bsangs/ /phyag rdor bya khyung rang byon bsangs/ /phyogs bzhir gu ru'i sgrub khang bsangs/ /dung mtsho dkar mo zla 'khyil bsangs/ /brag nag mkha' 'gro 'bum thil bsangs/ /dmar nag rak+ta'i bla mtsho bsangs/ /mgon po lha mo'i bla mtsho bsangs/ /g.yu mtsho mthing mtsho gser mtsho bsangs/ /nyi ma skar ma'i bla mtsho bsangs/ /klu rgyal mtsho dang lha sman mtsho/ /zhing skyong mgar nag bla mtsho bsangs/ /lcong mo pho brang gsang mtsho bsangs/ /lci yi brag nag bdud rdzong bsangs/ /ljig gi sku khyim bdud btsan bsangs/ /dred rong phu mda'i gnas bdag bsangs/ /dbyi shod dbyi rgyal rog chen bsangs/ /lho yi spe ne ri bkra bsangs/

/nub kyi kaḥrgyal mo nom bsangs/ /byang gi ske rgyal ne bro bsangs/ /bla mchod spu rgyal gangs dkar bsangs/ /phu bo gangs dkar ti se bsangs/ /pha zhang gnyan chen thang lha bsangs/ /bdag zhang tsā ri rtswa khang bsangs/ /shar gyi rma rgyal spom ra bsangs/ /mdo khams sku rgyal rtse dgu bsangs/ /ngom rgyal mtsho bkra 'khor bcas bsangs/ /mkhar nag rgyal po 'khor bcas bsangs/ /rgyal chen bco brgyad 'khor bcas bsangs/ /rgyal phran stong gi dmag tshogs bsangs/ /dbyar dgun ston dpyid gnas pa bsangs/ /ban bon srung ma thams cad bsangs/ /'jig rten lha 'dre'i tshogs rnams bsangs/ kyai/ jo bo gze rgyal 'khor bcas la/ /dgyes pa'i mthun rdzas mchod pa dang*/ /gtor ma sha khrag gser skyems phud/ /'bru sna dar tshon spos kyi dud/ /bsang gsur 'cham dbyangs rol mo bcas/ /sba dkar tshig gsum g.yu me long*/ /rin chen mu tig stag gzig ras/ /ba dan lce brgyad rnga thug dkar/ /'bras kyi g.yag lug ra gsum dang*/ /lug snying mkhar thab phye mar gtor/ /ja chang 'o zho bdud rtsi dang*/ /shing thog dkar dmar sna tshogs rigs/ /'khor dang bcas pas dgyes gyur cig /yul phyogs bkra shis bde skyid ldan/ /mi nor zas gsum longs spyod dar/ /nad yams lo nyes god kha zlog /rta nor lug gsum phyugs sgab spel/ /gtsug lag chos sde'i srung ma mdzod/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i phrin las rgyas/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i sku tshe srings/ /bsam don yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod/ /bu slob chos brgyud bstan pa dar/ /bsu skyel sdong grogs las bzhi mdzod/ /bsam don ngan pa'i dgra bo sod/ /mthu gtad byad kha dgra la phob/ /chos dgra bon gyi srog rtsa chod/ /lag dmar jag pa dgra la rgyugs/ /'dre khrom dgra bo'i yul du drongs/ /'dre gdon chag sgo dgra sgab phud/ /drag rtsal rbad do mthu ma chung*/ /bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ ces rig 'dzin sngags 'chang bde chen rdo rjes jo bo gze rgyal gyi bsang mchod 'khyer bde ru bris pas gang bcol phrin las myur du 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig

/maṅga laṃ/ dge'o// // jo bo gze rgyal gyi bsang mchod dngos grub char 'bebs bzhugs so// // hrīḥ rang nyid thugs rje chen po gsal ba yi/ /mdun du rin chen sna tshogs las grub pa/ /byin chags ya mtshan shel gyi pho brang dbus/ /rag dkar g.yu rngog sga srab chas mdzes steng*/ /lha yi btsan rgod rdo rje 'bar ba ni/ /sku mdog dkar gsal 'od stong zhi ma khro/ /sku la shel khrab dbu la shel rmog gsol/ /phyag g.yas mdung dar g.yon pas srab skyog bsgyur/ /chibs su lha rta myur mgyogs rag dkar chibs/ /spyan 'dren 'dir gshegs bsang mchod 'di bzhes la/ /smon lam dge bcu sgrub pa'i sdong grogs mdzod/ kyai/ de yi 'khor du dreg pa las byed ni/ /srog bdag shwa ra gnod sbyin mgul bzang dang*/ /a mye mu khri gnyan chen thang lha dang*/ /dregs chen bco brgyad mgul lha bcu gsum dang*/ /brtan ma bcu gnyis dge bsnyen nyer gcig dang*/ /bod yul 'dir gnas lha klu gzhi bdag la/ /bsang mchod 'dod yon rnam lnga 'di 'bul lo/ /bzhes nas rnal 'byor dpon slob 'khor bcas la/ /tshe bsod dpal 'byor mnga' thang rgyas pa dang*/ /gar 'gro gar 'dug gzhi byis lam gsum du/ /lus dang grib ma bzhin du ma 'bral ba/ kha 'dzin sdong grogs dpung gnyen rgyab rten dang*/ /'dod pa'i don dgu yid la gang bsam mdzod/ ces snang lam la jo bo gze rgyal dngos su zhal bstan pa ltar du bsang mchod 'di dag rten 'brel che bar sems nas gel thung sgar du shar mar bris// // jo bo gze rgyal sogs yul lha'i bsang bsdus ni/ kyai/ jo bo gze rgyal la sogs pa'i/ /'dir gnas yul lha gzhi bdag la/ /dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis sprul/ /mchod pa rgya che sna tshogs 'bul/ /dgyes par bzhes nas tshim gyur cig /rnal 'byor bdag gi bka' nyan cing*/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba dang*/ /sems can kun la phan byed cing*/ /'gal rkyen bar chad sel ba dang*/

/bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ ces zhwa dmar drug pa'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa'o// // ༈ gze rgyal bsang mchod phan bde'i dpal 'byor rta bdun rgyal po bzhugs so// // hrīḥ kun bzang pad 'byung chos sku'i rang mdangs las/ /ma 'gags sprul pa'i gangs ri gnas chen stong*/ /bod yul smag rum gsal mdzad yon tan sprul/ /gze rgyal gnas mchog gangs kyi rwa bar grags/ /phyi ltar gangs ri rgyal po gdan bzhugs 'dra/ /gsang ltar pha rol dgra la dmag chas 'dra/ /nang ltar mtshan nyid kun ldan rgyal srid bdun/ /de 'dra pho brang gnas 'dzin gze yi rgyal/ /lha klu gnod sbyin kun gyi mnga' dbang bsgyur/ /'dzam gling dregs pa'i mnga' bdag kun las rgyal/ /smon skyes gangs zhur mched gsum 'khor bcas rnams/ /'dir gshegs bsang mchod gser skyems 'di bzhes la/ /'dzam gling kun tu bkra shis bde legs stsol/ /mtha' dmag mi mthun dgra jag chom rkun zlog /bcol ba'i phrin las ma lus 'grub par mdzod/ ces pa gze gzhung 'brong pa dpon tshang gi sbra nang du gze rgyal zhal gzigs dang 'ja' tshon gur phub pa la sogs te ngo mtshar can byung skabs rig 'dzin mi 'jigs rdo rjes sbyar ba dge'o// // ༈ mtsho dkar gyi bsang ni/ hrī bh+yoḥ tshe yi lha mo brtan ma zla rgyas ma/ /lha sman rigs bzhi mtsho bdag 'khor dang bcas/ /slob dpon bstan srung rnal 'byor tshe bsring phyir/ /spyan 'dren gnas 'dir rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis byon/ /phyi nang gsang ba bsang gtor dkar mngar bzhes/ /sgrub pa'i sde skyong chos srid dpal bskyed la/ /'dod rgu ya mtshan dngos grub mchog stsol cig /sarba pū dza me gha ye swā hā/ i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ dmar nag rak+ta'i bsang mchod ni/ hūm̐ bh+yoḥ gru gsum chos 'byung dmar nag rak+ta'i klong*/ /mi ro rta ro gcal bkram gzhal yas dang*/ /bhan+dha smug po sku mkhar 'bar ba'i klong*/

/pad+ma nyi zla baṃ ro'i gdan steng du/ /e ka dzā ṭi mche gcig spyan gcig dmar/ /ral gcig nu gcig gshog gcig rkang pa gcig /ral gri snying 'dzin me rlung nang na gnas/ /yang 'khor ma mo bye ba 'bum gyis bskor/ /'dir gshegs bsang dang zhi ba'i mchod pa 'bul/ /bdag cag pha rol g.yul las rgyal ba dang*/ /byad dang rbod gtong nyer 'tshe tshar bcad nas/ /rnal 'byor gang bsam 'di phyi gong 'phel mdzod/ ces pa'ang rig 'dzin chen po khyab bdag bde chen rdo rje'i gnas yig nas khol du phyung ste phrin las bcol ba sh+lau ka ār+ya'i ming gis zla1tshes19dge bar snying nas dus kyi 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal zhi phyir rnam bkra dag pas brtse gdung rdo rje'i dad shugs kyis sbyar ba dge legs 'phel// // ༈ srung 'dzugs thabs bzhugs so// // kyai/ skyes pa pho yi phywa g.yang de/ /gser gyi ka ba'i steng du glan/ /mi 'gyur sa yi rten du 'dzugs/ /za ma mo yi phywa g.yang de/ /g.yu yi gdung ma'i steng du glan/ /mi 'chag sa yi srung du 'dzugs/ khang khyim bkra shis phywa g.yang de/ khyim chen 'di yi mdzod du 'dzugs/ /mi zad gter la spyod par shog /bshol zhing lo ma'i phywa g.yang de/ /zhing lha tshangs pa'i dkyil du 'dzugs/ /lo 'bras smin pa'i srung du 'dzugs/ /rkang bzhi nor gyi phywa g.yang de/ /rta nor lug gsum g.yang du len/ /rkang bzhi spel ba'i srung du 'dzugs/ /tshe srog brtan pa'i phywa g.yang de/ /tshe bum 'di yi nang du glan/ /tshe srog brtan pa'i srung du 'dzugs/ kyai/ khyim lha khyim gyi dkyil du bzhugs/ /'dre gdon phud la sbra khang zungs/ /thab lha thab kyi gong du bzhugs/ /mar khu'i mtsho mo 'khyil bar shog /'phrag lha phrag pa'i gong du bzhugs/ /bu khyim skyid la rdzi bo mdzod/ /tshe lha srog gi rtsa bar bzhugs/ /mi srog lcags las sra bar shog /phyogs bzhir sgo yi phywa g.yang de/ /sgo gdong g.yas dang g.yon du glan/

/sgo gdong g.yas su srung byed pa/ /rgya stag khra bo rngam zhing ngar/ /sgo gdong g.yon du srung byed pa/ /shel g.yag 'gying zhing ngar lhab byed/ /g.yang chen sgo ru ma 'bud cig /'dre ngan nang du ma gtong zhig /nang mi phyi la ma gtong zhig /phyi mi nang la ma gtong zhig /g.yang ye gnyan po da sdoms shig /phye mar la/ kyai/ phye mar phud la phyugs g.yang yod/ /phye mar phud la nor g.yang yod/ /phye mar phud la btsan g.yang yod/ /yon bdag spyi bo'i gtsug tu blugs/ /bo zag med pa rgya mtsho phyug mo bzhin/ /ma rul ma skam dpag bsam ljon shing bzhin/ /dar ba gnyen gyi g.yang len no/ /drag po btsan gyi g.yang len no/ /srog lha de yi nyams dga' ba/ /lcags kyi bya khra sngon po bdun/ /mgo spyi bo'i gtsug tu g.yang phob cig /g.yang chu thig rgyal po lan tshwa yin/ /rtsi thog rgyal po mar dkar yin/ /me tog snying po sbrang rtsi bzhin/ /sngags 'chang rgyal pos smon lam btab/ /seṅge dkar mo'i 'o ma gcig /g.yu 'brug sngon mo'i kha phru gnyis/ /bdud a tsa ra yi snying khrag gsum/ /g.yang chang yon tan kun dang ldan/ /g.yang rgya mtsho bzhin du rgyas par shog /yon bdag smon lam mtha' rgyas shog /snod bcud kyi phywa g.yang thams cad yon bdag la thim par bsam/ dge'o// // de nas yang phye mar g.yang skyabs la bkus la 'di skad do/ kyai/ mgo nag mi yi phywa longs la/ /dud 'gro kun gyi phywa khug cig /g.yang la g.yang 'phel gnag gis gang*/ /g.yang la g.yang 'phel lug gis gang*/ /g.yang la g.yang 'phel rta yis gang*/ /g.yang la g.yang 'phel bong bus gang*/ /g.yang la g.yang 'phel phyugs kyis gang*/ khyim la g.yang 'phel mi yis gang*/ /bang mdzod g.yang 'phel 'bru yis gang*/ /rwa ba g.yang 'phel ra yis gang*/ /de ltar bdag la stsal du gsol/ /de ring hu ye hu ldan no/ /de ring phywa ye phywa ye phywa ldan no/ de nas dkyil kar la bku'o/ kyai/ da ni khyim lha g.yang du len/

/pha ni spyi lha gang po yin/ /ma ni spyi gtsug rgyal mo yin/ /bu ni khyim lha gel thung yin/ /gser gyi ka ba ma 'bud cig /g.yu yi gdung ma ma 'chag cig /'thing bu lhog lhog ma byed cig /pha ru g.yu sbrang ma zhen cig /dbyar gsum sbra la thog ma lhung*/ /dgun gsum gur la me ma shor/ /dung gi bya lag ma 'thor cig /dngul gyi chon thag ma chad cig khyim lha phywa dang g.yang du len/ /de ring hu ye hu ldan no/ /de ring phywa ye phywa ldan no/ de nas sgo la bku'o/ kyai/ phyi sgo phye ba'i nang shed nas/ /rin chen gser gyi mi bo che/ /gser gyi sba mkhar phyag na bsnams/ /nang sgo phyug mo bya ba ni/ /lcags kyi rten mkhar phyag na bsnams/ /phyi mi skya bo nang du ma gtong zhig /nang mi smug mo sgo la ma 'bud cig /lha lug thang la ma 'bud cig /srid kyi glang chen ngan la ma gtong zhig /de ring hu ye hu ldan no/ /de ring phywa ye phywa ldan no/ de nas thab tu btab la/ kyai/ pha ni btsan la phur bu dang*/ /ma ni byams ldan btsun mo yin/ /bu ni thab lha rog po yin/ /sgyed pu gsum po sku gsung thugs/ /me ni 'byung ba'i dwangs ma drod/ /snod gcig btsugs pa gzhal yas khang*/ /'dod rgu g.yang gi zas dang ldan/ /de ring thab lha g.yang du len/ /de ring hu ye hu ldan no/ /de ring phywa ye phywa ldan no/ de nas sgam sgro nang du blugs la/ kyai/ de ring zas brgya phar gtong yang*/ /sang nyin zas stong tshur la shog /brtsegs pa'i ri bo ma nyil cig /bskyil ba'i mtsho mo ma 'bo zhig /zad med gter la spyod par shog /bag ma tshur phyin pa'i kha la blug par bya/ phar 'gro mi blug go kyai/ skyid pa'i zas mchog phye mar 'di/ /rigs bzang lha yi

bu'am bu mor sbyin/ dkon mchog gsum gyi thugs rje yi/ /lo brgya thub pa'i smon lam dang*/ /ston brgya mthong ba'i smon lam zhu/ /bde skyid dpal la spyod par shog /de nas phyi mi rnams la byin la 'di skad do/ kyai/ de ring zas mchog phye mar 'di/ khyod gzhan ma rnams la byin pa'i tshe/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang*/ chos skyong srung mas zas kyi bcud g.yang phob/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi nus stobs ma nyams shig /mi pho'i dpa' rtsal g.yang rten ma nyams shig /rnal 'byor bdag gi g.yang rten ma 'gul cig /mi pho khyed rnams kha 'phro ma zhen cig /rgyal lo rgyal lo lha rgyal lo/ rnal 'byor rang dang yon bdag gi zas g.yang mi nyams pa'i don la pad+ma'i yang sprul hūm̐ nag me 'bar gyis mdzad pa'o// // bsang gsol kyi skabs su yul ris bye brag pa'i gzhi bdag la bsngo ba'i gsur mchod ni/ kyai/ bdag cag 'dug pa'i sa cha yul ris 'di la gnas pa'i gzhi'i bdag po cha3lt;!TCC Tibetan character 3,148 undefined in unicode!>ཻ mo gang 'dod ming smros la/ de la sogs pa yul phyogs 'di'i gzhi bdag che phra thams cad dang*/ gzhan yang 'dug phyogs 'di'i sra ba brag la gnas pa/ brtan pa pha bong dang rdo la gnas pa/ mtho ba gangs ri dang spang ri sogs ri la gnas pa/ dma' ba gshong dang gzhung du gnas pa/ skye ba shing dang rtsi thog la gnas pa/ 'khyil pa mtsho dang mtshe'u la gnas pa/ 'bab pa chu mig dang chu klung la gnas pa/ brtan pa sa dang gnas khang la gnas pa/ lha rten dang sbas gnas gter gnas la gnas pa/ byin rlabs can gyi gnas dang gnyan dmigs la gnas pa/ ne'u seng dang skyed tshal rdzing bu sogs gnas sna tshogs la gnas pa/ pha ri dang g.yas la gnas pa/ tshur ri dang g.yon la gnas pa/ mdun rgyab nyin srib kyi phyogs su gnas pa/ mtho nam mkha' la gnas pa/ dma' sa gzhi la gnas pa/ bar bar snang du gnas pa/ 'bar ba me dang g.yo ba rlung la gnas pa/ phyugs lhas dang lam srang la gnas pa/

dur khrod dang 'brog stong la gnas pa/ gtsug lag khang dang mchod rten la gnas pa/ tshong 'dus sogs skye bo'i 'du gnas su gnas pa/ phug dang yang dben du gnas pa sogs che ba yul khams nas chung ba rdul phra mo'i bar gyi 'byung ba'i khams dang*/ steng 'og phyogs mtshams la gnas pa'i lha klu gnyan btsan bdud dang srin po rgyal po gza' dmu ma mo the'u brang sogs sde tshan sna tshogs kyi rigs su gtogs pa/ gnyug mar gnas dang glo bur lhags pa/ rje dang bran/ pho dang mo/ gnyen dang mdza' bo/ rgan pa dang gzhon nu che ba dang chung sogs sna tshogs kyi tshul du snang ba/ las sna tshogs byed pa/ rdzu bag sna tshogs ston pa/ gzugs sna tshogs 'chang ba/ bde sdug sna tshogs myong ba/ srid pa las kyi snang bas bslus pa'i mi ma yin ji snyed par phyogs 'dir 'khod pa/ gcig kyang ma lus pa thams cad la bdud rtsi bsang gi dud sprin/ dkar mngar 'dod rgu'i gtor ma/ ja chang 'o zho'i skyems phud/ dar mtshon bal mtshon gyi phreng ba sna tshogs mthun rdzas kyi mchod pa/ 'dod yon mi zad nam mkha' mdzod kyi 'khor lo 'dis khyed rnams so so'i ci 'dod pa pham rgyal phyogs lhung med par mnyam pa nyid du thob nas re ba yongs rdzogs shing dgyes mnyes mgu ste rab tu tshim par gyur cig /sdug bsngal thams cad dang bral ba'i bde ba la rtag tu gnas par gyur cig /phog thug 'gram 'khrug gi nyes pa zhi bar gyur cig /ko long gdug rtsub kyi sems dul bar gyur cig /'dir gnas pa thams cad la phan tshun pha ma bu tsha'i tshul du byams par mdzod cig /gnas mgron gyi dam tshig zungs shig /'gal rkyen las srungs shig /mthun rkyen spel cig /'dod don sgrubs shig /bcol ba'i las gyis shig /bkra shis dge mtshan dang mi nor mnga' thang rgyas par mdzod cig khyed cag skye ba kun tu bdag cag rnams la chos dang mthun pa'i grogs su 'gyur zhing byang chub kyi spyod pa spyad nas 'og min dag pa'i zhing du tshom bu gcig tu sangs rgyas par gyur cig

/sa sprel zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes 4la dhī ming pas bris pa dge'o// // rang lugs bsang mchod phyogs bsgrigs 'khor 'das mgron bzhi dgyes pa'i mchod sprin zhes bya ba 'di'ang gar dbang gnam lcags rdo rje'i ring lugs 'dzin pa'i skal ldan ser skya pho mo rnams la sku gnyis 'bras bu'i nyi ma mgron du 'gugs pa'i pho nya tshogs bsags sbyin pa'i skya rengs lha bsang phyogs bsgrigs gyis zhes rang slob 'brong bla karma longs spyod kyis yang yang bskul ngo ma ldog tsam sprang smyon gsang sngags bstan 'dzin nam rab btags sgo chen sprul ming pas rab rgyan chu rta'i smyos byed zla ba'i yar tshes bzang por grub par bgyis pa glog klad 'phrul gyi do rar lcug phran sor mo'i gar pa o rgyan gsang sngags kyis bgyis pa sa 'gro kun tshogs gnyis rdzogs nas sku gnyis thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ // ༈ gsum pa g.yang khrus rab gnas sogs nyer mkho'i skor la/ bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las: bstan skyong yul gyi cho ga bde legs kun 'byung bzhugs so: rig 'dzin pad+ma thod phreng rtsal la 'dud: sa ma ya: de yang bstan ma bskyed pa ni: sa yi lha mo ltar sgrub pa ni spyi khog dkyil 'khor mkha' 'gro'i gzhung la 'jug pa'i phyir: mchod phreng bsham tshogs las rim gyi don ltar las: slar yang mchod pa gcig kha gsos nas: om̐ swa bhā wa sogs? stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che sna tshogs kyi snod du rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa las byung ba'i mchod rdzas phun sum tshogs pa nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par gyur: om̐ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs? de nas rten bskyed pa ni: stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid pad+ma thod phreng rtsal du gsal ba'i mdun du rin chen gzhal yas khang phyi nang mtshan nyid rdzogs pa'i dbus su ri rab lhun po bang rim gsum pa'i steng du bh+rūm̐ las sa yi lha mo bstan ma sku mdog dmar ser zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma:

sku la rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas spras pa dar tshon sna lnga'i cod pan 'phur ba stod g.yogs dang ang rag bklubs pa phyag g.yas yid bzhin nor bu dang : g.yon bum pa 'dod yon sna lnga'i bcud kyis bkang ba bsnams pa: rgyan dang cha lugs phun sum tshogs shing glang po che sa la rab brtan la zhon pa: de'i phyi rol bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma bcu gnyis te snang srid kyi bdag mo rdo rje kun grags ma mthing nag drel rta rkang gsum la bzhon nas be con dang rgyu zhags thogs te g.yang gzhi dang re lde gsol ba ya bdud kyi bu mo: dpal ldan ha ri rdo rje g.ya' ma skyong ser nag chu glang la bzhon nas khram shing shwa rdel thogs te mi lpags gsol ba ma bdud gshin rje'i bu mo: gangs dkar sha med rdo rje kun bzang ma dmar nag dre'u nag po la bzhon nas phyag na thog ser gyi sgrom bu 'dzin cing bar bdud kyi bu mo: 'brog chen 'khor 'dus rdo rje bgegs kyi gtso mo ljang nag ba dan dang nad rkyal thogs nas rnga mong zhon cing g.yang gzhi dang mgo phreng gis brgyan pa bdud kyi bu mo: gangs kyi yum chen rdo rje g.yu bun ma sngo skya phyag na mda' dar dang shel bum thogs nas chu dar sngon po gsol zhing g.yu 'brug la zhon pa gshin rje dha sha dhe ha'i bu mo: kha rag khyung btsun rdo rje dpal yum ma sku mdog dmar mo phyag na pad+ma dang sgrom bu bsnams te dar dmar gsol nas chu rta la zhon pa dgra lha'i bu mo: gser chen mkha' lding rdo rje klu mo dung skyong sku mdog smug nag phyag na lcags kyu dang zhags pa 'dzin cing rin po ches brgyan te bya khyung la zhon pa dzi na mi tra'i bu mo: rma ri rab 'byams rdo rje drag mo rgyal sku mdog dmar smug g.yas thod dbyug dang g.yon bhan+dha bsnams te dar nag gsol nas stag la zhon pa yak+sha spyan gcig gi bu mo: kong btsun de mo rdo rje bod khams skyong dkar mo g.yas mda' dar dang g.yon gter sgrom bsnams te rin po che'i rgyan dang dar dkar gsol nas gser sha yu mo la chibs pa gnam lha skos rje'i bu mo:

btsan la rol pa'i rdo rje sman gcig ma dmar mo phyag na 'khor lo dang bhan+dha thogs shing dar dmar gyi ral ga gsol te rta dmar la zhon pa ya ba skya gcig gi bu mo: sman btsun ug chos rdo rje g.yar mo sil sngon mo nor bu dang rgyal mtshan thogs pa rin po che du mas spras shing cod pan lha rdzas bklubs te drel rta sngon po la zhon pa gtsug na 'od 'bar gyi bu mo: g.yu'i dril bu rdo rje si le ma ljang mo rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa dar dmar gsol nas g.yag dkar la zhon pa spyi bdud rgyal mo'i bu mo: de thams cad rgyan rin po che sna tshogs zhi ba'i cha lugs drag mo thams cad khro gnyer chas te rgyan dang phyag mtshan ma nges du mar ldan pa bkrag mdangs gzi brjid 'od du 'bar zhing rgyas pa: gzhan yang sprul pa nyid sprul sogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba gsal bar gyur: de las 'od zer 'phros pas skad cig sngon tshe slob dpon pad+ma'i bka' bzhin bdag cag sgrub pa po'i g.yar dam skyong ba'i slad du gnas 'dir spyan drangs: om̐ bhū mi ma ma ting ting shag shag le le dza dzaḥ de nas spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: sngon tshe slob dpon pad+ma dang : slob ma rlangs chen dpal seng dang : mthu chen sangs rgyas ye shes kyis: ru tra bsgral ba'i zhing gdan du: bka' bsgos bro bor dam bcas bzhin: sangs rgyas bstan pa skyong ba dang : gsang sngags dam chos spel ba'i phyir: ma sring brtan ma'i tshogs bcas rnams: ma thog gnas 'dir spyan 'dren no: hūm̐: dgung sngon dbyings dang rang bzhin gnas: gangs ri g.ya' spang mtsho dang nags: spang ljongs ne'u seng chu klung sogs: ri rab rol mtsho gar gnas kyang : gnas 'dir spyan 'dren da tshur byon: brtan ma'i tshogs rnams spyan 'dren no: sa yi lha mo gshegs su gsol: ri rab rol mtsho'i dbang mo che: gter bdag lha mo gshegs su gsol: brtan ma bcu gnyis gshegs su gsol: skyong ma bcu gnyis gshegs su gsol:

ya ma bcu gnyis gshegs su gsol: sman phran 'bum sde gshegs su gsol: om̐ badz+ra s+d+ya bi ra pa ti kal pi ta ma ma ting ting shag shag le le tiṣ+ṭha pā la sa mā ya dza dzaḥ bzhugs gsol mchod pa 'bul ba ni: skad cig gis spyan drangs pa'i dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa dbyer med du gyur: om̐ pad+ma ka ma la ye satwaṃ: hūm̐: bod skyong brtan ma yang dag sman: rang rang dgyes pa'i gdan la bzhugs: bod khams bde legs mdzad pa'i phyir: rtag chags brtan par bzhugs su gsol: sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha satwaṃ: gser skyems dang 'bru sna mchod cing : hūm̐: gling bzhi ri rab zom shed dang : rol mtsho gser ri mu khyud du: 'khor zhing rang bzhin gnas pa dang : khyad par sa 'dzin dbang mo bcas: bstan pa srung ba'i ma sring la: rin chen phud dang gser skyems 'bul: sa bdag lha mo gter mdzod la: bdud rtsi sman mchod sna tshogs 'bul: dgyes shing rab tu dge ba'i phyir: gling 'dir bkra shis rab gnas spel: 'byor drug rgyas pa'i phrin las stsol: dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i las mdzad mo: bstan pa srung ba'i zhal bzhes ma: bdud kyi bu mo sngags srung bzhir: rin chen phud dang gser skyems 'bul: yul gru 'jig rten 'dzam gling 'dir: dmag 'khrug zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod: bar chod zhi ba'i las mdzad ma: gnod sbyin sras mo mel tshe bzhir: rin chen phud dang gser skyems 'bul: rig 'dzin bdag gi rogs dan mdzod: hūm̐: dngos grub gter gyi las mdzad ma: sman lcam phywa sdud bu mo bzhi: rig 'dzin bdag gi dam chos spel: bstan pa gnyan la dgra dar na: bstan srung mthu chen bcu gnyis kyis: bal bod mtshams su khas blangs bzhin: dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: sa bdag lha mo rab brtan ma: sa 'dzin dbang mo nye 'khor dang : bod khams skyong ma bcu gnyis rnams: dgyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni: phyi mchod sna tshogs dbang ba'i gar: nang mchod sman gtor rak+ta bcud:

bla med mchog gi mchod pa 'di: bstan srung skyong ma bcas la 'bul: bzhes nas bod 'bangs bkra shis shing : dge legs mchog gi dngos grub stsol: om̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da ma hā pañtsa rak+ta bha ling+ta khā hi: 'bru sna dang dar zab mchod cing : hūm̐: ri rab gling shar dbang bsgyur ba: gnod sbyin ma hā dhe wa yis: shar phyogs dri za'i bu mo la: sbyor bas sa bdag dkar mo srid: lag na shel gyi bum pa thogs: shar gyi dbang lag bu mo la: rin chen 'bru sna dar zab 'bul: nad gdon zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: ri rab lho gling dbang bsgyur ba: gnod sbyin ma hā dhe wa yis: lho phyogs gshin rje'i bu mo la: sbyor bas sa bdag ser mo srid: lag na gser gyi bhan+dha thogs: lho yi bde 'byung bu mo la: rin chen 'bru sna dar zab 'bul: 'byor drug rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: ri rab nub la dbang bsgyur ba: gnod sbyin ma hā dhe wa yis: 'dod pa khams kyi gtso mo la: sbyor bas sa bdag dmar mo srid: lag na pad gzhong nor bu thogs: nub kyi klu dbang 'phrul mo la: rin chen 'bru sna dar zab 'bul: khams gsum dbang sdud phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: ri rab byang la dbang bsgyur ba: gnod sbyin ma hā dhe wa yis: byang phyogs mgrin sngon bu mo la: sbyor bas sa bdag ljang mo srid: phyag na rin chen bang mdzod thogs: byang gi ru sbal ye 'phrul la: rin chen 'bru sna dar zab 'bul: dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: rdo rje kun grags mthu mo che: 'khor ni bdud kyi bu mo gsum: dgra bgegs srog la rngam pa'i phyir: gcer mo dur khrod gnas nyul la: rin chen 'bru sna dar zab 'bul: yul gyi dmag 'khrug zhi bar mdzod: hūm̐: gangs kyi yum chen g.yu bun ma: 'khor ni gnod sbyin bu mo gsum: rig 'dzin phrin las sgrub pa'i tshe: rin chen rgyan dar na bza' gsol:

gsang sngags bstan pa'i bya ra mdzod: hūm̐: kong btsun rdo rje bod khams skyong : 'khor ni 'jig rten sman mo gsum: rin chen gter la dbang bsgyur tshe: rgyan spyod sna tshogs lhun ldan gsol: rin chen 'bru sna dar zab 'bul: yul 'dir rten 'brel sna tshogs spel: hūm̐: bstan skyong ma mo bcu gnyis la: rin chen phud rgod 'bru sna 'bul: khyed rnams bstan pa'i bya ra phyir: rin chen 'bru sna dar zab 'bul: rtag tu bkra shis dge legs stsol: om̐ sarba pū dza a mṛ ta rat+na bhi shwa pañtsa li ka hūm̐: zhes mchod pa bya zhing ting 'dzin gyi thugs su 'khod: hūm̐: ri rab mnga' dbang dpal gyi mdzod 'dzin ma: sa la gnas pa'i sems ma 'dod 'byung gter: bsam 'phel bzhin bzang gtso 'khor legs par bstod: hūm̐: rgyal ba'i bstan srung bdud grol gnod sbyin sman: bcu gnyis mdzes pa'i lha yi cha shas dang : rten 'brel so so bcu gnyis rnal 'byor ma: dug lnga dbyings grol ye shes lha mo'i tshul: rtag chags zhen pa'i 'khri ba gdung sel ma: yul srung bstan pa'i cha 'dzin dpa' mor bstod: hūm̐: ye nas thams cad chos sku'i ngang klong nas: sna tshogs sgyu ma'i gar gyis bstan skyong ngogs: chos bzhin sgrub pa'i bstan 'dzin bu bzhin skyong : gsang sngags gnyan la dgra dar 'joms mdzad ma: ye shes grub kyang rtag chags phra men gzugs: bod khams skyong ma bcas la bdag bstod do: zhes bstod la brtan ma'i sgrub sngags ni: om̐ ma ma kyed pa ṇi ho ku len ṇig nal ting ting shag shag phe sha dza dzaḥ de nas sngags ji ltar 'di bzhin mkha' 'gro sde lngar 'os 'tshams dang sbyar ba gnad shes par bya: sngags phreng 'di brjod pas rang bzhin srid gsum thams cad dngos su khengs pa phyogs las rnam rgyal ye shes drwa ba'i sngags drug brjod do: zur gyi don rgyas 'khrugs sdeb rnams nyams len rdo rje'i zhal gab: de'i rgyud rdo rje slob dpon gab pa mngon sum zhes rig pa 'dzin pa'i bla ma'am gang rtogs skyes bu la sngon mtha' sad pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen du brten zhing phyag rgyun la ches mthong du 'dzin nas thos bsam la dgra ru mi sdang ba zhig la mngon du sbyin pa gal che:

mthar gyi rjes spyod thams cad kyang de ltar mngon par bya ba khrus lung gong ma'i rgyud dang bstun: 'di la sum sgrub kha sgyur yod pa zhal las shes pa rjes rim mo: zhag ci tsam sgrub kyang rjes chog lha bstod bgyis par bya: om̐ swā na rin chen snod yangs su: bde chen bdud rtsi'i mchod gtor nyid: dru ma'i pad+ma'i brgyan gyis spras: nī laṃ bde ba'i mchod pa 'di: margad bstan skyong tshogs la 'bul: pū dza mchod pas dgyes gyur cig: om̐ āḥhūm̐: zhes mchod pas dgyes par bgyid nas bstan skyong du gnyer bgyid par bsam pa mngon rtogs kyi skor ro: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas sa khyi lor gdan drangs shog ser las zhal bshus so/ dge'o/ bkra shis// //

bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus kyi ri khrus dang ri bstod kyi cha lag khol du phyung ba bzhugs so// // de yang thugs sgrub kyi cha lag ri bstod ri khrus bum gter bca' thabs kyi man ngag las/ e ma nyon dang ye shes mtsho rgyal lcam: ma 'ongs yang mtha' dus kyi tha ma ru: sde brgyad 'khrugs pas sems can bsod nams dman: de yi shugs las yul gru dgon sde 'khrug: de tshe skyes lha srung ma thams cad nyams: de la ri bstod ri khrus bum gter dang : dam sri mnan pa sa gnad bcos pa gtso: mtsho rgyal brda yi ri mor yi ger gzugs: ma 'ongs bstan pa gso ba'i btsas su bzhag: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: de yang sa rtags dus dang lo zla sogs: khyad par snang srid 'khrugs pa'i sde tshogs 'di lta bu 'byung ste: steng du lha dang lha min 'khrugs: bar du sde brgyad 'og gi klu srin 'khrugs: gza' dang rgyal po 'khrugs: btsan dang ma mo 'khrugs: sa bdag dang the'u rang 'khrugs: bdud dang gnod sbyin 'khrugs: gshin rje dang dmu bdud 'khrugs: skyes lha dang dgra lha 'khrugs: mgul lha dang brtan ma 'khrugs: de'i rkyen gyis yul gru so sor 'khrugs: dmag 'khrug gi rlangs pa yul lha la phog pas yul lha nyams: skyes lha nyams pas rang mgo mi 'og tu 'chor: phrag lha nyams pas dgra lha mi 'khor: mi 'khon lha la phog pas lha 'khon srung ma dbyings su gyes: lha 'khon mi la phog pas nad yams kyis mi thog bur: srid rdzong du gri khrag 'khyil: sku gsung thugs kyi rten rnams nyams pas byin rlabs dang thugs rje nyams: bden pa'i nus pa dbyings su yal: yul du dgra sna dang dmag sna phogs pas bkra mi shis pa'i lam dod: rten 'brel log: ban sngags mthu chen gyis yul zhing byad du bcug pas yul dang grong du lo nyes rgyun mi chad: skyes lha dang yul lha 'khon gyis grib phog pas yul mdangs nyams: mi yi bkrag shor:

lus kyi chas 'gyur: dkar gzhon mi 'byung : khyad par du yul mi kha 'thor gyis yi dwags dang 'gong po spun dgu'i yas thag phyogs nas bskyal ba'i dam sri ldang : sde dgon dang yul mi nang zhig tu 'gro: mgur lha dang bod skyong rnams kyis bstan pa mi skyong zhing dgra 'bod kyi g.yab g.yob 'then pas sa gnad kyi me btsa' thams cad 'byung bas rang bzhin du stong : yul lha rgyal bsen 'gong po dam sri spun dgu chags: gtsug lag khang dang gnas gzhi nyams rgyal 'gong gi bstan pa me ltar 'bar: 'phung byed nag po'i yul nas dmag gi sna thag 'dren: des bod 'bangs thams cad chags sdang me ltar 'bar: nang tshan ngo log dgra la phyogs: khyad par 'byung ba dug gi kha rlangs mun ltar 'thib pa'i dus 'byung : de yi dus bod kyi mgur lha mchod thabs ri bstod bum gter dang ri khrus: dgra sri dang dam sri mnan pa bcas bgyis pas yul gru bkra shis shing lo phyugs legs: mi nad dang phyugs nad zhi khyad par dmag dang mu ge'i bskal pa zhi zhing : chos srid bstan pa dar la yun ring gnas: yul gyi 'dre chag thams cad kyi gdug pa zhi: dgra lha dar: mgur lha brtan ma rnams kyis grogs dang rogs dan bsgrub: yul gyi nyams grib sangs: lha srin sde brgyad kyang rten la chags par gyur: zhes gsungs pas shin tu gal che'o/ de yang*/ de dag gso ba'i tshe yang rdzas dang rten 'brel sogs ma nyams pa dang : dus dang gnas skabs tshes grangs kyi ngos shin tu legs par bya: gsungs pa ltar/ dus yar gyi ngo zla tshes bzang por ri bstod kyi rdzas/ rgyab ri dang lha mkhar sogs la/ rab byung na zur gsal bzhin snying gter bum pa tshad ldan sgrub pa lnga dang*/ rnga thug dkar dmar nag gsum/ rgyal mtshan lnga dar lcog lnga ldan/ mda' dar bzhi ldan/ me long gsum/ yul lha dang mthun pa'i phyag mtshan ba dan/ rlung rta lnga ldan lha mkhar re re brgya las mi nyung ba/

go khrab dang dpyad kha'i rigs gang srid/ yul lha dang mthun pa'i rkang 'gro 'dab chags sder chags/ mtshon kha zhi ba'i phyir rgya khab gang mang*/ mtsho 'bul gser g.yu sogs rin po che'i rigs ci mang*/ 'bru sna tshogs shing 'bras sna tshogs/ rgyan bstod kyi mda' dar gang mang*/ gzhan yang sa sna rdo sna chu sna shing sna sogs gang 'dzoms/ ri dwags g.yung dwags g.yag lug ra sogs kyi rwa co la dbyangs gsal dang sngags rgod kyis brgyan pa sogs mdor na mnga' 'bul gyi chas thams cad rdzogs par tshags su bya/ ri khrus kyi rdzas gzhung gsal ltar dang*/ bum rdzas sogs tshang bar byas pa'i bum pa lnga'am gcig mdun gyi tshom bu thog bkod/ so so'i mgul chings dang me long khrus gzhong la sogs yo byad tshogs par bya/ gter bum sgrub chen rig min tshe thig gdab dang tho 'dzugs sogs mi dgos/ dang po skyabs sems yan lag bdun pa ni/ na moḥ ka dag dbyings las lhun grub thugs rje'i rtsal: 'ja' zer thig le'i 'od phung 'khyil ba'i klong : pad+ma 'byung gnas bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sku: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems 'phags pa'i tshogs: rig 'dzin dpa' bo ḍāk+ki sprin ltar 'khrigs: bdag sogs 'gro ba'i gnyen du lham mer gsal: na mo: dbyings rig ngo bo ma bcos thod phreng rtsal: rig 'dzin bde gshegs 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor la: phyag 'tshal skyabs mchis phyi nang gsang mchod 'bul: brtse chen thugs rje'i gzi byin deng 'dir skyed: mchog thun dngos grub 'bad med char ltar phob: snod bcud bag sgrib nyes skyon kun sbyangs shing : snang srid phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor mngon du stsol: bgegs gtor ni/ hūm̐: phyogs bcu steng 'og bar mtshams 'khor yug tu: rab 'jigs pho nya'i tshogs kyis yongs su khengs: deng 'dir sgrub la mi dbang ba'i: gnod byed gdon bgegs dpung tshogs gang yin pa: gtor ma len phyir myur du gnas 'dir mchis:

om̐ badz+ra ṭāk+ki rā dza hūm̐ dzaḥ de nas bgegs bskrad pa ni: hūm̐: nga ni dbang drag dpal chen he ru kaḥ sku las sprul pa'i khro tshogs sprin ltar gtibs: gsung las sprul pa'i drag sngags 'brug ltar ldir: thugs las sprul pa'i pho nya glog ltar 'khyugs: las byed rdo rje'i mtshon cha thog ltar 'bebs: dam sri glags lta'i gzugs phung rdul du bsnyil: me dpung ser ba drag pos bsregs bcom nas: bskal pa'i rlung dmar drag po des gtor cig: om̐ āḥhūm̐ artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ a hūm̐ badz+ra hūm̐ rak+ṣa hūm̐ yak+ṣa hūm̐: a ya ma du ru tsa sha na mā ra byad ma gnod byed thams cad bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: ces thun kyis brdeg: de nas srung 'khor bsgom pa ni: hūm̐: sku las sprul pa'i khro bos nam mkha' gang : gsung las sprul pa'i khro mos sa gzhi gang : thugs las sprul pa'i sras mchog bar snang gang : gnyis med sprul pas 'khor yug khyon yang khengs: phyi nang bar med ye shes me dpung 'khrigs: glags lta bdud rigs gang yin mtshams chod cig: om̐ badz+ra kī li kī la ya biṣatsha ṣa ā yu dha sarba bhan+dha rak+ṣa rak+ṣa: zhes srung 'khor bsgom/ sngon du bla ma yi dam gang rung gi bdag bskyed sngon du btang la bsnyen pa'i mthar/ mchod cing bstod/ ri bstod yul khrus kho na tsam la bka' brgyad lha bsang bdag bskyed bsnyen pa grub pa'i rjes mdun bskyed khrus sgrub pa ni/ mchod pa bsang sbyang byas la/ hūm̐: phyi mchod bcu drug nang mchod rnam pa lnga: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol bla med bde ba'i rgyu: zag med ye shes chen por dgyes pa bskyed: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe?sogs shab+da āḥhūm̐: om̐ badz+ra rū pa nas spar+she āḥhūm̐: om̐ badz+ra a mṛ rak+ta bha ling+ta āḥhūm̐: ma hā māṃ sa tsit+ta go ro tsa bha su ta āḥhūm̐: de nas rten bskyed pa ni: om̐ swa bhā w stong p stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las dbang chen sa gzhi rim par brtsegs pa'i steng du:

bum pa ye shes gzhal yas khang : gru bzhi sgo bzhi rgyan spyod phyi nang phun sum tshogs pa'i dbus su pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i nyi zla'i lte bar mūm̐: shar du lām̐: lho ru mām̐: nub tu pām̐: byang du tām̐: sa bon de dag yongs su gyur pa las: dbus su yum chen dbyings phyug mtsho rgyal sku mdog mthing ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis la zhi 'dzum mdzes pa'i 'od zer 'phros pas sku la za 'og sna lnga'i na bza' gsol zhing rin po che'i prog zhu dang rgyan 'phreng gdub bu 'khrol ba mu tig drwa ba'i rnam par spras shing me long dar mtshon sna tshogs kyi cod pan 'phur ba: phyag g.yas in+d+ra nī la'i bum pa ye shes lnga yi bdud rtsi dang lha klu mi yi rig 'dzin rnams kyi 'chi med tshe bcud kyis gtams pa nyon mongs brgyad khri bzhi stong bag chags skad cig la dag par bgyid pa: g.yon snang srid dkar dmar sbyor ba'i dri med 'od 'bar 'bum 'bum du 'khyil zhing pra ltar gsal ba'i me long rin po che'i tshom bu'i drwa bas bskor ba bsnams pas snang srid sgrib med du ston pa'i 'od kyis phung khams 'byung ba 'khrugs pa'i dri ma rab tu bsal bar mdzad ma: zhabs gnyis gshibs te bzhengs pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa: phyogs bzhi'i pad 'dab la spyan ma dkar mo: mā ma kī ser mo: gos dkar dmar mo: dam tshig sgrol ma ljang mo: de dag thams cad kyang lha mo'i cha lugs 'chang ba: g.yas thams cad dngul gser byi ru g.yu yi bum pa bsnams shing : g.yon thams cad rin po che'i snang gsal gyi me long thogs pa: rigs bdag kun bzang rdor sems rin 'byung snang mtha' don yod grub pas brgyan zhing : sku yi cha las ye shes lnga yi 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho 'khor bcas til gyi gang bu kha phye ba ltar nam mkha' sa gzhi bar snang thams cad khyab par byon te dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa dbyer med mi phyed par bsgom:

oṃ badz+ra sa mā dza dzaḥ spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: mkha' spyod klong nas skur bzhengs pa: dbyings phyug mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol: me long klong nas skur bzhengs pa: sangs rgyas spyan ma gshegs su gsol: mnyam nyid klong nas skur bzhengs pa: yum chen mā kī gshegs su gsol: sor rtog klong nas skur bzhengs pa: gos dkar lha mo gshegs su gsol: bya grub klong nas skur bzhengs pa: dam tshig sgrol ma gshegs su gsol: nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gnas mchog nas: ḍāk+ki rgya mtsho gshegs su gsol: om̐ badz+ra mūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐ dza dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ om̐ hūm̐ trām̐ hrī āḥ badz+ra rat+na pad+ma karma ā li kā li ye swā hā: zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag: chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rigs lngas dbu brgyan par gyur: bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal bya ba ni: hūm̐: ye shes pho brang nyams re dga': pad+ma dri med mdangs dang ldan: nyi zla spel ma 'od re gsal: thabs shes spel ba'i khri 'phang du: ḍāk+ki rgya mtsho dgyes par bzhugs: gus pa'i yid kyis lha phyag 'tshal: dam tshig gdung bas rab tu 'dud: om̐ sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: na mo pū ru sha ya hoḥ mchod pa ni: hūm̐: dri med dbang gi me tog dmar: kun khyab ngad g.yo bdug pa'i spos: snang gsal mdangs ldan sgron me sbar: sman mchod sbyar ba'i dri chab gtams: ro brgya'i bcud ldan zhal zas bkram: snyan pa'i dbyangs dang rol mo brjid: bdud rtsi pañtsa a mṛ ta: rak+ta bcud bzang bha ling spungs: sbyor sgrol de bzhin kho na nyid: bla med mchog gi mchod pa 'di: ma sring yum chen tshogs la 'bul: mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang : dam tshig nyams pa bshags su gsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe?sogs rū pa shab+d om̐ pañtsa rak+ta bha ling+ta māṃ sa tsit+ta go ro tsa na bha su ta pū dza āḥhūm̐: de nas bstod pa ni: hūm̐: rang bzhin ka dag ngo bo nyid: nam mkha'i mdangs ldan dbyings phyug ma:

bde chen dpa' mo mtsho rgyal lcam: sku gsum rdo rje rigs kyi bdag: rgyal kun yum gyur ma la bstod: hūm̐: don dam chos dbyings ma g.yos kyang : 'byung bzhi sbyang phyir thabs kyi sku: ye shes lha mo 'od rab gsal: lha mo bzhi la phyag 'tshal bstod: ces pa'i bar dang*/ rang nyid pad+ma thod phreng du gsal zhing : mdun bskyed bum lha mkha' 'gro sde lnga so so'i srog gi thig le'i mthar sngags phreng 'khor ba gcig las gnyis mched kyi rnam pa grangs med kyis phyi nang gi khyon thams cad yig 'bru'i sa bon sku gzugs kyis gang bas: steng 'og phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems ye shes 'jig rten gyi bdud rtsi'i bcud thams cad 'ub kyis bsdus nas bum lha'i mkha' 'gro sde lngar thim: mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i mkha' lam las byang sems kyi bdud rtsi lnga babs pas bum pa'i bdud rtsi ye shes lnga yi ngo bor bsgom: yang mkha' 'gro sde lnga gnas gyur te bum pa'i mkha' ru 'phags pa: sngags bzlas ba'i tshe zung 'jug sbyor ba mdzad pa'i mkha' lam las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi kha dog lnga ldan babs bum pa mer gyis gang : de las spros pa'i lha mo grangs med bdud rtsi dang me long thogs pa gtso bor 'phros: brtan ma rigs lnga yul skyong bcas la khrus bstsal bas nyams sgrib thams cad dag ste gzi brjid ches cher 'bar bar bskyed: slar 'phros snang srid snod bcud thams cad la ye shes lnga yi khrus bstsal bas: ya ki kun bzang nas ma gi rigs drug phra mo yan chad thams cad kyi nyams sgrib dag: khyad par snang srid 'byung ba 'khrugs pa thams cad kyi dug zhi: 'byung ba rang sar dag cing sor chud: 'byung lngas bsdus pa thams cad mdangs dang dpe byed legs pa'i yon tan rgyas shing rnam mkhyen gyi go 'phang thob par bsams la/ de nas sgrub pa'i rtsa sngags dri med 'od phreng ni: om̐ hūm̐ trām̐ hrī āḥ mūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐ dzñā na pañtsa a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūm̐ phaṭḥ

mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i khrus sngags ni: om̐ ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa mu khaṃ a mṛ ta ye swā hā: nyams grib zhi ba'i gzungs sngags ni: om̐ bhur khuṃ ma hā pra ma na ya bhurtsi bhu khi bi na ma si na ra ga ga shud+dhe ye swā hā: las sngags ni: om̐ ḍāk+ki pā shaṃ ma ma rā ga he sha dza dzaḥ mthar mchod bstod ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe?sogs rū pa shab+d om̐ pañtsa rak+ta bha ling+ta māṃ sa tsit+ta go ro tsa na bha su ta pū dza āḥhūm̐: de nas bstod pa ni: hūm̐: rang bzhin ka dag ngo bo nyid: nam mkha'i mdangs ldan dbyings phyug ma: bde chen dpa' mo mtsho rgyal lcam: sku gsum rdo rje rigs kyi bdag: rgyal kun yum gyur ma la bstod: hūm̐: don dam chos dbyings ma g.yos kyang : 'byung bzhi sbyang phyir thabs kyi sku: ye shes lha mo 'od rab gsal: lha mo bzhi la phyag 'tshal bstod: bum lha 'od zhu bya/ gzhung las/ sgrub pa'i skabs su nyi ma rtse shar du: gu ru'i sku tshab mthong ba don ldan sogs: sku gsung thugs rten khyad par sngon bshams par: mchod sprin byin rlabs bcud kyis sku khrus gsol: zhes gsungs pa ltar/ lha khrus bya ba ni/ khrus chog /'di ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo bsgyur ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la yo byad thams cad dang ldan pas sku khrus gsol bar bgyi'o/ khrus kyi khang pa shin tu dri zhim pa/ /shel gyi sa gzhi gsal zhing 'tsher ba bstar/ rin chen 'bar ba'i ka ba yid 'ong ldan/ /mu tig 'od chags bla res bres pa der/ /de bzhin gshegs dang de yi sras rnams la/ /rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chus/ yid 'ong legs par bkang ba glu dang ni/ /rol mor bcas pa du mas sku khrus gsol/

/ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis khrus gsol lo/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ hūm̐: rig 'dzin thod phreng bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sku: snang stong mkha' la sgrib pa'i g.ya' bral ba: sems can 'dul bya'i 'jigs brgyad sbyang ba'i phyir: rtse gcig dad dung mos pas khrus 'bul lo: gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: rig 'dzin thod phreng bde gshegs 'dus pa'i gsung : grags stong rdo rje'i rang mdangs 'gags med kyang : sems can 'byung 'jug las rlung sgrib sbyang phyir: gsang sngags snying po'i bcud kyi khrus 'bul lo: gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: rig 'dzin thod phreng bde gshegs 'dus pa'i thugs: rang grol ye shes 'khor 'das ka dag kyang : sems can a 'thas 'khrul 'dzin sbyang ba'i phyir: gsal stong rdo rje'i bcud kyi khrus gsol lo: gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: rig 'dzin thod phreng bde gshegs yon tan rdzogs: thugs rje 'pho 'gyur skye 'gag ris med kyang : sems can rgyud la ye shes gsal bya'i phyir: kun 'byung rin chen bcud kyi khrus gsol lo: gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: rig 'dzin thod phreng bde gshegs phrin las rdzogs: gang la ci 'dul thogs med thugs mnga' yang : sems can dug lnga'i rtog tshogs sbyang ba'i phyir: rtsal chen ye shes lnga yi khrus gsol lo: gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: rig 'dzin rgyal ba bder 'dus thod phreng rtsal: mtshan brgyad rje 'bangs dus gsum gter ston sogs: dngos su zung 'jug sprul pa'i 'khor lo la: snod bcud bag sgrib sbyang phyir khrus gsol lo:

gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: bder 'dus rig 'dzin ye shes klong dgu'i gar: kun bzang rigs lnga zhi khro dpal chen lha: rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor thams cad la: srid gsum snang ba sbyang phyir khrus gsol lo: gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: hūm̐ rgyal ba kun 'dus bde chen 'od kyi rtsal: sku gsum mkha' 'gro zhing skyong ḍāk+ki'i tshogs: snod bcud zhing khams gcig tu rdzogs pa las: 'byung 'khrug rten 'brel sbyang phyir khrus gsol lo: gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i phrin las thogs med shugs: mthu stobs gzi 'bar ma mgon lcam dral sogs: dam can chos srung rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor la: dug lnga dgra gdon sbyang phyir khrus gsol lo: gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: rig 'dzin sku mchog dge 'dun mtshan dpe 'bar: gsung mchog yan lag drug cu dam pa'i chos: thugs mchog zab gsang gdod nas mngon sangs rgyas: mchog gsum yongs 'dus ngo bor khrus gsol lo: gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: snod bcud snang ba bde gshegs rgyal ba'i sku: 'byung 'jug rlung sgra bde gshegs rgyal ba'i gsung : gsal snang rol pa bde gshegs rgyal ba'i thugs: gdod nas 'khor 'das dbyer med ngo bo la: bya rtsol 'dzin zhen dag pa'i khrus gsol lo: gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: de nas sku phyi ba ni: hūm̐: 'khor 'das gdod nas dag pa chos sku'i ngang : gzung 'dzin 'khrul rtog bag chags rnam dag kyang : 'gro kun zhing rdul tshe rabs las sbyang phyir: rten 'brel 'od lnga'i rdzas kyis sku phyi'o: oṃ mūm̐ hūm̐ lām̐: trām̐ mām̐ hrī pām̐:
