a tām̐: kā ya bhi shwa dha na ye swā hā: zhes rgyas par nus na khrus tshar re bzhin sbyar: re re bzhin rten gsum byin ldan la me long bstan nas sku khrus gsol/ mthar khrus chu bum par blugs/ de nas bka' brgyad lha bsang bsang gzhung mdun bskyed spyan 'dren rdzogs pa dang lhan du/ ri rtse'am/ gter mkhar lta bu'am min kyang bla gab med pa'i sar phyogs mtshams rnams su me long bstan la/ hūm̐: ma rig mkha' khams gnas dag pa: dbyings phyug dpal mo ye shes chus: snang srid kun la khrus bstsal bas: lha 'dre mi gsum rme mnol grib: rnam dag thugs rje'i rten 'brel gyis: chos dbyings ngang du dag gyur cig: mūm̐ oṃ shud+dhe shud+dhe ye swā hā: hūm̐: zhe sdang chu khams gnas dag pa: sangs rgyas spyan ma'i mkha' dbyings chus: snang srid kun la khrus bstsal bas: lha 'dre mi gsum rme mnol grib: rnam dag thugs rje'i rten 'brel gyis: me long ngang du dag gyur cig: lām̐ hūm̐: shud+dhe shud+dhe ye swā hā: hūm̐: nga rgyal sa khams gnas dag pa: mā ma kī yi mkha' dbyings chus: snang srid kun la khrus bstsal bas: lha 'dre mi gsum rme mnol grib: rnam dag thugs rje'i rten 'brel gyis: mnyam nyid ngang du dag gyur cig: mām̐ trām̐ shud+dhe shud+dhe ye swā hā: hūm̐: 'dod chags me khams gnas dag pa: gos dkar mo yi mkha' dbyings chus: snang srid kun la khrus brtsal bas: lha 'dre mi gsum rme mnol grib: rnam dag thugs rje'i rten 'brel gyis: sor rtog ngang du dag gyur cig: pām̐ hrīḥshud+dhe shud+dhe ye swā hā: hūm̐: phrag dog rlung khams gnas dag pa: dam tshig sgrol ma'i mkha' dbyings chus: snang srid kun la khrus bstsal bas: lha 'dre mi gsum rme mnol grib: rnam dag thugs rje'i rten 'brel gyis: bya grub ngang du dag gyur cig: tām̐ āḥshud+dhe shud+dhe ye swā hā: hūm̐: phyi nang 'byung khams 'khrugs pa'i dpal:

'byung lnga dag pa yum lnga'i chus: snang srid kun la khrus bstsal bas: lha 'dre mi gsum rme mnol grib: rnam dag thugs rje'i rten 'brel gyis: ye shes lnga ru dag gyur cig: oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥmūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐ dzñā na pañtsa a mṛ ta shud+dhe shud+dhe ye swā hā: hūm̐: 'di ltar thabs shes rten 'brel gyis: rig sngags dmod dang 'byung 'khrugs kyi: rgyu rkyen log pa'i sbyor ba kun: ting 'dzin ngang du dag gyur nas: 'byung ba sor chud 'phel bskyed shugs: yul khams bkrag dang gzi mdangs ldan: lha 'dre mi gsum stobs dang ldan: rdzogs ldan dpal la yongs gnas gyur: oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥmūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐ dzñā na pañtsa a mṛ ta shud+dhe shud+dhe ye swā hā: hūm̐: phyi nang snod bcud srid gsum dbu ma'i zom: bde chen thabs kyi cha 'dzin dbang phyug ham̐: stong nyid shes rab rang bzhin dbu ma aḥ zung 'jug gnyis med ma ning rā sa mi: snod bcud srog 'dzin sku gsum rdo rje'i rtsal: gza' klu rgyal po'i rnam pa shar ba'i sde: rang byung bdud rtsi bcud kyi khrus bstsal bas: 'khrul pa'i gdon tshul bag chags ma lus pa: rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bor dag gyur cig: om̐ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥmūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐ dzñā na pañtsa a mṛ ta shud+dhe shud+dhe ye swā hā: hūm̐: lha brgyad klu brgyad gza' brgyad 'jigs brgyad dgu: rgyu skar nyer brgyad phyogs skyong rgyal chen sogs: bdun cu rtsa lnga gtsang ris dpal mgon la: bka' gsang dam tshig gnyan gyi khrus bstsal nas: nad mtshon dug sbyor nang dbyen dme 'khrug sogs: mi dge than ltas byur rkyen ma lus pa: mthu stobs 'bar ba'i klong du dag gyur cig: om̐ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥmūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐ dzñā na pañtsa a mṛ ta shud+dhe shud+dhe ye swā hā: hūm̐: srid pa'i ma lnga gnas dang kun tu rgyu: brtan ma bcu gnyis ya ma bcu gnyis dang :

skyong ma bcu gnyis pho nya drug cu sogs: lo zla zhag dus rten 'brel dbang rnams la: dbyings rig rang rtsal bcud kyi khrus bstsal bas: tsha grang 'byung ba 'khrugs pa'i nad dal yams: 'od gsal ma mo'i klong du dag gyur cig: om̐ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥmūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐ dzñā na pañtsa a mṛ ta shud+dhe shud+dhe ye swā hā: hūm̐: srid pa'i lha dgu dge bsnyen nyi shu gcig: rje yi mgul lha 'bang gi srog lha dang : skyes lha che btsan 'dzam gling gzhi bdag sogs: gtsang ma rigs dang 'jig rten skyong rnams la: lha sngags ting 'dzin bcud kyi khrus bstsal bas: snod gzugs 'byung ba 'khrugs pa'i yo lang dang : bcud kyi mthong snang log pa'i mi mthun rkyen: phyogs med rten 'brel klong du dag gyur cig: om̐ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥmūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐ dzñā na pañtsa a mṛ ta shud+dhe shud+dhe ye swā hā: hūm̐: dbang phyug rnam sras tshogs bdag dzam+bha la: gnod sbyin skya brgyad nor rgyun phywa g.yang bdag: mgon zhing sdong grogs byed pa thams cad la: yid bzhin bdud rtsi bcud kyi khrus bstsal bas: stobs dpal srid rkun dbul 'gong 'byung po'i gdon: dgos 'dod char 'bebs klong du dag gyur cig: hūm̐: sa chu me rlung nam mkha' 'byung ba'i bdag: dkar phyogs lha dang nag phyogs bdud kyi rigs: srid rtse mnar med srid pa'i 'dzin khyon kun: 'od gsal mnyam pa nyid du khyab brdal ba: rgyu 'bras rnam par dag pa'i khrus bstsal bas: 'khor 'das ro gcig thig ler dag gyur cig: om̐ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥmūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐ dzñā na pañtsa a mṛ ta shud+dhe shud+dhe ye swā hā: ces pa'i rtsa sngags dang*/ om̐ bhur khuṃ ma hā pra ma na ya bhurtsi bhu khi bi na ma si na ra ga ga shud+dhe ye swā hā: om̐ ḍāk+ki pā shaṃ ma ma rā ga he sha dza dzaḥ tshar gsum mam bdun sogs bzlas la bum chu kha rgyan yal 'dab kyis phyogs bcur 'thor ro:

de ni sku gsum rang bzhin byin 'bebs shes par bya'o: bden tshig brjod pa ni: hūm̐: ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje sku gsum gyi: mthu stobs byin 'od 'ja' zer chi li li: sku dang zhing khams tshom bu me re re: rig 'dzin ḍāk+kis 'dzab dbyangs 'u ru ru: dam can chos srung rgyud rtsal ya la la: nor lha gter bdag longs spyod chi li li: srid pa'i lha dgu dgyes gar lhags se lhag: nyams dbyangs bde stong tshor ba 'u ru ru: rtsa rlung dbang thang gzi byin chi li li: lha mi'i dpal 'byor 'dod rgu thibs se thib: bkra shis phywa g.yang char 'bebs si li li: gnas yul byin chags rdzogs ldan dpal 'bar ba'i: rten 'brel rtag tu shis pa'i dge legs stsol: ces dbyangs gsal rten 'brel snying po lan gsum brjod: de nas bsang gzhung rdzogs pa'i rjes/ bstan ma'i mgor bstan skyong yul gyi cho ga'ang bya/ rten 'dzugs rnams 'bul la g.yang skyobs skabs phye mar gtor zhing lha rgyal brjod/ bsang gzhung mchod bstod grub ma thag brtan bzhugs bya ba ni/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ khyad par du'ang rten 'di rnams la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs rnams ji srid 'byung ba bzhi'i gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas kyang bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsol ba dang yul khams bkra shis shing bde legs kyi snang bas phyogs kun tu khyab par mdzad du gsol/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ zhes me tog 'thor zhing dga' ston bkra shis kyi mtha' brgyan par bya'o/ o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i zab gter thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus kyi cha lag ri bstod dang ri khrus gter bum sgrub thabs las snga ma gnyis khol phyung gter gzhung dang man ngag gi dgongs pa bzhin bsdebs te spel ba po ni sgo sprul gu h+yas so//

rig 'dzin bla ma'i nor sgrub bsod nams stobs bskyed kyi las byang bzhugs so: ma hā gu ru yid bzhin gter la phyag 'tshal lo: 'dir rig 'dzin bla ma'i nor sgrub bsod nams stobs bskyed kyi phrin las rnal 'byor khrigs su bsdebs pa la: sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum las: thog mar sngon du 'gro ba la bzhi/ dang po skyabs sems ni: na mo hūm̐: bde gshegs kun 'dus rtsa gsum rgyal ba'i dal: yid bzhin nor bu dbang gi dkyil 'khor lhar: bsod nams spel zhing sgrub phyir skyabs su mchi: 'gro kun dbul 'phongs sel bar sems bskyed do: lan gsum: gnyis pa bgegs bskrad pa ni: dkar gtor sngon du 'gro la: bgegs gtor la: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: gis sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: gis 'dod yon du spel: hūm̐: khro rgyal thugs las sprul pa yi: 'gugs pa'i pho nya phyogs bcur 'gyed: sgrub la mi dbang log 'dren bgegs: gtor ma len phyir gnas 'dir mchis: oṃ badz+ra ṭāk+ki rā dza ya: gnod byed 'byung po dza dzaḥ hūm̐: nga ni khro rgyal khrag 'thung rol: 'byung po bka' las ma 'da' bar: gtor ma khyer la rang gnas dengs: 'tshe na drag sngags me char 'bebs: oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa pad+ma he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭ āḥhūm̐: gnod byed 'byung po mā ra ya rbad bh+yoḥ thums shig gtor myog rbad raṃ dz+wa la phaṭḥ gsum pa mtshams gcod srung 'khor ni: hūm̐: khro rgyal thugs las srung ba'i gur: rdo rje lcags sdig bya khyung 'phros: gri gug kha ṭ+wāṃ me yi gur: sra mkhregs pha lam rang bzhin gyur: om̐ badz+ra tsakra rak+ṣa: tri pā paṃ tsakra rak+ṣa: khrom̐ ga ru ṭa tsakra rak+ṣa: ka ra ti ka tsakra rak+ṣa: tri shu la tsakra rak+ṣa: raṃ dz+wa la tsakra rak+ṣa: e swa bhā tsakra rak+ṣa: bzhi pa mchod pa byin brlab ni: hūm̐: phyi mchod sna tshogs sprin chen g.yo: nang mchod sman gtor rak+ta dmar: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol bla med rdzas: srub skyed rgya chen spel bar gyur:

om̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs?shab+da rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she āḥhūm̐: om̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ om̐ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍal hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ om̐ ma hā bha li+eṃ ta te dz+wa bha liṃ ta bha la bha te gu h+ya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ zhes pas lan gsum gyis brlab: gnyis pa dngos gzhi la brgyad kyi dang po bskyed rim ni: hūm̐: bdag nyid rang bzhin dbyings kyi dpal chen po: 'bar ba'i gar dgus srid pa spyi nas gnon: log 'dren dgra bgegs dam sri bdud dpung bsregs: stong gsum snod kyi 'jig rten srid pa'i khyon: stong pa'i ngang las 'byung lnga bsnol brtsegs pa: rin chen sna tshogs las grub gzhal yas khang: gru bzhi sgo bzhi phyi nang mtshan nyid ldan: bkra shis rdzas rtags nor bu'i tog gis spras: de dbus rin chen sna tshogs khri steng du: longs spyod bdag nyid rig 'dzin dzam bha la: sku mdog ser la snum 'bol mol le ba: khro 'dzum zhal gcig phyag gnyis sgeg cing dgyes: dbu skra thor tshugs rin chen sna tshogs brgyan: dar tshon cod pan phyag gdub snyan cha 'khrol: phyag g.yas lcags kyu g.yon pas nor bu 'dzin: gsus khyim 'khyil zhing rat+na'i ga shal brgyan: zhabs gnyis g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang stabs kyis bzhengs: gsang ba'i yum mchog lha mo nor bdag ma: sku mdog dmar ser zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis: g.yas pas lcags kyu g.yon pas nor bu 'dzin: yab kyi mgul 'khyud rin chen sna tshogs brgyan: zhabs g.yas brkyang zhing g.yon pas yab la 'khril: bde chen rang bzhin zung 'jug ldan par bsgom: phyi rol dbang sdud pho nya mkha' 'gro bzhi: g.yas pas rang rtags g.yon pas ne'u le 'dzin: rin chen brgyan cing gar stabs 'gros su bsgom: phyi rol phywa g.yang 'gugs pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: bka' sdod nor lha phyogs skyong sde dpon bcas: de ltar gsal ba'i 'bru lnga'i 'od zer gyis: nor bdag dbang phyug lha tshogs spyan drangs gyur:

badz+ra sa mā ya dza: gnyis pa spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: gter 'byung yid bzhin gzhal yas nas: nor bdag rig 'dzin 'dod rgu'i rje: yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa rnams: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: om̐ badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥ gsum pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐: gter 'byung yid bzhin gzhal yas nas: yid 'ong dgos 'dod dar 'bol steng: nor bdag rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: mi g.yo dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs: badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: bzhi pa phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐: bsod nams 'dod rgu'i bdag nyid mchog: longs spyod phywa g.yang sdud mdzad pa: rig 'dzin nor lha'i tshogs dang bcas: dngos grub bdag po khyod la 'dud: om̐ na mo pū ru sha ya hoḥ lnga pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: phyi mchod yid 'ong lha yi gter: nang mchod bdud rtsi dkar dmar phud: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol bha liṃ ta: nor bdag 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: om̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs? om̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bha liṃ ta pū dza āḥhūm̐: drug pa bstod pa ni: hūm̐: bde chen lhun grub chos dbyings yangs pa'i klong: 'dod rgu'i dpal ldan nor bdag longs spyod rje: rin chen brgyan ldan sgrub la dngos grub ster: khro 'dzum dgyes pas rnal 'byor bu bzhin skyong: phyag g.yas lcags kyus mi nor dbang du sdud: g.yon pas rin chen 'dod rgu char bzhin 'bebs: sgeg cing dgyes la sa gsum zil gyis gnon: 'dor stabs zhabs ldan rdzu 'phrul gar dgu bsgyur: rin chen khrir bzhugs khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: gsang ba'i yum mchog lha mo nor bdag ma: sku mdog dmar ser dbang gi phrin las sgrub: phyag g.yas lcags kyus 'byung lnga'i bcud mdangs sdud: g.yon pas nor bu'i dngos grub char bzhin 'bebs: rin chen rgyan ldan bang mdzod bcud kyis 'gengs: yab la zhabs 'khril bkrag mdangs gzi brjid 'bar: 'dod rgu'i mchod sbyin dbyings phyug dpa' mor bstaud:

gar gyi nyams ldan myur mgyogs mkha' 'gro bzhi: rin chen rgyan cha sna tshogs spungs se spung: phyag g.yas rang rtags rigs lnga'i phrin las rdzogs: g.yon pas ne'u le nor gyi char pa 'bebs: gar sgyur 'greng stabs sgrub pa'i grogs mo'i tshul: dbang sdud mkha' 'gro bzhi la phyag 'tshal bstod: khyed nyid sgrub cing mchod pa'i skal ldan la: 'dod rgu yid bzhin 'bad med dngos grub stsol: bdun pa 'dzab bzla ba ni: om̐ gu ru puṇ+ye ḍā ka ḍāk+ki ā pa ra mi ta sid+dhi dza dzaḥ zhes dang sham bur/ a tri nṛ yaṃ sarba 'gul 'gul: ma ma hriṃ hriṃ: ma ma kha shi: mi snying bsgul bsgul: mi 'gram chog chog: hring hring bsdus bsdus ma ma kha shi baṃ hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes btags la bzla'o/ brgyad pa thun mtshams gtor ma 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: gling bzhi gling phran bkod pa'i tshom bu la: lha mi'i yo byad nor rdzas rgyan gyis phyug: snang srid 'di ru ci srid 'tshogs pa yi: phyi nang mnyes mchod dgyes pa'i 'dod rgu'i tshogs: pad 'byung nor lha bsgrub phyir mchod pa 'bul: sgrub la tshe chos zas nor mnga' thang srid: yid la mos pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol: om̐ gu ru ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa yak+ṣa nā ga dhe wa lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ bha liṃ ta la kha kha khā hi: zhes bskul dbyangs gsal yi ge brgya pas kha bskang ngo*/ gsum pa rjes kyi rim par nyi shu las: thog mar tshogs kyi mchod pa la brgyad las: dang po bsang sbyang ni: hūm̐: gdod nas chos dbyings ngo bo stong: rang byung snying po'i 'od zer gyis: rgyu 'byung yi ge sbyong byed 'phros: gtsang btsog bzang ngan ka nas dag: om̐ sarba dharma ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ shud+dhe hoḥ gnyis pa byin brlab ni: hūm̐: bdag nyid lha yi thugs ka nas: byin brlab yi ge 'bru gsum 'phros: om̐ āḥhūm̐ gis sbyangs spel bsgyur: tshogs rdzas nam mkha'i mdzod du gyur: om̐ ga ṇa tsakra pū dza bhi shwa mu ṣe bh+yaḥ

gsum pa tshogs zhing spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings pho brang nas: rje btsun thod phreng yab yum la: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: longs spyod dbang phyug dzam bha la: sa snying mdog can yum dang sbyor: dbang sdud mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: bka' dang dam tshig pho brang nas: gter srung dam can rgya mtsho la: sprul pa yang sprul tshogs kyis bskor: tshogs la spyan 'drain gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: zhi ba'i lha tshogs thibs se thib: khro bo'i lha tshogs ya la la: chos skyong las byed khyugs se khyug: dur khrod pho brang tshogs khang la: gshegs shing byin gyis brlab tu gsol: dkyil 'khor rdzas la byin chen phob: mos pa'i skal ldan smin par mdzod: om̐ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dza: bzhi pa phud kyi mchod pa ni: hūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang : dbang sdud yab yum mgyogs mar bcas: dam can gter bdag chos skyong la: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: bzhes nas skal ldan bdag cag la: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī ga ṇa tsakra pū dza la khā hi: lnga pa bskang ba ni: hūm̐: phyi yi spyan gzigs 'dod yon rnam lnga'i gter: nang gi rdzas mchog bla med mchod pa'i sprin: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol dbang po rnam lnga yis: rig 'dzin nor lha rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang : dbang drag pad+ma thod phreng thugs dam bskang : dbang sdud mkha' 'gro sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : bka' srung gter bdag rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : phyi nang gsang ba'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang: thugs dam bskang la dgyes pa rab bskyed nas: sgrub la dgos 'dod yid bzhin char ltar phob: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: drug pa bshags pa ni: hoḥ dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: phyi nang dam tshig 'gal zhing nyams pa dang:

bsnyen sgrub bskang bshags mchod rdzas chad cing lhag: bag med dam 'gal le lo ci mchis pa: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pas bskang zhing bshags: nyams sgrib dag nas tshangs par stsal du gsol: om̐ badz+ra sa twa hūm̐: bdun pa bsgral bstab ni: hūm̐: mdun du hom khung lcags khang gru gsum nang: nṛ tri las skyes dgra bgegs 'byung po dang: god bdag dbul sri mngon sum gsal bar gyur: na mo: mchog gsum rtsa ba phyag rgya ting 'dzin sngags: khyad par bka' srung chos skyong bden pa'i mthus: gnod byed 'byung po bar chad rtsom pa'i rigs: rang dbang med par tshogs ling 'di la khug: bskrad cing bsdoms la bsgral gtub phye mar thongs: om̐ badz+ra aṃ ku sha ya dzaḥ hūm̐: ye shes thugs las sprul pa khro bo'i rgyal: sras mchog las mdzad badz+ra ku mā ra: phyag gnyis srid pa'i ri rab phur bu bsgril: byad ma gdug pa'i snying la kī la ya: om̐ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ gnod byed dam sri mā ra ya trig nan: gzir nan: mā ra ya rbad rbad: brgyad pa zhal du bstab pa ni: hūm̐: dbang sdud rgyal po dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: dug lnga dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag 'bul: rngam yangs zhal du bzhes shig mgrin par drongs: bde stong chos nyid rang byung lto bar bskyil: om̐ āḥhūm̐ dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na ba su ta khā hi: g.yang skyabs bya bar 'dod na g.yang 'bod dngos grub char 'bebs 'dir bya/ de nas tshogs la rol/ gnyis pa rjes kyi bya ba la bcu gnyis las/ dang po lhag ma gtong ba ni: hūm̐: bka' nyan ma mo bye ba 'bum: gnas nyul dur khrod tshogs khang 'grims: gsang sngags grogs kyi mel tshe ma: lhag ma bzhes la phrin las mdzod: om̐ bhak+ṣa li si ta ma bha liṃ ta khā hi: gnyis pa chad mdo bsgrag pa ni: hūm̐: sngon tshe me ri 'bar ba ru: bla ma thod phreng drag po dang : mkha' 'gro gsang ba ye shes gnyis:

rdo rje gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor phye: steng 'og lha srin khas blangs bzhin: gtor ma bzhes la chad mdo srungs: de 'og ti sgro'i tshogs khang du: rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung gnas dang: mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal gnyis: khrag 'thung dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: ma sring gnas nyul khas blangs bzhin: gtor ma bzhes la bstan pa srungs: lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa yis: ti sgro'i tshogs khang chen mo nas: gsang rgya zab gter bton pa'i tshe: las kyi ma mos khas blangs bzhin: gtor ma bzhes la bstan pa srungs: yang gsang sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor 'di: phyogs bcur spel ba'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ kro ta kro ti ḍā ka ḍāk+ki ma ma ru lu bh+yoḥ i daṃ bha liṃ ta khā hi: gsum pa brtan ma skyong ba ni: hūm̐: bod khams skyong ba brtan ma'i tshogs: lhab lhub rgyan ldan sil snyan sgra: brda gar glu dbyangs khyugs se khyug: mchod gtor bzhes la phrin las mdzod: om̐ ma ma ting ting shag shag le le ma hā bha liṃ ta khā hi: bzhi pa rta bro brdung ba ni: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: stong gsum chem chem khro bo'i bro: mnan no ma sring mkha' 'gro'i bro: nam yang ma ldang las kyi bro: sgab 'dre dam sri 'dul zhing bshig: om̐ nan: a nan: hūm̐ nan: mā ra ya nan: lnga pa thugs dam bskul zhing dngos grub blang ba ni: hūm̐: bde gshegs kun 'dus rig 'dzin dzam bha la: mkha' 'gro nor lha rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams la: lha mi'i dpal yon 'dod rgu'i gter chen po: dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod sprin bla med 'bul: gdung sems dam tshig ldan pas tshul bzhin du: khyed rnams bsnyen sgrub mchod bstod phul ba'i mthus: sgrub mchog rnal 'byor bdag la zhal bzang ston: thugs rjes brtse dgongs shugs ldan thugs rje bskyed: sku gsum rgyal ba'i byin rlabs mthu stobs bsdus: rtse gcig bla med mchog gi dngos grub stsol: nyi zla drang srong rig 'dzin tshe bcud bsdus:

mi 'gyur gnas pa tshe yi dngos grub stsol: bde dga'i dpal ldan lha klu'i mthu stobs bsdus: brgyud 'dzin srid dang dpal 'phel dngos grub stsol: snang srid lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du bsdus: bla yid dung dung shes pa dbang med bsgyur: g.yang can nor gyi phung po ri ltar spungs: brjid ldan gos dang dar zab sprin ltar gtibs: grags can snyan pa'i sgra skad 'brug ltar sgrogs: bcud ldan zas nor longs spyod char ltar phob: bkra shis mi nor tshe dpal mtsho ltar bskyil: 'dod rgu 'bad med lhun gyis grub pa dang: kun la dbang bsgyur chab 'bangs chos srid stobs: srid par che btsan 'gran zla bral ba yis: kun kyang theg chen chos la 'god par stsol: gsol btab bden pa'i 'bras bu g.yel gyur na: brtse chen thugs rjes dam bca' gang la mdzad: brgyud 'dzin dbul zhing 'phongs pas nyam thag na: mthu stobs byin rlabs myur zhes ci zhig bya: de bas thugs dam gnyan pos brtser dgongs la: tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin bdag cag la: rtags dang mtshan ma mngon sum ston pa dang: zas nor longs spyod tshe dpal dngos grub kyi: skye ba 'di dang tshe rabs thams cad du: 'dzad med gter la spyod pa'i dngos grub stsol: sarba sid+dhi a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ drug pa mchod bstod ni/ hūm̐: phyi mchod yid 'ong lha yi gter: nang mchod bdud rtsi dkar dmar phud: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol bha liṃ ta: nor bdag 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: om̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs? om̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛta rak+ta ba liṃ ta pū dza āḥhūm̐: bstod pa ni: hūm̐: bde chen lhun grub chos dbyings yangs pa'i klong: 'dod rgu'i dpal ldan nor bdag longs spyod rje: gsang ba'i yum mchog dbyings phyug dpa' mo dang*/ dbang sdud mkha' 'gro nor lha'i tshogs la bstod: bdun pa bzod gsol ni/ hūm̐: rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyi: phyi nang gsang ba'i dam las 'gal ba dang:

ma 'byor nyams dang chad lhag 'khrul pa'i tshogs: mthol zhing bshags nas mi sgrib tshangs par stsol: om̐ badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya: sogs? zhes yig brgya bzlas: brgyad pa rten la bzhugs gsol 'debs pa ni: e ma hoḥ mngon par dga' ba'i zhing mchog bde ba can: rnam dag pad+ma bkod pa'i mkha' dbyings nas: snang mtha' 'od mi 'gyur la gsol ba 'debs: dbang bzhi stsol zhing brtan par bzhugs su gsol: rnga yab dpal ri zangs mdog tsit+ta'i dbyibs: lhun grub pad+ma 'od kyi pho brang nas: o rgyan yab yum rnams la gsol ba 'debs: dbang bzhi stsol zhing brtan par bzhugs su gsol: yid bzhin 'khor lo 'dod rgu 'byung ba'i zhing: snang srid dbang du 'du ba'i gnas mchog nas: gtso mchog mkha' 'gro nor lhar gsol ba 'debs: dbang bzhi stsol zhing brtan par bzhugs su gsol: deng nas bzungs te byang chub snying po'i bar: bsod nams longs spyod 'bad med 'grub pa dang: mi mthun bdud bzhi'i tshogs las rab rgyal nas: tshe dang sgrub pa mnyam par mdzad du gsol: om̐ gu ru pad+ma sarba sid+dhi dzaḥ dgu pa brtan bzhugs dang g.yang skyabs skabs yin na rgyas gdab bya/ bcu pa dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni: hūm̐: gsang 'dus rang byung dpal chen pho brang lha: dkyil 'khor mtha' nas 'khor bsdu yum la bsdu: yum yab hūm̐ thim hūm̐ yang dmigs med klong: ka dag rang byung rang shar klong du hoḥ a āḥ bcu gcig pa bsngo ba ni: hoḥ dmigs med rgya yan chos nyid rgyu yi bsngo: rang shar rang rtsal ma 'gags lam gyi bsngo: sna tshogs spros bral ka dag 'bras bu bsngo: kun gzhi skye med 'khor 'das gcig tu bsngo: bcu gnyis pa smon lam ni: hoḥ srid pas bsdus pa'i mtha' yas sems can rnams: dbul 'phongs pre ta'i 'ching ba rab grol nas: don gnyis bsod nams 'bras bu tshogs rdzogs te: mthar thug gu ru'i go 'phang thob gyur cig: bkra shis ni: hūm̐: chos sku'i bkra shis snang mtha' 'od mi 'gyur:

ka dag lhun grub rtogs pa'i bkra shis shog: longs sku'i bkra shis 'chi med tshe yi lha: gnas lugs rang rtsal mngon rdzogs bkra shis shog: sprul sku'i bkra shis rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung: tshe rabs gtan gyi bla mar bkra shis shog: zab rgya'i bkra shis mkha' 'gro las kyi bdag: gsang rgyud gdams pas rgyud smin bkra shis shog: dgos 'dod kun 'byung bla ma yi dam tshogs: zil non dbang sdud pad+ma rgyal po rtsal: mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i gnod sbyin nor gyi bdag: phyi nang rtsa gsum lha yi bkra shis shog: ces pa 'di yang gzhung nyid la rigs mthun gyi cho ga dag las kha skong ste: skyid grong smyon pas khams gsum bde ldan dpal 'khyil du bkod pa dge bar gyur cig: sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ gu ru nor lha dbyer med kyi g.yang 'bod dngos grub char 'bebs zhes bya ba bzhugs so: rgyal ba kun gyi spyi gzugs pad+ma 'byung: gang gi thugs rje'i rnam rol rmad po che: mi zad rgyun gyi 'khor los phyug pa'i phyir: dngos grub 'gugs pa'i chu rgyun 'di na spro: de yang g.yang rten rdzas gtor sogs: pad+ma rgyal po'i spyi gzhung 'gal med legs par grub nas: ༈ dang po sgab 'dre bse rag bskrad pa ni/ hūm̐: nga ni dbang drag pad+ma he ru kaḥ nyon cig bse rag dbul sri ltogs 'gong tshogs: dbus kyi ri rab lho phyogs 'dzam gling 'dir: spyi mthun chos nor longs spyod spel ba la: rang rang las kyi dbang gis mi 'tshams pa'i: dbul sri mi la bse rag zhes bya ba: gang gi rgyu ni ser sna'i rang gzugs te: rkyen ni rgyu mthun yi dwags yid kyi lus: sna tshogs gzugs su brdzu zhing dpal g.yang rku: snod bcud rten 'brel legs tshogs spel ba la: byur dang mi kha god kha gang stong sogs: rnam kun bar chad sna tshogs sgab 'dre ldang: ltogs 'gong dbul sri 'byung po'i sde tshogs kun: tshwa ram sgog g.yer la sogs mi kha'i rdzas:

rang rang yid mthun yas stags 'di longs la: lan chags bu lon 'brel thag chod par gyis: myur du mtha' yas rgya mtsho'i pha mthar song: bsgo ba'i bka' las 'da' na lus ngag yid: yi dam drag tu khros pa'i ting 'dzin gyis: rdul phran bzhin du brlag par gdon mi za: de bas da lta nyid du phyir dengs shig: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ ye shes lnga yi srung 'khor brtan par bsgom: gnyis pa dag byed bsang khrus bya ba ni: om̐ āḥhūm̐: lha shing bsang gis mi bsangs gang yang med: chab gtsang khrus kyis mi dag gang yang med: gtsang sme gnyis 'dzin sems kyi 'khrul snang char: btsog mnol dme yugs mi gtsang grib phog pa: phyi nang 'byung 'khrugs rten 'brel nyes tshogs kun: 'byung lnga rnam dag yum lnga'i mkha' dbyings klong: chos nyid rnam dag dbyings su dag gyur cig: om̐ e ho shud+dhe shud+dhe swā hāḥ yam̐ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe swā hāḥ bam̐ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe swā hāḥ ram̐ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe swā hāḥ e yam̐ bam̐ lam̐ ram̐ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe swā hāḥ.a a swā hā: zhes gter kha 'og ma sku dgongs las so/ de nas tshe bsod dpal 'byor mnga' thang dbang ba'i gces phrug pho mo rigs ldan kyi phyag du lcags kyu ne'u le'i mda' dar dang pad+ma'i zhags pa bcas thogs/ rnal 'byor sgrub pa po'i phyag tu rnga shing dang dam tshig rdo rje rat+na'i zhags pa bcas thogs la dbyangs snyan po dang bcas nas 'di skad do/ hūm̐/ chos dbyings lhun grub bde chen dbyings kyi mkha'/ /klong lnga zer thag phreng ba'i pho brang nas/ /skal ldan smin grol lam la 'god mdzad pa'i/ /rig 'dzin bla ma'i thugs rjes g.yang khug cig /gzugs 'dzin bral ba sems nyid rig pa'i mkha'/ rang gsal rig pa'i cho rol pho brang nas/ rang rig sangs rgyas chos skur grol mdzad pa'i/ sangs rgyas byang sems byin rlabs g.yang khug cig /ma 'gags shar grol rang byung shar ba'i mkha'/

/mdo sde 'dul ba lung rigs pho brang nas/ /yo ga rnam gsum chos kyis smin mdzad pa'i/ /phyag rdzogs gzhi grol chos kyi g.yang khug cig /bstan pa'i brgyud 'dzin 'dzam gling yongs kyi mkha'/ /snyan pa'i ba dan bsgrengs pa'i pho brang nas/ /ma rig sems can 'khor ba stongs mdzad pa'i/ /skyes chen tshogs 'dus dge 'dun g.yang khug cig /thugs rje'i rtsal las gang 'dul sprul pa'i klong/ /rgyud sde bzhi drug theg rim dgu yi lha/ /srid pa gsum na stobs bcus dbang bsgyur ba/ /yi dam lha tshogs dngos grub g.yang khug cig /rdzu 'phrul shugs kyis mkha' la lam lam 'gro/ /rtsa rlung thig le'i dwangs ma'i srog 'dzin ma/ /chos sku yum chen rgyal kun bskyed pa'i yum/ /ma sring mkha' 'gros rten 'brel g.yang khug cig /sngon tshe rgyal ba'i bka' btags dam gnas pa/ /mthu rtsal stobs ldan sha khrag srog la rngam/ /dam sri bdud rigs dgra bgegs thal bar brlag /chos skyong srung ma'i mthu rtsal g.yang khug cig /shar phyogs mgyogs ma rdo rje lcags kyu mas/ /yul 'khor srung dang dri za lha mi bcas/ /shar phyogs lus 'phags gling la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /phywa g.yang dpal 'byor 'dod rgu 'dir 'dus shig /lho phyogs mgyogs ma rin chen zhags pa mas/ /'phags skyes po dang gshin rje lha mi bcas/ /lho phyogs 'dzam bu gling la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /phywa g.yang dpal 'byor 'dod rgu 'dir 'dus shig /nub phyogs mgyogs ma pad+ma lcags sgrog mas/ /spyan mi bzang dang klu dbang lha mi bcas/ /nub phyogs ba lang spyod la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /phywa g.yang dpal 'byor 'dod rgu 'dir 'dus shig /byang phyogs mgyogs ma rgya gram dril bu mas/ /rnam thos sras dang gnod sbyin lha mi bcas/ /byang phyogs sgra ma'i snyan la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /phywa g.yang dpal 'byor 'dod rgu 'dir 'dus shig /dngos grub bdag mo klu mo nor skyong mas/

/lha klu mi yi mnga' thang longs spyod srid/ /tshe dpal mnga' thang snyan grags 'dod dgu'i dpyid/ /phywa g.yang dpal 'byor 'dod rgu 'dir 'dus shig /gzhan yang lo zla tshes la dbang ba dang/ /lo dang spar sme dus 'dzin sa yi bdag /chu tshod 'byung lnga'i khams dang rgyu skar gyi/ /phywa g.yang dpal 'byor 'dod rgu 'dir 'dus shig /sde dpon sum cu sngags bdag bco brgyad dang*/ /dregs chen bco brgyad 'jigs dgu sde brgyad kyis/ /'dzam gling srid pa'i yid la gang mos pa'i/ /rnal 'byor bdag gis dbang du 'du bar mdzod/ /phywa khu ye g.yang khu ye hu ye g.yang sdud do/ zhes dang*/ de nas brtan bzhugs gsol ba ni/ e ma ho/ mngon par dga' ba'i zhing mchog bde ba can/ /rnam dag pad+ma bkod pa'i mkha' dbyings nas/ /snang mtha' 'od ma'i 'gyur la gsol ba 'debs/ /dbang bzhi bstsal zhing brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /rnga yab dpal ri lhun grub pad+ma 'od/ /zangs mdog tsit+ta'i dbyibs kyi pho brang nas/ /o rgyan yab yum rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /dbang bzhi stsal zhing brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /yid bzhin 'khor lor 'dod rgu 'byung ba'i gnas/ /dug lnga rnam dag sku lnga lhun gyis grub/ /ye shes rtsal lnga spras pa'i pho brang nas/ /thod phreng yab yum rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /dbang bzhi stsal zhing brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /yid bzhin 'khor lor 'dod rgu 'byung ba'i gnas/ /snang srid dbang du 'du ba'i gnas mchog nas/ /brtan g.yo pad+ma rgyal por gsol ba 'debs/ /dbang bzhi stsal zhing brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /deng nas bzung ste byang chub snying po'i bar/ /bsod nams longs spyod 'bad med 'grub pa dang*/ /mi mthun bdud bzhi tshogs las rab rgyal nas/ /tshe dang sgrub pa mnyam par mdzad du gsol/ om̐ gu ru pad+ma sarba sid+dhi dzaḥ brtan bzhugs gsol nas rgyas gdab pa ni/ hūm̐/ ma chags thogs med 'khor lo rin po che/

/g.yang rten 'dzugs so gnas 'dir brtan par bzhugs/ /dgos 'dod kun 'byung nor bu rin po che/ /g.yang rten 'dzugs so gnas 'dir brtan par bzhugs/ /yid 'ong mdzes ldan btsun mo rin po che/ /g.yang rten 'dzugs so gnas 'dir brtan par bzhugs/ /kun la dbang bsgyur blon po rin po che/ /g.yang rten 'dzugs so gnas 'dir brtan par bzhugs/ /theg chen stobs ldan glang po rin po che/ /g.yang rten 'dzugs so gnas 'dir brtan par bzhugs/ /cang shes shugs ldan rta mchog rin po che/ /g.yang rten 'dzugs so gnas 'dir brtan par bzhugs/ /log rtog dpung 'joms dmag dpon rin po che/ /g.yang rten 'dzugs so gnas 'dir brtan par bzhugs/ /mi 'gyur dbyings kyi sna tshogs rdo rje yis/ /kun nas kun tu bzung zhing rgyas gtab bo/ kyai/ bkra shis dang po'i rgyal mtshan gcig /gser nya rin chen bkra shis gnyis/ /chos dung g.yas 'khyil bkra shis gsum/ /dri med pad+ma bkra shis bzhi/ /lhun grub bum pa bkra shis lnga/ /yid 'jo'i dpal be'u bkra shis drug /mkha' yi gdugs mchog bkra shis bdun/ /rtsibs stong 'khor lo bkra shis brgyad/ /mi shigs g.yu drung bkra shis dgu /phywa g.yang brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /mi chod mi shigs rgyas gdab bo/ /rtsal chen khyung dang stobs chen sdig /sgo lha stag g.yag mtshams su ni/ /'byung po zhugs pa'i go skabs med/ /de bas srungs shig rgyas gdab bo/ om̐ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ zhes rgyas 'debs bsngo smon sogs rten 'brel bzhin du bya/ g.yang 'gugs dngos grub char 'bebs zhes pa 'di/ gu ru nor lha dbyer med phrin chog kha skong du rong smyon pas sbyar ba dge/ bkra shis shog/ // ༈ rab gnas shin tu bsdus pa'i lugs nyung gsal snying por dril ba bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/ 'dir rten la rab gnas shin tu mgyogs par bya dgos na/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi dang po ni/

badz+ra ma hā shrī he ru ko3 haṃ/ zhes rang nyid gnyugs ma'i he ru ka lam gyi gsal/ rten rnams la/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ bi shwa badz+ra kro dha dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ ha la ha la ha la hūm̐/ zhes dang*/ sum+bha nis bgegs bskrad/ badz+ra rak+ṣas srung 'khor bsgoms la/ gnyis pa ni/ oṃ ma hā shū n+ya ta sogs/ rten rnams mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang nyid las/ /seṅge glang chen rta mchog rma bya dang*/ /shang shang rin chen pad+ma nyi zla'i steng*/ /rigs kyi sa bon phyag mtshan yongs gyur las/ /rnam snang mi bskyod rin 'byung snang mtha' yas/ /don grub rang 'od rig ma'i bde bas dgyes/ /g.yas pa rang rtags g.yon pa dril bu 'dzin/ /zhi tshul mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar rgyan chas sgeg /ye shes lnga ldan mu med 'od zer 'bar/ /dbyings nas ye shes spyan drangs gnyis med bstim/ /gnas gsum sku gsung thugs kyi phyag rgyas gdab/ /dbang lha'i dbang bskur ye shes dbu rgyan gyur/ oṃ e h+ya hi bha ga wan ma hā ka ru ṇi ka dri sh+ya hoḥ sa ma ya satwaṃ dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā ka ru ṇi ka ya wāk+ka tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā at+ma ko3 haṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ pañtsa ka la mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ oṃ tsak+ṣuḥtsak+ṣuḥs man+ta tsak+ṣu shwa dha ni swā hā/ zhes spyan drangs 'gugs bstim rgyas gdab dbang bskur spyan dbye bcas grub nas/ phyogs bcu rab 'byams rgyal ba'i zhing khams na/ /nyer spyod 'dod yon rig ma'i bde gar sogs/ /dngos dang yid kyis rnam sprul ji snyed pas/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams mchod par bgyi/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes mchod/ chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang*/ /gzugs sku 'ja' tshon bzhin du so sor gsal/ /thabs dang shes rab mchog la mnga' brnyes pa'i/

/rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ ces bstod/ de nas snyim pa me tog dang bcas te thal mo sbyar la/ ji srid sa chu me dang ni/ /rlung gis bskal pa'i 'jig bar du/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bcom ldan khyod ni bzhugs par mdzod/ 'dir ni rten dang lhan cig tu/ /'khor ba'i srid du bzhugs nas kyang*/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*/ /mchog rnams legs par stsal du gsol/ ces dang*/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ khyad par du yang sku gsung thugs kyi rten 'di rnams la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs rnams ji srid 'byung ba bzhi'i gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas kyang bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab mthar/ ye dharma dang*/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ me tog 'thor? gsum pa ni/ slar yang thal mo sbyar la/ sa dang chu dang me rlung las/ /lha rnams kun gyis rten 'di la/ /bskal pa brgya ru bsrung ba dang*/ /dgyes shing yid bzang gyur pa yis/ /slob dpon yon gyi bdag por bcas/ /kun nas zhi dang rgyas pa dang*/ /rtag tu bkra shis mdzad du gsol/ zhes dang*/ 'bad dang rtsol bas ma gos pa'i/ /yid bzhin nor bu dpag bsam shing*/ /sems can re ba skong mdzad pas/ /bsam pa 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /ces dang*/ 'jig rten bde zhing sogs ji ltar rigs pa'i shis pa brjod cing me tog gi char bsnyil bar bya'o/ tshul 'di ni rab gnas kyi cho ga dge legs 'dod 'jo las shin tu bsdus pa'i tshul gsungs pa nyid lag tu blang zhing khyer bde ba'i slad du ze chen pa 'gyur med pad+ma bstan 'dzin gyis bris pa maṅga laṃ//

// ༈ bka' brgyad gsang ba zil gnon gyi las tshogs snang brgyad kyi cho ga lha 'dre dgyes pa'i mchod sprin bzhugs so/ ༁ྂ: na mo pad+ma kā ra ye/ 'dir gson gshin gyi bya ba ci byed kyang lo zla zhag dus kyi sa bdag snang srid yul lha sogs la gtor mas brngan zhing bcol ba ni/ gzhi dkar steng du dkar gtor dgu dang srung bzhi khyung phag bum pa 'bru sna shel tshig gser skyems shing rtsi rgyang bu dar tshon: gzhan yang ho yi phyag rgya rus sbal khog pa sogs bca' gzhi tshang bar bsags la: rang nyid 'jam dpal lam snang srid zil gnon gu ru pad+ma'i skur gsal zhing mchod rdzas rnams kyi 'bag pa ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsang : oṃ swa bhā was sbyang : stong pa'i ngang las mchod rdzas rnams dag par gyur: na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo? khaṃ swā hā: 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i longs spyod mi zad pa nam mkha'i mdzod du gyur: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ t nam mkha'i mdzod de las so so'i thugs bzhed ci lta ba'i mod las dbang po lnga yi bdud rtsi dug lnga'i gsos su gyur pa ci yang 'gyur bar gyur: na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta ā? mgron rnams rang rang gi mdun du mchod rdzas ci 'dod par gsal bar gyur: oṃ dzñā na ā wa lo ki ti na maḥs man+t bdag gi lus zhing gi rdul gyi grangs su song bas yar mchod 'os pa dang mar snying rje'i mgron thams cad la pham rgyal med par blo kha rdzogs pa 'bul bar gyur: na maḥs man+ta bud+dha naṃ? mgron thams cad dam tshig la gnas nas bdag gi sdong grogs ci dgos pa thams cad byed par gyur: hūm̐: srid pa ye srid ye thog tu: spros bral dngos med mtha' las 'das: rtag chad mu bzhi'i 'du 'phros kyang : snang tsam snod kyi 'jig rten chags: de srid rten 'brel bcu gnyis las: 'gyu 'gros rlung dang dal gcig tu: lo zla zhag dus rgyu ba yi: gza' dang rgyu skar sa bdag dang : brtan ma dus 'dzin gsang nyul dang :

gzhan yang gdug sems 'chang ba yi: sgra gcan nag po gdong dgu dang : zin phung g.yu mdzod sngon mo dang : gnam khyi nag po mche ba can: hal khyi nag po ral pa can: phung zor nag po spu gri can: nyi ma nag po 'dab ma can: zla ba nag po kha dug can: dus 'dzin gser gyi ska rags can: gzhan yang zhag dus 'khor ba sogs: gnam lo rgyal po zla ba blon: zhag dang dmag mi dus tshod mtshon: spar sme sa 'dzin gnas bdag sogs: byams brtse sems kyi 'dir gshegs la: rang rang mthun pa'i dam rdzas dang : gser skyems khri dkar stong nag sogs: gzugs 'gros yas stags sna tshogs 'bul: srid pa'i sde tshogs dgyes gyur nas: ro 'don gshin 'don dur 'debs sogs: de ring rgyu sbyor yon bdag gis: bya ba ci dang ci bgyis kyang : ko long sdoms la ru nga dang : phrag dog gdug sems ma 'chang bar: zhi bas bde legs phan sems kyis: snying rjes phan sems bsam grub nas: phyogs dang g.yo 'khrug zhi bar mdzod: oṃ ye dharmā dhartu ya bhuṃ mi sa ma ho rā ga bo dhi sam+bha ya bha wan+tu swā hā: srung bzhi 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: srid pa'i ye thog sku mkhar gyi: rim pa bcu gsum gong shed na: tshangs pa brgya byin sde tshogs la: gza' skar sa bdag tshogs kyis bskor: khyed la bya khyung khra bo 'bul: khyung dmar gshog pa ma rdebs shig: gnam lo rgyal po'i 'khrugs bcos so: oṃ khrom̐ ga ru ṭa ye swā hā: gnam gyi dgra gshed sdang ba zhi bar gyur cig swā hā: steng phyogs su phul: hūm̐: shar phyogs shing gi sku mkhar nas: skyed byed shing gi mi bo che: gza' skar sa bdag tshogs kyis bskor: khyed la mtshal stag skya bo bsngo: stag skyas kha ni ma gdangs shig: gnam lo rgyal po'i 'khrugs bcos so: oṃ ra tri mu pa le ye swā hā: shar gyi dgra gshed sdang ba zhi bar gyur cig swā hā: shar du phul: hūm̐: lho phyogs me yi sku mkhar nas: gso byed me yi mi bo che:

gza' skar sa bdag tshogs kyis bskor: khyed la g.yu 'brug sngon mo bsngo: g.yu 'brug mjug ma ma g.yug cig: gnam lo rgyal po'i 'khrugs bcos so: oṃ bhurba tri sa ya sa ma ti swā hā: lho yi dgra gshed sdang ba zhi bar gyur cig swā hā: lho ru phul: hūm̐: nub phyogs lcags kyi sku mkhar nas: brtan pa lcags kyi mi bo che: gza' skar sa bdag tshogs kyis bskor: khyed la bya ni ze dmar bsngo: bya dmar gshog pa ma sprugs shig: gnam lo rgyal po'i 'khrugs bcos so: oṃ bhi bhu sa ha ti ta tri ye swā hā: nub kyi dgra gshed sdang ba zhi bar gyur cig swā hā: nub tu phul: hūm̐: byang phyogs chu yi sku mkhar nas: kun gso chu yi mi bo che: gza' skar sa bdag tshogs kyis bskor: khyed la rus sbal rgya bo bsngo: rus sbal rkan sgra ma rdebs shig: gnam lo rgyal po'i 'khrugs bcos so: oṃ saṃ bhak+ṣa ka taṃ dza ya swā hā: byang gi dgra gshed sdang ba zhi bar gyur cig swā hā: byang du phul: hūm̐: 'og phyogs sa yi sku mkhar nas: 'gyur med lha mo bstan ma che: 'byung ba sa bdag tshogs kyis bskor: khyed la phag dang bum pa 'bul: dur phag nag po ma 'khun cig: gnam lo sa bdag 'khrugs bcos so: oṃ bhū mi pa ti ya sa du ho swā hā: 'og gi dgra gshed sdang ba zhi bar gyur cig swā hā: 'og phyogs su phul: de nas shel tshig dang 'bru sna gtor ma rgyang bu dar tshon rnams phyogs mtshams su rim bzhin 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: shar phyogs 'byung lnga'i stag yos dang : lo zla zhag dus sa bdag tshogs: gza' rgod phur bu chen po dang : smin drug la sogs shar skar drug: spar sme gsum mthing zin la sogs: shing gi khams la dbang ba rnams: dus dang gnas nyul tshogs kyis bskor: gtor ma rgyang bu dar tshon dang : gser skyems 'bru sna shel tshig 'bul: dgra dang gshed du ma 'bebs par: de ring dus tshes 'khrugs bcos so:

oṃ baṃ bha ti sa mud lam bha ya swā hā: lo zla zhag dus kyi dgra gshed sdang ba zhi bar gyur cig swā hā: shar phyogs su phul: hūm̐: shar lho mtshams nas 'byung lnga'i 'brug: lo zla zhag dus sa bdag tshogs: gza' rgod sgra gcan skar ma skag: spar sme bzhi ljang zon la sogs: sa yi khams la dbang ba rnams: dus dang gnas nyul tshogs kyis bskor: gtor ma rgyang bu dar tshon dang : gser skyems 'bru sna shel tshig 'bul: dgra dang gshed du ma 'bebs par: de ring dus tshes 'khrugs bcos so: oṃ baṃ bha ti sa mud lam bha ya swā hā: lo zla zhag dus kyi dgra gshed sdang ba zhi bar gyur cig swā hā: shar lhor phul: hūm̐: lho phyogs 'byung lnga'i sbrul rta dang : lo zla zhag dus sa bdag tshogs: gza' rgod nyi ma mig dmar dang : rta chen la sogs lho skar drug: spar sme dgu dmar li la sogs: me yi khams la dbang ba rnams: dus dang gnas nyul tshogs kyis bskor: gtor ma rgyang bu dar tshon dang : gser skyems 'bru sna shel tshig 'bul: dgra dang gshed du ma 'bebs par: de ring dus tshes 'khrugs bcos so: oṃ baṃ bha ti sa mud lam bha ya swā hā: lo zla zhag dus kyi dgra gshed sdang ba zhi bar gyur cig swā hā: lho ru phul: hūm̐: lho nub mtshams nas 'byung lnga'i lug: lo zla zhag dus sa bdag tshogs: gza' rgod spen pa sa ga dang : spar sme gnyis nag khon la sogs: sa yi khams la dbang ba rnams: dus dang gnas nyul tshogs kyis bskor: gtor ma rgyang bu dar tshon dang : gser skyems 'bru sna shel tshig 'bul: dgra dang gshed du ma 'bebs par: de ring dus tshes 'khrugs bcos so: oṃ baṃ bha ti sa mud lam bha ya swā hā: lo zla zhag dus kyi dgra gshed sdang ba zhi bar gyur cig swā hā: lho nub tu phul: hūm̐: nub phyogs 'byung lnga'i sprel bya dang : lo zla zhag dus sa bdag tshogs: gza' rgod pa wa sangs dang ni: snron la sogs te nub skar drug:

spar sme dwa dang bdun dmar sogs: me yi khams la dbang ba rnams: dus dang gnas nyul tshogs kyis bskor: gtor ma rgyang bu dar tshon dang : gser skyems 'bru sna shel tshig 'bul: dgra dang gshed du ma 'bebs par: de ring dus tshes 'khrugs bcos so: oṃ baṃ bha ti sa mud lam bha ya swā hā: lo zla zhag dus kyi dgra gshed sdang ba zhi bar gyur cig swā hā: nub tu phul: ham̐'u: nub byang mtshams nas 'byung lnga'i khyi: lo zla zhag dus sa bdag tshogs: gza' rgod mjug ring byi bzhin dang : spar sme drug dkar khen la sogs: sa yi khams la dbang ba rnams: dus dang gnas nyul tshogs kyis bskor: gtor ma rgyang bu dar tshon dang : gser skyems 'bru sna shel tshig 'bul: dgra dang gshed du ma 'bebs par: de ring dus tshes 'khrugs bcos so: oṃ baṃ bha ti sa mud lam bha ya swā hā: lo zla zhag dus kyi dgra gshed sdang ba zhi bar gyur cig swā hā: nub byang du phul: hūm̐: byang phyogs 'byung lnga'i phag byi ba: lo zla zhag dus sa bdag tshogs: gza' mchog zla ba lhag pa dang : mon gre la sogs byang skar drug: spar sme gcig dkar khams la sogs: chu yi khams la dbang ba rnams: dus dang gnas nyul tshogs kyis bskor: gtor ma rgyang bu dar tshon dang : gser skyems 'bru sna shel tshig 'bul: dgra dang gshed du ma 'bebs par: de ring dus tshes 'khrugs bcos so: oṃ baṃ bha ti sa mud lam bha ya swā hā: lo zla zhag dus kyi dgra gshed sdang ba zhi bar gyur cig swā hā: byang du phul: hūm̐: byang shar mtshams nas 'byung lnga'i glang : lo zla zhag dus sa bdag tshogs: gza' rgod rā hu skar bra nye: spar sme brgyad dkar ging la sogs: sa yi khams la dbang ba rnams: dus dang gnas nyul tshogs kyis bskor: gtor ma rgyang bu dar tshon dang : gser skyems 'bru sna shel tshig 'bul: dgra dang gshed du ma 'bebs par: de ring dus tshes 'khrugs bcos so: oṃ baṃ bha ti sa mud lam bha ya swā hā:

lo zla zhag dus kyi dgra gshed sdang ba zhi bar gyur cig swā hā: byang shar du phul: hūm̐: phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad dbus gnas pa'i: lo zlar 'khor ba'i sa bdag dang : gza' dang rgyu skar 'gyu ba sogs: snang srid lha srin sde brgyad dang : nyul le bcu gnyis 'khor bcas kyis: mthun pa'i yas stags 'di bzhes la: dgra dang gshed du ma 'bebs shig: lha dang dpal du bskyed par gyis: ko long ru nga zhi ba dang : phrag dog gdug sems ma 'chang cig: oṃ ma ma kun ta shra bā ṇa ye swā hā: dbus su phul lo: de nas spar kha ho yi phyag rgya phyogs su bstan cing : sa bdag gi sgrib shing gtong ba ni: hūm̐: sngon tshe sangs rgyas bco ldan 'das: byang chub shing drung bzhugs pa'i tshe: 'khor 'das gnyis kyi sa mtshams gzigs: srid snang tshogs drug zil gyis mnan: snod kyi 'gyu ba phra rags bcom: 'byung lnga'i 'phro 'du dbang du bsdus: ye shes 'bar ba'i phyag rgya yis: lo zla snyoms shing dgra gshed zhi: de bzhin de ring rgyu sbyor gyis: ye shes ho yi phyag rgyas bsdams: de 'og bsam yas mchims phu ru: gtsug lag sa 'dul bgyis pa'i tshe: dregs 'dul pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: rdo rje mi shigs phyag rgya yis: myang 'das snod bcud shugs las mnan: srid pa gsum gyi sgrib shing gdab: lha 'dres 'khrugs grol gdug rtsub zhi: de bzhin de ring rgyu sbyor gyis: spar kha ho yi phyag rgyas bsdams: 'byung ba kun gyi phrag dog rnams: srung ba 'di yis zhi gyur cig: lo yi dgra gshed bsal du gsol: oṃ shang shang shing shing dha rod dha la ma ru pa ye a par yang gyang ta shrī sarba e haṃ ya ti twa shud+dhe ho dzñā na badz+ra pañtsa ye swā hā: lo zla zhag dus kyi dgra dang gshed kha dur kha bye ba thams cad zhi bar gyur cig swā hā: zhes pas phyogs su 'dzugs: snang brgyad snying po ni: oṃ a ka ni ni ka ni a byi la maṇ+ḍa le maṇ+ḍa le swā hā:

zhes ci nus bzlas so: mthar bkra shis brjod cing phrin las kyi bya ba gang dgos la 'jug go: 7 zhes pa 'di bka' brgyad gsang ba zil gnon gyi zhi khro'i gzhung nas khol du phyung zhing cung zad kha sab 'os 'dug pa rang blos brgyan te/ bdag ngag dbang dkon mchog bstan rgyal gyis sbyar bas/ nyes mchis rtsa gsum chos srung gter bdag tshogs la bshags shing*/ dge ba'i cha mchis ris med 'gro la bsngo/ sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ gtor ma cha gsum gyi rim pa ni/ bla ma dang dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ rdo rje theg pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i cho ga'i skabs su cha gsum gtor ma rgyas 'bring bsdus pa'i tshul ji snyed cig gsungs pa las 'di ltar shes par bya ste/ rin po che la sogs pa'i snod gsum gyi dang po gnyis su phyogs skyong dang 'byung po spyi'i gtor zlum mtheb skyu can 'bras chan la phug sogs dkar zhing gtsang ba'i bza' bca'i tshogs kyis brgyan pa dang*/ gsum pa bgegs kyi gtor ma ting lo changs bu can sha chang sogs kyis sbags pa rnams gral rim gyis bshams la/ bsangs chus sbran te/ rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi rgyas/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐/ gis bsangs/ rdo rje me'i rgyas/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha bhañdzar ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes dang*/ swa bhā wa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i snod zab cing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ lan gsum gyis thun mong du byin gyis brlab bo/ de nas gtor ma dang po phyogs skyong bcu la 'bul te/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis phyogs skyong 'khor bcas spyan drangs par bsams la/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ phyogs skyong 'jig rten skyong ba dbang dang ldan/ /thugs rje thabs mkhas thugs dam dkyel po che/

/lha dang drang srong yi dwags srin po klu/ /rig 'dzin rgyal po dang ni gnod sbyin bdag /de dag so so'i dbang po'i skur ston pa/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten skyong ba bzhugs so 'tshal/ /bstan pa rgyas pa'i slad du spyan 'dren na/ /'gro ba'i don du mchod kyis gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ da sha dika lo ka pa la sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi zhes spyan drangs/ pad+ma ka ma la ye satwaṃ gyis gdan phul la/ oṃ in+d+ra ya/ ag+na ye/ ya mā ye/ nai ri d+ya/ wa ru ṇā ya/ wā ya we/ ku be rā ya/ ī sha nā ya/ ūd+dhaṃ/ brah+mā ya/ sūr+ya gra ha a dhi pa ta ye/ tsan+d+ra nak+ṣa tra a dhi pa ta ye/ a dho pṛ thi we bh+yaḥ a su re bh+yaḥ nā ge bh+yaḥ sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ in+d+rā sogs sngar gyi sngags mthar/ na maḥ sarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa sogs btags pa gsum gyis gtor ma phul la/ dbang po rdo rje 'chang ba'i lha/ /lha yi rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar phyogs gdon gyi tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /me de bsreg bya za ba'i lha/ /drang srong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar lho gdon gyi tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /gshin rje be con 'chang ba'i lha/ /ma mo'i rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /lho phyogs gdon gyi tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /bden dang bral ba legs ldan lha/ /srin po'i rgyal po gdon gyi bdag / lho nub gdon gyi tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /zhags pa thogs pa chu yi lha/ /klu yi rgyal po gdon gyi bdag / nub phyogs gdon gyi tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /rlung ste srog kyang 'dzin pa'i lha/ /rig 'dzin rgyal po gdon gyi bdag / nub byang gdon gyi tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /gnod sbyin lag na dbyug tho thogs/

/nor bsrung rgyal po gdon gyi bdag / byang phyogs gdon gyi tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ dbang dang ldan pa 'dren pa'i lha/ /'byung po'i rgyal po gdon gyi bdag / byang shar dbang ldan tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /steng gi tshangs pa chen po dang*/ /nyi ma zla ba gza' chen po/ /gza' dang rgyu skar bcas pa la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /'og gi klu ste sa yi lha/ /sa 'dzin lag pa chen po dang*/ /dam tshig shes pa'i tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ zhes pas bstod/ shar phyogs rdo rje can gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas/ /gtor ma phul ba 'di dag bzhes su gsol/ /me dang gshin rje bden bral srin po'i bdag /chu bdag rlung bdag nor gyi bdag po dang*/ /dbang ldan lha ste 'byung po'i bdag po dang*/ /steng gi nyi zla tshangs pa chen po dang*/ /lha rnams kun dang gang dag sa steng klu/ /ri yi lha dang gtsang ma'i tshogs bcas la/ /sa sa so sor gtor ma phul ba rnams/ /rab tu dgyes pa yis ni bzhes nas kyang*/ /rang rang phyogs su legs par bzhugs nas su/ /rang gi bu smad mdza' bshes gnyen 'dun dang*/ /nang mi dmag dang dpung bcas lhan cig tu/ /me tog dri dang byug pa bdug par bcas/ /bstod dang gtor ma mar me gus 'bul na/ /'di dag gsol zhing legs par bsnams nas kyang*/ /bdag gi las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ ces phrin las gsol/ oṃ da sha dika sogs kyi mthar gats+tsha btags pas gshegs su gsol/ gtor ma gnyis pa 'byung po spyi la 'bul te/ lha dang lha min gnod sbyin lto phye grul/ /nam mkha' lding dang 'dab bzang lus srul po/ /dri za srin po gdon gyi rigs rnams dang*/ /gang dag sa la gnas pa'i rdzu 'phrul can/ /bu smad bcas shing g.yog 'khor bcas pa la/ /bdag gi pus mo sa la btsugs nas ni/ /thal mo sbyar nas khyod la gsol 'debs kyis/

/gsan nas phan gdags slad du 'dir gshegs shig /oṃ sarba lo ka pa la e h+ye hi spyan drangs/ pad+ma ka ma la ye satwaṃ gyis gdan phul/ oṃ de ba/ nā ga /yak+sha/ rak+sha/ gan+dharba/ a su ra/ ga ru ḍa/ ki ni ra/ ma ho rā ga /ma nu ṣ+ya/ a ma nu ṣ+ya/ sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ rdor thal gyen du phye ste oṃ de ba sogs sngar gyi sngags mthar na maḥsarba sogs btags pa gsum gyis gtor ma phul la/ 'byung po gang dag ri rab steng gnas dang*/ /dga' ba'i tshal dang lha yi gnas rnams dang*/ /shar nub ri dang nyi zla'i khyim rnams dang*/ ri bo kun la gang dag gnas pa dang*/ /rin chen gling na lhag par gang gnas dang*/ /chu bo kun dang chu yi mdo rnams dang*/ /mtsho dang rdzing bu lteng ka chu ngogs dang*/ /g.ya' chu bsil ma can na gang gnas dang*/ /grong dang phyugs lhas grong khyer stong ba dang*/ khang stong dag dang lha yi khang pa dang*/ /gtsug lag khang dang mchod rten gnas rnams dang*/ /dka' thub gnas dang glang chen bres rnams dang*/ /rgyal po'i dkor khang dag na gang gnas dang*/ /lam srang sum mdo dang ni bzhi mdo dang*/ gang dag lam po che dang shing gcig drung*/ /dur khrod chen po nags tshal chen po dang*/ /seṅge dred dang gcan gzan gnas rnams dang*/ /'brog chen 'jigs su rung bar gang gnas dang*/ /gang dag gling mchog dag na gnas pa dang*/ /lhun po dur khrod dag na gnas pa rnams/ /rab tu dgyes shing mgu bar gyur nas su/ /phreng ba dri dang byug pa me tog dang*/ /bstod dang gtor ma mar me gus 'bul na/ /'di dag gsol zhing legs par bsnams nas kyang*/ /bdag gi las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ ces phrin las bcol/ ye dharmā dang*/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya ste/ /dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad/ /rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ zhes chos kyi sbyin pa bya/ oṃ sarba lo ka pā la gats+tsha/ zhes gshegs su gsol/ gsum pa bgegs la bsngo ste/

badz+ra ma hā shrī he ru ko3haṃ/ rang nyid rdo rje khro bo'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcings te/ na mo/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ gsang sngags rigs sngags gzungs sngags snying po phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyis bgegs kyi rigs gang yin pa de dag thams cad skad cig yud tsam la 'dir mchis par gyur cig /oṃ ḍāk+ki hūṃ dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ oṃ guṃ ka ri guṃ ka ri swā hā/ oṃ pi tsi pi tsi swā hā/ oṃ guṃ guṃ swā hā/ sarba bigh+naṃn gṛh+na daṃ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ rdor thal se gol bcas pas oṃ guṃ ka ri sogs gong gi sngags mthar sarba bigh+nan na ma: sogs gsum gyis gtor ma sbyin la/ gang zhig mtshan mo rgyu ba yi/ /'byung po rnams dang sha za dang*/ /srin po sha rjen za ba dang*/ /sems can rnam pa sna tshogs pa/ /ljon shing gel pa sogs gnas dang*/ /de dang de la gtor ma ni/ /bza' ba sha chang la phug bcas/ /'bras chan 'bras bu mang po yis/ /mchod pa 'di yis mgu byos la/ /gnod pa'i bsam pa zhi ba dang*/ /bdag cag rnams la phan pa'i yid/ /de ring phyin chad bskyed par gyis/ /rgyan gyis brgyan par byas kyang chos spyod cing*/ /dul zhing yang dag sdom la tshangs par spyad/ /'byung po kun la chad pa spangs pa ste/ /dge slong dge sbyong de yin bram ze'ang de/ /mtshon chas mi 'jigs gang yang med/ /'tsho ba'i srog la kun kyang 'dzems/ /rang gi lus la dpe long la/ /gzhan la gnod pa ma byed cig oṃ/ chen po'am chung ngu gang dag gis/ /lus la mngon par gnod gyur pa'i/ /nad de nye bar phyungs nas su/ /gdon de rang gi gnas su dengs/ /de ltar bdag gis ci nus kyis/

/mchod dang bsnyen bkur byas pa yis/ /dam tshig la ni gnas nas su/ /bdag gi bsam pa skong bar mdzod/ /rtag tu dam tshig la gnas shing*/ /'dir ni sems can thams cad kyi/ /nad de rab tu sol mdzod la/ /gdon rnams rang gi gnas su song*/ zhes dang*/ chos kyi sbyin pa gong bzhin byas la/ sarba bigh+naṃ gats+tshas gshegs shing*/ gang dag gdug cing rtsub pa'i sems 'chang ba thams cad rdo rje khro bo'i sbyor bas hūm̐ bzhi pa'i sngags dang rol mo'i sgra drag pos bskrad par bya zhing gtor ma rnams gtsang sar rim pa bzhin dor/ slar yang*/ 'byung po gang dag 'dir ni lhags gyur tam/ /sa 'am 'on te bar snang 'khod kyang rung*/ /skye rgu rnams la rtag tu byams byed cing*/ /nyin dang mtshan du chos la spyod par shog /ces smon lam gdab par bya'o/ /gtor ma cha gsum gyi cho ga 'di ni snga 'gyur bka' ma'i yig cha du ma dang*/ sgrub chen bde gshegs 'dus pa'i gtor chog sogs las btus shing*/ phyi 'gyur ba'i lugs dang yang mi 'gal bar mtshungs par byas te shākya'i dge bsnyen rig pa 'dzin pa 'gyur med rdo rjes sbyar ba'o//

༈ o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i ring lugs rgyun gsol phyogs bsdus cung zad rgyas pa'i lugs su bkod pa phrin las srid zhi kun khyab ces bya ba bzhugs so/ na ma shrī badz+ra dharma pā la ye/ skye med chos dbyings mkha' las 'gag med snying rje khros pa'i rtsal chen gyis/ /shugs sgrol dmod pa'i 'brug stong ldir zhing drag shul thog rgod bye ba'i char/ /cig car bsnyil las srid gsum gdug pa thal bar brlag dang chab gcig tu/ /bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan srid zhi'i bla ru sgreng mdzad dam can tshogs rnams rgyal/ /de la 'dir o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i ring lugs rdo rje chos skyong rgya mtsho phrin las bskang gsol rgyas pa bklag chog tu 'god pa la/ rdo rje chos skyong rnams kyi bka' yis gnang ba stsal du gsol/ de la'ang sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi/ thog mar sbyor ba bca' bshams kyi bkod pa dang*/ dngos gzhi phrin las kyi cho ga nag 'gros su bkod pa gnyis la/ dang po bca' shom gyi rim pa ni zur gsal ltar byas la/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gong gnon yi dam rgyas bsdus skabs dang bstun/ bsdus pa'i dbang du byas na/ hūm̐: o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams: pad+ma ge sar sdong po la: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes: pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag bsgrub kyi: byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i dgongs pa yis: lhun grub phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin dang : rdo rje thod phreng rtsal la byin brlabs te: 'das dang ma byon da lta dus gsum gyi: phrin las brgyud pa'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs: o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs: kun bzang rdor sems dga' rab shrī sing*/ /pad+ma kā ra rje 'bangs nyi shu lnga/ /so zur gnubs gnyags gter ston brgya rtsa brgyad/

/dus gsum rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams/ /ngo bo gcig bsdus o rgyan rin po che/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad zhi ba dang*/ /chos skyong bran du khol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /rang bzhin chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*/ /'bar ba'i cho 'phrul gar gyi rol pa yis/ /rnam 'phrul du mas sangs rgyas bstan pa srung*/ /ma mgon lcam dral dam pa'i chos skyong rnams/ /ngo bo gcig bsdus o rgyan rin po che/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad zhi ba dang*/ /chos skyong bran du khol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /de ltar rtse gcig gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ /phyi nang bar chad bdud sde'i g.yul ngo las/ /rnam rgyal dpa' bo khrag 'thung he ru ka'i/ go 'phang dam pa tshe 'dir thob gyur cig /ces ka ma rā dza dī pas yig rnying las kha bsgyur te bris pa dge/ // ༈ rdo rje phur pa'i bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs ni/ rigs kun khyab bdag kun bzang he ru ka /dgongs brgyud rdor sems brda brgyud dga' rab rdor/ /snyan brgyud ston pa 'jam dpal bshes gnyen zhabs/ /tshig gi brgyud pa shrī singha la/ /gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /don gyi brgyud pa pra chen hastī'i zhabs/ /gter rgya'i brgyud pa go byi de ma lcam/ /byin rlabs dbang bskur brgyud pa pad+ma 'byung*/ /dam rdzas shog ser brgyud pa mtsho rgyal mar/ /gsol ba 'debs so? /smon lam lung bstan bud+dha dzñā na'i mtshan/ /zab mo gter gyi brgyud pa rtsa gsum gling*/ /smin grol bka' gtad brgyud pa tra ya sogs/ /chos bdag lung bstan dzñā na dh+wa dza la/ /gsol ba 'debs so? /yang dag rdo rje gsal byed he ru ka /che mchog yab yum badz+ra ku mā ra/ /'khor lo rgyas 'debs kī la rigs bzhi dang*/ khro bcu yab yum phra thabs 'khor bcas la/

/gsol ba 'debs so? /dbang phyug nyer brgyad sgo skyong chen mo bzhi/ /shwa na sa bdag re ti ging bdud sogs/ /bka' gter srung ma yongs rdzogs sprul 'khor bcas/ /snang srid phur pa'i dkyil 'khor rol pa la/ /gsol ba 'debs so? /rdzas kyi phur bus ma rig gdon bgegs bskrad/ /thugs rje'i phur bus rigs drug gnas nas sgrol/ /byang sems phur bus zung 'jug mkha' dbyings sbyor/ /chos dbyings phur bus phyir mi ldog pa'i sar/ /sku gsum phur bus khams gsum bsgral nus shog /de skad rang gis ngag 'don bya ba'i ched du ku mā ri'i sa ma dhi la gnas pa dad pa'i tshul ldan au ḍi ming gis bris pa'o// // bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: las byang phrin las rgyun khyer yid bzhin nor bu bzhugs so: dpal chen yang dag rdo rje gzhon nur 'dud: sa ma ya: e ma bdag 'dra rdo rje thod phreng rtsal: yang zab sgrub pa snying gi thig le las: gsang ba'i las byang yid bzhin nor bu bstan: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal mi brjed gzungs kyis zungs: yi ger thob la rin chen gter du sbos: ma 'ongs yang mtha' dus kyi tha ma la: bdud rigs sems can dmu rgod rnam rtog rags: de yi rkyen gyis dug lnga'i chos shig dar: gsang sngags chos kyi sgrom bu bun ltar gtor: sdug bsngal rnam smin las dbang zad mtha' med: sems can skyabs med dbul phongs a tsa ma: gang phyir pad 'byung nga yi smon lam gyis: gnubs kyi lo tsā bud+dha dzñā na 'di: skye ba du mar sems can 'gro don byed: lan gcig yul gyi stod dag la: pad+ma gter bdag gling zhes yongs grags nas: bod 'bangs skyob pa'i gter kha dpag med 'byin: ma 'ongs de dus zab chos 'di 'byung ste: 'brel tshad byang chub thob par lung yang bstan: bka' yi rgya 'di ma mo gsum gyis srungs: gter min bdud rigs lag tu ma sprod par: pad 'byung nga yi thugs sras de dang sprod:

gnas chen sha 'ug stag sgoṛ atsha rgya: sgra gcan me rlung gwa'u dmar nag rgya: dang po thun mong sngon 'gro bcu bzhi dang : dngos gzhir nyer gcig rjes la bcu gnyis so: dang po rgyud dang dbyer med sngon 'gro ni: dang po skyabs 'gro ni: na mo: gdod nas lhun grub gnyug ma'i rtsa ba gsum: kun tu rang sems ma g.yos skyabs su mchi: gnyis pa sems bskyed ni: hoḥ 'khor 'das mnyam yangs phyogs lhung bye brag gnad: legs par rtogs pa'i de bzhin sems bskyed do: gsum pa bgegs dgug pa ni: hūm̐: nga nyid ye nas rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku: thugs rje'i rang rtsal 'gyed pa pho nya'i tshogs: bar med khyab pas bgegs tshogs ma lus kun: a 'thas gzhom phyir gtor ma len par khug: oṃ badz+ra ṭāk+ki rā dza hūm̐ dzaḥ gnyis 'dzin ru tra a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ bzhi pa bgegs bskrad pa ni: hūm̐: snying rje'i sbyin yul ma rig bgegs kyi tshogs: rtog med de bzhin gtor mas tshim par dengs: ci ste mi 'gro zhen pas bcings srid na: rig pa rdo rje'i mtshon char des choms shig: oṃ badz+ra bidh+wa dzñā na mā ra sarba bigh+nān tshin+dha tshin+dha hūm̐ phaṭḥ lnga pa srung 'khor bsgom pa ni: ham̐'u: rdo rje gsum gyi dkyil 'khor bdag: ye nas ma bcos gzhal yas khang : rang bzhin rlung lngas srung ba'i gur: so 'thab 'khrigs pas mtshams chod cig: oṃ badz+ra tra ya maṇ+ḍa la yaṃ pañtsa sarba badz+ra rak+ṣa ye swā hā: drug pa phyi mchod byin brlab ni: hūm̐: ye nas tshogs drug lha mo'i gar: phyi mchod kun bzang mchod sprin gyur: oṃ sarba puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: bdun pa nang mchod byin brlab ni: hūm̐: thabs shes bde stong snod yangs mchog: nyi zla zhu ba'i bdud rtsi che: oṃ a haṃ pū dza hoḥ brgyad pa sman mchod byin brlab ni: hūm̐: 'dus byas rnam dag stong pa'i snod: phung khams skye mched bdud rtsi spel:

oṃ a mṛ ta āḥhūm̐: dgu pa rak+ta byin brlab ni: hūm̐: rdo rje'i mtshon bsnun ma rig bsgral: rgyud drug dmar chen sna tshogs gyur: oṃ rak+ta pañtsa āḥhūm̐: bcu pa gtor ma byin brlab ni: hūm̐: kun gzhi lhun grub bhan+dha ru: rnam thar bcu gnyis gtor mar gyur: oṃ ba liṃ ta pū dza hūm̐: bcu gcig pa byin dbab pa ni: hūm̐: rtsa ba gsum gyi brgyud pa yis: sku lnga ye shes byin phob cig: oṃ a be sha ya a tiṣ+ṭhi te ham̐'u: bcu gnyis pa brda sgo dbye ba ni: hūm̐: rang rig lta ba'i zhal mjal phyir: rnam dag thugs kyi brda sgo dbye: oṃ badz+ra pra be sha ya phaṭḥ bcu gsum pa brda bshags ni: hūm̐: ye nas 'khor 'das gnyis su med: de don ma rtogs gol bar bshags: oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya shud+dhe āḥ bcu bzhi pa bsgrub par dam bca' ni: hūm̐: gnas lugs rig pa'i gzungs thag gis: rang rtsal dkyil 'khor mi gtong bsgrub: oṃ badz+ra tsit+ta hūm̐: gnyis pa dngos gzhi la: dang po de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin ni: hūm̐: chos dbyings klong chen kun tu khyab: ngo bo lhun grub blo 'das ngang : oṃ dharma swa bhā hoḥ gnyis pa kun tu snang ba'i ting 'dzin ni: hūm̐: rang bzhin ma grub rtsal chen gyis: sgyu ma'i rlung gis cho 'phrul 'gyed: oṃ swa bhā dharmā hūm̐: gsum pa rgyu'i ting 'dzin ni: hūm̐: kun tu sgyu ma'i snying po yis: mkha' ltar bdag med sa bon shar: oṃ hūm̐ baṃ dharma hri da ya hūm̐: bzhi pa de las klong lnga yum gyi mkha' klong gsal gdab pa ni: hūm̐: bskal par brtsegs pa'i 'byung lnga la: sor rtog yi ge rim par shar: hūm̐ e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐ keṃ bh+rūm̐: lnga pa rgyu'i he ru ka rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum bskyed pa ni: hūm̐: gdan steng yab yum sbyor ba'i sras: 'khor tshogs zhal phyag ma 'dres rdzogs: oṃ pad+ma sūr+ya ti ra bam̐: maṇ+ḍa la bh+rūm̐ swa bhā haṃ swā hā: drug pa 'bras bu rten gzhal yas khang bsgom pa ni:

hūm̐: e las nam mkha' yam̐ las rlung : ram̐ las me ri kham̐ las chu: sum̐ las sa gzhi keṃ rus ri: bh+rūm̐ las lhun grub gzhal yas khang : gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs rdzogs: dbus su mdzes tog phyi rol gur: mtshan tshang drag po'i pho brang bsgom: oṃ bh+rūm̐ dzñā na hūm̐: bdun pa brten pa bdag rtsa ba'i lha tshogs bsgom pa ni: hūm̐: de dbus rdo rje brag dmar dang : pad+ma nyi zla bam gyi steng : hūm̐ yig mthing nag 'phro 'dus las: che mchog yang dag he ru kaḥ dbu dgu g.yas dkar g.yon dmar khro: bco brgyad phyag mtshan rim pa bzhin: gri gug ral gri dbyug to dang : rdo rje tho ba gsal shing khyung : 'khor lo nor bu bcas pa g.yas: bhan+dha kha ṭ+wāṃ thong gshol rnga: lcags sgrog rgyu ma dril bu zhags: phur pa dang bcas g.yon du bsnams: sgro gshog brgyangs shing dur khrod chas: zhabs brgyad khro rol gyad kyi 'gros: kro ti shwa rī yum dang sbyor: zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad: gri thod drug bcas mgul 'khyud stob: sku las skyes pa'i me ri 'bar: oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro ta pad+ma kro ti shwa rī hūm̐ bh+yoḥ hūm̐: dpal chen 'bar ba'i thugs ka ru: nī laṃ mchod rten sngon po'i dbus: bum pa gzhal yas lte ba'i nang : pad+ma nyi zla 'bar ba'i steng : ma hā badz+ra ku mā ra: mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa: mthing dkar dmar ba'i rngam zhal brjid: rdo rje rtse dgu rtse lnga g.yas: me dpung 'bar ba kha ṭ+wāṃ g.yon: mtha' gnyis ri rab phur pa bsgril: sgro gshog brgyangs shing dur khrod chas: zhabs bzhi gyad kyi dor stabs brjid: yum mchog 'khor lo rgyas 'debs mthing : rdo rje thod khrag stobs te 'khril: thugs kar sems dpa' srog yig bcas: mi bzad 'bar ba'i klong du gsal: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ sras sogs khro bo'i dkyil 'khor gyi sprin bkod pa/ hūm̐: yab yum rdo rje pad+ma'i tog:

bu ga'i yi ge dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zung 'jug bde stong rol pa las: hūm̐ bzhi baṃ bzhi sras su shar: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: rdo rje rin chen pad+ma dang : las kyi rigs te khrag 'thung bzhi: zhal gsum phyag drug sku smad dbal: rtse dgu rtse lnga me kha ṭ+wāṃ: phyag gi mtha' gnyis phur pa bsgril: rigs bzhi yum 'khril sgro gshog brgyangs: dur khrod chas ldan gar dgur gsal: oṃ badz+ra kro ta kro ti tsa tur hūm̐ bh+yoḥ hūm̐: yab yum gsang ba'i bu ga nas: hūm̐ yig baṃ yig phyogs bcur 'phro: khro bcu yab yum mthing nag rngam: zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad: dur khrod chas ldan sgro gshog brgyangs: rang 'dra'i yum 'khyud phra thabs gsal: oṃ badz+ra kro ta kro ti dā sha ka hūm̐ phaṭḥ 'khor tshogs bka' sdod kyi dkyil 'khor phra thabs tshul du bskyed pa/ hūm̐: slar yang sprul pa yang sprul tshogs: dbang phyug nyer brgyad 'bar ba'i gar: phur skyong nyer bzhi mi bzad tshogs: yang 'khor sprul sogs so sor gsal: oṃ ma ti kro ti ghṛ wa lak+ṣi hūm̐ bh+yoḥ brgyad pa dbang bskur byin brlab ni/ hūm̐: ye shes phur pa bskyed pa'i lha: gsal rdzogs mi g.yo brtan pa'i phyir: deng 'dir dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ a be sha ya hoḥ oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: dgu pa spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐: ye shes rol pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: yang dag dpal chen phur pa'i lha: bdag la dbang bskur byin brlab phyir: thugs rjes brtser dgongs gshegs su gsol: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥdzaḥ bcu pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐: rang bzhin brtan pa'i rgyud rtsal lha: bzhugs mdzad dgyes pa'i gad rgyangs can: gdod nas ma bcos rang byung ba: rol pa'i khrag 'thung che la 'dud: oṃ sarba tsit+ta tiṣ+ṭha lhan: na maḥsarba hāṃ sa pū ru sha ya hoḥ bcu gcig pa phyi mchod 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: dbang po'i 'bras bu tshim byed pa:

lha mo sna tshogs phyi mchod 'bul: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ya shab+da āḥhūm̐: bcu gnyis pa nang mchod 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: bde stong ye shes bdud rtsi mchog: bla med mchog gi mchod pa 'bul: oṃ sarba a haṃ pañtsa khā hi: bcu gsum pa gsang mchod 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: rig ma bcu drug mi phyed sbyor: gnyis med gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul: oṃ gu h+ya dzñā na pū dza hoḥ bcu bzhi pa sman mchod 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi mchog: dug lnga rnam dag sman mchod 'bul: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi: bco lnga pa rak+ta'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: 'khor 'das rgyud drug bsgral ba yi: dmar chen rak+ta'i mchod pa 'bul: oṃ ma hā rak+ta khā hi: bcu drug pa gtor ma'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: phung po lnga nyid ye shes su: bsgyur ba'i ba ling mchod pa 'bul: oṃ ba liṃ ta khā hi: bcu bdun pa tshogs mchod 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: tshogs mchod spyan gzigs mchod pa'i sprin: nyams chag bskang dang bshags phyir 'bul: oṃ ga ṇa tsakra khā hi: sa ma ya shud+dhe hoḥ bco brgyad pa de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: mchod yul bskang bya mi dmigs pa: kho na de bzhin nyid kyis mchod: oṃ sarba dharmā swa bhā wa pū dza hoḥ bcu dgu pa bstod pa ni/ hūm̐: che btsan yang dag he ru kaḥ rngam pa'i hūm̐ sgra 'brug ltar sgrog: bco brgyad mtshon chas dug lnga gzhom: sgro gshog dbyings kyi mkha' la bgrad: dur khrod chas brgyad dpa' bar 'gro: dor stabs zhabs kyis ri rab brdzis: sbyor ba'i yum chen shwa ri ma: bde stong zung 'jug gri thod bsnams: rgyan drug rol pa'i gar stabs can: dpal chen yab yum sku la bstod: hūm̐: thugs mchog rdo rje bzhad pa po: khro bo'i zhal rab gdangs shing rngam: phyag mtshan drug gis rig sngags gcod: rdo rje sgro gzengs me char 'bebs: dgyes pa'i dur khrod chas dang ldan:

dor stabs 'gying zhing dpa' rab 'chang : 'khor lo rgyas 'debs rtsa 'jib ma: khams kun g.yo ba'i zhal mnga' ma: zung 'jug thabs shes 'khyud pa mo: mnyen lcug 'khril ldem sgra 'byin ma: drug gis sbyor ba'i nyams ldan ma: bde chen g.yo zhing g.yo ba mo: thugs mchog yab yum sku la bstod: hūm̐: ting 'dzin gsum gyi sems dpa' che: yi ge hūm̐ gi rgyu nyid las: rdo rje rab tu 'bar ba'i mchog: sems dpa' rdo rje'i sku la bstod: hūm̐: 'bar ba'i gar gyis rnam rol ba'i: las bzhi'i phrin las dpal yon gyis: mi zad lta ba'i gar 'gyed pa: rigs bzhi'i sras la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: sprul pa chen po khyon gyi rtse: khyab cing sgeg bzhad ston pa po: sa bcu'i lam ni rab bgrod pa: yab yum khro bcur phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: zer gyis snang tshul cho 'phrul gyis: khyon ltar lta ba yangs shing 'geng : 'bebs pa rdo rje phur pa'i tshogs: phra thabs phur 'debs phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: nyer bzhi sa yi rim pa bdun: shes rab gcig la thabs drug gis: skur ston gar sgyur nyi shu brgyad: dbang phyug ma mo'i tshogs la bstod: hūm̐: skye mched gnas gsum gzhir dag pa'i: rol rtsal za byed mche ba dmar: las su grub pa'i ma mo'i tshogs: ma sring bcu gnyis khyod la bstod: hūm̐: las mdzad mā ra ya yi tshul: sna tshogs sde dpon gtso dang 'khor: za gsod dbugs la rngam byed tshogs: bcu gnyis sde dpon khyod la bstod: hūm̐: ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje yi: rtsal gyis sprul pa pho nya'i tshogs: srid gsum 'geng ba'i las byed pa: yongs rdzogs 'khor dang bcas la bstod: nyi shu pa bsnyen pa ni/ hūm̐: mi mngon chos dbyings mthing nag e klong nas: khrag 'thung rdo rje phur pa'i lha tshogs dang : yang dag he ru ka yi gtso 'khor bcas: gdul dka' 'gro ba'i don du skur bzhengs shig: snang srid 'khor 'das gzugs can gzugs med dang :

kun bzang thugs dang 'jag ma'i srin bu yan: snang gzugs thams cad rdo rje phur pa'i sku: sgra grags thams cad kī li'i drag sngags sgra: dran rtog thams cad rdo rje ting nge 'dzin: yin min ngos bzung bral ba'i dbyings chen por: the tshom zad pas bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rgyal: re dogs bral ba'i chos nyid klong du bzla: yang dag gi rtsa bsnyen/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro ta pad+ma kro ti shwa rī hūm̐ bh+yoḥ phur pa'i bsnyen pa/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya bigh+nān trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ spyi dril gyi sngags/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro ta kī li kī la ya sarba maṇ+ḍal tsakra hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐ sgrub ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: bdag nyid dpal chen he ru kaḥ 'jigs byed rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku: kham nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa: khro gtum tshwa tshwa skar ltar 'khrugs: g.yas gnyis gnam lcags rdo rje yis: ma rungs gdug pa'i ban bon 'joms: g.yon gnyis me dpung kha ṭ+wāṃ gyis: sde brgyad 'byung po'i srog snying phral: mtha' gnyis ri rab phur pa yis: rgyal bsen 'gong po rdul du rlog: sgro gshog spu gri brgyangs pa yis: snang srid kun gyi cho 'phrul zlog: 'jigs pa'i dur khrod chas brgyad kyis: ye shes 'jig rten zil gyis gnon: lte bar chu srin rngam zhal gyis: dam sri 'dre rgod snying khrag rol: sku smad gnam lcags phur gsham gyis: stong khams ru tra'i srog dbugs phral: sku la me dpung 'khrigs pa yis: log 'dren bdud bzhi'i dpung tshogs bsreg: yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs 'khril: khro rgyal stobs ldan kī la ya: bdud 'dul dpal gyi sku ru shar: dbang sdud zil gnon lhun gyis grub: bdud dgra tshar gcod las grub gyur: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: grags stong ngang du ci nus bzlas: sa ma ya: dbyangs gsal yig brgya dang*/ mchod bstod ni/ oṃ/ shrī badz+ra ku mā ra sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/

hūm̐: ma bcos lhun grub rdo rje gzhon nu'i dpal: sku yi rgyan rdzogs gar dgus sa gsum g.yo: gsung gis hūm̐ sgra'i drag sngags 'brug ltar sgrogs: thugs mchog mi g.yo yang dag 'khor lo'i gter: bde chen rang bzhin zung 'jug he ru kaḥ 'jigs byed khro rgyal yab yum sku la bstod: nyer gcig dzapa ྄bskul dam bca' ni/ dzaḥ dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab: deng 'dir bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor lha: thugs dam gnyan po dbyings nas bskul: srog ltar mi gtong bsgrubs lags na: dbang dang dngos grub 'dir stsol cig: oṃ sarba gar+bha sid+dhi hūm̐: ༈ rig 'dzin srog sgrub yid bzhin nor bu las: gtor bsngos bsdus pa phrin las myur mgyogs bzhugs so: rig 'dzin rgyal ba kun 'dus tshogs la gus pas 'dud: de yang rig 'dzin 'dus pa rtsa ba'i lha tshogs rnams kyi dkyil 'khor ma lus shing rab 'byams zhing gi rdul snyed rnams gcig tu bsdus nas: tshogs zhing gi mchod pa la 'jug par brtsam na: kho mo mtsho rgyal bdag gis sgrig chog 'di ltar bgyi'o: sa ma ya: thog mar dngos 'byor gyi mchod pa rgyas bsdus ci rigs bkod pa ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis sbyangs/ 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs par bgyis nas 'bul: ma 'grigs tshe yid sprul rgyas btab blo dang bstun pa'i 'dun pa bya: oṃ raṃ aḥyaṃ hūm̐ khaṃ sarba swā hā: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ha ho hrī hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dho sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las rlung me thod sgyed kyi steng du bh+rūm̐ smug po las byung ba'i thod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du bh+rūm̐ e dzeṃ kheṃ be ra shu la 'bru brgyad zhu ba las byung ba'i sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga'i rang bzhin du gyur: thod pa'i kha chod nyi zla rdo rje'i yu ba can: steng nyi ma la ā li: 'og zla ba la kā li: bar mu khyud la rten 'brel snying po: rdo rje'i yar gyi rwa lnga la oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ

mar gyi rwa lnga la mūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐: bhan+dha'i kha khyer phyogs bzhir dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes pa'i yi ge de rnams kyi sgras bskul ba'i rigs lnga yab yum gyis sbyor ba mdzad: sbyor mtshams nas bdud rtsi dkar dmar gyi rgyun babs pas dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang ye shes kyi bdud rtsi gcig tu 'dres ting nge 'dzin gyi bdud rtsir gyur: thabs kyi rlung g.yos shes rab kyi me sbar bdag 'dzin gyi dri ma sbyangs shing bdud rtsi khol: lbu ba'i rlangs pa las byung ba'i oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs/ shab+da rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she lā s+ye mā l+ye gīrti nīrti swa ra swa tī sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta māṃ sa tsit+ta go ro tsa na bha su ta pū dza me gha swā hā: zhes pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis sa dang bar snang nam mkha'i khyon thams cad gang bar gyur: oṃ hūm̐ āḥhrīḥtrām̐ bh+rūm̐ mūm̐ lam̐' mām̐ pām̐ tām̐ dzaḥha ho hrī phaiṃ phaiṃ dza dzaḥ de nas mchod cing lha spyan 'dren pa ni/ hoḥ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dam can chos skyong nor lha gter bdag gter srung gzhan yang phyi rgyud kyi dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu: sngags bdag dregs chen bco brgyad: bka' yi dregs pa sde brgyad 'jigs byed chen po dgu: yul lha gzhi bdag gnas bdag zo dor dang bcas pa rnams skad cig gis spyan drangs: thugs rje dang smon lam gyi bden pa'i dbang gis gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ pad+ma ka ma la ye satwaṃ: de nas bha ling+ta bran pa'o: bdud rtsi yin na mchod: gsur rdzas yin na bsreg: bsgrub gtor yin na mchod kha gso: gtor snod stong gsum tsam gyi 'jig rten bcud kyi skye 'gro 'byung lnga'i dbang du bsdus pa thams cad yi dam lha'i gsol mchod dmigs la 'bul ba ni:

oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum: hūm̐: phyi snod srid gsum yangs pa'i gtor gzhong du: nang bcud 'jig rten bcud kun gtor mar bsgyur: khams gsum 'byung lnga sems can rtsis su gdab: sems kyis ma bzung skye gnas 'jig gsum sogs: zhing rdul brtsegs pa'i grangs med mchod sprin rnams: 'bul byed mchod pa'i lha mo yid 'phrog rigs: nam mkha'i rgyun ltar gang ba'i tshogs rnams kyis: bstod cing bsngags nas btud de 'bul lags na: thugs rje'i brtse bas nyer dgongs bzhes su gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: kun bzang yab yum ston pa rdo rje sems: rin 'byung snang ba mtha' yas don yod grub: spyan ma mā kī gos dkar dam tshig sgrol: rdo rje 'chang sogs sangs rgyas byang sems la: mnyes pa'i dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchod gtor 'bul: gnas lugs chos skur rtogs pa'i phrin las mdzod: i daṃ bha ling+ta la khā hi: hūm̐: gsang ba ye shes dga' rab rdo rje dang : shrī singha mkha' 'gro las kyi dbang : sa la gnas dang phyag rgya tshe la dbang : lhun grub rnam par smin pa'i rig 'dzin dang : dgongs brda brgyud kyi slob dpon thams cad la: mnyes pa'i dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchod gtor 'bul: 'ja' lus mkha' spyod 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod: i daṃ bha ling+ta la khā hi: hūm̐: hūm̐ ka ra dang 'jam dpal bshes gnyen dang : klu sgrub snying po pra bha hastī dang : dha na saṃ skṛ bi ma mi tra dang : rom+bu gu h+ya shān+tiṃ gar+bha sogs: rig 'dzin grub thob drang srong thams cad la: mnyes pa'i dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchod gtor 'bul: tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod: i daṃ bha ling+ta la khā hi: hūm̐ḥ rtsa ba'i bla ma o rgyan rin po che: man+da ra ba ye shes mtsho rgyal dang : ka la sid+dhi shākya dhe ma dang : bkra shis khye'u 'dren la sogs mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: snyan brgyud 'dus pa'i slob dpon thams cad la: mnyes pa'i dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchod gtor 'bul:

tshe rabs rjes su bzung ba'i phrin las mdzod: i daṃ bha ling+ta la khā hi: hūm̐ḥ bya rgyud spyod rgyud rnal 'byor bla med rgyud: dam tshig dbang dang man ngag lung dang ni: shes rab rgyud dang nyams chag bskang ba yi: theg pa 'dzin pa'i slob dpon chen po dang : rje 'bangs nyer lnga lung 'dzin sum cu bdun: bka' bab brgyud 'dzin gter ston brgya rtsa brgyad: dbang lung man ngag brgyud dang brgyud 'gyur pa'i: drin can rtsa brgyud bla ma thams cad la: mnyes pa'i dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchod gtor 'bul: mi zad gter la spyod pa'i phrin las mdzod: i daṃ bha ling+ta la khā hi: hūm̐: rdo rje drag po dmar nag me phreng can: 'jam dpal sku dang pad+ma gsung gi lha: yang dag thugs dang che mchog yon tan sku: phrin las phur pa ma mo rbod gtong lha: 'jig rten mchod bstod dmod pa drag sngags pa: ye shes pa dang las su grub pa sogs: sgrub chen bka' brgyad dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: mnyes pa'i dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchod gtor 'bul: mchog thun dngos grub stsol ba'i phrin las mdzod: i daṃ bha ling+ta la khā hi: hūm̐: dbyings kyi dbang phyug mthing 'od 'bar ma dang : rdo rje phag mo rdo rje rnal 'byor ma: rdo rje mkha' 'gro rin chen mkha' 'gro dang : pad+ma mkha' 'gro las kyi mkha' 'gro dang : sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro khros ma nag mo dang : seṅge'i gdong can sna tshogs mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: ma rgyud mkha' 'gro 'khor dang bcas pa la: mnyes pa'i dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchod gtor 'bul: rten 'brel phyogs med 'char ba'i phrin las mdzod: i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha hi: hūm̐: legs ldan nag po phyag bzhi yab yum dang : ma ning gdong bzhi phyag drug bram ze'i gzugs: srog bdag bya rog gdong can bka' 'khor bcas: ye shes mgon po'i lha tshogs 'khor bcas la: mnyes pa'i dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchod gtor 'bul: sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba'i phrin las mdzod:
