i daṃ bha ling+ta la khā hi: hūm̐: dpal 'bar zhing skyong seng gdong yab yum dang : sprul pa las byed baṃ ro pho mo gnyis: bka' yi 'khor bcas dregs pa sde brgyad bcas: stobs ldan bdud mgon nag po 'khor bcas la: mnyes pa'i dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchod gtor 'bul: ma rungs bstan dgra bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: i daṃ bha ling+ta la khā hi: hūm̐: thog 'bebs ljang sngon gza' mchog rā hu la: gza' brgyad gdong mo mched bzhi yab yum dang : skyes bu chen po dam can rdo rje legs: mgar nag sde bzhi mched 'khor sum brgya drug: srog bdag sngags srung e ka dzā ṭi ma: 'dod khams dbang phyug dpal ldan re ma ti: ma mo mched brgyad bswe mo khrag ral can: dam can sde gsum 'khor dang bcas pa la: mnyes pa'i dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchod gtor 'bul: dam sri log 'dren bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: i daṃ bha ling+ta la khā hi: hūm̐: a phyi chos sgron ti sgro sman btsun lnga: rdo rje g.yu sgron ma gcig dpal lha mo: bod skyong bstan srung ming sring 'khor bcas la: mnyes pa'i dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchod gtor 'bul: phrin las spel ba'i kha 'dzin sdongs grogs mdzod: i daṃ bha ling+ta la khā hi: hūm̐: gnod sbyin chen po btsan rgod me 'od gdong : sprul pa sde bzhi rol pa khrag 'thung bzhi: shan pa rlung sgrub gnod sbyin khyung zhon dang : shan pa dmar nag rol pa bco brgyad dang : dgra srog dbang ba'i btsan rgod 'khor bcas la: mnyes pa'i dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchod gtor 'bul: pha rol dgra bo sdig can sgrol bar mdzod: i daṃ bha ling+ta la khā hi: hūm̐: lha yi dge bsnyen tshangs pa dung thod can: srog bdag chos skyong chen po dpe dkar dang : sprul pa sde brgyad yang 'khor bye ba 'bum: dge bsnyen chen po klu bdud ti pa tsa: smyo kha mkhar nag ti pa dam 'dzin sogs: drag rtsal ldan pa'i chos skyong 'khor bcas la: mnyes pa'i dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchod gtor 'bul:

dkor rkun rtsad nas gcod pa'i phrin las mdzod: i daṃ bha ling+ta la khā hi: hūm̐: ma hā dhe wa dbang phyug tshogs kyi bdag: rnam mang thos sras nor bdag dzam bha la: ku we ra dang rta bdag gnod sbyin brgyad: phyugs lha ljang gu dpal ldan nor rgyun ma: lug lha gang bzang ra lha gtsang btsan dang : drel lha dud sol 'bru lha brtan ma sman: mdzo lha khyung rgyal khyi lha bya ra ba: nor bdag dkor cha'i lha tshogs 'khor bcas la: mnyes pa'i dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchod gtor 'bul: dgos 'dod char ltar 'bebs pa'i phrin las mdzod: i daṃ bha ling+ta la khā hi: hūm̐: dregs pa sde brgyad dregs chen bco brgyad dang : sde dpon sum cu dge bsnyen nyi shu gcig: 'jigs byed sde dgu dpal mgon bdun cu gnyis: srid pa'i lha dgu mgul lha bcu gsum dang : gter srung sprul pa yang sprul 'khor bcas la: mnyes pa'i dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchod gtor 'bul: gsang sngags gnyan gyi bya ra 'grub par mdzod: i daṃ bha ling+ta la khā hi: hūm̐: lha klu gnod sbyin gzhi bdag zo dor dang : sa bdag chu bdag me bdag rlung bdag dang : nam mkha'i bdag dang rang bzhin 'gyu ba dang : shing spang rdza dang yul chen dur khrod brgyad: gangs gnyan chen po nyi shu rtsa gcig gi: srung ma gnas dang dus su 'gyu ba dang : gtsang ma ris sogs 'jig rten skyong rnams la: mnyes pa'i dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchod gtor 'bul: lo nyes nad 'khrugs zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod: i daṃ bha ling+ta la khā hi: hūm̐: gzhan yang 'khor ba myang 'das ma lus kyi: ye shes las dang grub pa'i srung ma dang : dkar phyogs lha dang nag phyogs bdud la sogs: mgron du 'os kyang dmigs bsal ma mchis pas: rgya mtsho'i srub dang ri rab zom gyi shod: dpag bsam rtse sogs mkha' lding mi ma yin: tshe rabs bsags pa'i bag chags nyer len rigs: dbang po nyams pa glo bur 'gyu ba sogs: kun bzang thugs dang srin bu phra mo'i sems:

thams cad chos kyi dbyings su bdal gyur pas: las dang ye shes grub pa'i tshogs rnams la: mnyes pa'i dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchod gtor bzhes: tshe rabs lan chags byang ba'i phrin las mdzod: i daṃ bha ling+ta la khā hi: hūm̐: lcang lo can gyi bhan+dha'i snod nang du: rtsa gsum gtor ma phrin las bzhi ldan ni: rtse mo nor bus dgos 'dod char bzhin 'bebs: dpung gshog zla gam 'chi med rig 'dzin 'grub: logs gsum chos 'byung ma sring dbang du bsdus: rtsa ba zlum pos nad gdon bar chad zhi: mtha' rnams gru bzhis phrin las sna tshogs 'grub: pad 'dab bzhis brgyan gling bzhi'i 'gro ba 'dul: skyu nyis bzhis bskor sde brgyad dam la gnas: ril bu bzhis bskor phyi rgyud mgron rnams tshim: rtse phran pa tra nor bu 'khor lo yis: phyogs bcu'i zhing khams kun tu mchod sprin g.yo: dkar rtsi dmar rtsi gur dang thig phran gyis: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam dgyes par skong : de ltar mthun rdzas gnyan po bha ling gis: chos sku longs sku sprul sku'i thugs dam bskang : dgongs brgyud brda brgyud rig 'dzin thugs dam bskang : snyan brgyud shog ser slob dpon thugs dam bskang : bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang : chos skyong dam can nor lha'i thugs dam bskang : gter bdag gter srung rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : yul lha gzhi bdag rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : rigs drug pha ma lan chags thugs dam bskang : chos sku skye ba med pa'i ngang du bskang : longs sku 'gag pa med pa'i ngang du bskang : sprul sku 'khrul pa med pa'i klong du bskang : 'khor gsum skye 'gag bral ba'i klong du bskang : bskang zhing dam tshig nyams chag thams cad bshags: 'dod rgu dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol ba dang : rkyen ngan bar chad bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ sarba dharma ya du ta e haṃ shrī gh+raṃ badz+ra bi ma la ye swā hā:

zhes phrin las rgyun chags kyi gtor bsngos bsdus pa 'di nyid rang gzhung gi gtor ma yod na kha gso med na gang 'byor gyi gtor ma bsham: rab stong nyid kyi mchod pa zer ba yin kyang : rgyu bsod nams kyi tshogs rdzogs la dkon mchog la mchod pa dang : nyam thag la sbyin pa btang ba sems bskyed rnams: rnam dag gi dge rtsa yin pas shin tu yang spros pa bya rung : spros bcas spros med gang byas kyang rung 'don brjod rnams kyang med kyang rung : des na dngos rdzas che phra gang 'byor bsham par bya: tshig kha yi 'don don yid la bsgom pa yin pas sgra yang dag par bya: ji bzhin nyams su blangs pas tshogs gnyis smin cing mkha' 'gro chos skyong gis grogs yang dag par bgyid do: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: thig le rgya: kho bo rig pa 'dzin pa'i rnal 'byor pa o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos bod yul bsam yas mchims phu'i ke'u tshang nas gdan drangs shing*/ bdud 'dul sngags gling du shog ser nas bshus so/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las/ dbang phyug nyer brgyad dang phur srung nyer bzhi'i gtor 'bul mnga' gsol bka' gter thun mong gcig dril bzhugs so/ gu ru badz+ra ku mā ra ya/ phur srung mchod par snod gang rung gi nang du/ gtor ma gzhung bzhin rgyas par grub na rab yang na lha grangs kyi bshos bu sha khrag gis brgyan pa gser skyems la 'bru sna tshogs gnas skabs su ci 'byor bsham/ yang phur dkyil 'khor rgyas 'bring gang 'os kyi rang nyid rdo rje gzhon nu'i ting 'dzin gsal bzhin nas 'di skad do/ hūm̐ bh+yo/ rang nyid che mchog badz+ra ku mā ra/ /rab 'jigs zhal gsum phyag drug dpal chas rdzogs/ /yum mchog 'khor lo rgyas 'debs gnyis med 'khril/ /dam sri bdud dpung tshar gcod dpa' bor gsal/ /g.yas dkar sgeg pa gshin rje gshed po'i zhal/

/bswe mo mched bzhi'i klad khrag 'dren par byed/ /g.yon dmar dpa' ba rta mgrin rgyal po'i zhal/ /shwa na bzhi yi mgrin sogs gcod par byed/ /dbus mthing 'jigs rung bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i zhal/ /bdag nyid bzhi yi tsit+ta 'dren par byed/ de phyir dbang phyug phur skyong dam la 'dus/ /sngon tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis dam mnos shing*/ /bar du slob dpon pad+ma 'byung nas kyis/ /bal yul a su ra yi brag phug tu/ /yang phur gnyan gyi dkyil 'khor zhal phye nas/ yang dag dkyil 'khor snying po grub pa'i tshe/ /bdud rtsi dbang rtags byin nas bka' bsgos ltar/ /chu mig byang chub ring dang bal bod mtshams/ /mon kha sha 'ug gter gnas la sogs su/ /yang phur sgrub pa'i grogs su khas blangs pa'i/ /dbang phyug phur srung lcam dral thams cad kyis/ /sngon gyi g.yar dam tha tshig dran mdzod la/ /mchod gtor 'di bzhes las bzhi'i phrin las mdzod/ dbang phyug ma sring nyer brgyad gtor 'bul ni/ hūm̐ bh+yo/ dpal gyi bka' nyan dbang mo nyer brgyad ni/ /srin mo tshangs ma lha chen stag gdong dkar/ /gzhon nu rgyal byin rdo rje lcags kyu ma/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi zla ba be con ser/ /srin mo za ba rin chen zhags pa bsrings/ /dga' ba stobs chen rdo rje 'dod pa dmar/ /nor srung rlung lha pad+ma lcags sgrog mdzad/ /gsod byed mi mo phag mo rgan byed ljang*/ /sna chen chu lha rgya gram dril 'dzin bran/ /rig 'dzin kun gyi ma sring mdza' bran mo/ /dkar ser dmar ljang bdud bzhi nyi shu brgyad/ /bstod do phur bu sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig /phra men dbang mo nyi shu rtsa brgyad la/ /bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pas mnga' gsol lo/ /rak+ta dmar gyi mchod pas mnga' gsol lo/ /bha ling dbang po rnam lngas mnga' gsol lo/ /dgra bgegs klad rus sha yis mnga' gsol lo/ /sna tshogs spyan gzigs du mas mnga' gsol lo/ /mnga' gsol 'di bzhes sangs rgyas bstan pa srungs/

/ma rungs log 'dren bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod/ dam can ma mo bcu gnyis gtor 'bul ni/ thog mar g.yas zhal gshin rje'i 'dul byar gyur pa'i bswe mo bzhi'am sa bdag ma bzhi ni/ hūm̐ bh+yo/ yang phur bstan srung ma sring bcu gnyis ni/ /rig 'dzin slob dpon pad+ma'i spyan snga ru/ /nam gyi tho rangs dam bcas bswe mo bzhi/ /bdud po bkrag med gza' rgod byi ti pa/ /btsan rje shu ba klu rgyal 'jog po yi/ /bu mo rnam bzhi bal phug nyi ma khu/ kha la rong dang mang yul la phreng dang*/ /snye nam sde'u gnas su mar khu dang*/ khrag zhag 'o ma'i mtsho la brten bcas pa'i/ /ya byin de byin bswe byin phag byin la/ /las byed myur mgyogs chen mo sa bdag bzhi/ /bstod do phur bu sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig /bdag nyid ma bzhi'i ming po lcags kyi skyes bu bzhi ni/ dbus zhal bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i gdul byar gyur pa'i re ti bzhi'am bdag nyid bzhi ni/ nam gyi gung la dam bcas bdag nyid bzhi/ /rgya mtsho'i klong las me 'bar rdzu 'phrul ston/ /bying byed 'brug la brten bca' re ma ti/ /bar snang g.yo la sa gzhi khams kun 'gul/ /'byung ba g.yo la brten bca' re ma dza/ /ri rab g.yo dang lhun po 'gul bar byed/ /srid pa'i rtse la brten bca' re ma tri/ /dbang chen bsgul zhing zhing rdul snyil bar byed/ /mchog rab khong seng brten bca' re ma bh+yo/ /snang srid bdag mo re ti mched bzhi la/ /bstod do phur bu sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig /g.yon zhal dmar po'i rta mgrin gyi gdul byar gyur pa shwa na bzhi ni/ nam gyi srod la dam bcas shwa na bzhi/ /srog bdag dbugs len bla 'khyer mdangs 'phrog ma/ /mthing kha dmar ser sngo nag srin mo'i gzugs/ /lcags spyang mgo dgu zangs wa rkang gsum dang*/ /gser 'phar lce brgyad g.yu khyi mgo gsum bzhon/ /gdug pa'i ma mo shwa na chen mo bzhi/ /bstod do phur bu sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig

/phur srung dam can ma mo bcu gnyis la/ /bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pas mnga' gsol lo/ /rak+ta dmar gyi mchod pas mnga' gsol lo/ /bha ling dbang po rnam lngas mnga' gsol lo/ /dgra bgegs klad rus sha yis mnga' gsol lo/ /sna tshogs spyan gzigs du mas mnga' gsol lo/ /mnga' gsol 'di bzhes sangs rgyas bstan pa srungs/ /ma rungs log 'dren bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod/ ging bdud shan pa bcu gnyis ni/ dang po bswe mo bzhi'i ming po dmag dpon bzhi'am dung gi skyes bu ging chen bzhi ni/ hūm̐ bh+yo/ dpal gyi bka' nyan shan pa bcu gnyis ni/ /pra ma rā dza rak+sha srin po'i ging*/ /ya ma rā dza 'chi bdag gshin rje'i ging*/ /dā sha ghṛ wa bskos rje bdud kyi ging*/ /yak+sha ghṛ wa ha la gnod sbyin ging*/ /skyes bu chen po sgrol ba'i ging chen bzhi/ /bstod do phur bu sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig /bdag nyid ma bzhi'i ming po lcags kyi skyes bu bzhi ni/ shar bdud dkar po mche gtsigs lha bu'i bdud/ /lho bdud sngon po ral bsigs phung po'i bdud/ /nub bdud nag po gdug pa nyon mongs bdud/ /byang bdud ljang gu srog gcod 'chi bdag bdud/ /dung gser g.yu dang mchong phur dgra la brdeg /'bar ba chen po gsod byed bdud po bzhi/ /bstod do phur bu sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig /shwa na bzhi'i ming po bzhi bswe'i skyes bu bzhi ni/ shel ging dmu gza' dgra lha srog bdag bzhi/ /dmar po 'jigs gzugs shan+ta pu ri'i btsan/ /'brong rtse nag po rngam pa klu bdud che/ /ldang lha zangs rtse shel ging yongs kyi rje/ /rdo rje gnam lha ser mo de ni dmu/ /kun kyang khro tshul phyung rdeg ral gri phyar/ /shan pa za byed chen po srog bdag bzhi/ /bstod do phur bu sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig /ging bdud shan pa myur mgyogs bcu gnyis la/ /bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pas mnga' gsol lo/ /rak+ta dmar gyi mchod pas mnga' gsol lo/

/bha ling dbang po rnam lngas mnga' gsol lo/ /dgra bgegs klad rus sha yis mnga' gsol lo/ /sna tshogs spyan gzigs du mas mnga' gsol lo/ /mnga' gsol 'di bzhes sangs rgyas bstan pa srungs/ /ma rungs log 'dren bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod/ bh+yo ma ma pa shaṃ ku ru hūm̐ ma taṃ pa nya ka ra i nan bar+dha ti/ ma ma karma shrī kraṃ ka ra ye/ a tsit+ta yā/ dza ye bi dza yā/ a pa rā dzi te mā ra se na pra mar+dha na ye/ dz+wa la dz+wa la badz+ra/ su ru su ru badz+ra/ mu ru mu ru badz+ra/ ma tham ma tham badz+ra/ dgra bgegs kyi māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa bha su kiṃ ni ri ti/ ma ra sa na pra mar la kha kha khā hi/ zhes bsngo zhing*/ gtor ma 'bul zhing phrin las bcol tshig ni/ hūm̐/ stobs bcu'i dbang phyug mdo sngags rgyal ba'i bstan/ /mi shigs rdo rje gsum gyi srung ma ru/ /ring nas smon pa'i mthu grub ḍāk+ki'i tshogs/ /ye shes dang ni 'jig rten sna tshogs sprul/ /gdod nas rnam dag bde chen btsun mo'i klong*/ /dbyings yum kun tu bzang mor dbyer med bstod/ /gsang sngags drod nyul legs nyes stangs byed cing*/ /log 'dren srid gsum dgra bgegs srog 'phrog tshe/ /las dang 'jig rten sha za mkha' 'gror sprul/ /tshogs zhing bshad sgrub chos 'khor gnas skyong tshe/ /dkyil 'khor bar khyams la gnas bya ra byed/ /dbang phyug mgo brnyan phur srung mi bsrun gzugs/ /spyi sgos ru tra skad cig nyid la bsgral/ /mtha' dmag dpung bzlog sbas gnas gter srung tshe/ /brtan ma skyong mas 'dzam gling bde skyid spel/ /sna tshogs gar gyis sngags bstan skyong la bstod/ /rig 'dzin bdag gis phrin las bcol ba ni/ /ma ltar byams shing zhi ba'i las sgrub tshe/ /mi mthun nyes tshogs ba mor nyi shar bzhin/ /zhi ba'i bde legs ngang la gnas par mdzod/ /sring ltar gdung zhing rgyas pa'i las sgrub tshe/ /tshe bsod mnga' thang gser ri lhun po'i dpyid/

/rol mtsho spungs ltar 'phel rgyas brtan par mdzod/ /mdza' ltar brtse zhing dbang gi las sgrub tshe/ /brtan g.yo'i phun tshogs yid la 'khu ba'i nor/ khab len lcags bzhin sgrub la myur du stsol/ /bran ltar myur mgyogs drag po'i las sgrub tshe/ /bsam ngan sbyor rtsub spyi sgos bstan pa'i dgra/ /nor rdzas 'phrog bcom dgra rkun byad ma'i tshogs/ /gnod byed yid srub mda' lnga ldan pa'i lus/ /chos srung drag shul mgrin sngon dmag gi mes/ /dper na brag rir gnam lcags thog phog bzhin/ /bsam pa tsam gyis ming med tshar chod cig /sngon tshe bcom ldan rdo rje khros pa'i zhal/ /hūm̐ ka ra dang pad 'byung mtsho rgyal lcam/ /rjes 'brangs rgya mtsho dpal seng rgyud par bcas/ /bud+dha dzñā na lo ha badz+ra zhabs/ /drin can rtsa brgyud bla mas bka' bsgos ltar/ /rgyal bstan spyi dang bye brag rnying ma ba/ /gnubs ston skye sprul rtsa gsum gling pa yi/ /zab chos nyi zla lta bur mtha' rgyas mdzod/ /phan bde'i 'byung gnas bla ma'i zhabs pad brtan/ /'dus pa'i grwa 'khor dbyar mtsho ltar rgyas mdzod/ /dad pa'i nor ldan sbyin bdag tshe dpal skyed/ /longs spyod rnam thos bu la 'gran nus mdzod/ /de yang 'ching ba'i sgrog gis ma bcings par/ /tshogs rdzogs dge la gtong phod nus par mdzod/ khyad par sgrub sde 'di yi mchod gzhis la/ /log par shom pa'i dgra rkun rtsad brlag mdzod/ /theg dgu spyi dang khyad par rdzogs pa che'i/ /smin grol 'khor los sa gsum khyab par mdzod/ /de yi thugs rjes bstan pa'i 'gro ba kun/ /rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i tshe dpal 'byor ldan mdzod/ /'di nas byang chub bar gyi phrin las kun/ /rtag tu dbang phyug phur skyong rnams kyis mdzod/ /yid la re ba'i don gnyis gang mchis pa/ /gegs med bsam pa tsam gyis 'grub par mdzod/ ces yang phur gyi phur srung dam can gsol mchod cha rkyen du/

bka' gter gong 'og du ma nas legs par bsgrigs te/ phur skyong bcu gnyis nam/ bcu drug nyer bzhi sogs rnam grangs du mar bzhed kyang*/ don du rang gzhung kho na la nyer bzhi gsungs bzhin/ dus skabs rnams su gsol mchod tshar grangs bsags pa sogs/ /spyi sgos dmigs bya 'ga' zhig la/ /phrin las bcol dgos pa 'ga' re byung ba la brten nas/ rang blo'i mos pas bskul bzhin/ 7 gter chen rin po che'i zhabs 'brangs tha shal pa au ḍi sha dha karma zhes pas rang gnas sngon brag sgrub sder thun mtshams su bkod pa'i mthus gong du smos pa'i phrin las thogs med 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ // bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: dpal ldan ye shes mgon po'i gsol kha bzhugs so: khrag 'thung legs ldan nag por 'dud: sa ma ya: dpal mgon nag po sgrub pa'i thabs: bkra shis yid 'ong dga' ba'i tshal: yang na dur khrod shing gcig drung : ri rngam chu sgra nags 'jigs shing : chu brag chos 'byung 'dra ba ru: bhan+dha lcang lo mtshan ldan nang : gnam lcags 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad steng : 'bru nag dpal gtor snying gi gzugs: 'khor ni rang 'dra brgyad dang ni: sha khrag la sogs rgyan gyis brgyan: bdud rtsi sman raka dag kyang gtams: bum pa cha phyed chu yis bkang : mda' mo sgro gsum legs pa la: dar nag gdugs dang cod pan 'phur: bla 'khor srog yig bla rdo dang : me long gri snying rdo rje phur: brgyan te rten du 'dzugs par bya: sku 'bag la sogs spyan gzigs bshams: de nas 'byung ba rim brtsegs ni: hūm̐: ye nas kun gzhi stong pa'i dbyings: rang byung rtsal gyi 'od zer shar: sna tshogs sprul pa'i sa bon hūm̐: e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐ keṃ bh+rūm̐: de nas 'byung ba lnga brtseg pa ni: hūm̐: e las chos 'byung nam mkha' mthing : yam̐ las rlung gi rgya gram bsnol: ram̐ las bskal pa'i me dpung 'khrigs: kham̐ las rak+ta'i rba klong khol:

sum̐ las sa gzhi smug nag khyab: keṃ las keng rus dur khrod chags: bh+rūm̐ las thod mkhar 'jigs su rung : om̐ bh+rūm̐ bhi shwa tsakra hūm̐: a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍa la: ma sūr+ya maṇ+ḍa la: paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍa la: ru ṭa ti ra baṃ: hūm̐ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭḥ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐: badz+ra tsakra dzñā na hoḥ de nas gzhal yas khang bskyed pa ni: hūm̐: yi ge bh+rūm̐ gyur gzhal yas khang : bhan+dha skam rlon brtsegs pa yi: rab 'jigs drag po'i thod mkhar ni: rmang gzhi gnam lcags ur mo bsnol: gru bzhi sgo bzhi mthongs skar phyes: ka gdung lha klu srin lpags bkab: g.yang gzhi rgyal mtshan thod pa'i tog: phyi rol dur khrod mtshon cha'i gur: bskal pa'i me ri smug nag 'khrigs: nang na rak+ta'i rgya mtsho 'khyil: baṃ ro skam rlon lhu dum 'khrol: mi lpags stag lpags g.yang gzhi bris: don snying rnam lnga'i 'phan gdugs 'phyangs: de dbus chos 'byung pad+ma dang : bam chen smug po'i gdan gyi steng : hūm̐ las byung ba'i nag po che: khrag 'thung legs ldan phyag bzhi pa: sma ra dbu skra dmar ser 'bar: thod skam prog zhu dar nag 'phur: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril spyan rtsa 'khyil: thal chen tshom bu sin+dhu ra: khrag zhag thig le zo ris zhag: g.yas gnyis gri gug tsit+ta dang : g.yon gnyis bhan dmar kha ṭ+wāṃ gaḥ sku la seṅge'i g.yang gzhi gsol: rus rgyan g.yer kha'i sgra dang ldan: sgeg cing sbom la yan lag rags: gsus khyim zlum la sma ra 'khyil: phyed skyil dgyes pa'i rngam stabs bzhugs: yum mchog dpal 'bar tsaṇ+ḍi ma: dmar mo khro 'dzum gzi 'od 'bar: gri thod yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud: rin chen rus pa'i rgyan cha 'khrol: zhabs gnyis yab kyi sked la 'khril: zung 'jug bde chen rgyas par bsgom: spyi gtsug nyi zla pad+ma'i steng : rigs kyi bdag po spyan ras gzigs: zhi zhing khro 'dzum rin chen brgyan: dmar gsal rdo rje bhan+dha 'dzin: thugs rje'i bdag nyid phyed skyil bzhugs:

ye shes mkha' 'gro dmar mo 'khril: nor bu 'dzin cing mgul nas 'khyud: rus rgyan zhabs gnyis yab la 'khril: phyogs bzhir gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro ma: pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs ldan ni: khro 'dzum rus pa'i rgyan ldan gar: g.yas pas cang te'u chos sgra sgrog: g.yon pas bhan+dha bdud rtsi bsnams: brda skad sgrogs shing chags tshul bsgom: hūm̐: gtso bo'i phyogs bzhir 'khor lo'i rtsibs: shar phyogs 'khor lo'i rtsibs steng du: hūm̐ las yon tan bla med kyi: ye shes mgon po ma ning sku: mthing nag gri gug thod khrag 'dzin: dur khrod chas rdzogs ber nag gsol: tsan dan beng chen sked par bcug: zhabs gnyis rol stabs bam steng 'gying : lho phyogs 'khor lo'i rtsibs steng du: hūm̐ las sku yi mgon po nag: ma hā kā la gdong bzhi pa: g.yas gnyis gri gug tsan dan beng : g.yon gnyis bhan+dha rtse gsum 'dzin: khro gtum dur khrod chas dang ldan: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum ro gdan 'gying : nub phyogs 'khor lo'i rtsibs steng du: hūm̐ las gsung gi mgon po ni: sku mdog mthing nag phyag drug pa: gri gug thod phreng cang te'u g.yas: thod khrag kha ṭ+wāṃ zhags pa g.yon: khro zhing dgyes la dur khrod chas: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum ro yi gdan: byang phyogs 'khor lo'i rtsibs steng du: hūm̐ las phrin las mgon po smug: bram ze dur khrod bdag po ni: khro 'dzum rus pa'i rgyan drug can: phyag g.yas thod pa'i cang te'u 'khrol: g.yon pas gri rkang gling bu 'bud: stag sham rus rgyan ro gdan 'gying : mtshams bzhir gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro bzhi: gri gug kha ṭ+wāṃ dku la brten: rus rgyan dor stabs ro gdan 'gying : khro 'dzum yab la dgyes par bsgom: hūm̐: gzhan yang phyi nang gsang ba yi: ye shes mgon po'i lha tshogs rnams: chu zla bzhin du gsal bar bsgom: de ltar gsal ba'i gnas gsum las: 'od zer 'phros pas spyan drangs gyur:

om̐ badz+ra sa mā ya phaiṃ phaiṃ dza dzaḥ a be sha ya a āḥ zhes sha chen gyi gsur btang zhing mi rkang gling bu gtser: rol mo dang bcas nas: hūm̐: bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i klong : 'og min chos dbyings pho brang nas: ye shes mgon po gshegs su gsol: nag po chen po gshegs su gsol: legs ldan nag po gshegs su gsol: ma hā kā la gshegs su gsol: mgon chen sde lnga gshegs su gsol: ma rgyud mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol: dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs gshegs su gsol: om̐ shrī ma hā kā la ya sa pa ri wā ra ho dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐: dur khrod pho brang drag po'i gnas mchog tu: khrag mchod pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan steng du: ye shes mgon po'i lha tshogs ma lus kun: mi g.yo bdag la dgyes pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs: om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: de nas phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐: dpal chen nag po khrag 'thung rgyal: dpa' bo gyad kyi ya 'dor can: drag pos sa bcu gnon mdzad pa: legs ldan mgon por bdag bstod do: om̐ na mo a ti pu hoḥ de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: mi lpags g.yang gzhi'i bla bre mkha' la bris: rgyu ma'i lda ldi 'phan gdugs sna tshogs 'phyangs: mda' mo sgro gsum dar nag gdugs kyis brgyan: bla rdo srog 'khor me long phyag mtshan dang : nam mkha'i rgyan gyur bya nag lang ling 'phur: rta nag cang shes tshogs ni 'tsher skad gtser: g.yag nag zhol chen tshogs ni ngar sgra sgrog: lug nag dpyi dkar tshogs ni 'ba' sgra 'byin: khyi nag snying dkar tshogs ni dgra sha rngam: mi nag pho mo gcer bus gar rtsed bsgyur: dug sbrul nag po'i tshogs ni 'khyug cing 'greng : tsit+ta'i nam mkha' nag po sprin ltar gtibs: rten gtor bshos bu nag po ri ltar brjid: dom nag la sogs gcan spyang sna tshogs ngar: g.yab dar ru dar rten dar nag po sogs: go khrab brjid ldan rno ngar mtshon cha gzengs:

dur khrod pho brang bkod legs sna tshogs 'di: ye shes mgon po sde lnga'i tshogs la 'bul: gsang ba'i khro mo ma sring tshogs la 'bul: mchod pas dgyes shing thugs dam bskang ba ni: rigs bdag spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs dam bskang : gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i thugs dam bskang : legs ldan mgon po phyag bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : yon tan mgon po ma ning thugs dam bskang : sku mgon gdong bzhi yab yum thugs dam bskang : gsung gi mgon po phyag drug thugs dam bskang : phrin las mgon po bram gzugs thugs dam bskang : yum mchog khro mo rigs lnga'i thugs dam bskang : mchod pas dgyes shing thugs dam bskangs gyur nas: bar chad sel zhing mchog thun dngos grub stsol: om̐ shrī ma hā kā la nā tha pañtsa ḍāk+ki nī sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ya āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: dgra bgegs dbang po'i me tog phung por brtsegs: sha chen gu gul dri spos dud sprin 'khrigs: rkang dang lha ba'i sgron me nyi ltar gsal: dgra bgegs snying khrag dri chab mtsho ltar 'khyil: 'bru nag 'bras kyi bshos bu ri ltar brjid: thod rnga gsang rnga rkang gling rol mo ldir: sna tshogs 'gyed pa'i mchod sprin gtibs pa 'di: ye shes mgon po sde lnga'i tshogs la 'bul: gsang ba'i khro mo ma sring tshogs la 'bul: mchod pas dgyes shing thugs dam bskang ba ni: rigs bdag spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs dam bskang : gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i thugs dam bskang : legs ldan mgon po phyag bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : yon tan mgon po ma ning thugs dam bskang : sku yi mgon po gdong bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : gsung gi mgon po phyag drug thugs dam bskang : phrin las mgon po bram gzugs thugs dam bskang : yum chen khro mo rigs lnga'i thugs dam bskang : mchod pas dgyes shing thugs dam bskangs gyur nas: bar chad sel zhing mchog thun dngos grub stsol: om̐ shrī ma hā kā la nā tha pañtsa ḍāk+ki nī puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐:

hūm̐: ga pur dzā ti dri mchog sna tshogs dang : legs par sbyar ba'i bdud rtsi sman mchog gtams: bde stong yid 'dzin lha mo sna tshogs la: zung 'jug sbyor te bskul ba'i bdud rtsi dang : dbyings phyug bzang mo'i dmar chen rak+ta 'khyil: thabs chen rdo rje'i byang sems zla ltar rgyas: bhan+dha'i snod du bha ling gtor ma la: pha rol dgra bgegs sha khrag rus kyis brgyan: bsgral mchod la sogs dgyes pa'i mchod pa 'di: ye shes mgon po sde lnga'i tshogs la 'bul: gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro ma sring tshogs la 'bul: mchod pas dgyes shing thugs dam bskang ba ni: rigs bdag spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs dam bskang : gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i thugs dam bskang : legs ldan mgon po phyag bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : yon tan mgon po ma ning thugs dam bskang : sku yi mgon po gdong bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : gsung gi mgon po phyag drug thugs dam bskang : phrin las mgon po bram gzugs thugs dam bskang : yum chen khro mo rigs lnga'i thugs dam bskang : mchod pas dgyes shing thugs dam bskangs gyur nas: bar chad sel zhing mchog thun dngos grub stsol: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta ma hā rak+ta hrī ṭha bha ling+ta māṃ sa tsit+ta go ro tsa na bha su ta kha kha khā hi: de nas bshags pa ni: hūm̐: dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: deng 'dir bdag cag sgrub pa'i sgor zhugs nas: phyi nang dam tshig nyams shing 'gal ba dang : dam rdzas ma tshang tshogs gtor chag pa dang : sgo gsum bag med dam 'gal ci mchis pa: dkyil 'khor lha la mthol bshags bzod par gsol: mi sgrib tshangs pa 'phrul gyi dngos grub stsol: om̐ badz+ra sa twa sa ma yaḥ ma nu pa la sogs yig brgya bzlas shing lhag chad bkang : de nas bstod pa bya ba ni: dbyangs snyan po dang bcas nas: hūm̐: bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: chos dbyings thod mkhar e yi dal dbus su:

legs ldan mgon po khrag 'thung phyag bzhi pa: sku mdog smug nag char sprin gtibs pa'i gzugs: dbu skra dmar ser srid rtse'i dbyings la bskyod: thod skam dbu rgyan snang srid dregs pa 'dul: dar nag cod pan ma sring mkha' 'gro sdud: a ra smin ma tshwa tshwa skar ltar 'khrugs: dmar zhing zlum pa'i spyan gsum gyen mthur gzigs: seng lpags gsol zhing rkan sgra phyogs bcur sgrog: rus pa'i rgyan ldan g.yer kha 'u ru ru: lhu tshigs sbrul rgyan klu gnyan sa bdag 'dul: khrag zhag thig le thal tshom rgyan gyis spras: sgeg cing dgyes pas ye shes 'jig rten sngangs: phyag g.yas gri gug bdud dpung rtsad nas gcod: tsit+ta 'dzin pas pha rol glo snying rol: ral gri 'bar bas bgegs dpung dum bur gtub: g.yon pas bhan dmar dam nyams klad khrag rol: kha ṭ+wāṃ 'dzin pas dug gsum rtsad nas gcod: gsus pa 'khyil bas 'gro ba'i tshe bsod sdud: phyed skyil rol stabs 'khor 'das zil gyis gnon: bam chen gdan bzhugs khrag 'thung nag por bstod: hūm̐: gsang ba'i yum mchog lha mo dpal 'bar ma: shes rab rang bzhin dmar gsal gzi 'od 'bar: khro 'dzum mdangs ldan dga' bzhi bde stong bskul: phyag g.yas gri gug skye 'chi rtsad nas gcod: g.yon pas bhan dmar dug lnga'i rak+ta stob: rus pa'i rgyan ldan phar phyin bskyed pa'i yum: zhabs gnyis yab 'khril dga' bzhi'i brda skad 'byin: tsaṇ+ḍi dpal 'bar khro mo'i sku la bstod: hūm̐: spyi bo 'od dpung nyi zer gzi 'bar dbus: rigs kyi bdag po 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs: dmar gsal mdangs ldan ye shes mi g.yo dang : khro 'dzum spyan gyis mkha' dbyings phyogs bcur gzigs: rdo rje bhan+dha bden gnyis 'du 'bral med: phyed skyil lham me 'gro ba'i mgon gyur pa: 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: gsang ba'i yum mchog dmar gsal 'od lnga'i mdangs:

'dzum zhal dgyes shing mnyen lcug rus rgyan mdzes: phyag g.yas nor bus thabs mchog dpa' bo sdud: g.yon pa'i pad+mas ma sring las la bskul: mnyen lcug zhabs 'khril bde stong ye shes ngang : yum mchog shes rab sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: phyogs bzhi ye shes gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro ma: pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs ldan khro 'dzum mdzes: rin chen rus rgyan sgrub la dngos grub ster: mnyen lcug 'khril ldem dgyes nyams sgeg pa mo: phyag g.yas cang te'us dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sdud: g.yon pa'i bdud rtsis rnal 'byor tshe srog sring : nu ma bha ga rgyas shing gar sgyur ma: ma gcig ye shes ḍāk+ki sde bzhir bstod: hūm̐: rab tu 'khrigs pa'i dur khrod sprin nag can: khrag mtsho me dpung 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: gnyis med mgon po ma ning khro bo rgyal: sku mdog mthing nag bla med rgyud sde'i sprul: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril khro gtum sa gsum dngangs: dbu skra thod skam me zer ya la la: phyag g.yas gri gug bstan dgra'i srog dbugs phral: g.yon pas bhan dmar dam nyams klad khrag gsol: mun pa'i lhub chen dug lnga zil gyis gnon: dur khrod chas ldan 'dre rgod dmag dpung bzlog: tsan dan beng chen bdud 'dul dmag gi gter: brkyang bskum dor stabs brjid la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: ti se chen po gangs kyi pho brang dbus: myur mgyogs sde brgyad kun gyi dmag dpon pa: ma hā kā la gdong bzhi mthu bo che: sku mdog nag po mun pa'i tsha zer 'phros: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril spyan rtsa glog ltar 'khyug: dbu skra'i gseb nas bskal pa'i me chen 'bar: thod skam 'bar ba'i prog zhu dar dmar 'phur: phyag g.yas gri gug bdud bzhi rtsad nas gzhom: tsan dan beng chen gdug pa'i g.yul ngo bzlog: g.yon pas bhan dmar rak+ta zhal du gsol: nyams pa bsgral phyir kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum phyar: dur khrod chas ldan bgegs dpung sa la 'gyel:

brkyang bskum tshul ldan ma hā kā lar bstod: hūm̐: dur khrod chen po rab 'jigs bsil ba tshal: gdug pa'i shing drung ro langs 'tshogs pa'i dbus: dpal chen mgon po mthing nag phyag drug pa: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril hūm̐ sgra 'brug ltar sgrog: dbu skra thod skam me yi bu yug 'tshubs: g.yas pas gri gug byad ma'i mgo lus phral: ḍā ma ru yis ma mo dbang du sdud: thod phreng 'dzin pas dmod pa'i drag sngags 'dren: g.yon pas bhan dmar 'dre rgod snying khrag rol: kha ṭ+wāṃ 'dzin pas dug gsum dbyings su bsgral: bdud zhags nag pos bstan dgra sgos dgra 'ching : dur khrod chas ldan 'byung po'i gdon tshogs 'joms: brkyang bskum gar ldan nag po che la bstod: hūm̐: rngam drag tshal gyi dur khrod ha ha dgod: bam chen gsar rnying ri ltar brtsegs pa'i dbus: dur khrod bdag po mgon po bram ze'i gzugs: smug nag khro 'dzum dbu skra spyi bor bcings: thod skam dbu rgyan srid gsum zil gyis gnon: phyag g.yas cang te'us dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bskul: g.yon pas rkang gling snang srid dbang du sdud: rus pa'i rgyan ldan dregs pa bran du bkol: gar stabs tshul gyis phyogs bcu'i gdon tshogs bcom: bram ze'i gzugs ldan dpa' bo che la bstod: hūm̐: chos 'byung e yi klong dkyil nas: las kyi yum chen mkha' 'gro bzhi: mthing nag khro 'dzum bh+yo sgra sgrogs: thor tsugs skra grol sku rgyab khebs: rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan dar dpyangs 'phur: gri gug nyon mongs rtsad nas gcod: bhan dmar dam nyams snying khrag 'thung : kha ṭ+wāṃ dug gsum rtsad nas gcod: rus rgyan las kyi ma mo sdud: gcer mo nu ma bha ga rgyas: brkyang bskum gar sgyur sgeg pa mo: khrag 'thung mkha' 'gro rigs bzhir bstod: hūm̐: gzhan yang phyi nang skyong ba yi: ye shes dang ni las grub pa: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro zhing skyong tshogs: ma sring shugs 'gro yang 'khor 'bum:

phyi nang skyong ba'i lha la bstod: 'dzab bskul ni: hūm̐: dpal chen mgon po'i lha tshogs rnams: thugs dam gnyan po dbyings nas bskul: drag sngags hūm̐ gis 'brug sgra ldir: phyi nang bar chad dbyings su sgrol: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin sngags 'chang la: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: 'dzab kyis thugs dam gnad nas bskul: spros pas ye shes 'dod yon dgyes: tshur 'dus bdag gis dngos grub thob: ma grub bar du mi btang bzung : phrin las sgrub pa'i dus la bab: thugs dam gnad nas da skul cig: rigs bdag sngags la: om̐ ā wa lo ki te ḍāk+ki pañtsa hūm̐ phaṭḥ rtsa sngags la: om̐ ma hā kā la nā tha pañtsa kro ti shwa rī hūm̐ bh+yoḥ las sngags ni: om̐ ma hā kā la ya k+ṣeṃ k+ṣeṃ ma tri tsa tri hūm̐ bh+yoḥ ma ning sngags ni: om̐ shrī ma hā ka la ga na gu h+ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ gdong bzhi pa la: om̐ ma hā kā la mu kha tsa tur hūm̐ phaṭḥ phyag drug pa la: om̐ ma hā kā la k+ṣeṃ k+ṣeṃ ka ra ṣe ṭa hūm̐ phaṭḥ dur khrod bdag po la: om̐ ma hā kā la u ta tsar+ya hūm̐ phaṭ: de nas khro mo rigs bzhi la: om̐ ma tri ḍāk+ki kro ti tsa tur hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces sngags rnams sgrub pa'i las rim ltar bzlas: de nas drag sngags ni: om̐ ma hā kā la kro ta raṃ he ru ka kro ti da sha tsaṇ+ḍa ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ drag sngags rnams rgyun du bgrang mi dgos: de nas dgra bo rbad gsod kyi sngags ni: dgra bo byad ma gdon gyi rigs: glo bur bsad thabs shin tu zab: 'gyang na 'di na lan gcig bskyar: ma spel gsang rgya sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: ༈ chos skyong kun 'dus gtor 'bul ni: hūm̐: dur khrod rngam chen me rlung 'tshubs pa'i klong : thod mkhar dmar nag pho brang so so'i dbus: bstan pa'i bka' srung las mdzad mi bsrun pa: legs ldan mgon po phyag bzhi phyag drug pa: ma ning dang ni gdong bzhi bram gzugs can: las mgon seng gdong srog bdag bya rog gdong :

gri gug bing chen dmar nag trag shad dang : gur mgon a gho ra dang stag zhon pa: ber nag can dang seng zhon mdung thung can: khyad par gza' brgyad ki kang rā hu la: e ka dzā ṭi dud sol re ma ti: tshe ring mched lnga a phyi chos sgron dang : srog bdag ma mo dam can rdo rje legs: btsan rgod khrag 'thung shan pa mdung dmar can: drag po dge bsnyen klu dang bdud kyi rje: ging chen pho mo sha za bye ba 'bum: rgyal chen dpe dkar la sogs gter srung dang : sde dpon sum cu dregs byed yang 'khor la: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di 'bul lo: bzhes nas sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba dang : sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin bdag la bu bzhin skyongs: snang srid lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du sdus: skye 'gro 'jig rten pho mo'i snying bsgul la: zas nor longs spyod gnas 'dir char bzhin phob: snyan grags mnga' thang dpal 'byor rgyas pa dang : bdag la sdang zhing 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs sgrol: bcol ba'i phrin las thogs med 'grub par mdzod: ces bka' brgyad nas khol du phyung ba'o// // ༈ bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: ma hā kā la'i ka bstod ye shes rol pa bzhugs so: dpal ye shes mgon po ma hā kā lar 'dud: de yang yang rdzong shel gyi phug pa ru gnubs ston sangs rgyas ye shes ka dag zab mo'i snyan brgyud kyi lam mchog 'byong zhing rdo rje phur pa'i gdeng tshad grub pa'i tshe: ma hā kā las zhal dngos su bstan nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung bar zhal gyis bzhes shing : lhag tu gnubs kyi gdung rgyud skyong bar tha tshig bgyis pa'i tshe: dran rdzogs nyid du ye shes mgon po la bstod pa'o: hūm̐: kā la rab 'jigs ye shes rol pa'i sku: kha gdangs mche gtsigs srid gsum lto bar 'gengs: ga shal mgo phreng dur khrod chas kyis brgyan: nga bdag g.yul las rgyal la bdag bstod do: ca co rgol ba'i dregs ldan ma rungs tshogs:

cha lugs rtsal bcu'i stobs kyis 'joms mdzad pa: ja ltar mdangs ldan rak+tas rtag tu dgyes: nya rgyas gzi 'bar 'od 'phro bdag bstod do: lta ba bla med bstan pa'i bya ra mkhan: tha dad so so'i snang ngor nag po che: da ni ma g.yel sngags bsrung tha tshig bzhin: na raka smin pa'i bdud bgegs 'joms la bstod: pa sangs dbyings su 'gyu ba'i rtsal chen ltar: pha rol dgra la mngon spyod 'bad mdzad pa: ba spu'i bu gar khro tshogs skar ltar 'khrugs: ma rungs sgrol mdzad mgon por bdag bstod do: rtsa brgyud rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i bka' srung che: tsha zer dus mtha'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar: dza yig spros pa'i pho nya dgra la 'gyed: wa skyes gnyen po seng ltar bdag bstod do: zhwa ltar spyi bor rigs bdag 'phags mchog brgyan: za byed tsaṇ+ḍi ma mo pang du 'khyud: 'a 'ur sgra 'byin nag po phyag bzhi pa: ya nga srid gsum sngangs la bdag bstod do: ra gdong gri gug la sogs phyag mtshan thogs: la la rngam dang la la gtum pa mo: sha khrag dgyes mdzad legs ldan mgon po'i tshogs: sa steng dgra dpung gzhom la bdag bstod do: ha ha dgod pa'i bstan srung nag po che: a ti rdzogs chen skyong ba'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ shrī ma hā kā la k+ṣeṃ k+ṣeṃ dharma pā la ra tri ghu na hri da hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces ye shes mgon po'i bstod pa 'di rgyun du brtson zhing gsang sngags gnyan gyi slob ma la: lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grog par 'gyur ro: ka bstod 'di ha ha dgod pa'i tshal du ma hā kā las zhal gzigs skabs kho bo bud+dha dzñā nas brda gnyis 'gyur du btab pa'o: sa ma ya: kho bo sngags 'chang rtsa gsum gling pas gnubs ston gyi shog ser nas zhal bshus so/ maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bka' brgyad chen po gsang ba zil gnon las: myur mdzad ye shes mgon po phyag drug pa'i gtor bsdus bzhugs so: bla ma dang mgon po yid bzhin nor bu la phyag 'tshal lo:

sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: e ma: kho mo mtsho rgyal gyis: ye shes mgon po'i gsol mchod bstan: sangs rgyas ye shes legs par zungs: brda gzugs rin chen gter du sbos: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: mgon po'i gsol mchod rim pa ni: bhan+dha rgyan bzang gtor ma bsham: sman raka phud kyis legs par bran: dang po mchod pa byin brlab ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum brjod: hoḥ gtor ma sman raka dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag rus pa: ye shes kyi bdud rtsi rgya mtsho chen por gyur: oṃ ha ho hrī phaiṃ phaiṃ: gnyis pa spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: rang gi thugs ka nas ting 'dzin rol pa'i 'od zer lcags kyu ltar 'phros pas: shar lho bsil ba tshal nas dur khrod shing tsan dan rkang gcig pa'i drung nas dpal ye shes kyi mgon po nag po chen po spyan drangs: oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la k+ṣeṃ k+ṣe ṭa bigh+nān bi na ya ka baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ bh+yo ma tri ka li tsaṇ+ḍa lī ku ru kul+le hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ pad+ma ka ma la ye satwaṃ: oṃ na mo pu ru sha ya hoḥ hoḥ mgon po'i ljags rdo rje'i sbu gus gtor ma'i bcud drangs te gsol bar gyur: oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya bh+yo ma tri ka li hūm̐ phaṭḥ i daṃ bha ling+ta ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na ba su ta khā hi: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi: zhes pas gtor ma legs par bsngo: gsum pa bstod pa bya ba ni: hūm̐: rab 'jigs dur khrod 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: che btsan dbang phyug ma hā kā la ya: mthing nag rngam pa'i zhal gsum rab tu 'khros: rigs bdag mi bskyod gtsug rgyan cod pan 'phur: dpral bar dam tshig sin+dhu ra yis byugs: 'bar ba'i gri gug thod khrag cang te'u g.yas: bhan dmar rtse gsum dgra 'ching zhags pa g.yon: dur khrod chas ldan zhabs bzhi dor stabs bgrad: glang po'i gdong can lha chen pho mo brdzis: k+ṣeṃ k+ṣeṃ sgra sgrogs me dpung klong du bzhugs:

tsan dan la gnas nag po phyag drug pa: sgrub mchog bu bzhin skyong ba'i dpal chen po: yid bzhin nor bu mgon po khyod la bstod: hūm̐: sbyor ba'i yum mchog sngags bdag dpal 'bar ma: dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis gtum pa mo: gri khug mgul 'khyud thod khrag yab la stob: dur khrod chas ldan ma sring pho nya 'gyed: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum dpa' bo'i sku la 'khril: dbyings phyug lha mo 'dod rgu mchod sbyin ma: lha mo tsaṇ+ḍa ma la phyag 'tshal bstod: bzhi pa gtor 'bul ni: hūm̐: legs ldan mgon po ma hā kā la ya: yum mchog sngags bdag 'dod khams dbyings phyug ma: nag po chen po lcam dral bran g.yog 'khor: bstan srung mthu chen dbang phyu+ug khyed rnams kyis: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: sgrub mchog bdag gi bka' nyon bu bzhin skyongs: ma rungs 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs sgrol bar mdzod: om̐ ma hā kā la k+ṣeṃ k+ṣe ṭa pā la bigh+nān bi na ya ka baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ bh+yo tri ka li tsaṇ+ḍa lī ku ru kul+le hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ āḥhūm̐: i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: zhes gtor ma phul zhing phrin las bcol: sa ma ya: 'di nyid bstan srung kun gyi mchog: slob dpon shān+tiṃ ghar+bha ni: bsil ba tshal du bzhugs pa'i tshe: mgon pos dngos su zhal gzigs nas: tsan dan shing la thim pa yi: dur khrod shing rkang gcig ces pa'i: tshang tshing 'khrigs pa'i mgon po ni: nags 'dabs ma hā kā lar grags: spyir na che btsan 'gran zla bral: ye shes mgon po nor gyi bdag: bsgrubs pas 'dod rgu char bzhin 'bebs: pha rol dgra bgegs dmod pas brlag: de bas mthu rtsal rmad byung 'di: dam du bzung la legs par bsten: kun gyi thun mong ma yin rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos lcags byi lor sbas tshal nas gdan drangs pa'o: sarba maṅga laṃ// 'jam dpal gshin rje dug ri me 'bar las:

dpal khrag 'thung mgon po ma hā kā la legs ldan bya rog gdong gi gsol mchod srog gzan nag po byad ma rtsad brlag bzhugs so: khrag 'thung chen po g.yul las rgyal la 'dud: sa ma ya: de yang khrag 'thung legs ldan ma hā kā la'i gsol mchod brtsam pa'i rim pa ni: lcags sam bhan+dha'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du: 'bru nag gi ngar phye la dpal gtor zlum po khram ris can g.yas gcus: gdan chos 'byung gi kha ru bzhag: mdun du khrag kong lhan du 'brang rgyas tshe nyungs kyis mtshan pa bzhag: 'khor dpal gtor bzhi dang kyu gu bzhi mtheb skyu brgyad gzhan yang sha sna snying sna ke tshe shang tshes brgyan: nyungs dkar nag gi sgang bu kyang gzug: phud rgod sna tshogs gtams shing rkang gling rol mo sgrogs gu gul sha chen gyi dud pa bdug tshil chen gyi mar me gtams khrag chen gyi yon chab bshams: dgyes pa'i dar phyar rngam pa'i dbyangs dang bcas nas legs ldan he ru ka chen po'i thugs dam rgyud bskul zhing phrin las kyi bya ba sna tshogs bsgrub phyir spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: bdag nyid dpal chen 'bar ba'i mdun: khrag zhag 'khrugs pa'i klong dkyil du: dur khrod e yi pho brang ni: mi mgo'i sku mkhar rgyan dang ldan: de dbus pad nyi ro gdan du: hūm̐ las legs ldan bya rog gdong : dur khrod chas ldan yum dang sbyor: 'khor du las byed pho nya ba: bya rog khros pa'i gdong can bzhi: mtshams su rang 'dra 'bar ma gnas: gzhan yang bya gcan yang sprul bcas: de ltar bskyed pa'i gnas gsum las: 'od 'phros chos skyong spyan drangs gyur: om̐ badz+ra ma hā kā la kau bha ma dāk+ṣi ya k+ṣa tsa tur li ha ho shwa ri ya badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥdzaḥdzaḥ hūm̐: 'jigs su rung ba'i gnas mchog nas: khams gsum yongs kyi ded dpon che: mthu chen ma hā kā la ni: khrag 'thung nag po mi bsrun pa: dur khrod tshogs bdag skur bzhengs shig: nag po chen po gshegs su gsol:

legs ldan nag po gshegs su gsol: dpal mgon nag po gshegs su gsol: bdud rgyal thod phreng gshegs su gsol: bya rog ming can gshegs su gsol: gnam lcags spu gri gshegs su gsol: srog bdud 'bar ba gshegs su gsol: rngam chen bkrag med gshegs su gsol: las mkhan me 'bar gshegs su gsol: sprul pa yang sprul gshegs su gsol: gshegs nas dur khrod pho brang 'dir: mi g.yo dgyes pas gdan la bzhugs: om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: zhes legs ldan mgon po'i dmag tshogs rnams sprin chen rlung gis bskyod pa ltar byon nas bzhugs par bsam: de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: ma hā kā la dgongs su gsol: dpal mgon chen po dgongs su gsol: khrag 'thung rgyal po dgongs su gsol: bya rog ming can dgongs su gsol: dam can rgya mtsho dgongs su gsol: hūm̐: khyed la mthun pa'i dam rdzas ni: bhan+dha lcang lo'i gtor gzhong du: 'bru nag ngar phye'i myos chang la: gri khrag la sogs dug rigs sbyor: kha zhing ngar ldan bam pa'i rigs: shin tu bstar ba'i gtor mchod 'di: dpal ldan mgon po'i zhal du 'bul: bzhes nas gdug cing sdang ba yi: dam nyams dgra bgegs sgrol bar mdzod: om̐ shrī ma hā kā la ya i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: hūm̐: khyed la mnyes pa'i dam rdzas ni: bum ril 'bar ba'i snod yangs su: mi khrag rta khrag glang po'i khrag: khyi khrag la sogs khrag chen la: thang khrom re lcag bong nga dang : sman chen dang bcas sbyor ba'i khrag: ru tra'i snying khrag dmar chen 'di: dpal ldan mgon po'i zhal du 'bul: bzhes nas gdug cing sdang ba yi: dam nyams dgra bgegs sgrol bar mdzod: om̐ shrī ma hā kā la ya ma hā rak+ta la kha kha khā hi: hūm̐: mtshan ldan zhal bur ka pā lar: ga pur dzā ti a ga ru: 'bras dkar dmar nag 'bru yi chang : rin chen zhun gyi brdar phye dang : byang sems dkar dmar bde ba'i rgyun: rdzas mchog lnga sogs bdud rtsi 'di:

dpal ldan mgon po'i zhal du 'bul: bzhes nas gdug cing sdang ba yi: dam nyams dgra bgegs sgrol bar mdzod: om̐ shrī ma hā kā la ya sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi: hūm̐: 'bru bcud sna tshogs phye ma'i rigs: bcud g.yo zhag gis sbags pa'i zan: dkar dmar brgyan pa'i zhal zas tshogs: dgra bgegs don snying dbang pos brgyan: tshil chen mar me gsur chen spos: rkang gling thod rnga'i sgra bcas 'di: dpal ldan mgon po'i zhal du 'bul: bzhes nas gdug cing sdang ba yi: dam nyams dgra bgegs sgrol bar mdzod: om̐ shrī ma hā kā la ya ga ṇa tsakra ma hā pū dza ya i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: de nas bskang bstod bya ba ni: g.yag nag la bam ros brgyan pa de'i steng du dpal gtor zur gsum zhig la/ dkar me bya rog gsum gyis brgyan: sha dum dang mtheb skyus bskor ba mdun du gser skyems bshams la: hūm̐: rab 'jigs 'bar ba'i dur khrod bsil ba tshal: khrag gi rgya mtsho bam ro ri ltar nyil: keng rus khral khrol rus pa gram ltar bdal: steng du lho sprin ngam nag bun ltar gtibs: 'khor yug kun kyang mi sdug rlung dmar 'tshubs: de dbus drag po'i pho brang gzhal yas ni: rmang gzhi nag po klu dang sa bdag bsnol: de steng gnam lcags rdo rje'i rgya gram bkod: zur bzhi khro chu mdzes pa'i so phag ldan: shar phyogs mi mgo skam rlon brtsegs pa la: dur khrod bdag mo'i gad mo ya la la: lho phyogs rta mgo skam rlon brtsegs pa la: gyi ling cang shes mtsher rgyangs tse re re: nub phyogs g.yag mgo skam rlon brtsegs pa la: kho kho 'brong gi ngar sgra 'u ru ru: byang phyogs stag mgo skam rlon brtsegs pa la: gcan gzan gdug pa'i ngar sgra di ri ri: ka gdung gza' dang rgyu skar bris pa la: 'brug glog thog ser zi ra chi li li: kha bad srin po'i thod pa bsgrigs pa la: rak+sha pho mo sprin ltar gtibs se gtib: g.yang gzhi 'phan dar ro skra'i ba dan la:

mi mgo'i rgyan tog du ma rongs se rong : tri shul la sogs mtshon chas brgyan pa la: 'phyang ba'i cod pan nag po pu ru ru: de ltar pho brang sna tshogs rgyan ldan gyi: bkod pa yo byad bdag gis bshams pa 'dis: yab gcig legs ldan nag po'i thugs dam bskang : yum gcig 'dod khams dbang phyug thugs dam bskang : sras mchog bya rog gdong gi thugs dam bskang : yum mchog tsaṇ+ḍi dmar mo'i thugs dam bskang : bdud po sde bzhi yab yum thugs dam bskang : sprul pa bya rog rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : yang sprul gcan spyang rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs bstod dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol: hūm̐: de dbus khrag mtsho pad nyi ti ra'i steng : hūm̐ las skyes pa'i myur mgyogs mthu bo che: las kyi mgon po dpal ldan bya rog gdong : mthing nag rngam pa srog bdag khros pa'i gzugs: khā kha mu kha rab 'jigs zhal gdangs shing : dmar zlum spyan 'khyil shangs nas 'brug stong ldir: dbu skra ser nag nam mkha'i dbyings su bskyod: thod skam dbyings nas bya rog sprin ltar gtibs: phyag g.yas gri gug srid gsum mthongs la phyar: g.yon pa'i bhan dmar gdug pa'i snying khrag 'thung : gti mug tshar gcod glang ko stod la g.yogs: pha rol gzhom phyir zhing lpags sked la dkris: zhe sdang tshogs 'joms sbrul gyi 'ching rgyan 'khyugs: nga rgyal mthar byed stag gi sham thabs dkris: nyon mongs mtsho skem mgo rlon phreng bas brgyan: bag chags gtor byed khrag zhag thal tshom spras: myur mgyogs shugs 'chang sgro gshog dbyings su brgyangs: log lta tshar gcod me ri smug nag 'bar: tsaṇ+ḍi dmar mo srin gzugs pang du 'khyud: gri thod 'dzin cing rgyan drug chas kyis spras: zung 'jug dang ldan khrag 'thung dor thabs can: las mdzad chen po gar dgu dgyes pa yi: bskyed rdzogs brtan po'i yid kyis sprul pa 'dis: yab gcig legs ldan nag po'i thugs dam bskang :

yum gcig 'dod khams dbang phyug thugs dam bskang : sras mchog bya rog gdong gi thugs dam bskang : yum mchog tsaṇ+ḍi dmar mo'i thugs dam bskang : bdud po sde bzhi yab yum thugs dam bskang : sprul pa bya rog rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : yang sprul gcan spyang rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs bstod dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol: hūm̐: dpal ldan mgon po'i g.yas kyi bka' nyan pa: sku mdog dmar nag nyin gyi pho nya ba: bdud po sgrol byed 'bar ba satwa re thogs: nad kyi rlangs pa dgra dang bgegs la bh+yoḥ hūm̐: dpal ldan mgon po'i g.yon gyi bka' nyan pa: sku mdog dkar sngon mtshan gyi pho nya ba: las mkhan 'bar ba lag na spu gri thogs: mtshon gyi gru gu dgra dang bgegs la phob: hūm̐: dpal ldan mgon po'i rgyab kyi bka' nyan pa: sku mdog ser nag dus kyi pho nya ba: shan pa srog bdag las byed ral gri thogs: dmod pa'i dug mda' sngo dmar dgra la gtong : hūm̐: dpal ldan mgon po'i mdun gyi bka' nyan pa: sku mdog mthing nag gnas nyul pho nya ba: las mkhan myur mgyogs gnam lcags phur pa thogs: mngon spyod chen pos dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol: kun kyang gcer bu 'jigs pa'i nyams gyur can: g.yon pa thams cad lcags kyu 'bar ba thogs: rus pa'i rgyan ldan za byed srin po'i tshul: me ltar mched cing dgra bo'i snying khrag 'thung : hūm̐: dpal ldan mgon po'i mtshams kyi bka' nyan pa: shar lho 'bar ba ma mos zor ba thogs: lho nub ma mos kha rlangs sog le thogs: nub byang dur khrod ma mos be con thogs: byang shar srin mo gser mig khram shing thogs: kun kyang nag mo bya rog khros pa'i gdong : g.yon pa thams cad dgra bo'i tsit+ta bsnams: mi sdug gzugs can ma mo rngam pa'i tshul: byad ma mthar byed sprul pa sgyu ma'i sku: bka' yi 'khor du gnas pa'i srung ma'i tshogs: dgyes pa'i yid la bkod pa'i bka' sdod kyi:

yab gcig legs ldan nag po'i thugs dam bskang : yum gcig 'dod khams dbang phyug thugs dam bskang : sras mchog bya rog gdong gi thugs dam bskang : yum mchog tsaṇ+ḍi dmar mo'i thugs dam bskang : bdud po sde bzhi yab yum thugs dam bskang : sprul pa bya rog rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : yang sprul gcan spyang rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs bstod dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol: hūm̐: dpal ldan mgon po'i sprul pa yang sprul po: dgra sha za byed bya rog nag po bzhi: dgra khrag 'thung byed bya rog dmar po bzhi: kun kyang mchu sder bgrad cing dgra la rngam: dgra bo'i snying nas 'dren pa'i stag mo bzhi: dgra bo'i srog rtsa gcod pa'i dom nag bzhi: kun kyang kha gdangs mche gtsigs bam ro 'drad: dgra bo'i bla 'khyams 'gugs pa'i lcags spyang bzhi: dgra bo'i tshe len zangs kyi 'phar ba bzhi: kun kyang ngu 'dur brgyugs shing gshin skad 'don: dgra la phung thal 'gyed pa'i spre'u bzhi: dgra la cho 'phrul 'gyed pa'i srin bya bzhi: kun kyang mi rung sna tshogs cha lugs ston: gzhan yang nying sprul ma lus rlung ltar 'tshubs: ma nges gar gyi 'phrul 'khor ltar bsgyur nas: sna tshogs dgra la dmar 'gyed sprul 'khor 'dis: yab gcig legs ldan nag po'i thugs dam bskang : yum gcig 'dod khams dbang phyug thugs dam bskang : sras mchog bya rog gdong gi thugs dam bskang : yum mchog tsaṇ+ḍi dmar mo'i thugs dam bskang : bdud po sde bzhi yab yum thugs dam bskang : sprul pa bya rog rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : yang sprul gcan spyang rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs bstod dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol: hūm̐: dpal ldan mgon po'i dam skong rdzas mchog ni: gling gi gling mchog 'dzam gling kha ba can: dbus 'gyur chen po'i dpag tshad gsum mtho'i gnas: 'khor yug gangs ri'i phreng bas bskor ba ru:

dpal ldan ye shes mgon po'i dal zhing gnas: phyi nang pho brang rgyan sogs bskyod pa'i mthar: rgya che dpangs mtho'i dur khrod gling bzhis bskor: gnyis mched tshul du yid dpyod mtha' yas kyi: grangs med blo yis sprul te bskang ba ni: sna tshogs spyan gyi dbang po tshim bya'i phyir: yid kyi me tog tsit+ta'i rgyal mtshan bsgrengs: mkhal ma'i me tog rna ba rdza ltar nyil: srog rtsa'i me tog mig 'bras phung por spungs: mchin pa'i me tog lce yi pur len phyur: glo ba'i me tog sna yi zur bu 'khrigs: dbyings ltar mtho ba'i me tog sna tshogs 'dis: thugs rje'i spyan gyis bdag la gzigs pa'i phyir: dbang po'i me tog rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : tsan dan dkar dmar dkon mchog mnyes pa'i spos: ga pur dzā ti yi dam mnyes pa'i spos: li shi sug smel mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i spos: gri snying na gi dpal mgon mnyes pa'i spos: gu gul shing kun bgegs srin tshar gcod spos: sha chen sna tshogs dregs pa mnyes pa'i spos: sprin ltar gtibs pa'i dri mchog sna tshogs 'dis: brtse ba'i dgongs pa bdag la dgyes pa'i phyir: dri mchog sna tshogs spos kyis thugs dam bskang : nyi zla'i zhun me 'dzam gling gsal ba'i mdangs: sems nyid zhun me 'khor 'das gsal ba'i mdangs: 'bri mar zhun me smag rum gsal ba'i mdangs: til mar zhun me zor mda' gsal ba'i mdangs: tshil chen zhun me dpal mgon mnyes pa'i mdangs: rkang dmar zhun me dregs pa mnyes pa'i mdangs: dbyings ltar gsal ba'i sna tshogs zhun me 'dis: gnas lugs dgongs pas bdag la skyong ba'i phyir: dkar me sna tshogs gtams pas thugs dam bskang : mkha' yi chu 'dzin dag gtsang dri yi chab: lha yi bdud rtsi brgyad ldan dri yi chab: byang sems bdud rtsi 'chi med bdud rtsi che: rol mtsho phyur 'khyil mchod 'os dri yi chab: dug khrag gri khrag dpal mgon dri yi chab:

khrag chen du ma shan pa dri yi chab: bsil ldan ma nges sbyar zhing gtams pa 'dis: mdangs bzang rdzas kyi dngos grub 'byung ba'i phyir: dri chab sna tshogs gtams pas thugs dam bskang : shing 'bras lha yi zhal zas bcud dang ldan: 'bras dkar drang srong zhal zas bcud dang ldan: gro nas tshogs kyi zhal zas bcud dang ldan: khre til rdzas kyi zhal zas bcud dang ldan: se 'bru mchod pa'i zhal zas bcud dang ldan: bra sran dpal mgon zhal zas bcud dang ldan: bu ram mtha' yi zhal zas bcud dang ldan: 'bru mar 'bras bu'i zhal zas bcud dang ldan: dgyes pa'i bsod nams dpal rten bskyed pa'i phyir: ro bcud zhal zas rnams kyis thugs dam bskang : lha yi rnga chen mkha' spyod dgyes pa'i sgra: dbyar gyi rnga chen 'byung lnga bskyed pa'i sgra: ghaṇ+ḍi'i rnga chen chos 'khor bskor ba'i sgra: drag shing rnga chen yi dam dgyes pa'i sgra: rin chen rnga zlum mkha' 'gro bskul ba'i sgra: thod pa'i rnga chen dpal mgon dgyes pa'i sgra: rdza yi rnga chen gar dang mchod pa'i sgra: lcags kyi hom rnga mthu gtad nag po'i sgra: 'brug ltar grags pa'i rol mo sna tshogs 'dis: snyan pa'i dung chen sna tshogs bsgrag pa'i phyir: rol mo 'brug ltar grags pas thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: rang bzhin khyon yangs mtshan ldan ka pā la: rgya che'i nang du sman mchod gtams pa ni: dzā ti rgyal po rlung sman bdud rtsi che: gi waṃ rgyal po mkhris sman bdud rtsi che: li shi rgyal po bad kan bdud rtsi che: a ru rgyal po 'dus pa'i bdud rtsi che: tsan dan ga pur tshad pa'i bdud rtsi che: ka ko sug smel grang ba'i bdud rtsi che: gur gum cu gang snyoms pa'i bdud rtsi che: dbang ril sbyor ba zhi ba'i bdud rtsi che: chig thub sbyor ba drag po'i bdud rtsi che: glang chen sbyor ba mngon spyod bdud rtsi che: phyi nang bzang ldan bdud rtsi sna tshogs 'dis: rang gzhan nyon mongs nad las bskyab pa'i phyir:

bdud rtsi mtsho ltar 'khyil bas thugs dam bskang : lcags zangs drag po'i snod mchog zur gsum du: bskyed pa'i rang bzhin gtor ma spungs pa ni: dbyings ltar mtho ba ri rab bha ling+ta: zhi la zlum pa'i lus 'phags bha ling+ta: rgyas la gru bzhi 'dzam bu'i bha ling+ta: dbang la zla gam ba lang bha ling+ta: drag po zur gsum sgra mi'i bha ling+ta: gangs dkar rtse mtho sgrub pa'i bha ling+ta: ri nag rngams 'thug bskang ba'i bha ling+ta: dmar nag dbal ldan rbad pa'i bha ling+ta: g.ya' sngo rtse gzengs bsad pa'i bha ling+ta: shing nags tshal gzengs bha ling brgyan pa'i rdzas: 'bru rigs ma nges bha ling las kyi thun: dur sa phung sa bha ling las kyi zor: g.yul sa'i lcags ri bha ling bzhugs pa'i gdan: dkar thig zla brgyan dmar lam nyi zlas byugs: mkha' yi dmar 'od 'khyugs pa'i zhags kyis dkris: de ltar rang byung bha ling gtor ma 'di: gdod nas dgyes shing brtse bas dgongs pa'i phyir: bha ling lhun mtho sna tshogs thugs dam bskang : bum ril dung dmar rgya che'i snod mchog tu: mkha' yi dbang mo'i mu khā las byung ba: a haṃ rak+ta rgyal ba bsgrub pa'i rdzas: ma hā rak+ta yi dam bsgrub pa'i rdzas: mu la rak+ta dpa' bo bsgrub pa'i rdzas: gu h+ya rak+ta mkha' 'gro bsgrub pa'i rdzas: mā ra rak+ta dpal mgon bsgrub pa'i rdzas: du na rak+ta chos skyong bsgrub pa'i rdzas: an+dza rak+ta dam can bsgrub pa'i rdzas: dza la rak+ta gter srung bsgrub pa'i rdzas: ha la rak+ta dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i rdzas: bhi shwa rak+ta dam can bsgrub pa'i rdzas: e ma rak+ta dam tshig bskang ba'i rdzas: du ma sbyor ba'i rmad byung rak+ta 'di: chag nyams bag sgrib ma lus bsal ba'i phyir: mdangs ldan rak+ta sna tshogs thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: sgrub cing bskang ba'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir: rang bzhin mkha' yi spyan gzigs thugs dam bskang : bzhugs pa'i dam rdzas gnyan po yin pa'i phyir: dur khrod pho brang 'bar bas thugs dam bskang :

skyon gyi ma gos rang bzhin gsal ba'i phyir: pad+ma nyi ma'i gdan gyis thugs dam bskang : sgrib pa'i g.ya' bral rtog med don ldan phyir: zla rgyas bam ro'i gdan gyis thugs dam bskang : phyi nang sgrib gnyis ka nas dag pa'i phyir: me rlung dkar ltar 'khrugs pas thugs dam bskang : srid pa'i rgya mtsho rmang nas skem pa'i phyir: rak+ta zham chu 'khyil bas thugs dam bskang : dgyes pa'i gar gyis sa bcu gnon pa'i phyir: dpal dang dur khrod chas kyis thugs dam bskang : pho rgyud thams cad zil gyis gnon pa'i phyir: rab 'bar gnam lcags gri gug thugs dam bskang : mo rgyud thams cad dbang du bsdu ba'i phyir: bhan dmar rak+ta phyur bas thugs dam bskang : dug gsum mtshan ma'i bag chags 'joms pa'i phyir: ngar ldan tri shul rtse gsum thugs dam bskang : dgra bo'i bdun rgyud rtsad nas gcod pa'i phyir: phyung rdeg ral gri 'bar bas thugs dam bskang : ma rungs bgegs srin snying la bsnun pa'i phyir: gdab pa ri rab phur bus thugs dam bskang : byad ma sdig can snying la bsnun pa'i phyir: ru mtshon gzir 'debs nag pos thugs dam bskang : pha rol rgol ba cham la dbab pa'i phyir: spu gri mtshon cha du mas thugs dam bskang : sgrub cing 'khor ba'i rten rdzas yin pa'i phyir: mda' mo dar nag brgyan pas thugs dam bskang : rten du mi 'bral grib bzhin 'grog pa'i phyir: srog 'khor bla rdo rnams kyis thugs dam bskang : nam mkha'i rgyan gyur rang bzhin pho nya'i phyir: mkha' lding gser mig nag pos thugs dam bskang : ngar sgras sa gzhi ma lus g.yo ba'i phyir: g.yag rog zhol chen rnams kyis thugs dam bskang : bya lam yud ldang rlung gshog myur ba'i phyir: cang shes rta mchog rnams kyis thugs dam bskang : srid la 'jol ba'i rnga yab sham bu can: sa le zal mo 'bri yis thugs dam bskang : 'ba' sgra'i tser skad gdangs snyan len pa'i phyir:

'jam legs shel sgong lug gis thugs dam bskang : snang glu ki sgra sang sang bsgrag pa'i phyir: tsa ra rog po mkhal dkar thugs dam bskang : snang ba'i yid spyod dgyes shing dgyes pa'i phyir: gzugs 'gros 'phur bskyod sna tshogs thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: mchod pa'i bye brag sna tshogs ma nges pa: mkha' ltar yangs shing gling ltar phyug pa'i tshogs: bskyed cing spel nas legs par bkram pa 'dis: yab gcig legs ldan nag po'i thugs dam bskang : yum gcig 'dod khams dbang phyug thugs dam bskang : sras mchog bya rog gdong gi thugs dam bskang : yum mchog tsaṇ+ḍi dmar mo'i thugs dam bskang : bdud po sde bzhi yab yum thugs dam bskang : sprul pa'i bya rog rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : yang sprul gcan spyang rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs bstod dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol: nyams chag bshags shing mi sgrib dag par stsol: zhes yi ge brgya pas chad lhag bkang : ༈ rgyal ba kun 'dus khyab bdag rol pa las: dam can rgya mtsho'i gsol mchod phrin las myur mgyogs bzhugs so: che mchog 'dus pa thod phreng drag po'i lha la 'dud: sa ma ya rgya: de yang bka' srung 'dus pa phrin las myur mgyogs mngon spyod rtsol med du 'byin pa che zhes cher 'jigs pa'i las su bskul na tha tshig so so'i gnyer du bgyis pa la: thog mar drag po'i snod dam rang byung bhan+dha'am ci 'khod pa zhig tu: gdan ri rab bang rim gsum pa: de'i steng du 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa dang bzhi pa: de'i steng du thod pa'i sgyed pu gsum: de'i steng du chos 'byung rngams 'thug gcig la thod tshal gyi kha bad yod pa: bang rim gsum dang ldan pa: de'i steng du rin chen zur brgyad pa: de'i steng du mgon po'i gtor ma tsit+ta'i dpal bshos thod tshal bzhis brgyan pa bya: rtsibs bzhi pa'i steng shar du zhing skyong mgon po'i gtor ma dbal zur gsum dang ldan pa dpung gshog gnyis brgyangs pa thog mde'u lta bur khrag kong gsum gyis bskor ba:

zor ris rak+ta'i rgyun lam bya: lho ru gza' mchog gtor ma dpal gtor g.yas gcus gru gsum gyi steng du sbrul mgo gsum brgyan pa: logs gsum du bzhag: nub tu gnod sbyin gtor ma chos 'byung steng du bra gzugs dbal thon la tsit+ta gsum chos 'byung zur gsum du bzhag: gri ris kyang 'then: byang du rgyal po dpe ha ra'i gtor ma gdan gru bzhi'i steng du mkhar thab rtse mo spre'u mgos mtshan pa mkhar gyi logs gsum du phyi ba gyen du langs pa bya: rtsibs bcu par shar du lha bshos: shar mtshams dkar gtor: shar lho kong bu gru bzhi'i kha ru phyi ba: lho ru gtor ma nag po zur bzhi pa khram ris can: lho nub tu dpal gtor g.yas gcus: nub tu sog kha'i steng du snying bshos: nub mtshams su mkhar thab steng du ra mgo bzhag: nub byang rus sbal steng du 'brang rgyas: byang du gtor ma zur gsum sbrul mgos brgyan par sbrul dkris can: byang shar du zur gsum g.yas gcus: mtshams rnams su khrag kong bcu: bang rim rnams su gtor zur drug cu rtsa bzhi: ling tshe drug cu rtsa gnyis mtha' ru khrag kong dang mtheb skyu: mtshams bzhir dbang po rnam lnga bcas rtse mor mdzes pa'i rgyan khra: gzhan yang liṅga'i rgyal mtshan dang dmar rgyan tshe nyungs kyi rkang bu bcas: rtse mor dar nag po'i rgyal mtshan: shar du seng lpags rgyal mtshan: lho ru stag lpags rgyal mtshan: nub tu dom lpags rgyal mtshan: byang du zhing lpags rgyal mtshan: mtshams su ru mtshon dkar ser dmar ljang : gru bzhir dar mtshon sna lnga: byung na snal ma'i gdugs bcas phub: gzhan yang mthun pa'i spyan gzigs du ma bsham: rang nyid yi dam gang rung gi bskyed rim song ba'i rjes su chos skyong bskyed nas spyan 'dren pa ni: sha chen sna tshogs kyi spos bsregs shing rol mo rnga chen 'brug ltar sgrogs shing : bdag nyid drag po'i ting 'dzin dang bcas nas: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐:

lan gsum: om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum: om̐ swa bhā w stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid yi dam che mchog drag po he ru ka gsal ba'i mdun du khrag zhag rgya mtsho ltar 'khyil zhing phyur ba mi ro rta ro'i lbu ba lang ling du 'phyo ba: de'i dbus su srid pa'i ri rab gru bzhi pa: de'i steng du pad+ma dang nyi ma ro yi steng du hūm̐ mthing nag dang gri gug las skyes pa'i dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa sku che zhing yan lag rags pa: thung zhing sbom la gsus pa rgyas pa: phyag g.yas g.yon dang pos gri gug dang bhan+dha 'og mas ral gri dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ka bsnams pa zhabs phyed skyil du bzhugs shing dur khrod 'bar ba'i chas dang ldan pa: de'i pang du 'khyud pa'i yum tsaṇ+ḍi ma dmar mo gri gug dang thod khrag 'dzin pa: yab la 'khyud pa yab yum bskal pa'i me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i klong du gsal ba'o: gtso bo'i phyogs bzhir dpal ye shes kyi mgon po ma ning nag po gdong bzhi pa phyag drug pa bram ze'i gzugs can sogs yum sgo skyong dang bcas pa snang la rang bzhin med pa gsal bar bskyed do: om̐ shrī ma hā kā la kā li dzñā na dhe wa gha na gu h+ya k+ṣeṃ k+ṣe ṭa raṃ sid+dhi hūm̐ phaṭḥ hoḥ shar phyogs dur khrod me rlung 'tshubs pa'i dbus su dgra bgegs pho mo gdan du bting ba'i steng du yi ge he dang ru mtshon las skyes pa'i dpal bdud kyi mgon po ma hā kā la sku mdog mthing nag seṅge rab tu khros pa'i gdong pa can sku la dar nag gi phod kha dang rus pa'i rgyan drug gis spras pa g.yas ru mtshon nag po mkha' la 'phyar zhing g.yon thod pa'i nang du dmar nag dbal gyi gtor ma dgra la 'phen pa stag ral gzig shubs ral gris brgyan pa swag lham gsol zhing bdud rta nag po rlung gshog la chibs pa: de'i g.yon du bh+yo las bdud mo seng gdong ma sku mdog dmar mo dar dmar gyi phod kha gsol zhing :

g.yas rtse gsum dang g.yon ral gri 'dzin pa btsan rta dmar zhur la chibs pa: yab yum me ri 'bar ba'i klong du gsal ba'o: de'i 'khor du sprul pa'i las mkhan spre'u gdong can gnyis: shar du lha: lho ru btsan rgod: nub tu ma mo: byang du dge bsnyen: mtshams bzhir bdud gza' dgra lha dam can la sogs pa myur mgyogs can gzhan yang sprul pa yang sprul dang bcas pa 'jigs pa'i rgyan sna tshogs kyi spras par bskyed do: lho ru dug mtsho khol ma'i dbus su yi ge ra dang ral gri las skyes pa'i drang srong gza' bdud nag po sku mdog dud kha zhal dgu bya rog gi dbu dang bcu: phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis spu gri dang chu srin gyi rgyal mtshan 'og ma gnyis ra yi mda' gzhu 'gengs shing sbrul zhags 'dzin pa sku smad dug sbrul nag po rgya mtsho'i klong du 'khyil ba: sku lus thams cad spyan stong gis gtams pa de'i g.yon du yum klu mo khrag mig ma nyi ma dang zla ba 'dzin pa: yab yum rlung nag bu yug 'tshubs pa'i klong du gsal ba'o: shar du zla ba: lho ru spen pa: nub tu nyi ma: byang du phur bu: mtshams bzhir lhag pa pa sangs mig dmar sgra gcan: gzhan yang gdong mo mched bzhi las kyi klu mo rigs brgyad nye 'khor sa bdag dang bcas pa bskyed do: nub tu byad ma mi ro rta ro bsnol mar brtsegs pa'i dbus su yi ge tsa dang beng chen las skyes pa'i gnod sbyin btsan rgod chen po sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum mche ba gtsigs pa'i ya so yis ma mchu mnan pa: sku la dar dmar gyi za ber gsol zhing bswe khrab bswe rmog ru mtshon gyis brgyan te phyag g.yas tsan dan gyi beng chen dang g.yon ru mtshon dang zhags dmar 'dzin pa: sku la stag ral gzig shubs ral gris mdzes pa: rta rag pa rting dkar la zhon cing myur mgyogs shan pa chen po'i las su chas pa'o: shar du lha: lho ru klu: nub tu sman mo:

byang du yak+ṣa: mtshams bzhir sprul pa za byed gsod byed sgrol byed las byed kyi bshan pa bzhi yang sprul dang bcas pa gsal ba'o: byang du snang zhing srid pa'i skye 'chi thams cad kyi 'byung ba 'khrugs pa dang ma 'khrug pa'i rlung dbang du phyam pa na bun 'tshub mar gtibs pa'i dbus su yi ge ru dang 'khar bsil ri rab kyi bkod pas brgyan pa las sprul pa'i chos skyong ba'i gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po chen po ging ha ra dpe dkar dkor bdag bstan pa'i bya ra ba chen po sku mdog dkar smug rgyas pa'i zhal can dbu la bswe chen gyi theb gsol zhing dar dkar po dang za 'og gi go zu gsol ba: phyag na 'khar bsil dang lcags kyi lhung phor byad ma sdang zhing gdug pa can rnams kyi snying khrag dang tsit+tas bkang ba chibs su seṅge dkar mo la zhon cing dkor cha'i gnyer kha 'tsho bar gsal ba'o: shar du dpe har shel ging : lho ru tshangs pa shel ging : nub tu li byin shel ging : byang du dpe har shel ging : mtshams bzhir dpe nag shing bya dpe dmar gnam lha bzhi ste thams cad kyang mngon spyod dang ldan pa: gzhan yang sprul pa yang sprul nyid sprul dang bcas pa gsal snang sgyu ma'i gar bsgyur ba lta bur gsal zhing bskyed do: de'i phyi rol du rin chen gter gyi rgya rin po che bsrung ba la dbang ba'i sprul pa nyid sprul gzhan yang sha za khrag 'thung las byed bsam gyis mi khyab pa du mar gsal ba'i dpral bar om̐: mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐: lte bar swā: gsang bar hā: las byed du bh+yoḥ sprul pa ru phaṭḥ nyid sprul du dzaḥ de rnams las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bstan pa'i bya ra ba gnyan po chos skyong ba'i srung ma drag rtsal dang ldan pa 'khor bcas spyan drangs: om̐ badz+ra shrī kā la k+ṣe ṭa pā la ki kang shu la tsa tri ging ka ra yak+ṣa rak+ṣa du pra ma ma hā raṃ ata tsi ta a ya ma du ru tsa sha na sa mā ya dza dzaḥ

zhes rnga dang rkang gling drag po 'bod pa'i dbyangs sna tshogs bgyis la: hūm̐: dur khrod ming ni nges su gang zhig bca': 'dzam gling 'di ru stobs bcus mnga' bsgyur ba'i: sa mtshams 'gog pa'i dmigs su ma mchis pa: tshangs pa'i yul nas sdong po'i gling 'jug pa: dpal chen nag po phyag bzhi gshegs su gsol: thabs shes mkha' la rol pa'i tshul 'chang ma: yum mchog tsaṇ+ḍi ma mo gshegs su gsol: phyogs bzhi mtshams dang las su sprul pa'i lha: ye shes mgon po lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: shar phyogs 'dzam gling 'jig rten tsā ri'i gnas: g.ya' gangs lhun snyogs nags tshal sprin ltar gtibs: ma mo mngon rgyu sha za lang long rgyug: de 'dra'i pho brang dbang sgyur nag po che: bdud mgon zhing skyong lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: dug mtsho nag po rba rlabs phyur ma 'khyil: stong gsum 'di ru 'gyu ba'i drag rtsal can: myur mgyogs shugs 'chang gnam lcags 'od po che: thog ser rngam klong 'gyu ba'i las byed pa: drang srong gza' mchog lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: khrag mtsho 'khrugs pa'i gnas chen zangs ri'i gling : mchong dmar 'gyings pa'i pho brang khang bzang nas: gnod sbyin chen po mi bsrun mthu bo che: mngon spyod mdzad tshe bshan pa'i tshul bzung ba: btsan rgod 'bar ba'i lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: tshangs pa'i pho brang 'dod rgu 'byung ba'i gnas: dbang phyug lha yi gzhal med lta bu'i khyim: 'dzam gling dkor mdzod spungs pa'i pho brang nas: skye 'gro dbang sgyur las byed dkar smug zhal: sprul pa'i chos rgyal 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: gzhan yang dam can srung ma drag rtsal can: gter la dbang zhing sngags kyi bstan pa srung : bka' yi las byed mthu ldan ma lus pa: sprul pa yang sprul las byed la sogs pa: chos skyong yongs rdzogs 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol: om̐ e h+ya hi shrī nā tha ma hā kā la singha mu kha ki kang shu la ya ging ka ra sarba dharma pā la ya dza dzaḥ

sa ma ya dung dung thun thun phaiṃ phaiṃ a be sha ya hriṃ hriṃ dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes chos skyong 'khor bcas sprin chen rlung gis bskyod pa ltar byon nas rten dang pho brang la bzhugs par bsam: hūm̐: dur khrod pho brang me rlung 'tshubs pa'i dbus: khrag mtsho nyi zla pad+ma ro yi gdan: bdud dgra bgegs srin tshar gcod gdan steng du: bstan pa'i bya ra myur mgyogs dam can rnams: chos 'khor gtsug lag gnyan po skyong ba'i phyir: phrin las thogs med bsgrub phyir brtan par bzhugs: om̐ sa ma ya dharma pā la ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni: gtor ma sman raka gis bran: mchod pa kha gso zhing gsur btang : dri zhim kyang bsreg: rol mo dang dbyangs shin tu snyan par bya: hūm̐: dpal mgon dam can rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs la: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni: gdug pa'i dam nyams byad ma bsgral ba yi: mig dang rna ba sna dang lce snying sogs: bsam gyis mi khyab ri ltar spungs pa 'di: dam can chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs la 'bul: bzhes nas gdug pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol bar mdzod: om̐ sarba dharma pā la ya badz+ra puṣ+pe swā hā: hūm̐: mi sha rta sha glang chen ba glang sha: khyi sha la sogs sha chen sna tshogs bsregs: gzhan yang rdzas rgod ngar ldan sbyar spos 'di: dam can chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs la 'bul: bzhes nas gdug pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol bar mdzod: om̐ sarba dharma pā la ya badz+ra dhū pe swā hā: hūm̐: rkang mar zhag dang til mar sbyar ba la: ro ras shi skra dkris pa'i sdong bus gtams: sbar ba'i sgron me 'tshubs pa'i 'od 'gengs 'di: dam can chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs la 'bul: bzhes nas gdug pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol bar mdzod: om̐ sarba dharma pā la ya badz+ra ā lo ke swā hā: hūm̐: dug khrag thang khrom gu gul sbyar ba yi: ngar ldan rba rlabs nag po gyen du phyur: rgyu khrag la sogs mkhris pa'i dri chab 'di:

dam can chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs la 'bul: bzhes nas gdug pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol bar mdzod: om̐ sarba dharma pā la ya badz+ra gan+dhe swā hā: hūm̐: 'bru nag ngar phye gri khrag sbags pa'i zan: dmar nag dpal ldan sha khrag liṅgas brgyan: zhag gi bcud g.yo 'khyil zhing phyur ba 'di: dam can chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs la 'bul: bzhes nas gdug pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol bar mdzod: om̐ sarba dharma pā la ya badz+ra nai wi d+ye swā hā: hūm̐: thod pa ltag sprod las kyi phyag rgya lnga: rdza rnga rnga zlum drag po'i shing gi rnga: 'brug ltar ldir ba'i rnga chen rol mo 'di: dam can chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs la 'bul: bzhes nas gdug pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol bar mdzod: om̐ sarba dharma pā la badz+ra shab+da swā hā: hūm̐: bhan+dha lcang lo yangs pa'i snod mchog tu: sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga dang yig 'bru lnga: 'od zhu sbyangs spel bsgyur ba'i rdzas mchog 'di: dam can chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs la 'bul: bzhes nas gdug pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol bar mdzod: om̐ sarba dharma pā la ya ma hā a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi: hūm̐: gtor snod drag po yangs shing rgya che'i nang : dgra bgegs 'byung po rnams kyi sha dang khrag: klad rus rkang dang nang rol khu ba bcas: ri ltar spungs pa'i dgra sha khrag mchod 'di: dam can chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs la 'bul: bzhes nas gdug pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol bar mdzod: om̐ sarba dharma pā la ya ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na ba su ta la kha kha khā hi: hūm̐: bum ril mtshan ldan snod mchog ka pā la: ma rungs byad ma rnams kyi snying khrag gtams: rlabs chen 'phyur ba'i rak+ta 'bar ba 'di: dam can chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs la 'bul: bzhes nas gdug pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol bar mdzod: om̐ sarba ma hā rak+ta la kha kha khā hi: de nas bskang gsol bya ba ni: mchod pa gso zhing bran khrag chang nam mkhar gtor zhing : hūm̐ hūm̐:

phyi snod yangs pa 'dzam gling bhan+dha ru: nang bcud longs spyod bsod nams dngos zhing tshogs: nyer spyod mthun rdzas sgrub rdzas skong ba'i rdzas: dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchod pa'i bye brag dang : rab dmar khrag gi rgya mtsho kyi li li: rmad byung sbyor ba'i mchod rdzas sna tshogs 'di: dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la 'bul lags na: dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: gdug pa'i dgra bgegs rnams kyi snying gi khrag: 'bru nag chang dang dug rigs sbyor ba'i phud: ru tra bsgral ba'i dbang po rnam lnga 'di: dpal chen nag po phyag bzhi'i zhal du 'bul: dpal mgon sde bzhi yab yum zhal du 'bul: las byed sgo ma mched bzhi'i zhal du 'bul: bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pas mnga' gsol lo: rak+ta dmar gyi mchod pas mnga' gsol lo: bha ling dbang po rnam lngas mnga' gsol lo: dgra bgegs klad rus sha yis mnga' gsol lo: sna tshogs spyan gzigs du mas mnga' gsol lo: mnga' gsol 'di bzhes sangs rgyas bstan pa srungs: ma rungs log 'dren bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: gdug pa'i dgra bgegs rnams kyi mchin pa'i khrag: 'bru nag chang dang dug rigs sbyor ba'i phud: ru tra bsgral ba'i dbang po rnam lnga 'di: dpal ldan zhing skyong yab yum zhal du 'bul: las mkhan bam ro pho mo'i zhal du 'bul: bka' sdod dregs pa sde brgyad zhal du 'bul: las byed sprul pa yang sprul zhal du 'bul: bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pas mnga' gsol lo: rak+ta dmar gyi mchod pas mnga' gsol lo: bha ling dbang po rnam lngas mnga' gsol lo: dgra bgegs klad rus sha yis mnga' gsol lo: sna tshogs spyan gzigs du mas mnga' gsol lo: mnga' gsol 'di bzhes sangs rgyas bstan pa srungs: ma rungs log 'dren bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: gdug pa'i dgra bgegs rnams kyi glo ba'i khrag: 'bru nag chang dang dug rigs sbyor ba'i phud: ru tra bsgral ba'i dbang po rnam lnga 'di:

drang srong gza' bdud yab yum zhal du 'bul: myur mgyogs gza' chen rnam brgyad zhal du 'bul: yum dang sras mchog sprul pa'i zhal du 'bul: bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pas mnga' gsol lo: rak+ta dmar gyi mchod pas mnga' gsol lo: bha ling dbang po rnam lngas mnga' gsol lo: dgra bgegs klad rus sha yis mnga' gsol lo: sna tshogs spyan gzigs du mas mnga' gsol lo: mnga' gsol 'di bzhes sangs rgyas bstan pa srungs: ma rungs log 'dren bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: gdug pa'i dgra bgegs rnams kyi mkhal ma'i khrag: 'bru nag chang dang dug rigs sbyor ba'i phud: ru tra bsgral ba'i dbang po rnam lnga 'di: gnod sbyin btsan rgod chen po'i zhal du 'bul: las mkhan myur mgyogs sde brgyad zhal du 'bul: sprul pa byi la mtshal bya'i zhal du 'bul: bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pas mnga' gsol lo: rak+ta dmar gyi mchod pas mnga' gsol lo: bha ling dbang po rnam lngas mnga' gsol lo: dgra bgegs klad rus sha yis mnga' gsol lo: sna tshogs spyan gzigs du mas mnga' gsol lo: mnga' gsol 'di bzhes sangs rgyas bstan pa srungs: ma rungs log 'dren bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: gdug pa'i dgra bgegs rnams kyi srog gi khrag: 'bru nag chang dang dug rigs sbyor ba'i phud: ru tra bsgral ba'i dbang po rnam lnga 'di: chos skyong dpe dkar chen po'i zhal du 'bul: yum mchog gnam sman rgyal mo'i zhal du 'bul: shel ging dregs pa sde brgyad zhal du 'bul: sprul pa yang sprul nyid sprul zhal du 'bul: bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pas mnga' gsol lo: rak+ta dmar gyi mchod pas mnga' gsol lo: bha ling dbang po rnam lngas mnga' gsol lo: dgra bgegs klad rus sha yis mnga' gsol lo: sna tshogs spyan gzigs du mas mnga' gsol lo: mnga' gsol 'di bzhes sangs rgyas bstan pa srungs: ma rungs log 'dren bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐:

gdug pa'i dgra bgegs rnams kyi dbang po'i khrag: 'bru nag chang dang dug rigs sbyor ba'i phud: ru tra bsgral ba'i dbang po rnam lnga 'di: dam can myur mgyogs rnams kyi zhal du 'bul: gter bdag gter srung rnams kyi zhal du 'bul: yul lha gzhi bdag rnams kyi zhal du 'bul: mchod 'os bstod 'os rnams kyi zhal du 'bul: bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pas mnga' gsol lo: rak+ta dmar gyi mchod pas mnga' gsol lo: bha ling dbang po rnam lngas mnga' gsol lo: dgra bgegs klad rus sha yis mnga' gsol lo: sna tshogs spyan gzigs du mas mnga' gsol lo: mnga' gsol 'di bzhes sangs rgyas bstan pa srungs: ma rungs log 'dren bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ āḥhūm̐: ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi: om̐ āḥhūm̐: ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la ya kha kha khā hi: om̐ āḥhūm̐: ma hā bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: om̐ āḥhūm̐: ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na ba su ta la kha kha khā hi: om̐ āḥhūm̐: sarba bi shwa pū dza me gha ya āḥhūm̐: de nas skong ba bya ba ni: hūm̐: smug nag gru gsum e yi dkyil 'khor nas: sa bcu'i dbang phyug legs ldan nag po che: ma hā kā la mthing nag rngam pa'i sku: srid gsum sngangs byed khrag 'thung phyag bzhi pa: ye shes mgon po chen po'i thugs dam bskang : gsang chen me ri 'bar ba'i dur khrod nas: ma ning srog sgrub nag po'i thugs dam bskang : ha ha dgod pa'i dur khrod chen po nas: dpal chen gdong bzhi mgon po'i thugs dam bskang : shing rkang gcig pa'i dur khrod chen po nas: myur mdzad phyag drug mgon po'i thugs dam bskang : rlung nag 'tshubs pa'i dur khrod chen po nas: mgon po bram ze'i gzugs can thugs dam bskang : 'phro 'du srid pa rnam bzhi'i dur khrod nas: tsaṇ+ḍi ma mo rigs bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : las mdzad mā ra ya yi dur khrod nas: srog bdag bya rog gdong can thugs dam bskang :

sngags bdag las la 'gyed pa'i dur khrod nas: tsaṇ+ḍi ma mo sgo skyong thugs dam bskang : srid pa las kyi mtha' sdud dur khrod nas: mgon po'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs shing mchog thun dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: dpal ldan ye shes mgon po mnyes pa'i rdzas: gdug pa'i dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i bhan+dha ru: dmar chen gtor ma dar nag gdugs kyis brgyan: gri rgod snying dang bla rdo srog 'khor bcas: rten dar rnga thug nag po mkha' la phyar: gri gug ral gri kha ṭ+wāṃ mtshon cha gzengs: rta nag cang shes bcu gsum 'tsher skad tser: g.yag nag ngar ldan bcu gsum dal gyis 'gro: lug nag dpyi dkar bcu gsum 'ba' sgra tser: tsa ra rog po bcu gsum sbrid cing 'khrab: khyi nag snying dkar bcu gsum kha gdangs 'dur: bya nag gser mig bcu gsum gshog 'gyur lding : dom nag smyon pa bcu gsum ngar sgra 'byin: sbrul nag 'khyug 'gying bcu gsum phya ma phyo: rwa can sder chags 'dab chags du ma dang : gzhan yang dgyes shing bskang dang mthun pa'i rdzas: byang g.yag zhol ldan kham pa ru ring la: rgyab tu dgra bgegs pho mo'i bam ro bkal: phyogs bzhir dur khrod ging pa pho mo rgyug: lag tu thod dbyug bhan+dha khrag bkang thogs: mtshams bzhir bram ze mi nag gcer bu yis: thod rnga dang ni gri rkang gling bu thogs: gzhan yang spyan gzigs mchod rdzas du ma yis: yab gcig legs ldan nag po'i thugs dam bskang : yum mchog 'dod khams dbang phyug thugs dam bskang : ye shes mgon po phyag bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : ma ning dpal 'bar nag po'i thugs dam bskang : gdong bzhi ma hā kā la'i thugs dam bskang : phyag drug ye shes mgon po'i thugs dam bskang : bram gzugs dur khrod bdag po'i thugs dam bskang : las byed bye ba 'bum gyi thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs shing nyams chag kun bsal nas: bar chad sel zhing dngos grub stsal du gsol:

hūm̐: shar phyogs kha ba can gyi shar lho'i mtshams: dbyings la bsnyegs pa'i dur khrod tsā ri ṭa: thod pa brtsegs pa'i pho brang chen po nas: mthing nag rngam byed dpal ldan seṅge'i gdong : dpa' ba'i chas ldan bdud rta rlung gshog chibs: bdud mo yum bcas 'dzam gling dbang sgyur ba: dpal mgon zhing skyong yab yum thugs dam bskang : dri gzhon rdul ltar g.yo ba'i gnas mchog nas: sprel gdong bam ro pho mo'i thugs dam bskang : dung ri 'ja' 'od 'khyil ba'i gnas mchog nas: lha btsan rdo rje 'bar ba'i thugs dam bskang : brag dmar khra tshang zangs g.yag gnas mchog nas: bshan pa btsan rgod chen po'i thugs dam bskang : mthing bzang srid pa yangs pa'i gnas mchog nas: sngags bdag e ka dzā ṭi'i thugs dam bskang : mtsho nag rba klong 'khrugs pa'i gnas mchog nas: dge bsnyen nā ga rak+sha'i thugs dam bskang : mun gling kha rag mgo dgu'i gnas mchog nas: bdud rje nag po bkrag med thugs dam bskang : me rlung rdul ltar 'khrigs pa'i gnas mchog nas: drang srong gza' mchog nag po'i thugs dam bskang : ma sang rtsal bcu 'gyed pa'i gnas mchog nas: che btsan dgra lha gnyan po'i thugs dam bskang : 'o yug lcags mkhar nag po'i gnas mchog nas: dam can rdo rje legs pa'i thugs dam bskang : myur mgyogs me ltar 'bar ba'i gnas mchog nas: zhing skyong bka' 'khor yongs rdzogs thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs shing mchog thun dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: chos skyong nag po bdud mgon mnyes pa'i rdzas: ru mtshon nag po pha rol rgol 'joms dang : ru dar nag po rlung gi 'khor lo can: g.yab dar nag po srid pa'i g.yul zlog che: dar nag phod dang gnam lcags go khrab bkram: chu gri ral gri spu gri drwa ba bris: mda' mo sgro gsum mthing nag dar gyis brgyan: me long la sogs srog gi yi ges spras: thog mda' dgra la 'phen pa'i gtor zor la: bdud kyi mtshon cha sna tshogs rtsang ltar gzengs:
