g.yu ral gtibs pa'i seng chung 'bum 'bum dang : rtsal sgro gzigs pa'i bya khyung sa ya khri: mkha' yi sgra 'dzin g.yu 'brug sngon mo stong : rta nag rta dmar nyi khri rlung gshog can: gzhan yang mi zan rngam dred dmar nag la: gdug pa'i dgra bgegs pho mo'i bam chen bkal: bdud kyi ling pa khyi khrid nyi li li: lce spyang lag ring ngu zug cangs se cang : zangs 'phar dmar po 'dur rgyug myu ru ru: khra glag bya rog dmar nag tshubs se tshub: bdud bya mchu dmar rngam 'jums kyi li li: srin bya 'ug pas ku 'debs lhangs se lhang : 'dre bya sreg pas skad ngan tse re re: sman bya pu shud bshugs sgra kyu ru ru: ging bdud sha za mtshon thogs rongs se rong : srin mo khrag mdog mi sdug mtshan ma bsgrad: zangs kyi spre'u pho mo la sogs pa: mthun pa'i spyan gzigs du ma bkram pa 'dis: bdud mgon zhing skyong chen po'i thugs dam bskang : yum mchog bdud mo seng gdong thugs dam bskang : sprul pa bam ro pho mo'i thugs dam bskang : lha btsan rdo rje 'bar ba'i thugs dam bskang : gnod sbyin btsan rgod chen po'i thugs dam bskang : ma mo sngags kyi srung ma'i thugs dam bskang : dge bsnyen nā ga rak+sha'i thugs dam bskang : bdud rje nag po bkrag med thugs dam bskang : gza' rgod ki kang nag po'i thugs dam bskang : myur mgyogs dgra lha chen po'i thugs dam bskang : dam can rdo rje legs pa'i thugs dam bskang : sprul pa yang sprul rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs shing nyams chag kun bsal nas: bar chad sel zhing dngos grub stsal du gsol: hūm̐: lho nub rang bzhin dbyings kyi pho brang dbus: 'byung ba dkar dmar rlung gsum tsha grang 'khrugs: lta bas mi bzod snang srid chu ltar khol: de 'dra'i gnas bzhugs srog bdag ljang sngon zhal: srid rtse mnar med kun kyang lto bar 'gengs: mkha' ru rgyu ba'i khyab 'jug phyag bzhi pa:

srin po dbu dgu klu mo dug sbrul 'khyil: dug mtsho'i klong bzhugs ki kang dmar 'od can: gza' mchog rā hu la yi thugs dam bskang : snang srid yongs kyi skye 'gro'i srog la rgyu: yum mchog khrag mig nag mo'i thugs dam bskang : chu yi mkha' la rgyu zhing bsil dug 'bebs: gza' rgod zla ba chen po'i thugs dam bskang : sa yi mkha' la rgyu zhing ri rab g.yo: gza' rgod spen pa chen po'i thugs dam bskang : me yi las byed tshad dug rims yams 'phyo: gza' rgod nyi ma chen po'i thugs dam bskang : rlung dang bu yug 'brug sgra'i sna ru rgyu: gza' rgod phur bu chen po'i thugs dam bskang : sngo dmar khrag gi rlabs la las kun byed: gza' rgod lag pa chen po'i thugs dam bskang : sha dang khams kyi dbang po 'phel 'grib byed: gza' rgod pa sangs chen po'i thugs dam bskang : tsha ba'i 'od ldan skye 'gro yongs la sdang : gza' rgod mig dmar chen po'i thugs dam bskang : snang srid 'khor 'das dbu ma'i zom du bcug: gza' rgod sgra gcan chen po'i thugs dam bskang : skye gnas rnam bzhi khams dang srid par sbyor: gza' yum gdong mo mched bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : dug lnga dug gsum g.yo byed ma rig bdag: klu yi ma mo brgyad kyi thugs dam bskang : steng 'og bar dang skye 'gro'i las su rgyu: dregs pa gza' rgod yongs rdzogs thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs shing mchog thun dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: chos skyong khra bo gza' rgod mnyes pa'i rdzas: bya rog prog gi zhu chen dbyings su phyar: rngam byed chu srin 'bar ba'i rgyal mtshan bsgrengs: nyi zla'i phreng ba glog zhags mkha' la bskyod: rno ba'i dbal ldan du ma dgra la phyar: 'ching byed sbrul zhags nag po glog ltar 'khyugs: rten dar khra bo ma ning thig le can: g.yab dar ljang sngon me yi ba dan can: gzi mig dgu dang rwa yi mda' gzhu 'gengs: g.yu 'brug sngon po rlung gi gshog pa can:

lho bun sngon po ngam nag 'khrigs pa'i dbus: glo bur yud ldang dmar 'od tsha zhags 'khyugs: las kyi mtshon cha thog ser skar ltar 'khrugs: dug rigs thun gyis brgyan pa'i gtor chen spungs: 'gyu ba bcu gnyis gnyan gyi bu mo stong : srid pa bcu gnyis klu yi bu mo stong : lo skor bcu gnyis bdud kyi bu mo stong : me yi las byed pho nya 'bar zhing mched: chu yi las byed pho nya 'brub cing 'phyur: sa yi las byed pho nya nyil zhing 'khrugs: rlung gi las byed pho nya 'ur zhing 'thab: bdud kyi srin po'i las byed rdul ltar 'tshubs: phyur ba'i dug chu 'tshubs pa'i dug rlangs dang : gzhan yang mthun rdzas sgrub rdzas sna tshogs kyis: gza' mchog dug gdong mgo dgu'i thugs dam bskang : yum mchog khrag mig nag mo'i thugs dam bskang : chu gza' zla ba lhag pa'i thugs dam bskang : me gza' nyi ma mig dmar thugs dam bskang : rlung gza' sgra gcan phur bu'i thugs dam bskang : sa gza' spen pa pa sangs thugs dam bskang : stag srin zor ba gdong gi thugs dam bskang : 'brog srin chu srin gdong gi thugs dam bskang : kong srin ba glang gdong gi thugs dam bskang : bam srin dred mong gdong gi thugs dam bskang : rgyu skar 'gyu ba bcu gnyis thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs shing nyams chag kun bsal nas: bar chad sel zhing dngos grub stsal du gsol: hūm̐: rngam pa 'od ldan zangs gling ma ru rtse: sham pa la zhes mchong brag khrag mtsho'i gling : btsan mkhar dmar smug ldan pa'i pho brang nas: gnod sbyin rgyal po dregs byed bshan pa'i gzugs: me 'od gdong can myur mgyogs rag pa zhon: 'dzam gling 'di ru dbang byed dregs pa'i gzugs: btsan rgod bswe khrab can gyi thugs dam bskang : sku yi sprul pas sbrul zhags dgra la 'debs: klu btsan bshan pa mthing nag thugs dam bskang : gsung gi sprul pas ma rungs srog rtsa gcod:

btsan rje bshan pa dmar nag thugs dam bskang : thugs kyi sprul pas skye 'gro rtsis la 'debs: srog bdag tshangs pa dkar po'i thugs dam bskang : yon tan sprul pas rin chen gter rgya skyong : sngags skyong ma mo dkar mo'i thugs dam bskang : phrin las sprul pas dkor rkun rtsad nas gcod: btsan rgod rol pa sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : yang sprul gtsug lag ka cha'i rten la 'bul: spra sprel mtshal bya byi la'i thugs dam bskang : bka' yi bya ra bstan pa'i gnyer 'dzin ma: btsan rgod 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs shing mchog thun dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: chos skyong dmar po btsan rgod mnyes pa'i rdzas: ru mtshon dmar po me lce ya la la: bswe yi rmog chen ru dar du mas brgyan: bswe khrab 'od ldan dam nyams klad pa 'gems: bswe phub ling chen rnga zhol dmar pos brgyan: tsan dan beng chen pho brang dmag gi gter: dung gi beng chen lha dmag nyi khri gtibs: gser gyi beng chen gnyan dmag sprin ltar g.yo: zangs kyi beng chen btsan dmag chu ltar khol: g.yu yi beng chen klu dmag mun ltar 'tshubs: dngul gyi beng chen pho nyas dgra srog sdud: seng ldeng beng chen bshan pas mtshon cha thogs: lha zhags dkar po nyi ma'i zer ltar 'khyugs: btsan zhags dmar po bar snang rlung ltar 'gyu: bdud zhags nag po myur mgyogs glog ltar 'phen: klu zhags sngon mo rba rlabs chu ltar 'khrugs: gza' zhags khra bo snang srid skar ltar 'khrugs: gnyan zhags ser po nyi ma'i zer ltar gtibs: dmu zhags kham pa sa g.yo rgyu ltar ldog: dar dmar rtsi ber sprin chen bzhin du g.yo: stag ral gzig shubs tshogs ni mkha' la bkram: zangs dmar mda' gzhu gnam lcags dar mdung 'gengs: rnga thug tshogs ni sprin dmar bzhin du 'tshubs: zangs khram zangs sho zangs rdel zangs kyi gdan: g.yang gzhi dmar po 'khor yug kun la bris: dgra bo'i mgo bcad lcang lo thur du bsigs:

rgyu ma'i drwa ba drwa ba phyed pa la: byad ma'i glo snying rkang pa lag pa 'phyangs: mkhal ma mchin pa mtsher pa pho rdos brgyan: gzhan yang mdzes pa'i rten rdzas du ma ni: rta mchog rag pa'i tshogs ni 'dur zhing rgyug: zhol g.yag kham pa ngar bas sa gzhi g.yo: lug dmar dar dmar tshogs ni gar rtsed 'khrab: zangs kyi spra sprel mang po'i mche ba gtsigs: dung gi byi la gwa pa rlung ltar 'tshubs: mtshal gyi bya dmar zangs kyi mche ba can: srin bya 'dab chags gtsug phud gyen du 'phyo: stag mo ri bkra 'bum sde ngar zhing 'phyo: zangs khyi zangs 'phar zangs wa nyi li li: btsan gyi pho nyas dgra bo 'ching zhing 'drud: btsan gyi khyi dmar dgra bo'i glo snying khur: btsan gyi bu mos khrag gi ral pa bsigs: btsan gyi bshan pas spu gri dgra la 'debs: btsan shwa ru bcur mi ro ring po bkal: btsan gyi kha sha dmar po phyogs bcur rgyug: btsan gyi las byed nyi khri rdul ltar 'tshubs: btsan brag btsan mkhar la sogs mthun rdzas kyis: gnod sbyin me 'od gdong gi thugs dam bskang : btsan rgod bswe khrab can gyi thugs dam bskang : sku sprul klu yi bshan pa'i thugs dam bskang : gsung sprul btsan gyi bshan pa'i thugs dam bskang : thugs sprul tshangs pa dung thod thugs dam bskang : yon tan sngags skyong dkar mo'i thugs dam bskang : phrin las rol pa spun bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : yang sprul mtshal bya byi la'i thugs dam bskang : bka' yi 'khor bcas yongs rdzogs thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs shing nyams chag kun bsal nas: bar chad sel zhing dngos grub stsal du gsol: hūm̐: tshangs pa'i 'jig rten du ma nas byung ba: li yul mnga' bsgyur bha ta'i sgom grwa skyong : bdud dang gnod sbyin btsan klu bshos pa'i rigs: gtsug lag ka cha'i rten la chags byed cing : skye 'gro'i srog la dbang zhing rtsis la 'debs: gnod sbyin chen po dkar smug khro 'dzum can:

gdong lnga'i khrir bzhugs 'jig rten snang ba sdud: gsang sngags grogs mdzad dngos grub char ltar 'bebs: chos skyong rgyal po dpe dkar thugs dam bskang : shar phyogs mnga' bsgyur lha yi longs spyod sdud: rgyal po dpe har chen po'i thugs dam bskang : lho phyogs mnga' bsgyur gshin rje'i longs spyod sdud: rgyal po tshangs pa chen po'i thugs dam bskang : nub phyogs mnga' bsgyur ma mo'i longs spyod sdud: rgyal po li byin chen po'i thugs dam bskang : byang phyogs mnga' bsgyur gnod sbyin longs spyod sdud: rgyal po dpe ha ra yi thugs dam bskang : shar lho mnga' bsgyur dmu yi longs spyod sdud: rgyal po dpe nag chen po'i thugs dam bskang : lho nub mnga' bsgyur btsan gyi longs spyod sdud: rgyal po shing bya chen po'i thugs dam bskang : nub byang mnga' bsgyur bdud kyi longs spyod sdud: rgyal po dpe dmar chen po'i thugs dam bskang : byang shar mnga' bsgyur klu yi longs spyod sdud: rgyal po gnam lha chen po'i thugs dam bskang : sprul pa phyogs bcur khyab cing longs spyod sdud: dkor bdag rgyal po 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs shing mchog thun dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: chos skyong dkar po dpe dkar mnyes pa'i rdzas: dar mdung dkar po 'phan 'phyang pu ru ru: za 'og ber chen sna tshogs dbyings la bskyod: lhab lhub mdzes pa'i phod ka shel khrab dang : shel rmog dang ru bya rgod thul bas brgyan: rba dkar tshigs bdun smyug dkar tshigs dgu la: rnga ma dkar po dngul byang mig dgus spras: dung sho dang ni khrung khrung rgyal mtshan gzugs: srog gi yi ge rin chen sna lngas brgyan: 'od zer zhags dkar wang long lcags kyu dang : dgra satwa mda' gzhu stag gi rlid bu'i nang : shel gyi gwa'u'i nang du bla rdo sbas: bswe theb chos gos lhung bzed 'khar bsil dang : kai la 'od ldan yid du mchis pa'i rdzas:

rten mdos dkar po ring cha drwa bas brgyan: mda' dar shing khra gtsug lag gnyug ma'i sa: 'phen 'phyang bla bre gdugs tog ba dan bsgrengs: rol mo bye brag ma nges snyan pa'i rigs: 'bras dkar la sogs 'bru mchog rdza ltar spungs: pha rol rgol 'joms mtshon cha sna tshogs dang : gzhan yang dung seng glang chen ma he dkar: rta dkar g.yag dkar lug dkar byi la dkar: ba dkar ra dkar khyi dkar bya dkar dang : spra sprel mon pa pho mo a tsa ra: sngags gzugs btsun gzugs mo sman gzhon nu'i tshogs: stag shar dang ni dar seng 'bag seng dang : pu tra'i gzugs can mgo brnyan du ma'i tshogs: khyad par rin chen sna tshogs las grub pa'i: pho brang dkor mdzod yid du mchis pa ru: phyi nang spyan gzigs longs spyod du mas bskang : ched du bkod pa'i gzugs 'gros la sogs kun: blos blangs yid sprul snang srid khyon 'gengs 'dis: chos skyong dpe dkar rgyal po'i thugs dam bskang : yum mchog gnam sman rgyal mo'i thugs dam bskang : dkor bdag shel khrab can gyi thugs dam bskang : rgyal po dpe ha ra yi thugs dam bskang : rgyal po tshangs pa dung thod thugs dam bskang : rgyal po li byin chen po'i thugs dam bskang : rgyal po bhi ha ra yi thugs dam bskang : rgyal po dpe nag chen po'i thugs dam bskang : rgyal po shing bya chen po'i thugs dam bskang : rgyal po dpe dmar chen po'i thugs dam bskang : rgyal po gnam lha chen po'i thugs dam bskang : yang 'khor gtsug lag skyong ba'i thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs shing nyams chag kun bsal nas: bar chad sel zhing dngos grub stsal du gsol: hūm̐: dam can rgya mtsho 'khor dang bcas pa la: gzhan yang thugs dam bskang ba'i rdzas mchog ni: dmar chen yon chab dbang po'i me tog dang : sha gsur bdug spos tshil chen zhun me sbar: dug khrag dri chab 'bru nag dpal gyi bshos: sna tshogs rol mo 'brug ltar sgrogs pa 'dis:

dpal chen phyag bzhi yab yum thugs dam bskang : zhing skyong mgon po yab yum thugs dam bskang : gza' mchog rā hu la yi thugs dam bskang : gnod sbyin btsan rgod chen po'i thugs dam bskang : dkor bdag dpe har rgyal po'i thugs dam bskang : dam can yongs rdzogs rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs shing nyams chag bsal du gsol: hūm̐: bhan+dha lcang lo yangs pa'i snod mchog tu: sman mchod bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho kyi li li: bla med nang gi mchod pa mtsho ltar 'khyil: dung khang zhal bur rak+ta phyur ru ru: sha chen zhag gi lbu ba gya ma gyu: drag po'i snod du bha ling ri ltar spungs: dbang po rnam lnga'i rgyal mtshan ye re re: lcang lo'i snod du dgra sha rdza ltar bskyil: bsgral mchod nang rol sna tshogs nyi li li: rin chen snod mchog yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor du: ga ṇa tshogs kyi mchod pa dbyings dang mnyam: mtho bsnyegs longs spyod bcud mchog chi li li: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'dis: dpal chen phyag bzhi yab yum thugs dam bskang : zhing skyong mgon po yab yum thugs dam bskang : gza' mchog rā hu la yi thugs dam bskang : gnod sbyin btsan rgod chen po'i thugs dam bskang : dkor bdag rgyal po dpe dkar thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs shing nyams chag bsal du gsol: hūm̐: gzhan yang phyi nang gsang ba kho na nyid: de bzhin blo yis blangs dang rang bzhin gyis: dngos 'byor yid sprul rgyu las byung ba yi: mchod rdzas sgrub rdzas skong rdzas rten pa'i rdzas: 'bod rdzas sgrub rdzas mnyes pa'i rdzas la sogs: spyan gzigs du ma gzugs 'gros sna tshogs dang : snang srid stong gsum 'jig rten thams cad du: ci srid de dang de srid 'byung ba dang : 'byung 'gyur spyad dang spyod pa'i tshogs rnams kyis: chos skyong pho rgyud thams cad thugs dam bskang : chos skyong mo rgyud thams cad thugs dam bskang :

dam can tha tshig gnyer ba'i thugs dam bskang : gter bdag gter srung rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : yul lha gzhi bdag rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : mchod 'os bstod 'os rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : dam can rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskangs gyur nas: bar chad sel zhing dngos grub stsal du gsol: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: de nas bshags pa bya ba ni: hoḥ dgongs su gsol lo dam tshig ldan pa'i lha: deng 'dir sngags 'chang sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin gyis: bskyed rim ma gsal rdzogs rim ma rtogs dang : bzlas brjod grangs nyung mchod rdzas g.yel ba dang : phud lhag 'dres shing dus kyi mchod pa chag: dam bca' dor bas nus mthu nyams pa dang : mngon spyod rtsal chung dgra bgegs ma bsgral sogs: le lo btang snyoms g.yeng ba'i dbang gyur rnams: dam can rgya mtsho'i thugs dang ci 'gal ba: mthol bshags bzod gsol mi sgrib tshangs par stsol: om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya sho dha ya sho dha ya bi sho dha ne bi sho dha ne sa pa ri bi sho dha na dharma pā la sarba shud+dhe ye swā hā: de nas bstod pa bya ba ni: hūm̐: bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: che mchog lhag pa'i lhar gyur nag po che: 'jigs byed stobs ldan khrag 'thung he ru kaḥ dpa' bo g.yul las rgyal byed phyag bzhi pa: 'bar ba'i mtshon cha bsnams shing dpa' ba'i chas: dur khrod bdag mo tsaṇ+ḍi zung 'jug 'khril: che ba'i 'khor bcas gdug pa'i g.yul las rgyal: ma rungs 'joms mdzad ye shes mgon po'i tshogs: bka' sdod srung mar bcas la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: pho brang chen po tsā ri'i gnas kyi bdag: legs ldan sras po bdud mgon seṅge'i gdong : mngon spyod las mdzad rta nag rting dkar zhon: mtshon cha'i sgyogs chen ma rungs dgra la 'phen: bdud mo yum bcas dregs pa'i 'khor gyis bskor: za gsod las mdzad pho nya 'bum dang bcas: zhing skyong 'khor dang bcas la bdag bstod do:

hūm̐: lho nub mun rum 'khrigs pa dug mtsho'i klong : me rlung 'tshub ma 'khyil ba'i pho brang nas: stong khams 'di ru drag rtsal ldan pa'i lha: srog bdag nag po srin lus sbrul mjug can: gnam lcags thog mda' dam nyams dgra la 'bebs: khrag mig yum chen glog gi zhags pa can: gza' brgyad 'khor bcas gdong mo las la 'gyed: ki kang nag po dbyings kyi las byed pa: drang srong 'khor dang bcas la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: khrag mtsho 'khrugs pa'i gnas chen zangs ri'i mkhar: mchong dmar dgra la 'gyed pa'i pho brang nas: gnod sbyin chen po mi bsrun srin po'i gzugs: btsan rgod 'bar ba myur mgyogs 'dzam gling nyul: lus la go khrab mtshon cha dmag gter thogs: rta mchog rag pa chibs shing sprul pa 'gyed: dgra bo rtsad brlag bshan pa'i 'khor gyis bskor: bstan pa srung ba'i las byed mthu bo che: btsan rgod 'khor dang bcas la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: rin chen sna tshogs las grub 'phrul lding khang : za 'og sna tshogs bkram pa'i pho brang dbus: skye 'gro mnga' dbang sgyur mdzad dkar smug zhal: dar dkar lhub gsol 'khar bsil lhung bzed thogs: sder chags zil gnon seṅge dkar mo zhon: mthu ldan las byed phrin las sde bzhi 'gyed: sku gsung thugs sprul sa gzhi'i rdul ltar 'gengs: chos rgyal 'khor dang bcas la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: gzhan yang bka' yi las byed gter gyi bdag: mthu rtsal rmad byung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs: phrin las bzhi ldan bstan pa'i bya ra mdzod: gsang sngags gnyan gyi chos 'khor skyong byed pa'i: gter srung yongs rdzogs tshogs la bdag bstod do: ༈ dpal ldan dud sol bsod nams dbang gi rgyal mo'i gtor mchod yid bzhin nor bu bzhugs so: dpal ldan dud sol bsod nams dbang gi rgyal mo bsgrub par 'dod na: rin chen snod du mchod pa rgya chen bshams la: rang nyid yi dam lhar gsal ba'i mdun du dgos 'dod rin po che sna bdun pho brang gi dbus su yi ge bh+yo ma yongs su gyur pa las ma gcig 'dod khams dbang phyug ma:

sku mdog dkar mo mdangs dang ldan pa snang la rang bzhin mngon par ma grub pa gzi brjid 'od dang ldan pa: 'byung ba lnga'i bcud 'dzin pa khams gsum dbang du sdud cing srid gsum zil gyis gnon pa'i skur gyur nas phyag g.yas lcags kyu dang g.yon tshe bum 'dzin pa: de'i shar du rdo rje lha mo me long dang tshe bum 'dzin pa: lho ru rin chen lha mo rin po che'i sgrom bu dang tshe bum 'dzin pa: nub tu pad+ma lha mo pad+ma'i steng du sre'u dang tshe bum 'dzin pa: byang du gnod sbyin lha mo kul+le ma: mi dang phyugs kyi g.yang thams cad bsdus pa'i: sku mdog ljang mo tshe bum dang ne'u le 'dzin pa: thams cad gzi brjid 'od dang ldan pa legs nyes thams cad sa ler gzigs pa: de'i 'khor du re re la: g.yang gi rgyal mo: dngos grub kyi bdag mo: dpal ldan dur khrod kyi bdag mo: tshe 'dzin bdag mo: srid pa'i bdag mo: dbang gi bdag mo: srid 'dzin bdag mo: nor gyi bdag mo: zas bcud kyi bdag mo: 'bru'i bdag mo: kha rje thub pa'i bdag mo: dbang thang thub pa'i bdag mo: thams cad kha ba bu yug 'tshubs pa ltar du spyan drangs: badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥ hūm̐ bh+yoḥ sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po la: srid pa ye thog rgyal mo srid: bar du srid pa'i rgyal mo byon: tha ma dud sol rgyal mo byon: dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis: da dus rnal 'byor spyan 'dren no: dus ngan snyigs ma'i bskal ngan la: lha mo byon pa'i gnas ngan kyang : rnal 'byor 'bod sa khyod las med: sems can re ltos khyod las med: dgos 'dod 'byung mkhan khyod las med: dngos grub ster mkhan khyod las med: ci bsam sgrub mkhan khyod las med: log 'dren 'dul mkhan khyod las med: rgyal 'gong 'dul mkhan khyod las med: dam sri 'dul mkhan khyod las med: chos min 'dul mkhan khyod las med: khyod kyi thugs rjes ma bzung na: sngon byon rgyal ba'i bka' yang 'gal:

rnal 'byor yi chad mi 'gyur ram: sems can log lta mi 'gyur ram: mchod sbyin chud du mi zos sam: dus ngan bstan bshig mi mtho 'am: de bas myur du da tshur byon: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ 'dzin byed dbang gi lha mo khyod: rin chen pho brang 'dir bzhugs la: srid gsum dbang gi dngos grub stsol: zas nor longs spyod dngos grub stsol: brgyud 'dzin srid kyi dngos grub stsol: ci 'dod phun tshogs dngos grub stsol: dngos grub char ltar 'bebs shing bzhugs: sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: a ti pu hoḥ pra tits+tsha hoḥ hūm̐ bh+yoḥ khyod la mchod pa 'bul ba ni: ar+ghaṃ me tog mchod pa 'bul: dri zhim spos ngad mchod pa 'bul: bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa 'bul: su ra chang gi mchod pa 'bul: 'dod chags khrag gi mchod pa 'bul: bstan bshigs bsgral ba'i snying khrag 'bul: gsod gcod sha'i mchod pa 'bul: bzhes nas bla med dngos grub stsol: bzhes nas sangs rgyas bstan pa srungs: bzhes nas bla ma'i sku tshe srings: bzhes nas rnal 'byor nyams rtogs spor: bzhes nas sems can bde skyid spel: bzhes nas yon bdag rkyen ngan zhi: dus ngan bstan bshig myur du sgrol: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: ces bsnyen dmigs ni: lha mo'i sku las 'od zer 'phros pas bdag la dngos grub ci bsam thams cad 'bad med lhun grub tu 'byung bar bsam mo: rjes su lha mo yang 'byung ba lnga yi bcud du gyur nas bdag la thim pas: bdag kyang gzi brjid bkrag mdangs dang ldan par bsgoms la: zhes bsnyen pa khri stong bzlas: ma ma ā yu sid+dhi hūm̐: gtor ma dang bdud rtsi mchod la 'di skad bsgrag: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ sku ni mi 'gyur ri rab lta bur brjid: gsung ni mi 'gags 'gro drug chos skad ston: thugs ni mi 'khrul nyi zla lta bur khyab: yon tan mi 'gyur dngos grub 'byung la bstod: phrin las myur mgyogs dmag zor rgyal mor bstod:

bsod nams dbang gi rgyal mo khyod la bstod: 'chi med tshe 'dzin lha mo khyod la bstod: brgyud 'dzin srid 'dzin lha mo khyod la bstod: ma gcig dud sol lha mo khyod la bstod: ma gcig srid pa'i rgyal mo khyod la bstod: khams gsum gzi brjid zil gnon khyod la bstod: log lta dbang sdud tshar gcod khyod la bstod: gtor ma bran la bdud rtsi mchod: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ bdag gis khyod la mchod bstod gsol btab mthus: nad med tshe yi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: rgas med 'ja' lus dngos grub bstsal du gsol: bsod nams nor gyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: 'bru bcud zas kyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: rin chen gter gyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: khams gsum dbang sdud dngos grub bstsal du gsol: srid gsum zil gnon dngos grub bstsal gsol: dag snang chos spyod dngos grub bstsal du gsol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bstsal du gsol: ces gtor ma nam mkhar mchod bdud rtsi rang gi srin lag gis myong zhing : dmigs pa ni lha mo'i nu ma dang bha ga nas bdud rtsi dkar mar byung nas: rang gis lus phyi nang gi nad gdon sdig sgrib dang bcas pa dag nas: 'ja' lus rdo rje'i skur gyur nas mchog gi dngos grub thob par bsam la: bsnyen pa 'di ci nus bzlas: oṃ ma hā kā li ma ma ā yu sid+dhi hūm̐ dza dzaḥ 'di yi dgos ched ni: dus ngan las ngan bstan bshig 'ga' yis ni: rngon ri rgyab dang rku jag las ngan sna tshogs byed pa: de'i skyon gyis ma mo mkha' 'gro 'khrugs: mkha' 'gro chos skyong ri rab la zhal gzigs: steng nyi zla gza' skar mdangs nyams: bar gza' klu rgyal po 'khrugs: 'og sa bdag klu gnyan 'khrugs: de'i dus skyes chen dam pa rnams sku tshe thung : sa bcud nyams nas 'bru mi 'phel: mu ge sna tshogs 'byung : bsod nams cung zad 'phel kyang rkyen che: longs spyod mi thub rgyud 'dzin sre'u mi sos:

bse rag 'byung po rlung ltar 'tshub: mo 'dre lha bab the'u rang ltag zer mang : de'i rtags su btsun pas khrims mi thub/ sngags pas dam tshig mi thub: dpon pos khrims mi thub: phal cher rang tshod mi thub: bud med kyis lus mi thub: sa yis gter dang rdo mi thub: dud 'gros chu rlung mi thub: chos byed gyis chos dang dge sbyong mi thub: de'i skabs su dpal ldan dud sol rgyal mo'am/ dbang gi rgyal mo'am/ srid pa'i rgyal mo'am/ rang byung rgyal mo'am/ bsod nams bcud thub rgyal mo'am/ phrin las dmag zor rgyal mo zhes: 'di dus ngan yang mtha' ru shin tu zab cing snod min bstan bshig 'ga' la ni bka' gnyan zhing srog rtsa rgol bar bgyi bas zab bo: mye'o lha mo lung nas : rtsa gsum gling pas gter nas phyung ba'o: maṅga laṃ// ka dag dbyings las ma g.yos kun bzang mo/ kha dog ma nges rigs lnga'i mkha' 'gro shar/ /ga ru gdul bya'i snang ngor sprul pa'i sku/ /nga yi skyabs gyur dbyings phyug mched lnga'i sku/ /ca co ma yin dad pas spyan 'dren na/ /cha lugs mdzes ldan lta bas mi mngon bzhin/ /ja hong mtshams sprin rlung gis bskyod ltar mtshungs/ /nya rgyas dar 'bol brtsegs pa'i gdan la bzhugs/ /ta gan la sogs dgyes pa skyed pa'i rdzas/ /tha dad dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod pa'i sprin/ /da lta dam tshig bsre phyir bdag 'bul na/ /na chung grogs ltar bsten gyis snying ma rengs/ /pa sangs dung zla ltar dkar dwang ba'i blos/ /pha mtha' brgal ba'i bstod dbyangs rol mo'i sgras/ /ba spu g.yo nus gdung shugs kyis bstod nas/ /ma ltar gus pas bsten na brtse ma zhan/ /tsa tur dus mchod ma bgyid bsnyen sgrub chag /tsha grang le los gsang gsum dam 'gal kun/ /dza drag snying nas bshags dang sdom bgyid na/ /wa ler sring ltar dgongs la skyong bar mdzod/ /zhwa mo'i tog ltar rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i gdung*/

/za ma tsam yang mi yengs skyong ngo zhes/ /'a 'ur khas blangs rdo rje'i yal gam gson/ /ya rab bran ltar bsten gyis mthu ma chung*/ /rā sa na sogs gzung 'dzin rgyu ba'i khams/ /la 'ur dhū tir drangs la 'ching mdud grol/ /sha khrag zag zad zag med dga' bzhi'i 'gros/ /sa lam myur bgrod pho nya khyod kyis mdzod/ /ha ha bde skyong rang rig gnyug ma'i gshis/ /a phyi khyod dang dbyer med ma gyur bar/ /a mas bu bzhin da dung srung skyob dang*/ /a ti theg rtse'i rnal 'byor la gnas shaug /a phyi'i bstod gsol kā li'i phreng*/ /a ma dran pas yid drangs nas/ /a mtshar ci dran gu h+yas bris/ /a rog 'phya yong ma ston cig/ // ༈ dpal ldan lha mo dud sol ma'i gsol mchod ni/ gtor ma dmar gtor gcig la 'khor gsum gyis bskor gser skyems mchod: hūm̐: bdag nyid gsang bdag gsal ba mdun gyi gnas: dur khrod thod mkhar me rlung rab 'khrugs klong : pad nyi baṃ steng dre'u dmar nag steng : bh+yo yig 'phro 'du sbyor ba'i dran rdzogs su: dud pa'i sol ma mthing nag khro mo'i gzugs: gri thod 'dzin cing dur khrod chas kun rdzogs: gsal ba'i thugs ka'i bh+yo las 'od 'phros pas: dud pa'i sol ma 'khor bcas spyan drangs gyur: bh+yo kā li kā li dhe wi kā li badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ bh+yo: lha gnas gsum dang dur khrod brgya rtsa brgyad: mu le mthing mtsho dgu brtsegs thod mkhar sogs: gar bzhugs gnas nas dud sol dpon g.yog 'khor: chu zla'i gar snang ci bzhin sku bskyod la: spyan 'dren 'bod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: khrag zhag pad nyi baṃ gyi gdan la bzhugs: phyi nang gsang gsum de bzhin nyid kyis mchod: om̐ ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she pū dza la kha kha khā hi: ༈ dpal ldan lha mo'i bskang gsol nyung ngur bsdus pa bzhugs so:

ḍāk+ki dbyings kyi lha la 'dud/ sa ma ya/ ma gcig dpal ldan lha mo ni/ /dbyings kyi yum chen kun tu bzang*/ /phyi ltar rdo rje sder mo la/ /nang ltar rdo rje phag mor grags/ /gsang ba khros ma nag mo'o/ /sprul sku bdud 'dul drag mo zhes/ /yang sprul dpal ldan lha mor grags/ /dus bzhi khams kyi bcud 'dzin cing*/ /'jig rten khams kyi ma ru grags/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i gnyer kha skyong*/ /legs nyes las kyi stangs su 'dzin/ /dam nyams kun gyi srog dbugs phral/ /dam ldan kun la bu ltar brtse/ /mchod pa phor kha tsam gyis dgyes/ /nyams pa yid 'gyu tsam la 'khu/ /rbad bskul dam bsgrags tsam gyis chog /gsol mchod sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor par/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub 'byung*/ /gang bsam 'grub par gdon mi za/ /zhes sogs me lce'i rgyud nas gsungs/ /lha mo ma btsun 'khu ba'i las/ /yul la 'khrug pa byung ba dang*/ /nang dgra mi kha kha mchu mang*/ /nad rims god kha 'byung ba dang*/ /nyams dang rmi lam thams cad du/ /bud med mi sdug gzugs mthong ngam/ /yang na bud med shi dang ngu*/ /skom snang ltogs snang 'byung ba sogs/ /de dag rmis na 'khu ba'i rtags/ /'khu ba de dag bskangs byas na/ /'jig rten mi dang mi ma yin/ /rtag tu bu ltar brtse bar 'gyur/ /de phyir bskang ba gal che'o/ sa ma ya/ bskang ba'i rnam dbye bstan pa ni/ /srog chags gzugs dang bskyed rim rdzas/ /gling bzhi gling phran rol mtsho sman/ /dkar mngar bdud rtsi sman spos dri/ /rten gtor bla 'khor spyan gzigs dang*/ /tsa ra mkha' lding shel nag mdangs/ /dngos su ma 'byor yid kyi sprul/ /gsal gdab sngags bzlas dbyer med ngang*/ /dbyangs snyan rnga rdung rol mo sgrogs/ /bskyed rdzogs ldan pas 'di skad do/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ om̐ āḥhūm̐/ hūm̐/ mdun bshams dngos 'byor yid sprul las/ /ma gcig mnyes pa'i rdzas su gyur/ /rgyu ni thabs shes gnyis las byung*/

/rkyen ni ma 'gags rol rtsal las/ /sprul ni dbyings rig mkha' la sprul/ /bsdus pas ye shes lnga ldan gyi/ /bdud rtsir bkug nas stong gsum khyon/ khyon dang dbyer med byin gyis brlabs/ /lha mo mnyes pa'i rdzas su gyur/ om̐ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥphaiṃ phaiṃ hriṃ hriṃ/ de nas spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐ bh+yo/ phyogs bcur dbyings dang dur khrod brgyad/ /mu le mthing mtsho gnas ri brag /shel gur thod pa dgu brtsegs mkhar/ /'og min gnas sogs gar bzhugs nas/ /dpal ldan lha mo dud sol ma/ /'khor dang bcas pa ma lus pa/ /skad cig gnas 'dir sku bskyod la/ /bskang ba'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ om̐ kā li kā li dhe wi kā li badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ de nas bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hūm̐ bh+yo/ ma gcig dpal ldan lha mo 'khor bcas rnams/ /'khor bcas mi mngon chu zla'i gar snang bzhin/ /dam tshig ye shes dbyer med gdan khri'i steng*/ /gnyis med dgyes bzhugs phyag 'tshal sdig pa bshags/ badz+ra tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ a ti pu ho pra tīts+tsha ho sa twa hūm̐: de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐ bh+yo/ dud sol lha mo 'khor bcas la/ /bskang ba'i rdzas mchod 'bul ba ni/ /phyi snod gling bzhi gling phran dbus/ /nang bcud ri rab rol mtshos gtams/ /gsang ba nyi zla'i rgyan gyis spras/ /'bul lo bzhes so thugs dam bskang*/ /phyi nang 'gal rkyen bar chad sol/ hūm̐ bh+yo/ phyi snod srid gsum yangs pa'i dbus/ /nang bcud skye 'gro'i gzugs kyis gtams/ /gsang ba dbyer med mkha' la sprul/ /'bul lo bzhes so thugs dam bskang*/ /phyi nang 'gal rkyen bar chad sol/ hūm̐ bh+yo/ phyi snod bhan+dha rgya che'i dbus/ /nang bcud sha lnga rdzas kyis gtams/ /gsang ba bdud rtsi lnga dang sbyar/ /'bul lo bzhes so thugs dam bskang*/ /phyi nang 'gal rkyen bar chad sol/ hūm̐ bh+yo/ phyi snod rat+na bh+rūm̐ yangs dbus/ /nang bcud 'bru lnga dpal gtor la/

/gsang ba dkar dmar rgyan gyis spras/ /'bul lo bzhes so thugs dam bskang*/ /phyi nang 'gal rkyen bar chad sol/ hūm̐ bh+yo/ phyi snod dung chen yangs pa'i dbus/ /nang bcud dmar chen rdzas kyis gtams/ /gsang ba zhag gi rba rlabs 'khrugs/ /'bul lo bzhes so thugs dam bskang*/ /phyi nang 'gal rkyen bar chad sol/ hūm̐ bh+yo/ dud sol lha mo 'khor bcas la/ /bskang ba'i rdzas mchog 'bul ba ni/ /bya nag gser mig bcu gsum 'phur 'jums lding*/ /rta nag rting dkar bcu gsum 'dur zhing rgyug /g.yag nag shugs chen bcu gsum ngar sgra sgrogs/ /shel nag dpyi dkar bcu gsum gar rtsed rgyug /tsa ra rog po bcu gsum gsung snyan sgrogs/ /bong bu dmar gwa bcu gsum bam ro bkal/ khyi nag snying dkar bcu gsum ngu zhing ldir/ /stag seng la sogs gcan spyang dpag med kyis/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i glo snying kha ru thogs/ /ma gcig dpal ldan lha mo 'khor bcas la/ /'bul lo bzhes so thugs dam gnyan po bskang*/ /rnal 'byor tshe srings bu nor chos gsum spel/ hūm̐ bh+yo/ gzhan yang dpal ldan lha mo mnyes pa'i rdzas/ /phod kha bla bre dar gdugs 'phan 'phyang dang*/ /mda' mo sgro gsum me long dar snas brgyan/ /rnga thug nag po dpal ldan thod tshal spras/ /mi lpags rgyal mtshan mi mgo'i tog gis spras/ /pho brang byin chags phyi nang bkod legs 'di/ /ma gcig dpal ldan lha mo 'khor bcas la/ /'bul lo bzhes so thugs dam gnyan po bskang*/ /lha klu mi gsum snang ba dbang du sdus/ hūm̐ bh+yo/ gzhan yang dpal ldan lha mo mnyes pa'i rdzas/ /gri gug thod khrag ral gri kha ṭ+wāṃ dang*/ /shaka ti tshon gru nad kyi rkyal pa sogs/ /dgra bgegs cham 'bebs nus mthu drag rtsal gyis/ /ma gcig dpal ldan lha mo'i thugs dam bskang*/ /bstan dgra sgos dgra pha rol byad ma sgrol/ hūm̐ bh+yo/ gzhan yang thugs dam bskang ba ni/ /rtag gtor rten gtor sgrub gtor dang*/

/sman raka g.yab dar dkor cha dang*/ /phyi nang gsang mchod sna tshogs 'dis/ /dpal ldan lha mo'i thugs dam bskang*/ /gdong mo bzhi yi thugs dam bskang*/ /sman mo bzhi yi thugs dam bskang*/ /dus 'dzin bzhi yi thugs dam bskang*/ /nag mo 'bum gyi thugs dam bskang*/ /sha za 'bum gyi thugs dam bskang*/ /las byed nyi khri'i thugs dam bskang*/ /thugs dam bskangs la g.yar dam sol/ /thugs dam bskangs la rkyen dbang zlog /nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi zlog /bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu zlog /ye 'drog sum brgya drug cu zlog /glo bur brgyad cu rtsa gnyis zlog /mo ngan ltas ngan rtsis rtsub zlog /gling bzhi mi kha brgyad cu zlog /byad kha phur kha rbod gtong zlog /yul 'dre 'khyams po'i god kha zlog /dus 'khrug mtha' dmag rgya 'dre zlog /bzlog cig dpal ldan dud sol ma/ /sdang byed dgra yi steng du zlog /gnod byed bgegs kyi steng du zlog om̐ kā li kā li ma hā kā li kha ling ta a ti pra mo hā bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog 'khrugs skong bsdus pa bh+yo lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma lsogs/ ces pa 'di yang dpon karma rnam rgyal gyis lha mo'i bskang gsol nyung ngur bsdus pa zhig dgos zhes zer ba la brten nas/ rlangs smyon gyis g.yo med gsum gyi rgyud bskul nas/ sa byi lo zla4tshes25la lung dmar ur 'gos su sbyar ba'o// // ༈ 'khrugs skong bsdus pa ni/ bh+yoḥ lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la/ /gsang sngags bon du gyer ba'i tshe/ /phas zer bu yis mi nyan dus/ /dus ngan nye ba 'thab pa'i dus/ /gos ngan re thul gyon pa dang*/ /zas ngan lci ba za ba dang*/ /sde 'khrug nang dme byed pa'i dus/ /ma mo nag mo thugs khros nas/ /bud med sna tshogs stong khams gang*/ /mi nad phyugs nad sna tshogs gtong*/ /mkha' la nad sprin sngo dmar 'khrigs/ /dus kyi 'khrugs pa slong byed ma/ /mtshon gyi bskal pas 'jigs byed ma/

/glo bur mi la lhog rgod 'bebs/ /thog ser 'bebs pa'i snying mo che/ /sa bdag klu gnyan khyod kyi 'bangs/ /lha srin sde brgyad khyod kyi 'khor/ khyod kyis mi 'dul gang yang med/ /nad kyang ma mo khyod kyi nad/ /rims kyang ma mo khyod kyi rims/ khrag kyang ma mo khyod kyi khrag /spyi bdud nad kyi kha lo sgyur/ /bskang ngo khyod kyi thugs dam bskang*/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i gtor ma dang*/ /brtan rdzas sgrub rdzas skong rdzas kyis/ /'khrugs pa'i ma mo'i thugs dam bskang*/ /thugs dam bskang ngo sa ma ya/ /thugs dam bskangs pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi/ /nad kha chod la rims kha sgyur/ khram kha phyes la shwa rdel spos/ /nad gdon bar chad bsgyur du gsol/ /mi nad phyugs nad bsgyur du gsol/ /mo ngan mtshan rtsub bsgyur du gsol/ /pho bdud dal kha g.yas su sgyur/ /mo bdud dal kha g.yon du sgyur/ /spyi bdud dal kha mkha' la sgyur/ /zlog sgyur chen po'i dus la bab/ /dus la bab bo sa ma ya/ /bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ /thog med dus nas ma rig dbang gyur pa'i/ /mi shes sgrib pa'i le lo dbang gis ni/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam la 'gal ba rnams/ /sprul pa mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la bzod par gsol/ /om̐ sa ma ya/ āḥs ma ya/ hūm̐ sa ma ya/ trag rak+sha kha mun+t+ra e ka dzā ṭi snying kha rak+mo bh+yo dzaḥ om̐ badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya/ sogs man ngag gi yig brgya dang lag g.yas mdzub mo srin lag gnyis mthil du bkug mthe bong dang gong mo mthe'u chung gsum bsgrengs te tri shu la'i phyag rgyas/ hūm̐ phaṭ ma hā de wi kā li duṣ+ṭāṃ ta ka ha na da ha ru lu bhan+dha pa tsa ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces bzlas pas mtshan ma ngan pa bzlog lag gnyis sor mo bcu rtse mo cung tsam bsdus nas khog pa zlum po bdud rtsi bum pa'i phyag rgya bcas la/ om̐ badz+ra dhā ki nī de wi ma hā kā li re ma ti kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sid+dhi sa ma ya a we sha ya āḥ

zhes brjod pas dngos grub blang*/ zhes lha mos 'khrug bskang rgyun khyer bsdus pa 'di ni rang gi thugs dam phyir sngags 'chang rā ga a s+yas bsgrigs pas bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa'i yams nad rims nad thams cad zhi bar gyur cig/ // ༈ lha mo'i mnga' gsol ni/ hūm̐ bh+yoḥ gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /stong gsum mnga' mdzad lha mo re ma ti/ /'das dang ma byon kun la dbang bsgyur zhing*/ /stong gsum 'jig rten kun gyi gzi brjid 'phrog /bla med 'dren mchog blon po rin chen 'dra/ /mig 'bras gzugs mdzes btsun mo rin chen 'dra/ /theg pa'i don ldan glang po rin chen 'dra/ /sa bcu bgrod pa'i rta mchog rin chen 'dra/ /bsam pa'i don 'grub nor bu rin chen 'dra/ /gzhan la dbang bsgyur 'khor lo rin chen 'dra/ /'jigs pa'i mgon skyob dmag dpon rin chen 'dra/ /lha dbang brgya byin ltar ni bsod nams che/ /'jig rten mgon po ltar ni dpal 'byor che/ /'phags pa 'jam dpal ltar ni shes rab che/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang ltar ni thugs rje che/ /phyag na rdo rje ltar ni mthu stobs che/ /u ma dhai wa ltar ni cho rigs bzang*/ /u dum wa ra ltar ni skye ba dkon/ /nam mkha'i lha bran bzhin du sku 'khrungs legs/ /me tog pad+ma bzhin du lta na mdzes/ /ri dwags seṅge bzhin du dpa' la brjid/ /stong gsum mnga' mdzad lha mo re ma ti/ /yid bzhin nor bu bzhin du gtsug gi bkur/ /'dzam gling rgyal mo bzhin du bdag gis bstod/ /dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ sngags kyi rnal 'byor ser rtsa rgyal blas dpal ldan lha mo lo bcu drug la sgrub pas lha mo dngos su zhal gzigs te bstod pa'o// // bh+yo/ lha la dbang bsgyur lha mo dpal 'bar ma/ /dbang po brgya byin sras mo yid 'ong ma/ /sum cu rtsa gsum gnas kyi gtso mo ste/

/lha mo re ma ti la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /klu la dbang bsgyur klu mo dpal 'bar ma/ /gtsug na rin chen bu mo nor 'dzin ma/ /rol mtsho bdun gyi gnas kyi gtso mo ste/ /klu mo re ma ti la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gnod sbyin dbang bsgyur gnod sbyin dpal 'bar ma/ /gang ba bzang po'i bu mo shan+ti ka /nags tshal drwa ba can gyi gtso mo ste/ /gnod sbyin re ma ti la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bdud la dbang bsgyur bdud mo dpal 'bar ma/ /re sde mgo nyag bu mo dril ldan ma/ /bdud mkhar rtse dgu'i gnas kyi bdag mo ste/ /bdud mo re ma ti la phyag 'tshal bstod/ rgyud me lce 'bar ba las khol du phyung ba'o/ dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ ༈ lha mo'i rgyud nas ral gcig ma'i phyag rgya nam gru mas gsungs pa/ na mo badz+ra pa ṇi s+yaṃ/ tsi li tsi li/ bhiṇ+ḍa bhiṇ+ḍa/ muñtsa muñtsa/ hi pā la ka na swā hā/ zhes so/ 'dis lha mo snying nye bar 'gyur ro/ ༈ dpal ldan sngags srung rang byung rgyal mo las/ ḍāk+ki dmar mo'i gtor 'bul phrin las bcol ba ni/ bh+yo/ ye shes ma mo srid gsum dbang sdud ma/ /rang byung rgyal mo lha mo chen mo ni/ khams gsum dbang sdud dbang gi las mdzad phyir/ /sku mdog dmar mo byi ru ltar du dmar/ /phyag g.yas me yi lcags kyu 'bar ba phyar/ /g.yon pas rlung gi zhags pas srid gsum bcing*/ /dbu skra dmar por me tog sna tshogs brgyan/ /gcer mo khro 'dzum nu ma bha ga rgyas/ khyod la rnal 'byor bdag gis mchod pa'i mthus/ /phud rgod rak+ta bha l̥ng 'di bzhes la/ /pha rol mi sems dkrugs la sems rtsa myos/ /mi nor zas gsum thams cad dbang du sdud/ /mnga' thang longs spyod thams cad char ltar phob/ /snyan grags 'brug sgras stong khams g.yo bar gyis/ /snang srid lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du sgyur/ /rgyal blon 'gro ba pho mo sprin ltar 'tshub/

/bdag cag gar 'gro gar sdod thams cad du/ /longs spyod rta nor rat+na thams cad rgyas/ khye'u pho mo sde dpon thams cad kyi/ /snying rtsa bsgul la sems rtsa dung dung 'dud/ /rang dbang med par bdag gi phyogs thad du/ /sha rul sbrang ma 'du 'tshubs ci bzhin du/ /g.yang can nor dang 'phan po'i phywa dpal dang*/ /mkho rgu'i dkor cha yid 'ong thams cad dang*/ /'gro ba'i bsod nams dbang thang thams cad ni/ /dbang du sdus shig dbang sdud sngags srung ma/ /zil gyis gnon cig srid gsum dbang bsgyur ma/ /rma g.yang spel cig nor gyi rgyal mo che/ /rgya bod hor sogs 'dzam gling srid gsum gyi/ /phywa g.yang dkor nor gnag khyu thams cad ni/ /mi lag bsgul la dbang med bdag la sprod/ /phyag g.yas lcags kyus pho yi snying nas zung*/ /g.yon pas rlung zhags phyā g.yang bdag la sdus/ /mo yi mtshan ma lcags kyus bdag mdun khug /bram bram 'dus 'dus badz+ra aṅku sha/ /dung dung yed yed pā shaṃ sid+dhi thun/ /dza dza bh+yo rbad rang byung dbang sdud ma/ /a kar+ṣa ya tri thun tsit+ta khug /ha ri ni sa sid+dhi dung ni thun/ zhes zhal shes su rig 'dzin bde chen rdo rjes sbyar ba dge zhing mchog thun dngos grub myur du 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ // ༈ bstod bskul ni: bh+yo/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs sprul dpal lha mo/ /srid gsum skye 'gro'i mnga' bdag dus bzhi'i rgyal/ /'gro kun thugs rjes brtse ba bdud rtsi'i rgyal/ /dbul ba'i phongs sel mi zad gter gyi bdag khams gsum dbang sdud log lta'i 'ching ba khrol/ /ma rungs bstan dgra'i srog dbugs bla tshe rku/ /sgrub brgyud kun la rtag tu bya ra skyongs/ /dam tshig can la ma yi bu ltar brtse/ /dud pa'i sol ma 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ /sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub stsol/ /rtag chad mu bzhi bdud bzhi'i 'jigs pa skyobs/

/rtsa thig rlung gsum dga' bzhi'i grogs mdzod la/ /chags zhan bo zag thig le'i gegs skyon sel/ /bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa ma rtogs bar/ /dbyings kyi yum mchog lus dang grib bzhin 'grog /shāka thub phur pa'i skur bzhengs dam bzhag ltar/ /gsang sngags theg chen bstan pa rgyas par mdzod/ /om̐ kā li kā li de wi kā li i dam bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi/ smon lam gdab pa ni/ bdag ni dus kun lha mo khyod nyid dang*/ /skad cig mi 'bral phrin las rnam bzhi yis/ /nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can kun/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa la 'god par shog /ces kyang bya'o/ zhes pa'ang mchog sprul o rgyan bstan 'dzin gyis bskul ngor/ rig 'dzin mi 'jigs rdo rjes shing bya lor hor zla gnyis pa'i yar tshes15la sngo ne brag gzim chung du sbyar ba yi ge pa yang bdag o rgyan bstan 'dzin gyis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel// // lha mo'i gtor 'bul bsdus pa ni: bh+yoḥ 'dod khams dbang phyug dpal ldan re ma ti: 'dod rgu bsgyur ba'i dbyings phyug dpal 'bar ma: 'dod yon rnam lnga'i gser skyems 'di bzhes la: 'dod don lhun gyis 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod: rtsa gsum gling pas so: ༈ dud sol ma'i gsol bsdus ni/ bh+yo/ byang shar thod pa 'phrul gyi gzhal yas nas/ /sangs rgyas stong gi bstan srung mthu mo che/ /zab mo rgyud kyi bstan 'dzin dud sol ma/ /las rnams kun 'grub khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ rlangs smyon nas so// // gsang ba ḍāk+ki yid bzhin nor mchog las: gter srung las kyi ma mo ye shes pa ltar du sgrub pa bzhugs pa'i dbu'o: bla ma dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la 'dud: sa ma ya: de yang ma gcig dbyings phyug rdo rje rigs kyi mkha' 'gro'i phrin las cho ga bgyis pa ni: thog mar bkra shis dge ba'i yar tshes su:

stegs bu mtshan ldan pad 'dab bzhi pa bkod: de yi steng bum pa rgyan bzang : bhan+dhar gtor ma zlum po pad 'dab bzhis bskor ba: mdun du gtor zor gsum: me long sin dhu ra yi dkyil 'khor bkod: mda' dar la sgrub rten rin chen sna tshogs bla 'khor bcas brgyan: gzhan yang mchod rdzas phun sum tshogs par bsham: spyan gzigs sna tshogs bkod: rigs ldan gyi mkha' 'gro lnga'am gcig la: rigs lnga dar dpyangs rgyan spyod mdzes par spras te: mchod pa'i mthun rkyen sgrub tu gzhug: gzhan yang ri rlung sogs bkra shis phun sum tshogs par bsham: shing sna chu sna me tog 'bru sogs dgos pa rnams bsdus la mchod pa'i rdzas su bsgom: bde ba'i gdan la 'khod de dkyil 'khor la 'jug par bya ste: sa ma ya: dang po sngon du 'gro ba ni: na mo: bde chen ye shes rol pa'i cho 'phrul las: bde stong zag med 'khor lo'i dbang phyug ma: bde ba'i lang tsho 'khril ba'i nyams ldan ma: bde ba rab g.yo dga' bzhi lhan skyes stsol: gnyis pa: mchog gi dpa' mor rtag tu gus 'dud na: mchog dga' dbyangs can brda grogs dpal lha mo: mchog thun yon tan spel mdzad rnal 'byor ma: mchog gi dngos grub stsol phyir grogs su byon: gsum pa: dga' ma khyod kyi bzhin ras rab dkar gyis: dga' chen yid kyi pad+mo rab tu g.yo: dga' bral nyi ma'i gdengs ka'i ze'u 'bru'i bcud: dga' ba lhan skyes rdo rjes skar ltar skyol: bzhi pa: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum dang : hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ hrīḥ.āḥ phyi snod gling bzhi yangs pa bhan+dha'i mkha': nang bcud mchod pa'i lha mo gar mo dang : sman gtor rak+ta dbang po'i me tog sogs: phyi nang spyan gzigs blo yi sprul pa'i tshogs: zag med mchod sprin nam mkha'i khyon du spel: om̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta pū dza āḥhūm̐: māṃ sa go ro tsa na bha su ta kiṃ ni ri ti āḥhūm̐: om̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐:

lnga pa: om̐ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐ bh+rūm̐: om̐ hūm̐ trām̐ hrī āḥ mūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐: e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐ keṃ bh+rūm̐: paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍa la: ma sūr+ya maṇ+ḍa la: a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍa la: hūm̐ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭḥ saṃ ha ra na hūm̐: ru tra ti ra baṃ: bh+rūm̐ las dur khrod sa gzhi'i dbus: thod mkhar gzhal yas dbyings su snyogs: nang rnams rin chen brtsegs pa mdzes: phyi nang 'od kyi drwa ba'i phreng : 'ja' 'od lug rgyud gtibs pa'i dbus: pad+ma nyi zla bam gyi steng : hrīḥlas yum chen dbyings phyug ma: bde gshegs rdo rje rigs kyi gtso: sku mdog dkar dmar 'od du 'bar: zhi 'dzum rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes: phyag g.yas mda' dar me long bsnams: g.yon pa'i thod pa nor bus bkang : sku las sna tshogs mdzes pa yi: dar dkar lhub can cod pan 'phyang : mu tig du ma'i chun pos spras: zhabs gnyis bshibs te bzhengs pa'i tshul: yid 'ong lang tsho rab tu skyud: rjes chags zim bu'i spyan dkyus g.yo: ye shes lus can 'od kyi sku: bde chen dgyes pa'i dpa' mor bskyed: phyogs bzhi rigs kyi mkha' 'gro bzhi: zhi ba dbyings kyi dpa' mo'i tshul: haḥ rdo rje rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma: shar na mthing gi zhal bzang ma: phyag na lcags kyu ne'u le thogs: riḥ rin chen rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma: lho na mi g.yo blo bzang ma: phyag na rgyal mtshan nor bu thogs: niḥ pad+ma rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma: nub tu gtad dkar 'gro bzang ma: phyag na mda' dar bum pa bsnams: saḥ las kyi rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma: byang nas cod pan mgrin bzang ma: phyag na rdo rje bhan+dha bsnams: thams cad rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes: prog zhu mu tig phreng ba phreng : dkar ser dmar ljang na bza' bklubs: sna tshogs mdzes pa'i cod pan 'phur: zhabs gnyis 'gying 'gros dal bu'i gdan: gtso 'khor gzi 'od 'bum du 'khyil: bde chen ye shes rgyas par bsgom: gzhan yang ma sring mkha' 'gro'i tshogs:

nyi ma dang ni gza' skar bzhin: sprul pa nyid sprul tshogs dang bcas: ma 'dres yid la 'ja' ltar gsal: om̐ dharma ḍāk+ki shwa ri mūm̐ḥha ri ni sa dza dzaḥ de ltar gsal ba'i gnas gsum las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin dbyings kyi pho brang rigs bzhi'i gnas: khyad par gzho stod ke'u ri gsang ba mchog gi pho brang nas: dbyings phyug ye shes rdo rje rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs: phaiṃ phaiṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal dam bsre ba ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ bde chen gsang ba dbyings kyi pho brang nas: thugs rje ma 'gags rang rtsal 'gyed pa'i phyir: ma gcig ye shes mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol: rang mdangs rol pa'i cho 'phrul gar bsgyur phyir: phrin las rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol: bka' dang dam tshig las su mi 'da' phyir: yang sprul ma sring 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol: om̐ badz+ra ḍāk+ki dzñā na dharma tā re karma shwa ri yo gi ni hri da ya ha ri ni sa sa mā ya dza dzaḥ hrīḥ chags med pad+ma nyi zla bam gyi gdan: zung 'jug rol pa'i gar gyis bzhugs su gsol: bzhin bzang rab dkar dga' ma'i zhi tshul can: zla rgyas bzhin ras g.yo ba'i dpal ldan ma: phyag bgyis dam bsre ma gcig bu gdung ltar: dbyangs can ye shes mkha' 'gros skyong bar mdzod: sku gsum dam tshig 'gal ba mthol lo bshags: zung 'jug dga' bzhi'i grol lam pho nya stsol: om̐ badz+ra ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: na mo pū ru sha ya hoḥ a ti pu hoḥ pra tīts+tsha hoḥ sa ma ya shud+dhe hoḥ mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: dbyings phyug rdo rje rigs kyi rnal 'byor ma: gsang ba ye shes ḍāk+ki'i dkyil 'khor la: lha rdzas me tog bdug spos mar me dri: zhal zas rol mo gzugs sgra dri ro reg: sman raka gtor mchod dza gad su ra chang : dbang po'i me tog tshogs kyi longs spyod bcas: gzhan yang phyi nang spyan gzigs dkor cha dang :

rten rdzas sgrub rdzas bskang rdzas mchod pa'i rdzas: rtag gtor rten gtor thun gtor nar ma phud: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'di: ma sring rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i tshogs la 'bul lags na: ye shes dbyings phyug mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang : zhal bzang rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang : blo bzang rin chen mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang : 'gro bzang pad+ma mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang : mgrin bzang las kyi mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang : ma sring mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs shing nyams chag sor chud nas: g.yar dam can la dngos grub stsal du gsol: om̐ badz+ra ḍāk+ki dzñā na dharma tā re karma shwa ri yo gi hri da ya ha ri ni sa ye hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: pū dza hoḥ rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she āḥhūm̐: pū dza hoḥ om̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta āḥhūm̐: pū dza hoḥ om̐ ga ṇa tsakra sarba i daṃ a mṛ ta bhi shwa me gha pū dza hoḥ badz+ra pū ra hoḥ badz+ra shud+dhe hoḥ de nas bdud rtsi mchod pa ni: dbyings phyug lha mo dngos su gsal zhing : om̐ dzñā na dharma shwa ri tā re ḍāk+ki nī om̐ āḥhūm̐: om̐ ha badz+ra dzñā na ḍāk+ki nī ye om̐ āḥhūm̐: om̐ ri rat+na sa ma ya ḍāk+ki nī ye om̐ āḥhūm̐: om̐ ni pad+ma prañdzā ḍāk+ki nī ye om̐ āḥhūm̐: om̐ sa karma gu h+ya ḍāk+ki nī ye om̐ āḥhūm̐: om̐ bhi shwa karma ḍāk+ki nī ye om̐ āḥhūm̐: om̐ karma ma tri tra ya ni ye om̐ āḥhūm̐: ye shes mkha' 'gro rnams bdud rtsis mnyes shing tshims nas sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub ma lus pa bdag la stsal du gsol: om̐ kā ya sid+dhi wāk+ka sid+dhi tsit+ta sid+dhi gu h+ya sid+dhi hoḥ zhes ljags su myong ngo : de nas bstod pa ni: hūm̐: rang bzhin chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang :

sgyu ma longs sku'i cho rol ma 'gags phyir: sna tshogs sprul sku rigs lnga'i skur ston pa'i: bzhin bzang lha mo rab dkar zla ba'i mdog: nya rgyas lta bu'i gzi byin 'bum du 'khyil: khyod kyi cha shas bde ba'i 'od zer gyis: nyon mongs g.yo ba'i tsha gdung nags klong skem: me long snang srid pra yi 'khor lo thogs: dam tshig gsang ba'i mda' dar tshe dpal 'gugs: mtshan ldan snod mchog dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i nang : yid bzhin bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal pos bkang : sku la dar dkar tshon zung le brgan gsol: rin chen rgyan spyod lta bas mi gzhigs spras: mu tig do shal se do sor gdub mdzes: gzhon sha'i dkar 'dzin chu gter ge sar bzhad: rab rgyas tshogs pa'i mdangs las rab 'grogs bzhin: ye shes lus can las kyi mkha' 'gro'i tshul: dbyings phyug 'dod rgu'i mchog gi dpal lha mo: grub pa'i dbang mo khyod la bdag bstod do: ma gcig sa gsum skye dgu mgon gyi mchog: sgrub pa'i ma gdung bu ltar brtse bas skyongs: brtse gzigs rnam pa kun tu khyod bsgrub na: phrin las sngon sgrub thugs rjes phyes ma ring : rtag tu yid kyi dpa' mos bdag skyongs shig: hūm̐: zhi ba'i lha mo 'jo sgeg mdzes ma 'phro: lcags kyus lha 'dre mi gsum gzhan snang 'gugs: rin chen ne'u les dgos 'dod char ltar 'bebs: dar dkar gos gsol rin chen rgyan gyis spras: dbang sdud lha mo khyod la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: rgyas pa'i lha mo ser bzhad lang tsho ldan: bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan ba dan mkha' la bsgrengs: yid bzhin re skong dgos 'dod nor bu bsnams: dar ser gos gsol rin chen du mas spras: bsod nams dpal bskyed lha mo khyod la bstod: hūm̐: dbang gi lha mo dbyangs can rjes chags nyams: mda' dar 'dzin pas snang srid tshe bcud sdud: 'chi med bum pas sgrub la rig 'dzin stsol: dar dmar gos gsol rin chen phreng bas spras:

tshe 'phel dbang gi lha mo khyod la bstod: hūm̐: drag po'i lha mo gtum zhing 'bur tshugs lta: bar gcod bdud las rgyal ba'i rdo rje gdeng : ma rungs bdud bzhi 'joms shing bhan dmar rol: dar ljang gos gsol rat+na'i zar bu bskyod: sna tshogs phrin las sgrub pa'i lha mor bstod: hūm̐: gzhan yang sprul pa'i ma sring mkha' 'gro ma: sgyu ma'i gar gyi cho 'phrul rnam 'gyur 'dzin: rol rtsal ma 'gags cir yang snang ba'i lha: dbyings phyug sprul pa'i phra men ma tshogs la: dwang bas dgyes pa bskyed nas bdag bstod do: de ltar sgrub pa'i sngags phreng rnams bzlas pa'i tshe: rang nyid pad+ma 'byung gnas su gsal ba'i mdun du mkha' 'gro ma rim par gsal btab pa'i thugs kar hrīḥdang ha ri ni sa'i srog yig la: sngags phreng dmar po 'od zer lnga ldan g.yon du 'khor bas thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul bas sku yi gzi brjid nyi ma 'bum gyi mdangs ltar cher 'bar brtan g.yo la phog: brtan g.yo'i tshe bsod gzi brjid bkrag mdangs yon tan tshur bsdus mkha' 'gro la bstim: mkha' 'gro'i gnas lnga nas yig 'bru'i rnam par sngags phreng dang 'od zer 'phros pas rang nyid gnas lnga la thim: rtsa rlung bde drod nyams rtogs thams cad rtsol med du sbar: lus ye shes lha yi rnam pa'i rol par gyur: ngag gsung dbyangs drug cu: yid ka dag zang thal mi dmigs pa'i ngo bo mngon du gyur:par bsam la/ rtsa sngags ni: om̐ badz+ra ḍāk+ki ni dharma dzñā na tā re hūm̐ phaṭḥ de nas sngags phreng bdag mdun dbyer med du 'khor ba 'gal me ltar ro: rang nyid kyi ba spu'i bu ga rnams su yang mkha' 'gro ma til gyi gang bu kha bye ba ltar gsal gdab la: las sngags ni: om̐ shwa ri dharma tā re hūm̐ phaṭḥ phrin las sngags ni: om̐ ḍāk+ki dharma shwa ra tā re hūm̐ phaṭḥ spro bsdu tshe bdag dang mkha' 'gro'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros: phyi nang snod bcud kyi mkha' 'gro dang rnal 'byor rnams la phog pas thams cad rang gi dbang du 'du bar bsam:

khyad par 'jig rten gyi mi yi rigs ldan bu mo lnga sogs dmigs gsal rnams kyi snying khar 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu ltar 'phros pas dbang med du rang gi mdun du 'dus par bsgom: ye shes 'jig rten thams cad bla yid bdag gi bzung bas nam yang mi shor bar bsgom: gcig dril tshe sgrub sngags ni: om̐ shwa ri dharma tā re dzñā na ā yur puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: bsod nams spel ba'i sngags ni: om̐ yo gi ni shwa ra tā re puṇ+ye sid+dhi ye swā hā: dbang sdud ni: om̐ gha mu a tā re dhe ma sarba pa shaṃ ma ma thun thun swā hā: rigs bzhi'i sngags gcig dril ni: om̐ badz+ra rat+na pad+ma karma hrīḥha ri ni sa dza dzaḥ ra ga he sha dhe wi ma ma thun thun swā hā: mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i srog gi snying po ni: om̐ ḍāk+ki nī hrīḥha ri ni sa tsit+ta hri da ya hriṃ hriṃ dzaḥswā hā: de ni dmigs pa spro bsdu las ye shes mkha' 'gro ltar bsgrub pa'i rim pa'o: de yang mthar mkha' 'gro ma rnams rang la bsdu: rten yod na rang dang rten gnyis ka bsdu: skabs su mkha' 'gro'i gtang rag gi gtor 'bul ni: phud rgod dang gtor ma bcas bsham: hūm̐: mi mngon chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang nas: rigs lnga ye shes mkha' 'gro skur bzhengs shig: deng 'dir bdag la dgyes pa'i mdangs ston phyir: thogs med thugs rje'i dbang gis gnas 'dir gshegs: sngon tshe ke'u ri gsang ba'i gnas mchog tu: rig 'dzin chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang : bde chen rig ma ye shes mtsho rgyal gnyis: zab gsang mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor zhal phye tshe: mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i lha tshogs 'ja' ltar shar: ma bsgoms sangs rgyas rang bzhin lhun gyis grub: sgom pa'i lha tshogs gzi brjid mdangs dang ldan: gnas gsum la sogs bstan pa'i bya ra mdzad: de ltar sngon gyi tha tshig dran dgongs phyir: dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dgyes pa'i mdangs phyung bsgrubs pa'i rtags bstan te:

phrin las sngon sgrub byang chub sa lam spel: 'gro ba'i tshe bsod mnga' thang dbang du sdud: yid la 'dod rgu dpal 'byor phun tshogs nas: dbyings phyug lha mos bstan pa'i mel tshe sgron: rig 'dzin bdag gi sgrub pa'i grogs dan mdzod: om̐ dzñā na ḍāk+ki dhe wi kā li ha ri ni sa ye sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi: zhes mchod gtor 'bul: bdag byang chub snying po mchis kyi bar: mkha' 'gro dang rtag tu 'bral ba med pa'i smon lam 'debs: hrīḥ bde chen ye shes rgyas pa'i dpal lha mo: zab lam rdo rje rigs kyi rnal 'byor dang : rtag tu 'bral med zung 'jug spyod pa yis: phrin las dpal du bdag gis deng 'grub shog: om̐ gu h+ya mu ṭa mu la maṅga la tiṣ+ṭha ye swā hā: zhes me tog gi rab tu gnas: sgrub rten la rtag tu bzhugs par bsam: sa ma ya: de yang ting 'dzin go cha bzhi ldan zhes: thun mtha' mi dmigs mnyam bzhag lha ru ldang : dbang gi rigs lnga'i sgrub thabs 'di: ma gcig mkha' 'gro ye shes tshul 'chang ma: sgrub pa'i 'grigs chags kho mo mtsho rgyal gyis: gzho stod ti sgro mkha' 'gro'i tshogs khang du: rin chen zab gsang shog ser logs su bkod: mi nub rin chen gsang ba'i gter du sbas: rgya 'di las kyi ma mo gsum gyis skyongs: ma 'ongs yang mtha' dus tshod lnga bdo la: skal ldan las can gcig dang 'phrad par shog: gangs khrod pho brang tshogs khang-i atsha rgyaḥ sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: dam rgya: gnyan rgya: kho bo rig 'dzin rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos 'bri gung gzho stod ti sgro'i tshogs khang yang rdzong nas: me sprel lor gdan drangs shing : bdud 'dul sngags pa gling du shog ser nas gsang zhal bsgyur ba'o/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ gsang ba ḍāk+ki yid bzhin nor mchog las: ma gcig dpal ldan lha mo 'jig rten ltar sgrub pa'i las byang mngon spyod nus ldan bzhugs pa'i dbu phyogs lags so:

ma gcig dus mkhyen dbyings phyug lha mor 'dud: sa ma ya: de yang sangs rgyas bstan pa'i bya ra ma: dpal ye shes dang las la grub pa'i ma gcig 'dod khams gtso mo'i phrin las gsol mchod ni: thog mar bla ma drag po'i dkyil 'khor sngon du song nas: lha mo'i gsol mchod bgyis pa la: lcags zangs bhan+dha la sogs pa rin po che'i snod kyi nang du: gtor ma zlum po 'khor bzhis bskor ba: mdun du dmar gtor gsum dang mtheb skyu bcu gnyis bha ling nyer brgyad kyis bskor ba: sman raka phud rgod sogs dgyes pa'i mchod pa sna tshogs bsham: spyan gzigs sku 'bag bla rten bcas bkram: khyad par dam tshig gsang ba'i me long mda' dar sba lcag srog 'khor: thun gtor zor gtor bcas spyi ltar bsham: rol mo'i bye brag rnams kyang rgyas par bsgrigs te: dri spos sogs legs par btang zhing : rang nyid bla ma drag po thod phreng rtsal gsal btab ste: mchod pa rnams byin gyis brlab pa ni: om̐ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ mūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐ dzaḥ om̐ āḥhūm̐: hoḥ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ e dzeṃ khaṃ: mūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐: hūm̐ ti gu h+ya niḥ hrīḥbh+rūm̐ sarba āt+ma ko3 haṃ: hoḥ de nyid yongs su gyur pa las rang rang gi snod so so'i nang du phyi nang gi mchod pa yig 'bru sa bon 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod rdzas sman raka gtor ma tshogs kyi yo byad thams cad phun sum tshogs par gyur: om̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she āḥhūm̐: om̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta te dz+wa bha ling+ta bha la bha te gu h+ya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ om̐ sarba pū dza me gha s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: gnyis pa skad cig gis 'dod khams dbang phyug ma bskyed pa ni: hoḥ skad cig gis rang nyid che mchog pad+ma drag po gsal ba'i mdun du:

e mthing nag gi rang bzhin nam mkha' mu mtha' med pa: de'i shugs las rlung me chu sa dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi 'khor yug khyab pa: de'i steng du dur khrod kyi sa gzhi dang bam gsar rnying ri ltar spungs pa'i dbus su: thod mkhar me rlung rab tu 'khyil ba'i gzhal yas khang : rgya khyon chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa: de'i lte bar pad+ma nyi zla bam ro'i gdan la: yi ge hrīḥm bh+yo yongs su gyur pa las: ma gcig 'dod khams dbang phyug sku mdog dmar po khro 'dzum gyi nyams dang ldan pa: snang srid kun la dbang ba'i ma mo chen mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dang ldan pa: dbu la rin po che'i prog zhu la thod skam dang ldan pa: phyag g.yas thod pa'i cang te'u nam mkha' la 'khrol bas ma mo mkha' 'gro dbang du sdud pa: g.yon bhan+dha khrag bkang bsnams pa: dam sri bdud kyi snying khrag rol pa: sku la dar dkar gyi za ber dang tshon ldan zung du bklubs pa: rin po che rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras pa: chu rta sngon po rlung gi shugs can la sga stan dang dar stan gyi steng du g.yang gzhi dang g.yer kha za ram gyis brgyan pa chibs te: skad cig gis stong gsum bskor ba'i nus pa dang ldan pa'o: de'i shar du drag byed las kyi lha mo sku mdog dkar dmar rgya bong sngon po la chibs pa: phyag na me long dang gter sgrom thogs pa: dar mthing gi ber chen gsol ba'o: lho ru rgyas byed srid pa'i lha mo gtsug na nor bu sku mdog ser mo g.yas rin po che'i rgyal mtshan dang : g.yon thod pa nor bus bkang ba 'dzin pa: le brgan ser po'i phod ka gsol zhing 'brong chen kham pa la chibs pa: nub tu bsam 'phel yid bzhin dbang gi lha mo dmar ser g.yas lcags kyu dang g.yon ne'u le 'dzin pa: dar dmar gyi phod kha gsol ba: rta dmar rlung gshog la chibs pa: byang du khams gsum dbang du sdud pa'i lha mo sku mdog dmar nag g.yas zangs gri dang g.yon lcags kyu gdengs shing :

rus pa'i rgyan drug gis spras te khyung dmar la chibs pa: de rnams kyi mdun du las byed sprul pa'i ma mo gsum spu gri dang nad rkyal thogs nas gcer mo g.yang gzhi gyon te gar bsgyur ba'o: thams cad kyang rab tu gzi brjid dang 'bar zhing rgyan du mas spras te: rin po che'i prog zhu thod rtsal can gsol zhing gtso mo ltar bskyed pa'o: rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ gi 'od zer lcags kyu ltar 'phros pas: rang bzhin dbyings kyi pho brang : u tsa la yi dur khrod: mu le mthing gi mtsho nang : spu rangs ta dang gangs ri: la phyi tsā ri ti sgro sogs: khyad par gyi gnas chen gang du bzhugs kyang : thugs rje dang thugs dam gyi dbang gis rgyud bskul nas thogs pa med pa spyan drangs: om̐ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ rol mo dbyangs dang bcas nas: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po la: 'og min chos dbyings pho brang du: mkha' 'gro sde lnga zhes su grags: bde gshegs rgyal bas dbang bskur bzhin: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: nyi zla bam ro'i gdan la bzhugs: dbyings phyug dpal 'bar bdag gis bstod: de 'og bar bskal gnyis pa la: gsang chen me ri 'bar ba ru: rdo rje phag mo zhes su grags: lag na rdo rjes dbang bskur bzhin: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: nyi zla bam ro'i gdan la bzhugs: dbyings phyug dpal 'bar bdag gis bstod: de 'og bar bskal gsum pa la: u tsa la yi dur khrod du: mkha' 'gro khros ma nag mor grags: yang dag rdo rjes dbang bskur bzhin: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: nyi zla bam ro'i gdan la bzhugs: dbyings phyug dpal 'bar bdag gis bstod: de 'og bar bskal bzhi pa ru: ri rab gling bzhi dbang bsgyur ba: mu le mthing gi mtshor brten bca': ma gcig 'dod khams dbang phyug zhes: rdo rje gzhon nus dbang bskur bzhin: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol:

nyi zla bam ro'i gdan la bzhugs: dbyings phyug dpal 'bar bdag gis bstod: de 'og tha tshig lnga pa la: rgya gar rdo rje gdan drung du: lha mo rdo rje gshog rgod drag: rdo rje khro bos dbang bskur bzhin: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: nyi zla bam ro'i gdan la bzhugs: dbyings phyug dpal 'bar bdag gis bstod: de 'og tha tshig drug pa ru: bal yul yang le shod kyi gnas: ma mo e ka dzā ṭir grags: rdo rje drag pos dbang bskur bzhin: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: nyi zla bam ro'i gdan la bzhugs: dbyings phyug dpal 'bar bdag gis bstod: de 'og tha tshig bdun pa la: bod yul gzho stod ti sgro ru: dbyings phyug chos kyi sgrol mar grags: thod phreng rtsal gyis dbang bskur bzhin: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: nyi zla bam ro'i gdan la bzhugs: dbyings phyug dpal 'bar bdag gis bstod: de 'og tha tshig brgyad pa ru: mchims phu dpal gyi bsam yas su: gnubs ston sangs rgyas ye shes la: mkha' 'gro'i gsang rgya gtad nas kyang : gter gyi srung ma gnyer bskos tshe: rdo rje g.yu sgron ma ru grags: pad+ma 'byung gnas dbang bskur bzhin: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: nyi zla bam ro'i gdan la bzhugs: dbyings phyug dpal 'bar bdag gis bstod: da lta sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin gyis: dur khrod gnas 'dir spyan 'dren na: thod mkhar 'bar ba'i dbus nyid du: nyi zla bam ro'i gdan la bzhugs: rtag tu dam tshig bsre ba'i phyir: dbyer med bdag gis phyag bgyid do: om̐ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ pad+ma sūr+ya tsan+d+ra ti ra baṃ: tiṣ+ṭha lhan: na mo pū ru sha ya hoḥ de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: dbyings phyug lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa la: 'dod yon phyi yi mchod pa 'bul ba ni: dbang po rnam lnga'i me tog ri ltar spungs: sha chen tshil chen ngad ldan dud sprin 'khrigs:

lha ba zhag dang rkang mar sgron me sbar: dmar chen rlabs su g.yo ba'i dri chab gtams: bcud ldan ba liṃ dgyes pa'i zhal zas bkram: rkang gling thod rnga sgra snyan 'brug ltar sgrogs: sna tshogs phyi yi mchod pa bkram pa 'di: dbyings phyug chos kyi sgrol ma gtso dang 'khor: dpal ldan lha mo 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: hūm̐: ma gcig las kyi mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang : rdo rje rigs kyi mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang : rin chen rigs kyi mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang : pad+ma rigs kyi mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang : las kyi rigs kyi mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang : dbyings phyug chos kyi sgrol ma'i thugs dam bskang : drag mo 'dod khams gtso mo'i thugs dam bskang : lha mo gtsug na nor bu'i thugs dam bskang : yid bzhin dbang gi lha mo'i thugs dam bskang : dbang sdud srid pa'i lha mo'i thugs dam bskang : pho nya shan pa ma gsum thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs shing bar chad sel ba dang : mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol: om̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: om̐ sarba pū dza su ra hūm̐: hūm̐: bhan+dha'i snod du bdud rtsi mtsho ltar 'khyil: bha ling rgyan gyi gtor ma dbyings su snyogs: rak+ta'i rba rlabs lbu ba phyar ma phyur: bsgral zhing gtub pa'i dbang po ri ltar spungs: dza gad sman phud bcud g.yo gya ma gyu: ro brgya'i bcud chags tshogs kyi yo byad bkram: shing 'bras 'bru bcud 'bras rgun bstar ba'i ro: rjes su chags pa'i dri dang dgyes pa'i phud: spyan gzigs lang tsho rnam par spyod pa'i yul: spyod ldan mkha' la 'khrigs pa'i sprin phung la: 'khu ba'i rnam par rang rang rten pa'i rdzas: rta bdun dbang po'i lang tsho ltar 'bar ba'i: dri med chu shel mdzes pa'i a dar+sha: mkhregs med rab mdzes sba lcag mnyen zhing ldem: 'gugs pa'i 'debs zor 'bebs pa'i mda' mo la:

tshon ldan rnam par bkra ba'i pañtsa li: yid la rtag tu chags pa'i bla 'khor bskrun: dri za'i dbyangs len ping ka'i rgyal mtshan bsgrengs: shugs ldan rlung gi 'dab can mig sman tshogs: dal 'gros spu yis mdzes pa'i khyu mo'i khyu: phyi mo zla ba ma ma'i gdong rwa can: mgrin bzang chu 'dzin mdangs ldan sgra dpangs mtho: nī laṃ in+d+ra rnyil ba'i phreng phreng po: gdengs can bdag po'i bang mdzod 'phya ba'i dpyid: rtag myos lha ltar 'bad med ci bzhin tu: 'gog med nā da'i dbang mo gtso dang 'khor: dus 'dzin mdza' mor btud de dga' mar 'bul: hūm̐: ma gcig las kyi mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang : rdo rje rigs kyi mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang : rin chen rigs kyi mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang : pad+ma rigs kyi mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang : las kyi rigs kyi mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang : dbyings phyug chos kyi sgrol ma'i thugs dam bskang : drag mo 'dod khams gtso mo'i thugs dam bskang : lha mo gtsug na nor bu'i thugs dam bskang : yid bzhin dbang gi lha mo'i thugs dam bskang : dbang sdud srid pa'i lha mo'i thugs dam bskang : pho nya shan pa ma gsum thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs shing bar chad sel ba dang : mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol: om̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta ru tra ma ra ṇi sha ma ni ma hā maṃ sa tsit+ta go ro tsa na kiṃ ni ri ti bha su ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: om̐ sarba pū dza su ra hūm̐: zhes pas mchod pa phul zhing bstod pa'i phrin las bgyis pa ni: thugs nyid ye shes klong nas ma g.yos par drag mo'i cha tsam 'dzin pa'i gzi brjid bskyed pa ni: hūm̐: dbyings las ma g.yos ye shes ngang : dbang phyug bdun ldan gtso mo'i gtso: chos nyid chos can rnyog bral ba'i: sgrol ba'i nyon mongs zhi ba mo: ma khyod rtag tu bdag gis bstod: bdud sde mthar byed mnyes mnyes mo:

mnyes shing gtum mos srid pa g.yo: zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las bzhi: las mkhan pho nya mo la bstod: dung dung gdung zhing sgrub pa la: mchog dang thun mong ma g.yel par: mchog gi dngos grub mchog stsol mdzod: ces ma gcig 'dod khams gtso mo 'jig rten ltar sgrub pa'o// // ༈ dpal ldan zhing skyong legs ldan rngam klong las: sgrub pa'i phrin las khrag 'thung rab 'bar nag po bzhugs so: om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum gyis sbyangs: sman raka gis bran no: hoḥ gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar ba'i dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgyan dam pa dang ldan pa: dri dam pa dang ldan pa: ro dam pa dang ldan pa: bcud kun 'dus la phun sum tshogs pa 'di nyid 'bul zhing bsngo ba'i gnas su gyur pa ni: sangs rgyas kyi bstan srung : rnal 'byor gyi dgra lha: rig 'dzin gyi rgyal po: gsang sngags kyi bstan pa rin po che bya ra mel tshe mkhan: legs nyes kyi stangs 'dzin cing dam tshig nyams pa thams cad tshar gcod pa'i las byed pa: bsam sbyor log par 'chang ba'i dgra bgegs kyi srog gcod: mna' tho chad la mi brtsi ba'i gshed ma: gtsug lag khang gi dkor bdag: nag po stong gi rgyal po: ma mo 'bum gyi gtso mo: sha za bye ba'i las byed: gtsug lag khang gi chos 'khor gnyan po: 'di nyid skyong ba'i srung ma chen po: yab khyab bdag khrag 'thung he ru ka chen po: yum ma gcig rdo rje rigs kyi rnal 'byor ma: sras legs ldan 'bar ba gzhon nu seṅge'i gdong pa can: khyad par ye shes dang las la chas pa'i tshe: ma la ya bam ri'i mdun du rgyal ba'i dbang po dge slong kun dga' gzhon nu chen po: yum mchog mkha' 'gro kun 'dus ma: sras mchog thog rgod rdo rje: sras mo gling bzhi dbang sgyur: e ka dzā ṭi ma la sogs te: sngon nas rgyal ba'i dam tshig la gnas pa chen po: sku yi mtshan mchog kun dga' gzhon nu: gsung gi mtshan mchog gha ya dha ra:

thugs kyi mtshan mchog legs ldan nag po: yon tan gyi mtshan mchog dur bdag dpal 'bar: phrin las kyi mtshan mchog bdud mgon seng gdong chen po he ru ka: gnas dang yul gyi bdag po chos skyong drag rtsal can khyed rnams la sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di 'bul lo: dgyes par bzhes su gsol lo: hoḥ yum mchog ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma las la grub pa'i cha lugs can: ma gcig 'dod khams dbang phyug ma seṅge'i gdong can dri za'i sras mo mgrin bzang dbyangs can ma: bdud kyi sras mo re ma ti: srin po'i sras mo khri sde ma: lha yi sras mo u ma dhe wa: gnod sbyin gyi sras mo ku ru kul+le: klu yi sras mo dung skyong ma: btsan gyi sras mo khrag ral ma: gshin rje'i sras mo dmag rgyal ma: ma hā de wa'i sras mo srid rgyal ma: rgyal po'i sras mo gzi legs nor skyong ma: gza' yi sras mo ha shang sbal mgo ma: dam can gyi sras mo rab brtan gser mig ma: dmu rje dgra lha'i sras mo rdo rje g.yu sgron ma: las kyi ma mo'i sras mo sngags srung spyang zhon ma: 'jig rten srid pa grub nas bstan pa srung ba'i sras mo a phyi chos kyi sgron ma jo mo bkra shis tshe ring ma ste: ye shes dang las la grub pa'i ngo bo gcig pa'i gtso mo khyed rnams la sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di 'bul lo: dgyes par bzhes su gsol lo: hoḥ yab yum las byed kyi sprul pa srog bdag bam ro dmar nag spre'u gdong pa can gnyis la sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di 'bul lo: dgyes par bzhes su gsol lo: hoḥ khyad par du bka' sdod dregs pa las la chas shing rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa shan pa spu gri thogs pa'i sde tshogs mtshan nas smos shing mchod sbyin 'bul ba ni: hoḥ sku yi sprul pa lha btsan rdo rje 'bar ba chen po: gsung gi sprul pa srog bdag btsan gyi sde dpon gnod sbyin bswe yi khrab can: thugs kyi sprul pa sngags srung e ka dzā ṭi ral gcig ma:

yon tan gyi sprul pa klu yi dge bsnyen nā ga rak+sha: phrin las kyi sprul pa bdud rje mgon po bkrag med: gnyis med kyi sprul pa ki kang gza' rgod chen po rā hu la: dmag dpon dgra 'dul du sprul pa dgra lha bdag skyob che btsan: gtsug lag dkor skyong du sprul pa dam can rdo rje legs pa ste: sku gsung thugs kyi sprul pa'i las byed chen po khyed rnams la sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di 'bul lo: dgyes par bzhes su gsol lo: gzhan yang nag po stong sha za 'bum: ma mo bye ba: gnod sbyin khri: sha za sa ya la sogs pa sprul pa yang sprul gyi dmag tshogs khyed rnams la sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di 'bul zhing bsngo'o: dgyes par bzhes su gsol: sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs: dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod: dge 'dun gyi sde skyongs: gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa mchog gi bstan pa rin po che mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan tshugs: khyad par du yang rgyal dbang pad+ma kā ra'i gdung gsob 'dzin pa skyes chen bstan pa'i mnga' bdag yang zab gter gyi bka' bab dam pa yongs 'dzin mchog gi sprul sku rnams kyi chos grwa chen po mtshon pa'i mkhan chen lo tsā sngags kyi dbang phyug nyi 'od gsal ba khu dbon rnams dang : snga 'gyur rgyal bstan 'dzin pa pad+ma gter bdag gling pa gang de'i yab sras kyi ring lugs so mar gnas shing : gong du rgyas pa'i dge 'dun 'dus sde dang bcas pa rnams bsrung zhing skyabs te sde snod lung rigs rgyud sde chen po bzhi thos bsam dang sgom sgrub: bslab pa dang rgyu 'bras drang por gnas pa'i nyams len dang : 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa'i bya ba rnams mthar phyin te: bdag cag rig 'dzin sgrub pa po'i 'gal rkyen gyi bar chad sol: mthun rkyen bsam pa ci smos pa thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzod cig: phaiṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: dza dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ

skabs 'dir rtsa sngags dang sbrags nas gtor ma legs par bsngo: hūm̐: chos dbyings drag po e yi klong : 'bar ba'i me chen 'khrigs pa yi: dbus bzhugs nag po seṅge'i gdong : dpa' bo gnod sbyin khrag 'thung pa: bla med sngags skyong 'khor dang bcas: dam can rgya mtsho mchod pa'i rdzas: dbang po lnga dang sman raka gtor: spyan gzigs sna tshogs sbreng ba 'dis: nag po chen po'i thugs dam bskang : legs ldan dpal 'bar thugs dam bskang : dur khrod bdag po'i thugs dam bskang : kun dga' gzhon nu'i thugs dam bskang : rngam chen 'dzin pa'i thugs dam bskang : nag po dgra 'dul thugs dam bskang : bdud mgon seng gdong thugs dam bskang : yum chen seng gdong thugs dam bskang : sprel gdong bam gnyis thugs dam bskang : lha btsan 'bar ba'i thugs dam bskang : gnod sbyin btsan rgod thugs dam bskang : ma mo ral gcig thugs dam bskang : klu yi dge bsnyen thugs dam bskang : bdud mgon nag po'i thugs dam bskang : gza' chen ljang sngon thugs dam bskang : bdag skyob yul lha'i thugs dam bskang : dam can rdor legs thugs dam bskang : nag po stong gi thugs dam bskang : sha za 'bum gyi thugs dam bskang : ma mo bye ba'i thugs dam bskang : srog gcod nyi khri'i thugs dam bskang : sprul pa sna tshogs thugs dam bskang : dam can rgya mtsho 'khor bcas kyi: thugs dam gnyan po bskangs gyur nas: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: ma rig sdig sgrib mthol lo bshags: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin bdag cag la: lus ngag yid gsum srung zhing skyobs: byang chub snying po rang bzhin spel: shes rab chen po'i mtshon cha yis: dgra bgegs 'byung po mthar zhing choms: bkra shis bde chen brtan par mdzod: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: bskul zhing bzhengs pa'i dbang phyug che: ma hā kā la seṅge'i gdong : dam can rgya mtsho 'khor bcas rnams:

mnyes phyir thugs dam bskang ba'i rdzas: dbang po lnga yi me tog dang : sha chen bsregs pa'i dri gsur spos: rkang dmar zhag gi sgron mes gtams: mkhris pa'i dri chab gser 'od 'khyil: 'bru nag dpal bshos ro bcud ldan: rkang gling thod rnga 'brug ltar sgrogs: dgyes pa'i phyi mchod sna tshogs 'dis: dpal 'bar zhing skyong thugs dam bskang : yum chen seng gdong thugs dam bskang : bam ro pho mo'i thugs dam bskang : dam can sde brgyad thugs dam bskang : sprul pa yang sprul thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: dgra bgegs ru tra bsgral ba yi: snod bzang bhan+dha lcang lo ru: sman mchod sna tshogs sbrengs se sbreng : sha lnga bdud rtsi me re re: rdzas chen ngad pa chi li li: rak+ta'i rba rlabs phya ra ra: zhag g.yos kyu mo lings se ling : dbyings bsnyegs dpal bshos tse re re: khrag mdog zangs 'od ta la la: rgyan dang rtsang phur hrengs se hreng : liṅga'i rgyal mtshan nyi li li: gdugs dang dar nag pu ru ru: dar mdung ru mtshon lhabs se lhab: gzugs 'gros sna tshogs tshubs se tshub: mthun pa'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'dis: dpal 'bar zhing skyong thugs dam bskang : yum mchog seng gdong thugs dam bskang : bam ro pho mo'i thugs dam bskang : dam can sde brgyad thugs dam bskang : sprul pa yang sprul thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: stong gsum 'jig rten srid pa'i snod: ye nas ye stong brtsegs pa'i nang : bsdus bya srid pa'i 'byung lnga bcud: gdod nas dag pa'i tshogs mchod dag: rgya chen lhun po rang bzhin nyid: kun tshang lhun grub rdzas chen po: rgyan mdzes snang gsal sgron mes spras: rgyu skar rgya mtsho'i thigs kyang gdab: dbang po'i gzhugs bzang zer kyang 'phro: rmad byung ro brgya'i bcud ldan pa: dug lnga rnam dag ye shes rdzas: dkar mngar skyur dang kha ba'i ro:

sha chen rdzas sogs gtsang rme'i rigs: ting 'dzin rlabs kyis bcud bsdus la: tshogs mchod sman raka mdangs dang ldan: sha sna snying sna bsam mi khyab: 'chi med bdud rtsi me re re: khyad par rten cing gnas pa'i rdzas: bla 'khor srog yig bris pa'i sku: blos blangs 'dra 'bag 'bur gzugs sogs: me long rin chen sna lnga phyar: gsang mchod mnyes pa'i dbyangs can rigs: gzhan yang 'phan dang bla bre dang : dur khrod rgyan cha du ma'i rigs: gcal du bkram dang yol bar bres: rnga thug ru mtshon sna tshogs gzengs: go khrab brjid ldan 'od 'gengs gzugs: bzlog 'khor g.yab dar dgra la phyar: ging dang keng rus gar stabs bsgyur: bya gcan sha za 'u ru ru: bdud kyi ling pa dgra la snyogs: pha rol bla 'gugs sha ra ra: snyan dang mi snyan cho nge 'bebs: dam nyams bsgral sogs dgyes pa'i rdzas: phyi nang gsang ba'i bskang rdzas kyis: dpal 'bar zhing skyong thugs dam bskang : yum chen seng gdong thugs dam bskang : bam ro pho mo'i thugs dam bskang : dam can sde brgyad thugs dam bskang : sprul pa yang sprul thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: las bzhi phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hoḥ dgongs su gsol lo dam can tshogs: bag med dbang gyur bdag cag gis: brtson 'grus go cha dor ba dang : g.yeng bas le lo rmongs shing 'khrul: bsnyen sgrub g.yel zhing dus mchod chag: mchod rdzas 'byor tshogs yo byad chung : phud lhag 'dres dang tshod yod kyis: bskang dang sbyor sgrol gnad dang 'gal: gzhan yang bdag blo rmongs pa yis: dam 'gal nyams chag ci mchis pa: mthol bshags bzod par gsol ba yis: mi sgrib tshangs pa stsal du gsol: om̐ badz+ra sa twa sa ma yaḥ ma nu pa la yaḥ badz+ra sa twsogs yig brgya brjod/ zhing skyong ru dar dmag bzlog las khol du phyung ba'o// // ༈ rdzogs chen dgongs pa zang thal gyi bka' srung mchod pa'i phrin las kyi rim pa bzhugs so:

rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal lo: rdzogs pa chen po kun tu bzang po'i dgongs pa zang thal gyi bka'i srung ma mchod pa ni: thod pa'am dung phor du gtor ma snying gi gzugs rtse sum zur du yod pa'am: zur gsum 'gying can mtheb skyus bskor te/ phud gtsang ma sha mar bdud rtsis brgyan te: oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum brjod la: bdud rtsi ro mchog brgya dang ldan par bsam la: oṃ e ka tsa ti hūm̐ dza dzaḥ zhes nyer gcig gis spyan drangs: hūm̐: sngon tshe 'khor 'das thog ma'i dus: kun tu bzang mo'i thugs sprul ma: 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi yum: rdzogs pa chen po zang thal gyi: bka' yi srung mar rang dam bcas: dam tshig can gyi grogs mdzad ma: e ka tsa ti ral gcig ma: khams gsum gzigs pa'i spyan gcig ma: smug nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma: phyag gnyis kha ṭ+wāṃ bhan+dha thogs: gos su sprin dkar thul pa la: 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i mtha' chag can: rdzogs pa chen po zang thal gyi: bstan pa srungs shig bka' srung ma: sems dang rig pa shan 'byed dus: gol sa chod cig bstan srung ma: rig pa rang byung lta ba'i tshe: bar chad srungs shig bka' srung ma: mngon sum ye shes mthong ba'i tshe: bye brag phyed cig bka' srung ma: kun bzang dgongs pa zang thal 'di: ma g.yel srungs shig bka' srung ma: dam rdzas gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dam la ma 'da' phrin las mdzod: oṃ badz+ra trag rak+sha sa mu tra bhan+dha hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ e ka tsa ti kha kha khā hi khā hi: zhes nam mkha'i mthongs su mchod do: sa ma ya: bka' srung chen mo e ka tsa ti mchod pa'i phrin las grub bo: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: brag ri dug sbrul sprungs 'dra'i sked nas: rig 'dzin rgod kyi ldem 'phru can gyis spyan drangs pa'o: ༈ ma mo e ka dzā ṭi'i gtor 'bul bzhugs so// // ma mo e ka dzā ṭi'i gtor ma tsit+ta zur brgyad kyi gzugs yod pa la dmar gyis brgyan te bshams la/ hūm̐ bh+yoḥ

bskal pa me 'bar khrag mtsho'i klong : rtsub 'gyur chos nyid dkyil 'khor nas: kun bzang ma gcig 'khros pa las: e ka dzā ṭi dmar nag gzugs: ral gcig spyan gcig nu ma gcig: rkang gcig stobs ldan 'dzam gling nyul: phyag gnyis spu gri dgra snying rol: ral pa sprugs pas dug char 'bebs: khrag nad dmar yams dgra la gtong : 'khor ni srog gcod srin mo bzhi: sha za khrag 'thung ma mos bskor: sngags srung khro gnyer ral pa bsigs: gsang sngags bka' yi srung ma che: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: sngags srung khro mo dgra la bh+yo: dgra bo bdun rgyud rtsad nas chod: sha za khrag 'thung mtshan ma gtor: dam nyams dgra bo las ngan 'di: khrag skyug nad kyis sod la shog: gsang sngags gnyan la dgra byung na: nyan thos yin kyang myur du sgrol: sngon tshe slob dpon bka' stsal pa: ji ltar khas blangs dam tshig bzhin: dam tshig bka' las ma 'da' bar: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: bh+yo bh+yoḥ ma mo rak+sha e ka dzā ṭi trig dgra bo mā ra ya bh+yo bh+yo kha kha khā hi: zhes gtor ma phyogs gtsang sar lam dgra phyogs su bskyal: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: sngags 'chang karma las 'brel rtsal gyis gser gling nas gdan drangs pa'o// // thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon las: gter srung gza' yi sgrub thabs bzhugs so: gtum po khros pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: e ma bdag 'dra pad 'byung gis: snying thig srung ma'i sgrub thabs bstan: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal gzungs kyis zungs: yi ger thob la gter du sbos: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: dang po sgrub pa'i rim pa ni: dur khrod phung shul gang rung la: dmar nag chos 'byung dal thig gdab: de dbus bhan+dha mtshan ldan nang : 'bru nag dpal gtor smad zlum la: bya rog mgo dang me ri yis: mtshan pa'i rgyan bkra legs par btab: 'khor du gtor chung brgyad kyis bskor: rtse mor dar nag gdugs kyi dbus:
