bya rog snying dang srog yig bzhag: bla rdo gzi mig dgu pa dang : lcags kyi mda' gzhu la sogs gzugs: gzhan yang mchod rdzas sna tshogs bsham: mdun du brub khung dgra ling dang : thun rdzas dag gis bskor ba bsham: sa ma ya: dang po bdag mdun bskyed chog ni: hūm̐: stong pa'i ngang las snang srid e yi klong : snod bcud thams cad rab 'jigs gzhal yas khang : de dbus dug rlangs dmar chen ro yi gdan: bdag nyid hūm̐ las ye shes gza' mchog ni: khra tsha mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar rab khros srid gsum sngangs: thod skam dbu rgyan spyi bor bya rog zhal: g.yas gsum rdo rje ral gri gnam lcags mda': g.yon gsum rgyal mtshan me thab rwa yi gzhu: dur khrod chas rdzogs lhu tshigs spyan gyis spras: zhabs bzhi dor stabs ma rungs 'byung po brdzis: gsang ba'i yum mchog klu mo 'od ldan ni: khro 'dzum mthing 'od dgyes pa'i mdangs mnga' ma: phyag gnyis nor bu sgrom bcas mgul nas 'khyud: dur khrod chas ldan brkyang bskum yab la 'khril: me 'od tshwa tshwa 'bar ba'i klong du gsal: oṃ hrī dzñā na khra tsha nā ga te dz+wa hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: mdun du dug rlangs khrag mtsho khol ma'i dbus: k+ṣaṃ yig nag po gnas 'gyur dran rdzogs su: gza' rgod ljang sngon ki kang rā hu la: srin po'i gzugs can zhal dgu rab tu khro: spyi bor sgra gcan bya rog nag po'i mgo: g.yas gnyis ral gri gnam lcags mda' gzhu bsnams: g.yon gnyis chu srin rgyal mtshan sbrul zhags thogs: lte bar khro zhal sku lus mig gis brgyan: sku smad dug sbrul rgya mtsho'i klong du 'khyil: gza' brgyad gdong mo rgyu skar tshogs kyis bskor: bstan dgra dam nyams bsgral ba'i ngo bor gsal: oṃ hrī rā hu la ki kang hrī shag ru raṃ gra ha bīmiṣa hūm̐ phaṭḥ de ltar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis drang srong gza' mchog 'khor bcas spyan drangs:

oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ hūm̐: me rlung 'tshubs pa'i pho brang nas: gza' mchog rgyal po gshegs su gsol: yang 'khor bka' nyan gshegs su gsol: dug sbrul nag po'i khri la bzhugs: hūm̐: khyod la mthun pa'i dam rdzas ni: lcags zangs bhan+dha'i snod nang du: dmar nag gtor ma liṅgas brgyan: dar nag gdugs phub srog sngags btags: dgra bgegs sha khrag don snying dang : dgyes pa'i mchod pa sna tshogs 'di: gza' bdud 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: hūm̐: drang srong chen po'i thugs dam bskang : ki kang chen po'i thugs dam bskang : sgra gcan 'bar ba'i thugs dmabaskang : rā hu la yi thugs dam bskang : ljang sngon chen po'i thugs dam bskang : sde brgyad dmag dpon thugs dam bskang : gza' brgyad 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : gdong mo rigs bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : rgyu skar nyer brgyad thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: thugs dam gnyan po bskangs gyur nas: bdag gi g.yar dam sor chud de: phrin las thogs med khyod kyis sgrubs: gdug pa'i dam nyams dgra dang bgegs: myur du bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ āḥhūm̐: sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta go ro tsa na la kha kha khā hi: de nas bstod pa bya ba ni: hūm̐: bskal pa me 'bar khrag mtsho'i klong : thog char bu yug dkyil 'khor dbus: gza' bdud chen po mi bsrun pa: dbu dgu khros pas stong gsum sngangs: bya rog gdong gi bstan pa srung : phyag bzhi mtshon char dgra la 'bebs: spyan stong gzigs pas srid gsum sngangs: sbrul mjug 'khyil bas klu srin 'dul: sku la me 'od tshwa tshwa 'khrugs: gza' bdud nag por bdag bstod do: gtor bskul 'og tu gsal/ ༈ de nas khyab 'jug gi gtor ma 'bul ba ni: gtor ma bya rog gis mtshan pa bshams la: hūm̐: dug rlangs dmar nag 'bar ba'i klong : gdug pa'i bu yug thog char dbus: ki kang rngam klong nang shed nas:

srog bdag khyab 'jug nag po bzhengs: dbu dgu mun rub 'khrigs pa'i gzugs: zhal nas dug rlangs chi li li: spyan dmar tshwa tshwa tho ro ro: srog gzan bya rog dbang rtags rdzogs: g.yas gnyis thog mda' spu gri bsnams: g.yon gnyis lcags gzhu rgyal mtshan bsgrengs: sku stod srin po sku smad sbrul: mgo lus khyab par mig gis gtams: de'i nang sde brgyad dmag tshogs 'gyed: lte bar khro zhal bstan dgra 'joms: g.yon du srog gcod ma mo rngam: 'khor du gza' brgyad gdong mo 'gyed: hrul du sha za khrag 'thung bskor: ki kang thog 'bebs nag po che: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: sdang ba'i dgra la thog ser phob: gza' nad steng grib 'tshub tu chugs: sangs rgyas bstan pa'i dgra dang bgegs: sgos su bdag la sdang ba rnams: srog gcod dbugs longs snying khrag 'thung : dus la bab bo sa ma ya: sngon tshe gsang bdag pad+ma yis: dam tshig ci ltar bka' bsgos bzhin: da lta sngags 'chang bdag gis bskul: ma thogs bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: hrīḥ rā hu la ki kang hrī shag ru raṃ dgra bo'i srog rtsa la yaṃ kha raṃ khā hi: zhes gtor ma dgra phyogs 'bul la: khyab 'jug dug mtsho nas khol du phyung ba'o: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gser gling nas karma las 'brel rtsal gyis gdan drangs pa'o: ༈ kī la che mchog khro rgyal las: skyes bu dam can gyi gtor 'bul bzhugs so: kyam̐: gter srung skyes bu dam can gyi gtor 'bul ni: 'bru nag gam ni gang rung zan: ra mgos mtshan pa'i dpal gtor gzugs: ra yi sha khrag gsur btang zhing : rang nyid lha yi nga rgyal gyis: hūm̐ bh+yo tri: byang shar me rlung 'bar ba'i klong : skyes bu badz+ra sa dhu rtsal: dmar nag ra skyes kham pa chibs: phyag gnyis rdo rje dgra snying rol: btsan mdung ru dar lhabs se lhab: sku la dar dmar phod chen gsol: stag ral gzig shubs ral gris brgyan: btsan dmag yang 'khor sha za sde:

drag bskul las la bos pa'i tshe: ma thogs gnas 'dir myur du byon: slob dpon ji ltar bka' bsgos bzhin: zab gter gnyan gyi bstan pa srungs: ra yi sha khrag gsur mchod bzhes: sngags 'chang rnal 'byor bdag cag gi: ka cha dkor nor gnyer du bcol: nyin mtshan srung ba'i mel tshe mdzod: gal te nyams pa'i dgra bo yi: gnod tshe gdug sems 'ching gyur tshe: skyes bu dam can las la chos: btsan rgod shan pa'i dmag sna drongs: the'u rang 'gong po'i phung shig thongs: yang 'khor sprul pa'i ru 'dren 'gyed: chos chos sdang ba'i dgra la chos: dgra bo'i mi nor phyags mas thobs: dgra bo'i yul zhing ser bas khongs: shwa kha khram sdeb snying rlung gyis: dgra bo bdun rgyud rtsad nas chod: pho rgyud mo rgyud mngal nas skoms: rigs rgyud thal ba rdul du rlog: dgra la dmag sna 'dren pa'i tshe: nam mkhar 'brug zhon nyi khri stong : dgra yul thog gi khongs la shog: bar snang seng zhon nyi khri stong : dgra la smyo 'bog snying gzer thongs: sa gzhi ra zhon nyi khri stong : dgra la grib rgod sna tshogs thongs: sprul pa pho nya las mkhan rnams: ka cha dkor nor phyir la rgyugs: yang 'khor gcan spyang sha za tshogs: dgra bo'i nor rdzas bla 'khyams sdud: byad ma lha srung rten dang phrol: dam can dregs pa btsan gyi tshogs: sha khrag dmar gtor 'di bzhes la: gsang bdag rdo rje khro bo dang : dregs 'dul snang srid zil gnon la: yang rdzong shel gyi brag phug tu: khyod kyis srog phul bka' bsgos bzhin: zab chos gnyan gyi mel tshe mdzod: ka cha chas ka gang zhig de: nyes can rkun 'phrog bcom srid na: myur du phyir 'brongs dgra bo sgrol: gal te nyes 'gal byung srid na: skyes bu dam can med do skad: de bas dam las ma 'da' bar: rgyud srung bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ badz+ra sa dhu tsa rak+sha nag po dgra bo'i don snying la khā hi khā hi: zhes gtor ma dgra phyogs su 'phang ngam skyal:

sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: bdag 'dra sngags 'chang karma hūm̐ gis phag lor gser gling nor bu'i bang mdzod nas gdan drangs shing shog ser las zhal bshus pa'o// // ༈ bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: gter srung btsan rgod kyi gsol kha bzhugs so: bla med yang dag rdo rje gzhon nur 'dud: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: de yang btsan rgod rol pa khrag 'thung bco brgyad kyi gsol mchod brtsam pa ni: zangs lcags bhan+dha gang rung gi snod du bang rim sum brtsegs kyi kha ru btsan mkhar gru bzhi bzhag /de'i steng la dmar gtor ra dgu pa tsit+ta gsum gyis brgyan pa bzhag: de yang dbus kyi btsan rgod har len chen po yin: de nas rim bzhin btsan rol pa bco brgyad g.yas skor rnam pas: ber ma la ri rab thog mde'u: dmar po kong zor snying brgyan: beng smug chos 'byung bra gzugs: rol pa khrag kong liṅga: lha btsan dkar gtor rtse gsum: mig dmar zangs sho zangs khrab: mtshal stag bam ro zlum po: lho btsan dpal gtor thod brgyan: sog ra g.yas gcus g.yon gcus: zangs ri zla skyong g.yas gcus: sham po rmog gzugs 'phru can: 'bar ba khrag 'thung glo ba'i rgyal mtshan: rdo rje 'bar ba bshos bu rtse gsum: zangs btsan mkhar thab sha rus brgyan: rong btsan sprel dmar bya dmar: rdor legs ra mgo 'dab can: shel ging phyi ba lag sbrel: de rnams mtho dman cha snyoms bya zhing dkar dmar gyis brgyan: mthar mtheb skyus bskor: mdun du sman raka bsham: sha dum bha ling gi mchod pa bzhag /skabs su tshig dang bstun nas mchod: mchod pa'i 'bag pa thams cad: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsangs nas byin gyis brlab pa ni: om̐ ma hā ku mā ra hṛ da ya badz+ra ye sarba dra byāṃ shwa dha ye swā hā: om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum bya: om̐ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ: stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las byung ba'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du:

sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga'i rang bzhin ming yig dang po zhu ba las byung ba'i dngos po zad mi shes pa nam mkha'i khyon dang mnyam par spel: khyad par du yang sprul pa'i chos skyong btsan rgod chen po gnas bco brgyad kyi bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa mnyes pa'i dam rdzas spyan gzigs rnams thogs pa med par 'byung ba'i rang bzhin du gyur: om̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ya shab+da āḥhūm̐: rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she āḥhūm̐: om̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ om̐ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ om̐ ma hā bha ling+ta te dz+wa bha ling+ta bha la bha te gu h+ya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ om̐ ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta go ro tsa na bha su ta om̐ āḥhūm̐: zhes byin gyis brlabs nas rnga gling rol mo drag tu bsgrag: sha chen gyi gsur btang : spyan gzigs dang ru dar sna tshogs mkha' la bsgrengs shing : rang nyid rdo rje gzhon nu'i ting nge 'dzin gsal ba'i ngang nas: rten bskyed pa ni: hoḥ stong pa'i ngang las mdun du me rlung 'tshub ma dang khrag gi rgya mtshor mi ro rta ro ri ltar spungs pa'i dbus su he tsa tri dang zangs gri ru mtshon las skyes pa'i gnod sbyin chen po sku mdog dmar po me yi mdog can dbu la zangs rmog rtse phran ru dar lnga yis brgyan cing : zhal gyi mche ba bsdams te dpral ba'i khro gnyer sum brtsegs bsdus pa: sku la dar dmar gyi phod kha dang zangs khrab gsol ba: g.yas zangs gri 'bar ba klad la bskor zhing : g.yon dgra bgegs kyi glo snying dang btsan zhags thogs te mchan du ru mtshon dmar po bsnams nas stag ral gzigs shubs kyis brgyan pa'o: zhabs la hor lham g.yu mthil gyon zhing sga srab mdzes pa'i zangs rta dmar zhur la zhon nas stong gsum gling gzhi thams cad kha lo bsgyur ba'i las byed du gsal ba'o: nyid las mi zhan pa'i sprul pa bcu bdun ni: cha lugs phal cher gtso bo la mthun zhing :

la las dgra la thog mda' char ltar 'bebs pa: la las zangs mdas dgra snying gzir ba: la las spu gris dgra srog gcod pa: la las dgra bo 'ching zhing drud pa: la las pags pa dmar bshus byed pa: la las bam chen dmar po za ba: la las mgo mjug ldog nas drud pa: la las nang rol rgyu ma 'dren pa: la las don snying dmar po za ba: la las rlid bu khrag rkyal thogs pa: la las bam bkal btsan shwa khrid pa: la las ru mtshon dgra la bsnun pa: la las zangs kyi 'ug pa 'gyed pa: la las mtshal stag dgra la 'phyo ba: la las rlung dmar 'tshub ma 'debs pa: la las 'jigs pa'i bswo sgra sgrog pa: la las dgra la sho khram 'debs pa: gzhan yang ma nges pa'i mngon spyod sna tshogs mdzad cing mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs te dgra bgegs thams cad gsod cing bcad de rgyal ba'i bstan pa srung ba'i las byed du gsal ba'o: yang 'khor du za byed gsod byed sgrol byed 'ching byed sdom byed: bya sha zan gcan gzan khrag 'thung la sogs mdog mi sdug pa'i cha lugs can du ma'i 'khor bcas ldan pa ste: de ltar gsal ba'i gnas gsum las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas dang : rang rang gi pho brang nas chos skyong chen po sku 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs: phaiṃ phaiṃ dza dzaḥ de nas spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: ma la ya yi byang shar mtshams: zangs ri rtse dgu'i gnas mchog dbus: mchong lding smug po'i pho brang nas: btsan gyi rgyal po mthu bo che: rdo rje gzhon nu'i bka' nyan zhing : slob dpon pad+ma'i dam gnas pa: bid+yot+ta mas tha tshig srungs: har len chen po gshegs su gsol: yang le shod du mtshan gsol ba: ber ma chen po gshegs su gsol: byang chub ring mor mtshan gsol ba: dmar po dpon g.yog gshegs su gsol: sha 'ug stag sgor mtshan gsol ba: gnod sbyin bswe khrab gshegs su gsol: sham bha la ru mtshan gsol ba: rol pa mi gzan gshegs su gsol: ti se gangs rir mtshan gsol ba:

rdo rje thog 'bebs gshegs su gsol: bsam yas mchims phur mtshan gsol ba: bshan pa mig dmar gshegs su gsol: yang rdzong shel phug mtshan gsol ba: gnyan stag dmar po gshegs su gsol: mkha' spyod tsā rir mtshan gsol ba: gha ya dha ra gshegs su gsol: gzho stod gnas su mtshan gsol ba: sog ra chen po gshegs su gsol: zangs ri gnas su mtshan gsol ba: 'bar ba zla skyong gshegs su gsol: sham po gnas su mtshan gsol ba: myur len har ting gshegs su gsol: sbas lung brgyad du mtshan gsol ba: 'bar ba khrag 'thung gshegs su gsol: gze rgyal gangs su mtshan gsol ba: rdo rje 'bar ba gshegs su gsol: sku rgyal shen ner mtshan gsol ba: gnod sbyin beg rtse gshegs su gsol: rong btsan gangs su mtshan gsol ba: bshan pa rlung dmar gshegs su gsol: gtsug lag skyong bar mtshan gsol ba: rdo rje legs pa gshegs su gsol: dkor gyi srung mar mtshan gsol ba: shel ging rgyal po gshegs su gsol: gzhan yang bka' yi las byed pa: sprul pa yang sprul gshegs su gsol: bstan pa bsrung phyir gshegs su gsol: dgra bgegs bsgral phyir gshegs su gsol: phrin las bsgrub phyir gshegs su gsol: om̐ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ hoḥ khrag zhag rba klong 'khrugs pa'i dbus: dgra bgegs mi ro rta ro'i gdan: me rlung 'tshubs pa'i dbus nyid du: gsol zhing mchod pa bzhes slad du: dgyes pa'i ngang gis bzhugs su gsol: om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya shu la dharma pā la tiṣ+ṭha satwaṃ: de nas gsol mchod bya ba ni: sman raka phud dang bha ling bran zhing : hoḥ btsan rgod chen po 'khor bcas la: mthun pa'i dam rdzas 'bul ba ni: phyi mchod spyan gzigs sna tshogs dang : nang mchod sman gtor rak+ta'i tshogs: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol mthun pa'i rdzas: rol mo sgra snyan gdung ba'i dbyangs: yid du bkod dang sprul pa'i tshogs: chos skyong 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: om̐ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she āḥhūm̐:

om̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta ma hā rak+ta bha ling+ta māṃ sa tsit+ta go ro tsa na bha su ta kha kha khā hi: de nas gsol zhing phrin las bcol ba ni: hoḥ rgya gar bid+yot+ta ma la yi btsan rgod har len chen po la gsol zhing mchod pa ni: sha chen bsregs pa'i dud pa: ngar chen dug khrag gser skyems: rak+ta dmar gyi mchod pa: dgra sha khrag gi mchod pa: bha ling brgyan pa'i mchod pa: btsan bshos dgra snying dmar po: btsan mkhar btsan chas sna tshogs dar dmar cod pan du ma: gzhan yang mthun rdzas mchod rdzas sna tshogs 'di 'bul lo: dgyes par bzhes la rig 'dzin sgrub pa po'i bka' dang bstan pa skyongs: grogs dang rogs dan gyis: phrin las sna tshogs bsgrub cing dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i las mdzod cig: i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: hoḥ yang le shod kyi btsan rgod ber ma chen po la gsol zhing mchod pa ni: sha chen bsregs pa'i dud pa: ngar chen dug khrag?sogs 'gres gong ltar bshangs/ hoḥ chu mig byang chub ring mo'i btsan rgod dmar po dpon g.yog l hoḥ sha 'ug brag gi btsan rgod beng smug bswe khrab l hoḥ sham bha la yi btsan rgod rol pa mi gzan l hoḥ ti se gangs kyi lha btsan rdo rje thog 'bebs l hoḥ mchims phu brag gi btsan rgod bshan pa mig dmar l hoḥ yang rdzong shel brag gi btsan rgod gnyan stag dmar po l hoḥ mkha' spyod tsā ri'i lha btsan gha ya dha ra l hoḥ gzho stod ti sgro'i btsan rgod sog ra chen po l hoḥ dbu ru zangs ri'i btsan rgod drag po zla skyong l hoḥ sham po'i btsan rgod myur len har ting l hoḥ sbas lung btsan rgod 'bar ba khrag 'thung l hoḥ gze rgyal btsan rgod rdo rje 'bar ba l hoḥ sku rgyal shen ne'i btsan rgod zangs btsan beg rtse l hoḥ rong btsan gangs kyi btsan rgod bshan pa rlung dmar l hoḥ gtsug lag gi btsan rgod rdo rje legs pa l hoḥ dkor skyong btsan rgod shel ging smug po l

hoḥ gzhan yang sprul pa yang sprul gyi btsan rgod 'khor dang bcas pa la: gsol zhing mchod pa ni: sha chen bsregs pa'i dud pa: ngar chen dug khrag gser skyems: rak+ta dmar gyi mchod pa: dgra sha khrag gi mchod pa: bha ling brgyan pa'i mchod pa: btsan bshos dgra snying dmar po: btsan mkhar btsan chas sna tshogs: dar dmar cod pan du ma: gzhan yang mthun rdzas mchod rdzas sna tshogs 'di 'bul lo: dgyes par bzhes la rig 'dzin sgrub pa po'i bka' dang bstan pa skyongs: grogs dang rogs dan gyis: phrin las sna tshogs bsgrub cing dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i las mdzod cig: i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: bar brjod la: de nas bstod pa bya zhing*/ hūm̐: chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos he ru kaḥ thugs kyi rang bzhin rdo rje lta bu'i klong : rdo rje gzhon nu yang dag ye shes rol: gsung gi bdag nyid pad+ma he ru kaḥ drag sngags 'bar zhing mched pa'i rang sgra sgrog: sku yi rtsal 'byin 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed: khro bo gar dgu sprul pa cir yang ston: de ltar dbyings las ma g.yos rang byung lha: dpal chen 'bar ba'i rtsal las shar ba yi: bka' yi las byed gnod sbyin me 'od gdong : srin po khros 'dra 'jigs rung rnam 'gyur can: 'od ldan zangs khrab rmog zhu nyi ltar gsal: ru dar dmar po bar snang 'tshubs kyis 'gengs: zangs gri 'bar bas bstan dgra rtsad nas gcod: thog ltar 'gyu ba'i ru mtshon dgra la 'bebs: ma rungs dgra snying gsol zhing btsan zhags 'phen: stag ral gzigs shubs dpa' bo'i cha lugs 'chang : sga srab chas ldan zangs rta dmar po zhon: bsam pa tsam gyis stong gsum yud kyis bskor: rang 'dra'i sprul pa btsan rgod las la 'gyed: bshan pa'i sde dpon gnod sbyin ma ru rtse: cha lugs sna tshogs snang srid 'gengs par ston: bsam pa tsam gyis dgra bgegs tshar gcod pa: btsan rgod 'khor dang bcas la bdag bstod do: om̐ rak+sha ma ru tse shu la pu ri shan+ta tsa ye swā hā:

las bskul zur du gsal/ ༈ btsan rgod me 'od gdong rol pa bco brgyad kyi gsol mchod bstan dgra thal 'byin bzhugs so/ drag po'i mchod rdzas dpag med bkram/ /ting 'dzin lha yi gsal snang brtan/ h+ya ghṛ was bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ dur khrod 'jigs rung bkod pa'i dbus/ /mi ro rta ro khrag mtsho'i dkyil/ /ral gri hrīḥs mtshan yongs gyur las/ /btsan rgyal drag po dmar nag khros/ /phyag g.yas ral gris dgra srog gcod/ /g.yon pas mdung dmar ru mtshon phyar/ /bswe khrab bswe rmog 'khor gsum bskor/ /rdzu 'phrul rlung gshog rta dmar chibs/ /rang 'dra'i sprul pa bcu bdun dang*/ /snang srid sde brgyad 'khor gyis bskor/ /gnas gsum 'bru gsum 'od zer gyis/ /phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rab 'byams nas/ /btsan rgod 'khor bcas spyan drangs gyur/ rol mo rdung la dbyangs kyis bskul/ /dar g.yab gsur btang spyan 'dren ni/ kyai/ phyogs phyogs dag kyang pha ki na/ /nyi ma nub phyogs pha ki na/ /zangs ri gnam du zangs se zang*/ /zangs thang de ni phya ma phyo/ /rlung dmar 'tshub ma kyi li li/ /btsan dmag bswo sgra di ri ri/ /zangs 'phar zangs khyi nyi li li/ /glog dmar 'brug sgra 'u ru ru/ /rak+ta'i rgya mtsho phyur ba'i dbus/ /zangs brag rtse dgu'i gzhal yas nas/ /btsan gyi rgyal po mthu bo che/ /rdo rje gzhon nu rta mgrin rgyal/ /pad+ma thod phreng la sogs pa'i/ /dam las ma g.yel da tshur byon/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba dang*/ /rnal 'byor phrin las sgrub pa dang*/ /bstan dgra thal bar brlag pa'i phyir/ /btsan rgod 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol/ om̐ shu la tsa tri dzaḥbadz+ra sa mā ya du du dza dzaḥ hūm̐/ khrag mtsho mi ro rta ro dang*/ /dgra bgegs bsnol ba'i gdan la bzhugs/ /brgyud gsum bla mas bka' bsgos ltar/ /dam las ma 'da' sa ma ya/ oṃ shu la tri tiṣ+ṭha lhan ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭ/ mchod cing dgyes pa bskyed pa ni/

kyai/ btsan rgod 'bar ba 'khor bcas la/ /dgyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ /rak+ta khrag gi ar+ghaṃ dang*/ /dbang po'i me tog tshil chen gsur/ /zhun chen mar me mkhris chen chab/ /sha rus zhal zas rkang gling sgra/ /bdud rtsi sman phud rak+ta'i skyems/ /snod bcud longs spyod gtor ma'i bcud/ /nam mkha'i khams kun rgyas bkang ste/ /btsan rgod 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /dgyes par bzhes la phrin las mdzod/ oṃ shu la dharma pā la ya ar+ghaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da sarba pañtsa ma hā rak+ta ma hā ba ling+ta pū dza khā hi khā hi/ che ba'i yon tan bsngags pa ni/ kyai/ bde chen dbang drag pho brang nas/ /zil gnon khrag 'thung he ru ka /'jig rten 'das kyang 'khor ba'i tshul/ /bstan srung drag po'i sku la bstod/ /glog ltar myur ba'i bstan srung ni/ /thog ltar 'bebs pa'i drag rtsal can/ /ser ltar 'dril bas dgra srog gcod/ /bu ltar brtse ba'i btsan rgod 'di/ /dus mtha'i shugs chen kha dog ltar/ /'bar ba'i me lce'i phreng ba 'khrugs/ /dus kyi dgra chen las brjid pa'i/ /rno dbal mtshon cha'i thog zer 'bebs/ /mi shigs rdo rje'i go khrab brjid/ /yid ltar mgyogs pa'i rta dmar zhon/ /sprul pa'i 'khor tshogs grangs med pa/ /srid pa gsum gyi dgra las rgyal/ khams gsum ma lus zil gyis gnon/ /'jig rten khams kyi drag rtsal can/ /bdud dgra ma lus rmang nas gzhom/ /gang bcol las la thogs pa med/ /rbad na dgra srog rbad kyis gcod/ bskul na bstan dgra gyur mid za/ /stobs kyis ri rab tsog pur 'phen/ /shugs kyis stong gsum bla 'og bsgyur/ /ki yis ri rab ldam ldem g.yo/ /nus pas mtha' yi rgya mtsho rngub/ /bswo yi 'brug sgras dgra mgo 'gems/ /hūm̐ sgras bdud dgra'i don snying skyug /mchod na bu bzhin rjes su brtse/ khros pas 'jig rten ma lus phung*/ rnal 'byor pa yis khyod bsten na/

/dngos grub ma lus char ltar 'bebs/ /dam tshig ldan pas khyod bsgrubs na/ /las bzhi'i phrin las thogs med sgrub/ /dam tshig gcig pas khyod bos na/ /lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grog /ting 'dzin stobs kyis khyod bskul na/ /sdang ba thams cad rnam par sreg /phyi ltar dregs byed btsan gyi rgyal/ /nang ltar pad+ma rigs kyi ging*/ /gsang ba pad+ma he ru ka /bstan srung 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ /brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la/ /las dang dngos grub thogs med pa'i/ /phrin las ma lus myur 'grub mdzod/ gsol kha'i mchod tshogs rgyas par bsham/ /mnga' gsol phrin las bcol ba ni/ kyai/ dpal gyi bka' sdod btsan gyi ging*/ /drag po sgrol byed khros pa'i sku/ /snang srid dregs byed btsan dmag tshogs/ /gsol lo mchod do mnga' gsol lo/ /dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis sprul/ /thugs la gang bzhed der 'char ba'i/ /rtag pa rgyun gyi longs spyod 'di/ /zad med mkha' dang mnyam pa 'dis/ /rgya gar bid+yot+ta ma'i bdag /btsan rgod har len 'khor dang bcas/ /gsol lo mchod do mnga' gsol lo/ /phrin las ma lus myur du sgrubs/ /yang le shod kyi gnas mchog nas/ /btsan rgod ber ma 'khor dang bcas/ /gsol lo mchod do mnga' gsol lo/ /phrin las ma lus myur du sgrubs/ /chu mig byang chub ring mo nas/ /btsan rgod dmar po 'khor dang bcas/ /gsol lo mchod do mnga' gsol lo/ /phrin las ma lus myur du sgrubs/ /mon yul sha 'ug stag sgo nas/ /btsan rgod beng smug 'khor dang bcas/ /gsol lo mchod do mnga' gsol lo/ /phrin las ma lus myur du sgrubs/ /byang phyogs sham bha la yi gnas/ /rol pa mi gzan 'khor dang bcas/ /gsol lo mchod do mnga' gsol lo/ /phrin las ma lus myur du sgrubs/ /ti se gangs kyi rwa ba nas/ /lha btsan thog 'bebs 'khor dang bcas/ /gsol lo mchod do mnga' gsol lo/ /phrin las ma lus myur du sgrubs/

/bsam yas mchims phu'i brag dmar nas/ /shan pa mig dmar 'khor dang bcas/ /gsol lo mchod do mnga' gsol lo/ /phrin las ma lus myur du sgrubs/ /yang rdzong shel brag 'bar ba nas/ /gnyan stag dmar po 'khor dang bcas/ /gsol lo mchod do mnga' gsol lo/ /phrin las ma lus myur du sgrubs/ /tsā ri tra yi gnas mchog nas/ /ga ya dha ra 'khor dang bcas/ /gsol lo mchod do mnga' gsol lo/ /phrin las ma lus myur du sgrubs/ /gzho stod ti sgro'i gnas mchog nas/ /btsan rgod sog ra 'khor dang bcas/ /gsol lo mchod do mnga' gsol lo/ /phrin las ma lus myur du sgrubs/ /dbu ru stod kyi zangs ri nas/ /drag po zla skyong 'khor dang bcas/ /gsol lo mchod do mnga' gsol lo/ /phrin las ma lus myur du sgrubs/ /sham po gangs kyi rwa ba nas/ myur len har ting 'khor dang bcas/ /gsol lo mchod do mnga' gsol lo/ /phrin las ma lus myur du sgrubs/ /sbas yul pad+ma bkod pa nas/ /'bar ba khrag 'thung 'khor dang bcas/ /gsol lo mchod do mnga' gsol lo/ /phrin las ma lus myur du sgrubs/ /gze rgyal gangs dkar rtse gsum nas/ /rdo rje 'bar ba 'khor dang bcas/ /gsol lo mchod do mnga' gsol lo/ /phrin las ma lus myur du sgrubs/ /mdo khams sku rgyal zangs ri nas/ /gnod sbyin beg rtse 'khor dang bcas/ /gsol lo mchod do mnga' gsol lo/ phrin las ma lus myur du sgrubs/ /rong btsan kha ba dkar po nas/ /shan pa rlung dmar 'khor dang bcas/ /gsol lo mchod do mnga' gsol lo/ /phrin las ma lus myur du sgrubs/ /gtsug lag chos 'khor bzhugs gnas na/ /rdo rje legs pa 'khor dang bcas/ /gsol lo mchod do mnga' gsol lo/ phrin las ma lus myur du sgrubs/ /bstan srung dkor nor kun gyi bdag /shel ging nag po 'khor dang bcas/ /gsol lo mchod do mnga' gsol lo/ /phrin las ma lus myur du sgrubs/ /stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten na/

/drag po btsan gyi dmag tshogs rnams/ /gsol lo mchod do mnga' gsol lo/ phrin las ma lus myur du sgrubs/ /bstan srung myur mgyogs drag po'i tshogs/ /g.yab bo rdo rje'i spyan ma rtul/ /bos so rdo rje'i snyan ma sra/ /'gyang nge ring se ma mdzad par/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi phrin las mdzod/ /chos 'khor bstan pa sde dang bcas/ /mi nor rta phyugs grwa 'khor g.yog /bcol lo ltos so mthu ma chung*/ /nyin mtshan kun tu g.yel med srungs/ /log par sems la cho 'phrul thongs/ /ngan dgu bshams la ltas ngan phobs/ /bsam pa ngan la rtags mtshan ston/ /sbyor ba rtsub la don snying phyungs/ /jag rkun rnams kyi don snying zo/ /byad ma mkhan rnams hur thum sod/ /yul mi ngan pa'i snying khrag 'thung*/ /ban dgra glo snying lus srog phrol/ /bran g.yog ngan pa'i rgyu 'grul chod/ /bstan dgra rnams kyi bla tshe skems/ /dkor rkun rnams kyi yan lag chod/ /mtha' dmag dus kyi 'khrug pa zlog /las bzhi grub pa chen po brgyad/ /yid la bsam pa'i don kun sgrubs/ /pho rnams btsan rgod ltar drag cing*/ /mi dang mi min rnam las rgyal/ khams gsum ma lus dbang du bsdus/ /srid pa gsum po zil gyis gnon/ /nang du snying mthun gros thub pas/ khe grags stobs ldan dpa' brtul bas/ /phyi ru g.yul las rnam par rgyal/ /byes su song na mgo thon cing*/ /lam dgra byes 'gong dgra jag choms/ /don 'grub rang gnas bde bar 'khor/ /gzhi la 'dug na bkra shis shing*/ /legs lam blo yi rtsa sgo phyes/ /gang brtsams las la thogs med cing*/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgya mtshan phyor/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i sku tshe srings/ /'khor slob dge 'dun dar zhing rgyas/ /'gro don phrin las snyan grags 'phel/ /chab srid dbyar gyi dpal ltar bkra/ /gnas skabs mthar thug thams cad du/ /bkra shis bde legs 'od po che/ /snang srid khyab pa'i phrin las mdzod/

thugs dam bskang ba'i rim pa ni/ gtor mchod bskang rdzas rgya cher bkram/ hūm̐/ mtshan nyid kun tshang gnas mchog 'dir/ /dam tshig ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /dngos su ci 'byor gtsang mar bshams/ /yid kyi dpag tu med par sprul/ /phyi nang gsang ba mchod pa'i rdzas/ /kun tu bzang po'i rgyan du shar/ /nyams pa bdun ldan bsgral ba las/ /dur khrod drag po'i rdzas chen bkram/ /g.yo ba med pa'i ting 'dzin brtan/ /gsal 'grib med pa'i bskyed rim rdzogs/ /ldog med bsrung bzlog bsreg pa'i las/ /sku gsung thugs kyi phyag rgya las/ /rgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rol rtsed 'gyed/ /rbad bskul las bzhi'i rdzas mchog bkram/ /bla na med pa'i skong rdzas 'dis/ /kun bzang rdor sems snang mtha' yas/ /nā gardzu na pad+ma 'byung*/ /sku gsum brgyud pa dgu ldan gyi/ /bka' bab dag snang srol 'dzin pa'i/ /rgya bod mkhas grub rig 'dzin rnams/ /thugs dam gnyan po dbyings su bskang*/ /bdag rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /dbang chen he ru ka dpal dang*/ /mdo dang sgyu 'phrul sems rgyud sde/ /rgyud sde bzhi dang sgrub sde brgyad/ /gsang sngags rgyud lung man ngag gi /yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams/ /thugs dam gnyan po dbyings su bskang*/ mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ /bde gshegs rdo rje rin po che/ /pad+ma las kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ /ri rab sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi/ /rdul dang mnyam pa'i ḍāk+ki'i tshogs/ /zhing sngags lhan cig skyes ma yi/ /ma sring mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /thugs dam gnyan po dbyings su bskang*/ /nyams chag bskangs shing nyams rtogs spor/ /legs ldan phyag bzhi phyag drug pa/ /gur mgon ma ning ber nag can/ /sngags srung dud sol ngan ne ma/ /gza' bdud lha chen rdo rje legs/ /las gshin tshe ring mched lnga sogs/ /brgyud gsum dam can rgya mtsho rnams/ /thugs dam gnyan po dbyings su bskang*/

/bstan pa srungs la phrin las sgrubs/ /rnam sras dzaṃ lha re man+ta/ /kun 'khyil tshogs bdag dpal chen mo/ /gnod sbyin nor lha gter bdag rnams/ /thugs dam gnyan po dbyings su bskang*/ /'dod rgu lhun grub dngos grub stsol/ /pad+ma dbang gi bka' nyan pa/ khams gsum srog gi shan pa che/ /myur mgyogs rdzu 'phrul 'gran zla bral/ /che btsan bdag po'i thugs dam bskang*/ /bla ma dgongs 'dus bka' srung pa/ /phyi ltar btsan rgod drag po bdun/ /nang ltar dge bsnyen mched bdun te/ /gsang ba gnod sbyin mched bdun sprul/ /btsan gyi ging chen thugs dam bskang*/ /sku lha zhang gi lha btsan sogs/ /'bar ba spun dgu thugs dam bskang*/ /li yul dge bsnyen dmod bor bas/ /drang shan 'byed pa 'byung po'i rgyal/ /btsan yul zangs thang dmar po ru/ /pad+ma dbang gi bka' sdod che/ /btsan rgod dmar po'i thugs dam bskang*/ /ya ba skya sogs thugs dam bskang*/ /dkar po lha yi sde dpon che/ /chos kyi rgyal po'i bka' sdod de/ /zhang zhung yul du a bswe'i rgyal/ /thim yu bde chen gsang phug tu/ /dgra lha'i rgyal po'i skur ston pa/ /jag pa me len thugs dam bskang*/ /rdo rje dgra 'dul thugs dam bskang*/ /shan pa mched gsum thugs dam bskang*/ /'o yug shang gi bre mo ru/ /'dzam bu gling gi skyes gcig pu/ /gtsug lag gnas chen kun gyi bdag /rdo rje legs pa'i thugs dam bskang*/ /skyes bu chen po'i thugs dam bskang*/ /sum brgya drug cu'i thugs dam bskang*/ /sa 'og gshin rje'i dmag dpon che/ /rdzong chen bco brgyad pho brang 'dzin/ /rdo rje brag btsan thugs dam bskang*/ /lho btsan nag po'i thugs dam bskang*/ /sprul pa mched drug thugs dam bskang*/ /phyag rgya chen po'i bstan pa skyongs/ /sgrub brgyud 'dzin pa'i dgra lha che/ /smon lam dbang gis bstan pa srungs/ /jo bo skrag btsan thugs dam bskang*/ /rdo rje kun skyob thugs dam bskang*/

/skya dgu bran bcu'i thugs dam bskang*/ /stong nyid sgom pa'i grogs mdzod cing*/ /bdag med rtogs pa'i phrin las can/ /gsang chen bstan pa spel mdzad pa/ /zangs ri btsan rgod thugs dam bskang*/ /drag po mched gnyis thugs dam bskang*/ /yang 'khor sprul pa'i thugs dam bskang*/ /he chen brdal gyi dur khrod nas/ rgyal ba mchog dang lhan cig tu/ /smon lam stobs kyis skur sprul pa/ /gnod sbyin khyung zhon thugs dam bskang*/ /beg rtse chen po'i thugs dam bskang*/ /yang 'khor sde brgyad thugs dam bskang*/ /ya ki sgo mo brag dmar na/ /zangs brag dmar po'i nang shed na/ /bkra shis dar rgyas che ba'i lha/ /skyes bu lung btsan thugs dam bskang*/ /rdo rje g.yu sgron thugs dam bskang*/ /btsan 'khor mang po'i thugs dam bskang*/ /zangs ri 'bar ba rtse dgu nas/ /shu ba srog len btsan gyi rje/ /yam shud dmar po'i thugs dam bskang*/ /sku rgyal shen ne'i thugs dam bskang*/ /sprul pa'i dmag tshogs thugs dam bskang*/ /phyi nang bar chad bzlog pa dang*/ /phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub tu gsol/ hūm̐/ btsan mkhar dmar po'i nang shed na/ /sha khrag longs spyod bsam mi khyab/ /yid 'ong spyan gzigs skar ltar bkram/ /rkang gling thod rnga 'brug ltar ldir/ /ma tshang med pa'i mthun rdzas 'dis/ /pad+ma dbang gi bka' nyan pa/ /btsan rgod har len thugs dam bskang*/ /btsan rgod ber ma'i thugs dam bskang*/ /dmar po dpon g.yog thugs dam bskang*/ /beng smug bswe khrab thugs dam bskang*/ /rol pa mi gzan thugs dam bskang*/ /rdo rje thog 'bebs thugs dam bskang*/ /shan pa mig dmar thugs dam bskang*/ /gnyan stag dmar po'i thugs dam bskang*/ /lho btsan seng gdong thugs dam bskang*/ /btsan rgod sog ra'i thugs dam bskang*/ /drag po zla skyong thugs dam bskang*/ /myur len har ting thugs dam bskang*/ /'bar ba khrag 'thung thugs dam bskang*/ /rdo rje 'bar ba'i thugs dam bskang*/

/drag po lcam sring thugs dam bskang*/ /shan pa rlung dmar thugs dam bskang*/ /gtsang btsan chen po'i thugs dam bskang*/ /shel ging smug po'i thugs dam bskang*/ /btsan rgod khro 'bar thugs dam bskang*/ /shar btsan dkar po'i thugs dam bskang*/ /lho btsan ser po'i thugs dam bskang*/ /nub btsan dmar po'i thugs dam bskang*/ /byang btsan ljang gu'i thugs dam bskang*/ /la btsan lung btsan thugs dam bskang*/ /lam btsan chu btsan thugs dam bskang*/ /gangs btsan brag btsan thugs dam bskang*/ /spang btsan shing btsan thugs dam bskang*/ /mgyogs pa kha bzhi'i thugs dam bskang*/ /btsan 'khor sde brgyad thugs dam bskang*/ khyad par yul 'dir gnas pa yis/ /btsan rgod drag po'i thugs dam bskang*/ /'bod pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir/ /dar dmar g.yab dar thugs dam bskang*/ /rten pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir/ /gri snying phyar dar thugs dam bskang*/ /rnal 'byor dam rdzas bskang ba'i phyir/ /sman raka gtor mas thugs dam bskang*/ /brtse gdung bu bzhin skyong ba'i phyir/ /lta sgom yang dag thugs dam bskang*/ /mi 'bral rtag tu 'grog pa'i phyir/ /rtag gtor chen pos thugs dam bskang*/ /rgyun du phrin las bcol ba'i phyir/ /rgyun gtor nar mas thugs dam bskang*/ /spyan gyi mchod pa yin pa'i phyir/ /spyan gzigs dkor chas thugs dam bskang*/ /snyan gyi dbang po tshim bya'i phyir/ /rnga dung rol mos thugs dam bskang*/ /shangs kyi mchod pa yin pa'i phyir/ /tshil chen gsur gyis thugs dam bskang*/ /ljags kyi dbang po tshim bya'i phyir/ /zhal zas sna tshogs thugs dam bskang*/ /sku yi mchod pa yin pa'i phyir/ /reg 'jam lha gos thugs dam bskang*/ /dam nyams dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i phyir/ /'khor tshogs pho nya'i thugs dam bskang*/ /dkor rkun rtsad nas gcod pa'i phyir/ /btsan dmag 'bum sde'i thugs dam bskang*/ /stong gsum yud kyis bskor ba'i phyir/ /zangs rta dmar zhur thugs dam bskang*/

khams gsum skad cig za ba'i phyir/ /zangs khyi zangs 'phar thugs dam bskang*/ /dgra bo'i srog dbugs len pa'i phyir/ /zangs gri 'bar bas thugs dam bskang*/ /dgra bgegs myur du dgug pa'i phyir/ /btsan zhags dmar pos thugs dam bskang*/ /nyams pa'i srog rtsa gcod pa'i phyir/ /ru mtshon dmar pos thugs dam bskang*/ /ci bcol phrin las bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /sha khrag gtor mas thugs dam bskang*/ /dgra la cho 'phrul dbab pa'i phyir/ /srin bya ku 'debs thugs dam bskang*/ /nyams pa'i bla srog dgug pa'i phyir/ /bse yi bya dmar thugs dam bskang*/ /bstan pa'i khur chen 'degs pa'i phyir/ glang dmar 'gying bas thugs dam bskang*/ dgra yul ltas ngan 'gyed pa'i phyir/ /wa mo brgyal bas thugs dam bskang*/ /bla srog chags pa'i mthun rdzas te/ /btsan shwa rgo bas thugs dam bskang*/ /bzhugs pa'i mthun rdzas khyad par 'phags/ /btsan mkhar dmar pos thugs dam bskang*/ /thugs kyi dgyes sde bskyed pa'i phyir/ /mdzes pa'i rig mas thugs dam bskang*/ /gzhan sde'i g.yul las rnam rgyal phyir/ /mi shigs go khrab thugs dam bskang*/ /gzhan sde rmang nas gzhar ba'i phyir/ /rno ngar mtshon chas thugs dam bskang*/ /dpa' bo rngam sgra yin pa'i phyir/ /dgra snying dmar pos thugs dam bskang*/ /dgra dpung g.yul las rgyal ba'i phyir/ /ha sgra bswo sgras thugs dam bskang*/ /dpa' bo'i zhal skyems yin pa'i phyir/ /bdud rtsi dza gad thugs dam bskang*/ /nyams pa'i snying la gzir ba'i phyir/ /lcags mda' lcags gzhus thugs dam bskang*/ /mchod cing dgyes pa bskang ba'i phyir/ /snang srid mdangs kyis thugs dam bskang*/ /rjes 'brangs pho nya 'gyed pa'i phyir/ /ri khyi spyang kis thugs dam bskang*/ /bla bya klad na lding ba'i phyir/ /ri bya pho rog thugs dam bskang*/ /'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra sgrogs pa'i phyir/ /'ug pa dgod pas thugs dam bskang*/ /yang sprul pho nya 'gyed pa'i phyir/

/mi hrengs gcer rgyug thugs dam bskang*/ /rtag tu dgyes pa'i zhal zas phyir/ /dgra sha dmar pos thugs dam bskang*/ /btung ba'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir/ /snying khrag rgya mtshos thugs dam bskang*/ /dpa' rtags ma mo dbang sdud phyir/ /dur khrod chas brgyad thugs dam bskang*/ /phyi yi rten rdzas yin pa'i phyir/ /mchong mar 'gying bas thugs dam bskang*/ /nang gi rten rdzas yin pa'i phyir/ /sku gzugs 'cham gar thugs dam bskang*/ /gsang ba'i rten rdzas yin pa'i phyir/ /ka dag dgongs pas thugs dam bskang*/ /spyan gyis gzigs mo mdzad pa'i phyir/ /snang srid bkod pas thugs dam bskang*/ /sku yi gzi brjid bskyed pa'i phyir/ /mnga' gsol mchod pas thugs dam bskang*/ /gsung gi tshangs dbyangs bskyed pa'i phyir/ /bstod dbyangs rol sgras thugs dam bskang*/ /thugs kyi ting 'dzin bskyed pa'i phyir/ /bskyed rdzogs dgongs pas thugs dam bskang*/ /yon tan ma lus yongs rdzogs phyir/ /rin chen sna lngas thugs dam bskang*/ /drag po'i las la bskul ba'i phyir/ /'bod rbad bsad pas thugs dam bskang*/ /dgra bo'i bdud du bskos pa'i phyir/ /mnan bsregs 'phang bas thugs dam bskang*/ /myur mgyogs pho nya mngag pa'i phyir/ /rlung dmar bang gis thugs dam bskang*/ /rtag tu mgon zhing bsrung ba'i phyir/ /rgyun du mchod pas thugs dam bskang*/ /mthun pa'i dam rdzas zad med pas/ /bstan srung 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang*/ /thugs dam bskangs shing rkyen ngan zlog /dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol/ /dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga dang*/ /stong gsum 'jig rten sa yi bdag /gnyan chen sde bzhi gnyan phran 'bum/ /dge bsnyen nyer gcig brtan skyong tshogs/ /gzhi bdag gnas bdag thugs dam bskang*/ /'go ba'i lha lnga skyob byed dgu/ /sdong grogs byed rnams thugs dam bskang*/ /chag che nyam nga thams cad zlog /'khor rnams bsrung zhing bar chad sol/

/mi nor rta phyugs bran g.yog 'khor/ /chos 'khor yul sde nor rdzas rnams/ /rtag tu srung ba'i mel tshe mdzod/ /srid dang zhi ba'i phan bde'i dpal/ /mos pa rnam bzhis dbang du sdus/ /mi mthun phyogs rnams mi 'byung zhing*/ /'byor drug dbyar mtsho ltar rgyas mdzod/ /'khor bcas thugs dam bskangs pa'i mthus/ /bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi/ /rnam dkar dge ba'i las brtsam na/ /bsam ngan sbyor rtsub byed pa yi/ /snang srid byad phur dgra la zlog /sde brgyad za kha zug pa zlog /rgyal po'i cho 'phrul dgra la zlog /gshin rje'i 'khor lo bskor ba zlog /drang srong dmod pa dgra la zlog /ma mo'i khrag nad dgra la zlog /klu yi byad gtad dgra la zlog /the'u rang 'byung po dgra la zlog /bdud kyi gshed bzhi dgra la zlog /ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa gcig zlog /ye 'drog sum brgya drug cu zlog /byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga zlog /g.yas nas pho brgya'i mda' zor zlog /g.yon nas mo brgya'i dug g.yos zlog /ngag mnan gtad khram rlung 'khor zlog /rmis ltas mtshan ma ngan pa zlog /lo keg zla skag zhag skag zlog /mi mthun phyogs rnams dgra la zlog /zlogs shig sgyur cig mthu ma chung*/ /dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams dang*/ /btsan rgod dmag tshogs rtsal ma zhan/ /mchod rdzas gtor ma chud ma gsan/ /sngags 'chang rnal 'byor yi ma gcod/ /sdang ba'i dgra la rtag phyungs shig /gnod pa'i bgegs la las mdzod cig /mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las mdzod/ mchod gtor phul zhing phrin las bcol ba ni/ /thun gtor liṅga brgyan pa bsham/ na mo/ dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa ba gsum/ /dam can rgya mtsho'i bden pa'i mthus/ /bstan dgra sgos dgra ma lus pa/ /dmar gyi gtor ma 'di la khug dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas bstim/ oṃ shu la tri sa pa ri wā ra -i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum gyis phul/ dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma rgya chen po 'di btsan rgod srog gzan har len chen po rol pa bcu bdun sprul pa yang sprul dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyis tshim zhing dgyes par bzhes la/

sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ dge 'dun dang chos kyi rgyal srid skyongs/ 'jig rten gyi phan bde spel/ rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi sdong grogs mdzod/ sngags 'chang rnams kyi phrin las sgrubs/ sdang ba'i dgra thul/ gnod pa'i bgegs choms/ khyad par bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa la phun tshogs 'dod rgu tshe g.yang mnga' thang longs spyod dar zhing rgyas par mdzod cig /gzhan yang gzhi byes lam gsum thams cad du mdun gyi 'khar ba/ rgyab kyi slog pa/ nyin gyi bya ra/ mtshan gyi mel tshe/ mthun pa'i rkyen/ mdza' ba'i grogs/ sra ba'i go /rno ba'i mtshon ltar/ yon mchod kyi mthu dpung rgyab rten srung skyob mdzod cig khyad par rnal 'byor pa yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa la/ snga dgra yid la bsam zhing*/ da dgra thad du langs shing*/ /bsam ngan sbyor rtsub 'chang ba/ sngags kyi byad phur 'debs pa/ mnan gtad sbyin sreg byed pa/ phra men rlung 'khor bskor ba/ mthu bu lon bzhin du snyog pa/ rkun sna dang jag sna ston pa dam nyams dgra bo las ngan gyi/ rang gshed rang la phob cig /rang mthu rang la zug cig /lha srung bdud du phob cig /gnam gyi 'ju thag chod cig /sa yi rten phur phud cig /srog rtsa dmar po chod cig /snying khrag thang la phos shig /don snying zhal du gsol cig /rnam shes dbyings su spor cig /gzhan yang snang srid lha 'dre'i byad kha rbod gtong 'phrul 'khor rgyan kha g.yos pa/ sde brgyad kyi kha rlangs gdug rtsub dus min 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa sogs/ glo bur rkyen ngan mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zlogs shig /mdor na chos dang mthun pa'i bsam sbyor ma lus pa 'bad med lhun gyis 'grub par mdzod cig /rgyal khams thams cad du mi nad phyugs nad mi 'byung zhing lo phyugs rtag tu legs shing bskal pa rdzogs ldan gyi dpal lta bu longs spyod pa'i sdong grogs mdzod cig

/mthun pa'i dam rdzas nged kyis 'bul lo/ /bcol ba'i phrin las khyed kyis mdzod cig /phug pa zhwa ltar gyon nas khyod bsgrub bo/ /lus srog 'ben du btsugs nas bsnyen no/ /dam rdzas sman raka gtor mas mchod do/ lha sngags ye shes rol pas bsten no/ /drag sngags me dpung 'bar bas rbad do/ /dri zhim bdud rtsi dud pas bsang ngo*/ /dkor cha spyan gzigs du mas brngan no/ /gser skyems phud sna du mas gsol lo/ /yon tan yid bzhin nor ltar bstod do/ de ltar sngon gyi rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i bka' ma bcag /da lta rnal 'byor bdag gis dam las ma 'da' bar yid la re ba'i 'bras bu myur du mchis pa'i phrin las mdzod cig /gtor ma btegs la phrin las bcol ba ni/ hūm̐/ dbang drag btsan gyi ging chen gyi/ /btsan khrom stong sde'i tshogs dang bcas/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa dang*/ /'dod yon mthun rdzas ba ling+ta/ /sngar mdzad las kyi gtang rag gtong*/ /phyi ma las kyi zhu rten 'bul/ /da bcol phrin las bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /dgyes pa chen po bzhes nas kyang*/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa khyod kyis srungs/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi dbu 'phang bstod/ /bla ma'i sku dgra khyod kyis thul/ /rnal 'byor sgos dgra da lta sgrol/ /dkor dang rten mchod bu slob skyongs/ /gdon bgegs bar chad 'jigs brgyad zhi/ /tshe bsod dpal 'byor yon tan rgyas/ /rlung sems snang ba dbang du sdus/ /dam nyams byad ma drag po choms/ /snyan pa'i ba dan srid rtser sgrengs/ /grags pa'i dung chen phyogs bcur sgrogs/ /gdul bya 'gro don phrin las spel/ /rdo rje 'chang gi bstan pa 'di/ /'khor ba ma stongs bar du gnas/ /chos 'khor gnyan po 'di dag ni/ /mthu chen khyod la gnyer du gtad/ /dar rgyas spel ba'i phrin las mdzod/ /bstan snub gsod pa'i shan pa mdzod/ /skad cig tsam yang ma g.yel bar/ /bkra shis bde legs 'od po ches/

/sa gsum khyab pa'i phrin las mdzod/ gtor ma mchod pa gtsang sar bskyal/ bskul zur du gsal/ ༈ dag snang 'ba' zhig tu shar ba'i sprul pa'i chos rgyal dpe ha ra'i gsol kha bzhugs so// // ma hā pad+ma kā ra bhan+dza ma li ta sid+dhi satwaṃ/ rig 'dzin rgyal mchog pad+ma kā ra'i zhabs la 'dud/ de yang rgyal po ging ka ra'i gsol mchod brtsam pa ni/ snod gtsang du ri rab bang rim gsum gyi kha ru mkhar thab bzhag /de'i phyogs bzhir mar me'i rgyal mtshan bzhi/ zur bzhi la phyi ba gyen du phyogs pa bzhi/ mtshams bzhir spre'u rgyal mtshan bzhi/ de'i phyi rim bar ma la dpal bshos rtse zur bcu/ bang rim 'og ma la g.yas su gtor ma rtse gsum lnga/ rgyab tu rkang gzugs lnga/ g.yon tu 'brang rgyas lnga/ mdun du zhal zas lnga/ mtshams su sman bshos lnga/ phyi rol du sgal phreng bcas/ rtse mor rgyan mdzes dang*/ dar tshon sna tshogs bklubs/ mdun du mkho ba'i rdzas rigs/ bsang phye sman raka za 'og dum bu re dang bcas/ mchod pa 'bag btsog bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlabs nas/ rang nyid pad+ma thod phreng gi mngon rtogs gang rung zhig song nas dngos gzhi la 'jug pa ni/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ om̐ āḥhūm̐/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ om̐ badz+ra shrī he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭḥ hoḥ stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid bla ma drag po dran rdzogs su gsal ba'i mdun du/ rin po che sna tshogs kyi gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa mtshan nyid tshang ba dkor cha sna tshogs kyis gang ba'i dbus su yi ge ru yongs su gyur pa las bha ta chos kyi rgyal po gnod sbyin dpe har chen po sku mdog 'od du 'bar ba sku la dar dkar gyis lhab lhub dang bswe theb gsol ba phyag na 'khar bsil lhung bzed bsnams shing seṅge la bzhon pa/ de'i 'khor du dregs pa'i sde tshogs du ma dang bcas pa/ gzhan yang sku gsung thugs kyi sprul pa du ma dang bcas pa gsal ba'i gnas gsum dang*/ bdag nyid kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu ltar 'phros pas brag dmar dpal gyi bsam yas sam gar bzhugs kyi gtsug lag khang nas skad cig gis spyan drangs/

om̐ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ gnas bstan pa ni/ hūm̐/ sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po la/ /tshangs pa lha yi dge bsnyen che/ /bar du shākya'i bstan pa la/ /dge bsnyen li byin chen po zhes/ /phyis 'byung rig 'dzin pad+ma yi/ /dam gnas rgyal po dpe ha ra/ /sde brgyad sprul pa yang sprul bcas/ /gtsug lag chos 'khor gar gnas kyang*/ /gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /rang rang dgyes pa'i gdan la bzhugs/ /bstan pa srung ba'i gnyer 'dzin mdzod/ hūm̐/ tshangs pa shel ging dkar po la/ /sman gtor rak+ta bsang phye dang*/ /shel tshig khri dkar stong nag dang*/ /za 'og rdzas mchod du ma 'bul/ /longs spyod dkor cha'i dngos grub stsol/ /gsang sngags gnyan gyi mel tshe mdzod/ om̐ ging ka ra ya she la she la bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi/ hūm̐/ dge slong li byin chen po la/ /sman gtor rak+ta bsang phye dang*/ /shel tshig khri dkar stong nag dang*/ /za 'og rdzas mchod du ma 'bul/ /longs spyod dkor cha'i dngos grub stsol/ /gsang sngags gnyan gyi mel tshe mdzod/ om̐ ging ka ra ya she la she la bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi/ hūm̐/ bha ta'i dkor bdag dpe ha ra/ /sman gtor rak+ta bsang phye dang*/ /shel tshig khri dkar stong nag dang*/ /za 'og rdzas mchod du ma 'bul/ /longs spyod dkor cha'i dngos grub stsol/ /gsang sngags gnyan gyi mel tshe mdzod/ om̐ ging ka ra ya she la she la bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi/ hūm̐/ dpe dkar sku yi rgyal po la/ /sman gtor rak+ta bsang phye dang*/ /shel tshig khri dkar stong nag dang*/ /za 'og rdzas mchod du ma 'bul/ /longs spyod dkor cha'i dngos grub stsol/ /gsang sngags gnyan gyi mel tshe mdzod/ om̐ ging ka ra ya she la she la bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi/ hūm̐/ dpe dmar gsung gi rgyal po la/ /sman gtor rak+ta bsang phye dang*/ /shel tshig khri dkar stong nag dang*/ /za 'og rdzas mchod du ma 'bul/ /longs spyod dkor cha'i dngos grub stsol/ /gsang sngags gnyan gyi mel tshe mdzod/

om̐ ging ka ra ya she la she la bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi/ hūm̐/ dpe nag thugs kyi rgyal po la/ /sman gtor rak+ta bsang phye dang*/ /shel tshig khri dkar stong nag dang*/ /za 'og rdzas mchod du ma 'bul/ /longs spyod dkor cha'i dngos grub stsol/ /gsang sngags gnyan gyi mel tshe mdzod/ om̐ ging ka ra ya she la she la bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi/ hūm̐/ shing bya yon tan rgyal po la/ /sman gtor rak+ta bsang phye dang*/ /shel tshig khri dkar stong nag dang*/ /za 'og rdzas mchod du ma 'bul/ /longs spyod dkor cha'i dngos grub stsol/ /gsang sngags gnyan gyi mel tshe mdzod/ om̐ ging ka ra ya she la she la bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi/ hūm̐/ gnam lha phrin las rgyal po la/ /sman gtor rak+ta bsang phye dang*/ /shel tshig khri dkar stong nag dang*/ /za 'og rdzas mchod du ma 'bul/ /longs spyod dkor cha'i dngos grub stsol/ /gsang sngags gnyan gyi mel tshe mdzod/ om̐ ging ka ra ya she la she la bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi/ rgyun du 'di nas phrin bcol la 'jug pa las 'di man gsung srol mi 'dug hūm̐/ sprul pa byi thang ke ru l hūm̐/ yang sprul hor pa nor sdud l hūm̐/ dkor sdud bha dra rta sdud l hūm̐/ myur mgyogs sprel mgo zas sdud l hūm̐/ ru 'dren stag chas rgyal po l hūm̐/ ru 'dren nyan thos brgyad po l hūm̐/ ru 'dren bud med brgyad po l hūm̐/ ru 'dren skyo sangs mgon gnyen l hūm̐/ ru 'dren mon bu brgyad po l hūm̐/ spra sprel byi la mtshal bya l hūm̐/ 'brug ltar sgrogs pa'i rgyal po l hūm̐/ khyung ltar lding ba'i rgyal po l hūm̐/ seng ltar 'gying ba'i rgyal po l hūm̐/ stag ltar rngam pa'i rgyal po l hūm̐/ dom ltar gtum pa'i rgyal po l hūm̐/ dred ltar 'phyo ba'i rgyal po l hūm̐/ spyang ltar rgyug pa'i rgyal po l hūm̐/ bya ltar 'jums pa'i rgyal po l hūm̐/ me ltar 'bar ba'i rgyal po l hūm̐/ chu ltar khol ba'i rgyal po l

hūm̐/ rlung ltar 'tshubs pa'i rgyal po l hūm̐/ rbab ltar myur ba'i rgyal po l hūm̐/ mi snying bsgul ba'i rgyal po l hūm̐/ mi 'gram gcog pa'i rgyal po l hūm̐/ mi sems bslu ba'i rgyal po l hūm̐/ mi yid 'phrog pa'i rgyal po l hūm̐/ mi snying 'phrog pa'i rgyal po l hūm̐/ mi nor sdud pa'i rgyal po l hūm̐/ mi zad 'phrog pa'i rgyal po l hūm̐/ mi bcud 'dren pa'i rgyal po l hūm̐/ rang nor srung ba'i rgyal po l hūm̐/ ka cha gnyer ba'i rgyal po l hūm̐/ dkor nor btsan pa'i rgyal po l hūm̐/ phywa g.yang 'tshubs pa'i rgyal po l hūm̐/ bsod nams brtan pa'i rgyal po l hūm̐/ longs spyod 'phel ba'i rgyal po l hūm̐/ dbang thang che ba'i rgyal po l hūm̐/ kha rje che ba'i rgyal po l hūm̐/ gzugs byad legs pa'i rgyal po l hūm̐/ rgyan gos mdzes pa'i rgyal po l hūm̐/ bu rta hrag pa'i rgyal po l hūm̐/ 'dod rgu 'dzoms pa'i rgyal po l hūm̐/ gtsug lag skyong ba'i rgyal po l hūm̐/ sgrub la mgon pa'i rgyal po l hūm̐/ dam la gnas pa'i rgyal po l hūm̐/ bka' la brtsi ba'i rgyal po l hūm̐/ dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i rgyal po l hūm̐/ shing la gnas pa'i rgyal po l hūm̐/ rlung la gnas pa'i rgyal po l hūm̐/ chu la gnas pa'i rgyal po l hūm̐/ sa la gnas pa'i rgyal po l hūm̐/ mkhar la gnas pa'i rgyal po l hūm̐/ dkor mdzod la gnas rgyal po l hūm̐/ dben ri la gnas rgyal po l hūm̐/ sgrub la 'khor ba'i rgyal po l hūm̐/ rten la chags pa'i rgyal po l hūm̐/ phrin las sgrub pa'i rgyal po la/ /sman gtor rak+ta bsang phye dang*/ /shel tshig khri dkar stong nag dang*/ /za 'og rdzas mchod du ma 'bul/ /longs spyod dkor cha'i dngos grub stsol/ /gsang sngags gnyan gyi mel tshe mdzod/ om̐ ging ka ra ya she la she la bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi/ de nas gsol kha btegs la phrin las bcol ba ni/

hoḥ sprul pa'i chos rgyal chen po 'khor dang bcas pa la tha tshig phrin las su bcol ba ni/ sngon tshe rig 'dzin pad+ma thod phreng gis dpal bsam yas su dam la btags nas gtsug lag gi gnyer kha gtad de ging dpe ha ra zhes dpe dkar dkor gyi bdag por mtshan gsol nas/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa skyong ba zhal gyis bzhes pa bzhin du/ deng 'dir sngags 'chang bdag gis gsol mchod brtsams nas khyed la phrin las su bcol ba ni/ spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ dge 'dun gyi sde skyongs/ gsang sngags kyi dam chos spel/ rig 'dzin gyi phrin las sgrubs/ zab gter gyi rgya srungs/ gtsug lag dang ka cha dkor nor gyi gnyer kha 'tshos/ nyin gyi bya ra gyis/ mtshan gyi mel tshe gyis/ g.yang can gyi g.yang khug /phyug po'i nor dbang du sdus/ 'phan po'i mi nor dbang du sdus/ pha rol gyi glo snying bsgul la/ zas nor dbang du sdus shig /mi lag bsgul la ka cha thams cad 'phrog par gyis shig /longs spyod tshe dang bsod nams thams cad char bzhin du phob/ phyugs lug rta nor gyis sa gzhi gang bar gyis shig /zhing gi 'bru bcud lo thog thams cad phun sum tshogs par gyis shig /dkor mdzod rin po che sna tshogs kyis gang bar gyis shig /bang ba 'bru dang ka chas gang bar gyis shig /rgyan gos mdzes pa'i chas phun sum tshogs par gyis shig khyim mam brgyud 'dzin las can gyis gang bar gyis shig /nang bcud bsod nams kyi rgya phyi ru ma gtong zhig /phyi yul bdud dang 'gong po'i bar chad nang du ma gtong zhig /nang mi la 'khrug rtsod dang mi kha ma gtong zhig /god kha dang kha mchu ma gtong zhig /sde brgyad 'byung po'i za kha ston du ma 'jug cig /yul mi rnams kyis sdang sems 'dzin du ma 'jug cig khang khyim gyi sgo bzhi stong du ma 'jug cig /ja chang longs spyod kyi zas bcud nyams su ma 'jug cig

/dkar bzhon gyi srid nyams su ma 'jug cig /thab spyad ka cha la chag grum ma gtong zhig /gdab 'khrug dang rma ngo khrag ngo ma gtong zhig /dgra rkun jag gsum gyi kha khogs shig /nad mug mtshon gsum gyi dal kha dgra la zlogs shig /mtshon cha 'khrugs su ma 'jug cig /dgra bo kha mang gi kha chings shig /dgra bo mig mang gi mig sgribs shig /dgra bo lag mang gi lag chogs shig /dgra bo bsam ngan can gyi snying gtor cig /mi mthun pa thams cad dgra la phob cig /mthun rkyen 'dod don gyi bsam pa rang la sgrubs shig /bka' ma khrol ba'i bran g.yog bros su ma 'jug cig /lag ma byin pa'i ka cha phra mo tsam yang mi la ma bskur cig /phyi nang gsang ba'i phrin las thogs med du sgrubs shig khyad par sngon tshe bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' dang dam la gnas shing*/ bar du rig 'dzin pad+ma thod phreng rtsal gyis g.yar dam gnyan po zhal gyis bzhes pa bzhin du rlangs chen dpal gyi seṅge'i gdung brgyud skyong zhing*/ gnubs ston sangs rgyas ye shes kyi bstan pa spel te/ rig 'dzin rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtsho'i mdzad phrin rnams gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang*/ bdag cag rnal 'byor sgrub pa po'i bsam don yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i phrin las dam pa mdzod cig bskul 'og tu gsal/ ༈ las byed chen po tsi'u dmar po'i gsol mchod bzhugs so// // las byed chen po tsi'u dmar po la mchod bstod byed par 'dod na/ zangs sder nang du khrag chang gis sbrus pa'i gtor ma btsan bshos rang 'dra drug gis bskor ba la/ bya dmar bdun klad du lding ba/ khyi dmar bdun/ dgra ling khrag kong*/ sha dum phud mchod/ za 'og dmar po'i gdugs dang ru mtshon gyis brgyan pa/ rta dmar bya dmar glang dmar ra dmar sogs kyi sha khrag stag gzig dred mong snying khrag /spre'u 'ug pa gcan spyang 'phar ba'i gzugs dang sha khrag don snying cod pan dmar po spyan gzigs la thod dmar po/

ru mtshon zangs gri zangs mdung zangs kyi go khrab ber dmar/ beng btsan zhags dgra satwa mda' stong dmar bswe phub khrab sogs bshams nas/ gri sha gu gul thang khrom mi klad bdug /gri rkang dung chen bcas/ hūm̐: roṃ: phyogs phyogs de ni pha ki na/ /btsan yul zangs thang dmar po na/ /pad+ma dbang chen bka' nyan pa/ /che btsan rol pa skya bdun po/ /btsan 'khor khrom tshogs grangs med bcas/ /rnal 'byor sgrub pa'i gnas 'di ru/ /dam tshig dbang gis spyan 'dren na/ /skad cig gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ oṃ shu la tsa tri thun dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ roṃ/ me ltar g.yo ba dregs pa'i rje/ /shan pa srog gi bdag po khyed/ /sngon tshe rta mchog he ru kas/ /slob dpon pad+ma'i bka' bzhin du/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba'i slad/ /dgyes pa'i gnas 'dir bzhugs su gsol/ badz+ra sa ma ya satwaṃ/ phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hoḥ dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas kyi/ /bstan pa gnyan srung g.yar dam can/ /che btsan dpon g.yog 'khor bcas la/ /dam tshig dbang gis phyag 'tshal bstod/ na mo pū ru sha ya hoḥ mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: gnod sbyin tsi'u dmar 'khor bcas la/ /dgyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ /dus kyis rgyan bkod me tog tshal/ /stong gsum 'ja' ltar bkrag mdangs mtshar/ /spos dkar si la tsan+dan sogs/ /bdug pa spos sprin stong khams khyab/ /nyi zla nor bu zhu chen sogs/ /snang srid yongs la gsal ba'i 'od/ /gtsang mar sbyar ba'i yon chab ni/ /yan lag brgyad ldan dri ma 'khrud/ /lha yi zhal zas ro brgya ltar/ /zhal mngar bza' btung grangs med mang*/ /rkang gling dung chen rol mo'i sgras/ /chos skyong 'khor bcas gzi byin bskyed/ /sra ba'i go dang rno ba'i mtshon/ /dpa' zhing rtul phod srid med bu/ /rgyal ba'i ngar skad 'brug ltar sgrogs/ /seṅge stag gzig rma bya dang*/ khyung 'brug spre'u'i rgyal mtshan sogs/ /dom dred 'phar spyang gcan gzan sogs/

/'jigs pa'i nga ro mche sder bgrad/ /gdugs 'phan rgyal mtshan ru mtshon thug /g.yang gzhi 'phan dar phya ra ra/ /gser dngul rin chen dar zab gos/ /'bru sna sman sna shing thog rigs/ /dkor mdzod bang mdzod grangs med pa/ /snang srid yongs la khyab par spungs/ /bzhed pa'i rma bya ngang ngur dang*/ khrung khrung ne tso la sogs pa/ /gnam la 'phur dgus khams gsum khyab/ /seṅge glang chen khyung 'brug dang*/ /rta drel bong bu g.yag lug ra/ /ri dwags g.yung dwags ma tshang med/ /bkra shis rtags brgyad rgyal srid bdun/ /'dod 'jo ba dang dpag bsam shing*/ /ma rmos lo tog yid bzhin nor/ /dngos su 'byor dang yid kyi sprul/ /gar 'cham spyan gzigs sna tshogs kyis/ /chos skyong 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ hūm̐/ 'bru sna kun las grub pa'i chang*/ /gtsang mar sbyar ba'i gser skyems 'di/ /lha yi bdud rtsi ro bcud ldan/ /myos pa'i dam rdzas skyems su bzhes/ /rak+ta khrag gi yon chab 'di/ /dmar ser lbu ba gur du 'khrigs/ khrag gi 'od zer 'bar ba 'di/ /byad ma'i snying khrag bsgyur te 'bul/ /bdag la gnod pa'i dgra bgegs rnams/ /bsad pa'i khrag chen don snying sogs/ /sha sna khrag sna sman spos sbyor/ /sgog gtsong la phug la sogs pa/ /chos skyong 'khor bcas mnyes par 'bul/ hūm̐/ phye mar 'o skol ja chang phud/ /'bru sna shel tshig bsang gsur gyis/ /bstan srung 'khor bcas dgyes par bsangs/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya yi/ /'dod pa'i yon tan ma tshang med/ /chos skyong sku gsung thugs rnams tshims/ /rtag tu dgyes par longs spyod cing*/ /stong gsum khyon ltar yangs pa bhan+dha'i snod/ /zangs lcags snod du bshams pa'i gtor ma ni/ /btsan bshos sha khrag dmar gyis rab brgyan te/ /srog chags gzugs 'gros dgra bgegs bam gzugs dang*/ khrag kong mtheb skyu gtor ma gdugs kyis brgyan/ /lha sngags phyag rgyas sbyangs gtor 'dod rgu spel/

/ro brgya phun sum tshogs pa'i gtor ma ni/ /gnod sbyin chen po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /snga bcol las rnams 'grub pa'i gtang rag gtong*/ /da bcol las rnams 'grub pa'i mnyes zas 'bul/ /phrin las gang bcol thogs med las sgrubs shig /i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi/ dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa la kha kha khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta l ma hā tsit+t ma hā go ro? ma hā keṃ ni ri ti l bstod pa ni/ hūm̐: dzaḥ rgyal ba kun gyi chos sku pad+ma'i gsung*/ /chos rje 'od dpag med pa rdo rje'i chos/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang hrī las rngam chen tshul/ /rta mgrin rta skad 'tsher la phyag 'tshal bstod/ hūm̐: rgya mtshor sku 'khrungs 'chi med rdo rje'i sku/ /snang srid zil gnon dregs pa bran du khol/ /bdud bzhi tshar gcod sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ /pad+ma 'byung gnas sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /pad+ma 'byung gnas gsung l pad+ma 'byung gnas thugs l kyai/ dbang chen bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i klong*/ /bka' nyan shan pa srog bdag mthu bo che/ /dregs byed yang rje btsan rgod myur mgyogs can/ /che btsan rol pa skya bdun 'khor dang bcas/ /gsang sngags bstan pa rin chen srung ma che/ /ma rungs dgra bo'i srog gcod shan pa ni/ /gnod sbyin tsi'u dmar po dbang gi sku/ /gdug rtsub rno myur gnam lcags thog las che/ /gzi brjid 'od kyis byad ma'i mi nor sreg khro gtum ngar skad sde brgyad dbang du sdud/ /gnam sa g.yo ba'i 'dre dmag bsam mi khyab/ /cha lugs rnam pa gcig tu ma nges kyang*/ /sku mdog dmar nag mi sdug drag po'i gzugs/ /bswe rmog bswe khrab bswe phub me stag 'phros/ /mdung dmar zhags 'dzin dgra bo'i srog rtsa gcod/ /zangs gri mda' gzhu stag ral gzig shubs 'chang*/ /bra bo g.yu rngog myur mgyogs gang bsam rgyug /me dud rlung nag bu yug 'tshub ma 'khyil/ /sdang mig me 'od shangs nas zangs rlung 'tshub/

/zangs kyi mche sder lan staṃ rak+ta 'bab/ /sangs rgyas bstan srung 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ bskul 'og tu gsal/ rgyal gsol bsdus pa/ hūm̐/ sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba'i mthu rtsal can/ /chos rgyal sku lnga tsi'u dmar yum blon 'khor/ /sprul pa yang sprul pho nya'i tshogs dang bcas/ /'dir gshegs dam rdzas gser skyems mchod gtor bzhes/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas la/ /gnod 'tshe 'gal rkyen spongs la mthun rkyen sgrubs/ /ji ltar bsam don ma lus 'grub par mdzod/ chos skyong gnod sbyin chen po las byed tsi'u dmar po la bskang ba byed par 'dod pas rol mo bcas sha chen gsur btang gri rkang bus nas dar nag g.yab ru mtshon phyar/ hūm̐/ chos skyong chen po sprul pa'i dam tshig can/ /las byed chen po gtsug lag dkor nor srung*/ /sangs rgyan bstan pa'i bya ra mel tshe mkhan/ /phrin las kun khyab rdo rje drag po rtsal/ /slob dpon pad+ma'i bka' nyan gdug pa 'dul/ /rol pa skya bdun 'khor g.yog bcas pa rnams/ /'dir byon dkor skyong mnga' gsol gnas 'dir bzhugs/ /log 'dren tshar gcod tsi'u dmar thugs dam bskang*/ /btsan rgod chen po bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni/ /rnal 'byor mi zad gter la mnga' brnyes phyir/ /mchod pa'i gtor ma 'dod yon phun sum tshogs/ /sha khrag bza' btung rgya mtshos thugs dam bskang*/ /bdud rtsi gser skyems dza gad btung ba dang*/ /dpa' bo dgyes pa'i rak+ta khrag mtsho 'khyil/ /dgra bgegs klad rus rkang mar sla ba dang*/ /chu ser zhag dang nang rol don snying gis/ /btsan rgod 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs dam bskang*/ sku yi dam rdzas gnyan po yin pa'i phyir/ /sku 'bag ras bris rten rdzas thugs dam bskang*/ /gsung gi dam rdzas gnyan po yin pa'i phyir/ /rkang gling dung chen rol mos thugs dam bskang*/ /thugs kyi dam rdzas gnyan po yin pa'i phyir/ /bla rdo srog 'khor sa bon thugs dam bskang*/

/yon tan rten rdzas gnyan po yin pa'i phyir/ /bkra shis rgyal srid yo byad thugs dam bskang*/ /phrin las rten rdzas gnyan po yin pa'i phyir/ /phyags dar g.yab dar ru mtshon thugs dam bskang*/ /'bod pa'i dam rdzas gnyan po yin pa'i phyir/ /gri rkang g.yab dar rol mos thugs dam bskang*/ /rtag tu mi 'bral dkor skyong mdzad pa'i phyir/ /mthun rdzas rten pa'i rdzas kyis thugs dam bskang*/ /rnal 'byor bdag la dam tshig bsre ba'i phyir/ /bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pas thugs dam bskang*/ /sgrub la mi shigs srung skyob mdzad pa'i phyir/ /sra brtan go khrab brjid pas thugs dam bskang*/ /pha rol dgra bo cham la 'bebs pa'i phyir/ /gri mdung mtshon cha rno bas thugs dam bskang*/ /zhing bcu dgra bo dbang med 'gugs pa'i phyir/ /btsan zhags glog ltar 'gyu bas thugs dam bskang*/ /byad ma dgra 'dul thal bar brlag pa'i phyir/ /shan pa'i dmag tshogs 'bum gyis thugs dam bskang*/ /bsam pas stong gsum yud kyis bskor ba'i phyir/ /cang shes bra bo g.yu rngog thugs dam bskang*/ /pha rol dgra las rnam par rgyal ba'i phyir/ /ru mtshon rgyal mtshan bsgrengs pas thugs dam bskang*/ /ma rungs dgra bo rtsis la gdab pa'i phyir/ /zangs kyi rde'u rtsis shom thugs dam bskang*/ /ma rungs dgra bo'i snying la 'dzer ba'i phyir/ /nyag phran stong dmar mda' gzhus thugs dam bskang*/ /yang sprul pho nya las la 'gyed pa'i phyir/ /'dre dmar bye ba 'bum gyis thugs dam bskang*/ bcol ba'i las rnams thogs med bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /mchod gtor gtsang sbyar gser skyems thugs dam bskang*/ /rtag tu bdag gis phrin las bcol ba'i phyir/ /rgyun gtor sha khrag mchod pas thugs dam bskang*/ /gang bcol las rnams ma lus bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /bka' drin gtang rag mchod pas thugs dam bskang*/ gnod sbyin dgra bgegs klad la 'jums pa'i phyir/ /bya dmar klad la 'jums pas thugs dam bskang*/

/dgra bgegs bla 'khyams ma lus 'gyu ba'i phyir/ /stag gzig 'phar spyang khyi dmar thugs dam bskang*/ /dpa' bo khyod kyi dgyes pa bskyed pa'i phyir/ /sha sna snying sna khrag snas thugs dam bskang*/ /mchod pa'i rdzas rnams mang po spel ba'i phyir/ /ting 'dzin lha sngags phyag rgyas thugs dam bskang*/ /rten rdzas mkho dgu dkor chas thugs dam bskang*/ /'jig rten srid pa'i nor gyis thugs dam bskang*/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg byas thugs dam bskang*/ /srog chags gzugs 'gros sna tshogs thugs dam bskang*/ /gar lang a tsar mtshams kyis thugs dam bskang*/ /sngags chas sog chas rgyan chas thugs dam bskang*/ /mon chas stag chas go khrab thugs dam bskang*/ /mo btsun sman dang bdud mos thugs dam bskang*/ /stong gsum skye 'gro'i srog chags thugs dam bskang*/ /mnan sreg 'phang gsum las kyis thugs dam bskang*/ /g.yag lug ra gsum phyugs kyis thugs dam bskang*/ /dkor nor yo byad 'dod yon rdzas kyis bskang*/ /de ltar phyi rten nang rten gsang ba'i rten/ /yon tan phrin las skong rdzas sgrub pa'i rten/ /ma tshang med pa dngos 'byor yid kyi sprul/ /snang srid gling gzhi 'jig rten bsam mi khyab/ /thugs la dgyes pa'i longs spyod ci yod kyis/ /gnod sbyin chen po 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang*/ /las mkhan chen po 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang*/ /btsan rgod rol pa skya bdun thugs dam bskang*/ /sprul pa yang sprul rnams kyi thugs dam bskang*/ /thugs dam bskang ngo nyams 'gal mthol zhing bshags/ /bzod par bzhes shig chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs/ /g.yar dam bskangs la rkyen ngan bar chad zlog /bor sgo re chag na tsha ma btang zhig /bdag cag bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa yi/ /gang bcol las rnams bcol ba'i phrin las sgrubs/ /gnod byed bsam sbyor ngan pa'i dgra bo rnams/ /thal ba rdul phran bzhin du brlag par gyis/ /rnal 'byor bdag gis bcol ba'i 'dod don rnams/

/yid bzhin nor bu lta bur 'grub par mdzod/ ces rol mo dang phrin las bcol bar bya'o/ sa ma ya/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ jo bo gze rgyal gyi gsol kha spu gri dmar po bzhugs so: gu ru pad+ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: pad+ma'i gsal bkod legs bris mchod bstod bstan: bkra shis byin chags yid 'ong dkyil 'khor dbus: mchod pa'i rigs sogs gzhung bzhin bshams byas te: dbus su dpal gtor zlum po dmar gyis brgyan: sde brgyad 'khor dang mtheb skyus bskor bar bya: de nas dkar gtor gtsang ma gnyis byas la: mdun rgyab gnyis su 'bul zhing phrin las bcol: dkyil 'khor bsang sbyangs skad cig dran rdzogs su: hūm̐: bdag nyid drag po kī la'i thugs ka nas: 'od 'phros lha btsan 'khor bcas spyan drangs gyur: om̐ dhe wa tsa tri shu la siṃ ha mu kha a ya ma du ru tsa sha na badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥdza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: ma bcos lhun grub drag po'i gzhal yas nas: dge bsnyen rdo rje bdud 'dul gze rgyal zhes: yum chen drag mo ḍāk+ki seng gdong ma: lha srin sde brgyad yang 'khor dmag tshogs rnams: pho brang dur khrod gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ hūm̐: klong yangs pad+ma 'bar ba'i gdan khri la: mi g.yo brtse bas dgongs te bzhugs su gsol: badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: hūm̐: gdod nas rnam dag sku lnga'i rang bzhin la: mi dmigs blo 'das chen por phyag 'tshal bstod: a ti pu hoḥ pra tīts+tsha hoḥ hūm̐: rgyud drug bsgral ba'i sha khrag gtor tshogs 'bul: om̐ dhe wa tsa tri shu la siṃ ha mu kha a ya ma du ru tsa sha na dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na ba su ta la kha kha khā hi: hūm̐: lha yi dge bsnyen zhing skyong rgyal po'i tshul: lha btsan rdo rje 'bar ba bdud 'dul ni: sku mdog dkar gsal mdangs ldan zhi ma khro: sku la shel khrab dbu la shel rmog gsol: phyag g.yas mdung dar dkar po mkha' la phyar:

g.yon pas lcags kyus khams gsum dbang du bsdus: rdzu 'phrul shugs 'chang rag pa rting dkar chibs: lha dmag sdud cing pha rol rgol ba 'joms: rdo rje bdud 'dul sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: bh+yo: de yi yum chen ḍāk+ki seng gdong ma: sku mdog dmar nag drag mo khros pa'i gzugs: phyag g.yas rtse gsum ma rungs gdug pa 'dul: g.yon pas bhan+dha sgrub mchog dngos grub gter: ral pa dmar nag bar snang sprin bzhin g.yo: chibs su rdzu 'phrul bar snang glog la chibs: mkha' 'gro'i dmag tshogs lam gyi bar chad sel: g.yul las rnam rgyal ḍāk+ki dpal 'bar ma: drag mo seng gdong sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: sprul pa sde brgyad gri thogs shan pa'i tshogs: rang rtags phyag mtshan log lta tshar gcod tshul: chibs su rdzu 'phrul mgyogs pa rlung gshog chibs: sha za khrag 'thung rngam pa'i nga ro sgrogs: sgrub mchog skyong zhing bstan dgra'i srog dbugs bsdus: log lta tshar gcod sde brgyad tshogs la bstod: de nas bskul ba'i tshul gyis: hūm̐: bskul lo dge bsnyen rgyal po las la bskul: mdzod cig ḍāk+ki seng gdong phrin las mdzod: rbad do dregs pa sde brgyad dgra la rbad: chos so yul lha gzhi bdag dmag la chos: byad kha rbod gtong bsam ngan 'chang ba yi: pha rol bsam sbyor ngan pa'i dgra bo 'di: lo zla zhag dus za mar ma bzhag la: srog gcod dbugs longs sha khrag don snying rol: sngon tshe slob dpon pad+ma'i bka' ma bcag: da lta sngags 'chang bdag gi dam ma bkral: mchod bstod gtor ma 'bul ba chud ma zos: yid la brnag pa'i dgra bo sgrol la shog: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: om̐ dhe wa tsa tri shu la siṃ ha mu kha a ya ma du ru tsa sha na mā ra ya dgra bo'i sha khrag rus pa la kha kha khā hi: dmod bcol bya zhing drag sngags bzlas la thal mo brdab: gtor ma dgra phyogs su 'phang bar bya'o: drag sngags mi 'gyur ā thaṃ rgya:

hūm̐ ka ra artsig gis jo bo gze rgyal gangs khrod nas gdan drangs rjes shog ser las bsgyur ba'o: jo bo gze rgyal gsol mchod bdud rtsi sprin phung bzhugs so/ kyaiḥ 'dzam gling byang skyong dpal ldan he ru kaḥ yid kyi phrin las gar khyab sku lnga po: dge bsnyen gze 'od rgyal po 'khor dang bcas: dad pas spyan 'dren gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: mdun du rin chen pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs: me tog bdug spos snang gsal dri chab dang : zhal zas rol mo ma lus rab tu bshams: phye mar dkar mngar sbrang rtsi shing thog 'bras: dza gad gtor ma sha khrag dar mtshon dang : khrab rmog spyan gzigs sna tshogs rab tu spungs: gze rgyal dge bsnyen mched lngas dgyes par bzhes: gze rgyal mnga' gsol yid bzhin dbang lhun bzhugs so/ kyai/ 'dzam gling bod yul mnga' bdag 'dod khams rgyal/ /gang 'dul bstan srid 'gro 'di'i rgyal mtshan che/ /dge legs ya mtshan las grub gze rgyal zhes/ /bkra shis rma g.yang phyugs gter rgyas pa yi/ /las bzhi'i phrin las bsgrub par dbang bskur zhing*/ /zab gsang ring lugs spel ba'i phrin las che/ /gsang sngags zab chos lde mig skyong ba'i gnyan/ /rgyal ba'i yon tan kun ldan gnas kyi mchog /rin chen shel gyi ri bo lhun mthug la/ /rta bdun stong gi gzi 'od 'bar ba'i gzugs/ /rigs gsum sprul pa'i zlos gar rdo rje mched/ /'dir gshegs mchod sgrub slad du spyan 'dren gshegs/ /bkod legs rang 'os gdan bzhugs gus pas bstod/ /dngos 'byor yid sprul snang srid khyon 'gengs pa'i/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod rdzas bye brag kun/ /bkra shis rtags brgyad rgyal srid rin chen bdun/ /mkha' lding khyung dang seṅge g.yu 'brug stong*/ /rin chen rigs gyur 'bru sna dar zab tshogs/ khrab rmog go mtshon bla rdo rten mdos dkar/ /nyag phran dar gyis mgul rgyan dngul dkar gyi/

/me long 'brang rgyas dkar po rba dkar dang*/ /bal ldan snying dang rin chen khu ba yi/ /bris pa'i srog yig rol mo bye brag bcas/ /gzhan yang chos ber phod kha mchod cha'i rigs/ /rta glang dril mdzo g.yag lug za le 'bri/ /stong gsum phyur ba'i g.yung dwags rnam pa kun/ /bya gcan ri dwags chu gnas ma lus pa/ khyed la rtag tu mnga' gsol rten du 'bul/ /'das dang ma byon rgyal kun bstan bskyang phyir/ /lha mchog sku gsung thugs kyi sprul pa las/ /rigs gsum rdo rje mched du mnga' gsol lo/ /chos sku'i mnga' gsol skye med cho rol las/ /longs sku'i mnga' gsol zhi rgyas dbang drag gzugs/ /sprul sku mnga' gsol gang 'dul cir yang ston/ /de bzhin rnal 'byor bdag gis mnga' gsol lo/ /bla ma'i mnga' gsol rigs kun bdag nyid 'chang*/ /yi dam mnga' gsol dregs sde mthu dpung ldan/ /mkha' 'gro'i mnga' gsol rdzu 'phrul myur shugs stobs/ /chos skyong mnga' gsol pha rol g.yul las rgyal/ /de bzhin rnal 'byor bdag gis mnga' gsol lo/ /dzam lha'i mnga' gsol dgos 'dod gter kha rdol/ /dregs sde'i mnga' gsol sde brgyad bran du khol/ /yul lha'i mnga' gsol yul gru dgon sde skyongs/ /gter bdag mnga' gsol dkar po'i dge tshogs sgrubs/ /dgra lha'i mnga' gsol byad ma bstan yul rlog /dam tshig mnga' gsol lus dang grib bzhin 'grog /de bzhin rnal 'byor bdag gis mnga' gsol lo/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas par mnga' gsol lo/ /dkon mchog dbu 'phang bstod par? /dge 'dun sde dgon skyong bar? /gang bsam thogs med 'grub par? /yul gru bde legs 'grub par? /nad gdon rkyen ngan zhi bar? /tshe bsod dpal 'byor rgyas par? /snang srid dbang du 'du bar? /dgra gdon drag tu bsgral bar? /mnga' gsol 'di bzhes bdag cag bsam rgu sgrubs/ /mi 'dod nyer 'tshe'i g.yul las rgyal gyur nas/ /bcol ba'i phrin las 'bad med lhun 'grub shog

/ces pa'ang gnas kyi nyer gnas pa ār+ya dh+wa dzas byang chen mer gzhung mtsho dmar kha la sbyar ba'o// // ༈ gze rgyal bskang ba lha'i btsan rgod rdo rje 'bar ba'i bskang ba phrin las kun 'grub bzhugs so// // na mo pad+ma kā ra ye/ de yang lha btsan rdo rje 'bar ba'i bskang ba bya bar 'dod na/ gang de'i bskang gtor ri rab gru bzhi pa'i steng du 'khor dkar gtor brgya/ gzhan yang skong rdzas gzugs 'gros sna tshogs kyis bskor te/ nyer spyod mthun rdzas bkod legs tshang bar bshams te 'di skad do/ hūm̐/ phyi snod snang srid yangs pa'i gzhal yas su/ /nang bcud stong gsum khams kyi longs spyod rdzas/ /skye 'gro srid 'dir gnas la bkod pa'i khyon/ /phyi mchod pañtsa nang mchod sman raka gtor/ /gsang mchod sbyor sgrol ga ṇa tsakra sogs/ /mkha' lding bya dang chu gnas klu yi nor/ /bkra shis rtags brgyad rgyal srid nor bu'i rigs/ /gzhan yang ri dwags gcan spyang sder chags rigs/ /g.yag lug ra dang rta drel mdzo glang 'bri/ /g.yung dwags dpung 'khrigs ja chang zhim mngar bcud/ /gnam rgyan sa rgyan dar zab yol ba dang*/ /go mtshon mtshon cha 'bru sman spyan gzigs bcas/ /lha btsan chen po mthun pa'i yo byad rdzas/ /rta mchog rag pa rta dmar dar phod dkar/ /shel gyi khrab rmog dar mdung lcags kyu bcas/ /dgra bo byur sdig sha khrag dbang po lnga/ /sde brgyad zas skal rang 'os spyan gzigs dang*/ /ma tshang med pa mnyes mchod mthun pa'i rdzas/ /lha sngags ting 'dzin phyag rgyas spel ba 'dis/ /lha btsan rdo rje 'bar ba'i thugs dam bskang*/ /yum chen si na ra ma'i thugs dam bskang*/ /sprul pa bam ro pho mo'i thugs dam bskang*/ /yang sprul sde brgyad dregs pa'i thugs dam bskang*/ /rin chen ri bo mchog rab dpag bsam shing*/ /shar phyogs shel la lho phyogs bai ḍūr+ya/ /nub phyogs pad+ma rā ga byang phyogs gser/ /rtse mor rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang bcas/

/gser gyi ri bdun rol pa'i mtsho chen bdun/ /gling bzhi gling phran lcags ri mu khyud bcas/ /rgyal chen sde rigs mnga' 'bangs srid sde'i khyon/ /gnam dang sa gzhi bar snang la 'khod pa'i/ /lha klu mi dang khams gsum srid pa'i khyon/ /skye 'gro ma lus stong gsum yongs 'gengs pa'i/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag sna tshogs mchod pa'i sprin/ /mi mjed dag zhing 'dir mkho bskang rdzas kyis/ /lha btsan rdo rje 'bar ba'i thugs dam bskang*/ /yum chen si na ra ma'i thugs dam bskang*/ /sprul pa bam ro pho mo'i thugs dam bskang*/ /yang sprul sde brgyad dregs pa'i thugs dam bskang*/ /mched gsum rgyal ba'i bka' 'gal zhing bcu dgra/ /dge bcu la byol nag phyogs gdug sems can/ /dben ri dkrug cing rngon rgya dkrol ba yi/ /nyams pa bdud dgra'i tshe bsod phung khams bcas/ /pha tshan mthun grogs 'og rta bran 'khor bcas/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi sgos dgra zas skal gyis/ /lha btsan rdo rje 'bar ba'i thugs dam bskang*/ /yum chen si na ra ma'i thugs dam bskang*/ /sprul pa bam ro pho mo'i thugs dam bskang*/ /yang sprul sde brgyad dregs pa'i thugs dam bskang*/ /de ltar bskang zhing sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor gyi/ /lha sngags phyag rgya ting 'dzin g.yel ba dang*/ /mi dge log lta phog thug nyams 'gal bshags/ /dge bas dgra lha chen pos rtag tu skyongs/ /bzang dgu spel ba gang 'dod yid bzhin sgrubs/ /'di phyi bde skyid dpal yon phun tshogs shog /ces pa 'di bzhin dgos pa gang zhe na/ bla ma dam pa ngag dbang grags pa zhes lung rtogs rig pa'i dpal dang yon tan gyis phyug pa gang de'i gsung gis yang yang du bskul ba'i zhal ngo ma ldog tsam du lcags lug lor zla9pa'i tshes la gang dran 'phral du rgyal ming gis bris pa dgra lha chen pos dge ba'i grogs mdzod cig/ // ༈ pad+ma rgyal po las: nor skyong klu mo'i gtor 'bul gsol mchod bzhugs so:

dbang sdud pad+ma rgyal po rtsal la 'dud: nor skyong klu mo'i gtor 'bul ni: bswe phor zangs snod gang rung du: bshos bu sngon po sbrul dkris can: mtheb skyu bzhi yis bskor bar bya: dkar gsum bya zhing byin brlabs nas: mchod bstod rim pa 'di ltar ro: hūm̐: yid 'ong rgya mtsho rab 'khyil mer ba'i dbus: dgos 'dod mchod sbyin klu mo nor skyong ma: dngos grub bdag mo mched bzhi skur bzhengs la: thogs med dkyil 'khor skyong phyir gshegs su gsol: oṃ nā ga ni dha ra mu tra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ hūm̐: mchog gsum bdud rtsi pañtsa a mṛ ta: klu bshos 'dod yon zag med tshogs mchod 'di: nor skyong klu mo 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: bzhes nas gter dang klu g.yang dngos grub stsol: oṃ nā ga ni dha ra ma ṇi mu tra sa ma ya ma hā bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: bstod bskul gtor ma 'bul bsdu ni: hūm̐: rol mtsho gling dgu'i bcud kyi mnga' bdag mo: zab gter gnyan gyi bka' srung mthu mo che: 'khor dang sprul pa klu mo 'bum dang bcas: thugs dam rgyud bskul mchog la rab tu bstod: 'dir gshegs brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: sngon tshe slob dpon pad+ma'i bka' bzhin du: sangs rgyas bstan srung brgyud 'dzin bu bzhin skyongs: 'dzam gling stong gsum klu g.yang srid bsdus la: skal ldan sgrub pa'i las bzhi smin par mdzod: zab chos gsang ba'i grogs po 'khor bcas tshogs: sngags 'chang bdag la grib bzhin 'grogs pa dang : phrin las thogs med lhun gyis 'grub gyur cig: ces rtsa sngags btags la 'bul: e ma hoḥ dgos 'dod kun 'byung klu mo bcud 'dzin gyi: zab pa'i gsol mchod las rim sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: zhes pa 'di yang karma las 'brel rtsal gyis shog ser nas dag par phab pa'o// // gnod sbyin dzam lha dbang sdud dmar po'i gter srung gnas po dge bsnyen gyi gtor 'bul bzhugs so:

hūm̐: pad+ma'i bka' nyan mthu stobs dbang phyug rgyal: dregs pa yongs rdzogs rdo rje bdud 'dul zhes: klu btsan gzi 'bar dge bsnyen thogs med rtsal: khro tshogs sprul pa'i 'jigs rung rol rtsal shugs: srog la dbang byed nā ga klu bdud che: sku mdog dmar nag dbu dgu srid rtser bslebs: phyag drug 'jigs pa'i mtshon cha chas drug ni: spu gri 'khor los ma rungs log lta sgrol: chu gri ral gris nyams pa'i srog dbugs sdud: sbrul zhags sdig rgod sangs rgyas bstan pa srung : dbu skra dmar ser bar snang mkha' la bskyod: zhal bgrad mche gtsigs srid gsum bsngangs shing brgyal: dur khrod chas rdzogs yan lag mig gis brgyan: chu gri'i 'dab gshog sa gzhi brdar sha gcod: lte bar khro zhal klu gnyan zas su za: sbyor yum chu srin gdong can gnyis med 'khril: dug sbrul mjug 'phyangs bdud rta rlung gshog bcibs: gong smed sbrul rigs sdom sdig sbal lcong 'phro: me rlung rab 'khyil dug rlangs sprin phung gtibs: gzi brjid mdangs stobs bstan srung mthu chen gyis: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: sngon tshe slob dpon spyan sngar zhal bzhes bzhin: rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob dge 'dun sde: dar rgyas bzang bskul sdong grogs rogs dan mdzod: snang srid dbang sdud lam 'phrang 'jigs sgrol nas: klu g.yang dngos grub 'dod rgu dpal 'byor sdud: bka' srung gter srung mchog khyed ma g.yel bar: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ nag po ti pa ra tsa ya: dgra bgegs kyi māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na ba su ta sogs khā hi bar brjod: gnod sbyin dzam lha dbang sdud dmar po'i gter srung gnas po dge bsnyen gyi gtor 'bul zangs shog gi sdeb ma las hūm̐ gis phab pa'o/ ༈ 'jam dpal gshin rje dug ri me 'bar las: gter srung klu yi dge bsnyen gyi gsol mchod bzhugs so:

kanal ga: dpal chen rdo rje 'jigs byed sku la 'dud: de yang gter srung chen po'i gsol mchod la brtson pa ni: rus sbal sgal snod dam: yang na rin chen rang byung snod du bshos bu nag po zur gsum pa rtse la sbrul gdengs dang ldan pa: sbrul gnyis bsnol gyis dkris pa: g.yas g.yon du dmar gtor la dgra bo liṅga dang sdig pas brgyan pa: 'khor mtheb skyu bcu gnyis skyems dang bcas pa bsham: rnga shang drag tu sbir te: bdag mdun gsal rdzogs bsgom pa ni: hūm̐: bdag nyid dpal chen rdo rje 'jigs byed sku: mthing nag rab khros za byed ma he'-i zhal: phyag gnyis dpa' ba'i mtshon cha gri thod 'dzin: gtum rngam mi bzad dur khrod chas kyis brgyan: dor stabs zhabs kyis dam sri pho mo mnan: dur khrod bdag mo ro langs yum dang sbyor: sku las skyes pa'i rdzu 'phrul me dpung 'khrigs: snang srid zil gnon gar gyi nyams su bsgom: om̐ ya ma rā dza sa twa me ya ya me dho ru ṇa yo dha ya ya dha yo ni ra ya k+ṣe ya yak+ṣe ya tsa ṇi ra ma ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swā hā: de nas gter srung bskyed pa ni: hūm̐: mdun du rgya mtsho mer ba'i klong : rba klong 'khrugs pa'i dkyil 'khor du: na las skyes pa'i mthu bo che: pha ni bdud dang ma ni klu: gnyis med bshol zhing 'tshogs pa'i bu: ngam rje 'bar ba drag shul can: gter srung myur mgyogs mi bsrun pa: sku mdog ha la dug can dag: ro stod srin po khros pa'i gzugs: zhal gcig phyag gnyis shin tu gtum: sbrul nag ral pa mun ltar gtibs: phyag g.yas gser gyi 'khor lo ni: rtsibs ldan dgra bo'i klad la bskor: g.yon pas sbrul nag zhags pa 'phen: 'debs shing dgra bo'i mgul nas 'ching : yan lag lhu tshigs mig gis brgyan: sku smad sbrul mjug rta nag zhon: gong smad sbrul nag 'ching rgyan 'khyugs: rnga rngog gseb nas sdom sdig 'phro: me yi tshwa tshwa 'bum phrag 'khyil:

yum mchog nor seng sngon mo lcam: dmar mo chu srin gdong pa can: phyag gnyis sbrul zhags nad rkyal bsnams: sbrul mjug rus sbal dmar po zhon: man tri dmar po'i ga shal 'phyangs: 'od dmar 'tshub ma kyi li li: res 'ga' sprul pa 'gyed tsa na: sku mdog dmar nag rak+ta'i mdog: dbu dgu srid pa'i dbyings su bsnyegs: phyag bzhi gri gug lcags phur dang : sdig rgod sbrul gyi zhags pa thogs: zha long mdze pho pha bu dang : sbal sdig sbrul nag 'bum gyis bskor: gshin rje pho nya glog zhags can: gter srung chen po 'khor 'bangs tshogs: ma thogs yud kyis gnas 'dir byon: sngon tshe gsang bdag gtum po dang : bar du rig 'dzin thod phreng rtsal: che mchog nyid kyis dam bzhag gam: khyad par rlangs chen dpal seng gis: sde brgyad dam la btags pa'i tshe: rang rtags srog snying phul ba ltar: khas blangs bzhin du dam ma g.yel: gnod sbyin chen po gnas 'dir byon: dge bsnyen chen po gnas 'dir byon: dgra lha chen po gnas 'dir byon: dmag dpon chen po gnas 'dir byon: gter bdag chen po gnas 'dir byon: 'dir gshegs dam bskang phrin las sgrubs: om̐ nag po ti pa ra tsa ya badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ de nas gtor ma bran zhing : hūm̐: dug mtsho khol ma'i dbus shed nas: bzhengs shig ti pa ra tsa bzhengs: khams gsum 'di na myur mgyogs che: bdud dang klu yi bshos pa'i bu: che btsan khyod la bdag gi bstod: las bskul 'og tu gsal/ ༈ sprul pa'i dge bsnyen rdo rje rgyal po'i gsol mchod bzhugs so/ dpal chen he ru ka la na mo/ sprul pa'i dge bsnyen chen po'i gsol mchod 'bad pa ni/ lcags min pa'i snod gang rung du/ bshos bu sngon po sbrul dkris can g.yas su lha bshos/ rgyab tu zur gsum g.yon du khram ris can/ mdun du gser skyems bsham/ bsang sbyangs spel gsum sngon du song nas las kyi rim pa la 'jug pa ni/
