kyai/ phyogs phyogs dag cing pha ki na/ /nyi ma steng 'og phyogs bcu ru/ /'gyu ba'i gnas chen nges med de/ /rab 'jigs ri bo'i khong gseng nas/ /rgya mtsho sngo nag me re ba/ /mun gling dgu yi gnas mchog nas/ /klu rgyal chen po skur bzhengs shig /'dir gshegs mthun pa'i gtor ma bzhes/ dzaḥ khyed la mthun pa'i dam rdzas ni/ /klu bshos bdud rtsi sna tshogs 'bul/ khyed kyi gnas brgyad ru 'dren pa/ /lha dang gshin rje dregs pa 'bum/ /rang rang mnyes pa'i mchod rdzas 'bul/ /gsol lo mchod do dgyes par bzhes/ /klu g.yang 'dod rgu char bzhin phob/ kha 'dzin rogs dan sgrub pa dang*/ /bcol ba'i phrin las myur 'grub mdzod/ hūm̐/ klu rgyal chen po drag rtsal can/ /myur mgyogs sprul pa 'gyed pa'i tshe/ /dri za'i yul du zur phud lnga/ /lha yi yul du tshangs pa che/ /lho rgyud bdud po zla ba'i gdong*/ /mon kha seṅge bkrag med zhes/ /mkhar chu'i dge bsnyen smyo kha ba/ /pho mar klu bdud mgo dgu ba/ /lci shod klu bdud rdo rje rgyal/ khams kyi nya nag dpral mdangs can/ /lci yi klu rgyal zla skyong ba/ /ngom gyi dge bsnyen bdud 'joms pa/ /spu bo nā ga yak+sha ba/ /nyin mo gling bzhir 'gyu ba'i tshe/ /shwa rbud drag po 'tshub ma 'khyil/ /mtshan mo gling bzhir 'gyu ba'i tshe/ /srod dang mun rub dus su nyul/ /rbad pa dgra la chas pa'i tshe/ /sngo nag khros pa srog gi bdag /g.yu khrab rmog zhu lams se lam/ /dar mdung sngon po pu ru ru/ /gri gug dang ni lcags par thogs/ /yan lag tshigs bzhi mig gis brgyan/ /bra nag rting dkar chas mdzes zhon/ /gcan spyang sna tshogs sngon la 'phyo/ /lha dang gshin rje 'bum gyis bskor/ /mi sngon sna tshogs las la 'gyed/ /chu chen bco brgyad dbang yang sgyur/ /pho brang lcags mkhar dgu la chags/ /ri nag bco brgyad dbang du sgyur/ /mtsho nag dgu yi pho brang skyong*/

/las su bstan pa'i bya ra mdzad/ /zas su dgra bgegs sha la za/ /dben ri dang ni dgon gnas skyong*/ /myur mgyogs dge bsnyen drag rtsal can/ /rbad do dam nyams dgra la rbad/ /zhing bcu tshang ba'i sdig can la/ /mdze skya me ltar 'bar du chugs/ /mdze nad rlung ltar 'tshub tu chugs/ /gnyan rgod lhog yams dgra la phob/ /ti pa ra tsa'i dus la bab/ /dam nyams bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod/ ti pa ra tsa dgra bgegs kyi bla srog la kha kha khā hi/ zhes pa dge bsnyen gyi gsol mchod bsdus pa 'di yang grwa slob rnams kyis bskul ngor/ 7 gar dbang gnam lcags rdo rjes sbyar ba'o// // ༈ seng chen ge sar nor bu'i gsol mchod phrin las lhun grub bzhugs so/ ja chang bha ling sogs bshams byin gyis brlabs nas 'di ltar ro/ hūm̐ hrīḥ 'jigs rung srin po'i grong khyer dpal gyi ri/ /sku gsum rgyal ba'i zhing khams pad+ma 'od/ /dmar nag me dpung 'khrugs pa drag po'i zhing*/ /nang ltar rdo rje lus kyi tsit+ta'i grong*/ /rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i pho brang nas/ /srid zhi mnyam nyid ye shes rdo rje'i sku/ /rab 'byams rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs mtsho skyes rje'i/ /thugs rje'i rtsal snang sgyu mar rol pa'i gzugs/ /rnal 'byor grub pa pho mo'i tshogs dang bcas/ /mos ldan bu la byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir/ /brtul zhugs rdo rje'i gar gyis mkha' lam nas/ /bdud 'dul dgra bla wer ma'i skur bzhengs te/ /rig 'dzin chen po 'dzam gling rgyan mchog rtsal/ /shes rab ral gri mda' gzhu'i 'khrul 'khor gyis/ /srid pa'i dgra sde 'joms pa'i mthu bo che/ /skyes mchog seng chen nor bu sku 'khor dpung*/ /ma lus 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kun/ /dpa' ba'i ki bswo cha sgra 'brug ltar sgrogs/ /dge mtshan snyan pa'i ba dan mkha' la phyar/ /rdo rje'i rta mchog bzhon pa'i bro gar gyis/ /bar chad dam sri'i srog snying tshal par 'gem/

/byin rlabs sprin 'khrigs dngos grub char rgyun 'bebs/ /skal ldan bdag gis mchod cing mnga' gsol lo/ /thogs med thugs rje'i dbang gis 'dir gshegs la/ /bdud rtsi dpa' skyems phud kyi mchod pa bzhes/ /bcud ldan yid bzhin gtor ma'i mchod pa bzhes/ khrag chang myos byed ar+ghaṃ mchod pa bzhes/ /gsol lo dri zhim bsang gi mchod pa bzhes/ /dar sna ba dan rol mo'i mchod pa bzhes/ /bde stong nyams myong gsang ba'i mchod pa bzhes/ /snang srid gzhir bzhengs mdos kyi mchod pa bzhes/ /thams cad mnyam nyid ye shes mchod pa bzhes/ /thugs rjes dgongs shig seng chen rin po che/ /dam bca' ma g.yel rigs gsum sprul pa'i sku/ /deng nas byang chub bar du mi 'bral bar/ /srung skyob byin gyis rlobs la phrin las bsgrub/ khyod ni snying rje mchog gi rin chen ste/ /thugs rje chen po'i mtshon chen rnal 'byor 'chang*/ /bdud kyi dpung rnams 'dul la mchog tu gyur/ /bdud bzhi'i 'jigs pa mtha' dag khyod kyis sol/ /mkhyen rab dgongs pa'i klong nas rtsal phyung la/ /skal ldan snying gi dbus su byin chen phob/ /rtsa rlung rig khams ye shes rtsi thob la/ /gang byas byang chub lam du bsgyur bar mdzod/ /bdud 'dul drag po sngags kyi gzi 'bar zhing*/ /skye dgu'i mos snang chos la bsgyur ba yi/ /tshar gcod rjes su bzung ba'i phrin las la/ /dbang 'byor mthu stobs nus pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /snying ga dpal gyi be'u'i gsang mdzod nas/ /gzungs spobs blo gros nor bu'i gter sgo phyes/ /gzhan phan mkha' dang mnyam pa'i phrin las kyis/ /don gnyis yid bzhin grub par mdzad du gsol/ /byang chub sems ldan kun bzang spyod pa yis/ /zab mo rdo rje theg mchog la gnas nas/ /sa lam mngon par rtogs pa cher 'phel zhing*/ /myur du rnam grol rgyal ba'i dbang por mdzod/ ces pa'ang lcags 'brug zla 6tshes 24 la mi pham pas gang shar bris pa dge/

ge sar gsol bsdus/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ dbyings nas thugs rje ma g.yel seng chen rje/ /rtsa gsum kun 'dus nor bu dgra 'dul rtsal/ /chos skyong dgra lha wer ma'i 'khor dang bcas/ /thugs rje'i thugs dam dbang gis 'dir gshegs la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi gtor ma'i mchod pa bzhes/ /sgrub pa'i rtags mtshan dngos su bstan pa dang*/ /re ba'i 'bras bu yid bzhin grub par mdzod/ mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ oṃ ma hā singha ma ṇi rā dza sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ bha ling+ta khā hi/ dhi ming pas so// // ༈ ge sar gsol mchod ni/ kye/ sangs rgyas mi gzugs byon pa'i rdzu 'phrul can/ /mthu rtsal stobs ldan hor bdud cham la phab/ /'dre srin dam btags bod khams bde la bkod/ /dbu nag dgra lha skyes bu don 'grub la/ /gser skyems 'di 'bul pho lhar mnga' gsol lo/ /gzhi la bkra shis bde legs phun sum tshogs/ /byes su gang bsam sgrubs la bar chad sol/ /bstan pa'i mnga' thang phyogs bcur rgyas gyur cig /rig 'dzin bde chen rdo rjes sbyar ba'o// // ༈ rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras kyi gsol mchod dgos 'dod char 'bebs bzhugs so/ om̐ swa sti/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs mtsho skyes pa/ /dbyer med gsum ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gus pas lan brgyar zhabs pad gtsug btud nas/ /dngos grub 'dod pa 'jo ba 'di na bri/ 'dir rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras kyi gsol mchod kyi rim pa ni: bca' bsham spyi 'gros mthong brgyud lag len bzhin bshams pa'i gung du/ rnam sras gtor ma zangs snod du gdan ri rab bang rim gsum brtsegs khar rin chen zur brgyad/ de steng gter bum khar gtor ma zlum po pad 'dab bzhi yis mtshan pa/ zur brgyad la bshos bu brgyad/ mtshams rnams su ril bu rnams bzhag /rgyan khra nor bu gang mdzes bya/ rgyun gtor dkar gtor 'bul/ sa ma ya/ om̐ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥkyis bsang*/

swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod du 'bru gsum zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma 'dod rgu'i longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa so so rang rang rigs kyi yid mthun nam mkha'i mdzod du gyur/ na ma sarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ ut+g rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas ri rab lhun po'i byang phyogs nas/ rgyal po chen po rnam sras 'khor dang bcas pa mchod sbyin gyi slad du skad cig gis mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ rol mo dbyangs dang bcas pas 'di skad do/ hūm̐/ 'dzam gling ri rab lhun po'i byang phyogs nas/ /rgyal chen btsun mo sras bzhi blon 'bangs dang*/ /dzam lha rigs lnga nor rgyun gnod sbyin brgyad/ /'khor bcas spyan 'dren gnas 'dir mchod phyir gshegs/ /sngon tshe rgyal ba thub pa chen po dang*/ /gar dbang pad+ma thod phreng spyan snga ru/ /ci ltar khas blangs dam bca' dran mdzod la/ /sna tshogs rin chen yid mthun khri la bzhugs/ /dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod sprin rgya mtsho mchod/ /'dod rgu char 'bebs rnam bzhi'i phrin las sgrubs/ om̐ bai shra ma ṇā ye dzaṃ bha la dza lan dha ra ba su dha ra ye i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: lan gsum/ bai/ byang phyogs skyong ba'i rgyal chen rnam sras dang*/ /dzam lha nor rgyun gnod sbyin gter bdag brgyad/ /lha srin sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /mchod bstod bdag gi 'dod don sgrub tu gsol/ bai/ mi 'jigs stobs chen seṅge'i khri steng du/ /bai las byung ba'i ngal gso dge ba'i rgyal/ /sa le sbram gyi mdangs ldan sgeg pa'i nyams/ /phyag g.yas srid gsum dbang sdud rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ /g.yon pas dgos 'dod char 'beb ne'u le dang*/ /dbu la rin chen sna lnga'i prog zhu gsol/ /gos dar g.yul las rgyal ba'i go khrab dang*/ /rgya lham swag chen gsol zhing phyed skyil bzhugs/

/sprin bral nyi 'od stong gi gzi 'bar ba'i/ /sa brgyad dbang phyug chen po khyod la bstod/ /btsun mo bzhi dang sras bzhi blon 'bangs dang*/ /dzam bha la dang lha mo nor rgyun ma/ /gnod sbyin rta bdag brgyad dang nor gyi lha/ /ma lus 'khor dang bcas la bstod par bgyi/ /gser mdog brjid ldan 'dzam gling longs spyod bsdu/ /sku yi sprul pa rab rgyas rtsal kun rdzogs/ /rnam mang thos sras byang phyogs skyong mdzad pa/ /sbyin pa'i phar phyin rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /byang phyogs skyong ba'i rgyal chen rnam thos sras/ /nor gyi bdag po ār+ya dzam bha la/ /dbul ba sel ba'i lha mo nor rgyun ma/ /rnam sras 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod/ longs spyod 'dod yon dngos grub char 'bebs stsol/ /mchod sbyin bdud rtsi'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bdag dang yon mchod 'khor bcas la/ /'chi med tshe dang 'dzad med zas nor dang*/ /snyan grags mnga' thang chos srid rin chen gter/ /'dod rgu'i rgyun gyis zad med brlan par mdzod/ rgyun du gshegs gsol 'di mi dgos

sarba gats+tsha: gtor ma gtsang sar bskyal/ zhes pa 'di yang stag lor bcad rgya'i skabs/ zla ba gsum pa'i tshes bcu bzhi'i nub mo'i rmi lam du rgyal chen gyis rang gzugs bstan nas/ 'di ltar gyis dang phrin las bsgrub stsal ba ltar/ rig 'dzin gnam lcags rdo rje'i zlos gar gsum par rag gan gser brdzus pas tshes bco lnga zhag mtshams su sa skyong rgyal po'i zhabs pad dbu rtse ru sbyar ba dge bar gyur cig/ // ༈ gnyan chen thang lha'i mchod phrin ni: dpal phyag na rdo rje'i sprul pa: slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas mtha' 'khob bod gyi yul du byon pa'i tshe: bod kyi lha srin thams cad gyi tho 'tshams te: thang lha yar zhud kyi slob dpon la kha ba phab: zhabs la bu yug 'tshubs: smug pas shul lam bkag pas: slob dpon thugs khros te: phyag na rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs nas: lha srin sde brgyad thams cad bred rgyal te: de'i dus su thang lha yar zhud btul nas dam la btags te: slob dpon gyi gsungs pa: lha chen thang lha yar zhud khyod kyi srog snying gang yin: nus pa'i phrin las ci nus gsungs pas: thang lha srog gi snying po rang dbang med par phul ba ni: oṃ badz+ra thaṅka ra mun nyid khu sha li a dza dzaḥs ma ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ de nas gsang mtshan phul ba ni: rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal: a dza dza hūm̐: kye slob dpon chen po bdag gi phrin las ni: smyo ba'i 'dre 'dul zhing sdang ba'i dgra gsod pa lags so: zhes zhus so: yang thang lha na re: slob dpon nyid kyi bka' mi nyan dbang med kyi: bdag la zas skal cig stsol cig: ces zhus so: khyod kyi zas skal ji ltar phyin: thang lhas zhus pa: bdag dngos kyi zas skal ni: 'bru'i zan sor mo bcu gnyis pa zur gsum la gser g.yu: byi ru rin po che sna lnga brdar ba: brngan cha gcig: gtsang lug gcig: chu phud gtsang ma gra phying gtsang ma'i steng du bzhag la: oṃ badz+ra thang ka ra mun nyid khu sha li a mṛ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi swā hā:

zhes gson cig zer nas thang lha yar bzhud mi snang bar gyur to: de nas slob dpon gyi shel gyi rnge'u chung phyag tu bzhes te: phyi rabs kyi don du 'di skad gsungs so: hūm̐: ye shes gzhal yas bskyed gyi rgya ma chung : seṅge glang chen khri bshams 'phang ma dman: nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan bting bkrag ma zhan: ye shes lha mchog bsnyen gyi rgyang ma ring : 'jig rten srung ma bsgrub kyi mthu ma chung : 'dir gshegs nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs: rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal sa ma ya dza dzaḥhūm̐: hūm̐: sku lha'i yab smos pa: 'od de gong rgyal lags: sku lha'i yum smos pa: g.yu bya gshog gcig lags: sku lha nyid smos pa: yar bzhud gnyan gyi lha: bzhugs yul mtshan gsol ba: 'dam shod snar mo lags: khri rgod g.yu ljang ldem: dbyar sngo dgun yang sngo: bzhugs yul nyams re dga': dgyes so lha yi yul: mi chos mtshan gsol ba: thang lha yar zhud lags: lha chos mtshan gsol ba: dri za'i rgyal po ni: zur phud lnga pa lags: gsang ba'i mtshan gsol ba: rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal: sku la ci gsol na: dar dkar ral ka gsol: chibs su ci chibs na: lha rta ngang dkar bcibs: khams gsum kun tu rgyu: mdog dkar 'od zer 'bar: g.yas na rba lcag phyar: ma bdun las la 'gyed: g.yon na shel phreng 'dren: thugs dam dbyings su zlo: sprul pa ci 'gyed na: lha dmag 'bum sde 'gyed: bran g.yog 'khor dang bcas: 'dir byon phrin las mdzod: dam can kun gyi lha: dam med kun gyi gshed: mna' gzan kun gyi bdud: rnal 'byor kun gyi dpal: sgrub mchog bdag gi grogs: phrin las skal phog pa: smyo ba'i 'dre 'dul zhing : sdang ba'i dgra srog gcod: mgyogs su rta brtod kyi: rmig thog zor ma lci: rno ru mtshon brdar gyis: rtse mo dbal ma zhan: ci dang do bsdo na: do thag chad ta re: mgyogs dang dkyus 'dren na: dkyus thog shor ra re: sdang dgras khyer ra re: byams kyis skyongs la re:

dus la bab po sa ma ya: dam tshig rjes su dran par mdzod: las la bab po bgegs kyi rgyal: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: dbus gtsang ru bzhi'i yul lha khyod: chos skyong rgyal po lha yi sras: khri srong lde'u btsan sku lha yin: o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: dam la btags pa'i dam tshig can: da lta ci bsgo'i las la nyon: phyi rabs bstan pa'i tha ma la: o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi: rjes su sgrub pa'i sngags 'chang dang : chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gyi: lha rgyud chags pa'i gdung rgyud rnams: mtho mtho dgung la reg pa dang : dma' dma' bu bzhin skyong bar gyis: bod khams ru bzhi phyugs bzhin skyongs: bsam yas lha khang dkor bzhin srungs: bskal pa tha ma'i sems can la: khyod kyis srung skyob mi byed na: dang po byang lam bar ma ru: gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje yis: srog snying gzir ba mi dran nam: bar du bsam yas has po rir: dbang chen pad+ma he ru kas: dbang du bsdus pa mi dran nam: tha ma ri rgyal bkra bzang gi: rtse mor lha srin kun bsags nas: dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yis: dam tshig phog pa mi dran nam: nga ni pad+ma 'byung gnas yin: khyod ni gnyan chen thang lha yin: yul 'di dbus gtsang ru bzhi yin: byin brlabs sprin ltar thibs se thib: thugs rje char ltar sha ra ra: dam tshig mdangs ldan ya la la: thang lha gnyan po gshegs su gsol: sku lha gnyan po 'khor bcas la: brjid ldan bzang ring bshos kyis mchod: gangs chu g.ya' chu gtsang mas mchod: dri zhim spos dkar dud pas mchod: gser dngul rin chen sna lngas mchod: brngan cha dar dang za 'og mchod: gsang lug 'bras dkar gtsang mas mchod: oṃ badz+ra thang ka ra mun nyid khu sha li a mṛ ta swā hā: zhes dgung sngon mthon po'i mchod do: de'i dus su bdag phyag na rdo rjer bsgoms: rnge'u chung dal gyis brdung la: dang po seṅge'i mchongs dbyangs kyi bskul:

rjes su dpa' bo 'gying glus: dam tshig bsgrag cing mchod na: rnal 'byor pa'i mgon dang srung ma byed: sde pa chos la dkar ba rnams kyi mgon skyabs dang srung mar 'gyur ro: gnyan chen thang lha mchod pa'i phrin las rdzogs so: byang zang zang lha brag gi sked nas: rig 'dzin sgod kyi ldem 'phru can gyis bton pa'o// // ༈ ban thung gsol mchod ni: hūm̐/ badz+ra gu ru rdo rje gro bo lod/ /bka' nyan ye shes mgon po stag la chibs/ /de bsgrub dgra lha 'brong pa ban thung ni/ /pha mes rgyud nas srung skyob 'bral med mdzod/ /'brong pas mchod na mgon pa'i lha srung rnams/ /dam tshig brtse gdung gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /gser skyems gtor ma 'bul ba bzhes su gsol/ /'gro 'dug dus su bsu skyel 'bral med mdzod/ i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi/ bde chen rdo rjes sbyar ba'o// // ༈ skrag dbyi'i gtor 'bul ni/ hūm̐/ dge bsnyen skrag btsan mched 'khor dang*/ /sman btsun la sogs skya dgu dang*/ /g.ya' mar btsan gyi tshogs bcas gshegs/ /dkar gtor bshos bu spyan gzigs dang*/ /gser skyems bsang mchod 'di bzhes la/ /las dang bya ba gang bzhin sgrubs/ /'dzam gling dbyi shod ri bo che/ /dmag dpon dbyi rgyal mched 'khor sogs/ /mtsho bkra la sogs nang blon mched/ /a mgon mi thung blon 'khor gyis/ /bshos ldan spyan gzigs bkra shis rdzas/ /'bru bcud gser skyems 'di bzhes la/ /bdag la rogs dan sgrub pa dang*/ /rtag tu mi 'bral bstan pa skyongs/ /gang bcol phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ gnam lcags rdo rjes sbyar ba'o// // skabs 'dir so so'i yul lha sogs gzhan yod na sbyar bas 'thus/ sde brgyad gser skyems bzhugs so/ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ gnubs ston sangs rgyas ye shes kyis mdzad pa'i gser skyems sde brgyad cha snyoms las/ thog mar lha bshos ri rab mar chang 'o phud me tog rtsi sman mngar gsum sha sna khrag sna 'bru sna dar zab gang 'byor bshams la/

/skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang ldan pas rang nyid yi dam gang byed bsgoms la rdzas rnams sngags drug phyag drug gis byin gyis brlabs la ting nge 'dzin ngang nas 'di skad do/ hūm̐/ sku gsum brgyud gsum bla ma dang*/ /yi dam zhi khro'i lha tshogs dang*/ /skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum po dang*/ /mkha' 'gro nor lha gter srung tshogs/ /mchod yul gong ma thams cad la/ /mchod pa dam pa 'di 'bul lo/ /gser skyems gtsang ma 'di bzhes la/ /bdag gi 'dod don sgrub tu gsol/ /lha yi dbang po brgya byin dang*/ /lha min dbang po thag bzang ris/ /klu yi rgyal po dga' bo dang*/ /mi'am ci ljon rta mgo dang*/ /gnod sbyin gang ba bzang po dang*/ /mkha' lding gser mig 'khyil ba dang*/ /chos skyong ma hā kā la dang*/ srin po laṅka mgrin bcu dang*/ /dri za zur phud lnga pa sogs/ /phyi yi sde brgyad 'khor bcas la/ /mchod pa dam pa 'di 'bul lo/ /gser skyems gtsang ma 'di bzhes la/ /bdag gi 'dod don sgrub tu gsol/ /yab gcig bdud rje nag po dang*/ /btsan rgyal yam shud dmar po dang*/ /yul lha phywa bsangs klu sras dang*/ /srog bdag rgyal po snying sbyin dang*/ /chos skyong gnod sbyin dmar po dang*/ /ma mo 'jigs pa'i glog 'byin dang*/ /dge bsnyen rdo rje legs pa dang*/ /dkar mo nyi zla'i thod phreng dang*/ /nang gi sde brgyad 'khor bcas la/ /mchod pa dam pa 'di 'bul lo/ /gser skyems gtsang ma 'di bzhes la/ /bdag gi 'dod don sgrub tu gsol/ /bdud po kha thun yak+ṣa dang*/ /gshin rje gshed po dmar po dang*/ /klu bdud nā ga rā dza dang*/ /gnod sbyin shan pa gri thogs dang*/ /ma mo srid pa'i khram 'debs dang*/ /btsan po yam shud srog len dang*/ /bdud po ri ti mgo yag dang*/ /srog bdag dung gi thor tshugs sogs/ /gsang ba'i sde brgyad 'khor bcas la/ /mchod pa dam pa 'di 'bul lo/ /gser skyems gtsang ma 'di bzhes la/

bdag gi 'dod don sgrub tu gsol/ /gza' mchog rgyal po rā hu la/ /skar mchog khram shing kha thor dang*/ /bdud mchog ma nu yak+ṣa dang*/ /btsan mchog gri btsan mthu bo dang*/ /ma mchog lce spyang mdung 'dzin dang*/ /klu mchog klu rgyal dung skyong dang*/ /mgon mchog nag po lter dkar dang*/ /rgyal mchog li byin ha ra sogs/ /mchog gi sde brgyad 'khor bcas la/ /mchod pa dam pa 'di 'bul lo/ /gser skyems gtsang ma 'di bzhes la/ /bdag gi 'dod don sgrub tu gsol/ /dpung g.yas dgra lhar sprul pa dang*/ /dpung g.yon ma mor sprul pa dang*/ /chu so bdud du sprul pa dang*/ /mgo bo srin por sprul pa dang*/ /mjug ma rmu ru sprul pa dang*/ /lag g.yas gshin rjer sprul pa dang*/ /lag g.yon klu btsan sprul pa dang*/ /mig dang snying dang mchin pa gsum/ gza' bdud nyid du sprul pa dang*/ /sprul pa'i sde brgyad 'khor bcas la/ /mchod pa dam pa 'di 'bul lo/ /gser skyems gtsang ma 'di bzhes la/ /bdag gi 'dod don sgrub tu gsol/ /sa bdag hal khyi nag po dang*/ /klu bdud sgo ra nag po dang*/ /sa yi lha mo brtan ma dang*/ /phyogs skyong rgyal chen sde bzhi dang*/ /mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga dang*/ /yul 'di'i gzhi bdag thams cad dang*/ /pho lha dgra lha srog lha dang*/ /mo lha mo sman la sogs pa/ /snang srid sde brgyad thams cad la/ /mchod pa dam pa 'di 'bul lo/ /gser skyems gtsang ma 'di bzhes la/ /bdag gi 'dod don sgrub tu gsol/ zhes gnubs ban sangs rgyas ye shes kyis mdzad pa'i gser skyems 'di ni/ ser ba srung ba/ sre'u gso ba/ gtor ma 'phen pa/ mdos glud gtong ba zor 'phen pa sogs las gang byed kyang sngon du 'gro ba'i sde brgyad mchod pa 'di med na byis pas mkhar las byed pa dang 'dra bas gal che gsungs so/ las gang gi sngon du 'gro ba'i sde brgyad mchod thabs gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so/

sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ yul lha mchod thabs ni/ kyai: sa yul 'di la gnas pa yi: lha gnyan klu gnyan btsan gnyan dang : yul lha gnyan dang nags tshal gnyan: yul lha mthu chen bzhugs pa kun: rin chen gser skyems 'di bzhes la: 'khor 'dir gnod pa ma byed cig: snga ma legs pa'i gtang rag yin: phyi ma legs pa'i zhu skyems 'bul: da yang las kyi zhu 'bul ni: bzhes nas 'dod don sgrub tu gsol: nyang gi gter ma'o// // mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*/ dpal dang grags dang bskal pa bzang*/ longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*/ zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs/ dngos grub kun gyi sdong grogs mdzod/ dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*/ gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*/ 'bru rnams 'phel zhing phyugs 'phel ba/ dge legs thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod/ ༈ na mo/ bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dag dang*/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sbyin stobs dang*/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis/ /bka' srung rnams la mchod pa dang*/ /gzhi bdag rnams la 'dod yon sogs/ /don rnams gang dag bsam pa kun/ /de dag thams cad ci rigs pa/ /'jig rten khams 'dir ma lus pa/ /thogs pa med par 'byung bar shog/ // ༈ skabs 'dir tshogs mchod yod na na rag bshags pa dang brjod med don bshags sogs rgyas bsdus ci rigs rjes sman gtor rak+ta'i bskang ba rnams 'dir bya/ rtsa gsum spyi'i gtor bsngos rig 'dzin srog sgrub nas tshogs dang bskul pa yan song nas gtor 'bul la 'jug pa yin yang gsol ka rkyang pa'i skabs mi dgos/ ༈ sa bcad gnyis pa gtor 'bul gyi rim pa ni/ dmigs bsal tshogs kyi skabs yin na chog gzhung lhag ma btang zhing bskul pa'i mthar 'dir 'jug dgos la rgyun gsol rkyang pa'i skabs 'di nas mthar chags su dkyus ltar bya bas chog go

/gtor ma rnams mdun du bshams shing gser skyems sbreng*/ dang po gtor ma la dgra bgegs 'gugs pa ni/ ༈ gtor 'gugs ni/ na mo/ rang nyid yi dam lhar gsal ba'i mdun du gtor snod dug gsum gyi khang sgrom shor med 'khor ba'i btson ra rgya khyon gzhal las 'das pa'i dbus su nṛ tri dza kham nag las/ ma rig nyams pa'i dgra gdon mi dge mya ngan gyi nyam gzugs/ lus la rang byas kyi rnam smin nad mtshon gyi dug rlangs 'tshubs pa de yi ro rkyang gi lam rgyud du/ dge sdig lha bdud dug sbrul dkar nag gnyis kyis khong khrag 'jib pa/ snying khar srog 'dzin gyi ngo bo nyon mongs khrag gi lbu ba de la chos nyid rnam dag gi 'khor lo la shes rab rig pa'i rno ngar dang ldan pas dgra bgegs kyi sgo gsum dbang lnga don snying thams cad gtubs par gsal lo/ na mo/ byin rlabs nus pa'i bdag nyid/ grub dbang rtsa brgyud bla ma/ dbyings nas bden rtags rdzogs pa/ rab 'byams yi dam rgya mtsho/ ye shes rdo rje lus can/ khyab bdag pad+ma 'byung gnas/ brten yul rtsad nas 'gugs mdzad/ zhing sngags ma dang mkha' 'gro/ myur mgyogs las la shar ba'i/ bstan srung dregs pa'i sde tshogs/ thugs rje khros pa'i dpung chen/ ting 'dzin lha sngags phyag rgyas dmigs pa'i yul du mchis pa'i/ sdang dgra gnod byed byad ma thams cad/ rgyu 'bras las kyi pho nya/ stong gsum gang ba'i rdul dang mnyam pas/ 'gugs byed snying rje'i lcags kyus zungs la/ 'od gsal stong nyid zhags pas bsdams te/ lha srung rdo rje'i ra gur steng 'og phyogs mtshams gang du mchis kyang*/ dmar chen thun gyi gtor ma/ dmar nag khrag gi lbu ba 'di la khug cig nṛ tri a kar+ṣa ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥ bdag mdun thugs las reg chod rno ngar gyi/ /mtshon cha sna tshogs bu yug char sprin gtibs/ /byad ma lha dang dngos po ma lus pa'i/ /lus la phog pas khrag rlung rdul phran gyur/

/tshe bsod rlung sems nṛ yig rang la thim/ /a yig khrus byas bde stong rnam shes de/ /chos dbyings bde chen lam nas lha la thim/ /sha ri khrag mtsho rus pa gram ltar spung*/ /stong gsum khyon gang dam ldan dpa' bo'i zas/ /dgyes pa'i mchod rdzas ro mchog stong ldan pa/ /ka dag chos dbyings ye rdzogs zas su gyur/ ār+ya dh+wa dzas so// // de nas gtor bskul bya ba ni: rab 'don cha ltar so so kha phral zhing gtor ma 'bul: bsdu na phyogs gcig tu lha grangs gtor gzugs kyi 'khor bha ling gis bskor bar bya: de yang gtor bsngos bya ba'i rim pa ni: gtor mchod stegs kyi kha ru bzhag: sha chen snod du bkram par khrag chang gis bran: sha gsur bya zhing rol mo drag brdung bya la 'di skad do: hoḥ gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar ba'i gtor ma sman raka dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag rus pa dbang po rnam lngas brgyan pa 'di nyid 'bul zhing bsngo ba'i gnas su gyur pa ni: dpal ye shes kyi mgon po legs ldan nag po'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: yum mchog 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma yi zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: khrag 'thung phyag bzhi chen po'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: yum mchog tsaṇ+ḍi ma mo'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: ma ning dpal 'bar nag po'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: gdong bzhi ma hā kā la'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: myur mgyogs phyag drug mgon po'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: bram gzugs dur khrod bdag po'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: yum mchog ma mo rigs bzhi'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: sgo skyong phra men rigs bzhi'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: gzhan yang sprul pa srog bdag bya rog gi gdong can 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi:

hoḥ ye shes mgon po'i lha tshogs kyis: dgyes pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: sangs rgyas bstan pa bshig pa dang : bla ma'i sku la bsdo ba dang : rig 'dzin bdag la 'gras pa dang : ka cha dkor nor 'phrog pa dang : gdug pa'i dgra bgegs byad ma yi: pho rgyud rnams kyi sha la zo: mo rgyud rnams kyi khrag la 'thung : rigs rgyud thams cad mngal nas skoms: sgo nor thams cad phyags mas thob: dgra bo'i gnyen 'dun nang 'thab thongs: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma dang : nyams pa'i dgra bo mnyam par bzhes: rbad do bzlog go las mdzod cig: thal mo lan gsum brdab cing gtor ma phul: hoḥ dpal ldan zhing skyong dbang po sha za nag po seṅge'i gdong pa can gyi zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: yum mchog bdud mo si na ra ma'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: las byed myur mgyogs bam chen pho mo'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: lha btsan rdo rje 'bar ba'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: btsan rgod 'bar ba khrag 'thung zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: ma mo sngags kyi srung ma'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: klu bdud nā ga rak+sha'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: bdud rje nag po bkrag med zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: gza' mchog dug gdong mgo dgu'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: che btsan dgra lha chen po'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: dam can rdo rje legs pa'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: bdud kyi las byed du ma'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: hūm̐: bdud mgon zhing skyong lha tshogs kyis: dgyes pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: sangs rgyas bstan pa bshig pa dang : bla ma'i sku la bsdo ba dang : rig 'dzin bdag la 'gras pa dang : ka cha dkor nor 'phrog pa dang : gdug pa'i dgra bgegs byad ma yi: pho rgyud rnams kyi sha la zo:

mo rgyud rnams kyi khrag la 'thung : rigs rgyud thams cad mngal nas skoms: sgo nor thams cad phyags mas thob: dgra bo'i gnyen 'dun nang 'thab thongs: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma dang : nyams pa'i dgra bo mnyam par bzhes: rbad do bzlog go las mdzod cig: thal mo lan gsum brdab cing gtor ma phul: hoḥ drang srong gza' mchog gi rgyal po ki kang rā hu la chen po'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: yum mchog khrag mig nag mo'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: chu gza' zla ba lag pa'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: me gza' nyi ma mig dmar zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: rlung gza' phur bu sgra gcan zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: sa gza' spen pa pa sangs zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: stag srin zor ba gdong gi zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: 'brog srin chu srin gdong gi zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: kong srin ba glang gdong gi zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: bam srin dred mong gdong gi zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: pho nya dur bya bzhi yi zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: drang srong gza' bdud yongs rdzogs zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: hoḥ drang srong gza' bdud 'khor bcas kyis: dgyes pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: sangs rgyas bstan pa bshig pa dang : bla ma'i sku la bsdo ba dang : rig 'dzin bdag la 'gras pa dang : ka cha dkor nor 'phrog pa dang : gdug pa'i dgra bgegs byad ma yi: pho rgyud rnams kyi sha la zo: mo rgyud rnams kyi khrag la 'thung : rigs rgyud thams cad mngal nas skoms: sgo nor thams cad phyags mas thob: dgra bo'i gnyen 'dun nang 'thab thongs: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma dang : nyams pa'i dgra bo mnyam par bzhes: rbad do bzlog go las mdzod cig: thal mo lan gsum brdab cing gtor ma phul: hoḥ

rgyal po chen po gnod sbyin 'bar ba btsan rgod bswe khrab can gyi zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: sku sprul klu yi bshan pa'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: gsung sprul btsan gyi bshan pa'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: thugs sprul tshangs pa dung thod zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: yon tan gter srung ma mo'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: phrin las rol pa sde bzhi'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: yang sprul bshan pa nyi khri'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: ban sngags mon pa nag po'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: stag shar a tsa ra yi zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: spra sprel byi la mtshal bya'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: sprul pa'i btsan rgod yongs rdzogs zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: hoḥ btsan rgod 'bar ba 'khor bcas kyis: dgyes pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: sangs rgyas bstan pa bshig pa dang : bla ma'i sku la bsdo ba dang : rig 'dzin bdag la 'gras pa dang : ka cha dkor nor 'phrog pa dang : gdug pa'i dgra bgegs byad ma yi: pho rgyud rnams kyi sha la zo: mo rgyud rnams kyi khrag la 'thung : rigs rgyud thams cad mngal nas skoms: sgo nor thams cad phyags mas thob: dgra bo'i gnyen 'dun nang 'thab thongs: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma dang : nyams pa'i dgra bo mnyam par bzhes: rbad do bzlog go las mdzod cig: thal mo lan gsum brdab cing gtor ma phul: hoḥ sprul pa'i dge bsnyen gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po chos skyong dpe dkar dkor gyi bdag po chen po'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: rgyal po dpe har chen po'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: rgyal po tshangs pa chen po'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: rgyal po li byin chen po'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi:

rgyal po bhi har chen po'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: rgyal po dpe nag chen po'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: rgyal po shing bya chen po'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: rgyal po dpe dmar chen po'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: rgyal po gnam lha chen po'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: dgra bcom dang ni sngags pa'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: stag shar dang ni sman btsun zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: pu ṭa'i gzugs 'chang gdong can rnams kyi zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: gnod sbyin hor pa nor sdud zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: byi thang ke ru lug sdud zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: dkor bdag rgyal po rta sdud zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: myur mgyogs sprel mgo zas sdud zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: dkor bdag dpe dkar 'khor bcas zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: hoḥ dkor bdag chen po 'khor bcas kyis: dgyes pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: sangs rgyas bstan pa bshig pa dang : bla ma'i sku la bsdo ba dang : rig 'dzin bdag la 'gras pa dang : ka cha dkor nor 'phrog pa dang : gdug pa'i dgra bgegs byad ma yi: pho rgyud rnams kyi sha la zo: mo rgyud rnams kyi khrag la 'thung : rigs rgyud thams cad mngal nas skoms: sgo nor thams cad phyags mas thob: dgra bo'i gnyen 'dun nang 'thab thongs: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma dang : nyams pa'i dgra bo mnyam par bzhes: rbad do bzlog go las mdzod cig: ces pa 'di yi mtshams su gtor ma chos skyong 'grig chags su gong du gnas shing rgyas pa so sor phrin bcol bzhin 'bul mthar thal mo gsum brdab par bya/ dmigs pa gzhung gi 'don cha ltar gang lcogs bya: dus bzlog la sogs shin tu gal che ba la dar nag g.yab skong ba brgya tshar bsog:

yang 'bring po 'dra yin na gzhung gi las bskul thams cad mthar rdzogs pa dang : gtor ma'i spyi 'dus gcig la tshang bar phul: zhes chos skyong sde lnga'i gtor 'bul lo/ drag bskul ni zur du gsal/ ༈ dpal ldan lha mo dud sol ma'i ka bstod bzhugs so/ hūm̐/ ka la sprin nag khrag mtsho 'khrugs pa'i klong*/ kha mo che zhes srid gsum za byed ma/ /ga nas bltas kyang sa gsum rab tu sngangs/ /nga ro a ra li yi gad mo sgrog /ca co ma rungs bsgral ba'i ro gdan du/ /cha lugs mthing nag bong bu dmar gwa zhon/ /ja chang phud la dgyes shing dgra sha za/ /nya rgyas 'bum phrag gzi 'bar gri thod 'dzin/ /lta bas mi bzod dur khrod chas kyis brgyan/ /tha mal mi gnas don la ye shes tshul/ /da lta 'dod khams dbyings phyug khyod sgrub na/ /na 'chi rkyen sogs mi mthun zhi bar mdzod/ /dpa' mo mthing nag nam mkha' dmar 'od ltar/ /pha rol dam nyams dgra la rbad pa'i tshe/ /ba mo nyi zer 'bum gyis ngang ltar bzhin/ /ma rungs bstan dgra sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod/ /rtswa rwa dkar phyogs rgyu sde'i bstan pa skyongs/ /tsha ngar 'bar ba'i pho nya bye bas bskor/ /dza yig ma mo 'bum sogs las la chas/ /wa skyes seṅge'i rtsal gyis mnan pa bzhin/ /zha ring nad yams dam nyams dgra la phob/ /za byed gsod byed dam nyams dgra la bh+yo/ /'a cag rtag tu rbad cing rab bskul na/ /ya ma gtibs bzhin snang srid dpung bskyed la/ /ral gri gri gug mtshon cha dgra la phob/ /la ma dud mtshan ma sogs 'khor bcas kyis/ /sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /sa steng la sogs gar gnas dgra bgegs sgrol/ /ha ha dgyes pa sgrub pa'i las rtsom par/ /a ti'i bstan pa rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod/ bh+yo bh+yo rak+mo re ma ti sa ma ya bh+yo bh+yo/ zhes pa 'di gar dbang gnam lcags rdo rjes sbyar ba'o/ dge'o// // zhing skyong gi gtor 'bul ni/ thal mo brdab cing : hoḥ

zhing skyong dam can 'khor bcas la: bdag gis mchod gtor phul ba'i mthus: pha rol log pa'i dgra bgegs kyis: sangs rgyas bstan pa bshig pa dang : bla ma'i sku la bsdo ba dang : gsang sngags chos la smad pa dang : rig 'dzin bdag la 'gras pa'i dgra: sdang zhing gdug pa'i tshogs rnams kun: dam can rgya mtsho khyed rnams kyis: myur du bsgral ba'i las mdzod cig: hūm̐ hūm̐ k+ṣeṃ k+ṣeṃ pha rol dgra bgegs byad ma thams cad bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: ces lan gsum sbyar: las byang rgyas pa ma lcogs na: gtor bsngos bsdus pa 'di rgyun du gtong rung : ༈ gza' yi gtor 'bul gnam lcags ral gri bzhugs so: hūm̐ dza bh+yoḥ mkha' klong gnas bzhugs stong khams mnga' bdag rje: khyab 'jug chen po gza' bdud rā hu la: spyan 'dren 'bod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: mchod rdzas dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus: don snying dbang po khrum khrum nang rol bcas: lhag ma med par gza' 'dud tshogs la 'bul: dza bh+yoḥ me gza' dmar po btsan dmag 'bum gyis bskor: nyi ma'i zer chibs dgra la zha ring phob: chu gza' sngo nag klu srin 'bum gyis bskor: zla ba'i zer chibs dgra la gegs char thongs: rlung gza' ljang nag dus 'khrug skar ltar 'khrugs: bu yug rta chibs dgra la smyo 'bog thongs: dzaḥbh+yoḥ gza' bdud gnas nas bskul zhing rbad pa'i tshe: dud sprin me lce dmar nag nam mkhar 'bar: 'bebs pa'i ser chen rlung nag 'u ru ru: 'khyugs pa'i glog zhags dgra bo'i klad khrag 'gems: 'phen pa'i thog chen dgra mkhar mgo mjug bsgyur: dmag dpon khyab 'jug chen po dgra la rgyugs: yum chen gdong mo mched bzhi dgra la rbad: khyod la drag rtsal yod na nga la mkho: nga yi bstan dgra gar yod longs la shog: rig 'dzin gnam lcags rdo rje'i bka' byung bas: ngos bstod lkog smad dmag jag dgra dpung dang : kha 'jam zhe nag yon bdag gzhungs ngan dang :

nor rdzas 'phrog bcom slob bu dam log dang : bran g.yog grwa 'khor ngo log rgyab ston rigs: bdag la gnod byed thams cad khyed la gtad: drag rtsal gshin rje'i las kyi 'khor los khrid: byin pa'i zas zo bcol ba'i las 'di sgrubs: sdang dgra bdun rgyud thams cad rtsad nas chod: rā hu la sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha raṃ khā hi: zhes pa 'di yang mi dbang chos kyi rgyal po gsang sngags bstan skyong gis bka' yis nye bar bskul ngor/ khrom gzigs rngam pa rong gi skyed tshal nas gza' 'dud kyi rgyal po hūm̐ kā la artsig gis sbyar bas ma rungs bstan dgra sgrol ba'i mtshon char shog/ // ༈ de nas gter srung btsan rgod kyi phrin las bcol zhing gtor ma 'bul ba ni: dzaḥ rab 'jigs pho brang mchong lding smug po'i gnas: rtag tu 'gyu ba'i byang shar ma ru rtse: sham bha la yi gnod sbyin me 'od gdong : me ri 'bar ba gsang bdag gtum po yis: rdo rje phur pa'i dkyil 'khor gral du bzhag: gsang sngags bstan pa skyong ba'i gnyer byang gtad: bla med dkyil 'khor skyong bar zhal bzhes bzhin: de ltar sngon gyi tha tshig ma 'da' bar: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rgyud srung rin chen gter gyi bya ra mdzod: ta ma la ru pra bha hastī la: gsang bdag gtum po'i bka' bab lung bstan rnyed: yang phur 'bum sde'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes nas: pad+ma 'byung gnas rgyal tshab mnga' gsol tshe: rdo rje lta ba klong yangs rgyud sde'i don: rig 'dzin rnam gnyis dbyings rig gcig tu rdzogs: dgongs don brda bzhi'i gnyer kha gtad pa'i tshe: gnod sbyin khyod kyis khas blangs dam bcas bzhin: gsang sngags tha tshig gnyan las ma 'da' bar: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rin chen gter srungs phyi nang bar chad sol: yang le shod du gsang phur bka' rgya gdams: jo mo mtsho rgyal phur pa'i gdeng tshad thob: bal bod mtshams su lha srin dam la btags:

mchims phur yang dag snying po sgrub pa mdzad: rje 'bangs grogs lnga gsang phur gtad pa'i tshe: bka' yi tha tshig rol pa mched la gdams: ma 'ongs brgyud 'dzin skyong bar zhal bzhes bzhin: sngon tshe pad 'byung bka' las ma 'da' bar: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: ༈ phrin las bcol ba rdo rje'i bden tshig bzhugs so/ ho/ rigs gsum sprul pa'i zlos gar/ lha klu gnyan gyi sde dpon/ rgyal ba yongs kyi bstan srung gsang sngags sgrub pa'i grogs mdzad/ dkar po dge ba'i gnyan po/ 'dzam gling yul gru'i mnga' bdag /rin chen gter gyi srung ma/ rnal 'byor bdag gi dgra lha/ sdang byed dgra bo'i gshed ma/ pha rol sgrol ba'i mtshon cha/ dregs byed kun gyi yang rje/ legs nyes las kyi stangs 'dzin/ lha mchog rdo rje mched gsum 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams la phrin las su bcol ba ni/ spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ dge 'dun gyi sde skyongs/ zab gsang rdo rje theg pa'i bka'i tha tshig gnyan po'i phrin las g.yel ba med par sgrubs shig /bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa'i nad mug mtshon 'khrug mi mthun pa 'jigs pa brgyad kyi g.yul ngo phyogs ngan thams cad zhi ba dang*/ mthun rkyen 'dod pa'i tshe bsod snyan grags rlung rta dbang thang thams cad 'bad med lhun grub tu rgyas par mdzod cig khams gsum srid pa'i phywa g.yang*/ lha klu gnyan gyi longs spyod/ gling bzhi skye 'gro'i mnga' thang snang zhing srid par gnas pa'i ka cha dkor nor thams cad khab len rdo yis lcags phye blangs pa ltar dbang du sdus shig /sdang bar byed pa'i dgra bo lha srung dang bcas pa dgra jag chom rkun gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa thams cad drag po'i stobs kyis bya sgro me la shor ba ltar srung ba'i gur shigs/ skyob pa'i lha dang phrol/ dmag mi dang 'og rta phyes la go cha dang mtshon cha sil bur thongs shig

/dpa' ba'i snying gtord cig /dbang lnga don snying bzhes la bstan srid ma lus pa thams cad thal zhags rlung gis gtor ba ltar phyogs med du choms shig /bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pas ci bsams pa'i don 'bras mchog gi dngos grub chen po pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi rang bzhin bsgom med a ti'i rgyal sa zin cing 'phro rgod bying ba'i rtog tshogs spun po'i bar chad rnams gtan nas gzhom pa dang*/ thun mong rim gnyis kyi dngos grub tshe chos zas nor longs spyod mnga' thang snyan grags dpal 'byor thams cad yid bzhin nor bu ltar dgos 'dod 'byung zhing ri rgyal ltar dpangs mtho la/ rgya mtsho ltar gting zab cing*/ lho sprin ltar mthug cing phyug pa klu rgyal chen po brgyad kyis yang 'gran bzod bral ba'i bde skyid phun sum 'tshogs shing ci bsams pa'i 'bras bu thams cad 'bad med lhun grub tu 'byung ba dang*/ zab gsang rdo rje theg pa'i bstan srid zab mo lha klu gnyan gsum gyis tha grur khyab cing dkar po dge ba'i rgyal mtshan lha gnas yangs pa'i rtse mor gyen du bsgreng ba'i phrin las dam pa mdzod cig /ces pa'ang rang 'dod kyi bcol tshig 'di rgyal ming gis 'bri gung du bris pa'o// // ༈ gter srung klu yi dge bsnyen gyi gtor 'bul ni/ hūm̐: yid 'ong rgya mtsho gling gi mnga' dbang sgyur: rin chen gter gyi rgya bsrung bya ra gyis/ /rtag tu gsang sngags bstan pa'i mel tshe mdzod: sgrub pa'i bu la brtse bas ma bzhin skyongs: mchog thun yid bzhin dngos grub char ltar phob: bsod nams re skong phrin las sna tshogs sgrubs: 'dod rgu srid la 'dzam gling kha lo sgyur: 'bad rtsol med pa'i dbul phongs pre ta sol: gsang sngags bstan pa'i bya ra dbyings nas skyongs: sngags 'chang bdag la lus dang grib bzhin 'grog: phyag rgya drug gis grol lam dga' bzhi skyed: phun tshogs yar zla ltar bskyed phrin las mdzod:

grogs ldan dgyes pa'i klu dbang yab yum gyis: dam rdzas gser skyems phud dang dkar gsum sogs: gtsang sbyar gtor ma 'bul ba bzhes su gsol: mnyes shing dgongs pa dgyes par bskyed nas su: snang srid lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du sdus: dgos 'dod bsod nams dpag med nam mkha'i khyon: ji ltar smon pa'i 'bras bu mchis pa'i grogs: klu rgyal 'khor dang bcas pas 'grub par mdzod: om̐ āḥhūm̐: sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: dge bsnyen gtor 'bul pad+ma rgyal po nas khol du phyung ba'o/ hūm̐ bh+yo: dgongs su gsol lo rtsa ba gsum gyi lha/ /gsan du gsol lo dam can dregs pa'i sde/ /dam rdzas rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /gnod pa'i dgra bgegs thal ba rdul bzhin rlogs/ /ma dang mkha' 'gro'i bka' rtags phyag gi rgya/ /'gro ba'i dus bab khyed kyi phrin las la/ /tho brtsam bdud sde'i snying khar rtsa ba gsum/ /rab khros gtum drag rngam pa'i bro chen rdungs/ /dam pa rnams dang dam pa'i spyod tshul la/ /log par 'khu ba'i ma rungs tshul 'chos mkhan/ /mda' lnga'i bdag po dug gi rkyal bu des/ /myur du sgrol ba'i phrin las dus la bab/ /mi min mir brdzu lha min lhar brdzu zhing*/ /dam sri'i sprul pa mkhas pa'i tshul bzung nas/ /blo dman log pa'i lam la 'phen byed pa'i/ /gsang sngags bstan pa'i dgra de myur du sgrol/ /o rgyan pad+ma'i bstan pa bshig mkhan po/ /mtho dman drag zhan gang gi khrod gnas kyang*/ /lo zla zhag dang za mar ma 'jog par/ /da lta myur du sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod/ mi pham pas so/ ༈ sku gsum dgongs 'dus las: rtsa gsum srung ma'i bstod bskul gnam lcags 'khor lo zhes bya ba: yi dam lha yi bsnyen song rnal 'byor pas: bstod bskul drag po gzhol 'dod na: 'bru nag dmar gtor sha khrag brgyan ldan la: dgra bgegs dmigs bya'i rnam shes bkug bstims nas: bdud rtsir byin brlabs sngags kyis so sor bsngos:

dar nag g.yab cing rkang sogs rol mos bskul: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ da lta snyigs ma lnga bdo'i yang mtha' 'dir: skye bo'i sdig spyod chos byed srung sdom nyams: dge 'dun nang dbyen bstan pa'i rtsa lag rul: mdo sngags nang 'khon chos spangs sdig chen bsags: phyi nang rten 'brel log pas 'byung ba 'khrugs: las ngan mtsho rdol mi 'dod rlung dmar 'tshubs: ma mo thugs 'khrugs lha srung bdud du bab: nad mug mtshon sprin sdug bsngal char rgyun 'bebs: 'gro rnams nyam thag rgyal bstan nub la nye: spyod ngan 'bras smin dus ngan me 'bar tshe: rgyal ba thugs rje'i rang bzhin ye shes spyan: mi mngon dbyings nas gzigs pa'i dkon mchog gsum: ma g.yel bzhengs shig stobs bcu'i bdag nyid dgongs: dus la bab bo rgyal ba sras dang bcas: chos dbyings mkha' las gzugs kyi skur bzhengs shing : sna tshogs thabs mkhas cho 'phrul rgya mtsho'i gnas: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dgongs su gsol: khyad par ma mgon lcam dral 'khor tshogs dpung : brgyud gsum dregs pa'i dmag tshogs dbyings nas bzhengs: zhi rgyas dbang drag mdzad pa dpag med kyis: 'gro mang thabs kyis sgrol ba'i thugs rje rmad: phrin las mkha' dang mnyam par bdag bstod do: dam rdzas sman dang dmar chen rak+ta'i mtsho: 'dod yon rgyan gyi mchod gtor dam pa 'dis: nyams pa skong la g.yar dam sor stsol zhing : ma mo 'khrugs dang srung ma'i 'khon bcugs byang : ma g.yel ma g.yel phyogs bcu'i dgra gdon bgegs: shugs sgrol stobs kyis bdud sde'i dpung chen choms: dregs pa'i za kha kla klo'i dpung la ya: gtor ma 'di dang dgra bgegs dbyer med par: zo zhig rold cig kha rje dbang thang khams: ming gi lhag mar mdzod cig mā ra ya: srung ma dam la mi dgongs ci la dgongs: drag rtsal dgra la mi rbad su la rbad: rnal 'byor lha la mi 'phrengs gang la 'phrengs: gdung shugs drag pos 'bod rbad deng bskul bas:

mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las mi mdzad rgyu: khyod rnams sngon gyi thugs dam gang du gnyan: de phyir ma g.yel lha dang srung ma'i tshogs: nyam thag snyigs ma'i 'gro la nyer dgongs te: gsang gsum rdo rje'i rtsal shugs cher bskyed nas: gnyer gtad las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod: gtor ma dgra phyogs dor la gnyer kha gtad: dgra dpung rdo rje yin kyang 'jig nus pa'i: sgyogs chen gsang 'dzin dpa' bo'i lag cha 'di: dam med rang 'dod can la shor ra re: bag med spyad na rang nyid phung bas gzob: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: ྀatshaḥ zhes pa'ang 'gro 'dul pad rgyal gling pa'i sbas yul pad+ma bkod kyi chos sde yang dag pa'o: ༈ phrin las bcol ba ni/ rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i bka' sdod dam tshig can/ /rgyal ba'i bstan srung dbang po khyed rnams kyis/ /sangs rgyas bstan dang mdo sngags bshad sgrub sde/ /'phel rgyas yun du gnas pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes chen dam pa rnams/ /zhabs pad brtan cing zab chos gong du 'phel/ /'gro kun smin grol bde la 'god pa dang*/ /bzhed pa'i don kun lhun gyis 'grub par mdzod/ /bye brag rgyal bstan rtsa lag snga 'gyur bstan/ /o rgyan pad+ma'i ring lugs 'dzin pa kun/ /phyogs dus kun tu dar rgyas yun du gnas/ /rnam bzhi'i phrin las lhun gyis 'grub par mdzod/ /sngags 'chang sgrub po gnam lcags rdo rje yi/ /rigs dang chos kyi brgyud pa 'dzin pa'i bu/ /zab chos nyams su len pa'i 'dus pa rnams/ /yon 'byor 'khor 'bangs kun tu dar rgyas mdzod/ /yang zab zab mo'i ring lugs snying po'i bstan/ /phyogs dus gnas skabs kun tu dar rgyas shing*/ /srid mthar bstan cing smin grol 'bras bu thob/ /rang gzhan don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub par mdzod/ /yul ris rgyal khams sa phyogs thams cad du/ /char chu dus 'bebs lo phyugs rtag tu legs/ /'bru rnams bcud smin rtswa than sad ser zhi/

/nad mug dus kyi 'khrug pa zhi bar mdzod/ /tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor ba dang*/ /bu nor 'khor 'bangs mnga' ris rgyas par mdzod/ khams gsum srid gsum lha 'dre mi gsum gyi/ /skye 'gro'i snang ba dbang du 'du bar mdzod/ /mtha' bzhi'i dmag dpung rgya 'dre 'gong po dang*/ /dam sri bdud rigs brlag dang bzlog par mdzod/ /ma rungs sems 'chang zhing bcu ldan pa yi/ /dgra bo phyi nang phyogs mtshams gar gnas kyang*/ /ring bar khugs la rngam pa'i stobs kyis sod/ /sha khrag lhag med rol la bstab par bzhes/ /mdor na o rgyan chen po'i spyan sngar ru/ /dam bca' bzhin du bstan pa gnyan po srungs/ /dam las ma 'da' brgyud 'dzin bu bzhin skyongs/ /'gro ba bde skyid dpal la spyod par mdzod/ /dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ ces phrin bcol 'di nyid 7rje btsun rin po che lo hā badz+ra gyi zhal slob phyogs med dā ri dra ma dā ya pas bris smon bzhin 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig /gang zhig yid la dran pa tsam gyis kyang*/ /'dod pa'i dngos grub stsol bar mdzad pa yi/ /srung ma yid bzhin nor bu khyed rnams kyis/ /bdag gi bsam don ma lus 'grub par mdzod/ 'gro mgon phag mo grub pas so// // ༈ bstan pa'i dpal gyur bla ma'i zhabs pad brtan/ /bstan 'dzin skyes bu sa steng yongs la khyab/ /bstan pa'i sbyin bdag mnga' thang 'byor ba rgyas/ /bstan pa yun ring gnas pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /gzhan yang ljongs 'dir nad mtshon mu ge dang*/ /mi mthun rgud pa'i ming yang mi grags shing*/ /gsang chen bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas pa dang*/ /'gro kun bde skyid ldan pa'i phrin las mdzod/ khyad par rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas/ /gzhi byes lam sogs gang du gnas gyur kyang*/ /lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs gyur nas/ /ma yengs bsrung zhing skyob pa'i phrin las mdzod//

// ༈ dung dung snying nas mi brjed gsol btab tshe/ /yang yang mchod cing bstod pa'i bdag sogs kun/ /'jigs 'jigs bar chad dgra las rnam rgyal zhing*/ /'dzum 'dzum dgyes pa'i sgo nas dngos grub stsol/ /rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i thugs rje dang*/ /sgrub brgyud yid bzhin nor bu khyed rnams kyis/ /mdo sngags kun gyi gtsug rgyan pad 'byung rje/ /dbyer med o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa yi/ /bstan pa phyogs dus kun tu rgyas gyur cig/ // om̐/ mthun pa'i dngos grub 'dod rgu'i yid bzhin nor/ /deng 'dir sgrub la stsol zhing byin brlabs nas/ /yid smon rgyas par gyur cig srung ma'i tshogs/ /'gro kun sa bcu'i rtse mor rab gnas shog /gtang rag mchod bstod ni/ om̐/ shrī badz+ra ku mā ra sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ hūm̐: ma bcos lhun grub rdo rje gzhon nu'i dpal: sku yi rgyan rdzogs gar dgus sa gsum g.yo: gsung gis hūm̐ sgra'i drag sngags 'brug ltar sgrogs: thugs mchog mi g.yo yang dag 'khor lo'i gter: bde chen rang bzhin zung 'jug he ru kaḥ 'jigs byed khro rgyal yab yum sku la bstod: sngon tshe o rgyan chen po'i spyan snga ru/ /chos bzhin sgrub pa byed pa'i gang zag la/ /ma yis bu ltar skyong bar zhal bzhes pa/ /chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bstod par 'os pa thams cad la/ /zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyis/ /lus btud pa yis rnam kun tu/ /mchog tu dad pas bstod par bgyi/ nongs pa bshags pa ni/ ma snyed yongs su ma tshang dang*/ /gang yang nus pa ma mchis pas/ /'dir ni bgyi ba gang nongs pa/ /de kun khyed kyis bzod mdzad rigs/ zhes dang yi ge brgya pas nongs pa 'chags/ 'dir ni rten dang lhan cig tu/ /'khor ba srid du bzhugs nas kyang*/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*/

/mchog rnams legs par stsal du gsol/ om̐ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ gats+tsha gats+tsha swa bhā wā nāṃ/ dge ba 'di yi myur du bdag /he ru ka dpal 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'god par shog /bkra shis ni/ rtsa brgyud bla ma'i byin rlabs snying la zhugs/ yi dam lha yis rjes bzung dngos grub thob/ /mkha' 'gro dam can lus dang grib bzhin 'grog /gang bsam lhun gyis 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /dkyil 'khor gzhal yas 'dir yang bkra shis shing*/ /nyin yang bkra shis dpal 'bar ta la la/ /mtshan yang bkra shis dpal 'bar kyi li li/ /nyin mtshan kun tu bkra shis bde legs shog /de dag ni rgyun gyi rnal 'byor ltar du bya ba yin la tshogs kyi skabs ni gzhan du shes so//

༈ gsum pa o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i ring lugs chos skyong yongs rdzogs kyi drag bskul phyogs bsdebs la/ khyad par can gyi dus dang dmigs gsal dgu chen sogs kyi skabs drag bskul bya bar mos na/ snga ma'i gtor 'bul rdzogs ma thag gtor ma rnams sbrengs tshar du bshams la dpal 'bar btsugs/ 'gugs pa drag po spyi ltar bya ba'am min kyang gsham gsal kho nas chog par byas kyang rung la spro bsdu'i skabs dbye shes par bya'o/ ༈ chos skyong yongs rdzogs kyi drag bskul khol du phyung ba bzhugs so// dang po mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i gtor bskul bya ba ni: gtor ma mañdzi'i khar bzhag nas 'gugs gzhug bya ba ni: phaṭḥ na mo: drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang : chos kyi bka' bden pa dang : dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang : chos nyid de bzhin nyid dang chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bka' bden pa dang : khyad par ye shes kyi mgon po legs ldan bya rog gi gdong pa can bka' 'khor las kyi pho nya dang bcas pa'i bden pa chen po'i mthu dang nus pa la brten nas deng 'dir dkyil 'khor zab mo sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa'i dgra bgegs 'byung po gdug cing sdang ba'i tshogs thams cad drag po thun gyi gtor ma 'di la rang dbang med par khug cig: badz+ra aṅku sha ya dza dzaḥ de nas gtor ma de dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag rus par bsam: om̐ āḥhūm̐: mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bsngo zhing 'bul ba'i gnas su gyur pa ni: dpal ye shes mgon po'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: phyag bzhi ma hā kā la'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: phyag drug yid bzhin nor bu'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: ma ning srog bdag nag po'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: dpal 'bar gdong bzhi chen po'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi:

bram ze dur khrod bdag po'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: las kyi mgon po chen po'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: myur mgyogs bya rog gdong can zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: sgrol byed gdong can bzhi yi zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: 'bar ba nag mo rnam bzhi'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: bya rog rngam pa du ma'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: gcan spyang 'dur byed du ma'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: yang sprul las kyi bya ra du ma'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: hoḥ dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs rnams la sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma phul bas gdug cing sdang ba'i dgra bo thams cad tshar gcod pa mngon spyod kyi las dang ldan par gyur cig: om̐ shrī ma hā kā la sha sa naṃ u pa ha ri ṇi e ka a pa tsi ma hā kā la e yaṃ ka la khā kha mu bh+yo ma tri san+dha li ku lu ku lu du pra ma ya sarba i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: zhes pas bdud rtsis bran te gtor ma la dpal 'bar btsugs: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: rngam zhing 'jigs pa'i gnas mchog u tsa la: dur khrod chen po phra men kun tu rgyu: nye zhing tshang tshing 'khrigs pa'i gnas kyi mchog: shin tu rngam pa'i 'byung 'jug bsil ba'i tshal: gling gi dbang gyur laṅka'i yul dang nye: srid pa 'di ru ci srid gling gi cha: 'khor 'das sa mtshams bral ba'i zhing mchog ni: mtshan ma gzugs bral g.yul las rgyal ba'i gnas: nyon mongs dug rlangs ngam nag sprin ltar g.yo: mtshan mo srid pa'i me chen mched cing 'bar: dus drug rlung nag sngo dmar bu yug 'tshubs: ri bo thams cad keng rus rus pa brtsegs: 'bab chu thams cad khrag gi rba klung 'khrugs: rang bzhin 'byung ba'i drag sngags 'brug ltar sgrog: de ru ye shes 'jig rten 'dus pa yi: tsan dan las grub dur shing rkang gcig pa: mi bzad rtsub pa'i rno ngar rab tu gzengs:

rtse mor dur bya sha gzan skar ltar 'khrugs: rtsa bar dur khyi gcan spyang rlung ltar 'tshubs: mche gtsigs dur phag 'khyugs shing dug sbrul gtibs: gzhan yang mi gdug dur gyi las byed sogs: ro za rnams kyis ngar skad stong ldir ba: de 'dra'i gnas su bzhugs pa'i nag po che: srog bdag chen po las mgon bya rog gdong : mi bsrun khros pa khrag 'thung mthu bo che: mun nag lta bu'i rnam par sgyur ba po: za byed yum dang sprul pa du ma'i tshogs: bskul lo mngon spyod drag po'i las la bzhengs: mthu ldan khyed kyi thugs dam dus la bab: ma g.yel dam tshig gnyan po'i dus la bab: zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra bgegs sdig can 'di: bla tshe rnam shes srog dbugs 'gyu ba'i tshe: da lta nyid du khug cig sgrol bar mdzod: srog la rngam par rol te rkan sgra rdeb: sha la dgyes pa'i rngam zhal mkha' ltar gdangs: khrag la btung ba'i ljags dmar glog ltar 'khyugs: rus la dkrig pa'i mche ba zangs yag brtsegs: 'dus byas gtor ba'i shangs nas rlung nag 'tshubs: ma rungs sngangs byed snyan nas 'brug stong ldir: gcod byed gri gug mtshon cha skar ltar 'khrugs: rgyas byed bhan dmar rak+ta zhal du 'dren: thogs med spu gri'i sgro gshog dbyings su brgyangs: dpa' ba'i dur khrod chas rdzogs gtum pa po: tsaṇ+ḍi las byed ma mo pang du 'khyud: phyag na mthu ldan las kyi mtshon cha 'dzin: brkyang bskum gar ldan stob 'chang zung du 'jug: 'khrigs pa'i rang bzhin me rlung 'tshub ma 'khyil: las mdzad nag po yab yum dus la bab: dgra sha khrag gi mchod pa 'di bzhes la: sdang zhing gdug pa'i dgra bgegs byad ma rnams: myur du sgrol mdzad las mgon mthu ma chung : zhing bcu'i byad ma sgrol mdzad las la ya: hūm̐: sgrol byed satwa re thogs pa'i dus la bab: de ring dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs shor ra re: las mkhan spu gri thogs pa'i dus la bab: dgra bo pho rgyud rnams kyi sha la zo:

srog bdag ral gri thogs pa'i dus la bab: dgra bo mo rgyud rnams kyi mngal nas skoms: las mkhan phur bu thogs pa'i dus la bab: dgra bo rigs rgyud thams cad rtsad nas chod: hūm̐: 'bar ba zor thogs khyod kyi dus la bab: dgra bo'i mkhar khang thams cad mgo mjug ldog: me yi kha rlangs sog thogs dus la bab: dgra bo'i sgo nor thams cad phyags mas thob: dur khrod be con thogs pa'i dus la bab: dgra bo'i nang spyad ka cha phung shig thongs: gser mig khram shing thogs pa'i dus la bab: dgra bo'i yul zhing thams cad ser bas khongs: bya rog nag po sde bzhi'i dus la bab: dgra bo'i pha tshan thal ba rdul du rlog: bya rog dmar po sde bzhi'i dus la bab: dgra bo'i mi rabs bdun rgyud rtsad nas chod: snying 'dren stag mo mched bzhi'i dus la bab: dam nyams slob ma snying ngan srog rtsa chod: rtsad bcad dom nag mched bzhi'i dus la bab: byad ma yon bdag gzhungs ngan rtsad nas chod: 'gugs byed lcags spyang sde bzhi'i dus la bab: kha 'jam snying rtsub dgra bo'i bla tshe sdud: zangs kyi 'phar ba sde bzhi'i dus la bab: yid la dmigs pa'i dgra bo phung bar gyis: 'phung byed spre'u sde bzhi'i dus la bab: ma rungs dgra la ltas ngan sna tshogs thongs: ltas ngan srin bya rnam bzhi'i dus la bab: dam nyams dgra la cho 'phrul sna tshogs thongs: sprul pa yang sprul rnams kyi dus la bab: dam nyams dgra la mi rung sna dgu thongs: mthu rtsal myur mgyogs chen pos phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: gzhan yang dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs rnams: sprin ltar gtibs shing rlung ltar 'tshubs pa yi: las mdzad chen po 'khor dang bcas pa yis: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dam nyams dgra bo'i snying khrag 'di bzhes la: ma rungs log 'dren srog dbugs 'di bzhes la: sdig can bsgral ba'i phung po 'di bzhes shig: ru tra'i skye mched rnam shes 'di bzhes la:

pha rol gdug pa'i g.yul ngo bzlog tu gsol: ban bon sngags pa'i byad kha bzlog tu gsol: gling bzhi'i yul gyi mi kha bzlog tu gsol: rgya 'dre dam sri smyo 'bog bzlog tu gsol: 'byung po rnams kyi sgab 'dre bzlog tu gsol: mi min lha 'dre'i za kha bzlog tu gsol: srin pos tshe la rku ba bzlog tu gsol: mu stegs nag po'i gtad khram bzlog tu gsol: gshin rje bdud kyi khram kha bzlog tu gsol: klu btsan the'u rang bar chad bzlog tu gsol: yul lha sa bdag gdug pa bzlog tu gsol: mo 'dre sman mos 'tshe ba bzlog tu gsol: lo zla zhag dus skag rigs bzlog tu gsol: mi mthun rkyen ngan bar chad bzlog tu gsol: gdug cing sdang ba'i byad ma dgra bgegs rnams: bka' yi gtor ma 'di dang mnyam por bzhes: dam bca' dus la ma g.yel phrin las mdzod: om̐ ma hā kā la karma he ru ka khā kha mu kha ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ kā li tsaṇ+ḍi ma ma tri mu kha ya baṃ hūm̐ bh+yoḥ om̐ du ma pra ma rak+sha tsa du yak+sha trag rak+mo mu kha li bh+yo bh+yoḥ byad ma nṛ tri ha la ham shang rbad ki kang shag shag du ru du ru hag hu lu ya pha rol byad ma thams cad zlog zlog: rbad nan mā ra ya bh+yo bh+yoḥ zhes gtor ma dgra phyogs su 'phang ngam gang rung bgyis: dpal khrag 'thung bya rog srog gzan nag po byad ma rtsad brlag zhes bya ba chos skyong thun mong ma yin pa kun las 'phags pa 'di nyid sgrub cing mchod pa'i gang zag rnams la nus mthu me las ngar tsha zhing myur mgyogs glog las bang mgyogs par 'byung zhing las kyi he ru ka chen po'i dgongs pa dang nges par mnyam mo: sa ma ya: e ma zab pa'i mthar thug legs ldan rngam klong las: mchod bskang bsgrigs chog yid bzhin 'dod 'jo'i bum: kun 'byung nor bu rin chen 'od rab gsal: ma 'ongs thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: dus bdag chen po'i tha tshig bya ra srungs: sa ma ya:

rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo o rgyan gter bdag gling pas khrom gzigs rngam pa rong gi gnas mchog nas gdan drangs shing shog ser las zhal bshus so// // chos skyong sde lnga'i bskul ni: bskul ring 'di phyogs kyi dmag chen byung ba'am: dgra jag chom pos ka cha 'phrog pa dang : don med kyis dgra rgol sdang sems byung na dgra bo la rtags ma thon bar nyin re rer bskul: do gal chung na tshes dgu dang bcu dgu nyer dgu rnams la bskul: bskul ba'i tshe mchod gtor shin tu rgyas par bya: bye brag phrin las so so'i sham bu sbyar dgos byung na: dgra bo 'di zhes bya ba zer nas dmigs bsal bya: hūm̐ bh+yo dzaḥ mi mngon chos dbyings dag pa'i pho brang nas: ye shes mgon po'i lha tshogs skur bzhengs shig: chos skyong smug mthing thugs dam dus la bab: dur khrod rab 'bar tsā ri'i pho brang nas: zhing skyong dpal 'bar lha tshogs skur bzhengs shig: chos skyong nag po'i thugs dam dus la bab: lho nub me dpung mun rub pho brang nas: drang srong gza' mchog lha tshogs skur bzhengs shig: chos skyong khra bo'i thugs dam dus la bab: byang shar ma ru rtse yi pho brang nas: gnod sbyin btsan rgod lha tshogs skur bzhengs shig: chos skyong dmar po'i thugs dam dus la bab: byang phyogs sham bha la yi pho brang nas: dpe dkar rgyal po'i lha tshogs skur bzhengs shig: chos skyong dkar po'i thugs dam dus la bab: phrin las glog ltar myur ba'i pho brang nas: gter bdag gter srung yongs rdzogs skur bzhengs shig: dam can rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs dus la bab: khyed rnams mi mngon dbyings las bzhugs pa'i lha: gang la bya ba phrin las mngon par mkhyen: bdag ni zob med don gyi rnal 'byor pa: thar pa sgrub cing 'gro don phan sems kyang : bdud dgra 'byung po'i byad du ma ster bas: kun mkhyen mgon pos gzu dpang rgyab rten mdzod:

bka' sdod dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag dpung skyed: deng 'dir pha rol dgra bo byad ma 'dis: byas pa med kyang srog la rgol snyob byed: chags pa med kyang bu lon ded nas byung : nyi ltar gsal yang sprin ltar g.yogs nas byung : char ltar 'bebs kyang rlung ltar gtor nas byung : dung ltar dkar kyang mun ltar gnag nas byung : seng ltar 'gyings kyang rlung ltar 'tshub nas byung : mi ltar bros kyang gshed ltar bsnyags nas byung : lha ltar bstod kyang 'dre ltar smad nas byung : chos ltar bsgrubs kyang sdig ltar bsags nas byung : de ltar dam can rgya mtshos dgongs mdzod cig: rig 'dzin bdag gi byang chub sgrub pa la: 'tshe zhing sdang ba'i byad ma sdig can 'di: lo zla dus la ma 'da' myur du sgrol: khyad par dmag sna jag sna ston pa dang : rku sna ston cing khyad gsod byed pa yi: pha rol byad ma dam nyams sdig can rnams: gnam sa gling bzhi ri rab zom khang dang : chos bon srung ma rnams kyi gur khang skyabs: gzhan yang steng 'og 'khor yug gar gnas kyang : dgra bo mi nor mkhar khang sa gzhi rnams: srid pa las kyi rlung gis mkha' la phyor: myur mgyogs rtsal gyis bar snang dbyings su g.yugs: mngon spyod sgyogs kyis sa gzhi'i mthil du rdobs: phye mar bshig nas ming yang med par gyis: dbyar sos gangs ri rtse nas zhig pa bzhin: dgra bo pho rgyud thams cad rtsad nas chod: ston ser lhag pas me tog khyer ba bzhin: dgra bo mo rgyud thams cad mngal nas skoms: brag ri gnam lcags thog gis bshig pa bzhin: dgra bo'i rten mkhar thams cad rmang nas bsgyil: me rgod 'tshub mas rtswa shing bsregs pa bzhin: dgra bo'i sgo nor thams cad phyags mas thob: spang sgang lcags dbyug ngar mas brdungs pa bzhin: dgra bo'i yul zhing thams cad ser bas khongs: dbal gyi spu gris tā la bcad pa bzhin: dgra bo'i mi rabs bdun rgyud rtsad nas chod:

thal me'i dong du chu nag blugs pa bzhin: dgra bo'i yul zhing thams cad phye mar dkrugs: bya rog 'ug pa 'thab pa'i snang ba bzhin: dgra bo'i pha sde nang tshan 'khrug par gyis: stag g.yag rtsal kha 'gyed pa'i 'phro mtha' bzhin: dgra bo'i dpung tshan gnyis med phung bar gyis: dus la bab bo mthu ldan srung ma rnams: mgon po'i dmag tshogs g.yab dar dgra la phyor: zhing skyong dmag tshogs ru mtshon dgra la phyor: gza' yi dmag tshogs thog mda' dgra la phob: btsan gyi dmag tshogs zhags pa dgra la thob: rgyal po'i dmag tshogs smyo 'bog dgra la thongs: pho nya 'bum gyi dmag tshogs dgra la bh+yoḥ dzaḥ dam can rgya mtsho'i shar gyi las byed pa: dri za'i rgyal po ru lu rta mgo can: dri za'i dmag tshogs sdang ba'i dgra la drongs: shar gyi dgra bgegs thams cad cham la phob: me lha'i rgyal po drang srong ra mgo can: me lha'i dmag tshogs sdang ba'i dgra la drongs: shar lho'i dgra bgegs thams cad cham la phob: gshin rje'i rgyal po'i khram bdag glang mgo can: gshin rje'i dmag tshogs sdang ba'i dgra la drongs: lho yi dgra bgegs thams cad cham la phob: srin po'i rgyal po mgrin bcu mi rgod gdong : srin po'i dmag tshogs sdang ba'i dgra la drongs: lho nub dgra bgegs thams cad cham la phob: klu yi rgyal po zhe sdang sbrul mgo can: klu yi dmag tshogs sdang ba'i dgra la drongs: nub phyogs dgra bgegs thams cad cham la phob: rlung lha'i rgyal po g.yer shing shwa mgo can: rlung lha'i dmag tshogs sdang ba'i dgra la drongs: nub byang dgra bgegs thams cad cham la phob: gnod sbyin rgyal po gti mug lug mgo can: gnod sbyin dmag tshogs sdang ba'i dgra la drongs: byang phyogs dgra bgegs thams cad cham la phob: dbang ldan rgyal po glang po che yi mgo: dbang ldan dmag tshogs sdang ba'i dgra la drongs: byang shar dgra bgegs thams cad cham la phob: gzhon nu tshangs pa bya khyung gdong pa can:

lha yi dmag tshogs sdang ba'i dgra la drongs: steng phyogs dgra bo thams cad cham la phob: sa bdag rgyal po rus sbal gdong pa can: sa bdag dmag tshogs sdang ba'i dgra la drongs: 'og phyogs dgra bgegs thams cad cham la phob: shar gyi dmag dpon chen po yul 'khor srung : lus 'phags gling gi dmag tshogs dgra la drongs: lho yi dmag dpon rgyal po 'phags skyes po: 'dzam bu gling gi dmag tshogs dgra la drongs: nub phyogs dmag dpon rgyal po spyan mi bzang : ba lang spyod kyi dmag tshogs dgra la drongs: byang phyogs dmag dpon rgyal po rnam thos sras: sgra mi snyan gyi dmag tshogs dgra la drongs: dmag dpung bskyed la ru mtshon dgra la phyor: mgon po'i dmag tshogs dar nag pu ru ru: zhing skyong dmag tshogs gtor zor wa la la: gza' yi dmag tshogs thog mda' sha ra ra: chos skyong dmag tshogs ru mtshon lhabs se lhab: shel ging dmag tshogs mtshon cha tshubs se tshub: lha yi dmag tshogs bswo sgra di ri ri: btsan gyi dmag tshogs sho kha tha ra ra: gshin rje'i dmag tshogs khram kha yugs se yug: rgyal 'gong dmag tshogs smyo 'bog chi li li: ma mo'i dmag tshogs nad rlangs phyu ru ru: dmu gnyan dmag tshogs rtsis kha ya la la: bdud kyi dmag tshogs zhags pa khyugs se khyug: klu bdud dmag tshogs mdze nad thibs se thib: dgra lha'i dmag tshogs rta rgyug springs se spring : gzhi bdag dmag tshogs go cha rongs se rong : pho nya'i dmag tshogs las byed nyi li li: bshan pa'i dmag tshogs gri brdar yugs se yug: srog gcod dmag tshogs shan pa rubs se rub: sha za'i dmag tshogs mche ba krigs se krig: khrag 'thung dmag tshogs rkan sgra thags se thag: sprul pa yang sprul nyi zer rdul ltar 'tshub: dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs 'khor bcas kyis: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dam nyams dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: dzaḥ gzhan yang bzlog cing dgra la bsgyur ba ni:

yi dam lha yis bka' chad dgra la zlog: ma sring mkha' 'gros sun ma dgra la zlog: nor lha'i dngos grub chad pa dgra la zlog: dam can las kyi pho nya dgra la zlog: pho rgyud khro bo'i drag sngags dgra la zlog: mo rgyud ma mo'i thun sngags dgra la zlog: gshin rje dregs pa'i 'khor lo dgra la zlog: zhang zhung dzo zor 'phen pa dgra la zlog: 'byung pos thod zor 'phen pa dgra la zlog: drang srong gza' yi dug mda' dgra la zlog: bdud kyis khram kha 'debs pa dgra la zlog: btsan gyis gzer nad gtong ba dgra la zlog: klu yis gtad du bcug pa dgra la zlog: sa bdag zha grum gtong ba dgra la zlog: ma mos rims nad gtong ba dgra la zlog: gnyan gyi lhog yams dmar nad dgra la zlog: gnod sbyin za kha ston pa dgra la zlog: rgyal 'gong smyo 'bog 'khrugs pa dgra la zlog: dmu yis gnam rdo 'phen pa dgra la zlog: ban+des sngags zor 'phen pa dgra la zlog: bon pos gtor zor 'phen pa dgra la zlog: sngags pas kong zor 'phen pa dgra la zlog: skye bos mda' zor 'phen pa dgra la zlog: bud med dmod zor 'phen pa dgra la zlog: gnam nas dal kha 'bebs pa dgra la zlog: sa nas dug mda' langs pa dgra la zlog: phyogs nas dmag chen g.yos pa dgra la zlog: jag pas rta kha bsigs pa dgra la zlog: rkun mas sha chings khur ba dgra la zlog: skag dang spar kha bdun zur dgra la zlog: sme ba dbang thang nyams pa dgra la zlog: rlung rta'i rgya ma chag pa dgra la zlog: phung sri gri sri langs pa dgra la zlog: rgyal po'i bka' yis chad pa dgra la zlog: lo nyes sad ser thams cad dgra la zlog: god kha gyod byur thams cad dgra la zlog: mi kha bram mchu thams cad dgra la zlog: dur sgo gshed sgo bye ba dgra la zlog: na sri 'chi sri thams cad dgra la zlog: nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi dgra la zlog: gdon rigs sum brgya drug cu dgra la zlog: bgegs rig stong phrag brgyad cu dgra la zlog:

ye 'drog sum brgya drug cu dgra la zlog: glo bur brgyad cu rtsa gcig dgra la zlog: dus min 'chi ba rnam brgyad dgra la zlog: byis pa'i gdon chen bco brgyad dgra la zlog: mi mthun rkyen ngan bar chad bdud kyi tshogs: bzlog go drag po'i zor chen 'di yis zlog: bsgyur ro dam nyams dgra bo'i steng du sgyur: bh+yoḥ lha yi bu mo dung gi mche ba can: de ring dmar chen gtor ma'i zor sna drongs: klu yi bu mo dug gi kha phru can: de ring dmar chen gtor ma'i zor sna drongs: bdud kyi bu mo nad kyi rkyal pa can: de ring dmar chen gtor ma'i zor sna drongs: btsan gyi bu mo khrag gi ral pa can: de ring dmar chen gtor ma'i zor sna drongs: srin po'i bu mo zangs kyi gdong pa can: de ring dmar chen gtor ma'i zor sna drongs: myur mgyogs chen mo gdug pa'i bu mo lnga: de ring dam nyams dgra la za kha ston: dgra bgegs thams cad rtsad gcod phrin las mdzod: om̐ ka la ka la dung dung e thun bh+yo bh+yo dgra bgegs byad ma zlog zlog: ka li ra tri shan+ta pa ra nan bring bring bh+yo bh+yoḥ dgra bo byad ma zlog zlog: ma hā kā la singha mu kha si na ra ma bh+yo bh+yoḥ dgra bo byad ma zlog zlog: ki king hri shag ru raṃ nṛ tri myog bh+yo bh+yoḥ dgra bo byad ma zlog zlog: shu la e haṃ ma ru rtse tsa tri ya bh+yo bh+yoḥ dgra bo byad ma zlog zlog: ging ka ra yak+sha dhe wa rak+sha pra ma sha la tri tri dz+wa la ya bh+yo bh+yoḥ dgra bo byad ma zlog zlog: dhe wa ma tri nā ga ma tri du pra ma ma tri shu la ya ma tri rak+sha ma tri sarba rak+ṣa ka ṇa ṣa sa ma ya bh+yo bh+yoḥ dgra bo byad ma mā ra ya zlog zlog: a ya ma du ru tsa sha ghan+dha re a su re kin na re gha ru tra: ma ho rā ga du kha biṣ+ṇi ṣa bh+yo bh+yoḥ dgra bo byad ma thams cad zlog zlog: mā ra ya nan: hūm̐ laṃ laṃ satwaṃ bha ya nan: zhes gtor ma dgra phyogs su 'phang ngam phul ba gal che na zor thab tu 'phang :

'di bskul zor bzlog pa zhes ste: thog mar gtor ma lha yi ngo bo: bar du gtor ma dgra bgegs kyi ngo bo: tha ma gtor ma sha khrag gi ngo bo: slad mar gtor ma mtshon cha'i ngo bo: rjes nas gtor ma ting nge 'dzin gyi ngo bo dang bcas lugs lnga las: thog mar 'bag bsang skabs gtor ma de lha dang : bar du dgra bgegs bkug cing bstim: thim pa'i ngo bo de rang bzhin gyi mtshon chas gtubs nas sha khrag gi ngo bor bsam: de dag chos skyong rnams kyis bzhes pa'i lhag ma phran tsam lus pa de chos skyong rnams kyi kha phru yis byin brlabs pas mtshon cha sna tshogs sgyogs chen lta bas mi bzod pa'i rang bzhin du bsam: bskul zhing 'phang pa'i tshe dgra bgegs rnams la phog pas byad ma rtsad nas brlags te ming yang med par bsam: dgra bo'i tshe bsod dbang thang rang la bsdu: rjes shes mtshon cha dang dgra bo mi dmigs pa'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag: de yang dmag bskul zor gnyis so sor bya na: zur du gtor zlog bsdus pa'i bzlog chung zhig bzos: rbad na zor bzlog skabs gdan chos 'byung gi steng du dpal gtor gri ris can bzhag kyang rung : gtor 'bul thams cad gzhung bzhin byas: zor rnams rtsang dang tshe nyungs kun kyang 'dzugs dmod pa'i las rang gzhung ltar gces: khyad par chos skyong drag po sde lnga'i bskang gsol 'di shin tu bka' gnyan pas rtsal grags che ba gal thod thod tu mi btang : bskang gtor dang gtor zor mi la mi sbyin: bye brag tu dam nyams rnams kyi don du chos skyong mi btang : rigs kyi brgyud pa 'dzin pa dang : gtsug lag khang chos rje rnams kyi sgar gzhis ma gtogs gang yang btang bar mi bya: dpe dang gdams pa mi sbyin gal srid bskang gsol gzhung rnams gzhan don du bya rung las kyi bskul pa mi btang : khā hi'i mtshams nas bzhengs bskul spyi 'gros dang : de nas las mtha'i bzlog byang tsam bya: de bas mang ba gzhan du mi bya:

rig 'dzin rdo rje slob dpon bka' med par dpe dang gdams pa mi sby-in: ci zhe na slob ma snod dang ldan mi ldan pas bskul du mi thub: dpal ye shes kyi mgon po chen po 'di bzhengs dka': legs ldan zhing skyong 'bar ba 'di bka' gnyan: drang srong gza' bdud nag po 'di mthong bas dug che: btsan rgod gnod sbyin 'bar ba 'di stobs dang drag rtsal che: gnod sbyin rgyal po dpe dkar gdeng che la zhe nag: de bas na bskyed rdzogs kyi gdeng med pa rnams kyis spyod du mi thub pa'i rgyu de ltar snang ngo : dngos blo'i dad pa dam tshig 'dun pa gtsang ba rnams la bran bzhin du mchis par 'gyur ro: sa ma ya: e maḥ mngon spyod phul byung shes rab spu gri'i mtshon: dgra bgegs sdig can rnams la phyung zhing brdeg: las kyi rlung dang gnam lcags 'khyug pa'i thog: gang la btab kyang 'gog med rtsal po che: gang gis mi bzlog las kyi sgyogs po che: ma 'ongs yang mtha' dus kyi mtha' gyur tshe: bstan dgra sgos dgra bsgral ba'i mtshon char shog: dpal gyi mchims phur mi nub a thaṃ rgya: bka' yi chos 'di dam can sde lngas skyongs: dam med bdud kyi lag tu ma shor gtad: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: mi nub rgya: sngags 'chang rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos sa pho khyi lor bod yul bsam yas mchims phu'i ke'u tshang nas gdan drangs shing me pho rta yi lo la sbas yul bdud 'dul gsang sngags gling du zangs shog dmar po nas zhal bshus so/ dge legs 'phel// // las bskul bka' rgya ma ni gzhan du shes par bya'o/ ༈ lha mo drag mo'i bskul ni/ hūm̐ bh+yoḥ gtum drag tshal dang tshang tshing 'khrigs: gsang chen he yi dur khrod nas: dbyings phyug lha mo skur bzhengs shig: rigs bzhi ma mo skur bzhengs shig: shan pa ma gsum skur bzhengs shig: bzhengs shig bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod:

dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab: rang bzhin mi dmigs chos dbyings kyang : thabs kyi cho 'phrul skur ston ma: mkha' la dbang sgyur dpal 'bar ma: dkar mo snang srid dbang mo che: khros ma dkar mo srid pa'i rgyal: sprul pa dmar mo khrag mig ma: nag mo khros ma bdud kyi lcam: srin mo glog gi phreng ba can: yak+sha'i bu mo re ma ti: gdol pa'i bu mo dung skyong ma: gshin rje'i bu mo ya ma nag: sngags bdag ral gcig kha mo che: u ma dhe wa lha min mo: sde brgyad yongs kyi gtso mo ste: mngon spyod las la chas pa'i tshe: phyag g.yas zangs kyi gri gug gdeng : dgra bgegs gzugs phung mgo lus phral: g.yon pas klad khrag zhal du gsol: dam sri snying nas bkums par byed: mkha' la myur mgyogs lam lam 'gro: cang shes rlung gi shugs can zhon: stong gsum dmigs pas yud kyis bskor: lha dang lha min gtso mo mdzad: res 'ga' srin mo'i cha lugs 'chang : bong bu gwa dmar zhon pa yis: rlung nag 'tshub ma'i sna yang 'dren: dgra la khrag nad dmar yams 'bebs: stong gsum nad kyi bskal pa bsnyil: srid pa 'di yi srog gi bdag: rngam zhing byad mar rbad pa'i tshe: kha nas lce spyang sprul pa 'gyed: pu tra sngon mo spyang ki'i gdong : pu tra nag mo khyi yi gdong : pu tra dmar mo stag gi gdong : pu tra ser mo gzig gi gdong : pu tra las byed dred mong gdong : pu tra mthar byed dom gyi gdong : pu tra nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi: gtso mor gnas tshe g.yag gi gdong : gnas yul dbang phyug nyi shu brgyad: nyid kyi sprul pa ma mo bzhi: dkar mo nyi zla'i phreng ba can: ser mo srid gsum rmang nas bsnyil: dmar mo rgya mtsho chol bur gtor: ljang mo dug gi kha rlangs g.yo: las byed ma mo shan pa mo: dmar mos khrag gi ral pa bsigs: nag mos nad rkyal dgra la 'phyo: sngon mos spu gris dam sri bkums: phyag gnyan shan pa 'bum 'bum 'phyo:

lha mo dus mtshan dmag gi rgyal: dgra lha ma khyod dbyings nas bzhengs: 'dir gshegs sha khrag gtor ma longs: rak+ta dmar gyi mchod pa 'bul: bdud rtsi gser skyems mchod pa 'bul: dgra bgegs sdig can bsgral ba yi: tsit+ta snying dang dbang po lnga: gzugs phung bsgral ba'i mchod pa 'bul: khyad par dam sri 'byung po dang : log lta dam nyams bdud kyi rigs: lha mo khyed la gtad pa'i yul: nag mo khyed kyi khong pa nas: dug gi rlangs pa phyur du phob: nad kyi sa mkhar dgra la chos: mtshon gyi gru gu dgra la 'phyo: lha yi byang bu dkar po la: dgra bo'i bla rtags myur du phob: bdud kyi byang bu nag po la: dgra bo'i mi nor myur du phob: btsan gyi byang bu dmar po la: dgra bo'i rten yul myur du phob: gshin rje'i khram ldan nag po la: dgra bo'i pha sde myur du phob: bstan pa'i ru tra sdig can 'di: srid rtse mnar med ri rab zom: nyi zla'i khong dang ban bon gur: gling bzhi gling phran gar gnas kyang : ma mo khyod kyis sgrol bar gyis: khyad par dam nyams dgra bo 'di'i: mi rabs bdun rgyud rtsad nas chod: dam sri dam nyams bdud kyi rigs: bka' la 'khu zhing dam g.yel ba'i: sdig can dgra bo shor ra re: rbad pa'i mngon spyod dus la bab: bka' las ma 'da' dam tshig can: sngon tshe pad 'byung spyan snga ru: tha tshig dmod de las bcol ba'i: gzu dpang lha mo khyed bskul bas: dus las ma 'da' phrin las mdzod: bh+yo bh+yoḥ dgra la bdud du babs pa'i tshe: dkar mo snying gi phreng ba thogs: ser mo gshin rje'i khram shing thogs: dmar mo zangs kyi sho rdel thogs: nag mo rtsis kyi sho bkra thogs: 'chi bdag srin mo khrag ral ma: gling bzhi 'di yi srog gi bdag: spu gri nad kyi rkyal pa thogs: gnas chen lnga la dbang yang bsgyur: dregs pa'i bu mo mthu rtsal can: rbad do mngon spyod phrin las mdzod: za byed 'bar ma mche ba can:

nag mo glog zhags rdeb ma ste: srin mo sha za kha mo che: pha rol rgol ba'i dgra bgegs kyi: mi khyi rta gsum zhal du 'bul: srin mo mched gsum dus la bab: dgra la glo bur rbad pa'i tshe: lcags kyi spyang ki sngon mo la: btsan bdud srid pa'i bu mos zhon: zhal nas khrag gi kha rlangs 'thul: dgra la dmar nad char du 'bebs: khrag gi ral pa bsigs pa las: nyi zla mi snang 'od kyang nyams: spu gri dgra la btab pa'i tshe: 'dzam gling khrag gi rba rlabs 'khrugs: nad rkyal dgra la 'phyo ba'i tshe: klu nad mdze dang lhog yams 'bebs: rngams shing drag tu bskul ba'i tshe: snang srid rlung gi gshog par rgyu: khyed rnams las kyi ma mo ste: tho rangs skya rengs rta la zhon: btsan gyi bu mos dus la bab: dgra la gzer thum sbos gris sod: mun rub smag rum rta la zhon: srin po'i bu mos dus la bab: dgra bo'i tsit+ta myur du chod: nam phyed bying rmugs rta la zhon: bdud kyi bu mos dus la bab: dgra bo'i rnam shes phye mar gtor: mā ra ya las grub pa mo: mā las spros pa'i pho nyas khug: ra las spu gri 'bar bas sgrol: ya las gtub gtor bzhes su gsol: byad ma dgra bgegs kyi bla srog rnam shes la kha kha khā hi khā hi: bh+yo bh+yo ma mo rak+mo tri dgra bo'i bla srog rnam shes la kha kha khā hi khā hi: liṅga zhig dang gtor ma sha dum zhig 'bul: de nas zor thogs te: dpal ldan re ma ti ltar bskul ba ni: 'di bai ro tsā nas yer pa zla ba phug tu bzhugs pa'i tshe: btsun mo bza' ba dmar rgyan la mdze nad par bu ma mo'i nad rkyal skor sgrub pa'i gnas de nyid du sbas pa las: khrigs bsdebs 'di yi cha lag tu: gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes la grogs kyi dga' ston du: nus pa me ltar du 'bar ba'i bskul yin pas: da grogs po khyod la sbyin: ngas kyang nus rtags thon pa yin: khyod la rang mthu che zhing nus pa dang ldan pa yod rung :

ma 'ongs pa'i don du bdag gis bka' 'bogs: khyod kyang dga' mgur spyod cig gsungs nas gdams mo: de yi bskul btang ba la: gtor ma tshe yungs kyis brgyan: rtsang nyi shu rtsa gcig gzug: rdzas phung shul gyi sa dang dur rdo: klu gnyan gnas pa'i rdo dkar nag khra gsum gyi: dkar po la: a tri bi shu tsa ka su na ke hu se bh+yoḥ khra bo la: ma tri shu ba e tri shug nan bh+yoḥ nag po la: ke du tri spra na he phu lu bh+yoḥ gtor ma'i zur gsum du bzhag: 'di'i skabs su dmigs bsal yod na dgra bo'i rkang rjes g.yon pa'i sa bsres pa'i liṅga zhig bzos par: 'gugs gzhug gang mang bgyis nas de'i snying khar zor btab pas chog: bskul ring thung gnyis zor phyogs gcig 'phang ba gtor dril yin: gtor mar dpal 'bar btsugs la: bskul gtong ba ni: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ he ru ka yi gnas bcu yi: rdo rje gdan gyi byang shar mtshams: mu le mthing gi mtsho nang nas: 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma: pha ni dbang phyug ma hā dhe: ma ni klu mo gdol pa'i rigs: de gnyis 'tshogs pa'i ma mo che: sku mdog mthing nag 'bar ba la: zhal gdangs spyan rtsa glog ltar 'gyu: a la la yi gad mo sgrogs: zhal du mi ro krig krig gsol: dbu skra dmar nag dud sprin gtibs: sku stod zhing chen g.yang gzhi gsol: sku smad re lde nag po dkris: thod rlon sbrul nag chun pos spras: dbu la rma bya'i sgro phod bskyon: phyag g.yas spu gri dmar po phyar: g.yon pas dgra bgegs klad khrag rol: bong bu gwa dmar rta la zhon: srin po pho mo'i sga stan spras: mtshon gru nad rkyal zung du thogs: srid pa gangs dkar rtse yi bdag: tshangs mo seng gdong sngon du 'phyo: klu bdud mtsho nag gnyan srin mo: chu srin gdong can rgyab tu 'brang : gdug pa'i lus la rtsub pa yi: bshan pa chen mo gtso 'khor gsum: rig 'dzin bdag gi bos pa'i tshe: tshangs pa'i gnas dang klu yi yul:
