'dzam gling 'di ru gar mchis kyang : ma thogs yud kyis gnas 'dir byon: khyed rnams las kyi rdzu 'phrul can: gzugs med mngon par shes pa rtogs: gang la ci bgyis khyod kyis shes: bdag ni rnal 'byor ma nyes so: tshe gcig byang chub sgrub pa la: bdud dang dam sris glags 'tshol so: 'gong po dam sri'i sna 'dren ma: srin mo dmar rgyan nam: dam nyams dgra bo shor ra re: gzugs phung sde brgyad khram du thob: bstan dgra

dmar rgyan nam dam nyams shor ra re: steng phyogs tshangs pa 'phrul gyi gnas: skar mda' 'bebs pa drag mo'i gdong : dbang phyug ma hā dhe ba dang : u ma dhe ba'i sras gcig ma: seṅge'i gdong can dus la bab: dam nyams dgra bo shor ra re: gza' nad steng grib char du phob: srid pa'i rgyal mo'i dus la bab: bstan dgra dam nyams shor ra re: khrag nad dmar yams me ltar 'phyo: chu srin gdong can dus la bab: dgra bo'i mi nor shor ra re: mdze nad lhog yams rdul ltar phob: dmigs pa'i byad ma gdug can 'di: bsrung yul skyabs 'og gar gnas kyang : ma gsum sring bzhis myur du khug: srid pa'i ma mo'i zas skal du: gtad do ma shor mthu ma chung : dgra bo'i pha sde nang tshan rnams: seṅge'i gdong can khyod la gtad: lha yi sde dpon dmag tshogs kyis: bsgral ba'i las mdzad rtsal ma zhan: chu srin gdong can khyod la gtad: klu bdud nag po'i dmag tshogs kyis: mdze nad thob cig bang ma bul: dmigs pa'i dgra bo shor ra re: nyes can bstan dgra ma bkums na: lha mo re ti dam g.yel lam: khyed rnams las kyi pho nyar rbad: rgya mtshor gnas pa'i srog len ma: klu bdud pho nyar bskul du rbad: ma mo klu srin gdong pa yis: dgra bo'i lus ngag yid gsum la: klu yi mdze nad bco brgyad thob: sngon tshe pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: mchims phur bka' bsgos dam bcas bzhin: rnal 'byor bdag la dgra byung na: srung ma dam can ra mda' rgyugs: lo zlar bzhag pa'i go skabs zad: mngon spyod yud kyis 'grub par mdzod: bh+yo bh+yoḥ ma mo nag mo kha la ral gcig la bh+yoḥ rak+mo ya ma dz+wa la bstan dgra dam nyams kyi dmar rgyan ma sogs sam srog rtsa la thun bh+yoḥ rak+mo kha rag dun+te a byā ta byā thun bh+yoḥ dgra bo'i tsit+ta la bh+yoḥ nā ga ti pa ra tsa myog myog: dgra bo'i sha la kying kying : khrag la rbad rbad: rus la shig shig: snying rtsa la 'ur 'ur: kaṃ shaṃ tri de shaṃ thun thun:

nā ga du pra ma kā li ha te ru tra sha truṃ rmo lo chod: ti lo sha ya rbad: trig trig byad ma'i srog rtsa khrag rtsa la 'dus 'dus: 'ur 'ur sa ma ya myog myog: nan rbad rbad: bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: ces srid pa ma bdud rgyal mo 'khor dang bcas pa bskal pa drag spyod kyi rlung ltar 'tshubs nas dmigs yul byad ma'i bla rten rnam shes phral nas: nad kyi rkyal kha phye: mtshon kyi gru gu gtor: klu'i mdze nad phab: lha srung bdud du bsgyur: lus ngag yid gsum thams cad chur bying ba ltar gyur pa'i dmigs pa bya: khyad par klu bdud ti pa ra tsa lcags sdig gi rnams pa can nam: sdom gyi dbyibs su yod pa de dgra bo'i sna bug g.yas nas zhugs te snying gar sleb pas: klu snying kun nag po'i pho brang du gyur par bsgom: sdom gzugs brkyang bskum bgyis pas khog pa'i rtsa mig thams cad khyab cing gang ba'i sbal lcong sbrul gyi rnam par bsam mo: de ltar dmod pa'i las bgyis pas bza' ba dmar rgyan mdze nad kyis gzir bar 'gyur ro: sngags rkang dmigs rim hrag bsdus 'di nyid lha mo rngam sgra ma'i bskor: de ltar zlog dmigs sogs kha sgyur dang 'gres rkang thams cad 'bri gung gzho stod du gsungs pa bzhin: dpal bsam yas su thugs sras nyer lnga la gdams pa gtad pa'i tshe khrigs chags su bkod pa'o: mchims phu dang gzho stod yer pa phug sogs shog dril so sor yin: sa ma yaḥ ma mo thun mong ma yin pa 'di nyid thugs kyi bu lnga la rab tu gdams pa gcig brgyud khyad par can no: kho mo mtsho rgyal bdag gi ka ti ka yi dkyil du sbas te sbyar ba'o: sa ma ya: kho bo gnubs ban sangs rgyas ye shes kyis lo paṇa gyi dga' ston du gnang ba la: dpal lha mo dgyes pa'i ka bstod dga' ston khrag 'thung rngam sgra gdangs su mchis so: bh+yo bh+yoḥ kā li nag mo ma skyes chos sku'i mdangs: kha mo cher bgrad sha za rab 'bar ma:

ga shal la sogs g.yang gzhi'i rgyan spyod mdzes: nga ro ston gyis srid gsum khyon yang 'gengs: ca co mi bgyid bya ra'i mel tshe ma: cha lugs rnam par rgyal ba'i dpa' mor bstod: ja chang phud rgod la sogs drag po'i rdzas: nya rgyas 'gengs pa'i mchod sprin g.yo ba 'di: ta thā ga ta'i bstan srung lha mor 'bul: tha dad mchis kyang gsang sngags rgyal bstan skyongs: da la dkyil 'khor kun gyi dbang mo che: nā da ye shes rab dga' gsal stong ma: pa la bstan pa skyong byed sna tshogs gar: pha rol dgra bgegs mthar ba'i dbang mo che: ba spu'i dbyings las spros pa'i las mkhan gyis: ma rungs dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: tsā ri tra sogs nyer bzhi'i dbang mo che: tsha rong gnas sogs skyong ba'i g.yu sgron ma: dza yig spros pa'i pho nya ma mo gsum: wa ltar zhum pa'i dgra bo'i snying nas chums: zha rengs lkugs sogs smyo zhing 'bog par gyis: za gsod dbugs longs dgra bo'i snying khrag gtor: 'a ya he yis 'bod pa'i las mkhan tshogs: ya nga las kyi gshin rjes sa steng g.yo: ra gzengs sdig pa klu'i pho nya bzhin: la la dus la ma 'da' ci bzhin sgrol: sha khrag rgyu lus ngan goms dgra bo 'di: dmar rgyan ma'am mchan/ sa steng 'di nas zhan 'khri chod pa yis: ha ha'i dga' ston dwang ba'i dge mchis nas: a don skye med ye shes rtsal rdzogs shog: ces pa rjes su yi rangs te bstod pa 'di ni sangs rgyas ye shes dpal gyis so: sa ma ya: de nas rjes chog rgyas bsdus ci rigs gzhung nas med rung : rang bzhin chos mthun gyi spyi khog kha tshar btags pas chog go: 'di nyid ma mo'i rgyud phreng 'dzam gling snyan grags dang rgyud kha mthun gong 'og yin pas: slan chad kyang de ka'i bka' srung du'ang 'dod do: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: ḍāk+ki'i rgya: rig 'dzin rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos 'bri gung gzho stod ti sgro'i gnas nas gdan drangs shing shog ser las zhal bshus so/

sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ 'khor 'das zil gnon gter srung gza' yi bskul ni/ skabs su dgra ling 'gugs pa ni: hūm̐ rā hu la ki kang ya ma dgra bgegs raṃ tri ta ha la mā ra ya khug khug dza dzaḥ dgra bo ngag mnan ni: oṃ tri gra ha kham lo ka ya dgra bo wāka satwaṃ bha gzer nan: dgra bor thun brdeg pa ni: oṃ ki kang hrī shag nā ga ha la dgra bo'i bla srog gzer thum bhi sha bhi sha ka ra tri ya rbad rbad: de nas dgra bo bsgral ba ni: hūm̐ yak+ṣa kā la thun thun dgra bo bhan+dha bhan+dha baṃ ril kham myog ma tri ya ma dgra bo'i tsit+ta la rbad rbad: de nas gtub pa ni: oṃ ya ma baṃ log pra ha si ta dgra bo mā ra ya rbad rbad nṛ tri myog thuṃ thib rtsa shig shig: dgra bo bsreg pa ni: oṃ raṃ shag kā la ki kang ya ma dun dun dgra bo raṃ ha la raṃ ha la rbad rbad: dgra bo mnan pa ni: oṃ yak+sha mā ra ya tri hur hur thuṃ thuṃ dgra sri satwaṃ bha ya nan: zhes sngags rnams skabs dang bstun te liṅga bsgral zhing gtor ma la bran: gzhan mnan gtad la sogs zhal du shes: de nas tha tshig bsgrag cing gtor ma 'bul ba ni: thun gtor la dgra bo 'gugs shing : hūm̐: sngon tshe rdor 'chang shāka thub bka': bar du gsang bdag pad 'byung bka': ci ltar khas blangs dam bcas bzhin: dam tshig dus la ma 'da' bar: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: gdug pa'i dam nyams myur du sgrol: hūm̐: ki kang nag po dgra la bh+yoḥ bya rog gdong can dgra la bh+yoḥ khra tsha sgra gcan dgra la bh+yoḥ stobs ldan ljang sngon dgra la bh+yoḥ gza' brgyad gdong mo dgra la bh+yoḥ lha srin sde brgyad dgra la bh+yoḥ yang 'khor ru 'dren dgra la bh+yoḥ dgra bo'i sha khrag don snying rol: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hrī rā hu la ki kang gra ha na ga raṃ wa nā ya i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: dgra bo byad ma'i snying la bh+yo bh+yoḥ sha la rbad rbad: rus pa la gtub gtub:

srog la rngub rngub: thun thun ha ya de sha de sha rbad bh+yoḥ zhes gtor ma dgra phyogs su 'phang : dmod pa bor: thal mo brdab: sgrub pa'i skabs yin na srog yig dang bla rten 'chang : rjes bsngo smon bya: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra pad+ma thod phreng gis: phyi rabs bstan dgra bsgral ba dang : gnyer gtad bka' bstan skyong ba'i phyir: drang srong ki kang sgrub thabs bzhag: ma 'ongs dus kyi tha ma la: las 'phro can dang 'phrad bar shog: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas lcags glang lor pad+ma shel phug nas gdan drangs shing shog ser las zhal bshus so// // ༈ yang phur gter srung btsan gyi bskul ni/ hūm̐: bskul lo bzhengs shig gnod sbyin mthu bo che: gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa skyongs: sngags 'chang rig 'dzin bdag gi phrin las sgrubs: bdag gi nor dang ka cha'i phyir la 'brongs: bdag la 'gras pa'i dam nyams dgra bo la: mi rung cho 'phrul sna dgu'i ltas ngan thongs: wa la sprel zhon mang po'i sgo khyim khongs: a tsar mon pas me 'bud ran 'thag skor: bya rog 'ug pas sgo rtsar skad ngan sgrogs: ming nas bos la bshan pa'i ki sgra sgrogs: mdze long zha bos cho nge ngu brang rdungs: srod la sngangs skrag smyo 'bog snying rlung 'gyed: gcer bu skra dmar gzengs pas sa gzhi khongs: zangs lcags 'phar spyang mang pos za kha ston: lha yi btsan rgod 'bum gyis bka' chad phob: gshin rje'i btsan rgod 'bum gyis khram la thob: ma mo'i btsan rgod 'bum gyis dmar yams thongs: bdud kyi btsan rgod 'bum gyis zhags pas chings: shel ging btsan rgod 'bum gyis snyo 'bog thongs: bshan pa'i btsan rgod 'bum gyis sho rdel sprugs: gnod sbyin btsan rgod 'bum gyis za kha ston: klu yi btsan rgod 'bum gyis mdze char phob: dgra lha'i btsan rgod 'bum gyis thog mda' rdegs: gza' yi btsan rgod 'bum gyis steng grib byos:

dam can btsan rgod 'bum gyis khang khyim dkrugs: rmu yi btsan rgod 'bum gyis gnam rdo brobs: yul lha'i btsan rgod 'bum gyis dgra mkhar snubs: chos shig chos shig bshan pa dmag la chos: nyes can dam nyams dgra bo sdig can 'di: lo zla zhag dus ma bsrings myur du sgrol: sha zo khrag 'thung dbang po phye mar shigs: choms shig thul cig ming yang med par mdzod: gdug cing sdang ba'i dam nyams dgra bo 'di: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di dang mnyam por bzhes: gsol cig rol cig tshims par bzhes su gsol: om̐ tha ra ha sha traṃ pi tsi pi tsi ru tra la ma ra ma ra trig trig myog myog thum thum dgra bo'i sha khrag dbang po lnga la kha kha khā hi: braṃ braṃ tre'u tre'u gur len gur len rgyug rgyug dgra bo'i snying la rgyug: srog la rgyug: khrag rtsa la rgyug: khaṃ maṃ shaṃ trig bh+yo bh+yoḥ zlog zlog: ces pas gtor ma dgra phyogs su kha bstan la 'phangs: thal mo brdab dar nag g.yab dmod pa bor dmigs pa ni: btsan gyi rgyal po me 'od gdong gis sde brgyad kyi dmag sna khrid nas dgra bo'i yul zhing khang khyim bcom nas zhal du bstabs te ming yang med par bgyis par bsgom: 'di nyid shin tu do mi gal na 'phang bar mi bya: chad mdo'i mtshams nas 'bul: nges par bskul nas bsgrigs chag bzhin du bshangs: 'di nyid thun mong ma yin pa'i chos skyong myur mgyogs can te: bshan pa spu bdun zla skyong zer: rol pa skya bdun: jag pa me len spun bdun: btsan dmar spun bdun: zangs ber spun bdun: tsi'u ber dmar po spun bdun: gnod sbyin spun bdun: a bswe spun bdun: mgar ba spun bdun: dpe har spun bdun: sogs lugs gang drangs kyang don la gnas kyi khyad par dang gang zag gis mtshan gsol ba'i khyad chos so: don la dbang chen hūm̐ ka'i sprul pa kho na'o: 'di zhi ba ltar bsgrub na tshangs pa yin: rgyas pa ltar bsgrub na nor bdag gnod sbyin mdung dmar can yin:

dbang ltar bsgrub na rta mchog rol pa yin: drag po ltar bsgrub na btsan rgod yin: dregs pa ltar bsgrub na bshan pa mi gzan bya ba yin: yang phur gyi bka' srung skabs rdo rje theg pa'i gral du tshud cing 'jig rten pa yang cung zad du 'dres: ci zhe na: rgyud srung dang gter srung gi khyad par yin: de ltar gnod sbyin chen po'i las bskul khrigs su bsdebs pa ste nges par bstan pa'o: sa ma ya: e maḥ kho mo bdag 'dra ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis: yang phur gus pa'i bla med bka' bsrung phyir: lcags shog sngon po nyer gcig logs su bris: ma 'ongs yang mtha' dus kyi mtha' ma ru: skal ldan las 'phro can gyis 'byin pa'i tshe: sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba'i bya ra shog: me 'od gdong khyod gsang sngags bstan pa skyongs: bka' yi rgya srungs mi nub-i atsha rgya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gtad rgya: man+t+ra dha ra ka ma la ni dī pa ti ram marga ṭa'i lo ru mon yul sha 'ug stag sgo nas gdan drangs shing me mo lug lor bdud 'dul gsang sngags gling du shog ser nas mkha' 'gro'i brda sum 'gyur ltar zhal bshus so// // ༈ btsan gsol bstan dgra thal 'byin las byung ba'i bskul ni/ dgos pa'i dus su dgra la rbad/ /rak+ta 'thor zhing zhing lpags rdeb/ /dmar chen gtor zor 'gugs bstim bsngo/ /ngar dang ldan pas 'di skad gyer/ hūm̐ bh+yo/ phyogs phyogs dag kyang pha ki na/ /nyi ma nub phyogs pha ki na/ /dur khrod chen po he chen brdal/ /'jigs su rung ba bskal pa yi/ /me chen 'bar zhing rlung nag 'tshub/ /rak+ta'i rgya mtsho rba rlabs 'phyo/ /mi ro rta ro gcal du bkram/ /sha za ro langs ha ha dgod/ /nad mtshon dug gi bu yug 'tshub/ /gnam lcags rdo rje'i thog ser 'bebs/ /'jigs pa'i ro langs srin po'i tshogs/ /ngoms pa med pa sha la za/ khros pa'i btsan dmag dung phyur rnams/ /snying rje med par gsod la dga'/

/bswe yi sku mkhar rab 'jigs pa/ /mi mgo rta mgos ha sgra sgrogs/ /btsan bya dgra bo'i srog la 'jums/ /btsan khyis dgra bo'i rus pa mur/ /pho nyas dam nyams bla la rku/ /shan pas dgra bo'i srog dbugs sdus/ /'jigs su rung ba'i gnas mchog nas/ /btsan dmar ging chen sku bskyod 'tshal/ /har len chen po dgra la rgyugs/ /btsan dmag stong sde dgra la bh+yo/ /de ring drag po'i phrin las 'di/ /dus la bab bo sa ma ya/ hūm̐/ bzhengs shig btsan rgod 'bar ba'i tshogs/ /ma ri rtse yi dur khrod nas/ /srog gzan chen po dgra la bh+yo/ /bid+yot+ta nas skur bzhengs la/ /btsan rgod me 'od dgra la chos/ /yang le shod nas skur bzhengs la/ /btsan rgod ber ma dgra la chos/ /chu mig gnas nas skur bzhengs la/ /dmar po dpon g.yog dgra la chos/ /sha 'ug brag nas skur bzhengs la/ /beng smug bswe khrab dgra la chos/ /sham bha la nas skur bzhengs la/ /rol pa mi gzan dgra la chos/ /ti se gangs nas skur bzhengs la/ /rdo rje thog 'bebs dgra la chos/ /mchims phu brag nas skur bzhengs la/ /shan pa mig dmar dgra la chos/ /yang rdzong gnas nas skur bzhengs la/ /gnyan stag dmar po dgra la chos/ /tsā ri tra nas skur bzhengs la/ /lho btsan nag po dgra la chos/ /ti sgro'i gnas nas skur bzhengs la/ /btsan rgod sog ra dgra la chos/ /dbu ru stod nas skur bzhengs la/ /drag po zla skyong dgra la chos/ /sham po'i gnas nas skur bzhengs la/ /myur len har ting dgra la chos/ /pad+ma bkod nas skur bzhengs la/ /'bar ba khrag 'thung dgra la chos/ /gze rgyal gnas nas skur bzhengs la/ /rdo rje 'bar ba dgra la chos/ /zangs ri rtse dgu'i gnas mchog nas/ /beg rtse chen po dgra la chos/ kha ba dkar nas skur bzhengs la/ /shan pa rlung dmar dgra la chos/ /gtsug lag gnas nas skur bzhengs la/ /rdo rje legs pa dgra la chos/ /dkor khang gnas nas skur bzhengs la/ /shel ging smug po dgra la chos/

/dam tshig gnas nas skur bzhengs la/ /btsan 'khor stong sde dgra la chos/ /srid gsum gnas nas skur bzhengs la/ /yang 'khor sde brgyad dgra la chos/ /pad+ma 'byung gnas spyan snga ru/ /rnal 'byor skyong ba'i tha tshig gnyan/ /bstan dgra sgrol bar khas blangs ltar/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi phrin las sgrubs/ /nyam chung bdag gi gzu dpang mdzod/ /zol med nges pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /'gro don byang chub sgrub pa la/ /bdud dgra dam sris rtag tu 'tshe/ /dung ltar dkar kyang mun ltar gtibs/ /nyi ltar gsal yang sprin ltar bsgribs/ /char ltar babs kyang rlung ltar 'tshubs/ /chos ltar bsgrubs kyang sdig ltar smod/ /phan lan gnod kyi gzhi ta re/ /bzang len ngan gyis yang yang gzhal/ /nyes med chad pa gcod pa'i dgra/ /dam can rgya mtsho'i dgongs mdzod cig /btsan rgod mig gis ma mthong sam/ /nyam thag skyob par mi mdzad dam/ /bdag ni ma nyes dgra bo nyes/ /drang mkhan mngon shes can gyis mdzod/ /rnal 'byor byang chub sgrub pa la/ /bsam ngan sbyor rtsub khyad gsod byed/ /mi la lha med zer nas brnyas/ /lha la mthu med zer nas smod/ /dge 'dun 'du sgo dkor nor phrogs/ /zhing khang ri rgya rlung rgya phral/ /gdug cing sdang sems 'chang ba'i dgra/ /gnam sa ri gling 'jig rten khams/ /nyi zla chos bon srung ma'i skyabs/ /sa 'og sa steng gar gnas kyang*/ /lha btsan drag pos sngon nas khrid/ /bdud btsan drag pos rgyab nas ded/ /klu btsan 'bum gyis byad du chugs/ /shel ging btsan gyis smyo 'bog thongs/ /btsan rgod 'bum gyis dgra mkhar shigs/ /chos shig shan pa las la rgyugs/ /mgyogs pa mtshal mdog rta yang rtod/ /go khrab gyon la rno mtshon rdor/ khros pa'i sdang mig glog 'od 'khyugs/ /rngam pa'i zhal gdongs khrag rgyun phob/ /'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra di ri ri/ /dug gsum khong nas za zhing 'khrugs/ /stong gsum 'jig rten bla 'og sgyur/

khyed rnams thugs dam gnad nas bskul/ /las ngan sdang byed dgra bo rnams/ /yar gyi srog sgo dmar po phyes/ /mar gyi dbugs sgo skya bo phyes/ /don snying dmar po spar gyis thob/ /gnam gyi 'ju dag dum bur chod/ /sa yi rten phur rmang nas phud/ /sha rus don snying dbang po lnga/ /gtor ma 'di dang mnyam du bzhes/ /gnod cing 'tshe ba'i dgra bo rnams/ /ming rus rjes shul med par mdzod/ /sgrol dang bsgral bya mi dmigs pas/ /bdag 'dzin rnam rtog rang sar grol/ /byams pa chen pos sgrol ba'i las/ /mngon spyod drag pos phrin las mdzod/ oṃ shu la me ru tse sa ma yaḥ dgra bo byad ma nṛ tri hur thuṃ dza dzaḥ dgra bo byad ma'i srog tsa la bh+yo bh+yoḥ snying la rbad rbadaḥ hrig hrigaḥ shag shagaḥ myog myogaḥ mā ra ya dgra bgegs kyi māṃ sa la khā hi/ rak+ta la khā hi/ tsit+ta la khā hi/ gtor ma dgra bo'i phyogs su 'phangs dmod pa bor zhing thal mo brdab/ /des ni bstan dgra lhag med 'joms/ /brtan bzhugs gshegs gsol gang 'os bya/ /shis pa brjod cing me tog 'thor/ /gter chen gnam lcags me 'bar gyi/ /yang phur bstan srung btsan rgod kyi/ /mchod bstod khrigs su bsdebs pa 'di/ /btsan rgod rta shod shwa ri'i 'gram/ /rlangs ban blo gros rab 'phel gyis/ /dgos pa'i dbang gis shar mar bris/ /bdud kyi ru dar bsnyil ba dang*/ /dge bas 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /he ru ka dpal myur thob shog /sarba sid+dhi dza yan+tu// // ༈ rgyal po'i bskul ni/ gtor ma bdud rtsis bran la de nas cung zad dpag la/ hūm̐/ dgung sngon nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus/ /rin chen 'phrul gyi lding khang nas/ /chos rgyal chen po skur bzhengs shig /gnod sbyin dpe har skur bzhengs shig /srog bdag shel ging skur bzhengs shig /dkor bdag chen po skur bzhengs shig /sgom grwa'i srung ma skur bzhengs shig /ru 'dren sprul pa'i skur bzhengs shig

/bzhengs nas bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod/ hūm̐/ sngon tshe slob dpon pad+ma dang*/ /slob ma rlangs chen dpal seng gis/ /dregs pa kun 'dul dkyil 'khor du/ /sde brgyad thams cad dam la btags/ /nga ni slob dpon de yi gdung*/ khyod ni dregs pa de yi rigs/ /sngon gyi tha tshig ci bzhin du/ /dgyes pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la/ /gsang sngags gnyan gyi mel tshe sgron/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i sku tshe srings/ /rig 'dzin bdag gi phrin las sgrubs/ /la chu 'phrang la sgrol 'don mdzod/ /'dod rgu longs spyod dbang du sdus/ /ka cha dkor nor gnyer kha skyongs/ /lha 'dre mi gsum dung dung skyed/ /'dzam gling kun gyi bsod nams khug /mtho ba gnam la 'ju thag rkyongs/ /chags pa sa la rten phur tshugs/ /gtsug lag chos 'khor gnyan po srungs/ /bran g.yog dam nyams rings su chugs/ /sdang ba'i dgra la smyo 'bog thongs/ /phyugs kyi god kha zhi bar gyis/ /dgra rkun jag pa'i za kha chings/ /gling bzhi mi kha'i dbang po snub/ /dkor nor rnams kyi phyi la 'brongs/ /phyogs kyi dgra bo'i steng du rgyugs/ /yul mi bsam ngan steng du rgyugs/ /slob ma dam nyams steng du rgyugs/ /bran g.yog ngo log steng du rgyugs/ /rdzas spyad 'phrog pa'i steng du rgyugs/ /dgra la cho 'phrul sna tshogs thongs/ /mngon spyod las kun bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /mthun rdzas dgyes pa'i mchod pa dang*/ /gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la/ /shel ging rgyal po las la chos/ /so sor phrin las bcol ba bzhin/ /skad cig nyid la 'grub par mdzod/ om̐ ru she la ging ka ra ya yak+sha rā dza sarba sa ma ya i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes gtor ma stegs kyi khar 'bul/ rten bskyed pa'ang rang bzhin mi dmigs pa'i klong du gshegs/ sgrub pa pos phrin las gang smod kyi dmigs pa bya/ khyad par rgyal po'i cho 'phrul lam/ rnal 'byor pa bdag la g.yang sdud dgos pa dang*/

yul mi nang tshan gyis dgra byung na gsol mchod 'di gnad shin tu che/ yang ja chang la 'dre chag zhugs pa'am/ god kha snod spyad la chag grum mang ba'am/ srid nyams pa la nges par phan no/ 'di ni slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas dang chos rgyal gyi dkor bdag yin pas thun mong ma yin pa nus pa che/ mchod pa'i dus ni tshes bcu dang dus chen la shin tu legs so/ zhes rgyal po dpe dkar kyi gsol mchod bsdus pa khol phyung 'di ni/ bha ta hor gyi dkor bdag yin zer ba mngon rtogs ltar lan mang zhig byung nas bskul ba dang*/ nang chas 'ga' zhig chud zos 'gro ba la brten nas/ khyad par rang re mi nyam chung la chos skyong zhe nag pa gcig med na mi thams cad kyis dbang yod a re tsha ba yin mdog kha bo che 'dug pas/ dgos pa 'dra byung na snyam ste/ zob po gter smyon gnam lcags rdo rjes lung rigs kyi rnam bshad la sbyangs pa'i gtan tshigs khrigs chags su mkhas par mi snang rung*/ blo bzo 'dra zhig bgyis te bdud 'dul gsang sngags chos gling du sbyar ba'o/ yi ge pa ni nyid kyi slob bu sngags btsun a nan+ta ma tis bris pa gsang sngags bstan pa mi nub cing phyogs mthar rgyas shing yun du brtan pa dang*/ lhag par dam ldan slob ma spel zhing bsam pa'i don kun thogs med 'grub pa dang ma rig log lta bdud kyi rigs kyi mgo bo 'gems pa'i rgyur gyur cig /dge'o// // ༈ chos skyong chen po tsi'u dmar po'i drag bskul ni/ dmar gtor btegs la/ rak+tas bran/ ru mtshon phyar nas/ dzaḥ phyogs phyogs de ni pha ki na/ /nyi ma lho phyogs pha ki na/ /btsan yul zangs thang dmar po nas/ /brag dmar gnam du zengs se zeng*/ /zangs mkhar smug po brjid re che/ /bswe yi sgo mo wangs se wang*/ /gser gyi ru bzhi khrigs se khrig /zangs kyi rlung dmar 'u ru ru/ /bswe yi 'brug stong khra la la/ /bswe yi glog zhags khyugs se khyug

/me yi ser ba sha ra ra/ /gnam lcags thog mda' chems se chem/ /bya dmar klad du kyi li li/ khrag mchod dmar chen 'khyil ba'i dbus/ /mi ro rta ro bcal bkram steng*/ /btsan gyi dad dpon mthu bo che/ /ma thogs gnas 'di spyan 'dren no/ /rak+ta khrag gi gser skyems bzhes/ /dgra sha don snying mchod pa bzhes/ /rnal 'byor bdag la dgra byung na/ /pha bu yin kyang sgrol la shog /sngon tshe o rgyan pad+ma'i drung*/ /dpal gyi bsam yas dbu rtse ru/ /ji ltar khas blangs dam bca' dgongs/ /gnod sbyin tsi'u dmar dgra la rbad/ /'bar ba spun bdun dgra la rbad/ /bskul lo drag po las la bskul/ /rbad do dgra bgegs steng du rbad/ /chod cig dgra bgegs srog rtsa chod/ /dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /bos pa'i tshe na snyan ma sra/ /g.yab pa'i tshe na spyan ma yengs/ /mchod pa'i tshe na ru ma ngar/ /bsten pa'i tshe na phrag ma dog /rbad pa'i tshe na mthu ma chung*/ /mngags pa'i tshe na las ma yengs/ /dgra bgegs mi nor rigs rgyud kyi/ /lnga phung thal ba rdul du rlogs/ /pho rgyud rnams kyi srog rtsa chod/ /mo rgyud rnams kyi mngal nas skoms/ /rigs rgyud mi rabs rtsad nas chod/ /sgo nor god dang lhog pas sod/ /yul zhing lo tog ser bas chom/ /dmag dpung bskyed la ru mtshon phyor/ /sdang byed dgra dang gnod byed bgegs/ /snga dgra lag tu brdar ba dang*/ /phyi dgra yid la sems pa dang*/ /da dgra thad du langs pa'i tshogs/ /srog bdag khyod la gnyer du gtad/ /mthu stobs nus rtsal ma chung bar/ /phrin las myur mgyogs drag po yis/ /bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ /ces gtor ma dgra phyogs su 'phang*/ bden brdar dmod bcol bya/ de ltar dam can chos skyong chen po mchod pa'i thabs/ 'di rgya dpe dang bstun rang gi chos srid bstan pa rgyas pa'i slad du g.yar dam bgyis te/ chos skyong nyid kyis khas blangs phrin las chen po dus las mi g.yel dam bca' sngon nas mdzad pa'i phyir/

slad nas kyang phrin las bcol ba'i ched kho bo sngags 'chang bde chen rdo rjes bris/ ༈ 'jam dpal dug ri me 'bar gyi gter srung las bskul ni/ bskul ba'i phrin las gnas bskyod 'tshal: lha yi dge bsnyen dung thod can: lha dmag ru mtshon lhabs se lhab: de ring dgra la dmag dpung skyed: dri za'i dge bsnyen zur phud can: lha min dal kha kyi li li: de ring dgra la dmag dpung skyed: mkhar chu'i dge bsnyen smyo kha ba: klu yi pho nya phyu ru ru: de ring dgra la dmag dpung skyed: lho yi dge bsnyen zla ba'i gdong : bdud dmag jag pa sha ra ra: de ring dgra la dmag dpung skyed: pho mar dge bsnyen mgo dgu ba: dmu yi las byed nyi li li: de ring dgra la dmag dpung skyed: seng rdzong dge bsnyen zu ra ba: btsan gyi ling pa tshubs se tshub: de ring dgra la dmag dpung skyed: mon kha'i dge bsnyen bkrag med pa: sa bdag gtad khram thibs se thib: de ring dgra la dmag dpung skyed: lci shod dge bsnyen rdo rje rgyal: gnyan gyi las byed khyugs se khyug: de ring dgra la dmag dpung skyed: ngom gyi dge bsnyen bdud 'joms pa: gza' yi las byed nyi li li: de ring dgra la dmag dpung skyed: lci yi dge bsnyen zla skyong ba: gnam smin bu yug thibs se thib: de ring dgra la dmag dpung skyed: spu rong dge bsnyen dregs pa can: dregs pa'i bu mo las la 'gyed: de ring dgra la dmag dpung skyed: mtsho nag dge bsnyen nya nag gdong : klu gnyan sa bdag las la bskul: de ring dgra la dmag dpung skyed: ya bdud mkha' la 'gyu ba'i tshe: skya rengs dkar po'i rta la zhon: de ring dgra la dmag dpung skyed: ma bdud sa la rgyu ba'i tshe: smag rum mun pa'i rta la zhon: de ring dgra la dmag dpung skyed: spyi bdud bar la 'gyu ba'i tshe: dmar thag nyi ma'i zer la zhon: de ring dgra la dmag dpung skyed: skye 'gro srog la dbang sgyur tshe:

'brug glog thog gi rta la zhon: de ring dgra la dmag dpung skyed: nyams pa'i dgra bo bsgral ba'i tshe: lhog yams dmar nad char du 'bebs: de ring dgra la dmag dpung skyed: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: gdug pa'i byad ma sdig can la: mdze dmar me ltar 'bar du chug: mdze skya rlung ltar 'tshubs su chug: dmu chu rdzing ltar 'khyil du chug: zha grum rdul ltar nyil du chug: dmigs pa'i dgra bo las ngan gyi: lus la mdze rigs bco brgyad thob: byad ma mi rabs phung bar gyis: ka cha dkor nor phyi la rgyugs: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: klu bdud dmag tshogs dgra la chos: dgra bo'i yul khams phung bar gy-is: mngon spyod rtags dang mthun par mdzod: gang bcol las rnams myur du sgrubs: om̐ nā ga rak+sha he traṃ ka la nag po ti pa ra tsa tri yang trag rak+sha sha ya bh+yo bh+yoḥ nā ga ti pa ye dun dun dgra bo'i srog la bh+yoḥ sha khrag la bh+yo tsa trum trig thun nā ga shag thun hi pra ma nan haṃ he phu lu bh+yo bh+yo dgra la bh+yo bh+yoḥ dgra la zlog zlog: ces thal mo brdab g.yab dar g.yab byad ma sdig can thams cad nges par sgrol ba'i ngan sngags 'dis thams cad phung bar nus so: dus snyigs ma'i skabs su gza' klu dang rgyal po 'di rang chos skyong myur mgyogs che bas: des na phyis 'byung skal ldan rnams kyi snying du chongs shig: ma 'ongs dgra bgegs tshar gcod shog: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: zhes pa 'di sngags 'chang gnam lcags rdo rje'i tho lum gyis lcags glang lor khrom gzigs dge bsnyen gyi pho brang bar ma rgyab ri rdo rje btsan drag gi mgul nas gdan drangs shing chu stag lor shog ser nas bsgyur ba'o/ mthar gong gsal ltar gtor bskul gnam lcags thog mda'i rjes su gtor ma 'phang ngam bsregs/ yang na rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i rjes gtsang sar gshegs/ rjes kyi bya ba ni gong ltar mtshungs so/

༈ dang po tshogs byin brlab ni/ hūm̐: rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis: cho 'phrul sgyu ma'i tshogs rdzas nyid: dngos 'dzin mi dmigs stong par sbyangs: oṃ āḥhūm̐: gnyis pa tshogs zhing spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐: dpal chen khro rgyal lha tshogs rnams: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren no: deng 'dir dkyil 'khor byin chen phob: sgrub la dbang bskur mchog thun stsol: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥdzaḥ gsum pa tshogs phud 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: che mchog dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: skye med ngang la thugs dam bskang : shes sgrib ka dag klong du bshags: oṃ ga ṇa tsakra khā hi: badz+ra sa ma shud+dhe āḥ bzhi pa tshogs bsgral ni/ hūm̐: mdun du lcags snod gru gsum nang : dmigs bya dgra bgegs myur du khug: gnod byed srog la kī la ya: gtub cing khro rgyal zhal du 'bul: oṃ āḥhūm̐ dgra bgegs kyi ma hā rak+ta māṃ sa tsit+ta go ro tsa na khā hi: dngos grub blangs shing tshogs la rol/ lnga pa lhag ma 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: dpal gyi bka' nyan bye ba 'bum: lhag ma'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: gdug pa'i dgra bgegs zhal du bzhes: oṃ uts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba liṃ ta khā hi: drug pa bskul ni/ hūm̐: dpal chen lha tshogs dbyings nas bzhengs: rig 'dzin bdag la byin gyis rlobs: che btsan mthu yi gzi byin bskyed: dmar chen gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dgra la zor gyi las mdzod cig: oṃ ma hā kro ta he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭḥ i daṃ ba liṃ ta khā hi: bdun pa chad mdo ni/ hūm̐: gsang chen ma la mchims phu ru: rgyal kun 'dus pa yab yum gyis: yang phur dkyil 'khor zhal phye tshe: gter srung khas blangs chad mdo bzhin: gtor ma bzhes la tha tshig mdzod: oṃ kro ta kro ti sarba ba liṃ ta khā hi: brgyad pa brtan ma skyong ba ni/ hūm̐: bod skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis tshogs: lhab lhub rgyan ldan gar mkhan mas: mchod gtor bzhes la phrin las mdzod:

dgu pa rta bro brdung ba ni/ hūm̐: stong gsum ru tra mnan pa'i bro: khro bo khro mos chem chem brdungs: mnan no nam yang ldang zhig: oṃ āḥnan: hūm̐ nan: mā ra ya nan: bcu pa dngos grub len pa ni/ hūm̐: zab dbyings dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: tshe chos zas nor snyan grags dpal: brtan g.yo mchog thun dngos grub stsol: oṃ sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: a bhi ṣiñtsa mam̐: bcu gcig bkra shis brjod pa ni/ hūm̐: chos dbyings klong dgu'i gter chen gyis: zab rgyas 'gro kun smin mdzad pa: deng 'dir bkra shis bde legs shog: bcu gnyis pa dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni/ hūm̐: mi dmigs dkyil 'khor ka dag dbyings: rang bzhin ye shes klong du ho: a a āḥ bcu gsum pa dge ba bsngo ba ni/ rnam dkar dge tshogs rgya mtsho nyid: mtha' yas sangs rgyas 'thob phyir bsngo: bde dge mchog gsum 'dus pa yi: thugs rje'i smon lam de 'grub shog: ces bkra shis bsngo smon rgyas par bya'o: bar skabs kyi yig chung rnams mchan bu'i tshul du gnam lcags gsang sngags bstan 'dzin pas kha sab bgyis pa'o/ sa ma ya: e ma bdag 'dra pad 'byung gis: snying thig yid bzhin nor bu bzhag: yang gsang shog dril mgul khug ma: mthong thos dran reg byang chub thob: mig ltar gces la snying ltar chongs: thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: gter rgya 'di la bya ra gyis: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo pad+ma gter bdag gling pas mon sha 'ug stag sgo nas gdan drangs shing gsang sngags chos gling du shog ser nas bod yig tu zhal bshus so/
